chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 24. Umzimba Wezilwane: Isakhiwo Nomsebenzi Oyisisekelo | 24.0 Isingeniso
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 24. Umzimba Wezilwane: Isakhiwo Nomsebenzi Oyisisekelo | 24.0 Isingeniso
chapterContent:
Izakhiwo zezilwane zakhiwa izicubu eziyinhloko ezakha izitho eziyinkimbinkimbi kakhulu kanye nezinhlelo zezitho. I-Homeostasis ivumela isilwane ukuthi silondoloze ibhalansi phakathi kwezimo zaso zangaphakathi nezangaphandle.

 Impungushe yase-arctic iyisibonelo sesilwane esiyinkimbinkimbi esivumelana kahle nendawo yaso futhi sibonisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwesimo nomsebenzi wesilwane. Ngokusho kwabacwaningi, izilwane ezaziphila eminyakeni eyizigidi edlule ezintabeni zaseHimalaya zaseTibet zingokhokho bezilwane eziningi zanamuhla ezihlala isikhathi eside. Isibonelo, uhlobo lwempungushe yaseTibet kusukela eminyakeni eyizigidi ezi-3-5 edlule luyidlozi lempungushe yase-arctic. Bheka Umfanekiso 24.1
answer1: Izicubu eziyinhloko ezihlangana ukuze zakhe izitho zomzimba nezinhlelo zezitho zomzimba
question2: Kuyini i-homeostasis?
answer2: Inqubo lapho isilwane sigcina khona indawo yangaphakathi ezinzile naphezu kwezinguquko zangaphandle
question3: Kungani impungushe yase-Arctic isetshenziswa njengesibonelo kulesi singeniso?
answer3: Kubonisa indlela isakhiwo sezilwane kanye nomsebenzi wazo okuhambisana ngayo nendawo ezungezile
distractor3a: Yisilwane esincelisayo esikhulu kunazo zonke e-Arctic
question4: Ngokusho kwabacwaningi, okhokho bezilwane eziningi ezazihlala isikhathi eside babehlala kuphi izigidi zeminyaka edlule?
question5: Cishe ukhokho wempungushe yase-Arctic wahlala nini?
question6: Yisiphi isilwane sasendulo esibhekwa njengokhokho wempungushe yesimanje yase-Arctic?

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 24. Umzimba Wezilwane: Isakhiwo Nomsebenzi Oyisisekelo | 24.1 Isakhiwo Nomsebenzi Wezilwane | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 24. Umzimba Wezilwane: Isakhiwo Nomsebenzi Oyisisekelo | 24.1 Isakhiwo Nomsebenzi Wezilwane | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent:
Njengoba usufundile, amangqamuzana akhethekile emzimbeni wesilwane ahlelwe ngezicubu, izitho zomzimba, kanye nezinhlelo zezitho zomzimba, ezenza imisebenzi yendawo ibe yindawo efanele, njengokugaya ukudla kanye nokususa imfucuza. Njengoba sihlola ulwazi olukulesi sigaba, ukugxila kwethu okuyinhloko yi-homeostasis—ikhono lokugcina ukulingana okuguquguqukayo endaweni ethile. Izilwane zidinga ukugcina "izindawo zazo zangaphakathi"ezijwayelekile ngenkathi zisabela ezinguqukweni zangaphandle zemvelo.

 Esifundweni sethu sebhayoloji kuze kube manje, sibone izibonelo eziningi zobudlelwano besakhiwo nomsebenzi, futhi ukwakheka komzimba wesilwane akuhlukile. Ubuchwepheshe ezilwaneni ezinamaseli amaningi kunegalelo ekusebenzeni kahle kwezinqubo zamaseli. Isibonelo, izilwane kumele zikwazi ukuthola izakhamzimba nokususa imfucuza, futhi amaseli asemathunjini amancane avumela ukusabalala. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ubudlelwano phakathi kwesilinganiso se-metabolic kanye nobunzima bomzimba buvame ukuba yinto ephambene: Uma isilwane sincane, kulapho i-metabolism yaso iphakama khona, lapho amagundane enesilinganiso se-metabolic esiphezulu kunezindlovu. Ngenxa yokuthi amagundane anesilinganiso esikhulu sendawo ebusweni kuya kuvolumu ngobuningi bawo kunezilwane ezinkulu, alahlekelwa ukushisa ngesivinini esikhulu futhi, ngenxa yalokho, adinga amandla engeziwe ukuze alondoloze izinga lokushisa lomzimba elihlala njalo.

 Sikhuluma ngokushisa, sifunde ukuthi izinga lokushisa lomzimba lezilwane ezinama-ectothermic liyahlukahluka ngokuya ngokushisa kwendawo. Lapho izinyoka zidinga ukufudumala, zijabulela ilanga; lapho zidinga ukupholisa, ziya emthunzini. Ezinye izilwane, kufaka phakathi amagundane, Ama-kangaroo nabantu, asebenza endothermic ngoba ayakwazi ukugcina izinga lokushisa lomzimba langaphakathi elingaguquki naphezu kwamazinga okushisa emvelo; isibonelo, ukuthuthumela kudala ukushisa, kanti ukujuluka kubuyisela izinga lokushisa lomzimba wethu endaweni yalo evamile engu-37◦C. Sizohlola ukulawulwa kwalezi zimpendulo ngokuningiliziwe esigabeni se-Homeostasis.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyisiwe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo echazwe ku-Big Idea 2 yohlaka lwekharikhulamu ye-AP® Biology. Izinhloso Zokufunda ze-AP® ezibalwe kuhlaka lwekharikhulamu zinikeza isisekelo esicacile senkambo ye-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekubuzeni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo nomunye noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yeSayensi eyisikhombisa.

 I-Big Idea 2
Izinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo zisebenzisa amandla amahhala kanye namabhlogo okwakha ama-molecule ukuze zikhule, zizale, futhi zilondoloze i-homeostasis enamandla.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 2.A
Ukukhula, ukuzala kanye nokugcinwa kwezinhlelo eziphilayo kudinga amandla amahhala nezinto.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
2.A.1 Zonke izinhlelo eziphilayo zidinga ukufaka amandla amahhala njalo.

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
6.2 Umfundi angakha izincazelo zezehlakalo ngokusekelwe ebufakazini obuvezwa ngemikhuba yesayensi.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
2.1 Umfundi uyakwazi ukuchaza ukuthi izinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo zisebenzisa kanjani amandla amahhala ngokusekelwe kudatha yobufakazi yokuthi zonke izinto eziphilayo zidinga ukufaka amandla angapheli ukuze zilondoloze ukuhleleka, zikhule futhi zizale.

2.A.1 Zonke izinhlelo eziphilayo zidinga ukufaka amandla amahhala njalo.

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
6.1: Umfundi angathethelela izimangalo ngobufakazi.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
2.2 Umfundi uyakwazi ukuthethelela isimangalo sesayensi sokuthi amandla amahhala ayadingeka ukuze izinhlelo eziphilayo zilondoloze ukuhleleka, zikhule noma zizale, kodwa ukuthi kukhona amasu amaningi ezinhlelweni eziphilayo ezahlukene.

2.A.1 Zonke izinhlelo eziphilayo zidinga ukufaka amandla amahhala njalo.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile

Ukuzijwayeza Kwesayensi

 Inhloso Yokufunda
2.36 Umfundi uyakwazi ukusekela izimangalo zesayensi ngobufakazi ukukhombisa ukuthi isikhathi nokuhlanganiswa kwemicimbi yemvelo kuhilela kanjani ukulawulwa.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
2.A.1 Zonke izinhlelo eziphilayo zidinga ukufakwa njalo kwamandla amahhala.

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
7.2 Umfundi angaxhumanisa imiqondo ngaphakathi nangaphandle kwesizinda (izizinda) ukuze ahlanganise noma achaze ukuqonda okuhlala njalo kanye/noma imibono emikhulu.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
2.37 Umfundi uyakwazi ukuxhumanisa imiqondo echaza izindlela ezilawula isikhathi kanye nokuhlanganiswa kwemicimbi yemvelo.

 Izilwane ziyahlukahluka ngesimo kanye nomsebenzi. Kusukela esiponji kuya esibungwini kuya embuzini, into ephilayo inohlelo lomzimba oluhlukile olukhawulela ubukhulu bayo kanye nesimo sayo. Imizimba yezilwane nayo iklanyelwe ukusebenzisana nezindawo zayo, kungaba olwandle olujulile, emphemeni wehlathi, noma ehlane. Ngakho-ke, ulwazi oluningi mayelana nesakhiwo somzimba wento ephilayo (i-anatomy) kanye nomsebenzi wamaseli ayo, izicubu kanye nezitho zomzimba (i-physiology) lungafundwa ngokutadisha leyo ndawo ephilayo
answer1: Ikhono lokugcina ukulingana okuguquguqukayo endaweni ethile naphezu kwezinguquko zangaphakathi nezangaphandle
question2: Kungani amangqamuzana akhethekile ehlelwe abe izicubu, izitho zomzimba, kanye nezinhlelo zezitho zomzimba?
answer2: Ukuthola indawo efanele nokwenza imisebenzi ethile
question3: Izinga lokuguqulwa kwe-metabolic lihlobene kanjani nobunzima bomzimba ezilwaneni?
answer3: Izilwane ezincane ngokuvamile zinezinga eliphezulu lokugaya ukudla kunezilwane ezinkulu
distractor3a: Izilwane ezinkulu zihlala zinezinga eliphezulu lokugaya ukudla
distractor3c: Zonke izilwane zinesilinganiso esifanayo sokuguqulwa kwezakhi zomzimba kungakhathaliseki ukuthi zingakanani
question4: Kungani amagundane edinga amandla amaningi ngeyunithi ngayinye yesisindo somzimba kunezindlovu?
answer4: Ngoba isilinganiso sabo esiphezulu sendawo ebusweni kuya kuvolumu sibenza balahlekelwe ukushisa ngokushesha okukhulu
distractor4b: Ngoba bagcina umoya-mpilo omncane egazini labo
question5: Iyini isilwane esinomoya oshisayo?
answer5: Isilwane esinokushisa komzimba okuhlukahluka kuye ngokushisa kwendawo
distractor5a: Isilwane esihlala sigcina izinga lokushisa lomzimba lingaguquguquki
distractor5b: Isilwane esingakwazi ukulawula indlela esisebenza ngayo
question6: Iyini isilwane esihlala isikhathi eside?
answer6: Isilwane esigcina izinga lokushisa lomzimba langaphakathi lingaguquguquki naphezu kokushintsha kwesimo sendawo
distractor6a: Isilwane esinokushisa komzimba okuhlala kufana nendawo esikuyo
distractor6c: Isilwane esingadingi amandla ukuze kulawulwe izinga lokushisa
question7: Abantu basiza kanjani ukubuyisela izinga lokushisa lomzimba endaweni yalo evamile uma lishisa kakhulu?
question8: Yini engafundwa ngokutadisha indawo yezilwane?
answer8: Ulwazi mayelana nokwakheka komzimba kanye ne-physiology yayo

chapterContent: Izinhlelo zomzimba wezilwane zilandela amaphethini ahleliwe ahlobene nokulingana. Azilingani, ziqondile, noma zimbili ngesimo njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 24.2. Izilwane ezingalingani yizilwane ezingenayo iphethini noma ukulingana; isibonelo sesilwane esingalingani yisponji. Ukulingana kwe-radial, njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 24.2, kuchaza lapho isilwane sinombono wokukhuphuka nokuhla: noma iyiphi indiza esikiwe eceleni kwe-axis yayo ende phakathi kwezinto eziphilayo ikhiqiza izingxenye ezilinganayo, kodwa hhayi uhlangothi oluqondile lwesokudla noma lwesobunxele. Lolu hlelo lutholakala kakhulu ezilwaneni zasemanzini, ikakhulukazi izinto eziphilayo ezizinamathisela esisekelweni, njengedwala noma isikebhe, bese zikhipha ukudla kwazo emanzini azungezile njengoba zigeleza zizungeze izinto eziphilayo. Ukulingana kwezinhlangothi ezimbili kuboniswe esithombeni esifanayo yimbuzi. Imbuzi nayo inengxenye ephezulu nephansi kuyo, kodwa indiza esikiwe kusukela phambili kuya emuva ihlukanisa isilwane zibe izinhlangothi eziqondile zesokudla nesobunxele. Amagama engeziwe asetshenziswa lapho kuchazwe izikhundla emzimbeni angaphambili (ngaphambili), ngemuva (ngemuva), ngemuva (ngasemuva), kanye nangaphakathi (ngasesiswini). Ukulingana kwamacala amabili kutholakala kokubili ezilwaneni ezisemhlabathini kanye nasemanzini; kwenza kube nokwenzeka ukuhambahamba okuphezulu
question1: Yiziphi izinhlobo ezintathu eziyisisekelo zokufana komzimba wesilwane?
answer1: Okungalingani, okuqondile, kanye nokuma okubili
question2: Yisiphi isilwane esiyisibonelo sokungalingani?
question3: Yini echaza ukulingana kwe-radial?
answer3: Noma iyiphi indiza edlula ku-axis ende ikhiqiza izingxenye ezilinganayo
distractor3a: Indiza eyodwa kuphela ehlukanisa umzimba ube yizingxenye ezilinganayo
distractor3b: Umzimba unezinhlangothi ezihlukile kwesokudla nakwesobunxele kuphela
question4: Ukulingana kwemisebe kuvame ukutholakala kuluphi uhlobo lwezilwane?
answer4: Izilwane zasemanzini, ikakhulukazi lezo ezinamathele endaweni engaphandle
question5: Yini echaza ukulingana kwamazwe amabili?
answer5: Indiza eyodwa ihlukanisa umzimba ube izingxenye ezihlukene kwesokudla nesobunxele
distractor5a: Noma iyiphi indiza emzimbeni ikhiqiza izingxenye ezilinganayo
distractor5b: Umzimba awunawo ngaphambili noma ngemuva okuchazwe kahle
question6: Yiliphi igama eliqondisa ngqo elibhekisela ngaphambili kwesilwane?
question7: Yiliphi igama eliqondisa ngqo elibhekisela emhlane wesilwane?
question8: Iyini inzuzo enkulu yokulingana kwamazwe amabili?
distractor8a: Ivumela izilwane ukuthi zinamathele unomphela emadwaleni
distractor8c: Ivumela noma iyiphi indiza ukuhlukanisa umzimba ube yizingxenye ezilinganayo

chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sesilwane Nomsebenzi Waso | 24. Umzimba Wesilwane: Isakhiwo Nomsebenzi Oyisisekelo | 24.1 Isakhiwo Nomsebenzi Wesilwane | Imikhawulo Esayizini Nokuma Kwesilwane
chapterContent:
Izilwane ezinezinhlangothi ezimbili ezihlala emanzini zivame ukuba nesimo se-fusiform: lokhu kungumzimba omise okwesibhamu onciphile kuzo zombili izinhlangothi. Lesi simo sinciphisa ukuhudula emzimbeni njengoba uhamba emanzini futhi sivumela isilwane ukuba sibhukude ngesivinini esiphezulu. Ithebula elingezansi libala isivinini esiphezulu sezilwane ezahlukahlukene. Izinhlobo ezithile zoshaka zingabhukuda ngamakhilogremu angamashumi amahlanu amamitha ngehora kanti ezinye amahlengethwa angamakhilogremu angu-32 kuya kwangu-40 amamitha ngehora. Izilwane zasemhlabeni zivame ukuhamba ngokushesha, yize ufudu nomnenke kuhamba kancane kakhulu kunezingwenya. Omunye umehluko ekuzivumelaniseni kwezinto eziphilayo zasemanzini nezasemhlabeni ukuthi izinto eziphilayo zasemanzini zivinjelwe ngesimo ngamandla okuhudula emanzini njengoba amanzi enobuthi obukhulu kunomoya. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, izinto eziphilayo zasemhlabeni zivinjelwe kakhulu amandla adonsela phansi, futhi ukuhudula akubalulekile kangako. Isibonelo, ukuzivumelanisa okuningi ezinyonini kungenxa yamandla adonsela phansi hhayi ukuhudula.

 Izilwane eziningi zine-exoskeleton, okuhlanganisa izinambuzane, izicabucabu, ofezela, izinkalankala ze-horseshoe, ama-centipedes, kanye nama-crustacean. Ososayensi balinganisela ukuthi, ezinambuzaneni zodwa, kunezinhlobo ezingaphezu kwezigidi ezingu-30 emhlabeni wethu. I-exoskeleton iyisimbozo esiqinile noma igobolondo elinikeza izinzuzo esilwaneni, njengokuvikelwa ekulimaleni okuvela ezidla ezinye nasekulahlekelweni kwamanzi (kwezilwane zasemhlabeni); futhi ihlinzeka nangokunamathelana kwemisipha.

 Njengesimbozo sangaphandle esiqinile nesimelana ne-arthropod, i-exoskeleton ingakhiwa nge-polymer eqinile njenge-chitin futhi ivame ukufakwa i-biomineral ngezinto ezifana ne-calcium carbonate. Lokhu kuhlanganiswa ne-epidermis yesilwane. Izitshalo ze-exoskeleton, ezibizwa ngokuthi ama-apodemes, zisebenza njengezindawo zokunamathisela imisipha, ezifana nemisipha ezilwaneni ezithuthukile (Isithombe 24.3). Ukuze sikhule, isilwane kumele siqale sakhe i-exoskeleton entsha ngaphansi kwedala bese sikhipha noma sincibilikise isimbozo sokuqala. Lokhu kunciphisa ikhono lesilwane lokukhula njalo, futhi kunganciphisa ikhono lomuntu lokuvuthwa uma ukubola kungenzeki ngesikhathi esifanele. Ubukhulu be-exoskeleton kumele bukhuliswe kakhulu ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nanoma yikuphi ukwanda kwesisindo. Kulinganiselwa ukuthi ukuphindaphindwa kobukhulu bomzimba kwandisa isisindo somzimba ngesilinganiso sesishiyagalombili. Ubukhulu obukhulayo be-chitin obudingekayo ukusekela lesi sisindo bukhawulela izilwane eziningi ezine-exoskeleton kusayizi omncane. Izimiso ezifanayo ziyasebenza kuma-endoskeleton, kodwa zisebenza kahle kakhulu ngoba imisipha inamathele ngaphandle, okwenza kube lula ukukhokhela isisindo esengeziwe.

 Isilwane esine-endoskeleton sinobukhulu baso obunqunywa inani lesistimu yamathambo esilidingayo ukuze sisekele ezinye izicubu kanye nenani lemisipha esilidingayo ukuze sinyakaze. Njengoba ubukhulu bomzimba bukhula, kokubili amathambo kanye nemisipha kuyakhula. Isivinini esingafinyelelwa yisilwane ukulinganisela phakathi kobukhulu baso bonke kanye nethambo kanye nemisipha enikeza ukwesekwa kanye nokunyakaza.
question1: Kungani izilwane eziningi zasemanzini ezinesimo sokulingana kwamabili zinesimo somzimba esifana ne-fusiform?
answer1: Ngoba kunciphisa ukudonswa kwamanzi futhi kuvumela ukubhukuda okusheshayo
question2: Kungani izilwane zasemanzini zivinjelwe kakhulu ukuma komzimba kunezilwane zasezweni?
answer2: Ngoba amanzi anokujiya okuphezulu kunomoya, okwenza kube nokudonseka okukhulu
distractor2a: Ngoba amanzi aqukethe umoya-mpilo omncane kunomoya
distractor2b: Ngoba amandla adonsela phansi anamandla ngaphansi kwamanzi
question3: Iyini isithiyo esiyinhloko ngesimo somzimba sezilwane eziningi zasezweni?
question4: Uyini umsebenzi oyinhloko we-exoskeleton?
answer4: Ihlinzeka ngesivikelo futhi isebenza njengendawo yokunamathisela imisipha
question5: Kungani izilwane ezinama-exoskeletons kumele zibole?
answer5: Ngoba i-exoskeleton eqinile ayikwazi ukukhula nesilwane
distractor5c: Ngoba ukubola kuvumela isilwane ukuthi sizale
question6: Ayini ama-apodemes?
answer6: Izitshalo ze-exoskeleton ezisebenza njengezindawo zokunamathela kwemisipha
question7: Kungani izilwane eziningi ezinama-exoskeleton zincane kakhulu?
answer7: Ngoba i-exoskeleton kumele ibe nkulu kakhulu ukuze isekele isisindo somzimba esengeziwe
question8: Yini enquma ubukhulu besilwane esine-endoskeleton?
answer8: Inani lethambo elidingekayo ukuze kusekelwe futhi kudingeke imisipha ukuze kushukume

chapterContent:
Ukushintshana kwezakhamzimba kanye nokungcola phakathi kweseli nendawo yalo enamanzi kwenzeka ngenqubo yokusabalala. Wonke amangqamuzana aphilayo agcwele uketshezi, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi asesithweni esiphilayo esineseli elilodwa noma esinamangqamuzana amaningi. Ukusabalala kusebenza ibanga elithile futhi kunciphisa ubukhulu obungafinyelelwa yiseli ngalinye. Uma iseli liyi-microorganism eneseli elilodwa, njenge-amoeba, lingazanelisa zonke izidingo zalo zezakhamzimba kanye nokungcola ngokusabalala. Uma iseli likhulu kakhulu, khona-ke ukusabalala akusebenzi futhi isikhungo seseli asitholi izakhamzimba ezanele futhi asikwazi ukukhipha imfucuza yaso ngempumelelo.

 Umqondo obalulekile ekuqondeni ukuthi ukusabalala kusebenza kahle kangakanani njengendlela yokuthutha isilinganiso sendawo kuya kuvolumu. Khumbula ukuthi noma iyiphi into enezinhlangothi ezintathu inendawo kanye nomthamo; isilinganiso salezi zilinganiso ezimbili yisilinganiso sobuso kuya kumthamo. Cabanga ngeseli elibunjwe njengesiyingi esiphelele: linendawo yobuso engu-4πr2, kanye nomthamo ongu-(4/3)πr3. Isilinganiso sobuso nomthamo se-sphere singu-3/r; njengoba iseli likhula, isilinganiso sobuso balo nomthamo siyancipha, okwenza ukusabalala kungasebenzi kahle. Uma ubukhulu be-sphere, noma isilwane, kulapho indawo encane yokusabalalisa enayo.

 Isixazululo sokukhiqiza izinto eziphilayo ezinkulu ukuthi zibe amaseli amaningi. Ubuchwepheshe buvela ezintweni eziphilayo eziyinkimbinkimbi, okuvumela amaseli ukuthi asebenze kahle kakhulu ekwenzeni imisebenzi embalwa. Isibonelo, izinhlelo zokujikeleza kwegazi ziletha izakhamzimba futhi zisuse imfucuza, kuyilapho izinhlelo zokuphefumula zihlinzeka nge-oxygen kumaseli futhi zisuse i-carbon dioxide kuwo. Ezinye izinhlelo zezitho zomzimba ziye zathuthukisa ubuchwepheshe obengeziwe bamaseli nezicubu futhi zilawula ngempumelelo imisebenzi yomzimba. Ngaphezu kwalokho, isilinganiso sobuso nomthamo sisebenza kwezinye izindawo zokukhula kwesilwane, njengobudlelwano phakathi kwemisipha kanye nendawo yobuso enqamulayo ekusekeleni amathambo, kanye nobudlelwano phakathi kwemisipha kanye nokukhiqizwa kanye nokusatshalaliswa kokushisa.
question1: Kungani ukusabalala kunciphisa ubukhulu bamaseli ngamanye?
answer1: Ngoba ukusabalala kuba okungasebenzi kahle emabangeni amade, okuvimbela ukulethwa okwanele kwezakhamzimba kanye nokususwa kwemfucuza
distractor1a: Ngoba amangqamuzana amakhulu adinga umoya-mpilo omncane
distractor1b: Ngoba ukusabalala kwenzeka kuphela ezintweni eziphilayo ezinamaseli amaningi
distractor1c: Ngoba amangqamuzana amakhulu alahlekelwa amanzi ngokushesha kakhulu
question2: Kungani i-amoeba ingathembela ngokuphelele ekusakazweni kwezakhamzimba kanye nokushintshaniswa kwemfucuza?
answer2: Ngoba incane ngokwanele ukuthi ukusabalala kwayo kuhlangatshezwane kahle nazo zonke izidingo zayo
question3: Isilinganiso sendawo ebusweni kuya kuvolumu sishintsha kanjani njengoba iseli eliyindilinga likhula ngobukhulu?
question4: Kungani isilinganiso esiphansi sendawo yobuso kuya komthamo sinciphisa ukusebenza kahle kokusabalalisa?
answer4: Ngoba kunendawo encane yokushintshanisa etholakala uma kuqhathaniswa nomthamo wamaseli
question5: Izinto eziphilayo ezinamaseli amaningi zinqoba kanjani ukulinganiselwa kokusabalala?
answer5: Ngokuthuthukisa amangqamuzana akhethekile, izicubu, kanye nezinhlelo zezitho zokuthutha nokushintshanisa
question6: Uyini umsebenzi oyinhloko wesimiso sokujikeleza kwegazi ezintweni eziphilayo ezinamaseli amaningi?
question7: Uyini umsebenzi oyinhloko wesimiso sokuphefumula ezintweni eziphilayo ezinamaseli amaningi?
answer7: Ukunikeza umoya-mpilo emaseli nokususa i-carbon dioxide
question8: Ngaphandle kokusabalala, isilinganiso sendawo ebusweni kuya kuvolumu siphinde sithonye yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo?
answer8: Ubudlelwano phakathi kwemisipha, ukwesekwa kwamathambo, kanye nokukhiqizwa kokushisa kanye nokushabalaliswa

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 24. Umzimba Wezilwane: Isakhiwo Nomsebenzi Oyisisekelo | 24.1 Isakhiwo Nemisebenzi Yezilwane | I-Bioenergetics Yezilwane
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 24. Umzimba Wezilwane: Isakhiwo Nomsebenzi Oyisisekelo | 24.1 Isakhiwo Nemisebenzi Yezilwane | I-Bioenergetics Yezilwane
chapterContent:
Zonke izilwane kumele zithole amandla azo ekudleni ezikudlayo noma ezimuncayo. Lezi zakhi zomzimba ziguqulwa zibe yi-adenosine triphosphate (ATP) ukuze zigcinwe futhi zisetshenziswe isikhathi esifushane yiwo wonke amaseli. Ezinye izilwane zigcina amandla isikhathi eside njenge-glycogen, kanti ezinye zigcina amandla isikhathi eside kakhulu ngesimo se-triglycerides egcinwe ezicutshini ezikhethekile zamafutha. Akukho simiso samandla esisebenza kahle ngamaphesenti ayikhulu, futhi i-metabolism yesilwane ikhiqiza amandla angcolile ngesimo sokushisa. Uma isilwane singalondoloza lokho kushisa futhi sigcine izinga lokushisa lomzimba elihlala njalo, sihlukaniswa njengesilwane esinegazi elifudumele futhi sibizwa ngokuthi i-endotherm. I-insulation esetshenziselwa ukugcina ukushisa komzimba iza ngezindlela zoboya, amafutha, noma izimpaphe. Ukungabikho kwe-insulation ezilwaneni ezisebenzisa i-ectothermic kwandisa ukuthembela kwazo endaweni yokushisa komzimba.

 Inani lamandla asetshenziswa yisilwane esikhathini esithile libizwa ngokuthi izinga layo le-metabolic. Isilinganiso silinganiswa ngendlela ehlukahlukene ngama-joules, ama-calories, noma ama-kilocalories (ama-calories ayi-1000). Ama-carbohydrate namaprotheni aqukethe cishe ama-kcal angu-4.5 kuya ku-5, kanti amafutha aqukethe cishe ama-kcal angu-9/g. Izinga lokuguqulwa kwe-metabolic lilinganiselwa njengesilinganiso se-basal metabolic (BMR) ezilwaneni eziphumule futhi njengesilinganiso se-metabolic esijwayelekile (SMR) kuma-ectotherms. Abesilisa bane-BMR engu-1600 kuya ku-1800 kcal/ngosuku, kanti abesifazane bane-BMR engu-1300 kuya ku-1500 kcal/ngosuku. Ngisho noma kune-insulation, izilwane ezisebenzisa i-endothermal zidinga amandla amaningi ukuze zigcine izinga lokushisa lomzimba lihlala linjalo. I-ectotherm efana ne-alligator ine-SMR engu-60 kcal/ngosuku.
question1: Yimuphi umolekyuli osebenza njengesitoreji samandla sesikhathi esifushane esisetshenziswa yiwo wonke amaseli?
answer1: I-Adenosine triphosphate (ATP)
question2: Izilwane ziwagcina kanjani amandla isikhathi eside?
answer2: Njenge-glycogen yokugcina okuphakathi kanye ne-triglycerides ezicutshini zamafutha ukuze kugcinwe isikhathi eside
question3: Kungani i-metabolism yezilwane ikhiqiza ukushisa?
answer3: Ngoba akukho uhlelo lokuguqula amandla olusebenza kahle ngamaphesenti ayi-100
distractor3a: Ngoba i-ATP iguqulwa ngqo ibe amafutha
distractor3b: Ngoba zonke izakhamzimba zigcinwa ngaphambi kokusetshenziswa
question4: Kuyini i-endotherm?
answer4: Isilwane esigcina ukushisa komzimba ukuze silondoloze izinga lokushisa lomzimba elilinganayo
distractor4b: Isilwane esingakwazi ukulawula izinga lokushisa lomzimba
question5: Yiziphi izakhiwo ezisiza ama-endotherms ukuthi alondoloze ukushisa komzimba?
question6: Iyini izinga lokuguqulwa kwe-metabolic?
answer6: Inani lamandla isilwane esiwasebenzisayo esikhathini esithile
distractor6a: Inani lokudla isilwane esikudlayo nsuku zonke
question7: Mangaki ama-kilocalories ngegremu ngalinye amafutha aqukethe?
question8: Iyini izinga le-basal metabolic (BMR)?
distractor8a: Izinga eliphezulu kakhulu lokugaya ukudla ngesikhathi sokuzivocavoca
distractor8b: Izinga lokuguqulwa kwe-metabolic lama-ectotherms lapho ephumula
question9: Iyini izinga elijwayelekile lokuguqulwa kwe-metabolic (SMR)?
answer9: Izinga lokuguqulwa kwe-metabolic yesilwane esisebenza ngogesi
distractor9b: Izinga lokuguqulwa kwemizimba yezinyoni ngesikhathi sokundiza

chapterContent: Izilwane ezincane ze-endothermic zinendawo enkulu ebusweni bayo kunezinkulu (Isithombe 24.4). Ngakho-ke, izilwane ezincane zilahlekelwa ukushisa ngesivinini esisheshayo kunezilwane ezinkulu futhi zidinga amandla engeziwe ukuze zigcine izinga lokushisa langaphakathi lihlala linjalo. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni isilwane esincane se-endothermic sibe ne-BMR ephezulu, ngesisindo somzimba, kunesilwane esikhulu se-endothermic.
question1: Kungani izilwane ezincane ze-endothermic zilahlekelwa ukushisa ngokushesha kunezilwane ezinkulu ze-endothermic?
answer1: Ngoba banesilinganiso esikhulu sendawo ebusweni kuya kubukhulu
question2: Kungani izilwane ezincane ze-endothermic zidinga amandla engeziwe ngeyunithi yesisindo somzimba?
answer2: Ngoba zilahlekelwa ukushisa ngokushesha futhi kumele zikhiqize ukushisa okwengeziwe ukuze zilondoloze izinga lokushisa lomzimba
distractor2a: Ngoba zigaya ukudla ngendlela engaphumeleli kahle
question3: Usayizi womzimba uthinta kanjani izinga lomzimba eliyisisekelo (i-BMR) ngeyunithi ngayinye yesisindo somzimba kuma-endotherms?
answer3: Ama-endotherm amancane anesisindo somzimba esiphezulu se-BMR ngeyunithi ngayinye kune-endotherm enkulu.
distractor3a: Ama-endotherm amakhulu ane-BMR ephezulu ngeyunithi ngayinye yesisindo somzimba
distractor3c: Zonke i-endotherms zine-BMR efanayo ngeyunithi ngayinye yesisindo somzimba
question4: Yini esiza ukuchaza ubudlelwano phakathi kobukhulu bomzimba nokulahlekelwa ukushisa kuma-endotherms?
question5: Kungani izilwane ezinkulu ze-endothermic ngokuvamile zidinga amandla amancane ngeyunithi yesisindo somzimba kunezilwane ezincane?
answer5: Ngoba zilahlekelwa ukushisa kancane ngenxa yesilinganiso esiphansi sendawo ebusweni kuya kobukhulu
distractor5b: Ngoba zimunca ukushisa ngqo endaweni ezungezile

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 24. Umzimba Wezilwane: Isakhiwo Nomsebenzi Oyisisekelo | 24.1 Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | I-Bioenergetics Yezilwane | Izidingo Zamandla Ezihlobene Namazinga Omsebenzi
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 24. Umzimba Wezilwane: Isakhiwo Nomsebenzi Oyisisekelo | 24.1 Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | I-Bioenergetics Yezilwane | Izidingo Zamandla Ezihlobene Namazinga Omsebenzi
chapterContent: Uma isilwane sisebenza kakhulu, kulapho kudingeka amandla amaningi ukuze silondoloze lowo msebenzi, futhi lapho i-BMR noma i-SMR yaso iphakama khona. Izinga elijwayelekile lokusetshenziswa kwamandla kwansuku zonke liphindwe kabili kuya kane kune-BMR noma i-SMR yesilwane. Abantu bahlala phansi kakhulu kunezilwane eziningi futhi banesilinganiso sansuku zonke esiphindwe ka-1.5 kuphela kune-BMR. Ukudla kwesilwane esiphila e-endothermic kunqunywa yi-BMR yaso. Isibonelo: uhlobo lotshani, amaqabunga, noma izihlahla ezidliwa yisilwane esidla utshani kuthinta inani lamakhalori esiwadlayo. Okuqukethwe kwamakhalori okudla okudla utshani, ngokulandelana, utshani obude > ubhontshisi > utshani obufushane > ama-forbs (noma yisiphi isitshalo esinamaqabunga abanzi, hhayi utshani) > izihlahla ezincane > izihlahla zonyaka/zeminyaka emibili
question1: Izinga lomsebenzi wesilwane lithinta kanjani izidingo zaso zamandla?
answer1: Izilwane ezikhuthele kakhulu zidinga amandla engeziwe ukuze ziqhubeke nomsebenzi wazo
distractor1a: Izilwane ezikhuthele kakhulu zidinga amandla amancane ngoba zisebenza kahle kakhulu
distractor1c: Ama-ectotherm kuphela adinga amandla engeziwe ngesikhathi somsebenzi
question2: Umsebenzi owandisiwe uyithinta kanjani i-BMR noma i-SMR yesilwane?
answer2: Umsebenzi omkhulu uhlotshaniswa ne-BMR noma i-SMR ephezulu
distractor2a: Umsebenzi omkhulu wehlisa i-BMR noma i-SMR
distractor2b: Umsebenzi awunawo umthelela ku-BMR noma ku-SMR
distractor2c: I-BMR kuphela eshintshayo kuyilapho i-SMR ihlala ingaguquguquki
question3: Ingakanani isilinganiso sansuku zonke sokusetshenziswa kwamandla ezilwaneni eziningi uma kuqhathaniswa ne-BMR noma i-SMR yazo?
answer3: Cishe izikhathi ezimbili kuya kwezine ze-BMR noma i-SMR yabo
distractor3a: Cishe ingxenye eyodwa kwezintathu ze-BMR noma i-SMR yabo
distractor3b: Cishe kufana ne-BMR noma i-SMR yabo
distractor3c: Cishe izikhathi eziyishumi ze-BMR noma i-SMR yabo
question4: Ingakanani isilinganiso samandla abantu abawasebenzisa nsuku zonke uma kuqhathaniswa ne-BMR yabo?
question5: Yini enquma ukudla kwesilwane esihlala e-endothermic?
question6: Yikuphi ukudla okudliwa yizilwane ezidla uhlaza okubhalwe ohlwini okune-caloric ephezulu kakhulu?
question7: Yikuphi ukudla okudliwa yizilwane ezidla uhlaza okubhalwe ohlwini okune-caloric ephezulu kunotshani obufushane?

chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 24. Umzimba Wezilwane: Isakhiwo Nomsebenzi Oyisisekelo | 24.1 Isakhiwo Nemisebenzi Yezilwane | I-Bioenergetics Yezilwane | Izidingo Zamandla Ezihlobene Nemvelo
chapterContent:
Izilwane ziyazivumelanisa nezimo zokushisa eziphakeme kakhulu noma ukutholakala kokudla ngenxa ye-torpor. I-Torpor inqubo eholela ekunciphiseni komsebenzi kanye ne-metabolism futhi ivumela izilwane ukuba zisinde ezimweni ezimbi. I-Torpor ingasetshenziswa yizilwane isikhathi eside, njengokungena esimweni sokulala ebusuku phakathi nezinyanga zasebusika, lapho-ke izenza zikwazi ukugcina izinga lokushisa lomzimba eliphansi. Ngesikhathi sokulala ebusuku, ama-squirrel asemhlabathini angafinyelela izinga lokushisa lesisu elingu-0° C (32° F), kuyilapho izinga lokushisa langaphakathi lebhere ligcinwa liphezulu cishe ku-37° C (99° F).

 Uma i-torpor ivele phakathi nezinyanga zasehlobo lapho amazinga okushisa aphezulu namanzi amancane, ibizwa ngokuthi i-estivation. Ezinye izilwane zasehlane zisebenzisa lokhu ukuze zisinde ezinyangeni ezinzima kakhulu zonyaka. I-Torpor ingenzeka nsuku zonke; lokhu kubonakala kumalulwane nama-hummingbird. Ngenkathi i-endothermy inqunyelwe ezilwaneni ezincane ngesilinganiso sobuso nobubanzi, ezinye izinto eziphilayo zingaba zincane futhi zibe ama-endotherm ngoba zisebenzisa i-torpor yansuku zonke phakathi nengxenye yosuku ebanda kakhulu. Lokhu kubavumela ukuthi bonge amandla ngezikhathi ezibandayo zosuku, lapho besebenzisa amandla amaningi ukuze balondoloze izinga lokushisa lomzimba wabo.
answer1: Isimo sokuncipha komsebenzi kanye nokusetshenziswa kwe-metabolism okusiza izilwane ukuthi zisinde ezimweni ezimbi
question2: Kuyini ubusika?
answer2: Uhlobo olude lokungaphumuli oluvela phakathi nezinyanga zasebusika
question3: Kuyini u-estivation?
answer3: Uhlobo lokungakhululeki okwenzeka ngesikhathi sasehlobo esishisayo nesomile
question4: Kungani izilwane zasehlane zisebenzisa i-estivation?
answer4: Ukusinda ezikhathini zokushisa okukhulu namanzi alinganiselwe
distractor4b: Ukugwema izilwane ezidla ezinye ngesikhathi sasebusika
question5: Yiziphi izilwane eziyizibonelo zezinhlobo ezingasebenzisa i-torpor yansuku zonke?
question6: Ukuzibamba kwansuku zonke kuzuzisa kanjani ama-endotherm amancane?
answer6: Igcina amandla ngezikhathi ezibandayo kakhulu zosuku ngokunciphisa izinga lokuguqulwa kwezakhi zomzimba.
distractor6a: Kwehlisa izinga lokushisa lomzimba wabo unomphela
question7: Kungani ama-endotherm amancane enamathuba amaningi okuzuza ekuphefumuleni kwansuku zonke?
answer7: Ngoba zilahlekelwa ukushisa ngokushesha ngenxa yesilinganiso sazo esiphezulu sendawo nomthamo

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 24. Umzimba Wezilwane: Isakhiwo Nomsebenzi Oyisisekelo | 24.1 Isakhiwo Nomsebenzi Wezilwane | Izindiza Nezimbobo Zomzimba Wezilwane
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 24. Umzimba Wezilwane: Isakhiwo Nomsebenzi Oyisisekelo | 24.1 Isakhiwo Nomsebenzi Wezilwane | Izindiza Nezimbobo Zomzimba Wezilwane
chapterContent:
Isilwane esinezinhlungu zomgogodla esimi singahlukaniswa ngezindiza eziningana. Indiza ye-sagittal ihlukanisa umzimba ngezingxenye kwesokudla nesobunxele. Indiza ye-midsagittal ihlukanisa umzimba ngqo phakathi, okwenza izingxenye ezimbili ezilinganayo kwesokudla nesobunxele. Indiza engaphambili (ebizwa nangokuthi indiza ye-coronal) ihlukanisa isisu (i-ventral) noma isisu ngemuva (i-dorsal). Indiza evundlile (noma, indiza evundlile) iqonde ngqo ezindizeni ze-sagittal kanye ne-axis ende yomzimba. Lokhu ngezinye izikhathi kubizwa ngokuthi isigaba esivundlile, futhi, uma ukusika okuvundlile kuse-engeli, kubizwa ngokuthi indiza eqondile. Isithombe 24.5 sibonisa lezi zindiza embuzini (isilwane esinemilenze emine) kanye nomuntu.

 Izilwane ezinezinhlungu zomgogodla zinezimbobo eziningi zomzimba ezichaziwe, njengoba kuboniswe ku-Figure 24.6. Ezimbili zalezi yizimbobo ezinkulu eziqukethe izimbobo ezincane ngaphakathi kwazo. Imbobo engemuva iqukethe izimbobo ze-cranial kanye ne-vertebral (noma umgogodla). Umgodi wesisu uqukethe umgodi wesifuba, wona uqukethe umgodi we-pleural ozungeze amaphaphu kanye nomgodi we-pericardial, ozungeze inhliziyo. Umgodi wesisu uqukethe nomgodi wesisu, ongahlukaniswa phakathi kwesisu kanye nemigodi ye-pelvic.
answer1: Umzimba ube izingxenye kwesokudla nakwesobunxele
distractor1c: Umzimba ungena ezingxenyeni ze-cranial kanye ne-pelvic
question2: Iyini indiza ye-midsagittal?
answer2: Indiza ye-sagittal ehlukanisa umzimba ube izingxenye ezilinganayo kwesokudla nesobunxele
distractor2a: Indiza ehlukanisa umzimba ube izingxenye zangemuva nangaphakathi
distractor2b: Indiza ehlukanisa umzimba ube izingxenye eziphezulu nezingezansi
distractor2c: Indiza ehlukanisa umgodi wesifuba nomgodi wesisu
question3: Yini ehlukaniswa yindiza engaphambili (i-coronal)?
question4: Liyini elinye igama lendiza enqamulayo?
question5: Kubizwa ngokuthini ukusika okuphambene okwenziwe nge-engela?
question6: Yimuphi umgodi omkhulu womzimba oqukethe imigodi ye-cranial kanye ne-vertebral?
question7: Yimuphi umgodi omkhulu womzimba oqukethe imigodi yesifuba neyesisu?
question8: Yimuphi umgodi ozungeze amaphaphu?
question9: Yimuphi umgodi ozungeze inhliziyo?

chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 24. Umzimba Wezilwane: Isakhiwo Nomsebenzi Oyisisekelo | 24.1 Isakhiwo Nemisebenzi Yezilwane | Ukuxhumana Komsebenzi | Isazi Sezinto Eziphilayo
chapterContent:
Izazi ze-anthropology zemvelo zifunda ukuzivumelanisa nezimo, ukuguquguquka, kanye nokuvela kwabantu, kanye nezihlobo zabo eziphilayo kanye nezakudala. Zingasebenza ezindaweni ezahlukene, yize iningi lizoba ne-aphoyintimenti yezemfundo eyunivesithi, ngokuvamile emnyangweni we-anthropology noma emnyangweni we-biology, genetics, noma we-zoology.

 Izikhundla ezingezona ezezemfundo ziyatholakala embonini yezimoto kanye nezindiza lapho kugxilwe khona kusayizi womuntu, ukuma, kanye nokwakheka komzimba. Ucwaningo lwalaba ochwepheshe lungase luqale ezifundweni zendlela umzimba womuntu osabela ngayo ezingozini zezimoto kuya ekuhloleni indlela yokwenza izihlalo zibe zikhululekile kakhudlwana. Ezinye izikhundla ezingezona ezezemfundo zingatholakala eminyuziyamu yomlando wemvelo, i-anthropology, i-archaeology, noma isayensi nobuchwepheshe. Lezi zikhundla zihilela ukufundisa abafundi kusukela esikoleni samabanga aphansi kuya esikoleni samabanga aphezulu. Izazi ze-anthropology zemvelo zisebenza njengabaxhumanisi bezemfundo, abaphathi beqoqo, ababhali bezincwadi zemyuziyamu, kanye nabaphathi. Ama-zoo aqasha laba ochwepheshe, ikakhulukazi uma benolwazi nge-biology yezinyamazane; basebenza ekuphathweni kweqoqo kanye ne-pro yokuzalanisa eboshiwe grams yezinhlobo ezisengozini yokuqothulwa. Isayensi ye-forensic isebenzisa ubuchwepheshe be-anthropology ekuboneni izinsalela zabantu nezilwane, isize ekutholeni imbangela yokufa, kanye nobufakazi bochwepheshe ezivivinyweni
answer1: Ukuzivumelanisa nezimo, ukuguquguquka, kanye nokuvela kwabantu kanye nezihlobo zabo eziphilayo kanye nezakudala
question2: Iningi lezazi ze-physical anthropologist lisebenza kuphi?
answer2: Emanyuvesi, ngokuvamile eminyangweni ye-anthropology, i-biology, i-genetics, noma i-zoology
question3: Izazi ze-anthropology zomzimba zinikela kanjani embonini yezimoto kanye nezindiza?
answer3: Ngokutadisha usayizi womuntu, ukuma, ukwakheka komzimba, kanye nezimpendulo zokuthuthukisa ukuphepha nenduduzo
question4: Yiziphi izindima ezingaba nazo izazi ze-anthropology eminyuziyamu?
answer4: Bangasebenza njengabafundisi, abaphathi beqoqo, ababhali, noma abaphathi
question5: Kungani izazi ze-physical anthropologist ziqashwa yi-zoo?
answer5: Ukusiza ngokuphathwa kokuqoqwa kanye nokuzalanisa okuvalelwe amagremu, ikakhulukazi okubandakanya izinkawu
question6: Izazi ze-physical anthropologists zihileleka kanjani kwisayensi ye-forensic?
answer6: Zisiza ekuboneni izinsalela zabantu nezilwane, zinqume izimbangela zokufa, futhi zinikeze ubufakazi bochwepheshe

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 24. Umzimba Wezilwane: Ifomu Nomsebenzi Oyisisekelo | 24.2 Izicubu Eziyinhloko Zezilwane | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 24. Umzimba Wezilwane: Ifomu Nomsebenzi Oyisisekelo | 24.2 Izicubu Eziyinhloko Zezilwane | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent:
Okuqukethwe okuchazwe kulesi sigaba akukho ngaphakathi kobubanzi be-AP®. Kodwa-ke, sesifundile kakade ukuthi ubudlelwano phakathi kwesakhiwo nomsebenzi buhlanganisa izinga leseli, futhi sizoqhubeka nokuqinisa lokho lapho sihlola uhlelo lwezinzwa kamuva.

 Izicubu zezilwane ezinamaseli amaningi, eziyinkimbinkimbi ziyizinhlobo ezine eziyinhloko: i-epithelial, i-connective, imisipha, kanye ne-nervous. Khumbula ukuthi izicubu zingamaqembu amaseli afanayo iqembu lamaseli afanayo enza imisebenzi ehlobene. Lezi zicubu ziyahlangana ukuze zakhe izitho—njengesikhumba noma izinso—ezinemisebenzi ethile, ekhethekile emzimbeni. Izitho zihlelwe zibe izinhlelo zezitho ukuze zenze imisebenzi; izibonelo zifaka phakathi uhlelo lokujikeleza kwegazi, oluqukethe inhliziyo nemithambo yegazi, kanye nohlelo lokugaya ukudla, oluqukethe izitho eziningana, okuhlanganisa isisu, amathumbu, isibindi, kanye ne-pancreas. Izinhlelo zezitho ziyahlangana ukuze zidale isidalwa esiphelele
question1: Yiziphi izinhlobo ezine eziyinhloko zezicubu ezitholakala ezilwaneni ezinamaseli amaningi?
answer1: Izicubu ze-Epithelial, connective, muscle, kanye ne-nervous
distractor1a: Izicubu ze-Epithelial, zemithambo yegazi, zamathambo, nezemizwa
distractor1b: Izicubu zemisipha, igazi, amathambo kanye ne-cartilage
distractor1c: Izicubu ezixhumene, ze-endocrine, ze-epithelial, kanye nezama-immune
question2: Kuyini izicubu?
answer2: Iqembu lamaseli afanayo enza imisebenzi ehlobene
question3: Yini ehlangana izicubu ukuze yakheke?
question4: Iyini isitho somzimba?
answer4: Isakhiwo esenziwe ngezicubu eziningi ezenza umsebenzi othile okhethekile
distractor4a: Iqembu lamaseli afanayo enza umsebenzi ofanayo
question5: Yini ehlanganayo ukuze yakhe izitho zomzimba?
question6: Yiziphi izitho zomzimba eziyingxenye yesistimu yokujikeleza kwegazi?
question7: Yisiphi sezitho ezilandelayo esiyingxenye yesimiso sokugaya ukudla?
question8: Zakhani izinhlelo zezitho ndawonye?

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 24. Umzimba Wezilwane: Ifomu Nomsebenzi Oyisisekelo | 24.2 Izicubu Eziyinhloko Zezilwane | Izicubu Ze-Epithelial
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 24. Umzimba Wezilwane: Ifomu Nomsebenzi Oyisisekelo | 24.2 Izicubu Eziyinhloko Zezilwane | Izicubu Ze-Epithelial
chapterContent:
Izicubu ze-epithelial zimboza ingaphandle lezitho nezakhiwo emzimbeni futhi ziqondisa ama-lumens ezitho ngqimbeni olulodwa noma izingqimba eziningi zamaseli. Izinhlobo ze-epithelia zihlukaniswa ngokwezimo zamaseli akhona kanye nenani lezingqimba zamaseli. I-epithelia eyakhiwe ungqimba olulodwa lwamaseli ibizwa ngokuthi i-simple epithelia; izicubu ze-epithelial ezakhiwe izingqimba eziningi ibizwa ngokuthi i-stratified epithelia. Ngezansi ithebula lifingqa izinhlobo ezahlukene zezicubu ze-epithelial.

 Izinhlobo Ezihlukene Zezicubu Ze-Epithelial
Ukuma kweseli
Incazelo_____Indawo

 squamous
ukuma okuyisiyingi okuyisicaba, okungajwayelekile_____ okulula: i-alveoli yamaphaphu, ama-capillary ahlukaniswe: isikhumba, umlomo, isitho sangasese sowesifazane

 i-cuboidal
ukuma kwe-cube, i-nucleus ephakathi_____izindlala, ama-tubules ezinso

 i-columnar
inde, incane, i-nucleus ibheke esisekelweni inde, incane, i-nucleus eduze kweseli_____elula: umgudu wokugaya ukudla ohlukaniswe ngokwe-pseudostratified: umgudu wokuphefumula

 oguqukayo
ojikelezayo, olula kodwa obonakala uhlukaniswe ngokwe-stratified_____isinyi somchamo
answer1: Ukumboza ubuso bomzimba nokubeka umugqa kuma-lumens ezitho zomzimba
question2: Izicubu ze-epithelial zihlukaniswa kanjani?
answer2: Ngokuma kwamaseli ayo kanye nenani lezingqimba zamaseli
question3: Iyini i-epithelium elula?
answer3: Izicubu ze-epithelial ezakhiwe ungqimba olulodwa lwamaseli
distractor3a: Izicubu ze-epithelial ezakhiwe ngezingqimba ezimbili zamaseli
distractor3b: Izicubu ze-epithelial ezinezimo zamaseli ezingajwayelekile kuphela
question4: Iyini i-epithelium ehlanganisiwe?
answer4: Izicubu ze-epithelial ezakhiwe ngezingqimba eziningi zamaseli

question9: Yisiphi izicubu ze-epithelial ezikhethekile zesinyi somchamo?

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 24. Umzimba Wezilwane: Ifomu Nomsebenzi Oyisisekelo | 24.2 Izicubu Eziyinhloko Zezilwane | Izicubu Ze-Epithelial | I-Squamous Epithelia
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 24. Umzimba Wezilwane: Ifomu Nomsebenzi Oyisisekelo | 24.2 Izicubu Eziyinhloko Zezilwane | Izicubu Ze-Epithelial | I-Squamous Epithelia
chapterContent:
Amaseli e-epithelial e-squamous ngokuvamile ayindilinga, ayizicaba, futhi ane-nucleus encane, ephakathi nendawo. Uhlaka lweseli alujwayelekile kancane, futhi amaseli ahlangana ndawonye ukuze akhe isembozo noma ulwelwesi. Lapho amaseli ehlelwe ngesendlalelo esisodwa (i-epithelia elula), enza kube lula ukusabalala kwezicubu, njengezindawo zokushintshana kwegesi emaphashini kanye nokushintshana kwezakhamzimba kanye nokungcola kuma-capillary egazi.

 Isithombe 24.7a sibonisa ungqimba lwamaseli e-squamous anezingqimba zawo ezihlangene ukuze zakhe i-epithelium. Isithombe Isithombe 24.7b sibonisa amaseli e-epithelial e-squamous ahlelwe ngezingqimba ezihlukaniswe ngezigaba, lapho kudingeka khona ukuvikelwa emzimbeni ekukhungathekeni nasemlilweni wangaphandle. Lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi i-epithelium ehlukaniswe ngezigaba futhi kwenzeka esikhumbeni nasezicutshini ezimboze umlomo nesitho sangasese sowesifazane.
question1: Iyini ukuma okujwayelekile kwamaseli e-epithelial e-squamous?
answer1: Amaseli asicaba, angenasimo esingavamile ane-nucleus encane, ephakathi nendawo
distractor1b: Amaseli amade, amancane ane-nuclei eduze kwesisekelo
question2: Uyini umsebenzi oyinhloko we-epithelium elula ye-squamous?
question3: Itholakala kuphi i-simple squamous epithelium emaphashini?
question4: Kungani i-simple squamous epithelium ifaneleka kahle kuma-capillary?
answer4: Ingqimba yayo encane eyodwa ivumela ukushintshaniswa okuphumelelayo kwezakhamzimba kanye nokungcola
question5: Iyini i-epithelium ye-squamous ehlanganisiwe?
answer5: Izendlalelo eziningi zamaseli ayisikwele ahlinzeka ngokuvikelwa ekukhungathekeni
distractor5a: Ingqimba eyodwa yamaseli ayisikwele akhethekile ukusabalala
question6: Itholakala kuphi i-stratified squamous epithelium?
answer6: Isikhumba, umlomo, kanye nesitho sangasese sowesifazane
question7: Kungani i-epithelium ye-squamous ehlanganisiwe itholakala ezindaweni zomzimba ezivezwe ekukhubekeni?
answer7: Ngoba izendlalelo zayo eziningi zamaseli zinikeza isivikelo ekulimaleni

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 24. Umzimba Wezilwane: Ifomu Nomsebenzi Oyisisekelo | 24.2 Izicubu Eziyinhloko Zezilwane | Izicubu Ze-Epithelial | I-Cuboidal Epithelia
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 24. Umzimba Wezilwane: Ifomu Nomsebenzi Oyisisekelo | 24.2 Izicubu Eziyinhloko Zezilwane | Izicubu Ze-Epithelial | I-Cuboidal Epithelia
chapterContent: Amaseli e-epithelial e-cuboidal, aboniswe kuMfanekiso 24.8, amise okwesikwele esine-nucleus eyodwa, ephakathi. Avame ukutholakala ongqimbeni olulodwa olumele i-epithelia elula ezicutshini ze-glandular kuwo wonke umzimba lapho elungiselela futhi ekhipha khona izinto ze-glandular. Atholakala nasezindongeni zama-tubules nasemapayipini ezinso nesibindi.
question1: Iyini ukuma okujwayelekile kwamaseli e-epithelial e-cuboidal?
answer1: Amaseli amise okwesikwele ane-nucleus eyodwa, ephakathi
distractor1b: Amaseli amade, amancane ane-nuclei eduze kwesisekelo
question2: Atholakala kuphi amaseli e-epithelial e-cuboidal?
answer2: Ngongqimba olulodwa okwakha i-epithelium elula ezicutshini ze-glandular
question3: Uyini umsebenzi oyinhloko wamaseli e-epithelial e-cuboidal kuma-gland?
question4: Yiluphi uhlobo lwe-epithelium olwakhiwa ungqimba olulodwa lwamaseli e-cuboidal?
question5: Ngaphandle kwezindlala, atholakala kuphi amaseli e-epithelial e-cuboidal?
answer5: Ezindongeni zama-tubules kanye nemigudu yezinso nesibindi
question6: Yiziphi izitho eziqukethe imigudu ehlanganiswe yi-epithelium ye-cuboidal?

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 24. Umzimba Wezilwane: Ifomu Nomsebenzi Oyisisekelo | 24.2 Izicubu Eziyinhloko Zezilwane | Izicubu Ze-Epithelial | I-Columnar Epithelia
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 24. Umzimba Wezilwane: Ifomu Nomsebenzi Oyisisekelo | 24.2 Izicubu Eziyinhloko Zezilwane | Izicubu Ze-Epithelial | I-Columnar Epithelia
chapterContent:
Amaseli e-epithelial e-columnar amade kakhulu kunalawo abanzi: afana nenqwaba yamakholomu kungqimba ye-epithelial, futhi avame ukutholakala kulungiselelo lwengqimba eyodwa. Ama-nuclei amaseli e-epithelial e-columnar kumgudu wokugaya ukudla abonakala ebekwe phansi kwamaseli, njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 24.9. Lawa maseli amunca izinto ezivela ku-lumen yomgudu wokugaya ukudla futhi azilungiselele ukungena emzimbeni ngezinhlelo zokujikeleza kwegazi kanye ne-lymphatic.

 Amaseli e-epithelial e-columnar amboze umgudu wokuphefumula abonakala ehlukaniswe ngezigaba. Kodwa-ke, iseli ngalinye linamathele kulwelwesi oluyisisekelo lwezicubu futhi, ngakho-ke, ayizicubu ezilula. Ama-nuclei ahlelwe ngamazinga ahlukene kungqimba lwamaseli, okwenza kubonakale sengathi kunezingqimba ezingaphezu kweyodwa, njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 24.10. Lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi i-pseudostratified, i-columnar epithelia. Lesi simbozo seseli sine-cilia ebusweni be-apical, noma obukhululekile bamaseli. I-cilia ithuthukisa ukunyakaza kwama-mucous kanye nezinhlayiya ezivalelekile ziphuma endleleni yokuphefumula, okusiza ekuvikeleni uhlelo kuma-microorganisms ahlaselayo kanye nezinto eziyingozi eziphefumulelwe emzimbeni. Ama-goblet cell ahlanganiswe kwezinye izicubu (njengolwelwesi lwe-trachea). Ama-goblet cell aqukethe ama-mucous abamba izinto ezicasulayo, ezithi uma kwenzeka i-trachea zivimbele lezi zinto ezicasulayo ukuthi zingangeni emaphashini.
answer1: Zinde kakhulu kunezingabanzi futhi zifana nezinsika
question2: Atholakala kuphi amaseli e-epithelial alula e-columnar?
question3: Uyini umsebenzi oyinhloko wamaseli e-epithelial alula angaphakathi komgudu wokugaya ukudla?
answer3: Ukumunca izinto ezivela ku-lumen nokuzilungiselela ukuthuthwa ziye ezinhlelweni zokujikeleza kwegazi kanye neze-lymphatic
question4: Kungani i-pseudostratified columnar epithelium ibonakala inezendlalelo eziningi?
answer4: Ngoba ama-nuclei atholakala emazingeni ahlukene ngisho noma iseli ngalinye lithinta i-basement membrane
distractor4a: Ngoba empeleni yakhiwe yizingqimba eziningi zamaseli
distractor4c: Ngoba amaseli abekwe phezu komunye nomunye
question5: Itholakala kuphi i-pseudostratified columnar epithelium?
question6: Uyini umsebenzi we-cilia kumaseli e-epithelial e-pseudostratified columnar?
answer6: Ukususa amafinyila nezinhlayiya ezivalelekile endleleni yokuphefumula
question7: Uyini umsebenzi wamaseli e-goblet endleleni yokuphefumula?
answer7: Zikhipha amafinyila abamba izinto ezicasulayo futhi azisize ekuvimbeleni ukungena emaphashini

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 24. Umzimba Wezilwane: Ifomu Nomsebenzi Oyisisekelo | 24.2 Izicubu Eziyinhloko Zezilwane | Izicubu Ze-Epithelial | I-Transitional Epithelia
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 24. Umzimba Wezilwane: Ifomu Nomsebenzi Oyisisekelo | 24.2 Izicubu Eziyinhloko Zezilwane | Izicubu Ze-Epithelial | I-Transitional Epithelia
chapterContent: Amaseli e-transitional noma e-uroepithelial avela kuphela ohlelweni lomchamo, ikakhulukazi esinyeni kanye ne-ureter. Lawa maseli ahlelwe ngesendlalelo esihlukaniswe ngezigaba, kodwa anamandla okubonakala enqwabelana phezu komunye nomunye kwesinyeni esikhululekile nesingenalutho, njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 24.11. Njengoba isinye sigcwala, isendlalelo se-epithelial siyavuleka futhi sinwebeke ukuze sibambe umthamo womchamo ofakwe kuso. Njengoba isinye sigcwala, siyanwebeka futhi ulwelwesi luba luncane. Ngamanye amazwi, izicubu ziyashintsha zisuka kobukhulu ziye kobuncane.
answer1: Esistimu yomchamo, ikakhulukazi esinyeni kanye ne-ureter
question2: Ahlelwe kanjani amaseli e-epithelial aguqukayo?
question3: I-epithelium yesikhashana ivela kanjani lapho isinye singenalutho futhi sikhululekile?
answer3: Amaseli abonakala enqwabelene, okwenza izicubu zibukeke zijiyile
distractor3a: Amaseli aba yisicaba futhi akha ungqimba olulodwa
question4: Kwenzekani ku-epithelium yesikhashana njengoba isinyi somchamo sigcwalisa?
answer4: Ingqimba ye-epithelial iyavuleka futhi iba mncane njengoba inwebeka
distractor4b: Amaseli ahlukana ngokushesha ukuze kwandiswe inani lezingqimba
distractor4c: Izicubu ziyashintsha zibe yi-epithelium elula ye-squamous
question5: Uyini umsebenzi oyinhloko we-epithelium yesikhashana?
answer5: Ukuvumela izitho zomchamo ukuthi zelule futhi zivumelane nokushintshashintsha komthamo womchamo
question6: Kungani i-epithelium yesikhashana ifaneleka kahle isinyi somchamo?
answer6: Ngoba ingakhula futhi ibuyele esimweni sayo sokuqala njengoba isinyi sigcwala futhi siphela
distractor6a: Ngoba yakhiwe ngesendlalelo esisodwa sokusabalalisa okusheshayo
distractor6c: Ngoba iqinile unomphela futhi imelana nokunwebeka
question7: Bheka uMfanekiso 24.11 kanye noMfanekiso 24.11.1. Isithombe sibonisa amangqamuzana e-epithelial aguqukayo akha izindonga zesinyi. I-lumen yindawo engenalutho egcwala umchamo. Ubungabikezela ukuthi kuzokwenzekani kulawo maseli njengoba isinyi sigcwala umchamo?
answer7: Ulwelwesi lwe-epithelial luyavuleka futhi lube luncane
distractor7a: Ulwelwesi lwe-epithelial luyavuleka futhi lube lujiyile
distractor7b: Ulwelwesi lwe-epithelial luhlala lugoqiwe ngamaseli anqwabelene
distractor7c: Ulwelwesi lwe-epithelial luyavuleka, kodwa luhlala lufana nobukhulu

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 24. Umzimba Wezilwane: Isakhiwo Nomsebenzi Oyisisekelo | 24.2 Izicubu Eziyinhloko Zezilwane | Izicubu Ezixhumeneyo
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 24. Umzimba Wezilwane: Isakhiwo Nomsebenzi Oyisisekelo | 24.2 Izicubu Eziyinhloko Zezilwane | Izicubu Ezixhumeneyo
chapterContent:
Izicubu ezixhumene zakhiwe yi-matrix equkethe amangqamuzana aphilayo kanye nento engaphili, ebizwa ngokuthi into engaphansi komhlaba. Into engaphansi komhlaba yenziwe ngento ephilayo (ngokuvamile iphrotheni) kanye nento engaphili (ngokuvamile iminerali noma amanzi). Iseli eliyinhloko lezicubu ezixhumene yi-fibroblast. Leli seli lenza imicu etholakala cishe kuzo zonke izicubu ezixhumene. Ama-Fibroblast ayanyakaza, akwazi ukwenza i-mitosis, futhi angahlanganisa noma yiziphi izicubu ezixhumene ezidingekayo. Ama-Macrophage, ama-lymphocyte, futhi, ngezinye izikhathi, ama-leukocyte angatholakala kwezinye izicubu. Ezinye izicubu zinamaseli akhethekile angatholakali kwezinye. I-matrix ezicutshini ezixhumeneyo inikeza izicubu ubuningi bazo. Lapho izicubu ezixhumeneyo zinezinga eliphezulu lamaseli noma imicu, ine-matrix encane kakhulu.

 Ingxenye ephilayo noma imicu yamaprotheni etholakala ezicutshini ezixhumeneyo yi-collagen, elastic, noma imicu ye-reticular. Imicu ye-Collagen inikeza amandla ezicutshini, ivimbela ukuthi ziqhekeke noma zihlukaniswe nezicubu ezizungezile. Imicu ye-Elastic yenziwe nge-protein elastin; Le fibre inganwebeka ibe yinye nengxenye yobude bayo bese ibuyela kusayizi wayo wokuqala kanye nesimo sayo. Imicu ye-Elastic inikeza ukuguquguquka kwezicubu. Imicu ye-reticular uhlobo lwesithathu lwe-protein fibre olutholakala ezicutshini ezixhumene. Le fibre yakhiwe imicu emincane ye-collagen eyakha inethiwekhi yemicu yokusekela izicubu nezinye izitho lapho ixhunywe khona. Izinhlobo ezahlukene zezicubu ezixhumene, izinhlobo zamaseli kanye nemicu ezenziwe ngazo, kanye nezindawo zesampula zezicubu kufingqiwe kuthebula elingezansi.

 Izicubu Ezixhumene

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 24. Umzimba Wezilwane: Isakhiwo Nomsebenzi Oyisisekelo | 24.2 Izicubu Eziyinhloko Zezilwane | Izicubu Ezixhumene | Izicubu Ezixhumene Ezikhululekile/Ezingangeni
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 24. Umzimba Wezilwane: Isakhiwo Nomsebenzi Oyisisekelo | 24.2 Izicubu Eziyinhloko Zezilwane | Izicubu Ezixhumene | Izicubu Ezixhumene Ezikhululekile/Ezingangeni
chapterContent: Izicubu ezixhumeneyo ezikhululekile, ezibizwa nangokuthi izicubu ezixhumeneyo ze-areolar, zinesampula yazo zonke izingxenye zezicubu ezixhumeneyo. Njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 24.12, izicubu ezixhumeneyo ezikhululekile zinama-fibroblast athile; ama-macrophage nawo akhona. Imicu ye-Collagen ibanzi kakhulu futhi inombala opinki okhanyayo, kuyilapho imicu enwebekayo imincane futhi inombala oluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka kuya kumnyama. Isikhala esiphakathi kwezinto ezakhiwe zezicubu sigcwele i-matrix. Izinto ezisezicutshini ezixhumeneyo zisinika ukuqina okukhululekile okufana nebhola likotini elikhishwe lahlukaniswa. Izicubu ezixhumeneyo ezikhululekile zitholakala kuyo yonke imithambo yegazi futhi zisiza ukugcina imithambo yegazi isendaweni yayo. Izicubu zitholakala futhi phakathi kwezitho eziningi zomzimba. Ngamafuphi, izicubu ze-areolar ziqinile, kodwa ziguquguquka, futhi zakhiwe ngama-membrane.

chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 24. Umzimba Wezilwane: Isakhiwo Nomsebenzi Oyisisekelo | 24.2 Izicubu Eziyinhloko Zezilwane | Izicubu Ezixhumene | Izicubu Ezixhumene Nezinhlayiya
chapterContent: Izicubu ezixhumene ezinezintambo ziqukethe inani elikhulu lemicu ye-collagen kanye namaseli ambalwa noma izinto ze-matrix. Imicu ingahlelwa ngendlela engajwayelekile noma njalo ngemicu ebekwe ngendlela efanayo. Izicubu ezixhumene ezinezintambo ezingahlelekile zitholakala ezindaweni zomzimba lapho kuvela khona ukucindezeleka kuzo zonke izinhlangothi, njenge-dermis yesikhumba. Izicubu ezixhumene ezinezintambo ezivamile, eziboniswe kuMfanekiso 24.13, zitholakala kuma-tendon (axhumanisa imisipha namathambo) kanye nama-ligaments (axhumanisa amathambo namathambo)

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 24. Umzimba Wezilwane: Isakhiwo Nomsebenzi Oyisisekelo | 24.2 Izicubu Eziyinhloko Zezilwane | Izicubu Ezixhumene | I-Cartilage
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 24. Umzimba Wezilwane: Isakhiwo Nomsebenzi Oyisisekelo | 24.2 Izicubu Eziyinhloko Zezilwane | Izicubu Ezixhumene | I-Cartilage
chapterContent:
I-cartilage iyizicubu ezixhumanisayo ezinenani elikhulu le-matrix kanye nenani eliguquguqukayo lemicu. Amaseli, abizwa ngokuthi ama-chondrocytes, enza i-matrix kanye nemicu yezicubu. Ama-Chondrocytes atholakala ezindaweni ezingaphakathi kwezicubu ezibizwa ngokuthi ama-lacunae.

 I-cartilage enemicu embalwa ye-collagen kanye ne-elastic yi-hyaline cartilage, eboniswe ku-Figure 24.14. Ama-lacunae ahlakazeka ngokungahleliwe kuzo zonke izicubu futhi i-matrix ithatha ukubukeka okufana nobisi noma okuhlanziwe ngamabala ajwayelekile e-histological. Oshaka banezihlakala ze-cartilaginous, njengoba kunjalo cishe wonke uhlaka lomuntu ngesikhathi esithile sokuthuthukiswa kwangaphambi kokuzalwa. Insalela yale cartilage ihlala engxenyeni engaphandle yekhala lomuntu. I-hyaline cartilage itholakala futhi emaphethelweni amathambo amade, inciphisa ukungqubuzana futhi ivikele ukuhlangana kwala mathambo.

 I-cartilage e-elastic inemicu eminingi e-elastic, eyinika ukuguquguquka okukhulu. Izindlebe zezilwane eziningi ezinomgogodla ziqukethe le cartilage njengoba kunjalo nezingxenye ze-larynx, noma ibhokisi lezwi. I-Fibrocartilage iqukethe inani elikhulu lemicu ye-collagen, enikeza izicubu amandla amakhulu. I-Fibrocartilage yakha ama-disc e-intervertebral ezilwaneni ezinezinhlungu. I-Hyaline cartilage etholakala emalungeni ashukumayo njengedolo nehlombe iyalimala ngenxa yokuguga noma ukulimala. I-hyaline cartilage eyonakele ithathelwa indawo yi-fibrocartilage futhi ibangela ukuthi amalunga aqine.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 24. Umzimba Wezilwane: Isakhiwo Nomsebenzi Oyisisekelo | 24.2 Izicubu Eziyinhloko Zezilwane | Izicubu Ezixhumene | Ithambo
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 24. Umzimba Wezilwane: Isakhiwo Nomsebenzi Oyisisekelo | 24.2 Izicubu Eziyinhloko Zezilwane | Izicubu Ezixhumene | Ithambo
chapterContent:
Ithambo, noma izicubu ezinamathambo, iyizicubu ezixhumanisayo ezinezinhlobo ezimbili ezahlukene zezinto ze-matrix. I-matrix yezinto eziphilayo ifana nezinto ze-matrix ezitholakala kwezinye izicubu ezixhumanisayo, okuhlanganisa inani elithile le-collagen kanye ne-elastic fibers. Lokhu kunikeza amandla nokuguquguquka kwezicubu. I-matrix yezinto eziphilayo iqukethe usawoti wamaminerali—ikakhulukazi usawoti we-calcium—onikeza ubulukhuni bezicubu. Ngaphandle kwezinto eziphilayo ezanele ku-matrix, izicubu ziyaphuka; ngaphandle kwezinto ezingaphili ezanele ku-matrix, izicubu ziyagoba.

 Kunezinhlobo ezintathu zamaseli emathanjeni: ama-osteoblast, ama-osteocyte, nama-osteoclast. Ama-osteoblast ayasebenza ekwenzeni ithambo ukuze akhule futhi avuselele. Ama-osteoblast afaka izinto zamathambo ku-matrix futhi, ngemva kokuba i-matrix izizungezile, ayaqhubeka nokuphila, kodwa esimweni esinciphile se-metabolic njengama-osteocyte. Ama-osteocyte atholakala emingxunyeni yethambo. Ama-osteoclast ayasebenza ekuphuleni ithambo ukuze avuselele amathambo, futhi ahlinzeka ngokufinyelela ku-calcium egcinwe ezicutshini. Ama-osteoclast avame ukutholakala ebusweni bezicubu.

 Ithambo lingahlukaniswa ngezinhlobo ezimbili: eliqinile neliyisiponji. Ithambo eliqinile litholakala ku-shaft (noma i-diaphysis) yethambo elide kanye nobuso bamathambo asicaba, kanti ithambo eliyisiponji litholakala ekugcineni (noma i-epiphysis) kwethambo elide. Ithambo eliqinile lihlelwe ngamayunithi amancane abizwa ngokuthi ama-osteon, njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 24.15. Umthambo wegazi kanye nomthambo kutholakala maphakathi nesakhiwo ngaphakathi komsele waseHaversian, onezindilinga ze-lacunae eziwuzungezile ezaziwa ngokuthi ama-lamellae. Imigqa egobile ebonakala phakathi kwe-lacunae yiziteshi ezincane ezibizwa ngokuthi ama-canaliculi; zixhumanisa i-lacunae ukusiza ukusabalala phakathi kwamaseli. Ithambo eliyisiponji lenziwe ngamapuleti amancane abizwa ngokuthi ama-trabeculae lawa mapuleti asebenza njengezintambo zokunikeza ithambo eliyisiponji amandla. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, la mapuleti angaphuka okwenza ithambo lingasakwazi ukuqina. Izicubu zethambo zakha uhlaka lwangaphakathi lwezilwane ezinomgogodla, zihlinzeka ngesakhiwo esilwaneni kanye namaphuzu okunamathela emisipha.

chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 24. Umzimba Wezilwane: Ifomu Nomsebenzi Oyisisekelo | 24.2 Izicubu Eziyinhloko Zezilwane | Izicubu Ezixhumene | Izicubu Zamafutha
chapterContent: Izicubu zamafutha, noma izicubu zamafutha, zibhekwa njengezicubu ezixhumanisayo yize zingenayo i-fibroblast noma i-matrix yangempela futhi zinemicu embalwa kuphela. Izicubu zamafutha zakhiwe ngamaseli abizwa ngokuthi ama-adipocytes aqoqa futhi agcine amafutha ngesimo se-triglycerides, ukuze kusetshenziswe amandla. Izicubu zamafutha ziphinde zisebenze njengokuvikela ukugcina amazinga okushisa omzimba, okuvumela izilwane ukuba zibe yi-endothermic, futhi zisebenza njengokuvikela ekulimaleni kwezitho zomzimba. Ngaphansi kwe-microscope, amangqamuzana ezicubu zamafutha abonakala engenalutho ngenxa yokukhishwa kwamafutha ngesikhathi sokucubungula izinto zokubukwa, njengoba kubonwe kuMfanekiso 24.16. Imigqa emincane esithombeni yizindwangu zeseli, kanti ama-nuclei angamachashazi amancane amnyama emaphethelweni amaseli.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 24. Umzimba Wezilwane: Ifomu Nomsebenzi Oyisisekelo | 24.2 Izicubu Eziyinhloko Zezilwane | Izicubu Ezixhumene | Igazi
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 24. Umzimba Wezilwane: Ifomu Nomsebenzi Oyisisekelo | 24.2 Izicubu Eziyinhloko Zezilwane | Izicubu Ezixhumene | Igazi
chapterContent:
Igazi libhekwa njengezicubu ezixhumene ngoba line-matrix, njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 24.17. Izinhlobo zamaseli aphilayo amaseli abomvu egazi (RBC), abizwa nangokuthi ama-erythrocyte, kanye namaseli amhlophe egazi (WBC), abizwa nangokuthi ama-leukocyte. Ingxenye yoketshezi yegazi lonke, i-matrix yayo, ivame ukubizwa ngokuthi i-plasma.

 Iseli elitholakala ngobuningi kakhulu egazini yi-erythrocyte. Ama-Erythrocyte abalwa ngezigidi kusampula yegazi: inani elimaphakathi lamaseli abomvu egazi kuma-primate lingamaseli ayizigidi ezingu-4.7 kuya ku-5.5 nge-microliter ngayinye. Ama-Erythrocyte alingana njalo ohlotsheni oluthile, kodwa ayahlukahluka ngobukhulu phakathi kwezinhlobo. Isibonelo, ububanzi obumaphakathi beseli elibomvu legazi le-primate bungu-7.5 um, inja iseduze no-7.0 um, kodwa ububanzi be-RBC yekati bungu-5.9 um. Ama-erythrocyte ezimvu mancane nakakhulu ku-4.6 um. Ama-erythrocyte ezilwane ezincelisayo alahlekelwa ama-nuclei awo kanye ne-mitochondria uma ekhishwa emnkantsheni lapho enziwa khona. Amaseli egazi abomvu ezinhlanzi, ama-amphibian, kanye nezinyoni agcina ama-nuclei awo kanye ne-mitochondria kuyo yonke impilo yeseli. Umsebenzi oyinhloko we-erythrocyte ukuthwala nokuletha umoya-mpilo ezicutshini.

 Ama-leukocyte amangqamuzana amhlophe egazi atholakala egazini elingaphandle. Ama-leukocyte abalwa ngezinkulungwane egazini ngezilinganiso ezivezwe njengezigaba: inani lama-primate lisukela kumaseli angu-4,800 kuya ku-10,800 nge-μl, izinja zisukela kumaseli angu-5,600 kuya ku-19,200 nge-μl, amakati asukela kumaseli angu-8,000 kuya ku-25,000 nge-μl, izinkomo zisukela kumaseli angu-4,000 kuya ku-12,000 nge-μl, kanye nezingulube zisukela kumaseli angu-11,000 kuya ku-22,000 nge-μl.

 Ama-lymphocyte asebenza ngokuyinhloko ekuphenduleni komzimba kuma-antigen angaphandle noma izinto. Izinhlobo ezahlukene zama-lymphocyte zenza ama-antibodies aklanyelwe ama-antigen angaphandle futhi alawula ukukhiqizwa kwalawo ma-antibodies. Ama-neutrophil angamaseli e-phagocytic futhi ahlanganyela komunye wemigqa yokuqala yokuzivikela kubahlaseli bamagciwane, esiza ekususweni kwamagciwane angene emzimbeni. Enye i-leukocyte etholakala egazini elingaphandle yi-monocyte. Ama-monocyte adala ama-phagocytic macrophage ahlanza amangqamuzana afile nawonakele emzimbeni, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi angaphandle noma avela esilwaneni esisiphethe. Ama-leukocyte amabili engeziwe egazini yi-eosinophils nama-basophil—womabili asiza ekwenzeni lula impendulo yokuvuvukala.

 Izinto ezincane ezihlanganisiwe phakathi kwamaseli yisiqeshana se-cytoplasmic seseli emnkantsheni wethambo. Lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi i-platelet noma i-thrombocyte. Ama-platelet ahlanganyela ezigabeni eziholela ekuqineni kwegazi ukuze kumiswe ukopha ngemithambo yegazi eyonakele. Igazi linemisebenzi eminingana, kodwa ngokuyinhloko lithutha izinto emzimbeni ukuze lilethe izakhamzimba emangqamuzaneni futhi lisuse udoti kuwo.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 24. Umzimba Wezilwane: Isakhiwo Nokusebenza Okuyisisekelo | 24.2 Izicubu Eziyinhloko Zezilwane | Izicubu Zemisipha | Imisipha Ebushelelezi | Imisipha Yamathambo | Imisipha Yenhliziyo
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 24. Umzimba Wezilwane: Isakhiwo Nokusebenza Okuyisisekelo | 24.2 Izicubu Eziyinhloko Zezilwane | Izicubu Zemisipha | Imisipha Ebushelelezi | Imisipha Yamathambo | Imisipha Yenhliziyo
chapterContent:
Kunezinhlobo ezintathu zemisipha emizimbeni yezilwane: ebushelelezi, eyohlakaniphe, neyenhliziyo. Ziyahluka ngokuba khona noma ukungabikho kwemigqa noma ama-band, inani nendawo yama-nuclei, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi alawulwa ngokuzithandela noma ngokungazithandeli, kanye nendawo yawo emzimbeni. Ithebula elingezansi lifingqa lo mehluko.

 Izinhlobo Zemisipha
Uhlobo Lwemisipha
Imigqa_____I-Nuclei_____Ukulawula___Indawo

 bushelelezi
akukho_____oyedwa, enkabeni_____ngokuzithandela_____izitho zomzimba

 uhlaka lwamathambo
yebo_____oyedwa, enkabeni_____ngokuzithandela_____inhliziyo

 Uhlaka Lwamathambo ... Ine-nucleus eyodwa, etholakala phakathi nendawo, njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 24.18. Ukuminyana kwemisipha ebushelelezi kwenzeka ngaphansi kokulawulwa kwemizwa okuzenzakalelayo, okuzenzakalelayo kanye nokuphendula izimo zendawo ezicutshini. Izicubu zemisipha ezibushelelezi zibizwa nangokuthi azinama-striated njengoba zingenawo ukubukeka okuhlanganisiwe kwemisipha yamathambo neyenhliziyo. Izindonga zemithambo yegazi, amapayipi ohlelo lokugaya ukudla, kanye namapayipi ezinhlelo zokuzala zakhiwe yimisipha ebushelelezi kakhulu.

 Imisipha Yamathambo
Imisipha yamathambo ine-striations kuwo wonke amaseli ayo okubangelwa ukuhlelwa kwamaprotheni aqunyiwe i-actin ne-myosin. Lawa maseli emisipha amade kakhulu futhi anama-nuclei amaningi emaphethelweni eseli. Imisipha yamathambo ingaphansi kokulawulwa kwesistimu yezinzwa ngokuzithandela, ye-somatic futhi itholakala emisipheni enyakazisa amathambo. Umfanekiso 24.18 ubonisa i-histology yemisipha yamathambo.

 Imisipha Yenhliziyo
Imisipha yenhliziyo, eboniswe kuMfanekiso 24.18, itholakala enhliziyweni kuphela. Njengemisipha yamathambo, inezingqimba eziwela emaseli ayo, kodwa imisipha yenhliziyo ine-nucleus eyodwa, ephakathi nendawo. Imisipha yenhliziyo ayilawulwa ngokuzithandela kodwa ingathonywa uhlelo lwezinzwa oluzimele ukuze lusheshise noma lwehlise ijubane. Isici esengeziwe kumaseli emisipha yenhliziyo umugqa odlula ekugcineni kweseli njengoba ugoqa iseli lenhliziyo elilandelayo emgqeni. Lo mugqa ubizwa ngokuthi i-disc ehlanganisiwe: uyasiza ekudluliseni i-electrical impulse ngempumelelo kusuka kwelinye iseli kuya kwelinye futhi ugcina ukuxhumana okuqinile phakathi kwamaseli enhliziyo angomakhelwane.

chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 24. Umzimba Wezilwane: Isakhiwo Nomsebenzi Oyisisekelo | 24.2 Izicubu Eziyinhloko Zezilwane | Izicubu Ezinemizwa
chapterContent: Izicubu zemizwa zenziwe ngamaseli akhethekile ukwamukela nokudlulisa ama-impulse kagesi avela ezindaweni ezithile zomzimba nokuwathumela ezindaweni ezithile emzimbeni. Iseli eliyinhloko lesimiso sezinzwa yi-neuron, eliboniswe ku-Figure 24.19. Isakhiwo esikhulu esine-nucleus ephakathi umzimba weseli we-neuron. Ama-projection avela emzimbeni weseli angama-dendrites akhethekile ekwamukeleni okungenayo noma i-axon eyodwa ekhethekile ekwadluliseni ama-impulse. Amanye amaseli e-glial nawo ayaboniswa. Ama-astrocyte alawula indawo yamakhemikhali yeseli lezinzwa, futhi ama-oligodendrocyte avikela i-axon ukuze i-electrical nerve impulse idluliselwe kahle kakhulu. Amanye amaseli e-glial angaboniswanga asekela izidingo zokudla okunempilo kanye nokulahlwa kwe-neuron. Amanye amaseli e-glial ayinkimbinkimbi futhi asusa udoti noma amaseli alimele ezicutshini. Izicubu zezinzwa zakhiwa ama-neurons namaseli e-glial

chapterContent: Isazi sezifo ngudokotela noma udokotela wezilwane ogxile ekutholeni izifo elabhorethri ezilwaneni, okuhlanganisa nabantu. Laba ochwepheshe baqeda imfundo yesikole sezokwelapha futhi bayilandela ngokuhlala isikhathi eside esikhungweni sezokwelapha. Isazi sezifo singase sibhekele amalabhorethri emitholampilo ukuze kuhlolwe izicubu zomzimba kanye namasampula egazi ukuze kutholakale isifo noma ukutheleleka. Bahlola amasampula ezicubu nge-microscope ukuze bathole izifo. Abanye ososayensi bezifo benza ukuhlolwa kwezidumbu ukuze bathole imbangela yokufa kanye nokuqhubeka kwesifo.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 24. Umzimba Wezilwane: Ifomu Nomsebenzi Oyisisekelo | 24.3 I-Homeostasis | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 24. Umzimba Wezilwane: Ifomu Nomsebenzi Oyisisekelo | 24.3 I-Homeostasis | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent:
Izilwane kumele zikwazi ukugcina i-homeostasis—ikhono lokugcina ukulingana okuguquguqukayo endaweni ethile—ngenkathi zikwazi nokusabela ezimweni ezishintshayo. Isibonelo, njenge-endotherm, izinga lokushisa lomzimba wakho lihlala lingaguquki cishe ku-37◦C noma ku-98.6◦F. Uma izinga lokushisa lakho likhuphuka ngaphezu kwephuzu elibekiwe, uyajuluka ukuze uphole; uma izinga lokushisa lakho lehla ngaphansi kwephuzu elibekiwe, uyathuthumela ukuze ufudumale. Amazinga akho kashukela egazini nawo ahlala engaguquki ngoba isibindi sisusa i-glucose egazini bese siyiguqula ibe yi-glycogen; lapho amangqamuzana omzimba edinga i-glucose, i-glycogen iyaqhekeka. (Cishe ungacabanga ukuthi isibindi sakho sizosabela kanjani uma udla ama-jelly donuts ayishumi nambili!) Ukwehluleka ukugcina i-homeostasis kungaba yingozi futhi kungabangela nokufa. Ngenxa yalokho, ama-negative kanye/noma ama-positive feedback loops alawula i-homeostasis.

 Izindlela ze-negative feedback ziholela ekushintsheni okuncane ngaphezulu nangaphansi kwephuzu elibekiwe. Isibonelo, uma ubungadla ama-jelly donuts ayishumi nambili, izinga likashukela egazini lakho lingakhuphuka, futhi ama-pancreas akho angakhipha i-insulin, i-hormone ehilelekile ekuguqulweni kwe-glucose ibe yi-glycogen, ngaleyo ndlela abuyisele izinga likashukela egazini lakho endaweni yalo efanele. Ngokuqhathanisa, impendulo enhle yandisa izimpendulo ngendlela efanayo, lapho okuguquguqukayo kuqala impendulo eshukumisa uhlelo kude kakhulu nephuzu elibekiwe. Kunezibonelo ezimbalwa zempendulo enhle, kodwa esinye ukuqala kokubeletha lapho ukufinyela kwesibeletho kukhula ngamandla ngokukhiqizwa kwe-oxytocin, enye i-hormone. Kodwa-ke, ukulahlekelwa ukulingana kwangaphakathi ngenxa yempendulo enhle kungaba yingozi; isibonelo, indawo encane yezicubu zenhliziyo ezonakele ingabangela ukuhlaselwa yinhliziyo, okulimaza imisipha yenhliziyo eyengeziwe.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyiswe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo echazwe ku-Big Idea 2 ye-AP Biology® Curriculum Framework. Izinhloso Zokufunda ze-AP® ezibhalwe ku-Curriculum Framework zinikeza isisekelo esicacile senkambo ye-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekubuzeni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo nomunye noma ngaphezulu weMikhuba Yesayensi eyisikhombisa.

 Umqondo Omkhulu 2

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 2.C

 Izitho zezilwane kanye nezinhlelo zezitho zihlala zivumelana nezinguquko zangaphakathi nezangaphandle ngenqubo ebizwa ngokuthi i-homeostasis (isimo esizinzile). Lezi zinguquko zingase zibe sezingeni le-glucose noma i-calcium egazini noma emazingeni okushisa angaphandle. I-Homeostasis isho ukugcina ukulingana okuguquguqukayo emzimbeni. Kuyi-dynamic ngoba ihlala ivumelana nezinguquko ezihlangabezana nezinhlelo zomzimba. Kuyi-equilibrium ngoba imisebenzi yomzimba igcinwa ngaphakathi kwebanga elithile. Ngisho nesilwane esibonakala singasebenzi silondoloza lokulingana kwe-homeostatic.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 24. Umzimba Wezilwane: Ifomu Nomsebenzi Oyisisekelo | 24.3 I-Homeostasis | Inqubo Ye-Homeostatic
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 24. Umzimba Wezilwane: Ifomu Nomsebenzi Oyisisekelo | 24.3 I-Homeostasis | Inqubo Ye-Homeostatic
chapterContent: Umgomo we-homeostasis ukugcinwa kokulingana okuzungeze iphuzu noma inani elibizwa ngokuthi iphuzu elibekiwe. Nakuba kunokuguquguquka okuvamile kusuka endaweni ebekiwe, izinhlelo zomzimba zivame ukuzama ukubuyela kuleli phuzu. Ushintsho endaweni yangaphakathi noma yangaphandle lubizwa ngokuthi isikhuthazo futhi lutholakala yi-receptor; impendulo yesistimu ukulungisa ipharamitha yokuphambuka iye endaweni ebekiwe. Isibonelo, uma umzimba ufudumala kakhulu, kwenziwa izinguquko zokupholisa isilwane. Uma ushukela wegazi ukhuphuka ngemva kokudla, kwenziwa izinguquko zokwehlisa izinga likashukela egazini ngokungenisa izakhamzimba ezicutshini ezidingayo noma ukuze zigcinwe ukuze zisetshenziswe kamuva.
answer1: Ukugcina ukulingana endaweni ethile
distractor1a: Ukugcina zonke izimo zomzimba zizinzile ngokuphelele
question2: Iyini iphuzu elibekiwe?
answer2: Inani elijwayelekile noma ububanzi umzimba ogcina ukulingana nxazonke
distractor2a: Inani eliphakeme kakhulu elingenzeka le-body variable

answer7: Yehlisa ushukela wegazi ngokuhambisa ushukela ezicutshini noma ukuwugcina ukuze usetshenziswe kamuva

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 24. Umzimba Wezilwane: Ifomu Nomsebenzi Oyisisekelo | 24.3 I-Homeostasis | Ukulawulwa kwe-Homeostasis
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 24. Umzimba Wezilwane: Ifomu Nomsebenzi Oyisisekelo | 24.3 I-Homeostasis | Ukulawulwa kwe-Homeostasis
chapterContent: Uma kwenzeka ushintsho endaweni yesilwane, kufanele kwenziwe ukulungiswa. I-receptor izwa ushintsho endaweni ezungezile, bese ithumela isignali esikhungweni sokulawula (ezimweni eziningi, ebuchosheni) okuthi yona ikhiqize impendulo enikezwa isignali ku-effector. I-effector iyisicubu (esincipha noma esiphumuzayo) noma i-gland ekhipha i-hormone. I-Homeostasis igcinwa yi-negative feedback loops. I-positive feedback loops empeleni isunduza i-organism kude ne-homeostasis, kodwa ingadingeka ukuze kwenzeke impilo. I-Homeostasis ilawulwa uhlelo lwezinzwa kanye ne-endocrine lwezilwane ezincelisayo.
question1: Yisiphi isinyathelo sokuqala empendulweni ye-homeostatic ekushintsheni kwemvelo?
answer1: I-receptor ibona ushintsho endaweni ezungezile
question2: Iyini indima eyinhloko yesikhungo sokulawula ku-homeostasis?
answer2: Ukucubungula ulwazi oluvela kuma-receptor nokuthumela amasignali kuma-effectors
question3: Ezimweni eziningi, yini esebenza njengesikhungo sokulawula i-homeostasis?

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 24. Umzimba Wezilwane: Ifomu Nomsebenzi Oyisisekelo | 24.3 I-Homeostasis | Ukulawulwa kwe-Homeostasis | Izindlela Zokuphendula Ezingalungile
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 24. Umzimba Wezilwane: Ifomu Nomsebenzi Oyisisekelo | 24.3 I-Homeostasis | Ukulawulwa kwe-Homeostasis | Izindlela Zokuphendula Ezingalungile
chapterContent: Noma iyiphi inqubo ye-homeostatic eshintsha indlela yesikhuthazo iyi-negative feedback loop. Ingase ikhulise noma yehlise isikhuthazo, kodwa isikhuthazo asivunyelwe ukuqhubeka njengoba senza ngaphambi kokuba i-receptor isizwe. Ngamanye amazwi, uma izinga liphezulu kakhulu, umzimba wenza okuthile ukuze ulihlise, futhi ngokuphambene nalokho, uma izinga liphansi kakhulu, umzimba wenza okuthile ukuze ulinyuse. Ngakho-ke igama elithi impendulo engemihle. Isibonelo ukugcinwa kwezilwane kwamazinga kashukela egazini. Lapho isilwane sesidlile, amazinga kashukela egazini ayakhuphuka. Lokhu kuzwakala uhlelo lwezinzwa. Amaseli akhethekile kuma-pancreas ayaqonda lokhu, kanti i-hormone i-insulin ikhishwa uhlelo lwe-endocrine. I-insulin ibangela amazinga kashukela egazini ukuba ehle, njengoba kungalindelwa ohlelweni lwempendulo engemihle, njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 24.20. Kodwa-ke, uma isilwane singadlanga futhi amazinga kashukela egazini ehla, lokhu kuzwakala kwelinye iqembu lamaseli kuma-pancreas, futhi i-hormone i-glucagon ikhishwa okwenza amazinga kashukela akhuphuke. Lokhu kuseyi-negative feedback loop, kodwa hhayi ngendlela elindelwe ngokusebenzisa igama elithi negative.” Esinye isibonelo sokwanda ngenxa ye-feedback loop ukulawula i-calcium egazini. Uma amazinga e-calcium ehla, amaseli akhethekile e-parathyroid gland ayakuzwa lokhu bese ekhulula i-parathyroid hormone (PTH), okubangela ukumuncwa okwengeziwe kwe-calcium ngamathumbu nezinso, futhi mhlawumbe, ukuwohloka kwamathambo ukuze kukhululwe i-calcium. Imiphumela ye-PTH ukuphakamisa amazinga egazi e-element. Ama-negative feedback loops ayindlela esetshenziswa kakhulu ku-homeostasis.

answer1: Ukuguqula ushintsho bese ubuyisela okuguquguqukayo endaweni yalo ebekiwe

answer2: Iqala izimpendulo ezehlisa i-variable iye ebangeni layo elijwayelekile

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 24. Umzimba Wezilwane: Ifomu Nomsebenzi Oyisisekelo | 24.3 I-Homeostasis | Ukulawulwa kwe-Homeostasis | I-Loop Yempendulo Enhle
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 24. Umzimba Wezilwane: Ifomu Nomsebenzi Oyisisekelo | 24.3 I-Homeostasis | Ukulawulwa kwe-Homeostasis | I-Loop Yempendulo Enhle
chapterContent: I-positive feedback loop igcina indlela ye-stimulus, mhlawumbe iyisheshise. Zimbalwa izibonelo ze-positive feedback loop ezikhona emizimbeni yezilwane, kodwa eyodwa itholakala eqoqweni lezimpendulo zamakhemikhali eziholela ekuqineni kwegazi, noma ekuqineni kwegazi. Njengoba i-clotting factor eyodwa isebenza, ivuselela i-factor elandelayo ngokulandelana kuze kube yilapho kufinyelelwa i-fibrin clot. I-factor yokugcina, iphrotheni ebizwa ngokuthi i-thrombin, iguqula i-fibrinogen engasebenzi ibe yi-fibrin. I-Thrombin iphinde isebenze ama-molecule e-clotting factor engeziwe ekuqaleni kwe-cascade, okuholela ekusebenzeni kwe-thrombin eyengeziwe. Le positive feedback loop ikhulisa i-cascade ukuze kwakheke i-blood clot ngokushesha nangendlela ephumelelayo. Esinye isibonelo se-positive feedback ukuqineka kwesibeletho ngesikhathi sokubeletha, njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 24.21. I-hormone i-oxytocin, eyenziwe uhlelo lwe-endocrine, ivuselela ukuqineka kwesibeletho. Lokhu kukhuthazeka kuzwakala uhlelo lwezinzwa. Esikhundleni sokwehlisa i-oxytocin, kukhiqizwa i-oxytocin eyengeziwe kuze kube yilapho ukuqineka kunamandla okukhiqiza ukubeletha.

answer1: Kuqinisa futhi kwandise isikhuthazo sokuqala

answer4: Ngoba izinto eziqinisa ukujiya ezisebenza zivuselela ukusebenza kwezinye izinto eziqinisa ukujiya
