chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 24. Umzimba Wezilwane: Ifomu Nomsebenzi Oyisisekelo | 24.3 I-Homeostasis | Ukulawulwa kwe-Homeostasis | Iphuzu Elibekiwe
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 24. Umzimba Wezilwane: Ifomu Nomsebenzi Oyisisekelo | 24.3 I-Homeostasis | Ukulawulwa kwe-Homeostasis | Iphuzu Elibekiwe
chapterContent:
Kungenzeka ukulungisa iphuzu elibekiwe lesistimu. Uma lokhu kwenzeka, i-feedback loop isebenza ukugcina indawo entsha. Isibonelo salokhu umfutho wegazi: ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, iphuzu elijwayelekile noma elibekiwe lomfutho wegazi linganda ngenxa yokwanda okuqhubekayo komfutho wegazi. Umzimba awusaqapheli ukuphakama njengokungavamile futhi akukho mzamo owenziwayo wokubuyela endaweni ephansi ebekiwe. Umphumela uba ukugcinwa komfutho wegazi ophakeme ongaba nemiphumela emibi emzimbeni. Imithi inganciphisa umfutho wegazi futhi yehlise iphuzu elibekiwe ohlelweni ibe sezingeni elinempilo kakhudlwana. Lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi inqubo yokuguqulwa kwephuzu elibekiwe ku-feedback loop.

 Izinguquko zingenziwa eqenjini lezinhlelo zezitho zomzimba ukuze kugcinwe iphuzu elibekiwe kwenye uhlelo. Lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi i-acclimatization. Lokhu kwenzeka, isibonelo, lapho isilwane sithuthela endaweni ephakeme kunalokho esikujwayele. Ukuze sivumelane namazinga aphansi omoya-mpilo endaweni entsha ephakeme, umzimba wandisa inani lamaseli abomvu egazi ajikeleza egazini ukuqinisekisa ukulethwa okwanele komoya-mpilo ezicutshini. Esinye isibonelo sokujwayelana nezilwane ezishintshashintshayo ngezikhathi ezithile zonyaka: uboya obunzima ebusika buqinisekisa ukugcinwa kokushisa okwanele, kanti uboya obuncane ehlobo buyasiza ekugcineni izinga lokushisa lomzimba lingakhuphuki liye emazingeni ayingozi.
answer1: Inani elijwayelekile noma ububanzi umzimba ozama ukubugcina
distractor1a: Izinga eliphezulu kakhulu elingafinyelelwa yi-body variable
question2: Kwenzekani uma iphuzu lesistimu lishintsha?
answer2: I-feedback loop isebenza ukugcina iphuzu elisha elibekiwe
distractor2b: Umzimba awunaki zonke izinguquko zesikhathi esizayo
distractor2c: Iphuzu lokuqala elibekiwe lihlala libuyiselwa ngokushesha

answer3: Umzimba ungase wamukele umfutho wegazi ophezulu njengendawo entsha evamile ebekwe
distractor3a: Umzimba wehlisa umfutho wegazi unomphela ngaphansi kokuvamile
question4: Imithi ingasiza kanjani ekwelapheni umfutho wegazi ophakeme njalo?
answer4: Yehlisa umfutho wegazi futhi ishintshele iphuzu elibekiwe ezingeni elinempilo
distractor4c: Kuvimbela inhliziyo ukuthi ingakwazi ukupompa igazi
question5: Kuyini ukujwayela?
answer5: Ukulungiswa kwezinhlelo zomzimba ezisiza ekugcineni i-homeostasis ngaphansi kwezimo ezintsha zemvelo
distractor5a: Ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo okuhlala njalo kudluliselwa enzalweni
question6: Umzimba ukwazi kanjani ukujwayela ukuphakama okuphezulu?
answer6: Ngokwandisa inani lamaseli abomvu egazi ajikelezayo
question7: Kungani ukwandisa inani lamaseli abomvu egazi kusiza ezindaweni eziphakeme?
answer7: Kuthuthukisa ukulethwa komoya-mpilo ezicutshini zomzimba naphezu kokutholakala komoya-mpilo okuncane
question8: Yiluphi ushintsho lwesizini oluyisibonelo sokujwayela?
answer8: Ukukhulisa uboya obukhulu ebusika kanye noboya obulula ehlobo

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 24. Umzimba Wezilwane: Ifomu Nomsebenzi Oyisisekelo | 24.3 I-Homeostasis | I-Homeostasis: Ukuqina Kwemithambo
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 24. Umzimba Wezilwane: Ifomu Nomsebenzi Oyisisekelo | 24.3 I-Homeostasis | I-Homeostasis: Ukuqina Kwemithambo
chapterContent: Izinga lokushisa lomzimba lithinta imisebenzi yomzimba. Ngokuvamile, njengoba izinga lokushisa lomzimba likhuphuka, umsebenzi we-enzyme nawo uyakhuphuka. Ngokukhuphuka kwezinga lokushisa kwama-degree ayishumi, umsebenzi we-enzyme uphinda kabili, kuze kufike eqophelweni. Amaprotheni omzimba, kufaka phakathi ama-enzyme, aqala ukuwohloka futhi alahlekelwe umsebenzi wawo ngokushisa okuphezulu (cishe ama-50oC ezincelisayo). Umsebenzi we-enzyme uzoncipha ngesigamu ngokwehla kwezinga lokushisa kwama-degree ayishumi, kuze kufike eqophelweni lokubanda, ngaphandle kwezimbalwa. Ezinye izinhlanzi zingamelana nokubanda okuqinile futhi zibuyele esimweni esijwayelekile ngokuncibilika.
question1: Ukushisa komzimba ngokuvamile kuthinta kanjani umsebenzi we-enzyme?
answer1: Njengoba izinga lokushisa lomzimba likhuphuka, umsebenzi we-enzyme uvame ukwanda kuze kufike ezingeni elifanele
distractor1a: Umsebenzi we-enzyme uhlala uncipha njengoba izinga lokushisa likhuphuka
distractor1b: Ukushisa komzimba akunawo umthelela emsebenzini we-enzyme
distractor1c: Umsebenzi we-enzyme uhlala ungaguquki kungakhathaliseki ukuthi izinga lokushisa lingakanani
question2: Cishe umsebenzi we-enzyme ushintsha kanjani ngokukhuphuka kwezinga lokushisa okungu-10°C?
answer2: Cishe iphindwe kabili, kuze kufike ephuzwini
question3: Kwenzekani kumaprotheni ezilwane ezincelisayo, okuhlanganisa nama-enzyme, emazingeni okushisa acishe abe ngu-50°C?
answer3: Ziqala ukuwohloka futhi zilahlekelwe umsebenzi wazo
question4: Umsebenzi we-enzyme uvame ukushintsha kanjani ngokuncipha kwezinga lokushisa okungu-10°C?
answer4: Iyancipha cishe ngesigamu kuze kube yilapho iqhwa lifika
question5: Kungani kubalulekile ukugcina izinga lokushisa lomzimba elifanele?
answer5: Ngoba umsebenzi we-enzyme kanye neminye imisebenzi yomzimba kuncike ekushiseni
question6: Yiziphi izinto eziphilayo okukhulunywe ngazo ezingasinda ziqine ziqandisiwe futhi zilulame ngemva kokuncibilika?
question7: Kwenzekani emsebenzini wama-enzyme lapho izinga lokushisa lomzimba liwela ngaphansi kwebanga elifanele?
question8:
Bheka uMfanekiso 24.21.1. Le grafu ikhombisa izinga lokushisa lomzimba wesilwane emahoreni ahlukahlukene osuku.

 Yini engathiwa ngalesi silwane?
answer8: Isilwane sigcina izinga lokushisa lomzimba waso lihlala lifana
distractor8b: Isilwane sisebenza kakhulu uma izinga lokushisa lomzimba waso lingaphezu kuka-30°C

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 24. Umzimba Wezilwane: Ifomu Nomsebenzi Oyisisekelo | 24.3 I-Homeostasis | Ama-Endotherms Nama-Ectotherms
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 24. Umzimba Wezilwane: Ifomu Nomsebenzi Oyisisekelo | 24.3 I-Homeostasis | Ama-Endotherms Nama-Ectotherms
chapterContent: Izilwane zingahlukaniswa ngamaqembu amabili: ezinye zigcina izinga lokushisa lomzimba elingaguquki lapho zibhekene namazinga okushisa ahlukene endawo, kanti ezinye zinezinga lokushisa lomzimba elifanayo nendawo ezikuyo futhi ngaleyo ndlela ziyahlukahluka ngokwendawo ezikuyo. Izilwane ezithembele emazingeni okushisa angaphandle ukuze zibeke izinga lokushisa lomzimba wazo ziyi-ectotherms. Leli qembu libizwa ngokuthi i-cold-blooded, kodwa leli gama lingase lingasebenzi esilwaneni esisehlane esinezinga lokushisa lomzimba elifudumele kakhulu. Ngokungafani nama-ectotherms, ama-poikilotherms yizilwane ezinamazinga okushisa angaphakathi aguquguquka njalo. Isilwane esigcina izinga lokushisa lomzimba elingaguquki lapho sibhekene nezinguquko zemvelo sibizwa ngokuthi i-homeotherm. Ama-Endotherms yizilwane ezithembele emithonjeni yangaphakathi ukuze zilondoloze izinga lokushisa lomzimba elingaguquki lapho zibhekene nezinguquko zemvelo. Lezi zilwane ziyakwazi ukugcina izinga lomsebenzi we-metabolic emazingeni okushisa angaphandle apholile, okuyinto i-ectotherm engenakukwazi ukuyenza ngenxa yamazinga omsebenzi ahlukene e-enzyme. Kuhle ukusho ukuthi amanye ama-ectotherms nama-poikilotherms anezinga lokushisa lomzimba elingaguquki ngenxa yamazinga okushisa ahlala njalo endawo ezikuyo. Lezi zilwane zibizwa ngokuthi ama-ectotherms e-ectothermic, njengezinhlobo zezinhlanzi zasolwandle olujulile.
answer1: Isilwane esithembele ekushiseni kwangaphandle ukulawula izinga lokushisa lomzimba waso
distractor1a: Isilwane esigcina izinga lokushisa lomzimba lingaguquguquki sisebenzisa ukushisa kwangaphakathi
distractor1b: Isilwane esihlala sinezinga lokushisa eliphansi lomzimba
question2: Iyini i-poikilotherm?
answer2: Isilwane esinezinga lokushisa lomzimba elishintshashintsha njalo
distractor2a: Isilwane esigcina izinga lokushisa langaphakathi lingaguquguquki
question3: Kuyini i-homeotherm?
answer3: Isilwane esigcina izinga lokushisa lomzimba lingaguquguquki naphezu kokushintsha kwesimo sezulu
distractor3a: Isilwane esinokushisa komzimba okuhlala kuhambisana nendawo esikuyo
distractor3b: Isilwane esithembele kuphela elangeni ukuze sifudumale
question4: Kuyini i-endotherm?
answer4: Isilwane esithembele emithonjeni yangaphakathi ukuze silondoloze izinga lokushisa lomzimba elingaguquguquki
distractor4b: Isilwane esingakwazi ukulawula izinga lokushisa lomzimba
distractor4c: Isilwane esihlala sinokushisa komzimba okungaphansi kwama-20°C
question5: Kungani ama-endotherm ehlala esebenza ezindaweni ezipholile?
answer5: Ngoba zikhiqiza ukushisa kwangaphakathi futhi zigcina umsebenzi we-metabolic
distractor5a: Ngoba zimunca ukushisa ngqo elangeni kuphela
distractor5c: Ngoba bayayeka ukusebenzisa amandla ezimweni ezibandayo
question6: Iyini i-homeotherm ye-ectothermic?
answer6: I-ectotherm egcina izinga lokushisa lomzimba lingaguquguquki ngoba indawo ezungezile ihlala ingaguquki
distractor6b: Isilwane esishintsha njalo izinga lokushisa lomzimba kungakhathaliseki indawo esikuyo
question7: Yiziphi izilwane ezinikezwa njengezibonelo zama-homeotherms e-ectothermic?
question8: Bheka uMfanekiso 24.23. Uma ingwenya yaseMelika ibilokhu ithamela kodwa ishisa kakhulu, ingwenya ingazipholisa kanjani?

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 24. Umzimba Wezilwane: Isakhiwo Nomsebenzi Oyisisekelo | 24.3 I-Homeostasis | Ukulondolozwa Nokushabalaliswa Kokushisa
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 24. Umzimba Wezilwane: Isakhiwo Nomsebenzi Oyisisekelo | 24.3 I-Homeostasis | Ukulondolozwa Nokushabalaliswa Kokushisa
chapterContent:
Izilwane zigcina noma ziqeda ukushisa ngezindlela ezahlukene. Ezimweni ezithile zezulu, izilwane ezihlala e-endothermic zinendlela ethile yokuvikela ukushisa, njengoboya, amafutha, izimpaphe, noma inhlanganisela yazo. Uboya obukhulu nezimpaphe zibamba ungqimba lomoya olusiza ekuhlinzekeni ngokuvikela ukushisa. Amabhere nezimfene ezihlala e-polar zihlala futhi zibhukuda endaweni ebandayo kodwa zigcina izinga lokushisa lomzimba elihlala njalo, elifudumele. Impungushe yase-Arctic, isibonelo, isebenzisa umsila wayo othambile njengokuvikela ukushisa okwengeziwe lapho igoba ukuze ilale esimweni sezulu esibandayo. Izilwane ezincelisayo zinomphumela osele ngenxa yokuthuthumela kanye nomsebenzi wemisipha owandisiwe: imisipha ye-arrector pili ibangela amaqhubu e-goose,” okubangela izinwele ezincane ukuba zime lapho umuntu ebanda; lokhu kunomphumela ohlosiwe wokwandisa izinga lokushisa lomzimba. Izilwane ezincelisayo zisebenzisa izendlalelo zamafutha ukuze zifinyelele injongo efanayo. Ukulahlekelwa inani elikhulu lamafutha emzimbeni kuzolimaza ikhono lomuntu lokugcina ukushisa.

 Ama-Endotherm asebenzisa izinhlelo zawo zokujikeleza kwegazi ukusiza ukugcina izinga lokushisa lomzimba. I-Vasodilation iletha igazi eliningi nokushisa ebusweni bomzimba, okwenza kube lula ukushiswa kwemisebe kanye nokulahlekelwa ukushisa okubangelwa ukuhwamuka, okusiza ukupholisa umzimba. I-Vasoconstriction inciphisa ukugeleza kwegazi emithanjeni yegazi engaphandle, iphoqa igazi liye enkabeni nasezithweni ezibalulekile ezitholakala lapho, futhi ilondoloze ukushisa. Ezinye izilwane zinezindlela zokushintshana nokujikeleza kwegazi ezizivumela ukuthi zidlulise ukushisa kusuka emithanjeni kuya emithanjeni, kufudumeze igazi libuyele enhliziyweni. Lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi ukushintshana kokushisa okuhambisana nesikhathi; kuvimbela igazi elibandayo lemithambo yegazi ukuthi lingapholisi inhliziyo nezinye izitho zangaphakathi. Lokhu kuguquguquka kungavalwa kwezinye izilwane ukuvimbela ukushisa kakhulu kwezitho zangaphakathi. Ukuguquguquka kwesikhathi okuhambisana nesikhathi kutholakala ezilwaneni eziningi, okuhlanganisa Amahlengethwa, oshaka, izinhlanzi ezinamathambo, izinyosi, kanye nama-hummingbird. Ngokuphambene nalokho, ukuzivumelanisa nezimo okufanayo kungasiza ekupholiseni ama-endotherm uma kudingeka, njenge-dolphin fluke kanye nezindlebe zendlovu.

 Ezinye izilwane eziphila isikhathi eside zisebenzisa izinguquko ekuziphatheni kwazo ukusiza ukulawula izinga lokushisa lomzimba. Isibonelo, isilwane esiphila isikhathi eside esingaphila isikhathi eside singase sifune izindawo ezipholile ngesikhathi esishisa kakhulu sosuku ehlane ukuze singafudumali kakhulu. Izilwane ezifanayo zingase zikhuphukele emadwaleni ukuze zibambe ukushisa phakathi nobusuku obubandayo basehlane. Ezinye izilwane zifuna amanzi ukusiza ukuhwamuka ekuzipholiseni, njengoba kubonakala ezihuquzelayo. Ezinye izilwane eziphila isikhathi eside zisebenzisa umsebenzi weqembu njengomsebenzi wezinyosi ukufudumeza isidleke ukuze zisinde ebusika.

 Izilwane eziningi, ikakhulukazi izilwane ezincelisayo, zisebenzisa ukushisa okulahliwe kwe-metabolic njengomthombo wokushisa. Lapho imisipha ifinyezwa, iningi lamandla avela ku-ATP asetshenziswa ezenzweni zemisipha amandla achithekayo aguqulelwa ekushiseni. Umkhuhlane omkhulu udala ukusabela okuqhaqhazelayo okukhiqiza ukushisa komzimba. Izinhlobo eziningi nazo zinohlobo lwezicubu zamafutha ezibizwa ngokuthi amafutha ansundu akhethekile ekukhiqizeni ukushisa

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 24. Umzimba Wezilwane: Ifomu Nomsebenzi Oyisisekelo | 24.3 I-Homeostasis | Ukulawulwa Kwezinzwa Kokushisa Kwemithambo
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 24. Umzimba Wezilwane: Ifomu Nomsebenzi Oyisisekelo | 24.3 I-Homeostasis | Ukulawulwa Kwezinzwa Kokushisa Kwemithambo
chapterContent:
Uhlelo lwezinzwa lubalulekile ekulawuleni ukushisa, njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 24.22. Izinqubo ze-homeostasis kanye nokulawula izinga lokushisa zigxile ku-hypothalamus yobuchopho besilwane obuthuthukile.

 I-hypothalamus igcina indawo ebekelwe izinga lokushisa lomzimba ngokusebenzisa ama-reflex abangela ukugeleza kwegazi nokujuluka lapho umzimba ufudumele kakhulu, noma ukuvaleka kwegazi nokuthuthumela lapho umzimba ubanda kakhulu. Isabela kumakhemikhali avela emzimbeni. Lapho igciwane libhujiswa ama-leukocyte e-phagocytic, amakhemikhali abizwa ngokuthi ama-pyrogens endogenous akhishwa egazini. Lawa ma-pyrogen ajikeleza ku-hypothalamus futhi asethe kabusha i-thermostat. Lokhu kuvumela izinga lokushisa lomzimba ukuthi likhuphuke kulokho okuvame ukubizwa ngokuthi umkhuhlane. Ukwanda kwezinga lokushisa lomzimba kubangela ukuthi insimbi ilondolozwe, okunciphisa izakhamzimba ezidingwa amabhaktheriya. Ukwanda kokushisa komzimba kwandisa nomsebenzi wama-enzyme esilwane kanye namaseli avikelayo ngenkathi kuvimbela ama-enzyme kanye nomsebenzi wama-microorganism ahlaselayo. Okokugcina, ukushisa ngokwako kungabulala ne-pathogen. Umkhuhlane owawucatshangwa ukuthi uyinkinga yokutheleleka manje uqondwa njengendlela evamile yokuzivikela
question1: Iyiphi ingxenye yobuchopho ebangela kakhulu ukuguquguquka kwesimo sokushisa komzimba?
answer1: I-hypothalamus
question2: I-hypothalamus isabela kanjani lapho umzimba ushisa kakhulu?
answer2: Kubangela ukuvuvukala kwemithambo yegazi kanye nokujuluka

question6: Umkhuhlane ungasiza kanjani ekuvikeleni umzimba ekuthelelekeni?
answer6: Kunciphisa ukutholakala kwensimbi kumabhaktheriya, kwandisa umsebenzi wokuzivikela komzimba, futhi kungavimbela noma kubulale amagciwane
distractor6b: Yehlisa umsebenzi we-metabolic ukuze kongiwe amandla
question7: Izazi zezinto eziphilayo ziyiqonda kanjani imfiva njengamanje?
question8: Bheka Umfanekiso 24.24. Lapho amabhaktheriya ebhujiswa ama-leukocyte, ama-pyrogen akhishwa egazini. Ama-pyrogen abuyisela kabusha i-thermostat yomzimba ekushiseni okuphezulu, okubangela umkhuhlane. Ama-pyrogen abangela kanjani ukuthi izinga lokushisa lomzimba likhuphuke?
answer8: Ama-pyrogen ajikeleza aye ku-hypothalamus ukuze aphinde aqalise i-thermostat yomzimba,” okubangela ukwenyuka kwezinga lokushisa
distractor8a: Ama-pyrogen ajikeleza ku-thalamus ukuze aqalise kabusha i-thermostat yomzimba,” okubangela ukwenyuka kwezinga lokushisa
distractor8b: Ama-pyrogen abangela ukwanda komsebenzi wama-enzyme esilwane, okuholela ekukhuphukeni kwezinga lokushisa
distractor8c: Ama-pyrogen angena egazini akhipha ezinye izinto ezinamafutha, okubangela ukukhuphuka kwezinga lokushisa.

chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 24. Umzimba Wezilwane: Isakhiwo Nomsebenzi Oyisisekelo | 24.5 Isifinyezo Sesahluko
chapterContent:
24.1 Uhlobo Lwezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo
Imizimba yezilwane iza ngobukhulu obuhlukahlukene kanye nezimo. Imikhawulo ngobukhulu besilwane kanye nesimo sayo ihlanganisa imithelela ekuhambeni kwayo. Ukusabalala kuthinta ubukhulu kanye nentuthuko yazo. I-Bioenergetics ichaza indlela izilwane ezisebenzisa futhi zithola ngayo amandla maqondana nosayizi wemizimba yazo, izinga lomsebenzi, kanye nendawo ezungezile.

 24.2 Izicubu Eziyinhloko Zezilwane
Izinto eziyisisekelo zokwakha izilwane eziyinkimbinkimbi yizicubu ezine eziyinhloko. Lezi zihlanganiswa ukwakha izitho, ezinomsebenzi othize, okhethekile emzimbeni, njengesikhumba noma izinso. Izitho zihlelwe ndawonye ukuze zenze imisebenzi evamile ngesimo sezinhlelo. Izicubu ezine eziyinhloko yi-epithelia, izicubu ezixhumanisayo, izicubu zemisipha, kanye nezicubu zezinzwa.

 24.3 I-Homeostasis
I-Homeostasis iwukulinganisela okuguquguqukayo okugcinwa ezicutshini zomzimba nasezithweni zomzimba. Iyashintshashintsha ngoba ihlala ivumelana nezinguquko ezihlangabezana nazo izinhlelo. Kusesilinganisweni ngoba imisebenzi yomzimba igcinwa ngaphakathi kobubanzi obujwayelekile, kanye nokushintshashintsha okuthile endaweni ethile yezinqubo.

question34: Ukulingana kwemisebe ngokuvamile kutholakala ezintweni eziphilayo zasemanzini. Kuyini ukulingana kwemisebe futhi kungani kuzuzisa kwezinye izinto eziphilayo zasemanzini?

question39: I-squamous epithelia, enesilinganiso esiphezulu sendawo kuya komthamo, ingasiza kanjani ekusabalaleni nasekuvimbeleni umonakalo ovela ekukhumuleni?

question40: Kuyini i-homeostasis futhi isiza kanjani ukugcina ukulingana kwemisebenzi eyahlukene yomzimba wonke?

question44: Ukugcina ukushisa komzimba kubalulekile ekugcineni imisebenzi yomzimba ezilwaneni. Yisiphi isitatimende esilandelayo esinikeza isibonelo sendlela isilwane esingakhiqiza ngayo ukushisa komzimba ngenkuthalo?

question45: Ama-ectotherm nama-endotherm anamasu ahlukene okukhiqiza nokugcina ukushisa komzimba. Chaza ukuthi kungani ama-ectotherm encike kakhulu endaweni ezungezile ukuze kutholakale ukushisa komzimba kunama-endotherm nokuthi ama-endotherm akwazi kanjani ukukhiqiza nokugcina izinga lokushisa lomzimba
answer45: Ama-ectotherms asebenzisa ukushisa kwangaphandle okushisayo kanti ama-endotherms asebenzisa ukushisa okukhiqizwa ngokwe-metabolic ukusiza ukulawula nokugcina amazinga okushisa omzimba
distractor45a: Ama-ectotherm asebenzisa ukushisa kwangaphandle ukusiza ukulawula nokugcina amazinga okushisa omzimba kuyilapho ama-endotherm enamazinga okushisa angaphakathi ahlukahluka njalo.
distractor45b: Ama-ectotherm asebenzisa ukushisa okudalwe ngokwe-metabolism ukuze agcine izinga lokushisa lomzimba lihlala linjalo kanti ama-endotherm asebenzisa ukushisa okudalwe ngokwe-metabolism ukuze alawule izinga lokushisa lomzimba ngaphakathi kobubanzi obubanzi.
distractor45c: Ama-ectotherm asebenzisa amandla okushisa angaphandle ukusiza ukulawula nokugcina amazinga okushisa omzimba kuyilapho ama-endotherm egcina izinga lokushisa lomzimba elingaguquki.
question46: Yisiphi kulezi zitatimende ezilandelayo esisekela ngqo isimangalo sokuthi izinhlobo ezahlukene zezinto eziphilayo zisebenzisa amasu ahlukene okusebenza kwe-metabolic ukuze zihlangabezane nezidingo zazo zamandla okukhula, ukuzala, kanye ne-homeostasis?

distractor50b: Cishe ezinsukwini ezingama-20 ngemva kokunikela ngegazi
distractor50c: Ngemva kwezinsuku ezingu-40 ngemva kokunikela ngegazi
question51: Isifo sikashukela sibangelwa ukuthi i-insulin ayikwazi ukukhiqizwa noma ayisebenzi kahle. Ngenxa yalokho, isifo sikashukela singadala izinkinga ezifana nobumpumputhe, isifo senhliziyo, kanye nesifo sezinso. Ukuze kusizwe ekuphatheni isifo sikashukela, isiguli singathola imijovo ye-insulin. Imijovo ye-insulin ikhuthaza kanjani i-negative feedback loop ukusiza ukugcina ukukhiqizwa kwe-glucose egazini?
answer51: Imijovo ye-insulin ivumela ukuthuthwa nokugcinwa kwe-glucose ukunciphisa amazinga kashukela egazini ngemva kokudla ukudla okuningi noma okunoshukela omningi.
distractor51a: Imijovo ye-insulin ivumela ukuthuthwa nokugcinwa kwe-glucose ukwandisa amazinga kashukela egazini ngemva kokudla ukudla okuningi noma okunoshukela omningi.
distractor51b: Imijovo ye-insulin ivumela kuphela ukugcinwa kwe-glucose ukunciphisa amazinga kashukela egazini ngemva kokudla ukudla okuningi noma okunoshukela omningi
distractor51c: Ukujova nge-insulin kuvumela ukuthuthwa nokugcinwa kwe-glucose ukwandisa amazinga kashukela egazini ngaphambi kokudla ukudla
question52: Ama-loop empendulo enhle akhulisa izinqubo ezintweni eziphilayo. Yisiphi isitatimende esilandelayo esichaza indima yehomoni i-oxytocin ku-loop yempendulo enhle yokubeletha?
answer52: I-Oxytocin ivuselela ukufinyela kwesibeletho lapho ingane isunduza odongeni lwesibeletho
distractor52a: I-Oxytocin iyamisa ukufinyela kwesibeletho lapho ingane isunduza udonga lwesibeletho
distractor52b: I-Oxytocin igcina amazinga obuhlungu njengoba ingane icindezelwa emgudwini wokuzalwa
distractor52c: I-Oxytocin yehlisa amazinga obuhlungu njengoba ingane icindezelwa emgudwini wokuzalwa
question53: Ukuzalwa kungenye yezindlela ezimbalwa zokuphendula okuhle ezibonwa kubantu futhi kubalulekile ekuzalweni okufanele kwezingane. Chaza ukuthi ingane esunduza umlomo wesibeletho sowesifazane okhulelwe ivuselela kanjani indlela yokuphendula okuhle
answer53: Ukuzilula kuvuselela imizwa yezinzwa ukuba ithunyelwe ebuchosheni, ekhipha i-oxytocin ku-pituitary, okubangela ukufinyela kwesibeletho
distractor53a: Ukunwebeka kuvuselela imizwa yezinzwa ukuba ithunyelwe ebuchosheni, ekhipha i-estrogen ku-pituitary, okubangela ukufinyela kwesibeletho
distractor53b: Ukuzilula kuvuselela imizwa yezinzwa ukuthi ithunyelwe ebuchosheni, ekhipha i-oxytocin endlaleni ye-parathyroid, ebangela ukufinyela kwesibeletho
distractor53c: Ukunwebeka kuvuselela imizwa yezinzwa ukuthi ithunyelwe ebuchosheni ekhipha i-progesterone kusuka ku-pituitary, okubangela ukufinyela kwesibeletho
question54: Izindlela zokuphendula ezingezinhle zivame kakhulu emzimbeni womuntu kunezindlela zokuphendula ezihle ngoba zisiza ekulawuleni i-homeostasis. Kodwa-ke, kunezinye izimo zezindlela zokuphendula ezihle ezingabonakala ezilwaneni. Ukulawulwa kwalokhu okulandelayo okuyisibonelo sendlela yokuphendula ehle?
answer54: Ukusebenza kwesici esisodwa sokujiya kwegazi kukhuthaza ukukhiqizwa kwezinye izinto zokujiya kwegazi kuze kube yilapho kukhiqizwa i-fibrin clot
distractor54a: Uma izinga lokushisa lomzimba liphezulu kakhulu, kuthunyelwa amasignali ukuze kwehliswe izinga lokushisa lomzimba
distractor54b: Ukwanda kwamazinga kashukela egazini kukhuthaza ukukhiqizwa kwe-insulin, okuholela ekususweni kwe-glucose egazini.
distractor54c: Amazinga e-calcium anciphile akhuthaza ukwanda kokumuncwa kwe-calcium
question55: Zombili izihibe zempendulo ezingezinhle nezingezinhle zibalulekile ekugcineni imisebenzi yomzimba efanele. I-calcium yegazi kanye nokujiya kwegazi kulawulwa yizihibe zempendulo ezahlukene. Yikuphi kulezi zinqubo okugcinwa yi-loop yempendulo enhle futhi ngani?
answer55: Ukujiya kwegazi kugcinwa nge-feedback loop enhle, njengoba ukujiya kwegazi kwandiswa ngokwandisa inani lezinto ezijiya igazi lapho kukhona izinto ezijiya igazi.
distractor55a: Ukujiya kwegazi kugcinwa yi-positive feedback loop, njengoba izici zokujiya kwegazi zigcinwa zisezingeni elithile futhi i-positive loop isiza ukubuyisela izimo endaweni ebekiwe.
distractor55b: I-calcium egazini igcinwa nge-feedback loop enhle, njengoba amazinga e-calcium ekhuliswa ngokwandisa inani lamazinga e-calcium uma i-calcium ikhona.
distractor55c: I-calcium egazini igcinwa yi-positive feedback loop, njengoba amazinga e-calcium egcinwa ebangeni elithile futhi i-positive feedback loop isiza ukubuyisela izimo endaweni ebekiwe.
question56: Kungani ubusika bungesona inketho enhle yezilwane ezincane njenge-hummingbird ukusiza ekunciphiseni izinga lokugaya ukudla kwazo nokugcina isidingo sazo sokudla?
answer56: Izinyoni ze-Hummingbird zinesilinganiso esisheshayo sokugaya ukudla kanye nesilinganiso esikhulu sendawo ebusweni kuya kumthamo
distractor56a: Izinyoni ezibizwa ngokuthi ama-hummingbird azikwazi ukwehlisa izinga lazo lokugaya ukudla kanye nokushisa komzimba ukuze zingene ebusika
distractor56b: Izinyoni ezibizwa ngokuthi ama-hummingbird zithuthela eningizimu ebusika
distractor56c: Izinyoni ezibizwa ngokuthi ama-hummingbird ziphila impilo emfushane
question57: Ukulala ebusuku kuhluke kanjani ezilwaneni ezincane njengezingwejeje zomhlaba kanye nezilwane ezinkulu ezifana namabhere?
answer57: Izilwane ezincane azikwazi ukuhlala zingasebenzi kulo lonke ubusika kuyilapho izilwane ezinkulu zingakwazi
distractor57a: Izilwane ezincane zingaba nomuzwa wokungalali kahle kanti izilwane ezinkulu azikwazi
distractor57b: Izilwane ezinkulu zingaba nomuzwa wokungalali kahle kanti izilwane ezincane azikwazi
distractor57c: Izilwane ezinkulu azikwazi ukuhlala zingasebenzi kulo lonke ubusika kuyilapho izilwane ezincane zingakwazi
question58: Bheka uMfanekiso 24.32. Kudatha, i-BM = isisindo somzimba, i-CD = isikhathi sokuphola; i-WU = isikhathi sokufudumeza, i-NBT = izinga lokushisa lomzimba elijwayelekile kanye ne-BTH = izinga lokushisa lomzimba ngesikhathi sokulala. Yini ongayiphetha ngayo ngedatha eqoqwe ezilwaneni ezinhlanu ezahlukene njengoba kuboniswe kuthebula elingenhla?
answer58: Isikhathi esithatha izilwane ukushintsha izinga lokushisa lomzimba sihlobene ngqo nosayizi womzimba
distractor58a: Isikhathi esithatha izilwane ukushintsha izinga lokushisa lomzimba wazo sihlobene ngokungaqondile nobukhulu bazo.
distractor58b: Izilwane ezinkulu zihlala isikhathi eside zilele
question59:
Bheka uMfanekiso 24.32. Kudatha, i-BM = isisindo somzimba, i-CD = isikhathi sokuphola; i-WU = isikhathi sokufudumeza, i-NBT = izinga lokushisa lomzimba elijwayelekile kanye ne-BTH = izinga lokushisa lomzimba ngesikhathi sokulala.

 Yisiphi isimangalo sesayensi esingenziwa kusetshenziswa le datha?
answer59: Kuthatha isikhathi eside izilwane ezinkulu ukushintsha izinga lokushisa lomzimba wazo
distractor59a: Izilwane ezinkulu zinezinga lokushisa lomzimba elikhulu
distractor59b: Izilwane ezilala ebusika zinezinga lokushisa elifanayo lomzimba ngesikhathi sokulala ebusika
distractor59c: Kuthatha isikhathi eside izilwane ezincane ukufudumala ngemva kokulala ebusika
question60: Uhlelo lwe-endocrine luhlanganisa izindlela zokuphendula ezigcina i-homeostasis. Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okubonisa impendulo engemihle evela ohlelweni lwe-endocrine?
answer60: Ngemva kokudla, amazinga kashukela egazini ayakhuphuka, okukhuthaza amaseli e-beta e-pancreas ukuthi akhiphe i-insulin egazini. I-glucose eningi ibe isiguqulwa ibe yi-glycogen esibindini, okunciphisa amazinga kashukela egazini.
distractor60a: Ngesikhathi sokubeletha, ingane icindezela udonga lwesibeletho, okubangela ukukhiqizwa kwe-oxytocin, okukhuthaza ukufinyela kodonga lwesibeletho. Ukufinyela kubangela ukuthi ingane iqhubeke nokufinyela odongeni, okwandisa ukukhiqizwa kwe-oxytocin.
distractor60b: Ezindaweni eziphakeme, umoya-mpilo womkhathi uba mncane kakhulu. Ngokuphendula izimpawu zokuthi umoya-mpilo uphansi, ubuchopho bunciphisa izinga lokuphefumula komuntu ukuze kulungiswe umehluko.
distractor60c: Isici sokubhala sibopha esifundeni esilawulayo sejini, sivimba ukubopha kwesinye isici sokubhala esidingekayo ukuze kuvezwe
question61: Bheka uMfanekiso 24.33. Lesi sithombe sibonisa inqubo ye-calcium homeostasis. Chaza ukuthi ukulawulwa kwe-calcium egazini kuyisibonelo kanjani se-negative feedback loop
answer61: Amaseli ezindlala ze-parathyroid athola i-calcium ephansi egazini futhi akhiphe i-parathyroid hormone (PTH), ekhulisa ukukhishwa kwe-calcium emathanjeni, ukumuncwa kabusha kwe-calcium yizinso, kanye nokumuncwa kwe-calcium emathunjini. Njengoba i-calcium egazini ibuyela esimweni esijwayelekile, ukukhiqizwa kwe-PTH kuyancipha
distractor61a: Amaseli ezindlala ze-parathyroid athola i-calcium ephansi egazini bese ekhipha i-calcitonin, ekhuthaza ukumuncwa kwe-calcium. Ithambo lingaphinde liqhekeke ukuze likhiphe i-calcium
distractor61b: Amaseli e-thyroid gland athola i-calcium ephansi egazini bese ekhipha i-calcitonin, ekhuthaza ukumuncwa kwe-calcium. Ithambo lingaphinde liqhekeke ukuze likhiphe i-calcium
distractor61c: Amaseli ezindlala ze-parathyroid athola i-calcium ephezulu egazini futhi akhiphe i-parathyroid hormone (PTH), okukhuthaza ukumuncwa kwe-calcium kanye nokuqhekeka kwamathambo.
question62: Bheka uMfanekiso 24.34. Yikuphi ukukhetha okuchaza iziguquguquko kumagrafu anikeziwe?
answer62: I-glucose ye-plasma kanye ne-glucagon ye-plasma zombili ziyizinto eziguquguqukayo ezixhomeke kuzo. Isikhathi siyi-variable ezimele
distractor62a: I-plasma glucose iyi-variable ezimele. I-plasma glucagon iyi-variable exhomeke kuyo
distractor62b: I-glucose ye-plasma kanye ne-glucagon ye-plasma zombili ziyizinto eziguquguqukayo ezizimele. Isikhathi yizinto eziguquguqukayo ezixhomeke kuzo
distractor62c: I-glucose ye-plasma iyi-variable exhomeke kuyo. I-plasma glucagon iyi-variable ezimele
question63:
Bheka uMfanekiso 24.34. I-Glucagon iyi-hormone edlala indima ekulawuleni ushukela wegazi. Amagrafu abonisa ukuhlushwa kwe-glucose egazini kanye nokuhlushwa kwe-glucagon ezimweni ezahlukene. I-Hyperglycemia iwukuba ne-glucose eningi kakhulu, i-euglycemia iba namanani ajwayelekile ayo kanti i-hypoglycemia iba ne-glucose encane kakhulu egazini.

 Ngokusekelwe kulolu lwazi, iyini indima ye-glucagon?
answer63: Qalisa izinqubo ezishintsha amanye ama-molecule abe yi-glucose
distractor63a: Qalisa izinqubo ezishintsha i-glucose ibe amanye ama-molecule
distractor63b: Qalisa izinqubo ezenza amaseli asebenzise amandla amaningi
distractor63c: Qalisa izinqubo ezenza amaseli asebenzise amandla amancane

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 25. Ukudla Okunomsoco Kwezilwane Nohlelo Lokugaya | 25.0 Isingeniso
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 25. Ukudla Okunomsoco Kwezilwane Nohlelo Lokugaya | 25.0 Isingeniso
chapterContent:
Zonke izinto eziphilayo zidinga izakhamzimba ukuze ziphile. Izilwane zithola izakhamzimba zazo ngokudla ezinye izinto eziphilayo. Ezingeni lamaseli, ama-molecule ezinto eziphilayo adingekayo ekusebenzeni kwezilwane ama-amino acid, ama-molecule e-lipid, ama-nucleotide, kanye noshukela olula. Kodwa-ke, ukudla okudliwayo kuqukethe amaprotheni, amafutha, nama-carbohydrate ayinkimbinkimbi. Izilwane kumele ziguqule la ma-macromolecule abe ama-molecule alula adingekayo ekugcineni imisebenzi yamaseli, njengokuhlanganisa ama-molecule amasha, amaseli, kanye nezicubu. Ukuguqulwa kokudla okudliwayo kube izakhamzimba ezidingekayo kuyinqubo enezinyathelo eziningi ehilela ukugaya nokumunca. Ngesikhathi sokugaya, izinhlayiya zokudla zihlukaniswa zibe yizingxenye ezincane; kamuva, zimuncwa ngumzimba.

 Enye yezinselele ekudleni kwabantu ukugcina ibhalansi phakathi kokudla, ukugcina, kanye nokusetshenziswa kwamandla. Ukungalingani kungaba nemiphumela emibi empilweni. Isibonelo, ukudla ukudla okuningi kakhulu ngenkathi ungachithi amandla amaningi kuholela ekukhuluphaleni; lokhu kuzokwandisa ingozi yokuthola izifo ezifana nesifo sikashukela sohlobo lwesibili kanye nesifo senhliziyo. Ukwanda kwamuva kokukhuluphala kanye nezifo ezihlobene nakho kwenza ukuqonda indima yokudla kanye nokudla okunempilo ekugcineni impilo enhle kubaluleke kakhulu. Ochwepheshe abaningi bezempilo bakholelwa ukuthi imfundo yokudla okunempilo izothuthukisa impilo iyonke yabantu bonke. Eqinisweni, uhlelo olulodwa lokufundisa ngokudla okunempilo, i-Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP),1 lugxile ezinganeni zasenkulisa ezibhalise endaweni yokunakekela izingane engabizi kakhulu futhi lwathola ukuthi izingane ezihlanganyelayo zazinamathuba amaningi okudla imifino eminingi ekhaya. Bheka Umfanekiso 25.1
answer1: Ukuthola ama-molecule adingekayo ukuze aphile, akhule, futhi asebenze kahle kumaseli
question2: Yimaphi ama-molecule ezinto eziphilayo adingwa ngqo ngamaseli ezilwane?
answer2: Ama-amino acid, ama-lipid molecule, ama-nucleotide, kanye noshukela olula
question3: Kungani izilwane kufanele zigaye ukudla ezikudlayo?
answer3: Ukuphula ama-macromolecule abe ama-molecule alula angasetshenziswa amaseli
distractor3b: Ukuguqula ukudla kube yi-ATP ngqo ngaphandle kokumuncwa
question4: Kwenzekani ngesikhathi sokugaya ukudla?
answer4: Izinhlayiya zokudla zihlukaniswa zibe yizingxenye ezincane
distractor4b: Amaseli akhiqiza amaprotheni amasha ngqo ekudleni
question5: Kwenzekani ngemva kokugaya ukudla?
question6: Yini engaba umphumela wokudla ukudla okuningi kunalokho umzimba okusebenzisa njengamandla?
question7: Ukukhuluphala ngokweqile kwandisa ingozi yokuthola ziphi izimo zempilo?
answer7: Isifo sikashukela sohlobo lwesibili kanye nesifo senhliziyo
question8: Kungani imfundo yokudla okunempilo ibhekwa njengebalulekile?
answer8: Ngoba kungathuthukisa impilo iyonke yabantu ngokukhuthaza imikhuba yokudla enempilo

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 25. Ukudla Okunomsoco Kwezilwane Nohlelo Lokugaya | 25.1 Izinhlelo Zokugaya | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 25. Ukudla Okunomsoco Kwezilwane Nohlelo Lokugaya | 25.1 Izinhlelo Zokugaya | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent:
Ulwazi oluningi kulesi sahluko alukho ngaphansi kwe-AP®. Kodwa-ke, lesi sahluko sisinikeza ithuba lokubukeza imiqondo esiyihlolile ngaphambilini, okuhlanganisa isakhiwo nomsebenzi, ama-macromolecule, ukukhiqizwa kwamandla, ukuthuthwa kwezinto ezidlula kuma-membrane, kanye nomsebenzi we-enzyme. Zonke izinto eziphilayo zidinga umthombo wamandla nama-molecule adingekayo ukwakha amaseli, izicubu, kanye nezitho zomzimba. Ngesikhathi sokugaya, ukudla kuhlukaniswa kube ama-molecule amancane ukuze kufakwe futhi kusatshalaliswe kuwo wonke amaseli omzimba. Izakhamzimba ziyadingeka ukuze kuqhutshwe izinqubo zamaseli futhi kugcinwe i-homeostasis, futhi ukugaya nokumunca kudinga ukuhlanganyela kwezitho eziningana. Izilwane ezahlukene ziye zathuthukisa izinhlobo ezahlukene zezinhlelo zokugaya ezikhethekile ukuze zihlangabezane nezidingo zazo zokudla. Awudingi ukubamba ngekhanda imininingwane mayelana nezinhlobo ezahlukene zezinhlelo zokugaya zezilwane, kodwa ungase ukuthole kuthakazelisa ukuhlola ukuvela kwesistimu ngamaqembu ambalwa ezilwane, kusukela ekugayweni kwangaphakathi kweseli ezinhlotsheni ezilula ezingenamgogodla kuya endleleni yokugaya kanye nezitho ezingeziwe ezilwaneni ezinomgogodla eziyinkimbinkimbi. Usebenzisa isandwich ye-turkey yomuntu njengesibonelo, ukudla kugwinywa ngomlomo. Umlomo yindawo lapho kokubili ukuqhekeka kokudla ngomshini (ukuhlafuna) kanye namakhemikhali kuqala khona nge-enzyme i-amylase, ephula ama-carbohydrate abe ushukela olula. I-bolus yokudla bese ihamba nge-peristalsis (amagagasi ashintshanayo okufinyela) iye e-pharynx kanye ne-esophagus iye esiswini. Esiswini, i-pepsinogen ixubana ne-hydrochloric acid ukuze yakhe i-pepsin, eqala ukugaya amaprotheni, njenge-turkey, ibe yizintambo ezincane zama-amino acid. I-mucus esiswini ivikela ulwelwesi lwayo ekulimaleni yi-acidity, kanti ukuqina kwe-sphincter kuvimbela okuqukethwe yisisu ukuthi kungaphindeli e-esophagus. Ukugaya okwengeziwe kwezithako ze-sandwich kwenzeka emathunjini amancane kusizwa ama-enzyme ahlukahlukene; isibonelo, usawoti we-bile kanye ne-pancreatic amylase elahlwa emathunjini amancane avela enyongweni kanye nakuma-pancreas, ngokulandelana, kusiza ukukhiqiza amafutha. Uma izithako ze-sandwich sezihlukaniswe zaba ama-molecule amancane ezakhamzimba, okuhlanganisa ama-amino acid, i-glucose, nama-fatty acid, zimuncwa zisuka emathunjini amancane ziye ezinhlelweni zokujikeleza kwegazi kanye ne-lymphatic. Izindonga zamathumbu amancane ziqukethe ama-projection amancane afana nomunwe abizwa ngokuthi i-villi kanye ne-microvilli akhulisa indawo engaphezulu yokumunca izakhamzimba ngokusabalala. Amathumbu amakhulu noma ikholoni alikhiqizi ama-enzyme okugaya ukudla kodwa lisebenza ukumunca amanzi, usawoti, kanye namavithamini athile. Noma yiziphi izakhamzimba ezivela ku-sandwich zigcinwa esibindini, futhi imfucuza iyasuswa.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyiswe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo echazwe ku-Big Idea 2 kanye no-Big Idea 4 wohlaka lwekharikhulamu ye-AP® Biology. Izinhloso Zokufunda ze-AP® ezibalwe kuhlaka lwekharikhulamu zinikeza isisekelo esicacile senkambo ye-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekubuzeni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa ye-AP®. Inhloso Yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo neyodwa noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yeSayensi eyisikhombisa.

 Inhloso Enkulu 2
Izinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo zisebenzisa amandla amahhala kanye namabhlogo okwakha ama-molecule ukuze zikhule, zizale, futhi zigcine i-homeostasis enamandla.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 2.A
Ukukhula, ukuzala kanye nokugcinwa kwezinhlelo eziphilayo kudinga amandla amahhala kanye nezinto.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
2.A.3 Izinto eziphilayo kumele zishintshane ngezinto nendawo ukuze zikhule, zizale futhi zilondoloze ukuhleleka.

 Ukuzijwayeza Kwesayensi
2.2 Umfundi angasebenzisa izindlela zezibalo emananini achaza izinto zemvelo.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
2.6 Umfundi uyakwazi ukusebenzisa izilinganiso zendawo-kuya-ivolumu ezibalwe ukubikezela ukuthi yiliphi iseli (amaseli) elingasusa imfucuza noma lithole izakhamzimba ngokushesha ngokusabalala.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
2.A.3 Izinto eziphilayo kumele zishintshane ngezinto nendawo ukuze zikhule, zizale futhi zilondoloze ukuhleleka.

 Ukuzijwayeza Kwesayensi
6.2 Umfundi angakha izincazelo zezinto ezisekelwe ebufakazini obuvezwa ngemikhuba yesayensi.
Inhloso Yokufunda
2.7 Umfundi uzokwazi ukuchaza ukuthi ubukhulu kanye nesimo seseli kuthinta kanjani izinga lokudla okunomsoco kanye nezinga lokususwa kwemfucuza.

 Umqondo Omkhulu 4
Izinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo ziyasebenzisana, futhi lezi zinhlelo kanye nokusebenzisana kwazo zinezakhiwo eziyinkimbinkimbi.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 4.A
Ukusebenzisana ngaphakathi kwezinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo kuholela ezimpahleni eziyinkimbinkimbi.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
4.A.4 Izinto eziphilayo zibonisa izakhiwo eziyinkimbinkimbi ngenxa yokusebenzisana phakathi kwezingxenye zazo eziyinhloko.

 Izilwane zithola ukudla kwazo ngokudla ezinye izinto eziphilayo. Kuye ngokudla kwazo, izilwane zingahlukaniswa ngezigaba ezilandelayo: izidla izitshalo (izilwane ezidla uhlaza), izidla inyama (izidla inyama), kanye nalezo ezidla izitshalo nezilwane (izilwane ezidla inyama). Izakhamzimba nama-macromolecule akhona ekudleni awatholakali ngokushesha kumaseli. Kunezinqubo eziningana eziguqula ukudla emzimbeni wesilwane ukuze zenze izakhamzimba nama-molecule ezinto eziphilayo atholakale ukuze kusebenze amaseli. Njengoba izilwane zathuthuka ngendlela eyinkimbinkimbi yesimo kanye nokusebenza, izinhlelo zazo zokugaya ukudla nazo ziye zathuthuka ukuze zihlangabezane nezidingo zazo ezahlukene zokudla

chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 25. Ukudla Okunomsoco Kwezilwane Nohlelo Lokugaya | 25.1 Izinhlelo Zokugaya | Izilwane Ezidla Uhlaza, Ezidla Izilwane Eziningi, Nezidla Izilwane Ezidla Izilwane Eziningi
chapterContent:
Izilwane ezidla uhlaza yizilwane ezithola ukudla okuyinhloko okusekelwe ezitshalweni. Izibonelo zezilwane ezidla uhlaza, njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 25.2 zifaka phakathi izilwane ezinomgogodla njengenyamazane, ama-koala, kanye nezinhlobo ezithile zezinyoni, kanye nezilwane ezingenamgogodla njenge-cricket kanye nezibungu. Lezi zilwane ziye zathuthukisa izinhlelo zokugaya ukudla ezikwazi ukuphatha inani elikhulu lezinto zezitshalo. Izilwane ezidla uhlaza zingahlukaniswa kabanzi zibe yi-frugivores (ezidla izithelo), ama-granivores (ezidla imbewu), ama-nectivores (ezidla ama-nectar), kanye nama-folivores (ezidla amaqabunga).

 Izilwane ezidla uhlaza yizilwane ezidla ezinye izilwane. Igama elithi carnivore lisuselwa olimini lwesiLatini futhi lisho ukuthi umuntu odla inyama.” Amakati asendle afana namabhubesi, aboniswe kuMfanekiso 25.3a kanye namahlosi ayizibonelo zezilwane ezidla inyama ezinezinhlungu, njengezinyoka noshaka, kanti izilwane ezidla inyama ezingenazo izinhlungu zifaka izinkanyezi zasolwandle, izicabucabu, kanye nama-ladybug, aboniswe kuMfanekiso 25.3b. Izilwane ezidla inyama ezinezihlungu yilezo ezithembele ngokuphelele enyameni yezilwane ukuze zithole izakhamzimba zazo; izibonelo zezilwane ezidla inyama ezinezihlungu zingamalungu omndeni wamakati, njengezingonyama nama-cheetah. Izilwane ezidla inyama ezinezihlungu yilezo ezidla nokudla okungewona okwezilwane ngaphezu kokudla kwezilwane. Qaphela ukuthi akukho mugqa ocacile ohlukanisa izilwane ezidla inyama ezinezihlungu ezivela kwezinye izilwane; izinja zingabhekwa njengezilwane ezidla inyama ezinezihlungu ezivela kwezinye izilwane.

 Izilwane ezidla inyama ezinezihlungu ziyizilwane ezidla kokubili ukudla okuvela ezitshalweni nasezilwaneni. NgesiLatini, i-omnivore isho ukudla konke. Abantu, amabhere (aboniswe kuMfanekiso 25.4a), kanye nezinkukhu ziyisibonelo sezilwane ezinezihlungu ezivela kwezinye izilwane; izilwane ezingenazo izinhlungu ezivela kwezinye izilwane zifaka amaphela kanye ne-crayfish (kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 25.4b)

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 25. Ukudla Okunomsoco Kwezilwane Nohlelo Lokugaya | 25.1 Izinhlelo Zokugaya | Izinhlelo Zokugaya Ezingenamgogodla
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 25. Ukudla Okunomsoco Kwezilwane Nohlelo Lokugaya | 25.1 Izinhlelo Zokugaya | Izinhlelo Zokugaya Ezingenamgogodla
chapterContent:
Izilwane ziye zasungula izinhlobo ezahlukene zezinhlelo zokugaya ukudla ukuze zisize ekugayweni kokudla okuhlukahlukene ezikudlayo. Isibonelo esilula kakhulu yileso somgodi wesisu futhi sitholakala ezintweni eziphilayo ezinesikhala esisodwa sokugaya ukudla. Ama-Platyhelminthes (izibungu ezisicaba), ama-Ctenophora (ama-comb jellies), kanye nama-Cnidaria (ama-coral, ama-jelly fish, kanye nama-sea anemones) asebenzisa lolu hlobo lokugaya ukudla. Izimbobo zesisu, njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 25.5a, ngokuvamile ziyipayipi noma umgodi ongaboni onesikhala esisodwa kuphela, umlomo”, ophinde usebenze njenge-anus”. Izinto ezidliwayo zingena emlonyeni futhi zidlule emgodini ongenalutho, onama-tubular. Amaseli angaphakathi komgodi akhipha ama-enzyme okugaya ukudla aphula ukudla. Izinhlayiya zokudla zimbozwa amaseli amboze umgodi wesisu.

 Umsele wokudla, oboniswe kuMfanekiso 25.5b, uwuhlelo oluthuthuke kakhulu: luqukethe ipayipi elilodwa elinomlomo ngakolunye uhlangothi kanye ne-anus kolunye. Izibungu zomhlaba ziyisibonelo sesilwane esinomsele wokudla. Uma ukudla sekugwinyiwe ngomlomo, kudlula emphinjeni bese kugcinwa esithweni esibizwa ngokuthi isivuno; bese kudlulela emphinjeni lapho kuqhunyiswa khona futhi kugaywe khona. Kusukela emphinjeni, ukudla kudlula emathunjini, izakhamzimba ziyamuncwa, bese indle ikhishwa njengendle, ebizwa ngokuthi i-castings, nge-anus.

chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 25. Ukudla Okunomsoco Kwezilwane Nohlelo Lokugaya | 25.1 Izinhlelo Zokugaya | Izinhlelo Zokugaya Ezinomgogodla | Isisu Esinomunye: Isisu Esinogumbi Elilodwa
chapterContent:
Ngokuziphendukela kwemvelo, izinhlelo zokugaya ukudla zezilwane ezinomgogodla ziye zajwayela ukudla okuhlukahlukene. Ezinye izilwane zinesisu esisodwa, kanti ezinye zinesisu esinezigumbi eziningi. Izinyoni ziye zakha uhlelo lokugaya ukudla olujwayele ukudla ukudla okungahlafunwanga.

 Isisu esisodwa: Isisu esinezigumbi esisodwa
Njengoba igama elithi monogastric lisikisela, lolu hlobo lwesimiso sokugaya ukudla luqukethe igumbi elilodwa (elilodwa) lesisu (isisu). Abantu nezilwane eziningi banesimiso sokugaya ukudla esisodwa njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 25.6ab. Inqubo yokugaya ukudla iqala ngomlomo kanye nokudla. Amazinyo adlala indima ebalulekile ekuhlafuneni (ukuhlafuna) noma ekuhlukaniseni ukudla ngokomzimba kube yizinhlayiya ezincane. Ama-enzyme akhona ematheni nawo aqala ukuhlakaza ukudla ngamakhemikhali. I-esophagus iyipayipi elide elixhumanisa umlomo nesisu. Ngokusebenzisa i-peristalsis, noma ukufinyela kwemisipha ebushelelezi efana namagagasi, imisipha ye-esophagus isunduza ukudla iye esiswini. Ukuze kusheshiswe ukusebenza kwama-enzyme esiswini, isisu siyindawo ene-acid kakhulu, ene-pH ephakathi kuka-1.5 no-2.5. Amanzi esiswini, ahlanganisa ama-enzyme esiswini, asebenza ezinhlayiyeni zokudla futhi aqhubeke nenqubo yokugaya ukudla. Ukuwohloka kokudla okuqhubekayo kwenzeka emathunjini amancane lapho ama-enzyme akhiqizwa yisibindi, emathunjini amancane, kanye ne-pancreas aqhubeka nenqubo yokugaya ukudla. Izakhamzimba zimuncwa egazini kuwo wonke amaseli e-epithelial amboze izindonga zamathumbu amancane. Izinto ezilahliwe ziya emathunjini amakhulu lapho amanzi amuncwa khona bese izinto ezilahliwe zomile zihlanganiswa zibe yindle; zigcinwa kuze kube yilapho zikhishwa nge-rectum

chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 25. Ukudla Okunomsoco Kwezilwane Nohlelo Lokugaya | 25.1 Izinhlelo Zokugaya | Izinhlelo Zokugaya Ezinethambo | Izinyoni
chapterContent:
Ngokuziphendukela kwemvelo, izinhlelo zokugaya ukudla zezilwane ezinomgogodla ziye zajwayela ukudla okuhlukahlukene. Ezinye izilwane zinesisu esisodwa, kanti ezinye zinesisu esinezicabha eziningi. Izinyoni ziye zakha uhlelo lokugaya ukudla olujwayele ukudla ukudla okungahlafunwanga.

 Izinyoni

 Izinyoni zibhekene nezinselele ezikhethekile uma kuziwa ekutholeni ukudla okunomsoco ekudleni. Azinamazinyo ngakho-ke uhlelo lwazo lokugaya ukudla, oluboniswe kuMfanekiso 25.7, kumele lukwazi ukucubungula ukudla okungahlafunwanga. Izinyoni ziye zathuthukisa izinhlobo ezahlukene zemilomo ezibonisa ukuhlukahluka okukhulu ekudleni kwazo, kusukela ezinhlamvini nasezinambuzaneni kuya ezithelweni namantongomane. Ngenxa yokuthi izinyoni eziningi ziyandiza, amazinga azo okugaya ukudla aphezulu ukuze zicubungule ukudla kahle futhi zigcine isisindo somzimba wazo siphansi. Isisu sezinyoni sinezicabha ezimbili: i-proventriculus, lapho kukhiqizwa khona ujusi wesisu ukuze kugaywe ukudla ngaphambi kokuba kungene esiswini, kanye ne-gizzard, lapho ukudla kugcinwa khona, kumanziswe, futhi kugaywe ngomshini. Izinto ezingagaywanga zakha ama-pellets okudla ngezinye izikhathi aphinde ahlanzwe. Iningi lokugaya amakhemikhali kanye nokumuncwa kwenzeka emathunjini bese imfucuza ikhishwa nge-cloaca
question1: Kungani izinyoni zidinga izinhlelo zokugaya ukudla ezikhethekile?
answer1: Ngoba azinamazinyo futhi kumele zigaye ukudla okungahlafunwanga

answer3: Ukucubungula ukudla kahle ngenkathi ugcina isisindo somzimba esiphansi sokundiza
question4: Uyini umsebenzi we-proventriculus?
answer4: Ikhiqiza ujusi wesisu oqala ukugaya amakhemikhali

chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 25. Ukudla Okunomsoco Kwezilwane Nohlelo Lokugaya | 25.1 Izinhlelo Zokugaya | Izinhlelo Zokugaya Ezinethambo | Ukuguqulwa Kwezinyoni
chapterContent: Izinyoni zinesimiso sokugaya ukudla esisebenza kahle kakhulu nesilula. Ubufakazi bamuva nje bezinsalela bubonise ukuthi ukuhlukahluka kokuvela kwezinyoni kwezinye izilwane zasemhlabeni kwaphawulwa ngokwenza uhlelo lokugaya ukudla lube lula futhi lube lula. Ngokungafani nezinye izilwane eziningi, izinyoni azinawo amazinyo okuhlafuna ukudla kwazo. Esikhundleni sezindebe, zinemilomo ebukhali ecijile. Umlomo onezimpondo, ukuntuleka kwemihlathi, kanye nolimi oluncane lwezinyoni kungalandelelwa emuva kokhokho bazo bama-dinosaur. Ukuvela kwalezi zinguquko kubonakala kuhambisana nokufakwa kwembewu ekudleni kwezinyoni. Izinyoni ezidla imbewu zinemilomo eyakhelwe ukubamba imbewu kanti isisu esinezingxenye ezimbili sivumela ukwabiwa kwemisebenzi. Njengoba izinyoni zidinga ukuhlala zilula ukuze zindiza, amazinga azo okugaya ukudla aphezulu kakhulu, okusho ukuthi zigaya ukudla kwazo ngokushesha kakhulu futhi zidinga ukudla kaningi. Qhathanisa lokhu nezilwane ezidla inyama, lapho ukugaya izinto zezitshalo kuthatha isikhathi eside kakhulu.
answer1: Uhlelo lwabo lokugaya ukudla lujwayele ukucubungula ukudla ngaphandle kokuhlafuna, okunciphisa isisindo somzimba ukuze lundize.
distractor1a: Ngoba izinyoni azikwazi ukukhiqiza ama-enzyme okugaya ukudla
question2: Yiziphi izinguquko zokuziphendukela kwemvelo ezisize ekwenzeni lula uhlelo lokugaya ukudla kwezinyoni?
answer2: Ukukhula kwemilomo, ukulahlekelwa imihlathi namazinyo, kanye nolimi oluncane

answer5: Ngoba kumele zihlale zilula ukuze zindize futhi zicubungule ukudla ngokushesha ukuze zihlangabezane nezidingo zazo zamandla
distractor5b: Ngoba zigaya ukudla kancane kunezilwane ezincelisayo
question6: Izinyoni zisilungisa kanjani izinga lazo eliphezulu lokugaya ukudla?
answer6: Zigaya ukudla ngokushesha futhi zidinga ukudla kaningi

answer7: Izinyoni zigaya ukudla ngokushesha, kanti ezenyama zigaya izinto zezitshalo kancane kakhulu

distractor7c: Izilwane ezidla inyama azigayi izinto zezitshalo
question8: Nakuba izinyoni nabantu beyizilwane ezinomgogodla, izinyoni zinezinga eliphezulu lokuguqulwa kwezakhi zomzimba kunabantu. a. Kungani izinga lokuguqulwa kwezakhi zomzimba lezinyoni liphakeme kunelabantu? b. Izinyoni zisibuyisela kanjani ijubane eliphezulu kangaka lokuguqulwa kwezakhi zomzimba?
answer8: A. Izinyoni kudingeka zibe lula ukuze zindiza, ngakho-ke zidinga ukugaya ukudla kwazo ngokushesha kunabantu. b. Izinyoni zidinga ukudla kaningi ukuze zilondoloze amandla njengoba zigaya ukudla ngokushesha
distractor8a: A. Izinyoni zinezindawo ezincane zokulahlekelwa ukushisa kunabantu, ngakho-ke izinga lazo lokugaya ukudla kumele libe phezulu. b. Izinyoni zidinga ukudla ukudla okuningi njengoba zigaya ukudla ngokushesha
distractor8b: A. Izinyoni kudingeka zibe lula ukuze zindiza, ngakho-ke zidinga ukugaya ukudla kwazo ngokushesha kunabantu. b. Izinyoni zidinga ukudla ukudla okuningi njengoba zigaya ukudla ngokushesha
distractor8c: A. Izinyoni zinezindawo ezincane zokulahlekelwa ukushisa kunabantu, ngakho-ke izinga lazo lokugaya ukudla kumele libe phezulu. b. Izinyoni kudingeka zidle kaningi ukuze zilondoloze amandla njengoba zigaya ukudla ngokushesha

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 25. Ukudla Okunomsoco Kwezilwane Nohlelo Lokugaya | 25.1 Izinhlelo Zokugaya | Izinhlelo Zokugaya Ezinezinhlungu | Izilwane Ezidla Izilwane Ezincelisayo
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 25. Ukudla Okunomsoco Kwezilwane Nohlelo Lokugaya | 25.1 Izinhlelo Zokugaya | Izinhlelo Zokugaya Ezinezinhlungu | Izilwane Ezidla Izilwane Ezincelisayo
chapterContent:
Izilwane ezidla uhlaza ikakhulukazi ziyizilwane ezidla utshani njengezinkomo, izimvu, nezimbuzi, okudliwa kwazo ukudla inani elikhulu le-roughage noma i-fiber. Ziye zathuthukisa izinhlelo zokugaya ukudla ezizisiza ukugaya inani elikhulu le-cellulose. Isici esithakazelisayo somlomo wezilwane ezidla ubhedu ukuthi azinamazinyo angaphansi, ulimi nezindebe ukuklebhula nokuhlafuna ukudla kwazo. Kusukela emlonyeni, ukudla kuhamba kuye emhubheni kuye esiswini.

 Ukuze kusizwe ukugaya inani elikhulu lezinto zezitshalo, isisu sezilwane ezidla ubhedu siyisitho esinamakamelo amaningi, njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 25.8. Izingxenye ezine zesisu zibizwa ngokuthi i-rumen, i-reticulum, i-omasum, kanye ne-abomasum. Lawa makamelo aqukethe amagciwane amaningi aphula i-cellulose futhi abilise ukudla okudliwe. I-abomasum yisisu sangempela futhi ilingana negumbi lesisu elilodwa lapho kukhishwa khona ujusi wesisu. Igumbi lesisu elinamagumbi amane linikeza isikhala esikhulu kanye nokusekelwa kwamagciwane okudingekayo ukugaya izinto zezitshalo ezitshalweni ezidla inyama. Inqubo yokubilisa ikhiqiza inani elikhulu legesi ekamelweni lesisu, okumele lisuswe. Njengakwezinye izilwane, amathumbu amancane adlala indima ebalulekile ekumuncweni kwezakhamzimba, kanti amathumbu amakhulu asiza ekususeni imfucuza.
question1: Uhlobo luni lokudla olusetshenziswa kakhulu yizilwane ezelusayo?
answer1: Inani elikhulu le-roughage noma i-fiber evela ezitshalweni
question2: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okuyisibonelo sesilwane esidla inyama?
question3: Yisiphi isici esihlukile somlomo wesilwane esincelisayo?
question4: Iyini inzuzo eyinhloko yesisu sezilwane ezincelisayo esinezindawo eziningi?
answer4: Inikeza isikhala kanye nokusekelwa kwamagciwane okugaya izinto zezitshalo ezicebile nge-cellulose
question5: Yiziphi izingxenye ezine zesisu sesilwane esincelisayo?
question6: Iyini indima eyinhloko yamagciwane esiswini sesilwane eselisayo?
answer6: Ziphula i-cellulose futhi zibilise ukudla okudliwe
question7: Yisiphi isitho sesisu esibhekwa njengesisu sangempela ezinhlotsheni zezilwane ezelusayo?
question8: Yini ekhiqizwa ngesikhathi sokubiliswa kwamagciwane esiswini sesilwane esidla inyama?
question9: Yimiphi imisebenzi eyinhloko yamathumbu amancane namakhulu ezilwanyaneni ezelusayo?
answer9: Amathumbu amancane amunca izakhamzimba, kanti amathumbu amakhulu asiza ekususeni imfucuza
distractor9a: Amathumbu amancane agcina ukudla, kanti amathumbu amakhulu akhiqiza ama-enzyme
distractor9b: Amathumbu amancane abilisa i-cellulose, kanti amathumbu amakhulu amunca amaprotheni
distractor9c: Amathumbu amancane akhipha inyongo, kanti amathumbu amakhulu agaya i-cellulose

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 25. Ukudla Okunomsoco Kwezilwane Nohlelo Lokugaya | 25.1 Izinhlelo Zokugaya | Izinhlelo Zokugaya Ezinezinhlungu | Izilwane Ezidla Izilwane Ezincelisayo
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 25. Ukudla Okunomsoco Kwezilwane Nohlelo Lokugaya | 25.1 Izinhlelo Zokugaya | Izinhlelo Zokugaya Ezinezinhlungu | Izilwane Ezidla Izilwane Ezincelisayo
chapterContent: Ezinye izilwane, njengekamela nama-alpaca, ziyizilwane ezidla imifino eningi kanye ne-roughage. Ukugaya izitshalo akulula ngoba izindonga zamaseli ezitshalo ziqukethe i-polymeric sugar molecule cellulose. Ama-enzyme okugaya ukudla alezi zilwane awakwazi ukuphula i-cellulose, kodwa ama-microorganisms akhona ohlelweni lokugaya ukudla angakwazi. Ngakho-ke, uhlelo lokugaya ukudla kumele lukwazi ukuphatha inani elikhulu le-roughage futhi luphule i-cellulose. Ama-pseudo-ruminants anesisu esinamakamelo amathathu ohlelweni lokugaya ukudla. Kodwa-ke, i-cecum yawo—isitho esifakwe esikhwameni ekuqaleni kwamathumbu amakhulu esiqukethe ama-microorganisms amaningi adingekayo ekugayweni kwezinto zezitshalo—sikhulu futhi yindawo lapho i-roughage ivundiswa futhi igaywe khona. Lezi zilwane azina-rumen kodwa zine-omasum, i-abomasum, ne-reticulum
answer1: Izilwane ezidla uhlaza ezinesisu esinamakamelo amathathu esigaya izinto zezitshalo ngosizo lwezinambuzane ezincane
distractor1a: Izinyamazane ezidla inyama ezinesisu esinamakamelo amane
distractor1b: Izilwane ezidla inyama ezinesisu esinegumbi elilodwa
question2: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okuyisibonelo sesilwane esikhohlisayo?
question3: Kungani izinto zesitshalo kunzima ukuthi izilwane ezidla inyama zingazigayi?
answer3: Ngoba izindonga zamaseli ezitshalo ziqukethe i-cellulose, ama-enzyme azo okugaya ukudla angenakukwazi ukuwaphula
distractor3a: Ngoba izitshalo ziqukethe amaprotheni amaningi kakhulu
distractor3c: Ngoba i-cellulose imuncwa ngokushesha ngaphambi kokugaya ukudla.
question4: Izilwane ezidla inyama zingayigaya kanjani i-cellulose?
answer4: Ngosizo lwezilokazane ezincane ohlelweni lwazo lokugaya ukudla
question5: Zingaki izindawo zesisu ezinazo izilwane ezidla inyama ezingafanele?
question6: Uyini umsebenzi we-cecum ezinhlotsheni zezilwane ezidla inyama?
answer6: Iqukethe ama-microorganisms abilisa futhi agaye izinto zezitshalo
question7: Ikuphi i-cecum?
question8: Yiliphi igumbi lesisu elingekho ezinhlotsheni mbumbulu zezilwane ezidla inyama?

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 25. Ukudla Okunomsoco Kwezilwane Nohlelo Lokugaya | 25.1 Izinhlelo Zokugaya | Izingxenye Zohlelo Lokugaya | Umgodi Womlomo
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 25. Ukudla Okunomsoco Kwezilwane Nohlelo Lokugaya | 25.1 Izinhlelo Zokugaya | Izingxenye Zohlelo Lokugaya | Umgodi Womlomo
chapterContent:
Uhlelo lokugaya ukudla lwezilwane ezinomgogodla lwenzelwe ukusiza ukuguqulwa kwezinto zokudla zibe izakhi zezakhamzimba ezisekela izinto eziphilayo.

 Umgodi Womlomo
Umgodi womlomo, noma umlomo, yindawo yokungena kokudla ohlelweni lokugaya ukudla, okuboniswe kuMfanekiso 25.9. Ukudla okudliwayo kuhlukaniswa kube yizinhlayiya ezincane ngokuhlafuna, isenzo sokuhlafuna amazinyo. Zonke izilwane ezincelisayo zinamazinyo futhi zingahlafuna ukudla kwazo.

 Inqubo enkulu yamakhemikhali yokugaya ukudla iqala emlonyeni. Njengoba ukudla kuhlafunwa, amathe, akhiqizwa yizindlala zamathe, ahlangana nokudla. Amathe ayinto enamanzi ekhiqizwa emilonyeni yezilwane eziningi. Kunezindlala ezintathu ezinkulu ezikhipha amathe—i-parotid, i-submandibular, kanye ne-sublingual. Amathe aqukethe i-mucus emanzisa ukudla futhi ivimbele i-pH yokudla. Amathe aqukethe nama-immunoglobulins kanye nama-lysozymes, anesenzo sokulwa namagciwane sokunciphisa ukubola kwamazinyo ngokuvimbela ukukhula kwamanye amagciwane. Amathe aqukethe ne-enzyme ebizwa ngokuthi i-salivary amylase eqala inqubo yokuguqula izitashi ekudleni zibe yi-disaccharide ebizwa ngokuthi i-maltose. Enye i-enzyme ebizwa ngokuthi i-lipase ikhiqizwa amaseli olimini. Ama-lipase ayisigaba sama-enzyme angaphula ama-triglycerides. I-lingual lipase iqala ukuqhekeka kwezingxenye zamafutha ekudleni. Isenzo sokuhlafuna nokumanzisa esinikezwa amazinyo namathe silungiselela ukudla kube yinqwaba ebizwa ngokuthi i-bolus yokugwinya. Ulimi luyasiza ekugwinyeni—ukuhambisa i-bolus emlonyeni iye e-pharynx. I-pharynx ivula izindlela ezimbili: i-trachea, eholela emaphashini, kanye ne-esophagus, eholela esiswini. I-trachea inomgodi obizwa ngokuthi i-glottis, ombozwe yi-cartilaginous flap ebizwa ngokuthi i-epiglottis. Uma igwinya, i-epiglottis ivala i-glottis bese ukudla kudlulela e-esophagus hhayi e-trachea. Lokhu kulungiselela kuvumela ukudla ukuthi kugcinwe kude ne-trachea
question1: Uyini umsebenzi oyinhloko womlomo ekugayweni kokudla?
answer1: Ukwamukela ukudla nokuqala ukugaya kwayo ngomshini nangamakhemikhali
question2: Kuyini ukuhlafuna?
answer2: Isenzo sokuhlafuna amazinyo esiphula ukudla kube yizinhlayiya ezincane
question3: Yiziphi izindlala ezintathu ezinkulu ezikhiqiza amathe?
question4: Yimuphi u-enzyme ematheni oqala ukugaya isitashi sibe yi-maltose?
question5: Uyini umsebenzi we-lingual lipase?
question6: Iyini i-bolus?
answer6: Inqwaba yokudla okuhlafunwayo okuxutshwe namathe okulungele ukugwinywa
question7: Uyini umsebenzi we-epiglottis ngesikhathi sokugwinya?
answer7: Ivala ama-glottis ukuvimbela ukudla ukuthi kungangeni ku-trachea
distractor7a: Ivula umphimbo ukuze ivumele ukudla kungene emaphashini
question8: Yiziphi izinto ezilwa namagciwane ematheni ezisiza ekunciphiseni ukubola kwamazinyo?
question9: Yisiphi isakhiwo esisiza ukuhambisa i-bolus isuka emlonyeni iye epharynx?

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 25. Ukudla Okunomsoco Kwezilwane Nohlelo Lokugaya | 25.1 Izinhlelo Zokugaya | Izingxenye Zohlelo Lokugaya | Umphimbo
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 25. Ukudla Okunomsoco Kwezilwane Nohlelo Lokugaya | 25.1 Izinhlelo Zokugaya | Izingxenye Zohlelo Lokugaya | Umphimbo
chapterContent:
Uhlelo lokugaya ukudla lwezilwane ezinomgogodla lwenzelwe ukusiza ukuguqulwa kwezinto zokudla zibe izakhi zezakhamzimba ezisekela izinto eziphilayo.

 I-Esophagus
I-esophagus iyisitho esiyisicaba esixhumanisa umlomo nesisu. Ukudla okuhlafunwayo nokuthambile kudlula e-esophagus ngemva kokugwinywa. Imisipha ebushelelezi ye-esophagus idlula uchungechunge lweminyakazo efana namagagasi ebizwa ngokuthi i-peristalsis esunduza ukudla iye esiswini, njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 25.10. Igagasi le-peristalsis aliqondisi ngakunye—lihambisa ukudla kusuka emlonyeni kuya esiswini, futhi ukunyakaza okuphambene akunakwenzeka. Ukunyakaza kwe-peristaltic ye-esophagus kuyindlela yokusabela engazikhetheli; kwenzeka ngokuphendula isenzo sokugwinya.

 Imisipha efana nendandatho ebizwa ngokuthi i-sphincter yakha ama-valve ohlelweni lokugaya ukudla. I-gastro-esophageal sphincter itholakala ekugcineni kwesisu se-esophagus. Ngokuphendula ekugwinyeni kanye nokucindezela okwenziwa yi-bolus yokudla, le-sphincter iyavuleka, bese i-bolus ingena esiswini. Uma kungekho senzo sokugwinya, le sphincter iyavalwa futhi ivimbele okuqukethwe yisisu ukuthi kungahambi nge-esophagus. Izilwane eziningi zine-sphincter yangempela; nokho, kubantu, ayikho i-sphincter yangempela, kodwa i-esophagus ihlala ivaliwe uma kungekho senzo sokugwinya. I-acid reflux noma isilungulela kwenzeka lapho amajusi okugaya ukudla ane-acid ephuma e-esophagus.
answer1: Ukuthutha ukudla okugwinyiwe kusuka emlonyeni kuya esiswini
question2: Iyiphi inqubo ehambisa ukudla nge-esophagus?
question3: I-peristalsis ihambisa kanjani ukudla nge-esophagus?
answer3: Ngokufinyela okufana namagagasi okungahleliwe kwemisipha ebushelelezi
question4: I-peristalsis ihambisa ukudla ku-esophagus ngakuphi?
question5: Yini ebangela ukunyakaza kwe-peristaltic kwe-esophagus?
question6: Uyini umsebenzi we-gastro-esophageal sphincter?
answer6: Ivumela ukudla ukuthi kungene esiswini futhi isize ekuvimbeleni ukuthi okuqukethwe esiswini kungene emphinjeni
question7: Yini ebangela i-acid reflux noma isilungulela?
answer7: Amajusi okugaya ukudla ane-asidi aphuma esiswini angene emhubheni
question8: Kungani i-gastro-esophageal sphincter ivuleka?
answer8: Ukuphendula ekugwinyeni kanye nokucindezela kwe-bolus yokudla

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 25. Ukudla Okunomsoco Kwezilwane Nohlelo Lokugaya | 25.1 Izinhlelo Zokugaya | Izingxenye Zohlelo Lokugaya | Isisu
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 25. Ukudla Okunomsoco Kwezilwane Nohlelo Lokugaya | 25.1 Izinhlelo Zokugaya | Izingxenye Zohlelo Lokugaya | Isisu
chapterContent:
Uhlelo lokugaya ukudla lwezilwane ezinomgogodla lwenzelwe ukusiza ukuguqulwa kwezinto zokudla zibe izakhi zezakhamzimba ezisekela izinto eziphilayo.

 Isisu
Ingxenye enkulu yokugaya ukudla yenzeka esiswini, okuboniswe kuMfanekiso 25.11. Isisu siyisitho esifana nesikhwama esikhipha ujusi wokugaya esiswini. I-pH esiswini iphakathi kuka-1.5 no-2.5. Le ndawo ene-acid eningi iyadingeka ekuqhekekeni kwamakhemikhali kokudla kanye nokukhishwa kwezakhamzimba. Uma singenalutho, isisu siyisitho esincane; noma kunjalo, singakhula sibe usayizi waso wokuphumula ophindwe izikhathi ezingu-20 uma sigcwele ukudla. Lesi sici siwusizo kakhulu ezilwaneni ezidinga ukudla lapho ukudla kutholakala.

 Isisu siyindawo enkulu yokugaya amaprotheni ezilwaneni ngaphandle kwezilwane ezelusayo. Ukugaya amaprotheni kulawulwa yi-enzyme ebizwa ngokuthi i-pepsin ekamelweni lesisu. I-Pepsin ikhishwa amangqamuzana amakhulu esiswini ngendlela engasebenzi ebizwa ngokuthi i-pepsinogen. I-Pepsin iphula izibopho ze-peptide futhi ihlukanise amaprotheni abe ama-polypeptide amancane; futhi kusiza ekuvuseleleni i-pepsinogen eningi, kuqale indlela yokuphendula eyakha i-pepsin eningi. Olunye uhlobo lweseli—amangqamuzana e-parietal—lukhipha ama-ion e-hydrogen ne-chloride, ahlangana ku-lumen ukuze akhe i-hydrochloric acid, ingxenye eyinhloko ye-acidic yejusi lesisu. I-Hydrochloric acid isiza ukuguqula i-pepsinogen engasebenzi ibe yi-pepsin. Indawo ene-acidic eningi ibulala nama-microorganism amaningi ekudleni futhi, kuhlangene nesenzo se-enzyme i-pepsin, kuphumela ekuqhekekeni kweprotheni ekudleni. Ukugaya kwamakhemikhali kwenziwa lula yisenzo sokuguguleka kwesisu. Ukufinyela nokuphumula kwemisipha ebushelelezi kuxuba okuqukethwe yisisu cishe njalo ngemizuzu engama-20. Ukudla okugayiwe kancane kanye nengxube yejusi lesisu kubizwa ngokuthi i-chyme. I-Chyme idlula esiswini iye emathunjini amancane. Ukugaya okwengeziwe kweprotheni kwenzeka emathunjini amancane. Ukuphuma kwesisu kwenzeka zingakapheli amahora amabili kuya kwayisithupha ngemva kokudla. Inani elincane le-chyme likhishwa emathunjini amancane ngesikhathi. Ukuhamba kwe-chyme kusuka esiswini kuya emathunjini amancane kulawulwa yi-pyloric sphincter.

 Lapho kugaywa amaprotheni kanye namafutha athile, ulwelwesi lwesisu kumele luvikelwe ekugayweni yi-pepsin. Kunamaphuzu amabili okufanele uwacabangele lapho uchaza indlela ulwelwesi lwesisu oluvikelwe ngayo. Okokuqala, njengoba kushiwo ngaphambili, i-enzyme i-pepsin yenziwa ngendlela engasebenzi. Lokhu kuvikela amangqamuzana ayinhloko, ngoba i-pepsinogen ayinawo umsebenzi ofanayo we-enzyme ne-pepsin. Okwesibili, isisu sinolwelwesi olukhulu lwe-mucus oluvikela izicubu ezingaphansi esenzweni sejusi lokugaya ukudla. Lapho lolu lwelwelwesi lwe-mucus luqhekeka, izilonda zingakheka esiswini. Izilonda ziyizilonda ezivulekile ngaphakathi noma esithweni esibangelwa amagciwane (i-Helicobacter pylori) lapho ulwelwesi lwe-mucus luqhekeka futhi luhluleka ukuguquka.
answer1: Ukugaya ukudla ngamakhemikhali nangomshini, ikakhulukazi amaprotheni
question2: Kungani isisu sine-asidi ephezulu, kanti i-pH iphakathi kuka-1.5 no-2.5?
answer2: Ukukhuthaza ukugaya kwamakhemikhali, ukwenza kusebenze i-pepsin, nokubulala amagciwane amaningi
question3: I-pepsin ikhiqizwa ngayiphi indlela engasebenzi ekuqaleni?
question4: Iyini indima ye-hydrochloric acid esiswini?
question5: Yimaphi amangqamuzana esiswini akhipha i-pepsinogen?
question6: Yimaphi amangqamuzana esiswini akhipha ama-ion akha i-hydrochloric acid?
question7: Kuyini i-chyme?
answer7: Ingxube yokudla okugayiwe kancane kanye nojusi wesisu ophuma esiswini
question8: Yisiphi isakhiwo esilawula ukuhamba kwe-chyme kusuka esiswini kuya emathunjini amancane?
question9: Kungani i-pepsin ikhishwa njenge-pepsinogen engasebenzi?
question10: Yini evame ukubangela izilonda esiswini lapho ulwelwesi oluvikelayo lwe-mucus lonakele?
question11: Bheka uMfanekiso 25.11. Yisiphi kulezi zinkulumo ezilandelayo mayelana nohlelo lokugaya ukudla esingamanga?
answer11: Ukudla kungena emathunjini amakhulu ngaphambi kwamathumbu amancane
distractor11a: I-Chyme iyinhlanganisela yokudla kanye nojusi wokugaya ukudla okhiqizwa esiswini
distractor11b: Emathunjini amancane, i-chyme ixubana ne-bile, ehlanganisa amafutha
distractor11c: Isisu sihlukaniswe nomathumbu amancane yi-pyloric sphincter

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 25. Ukudla Okunomsoco Kwezilwane Nohlelo Lokugaya | 25.1 Izinhlelo Zokugaya | Izingxenye Zohlelo Lokugaya | Amathumbu Amancane
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 25. Ukudla Okunomsoco Kwezilwane Nohlelo Lokugaya | 25.1 Izinhlelo Zokugaya | Izingxenye Zohlelo Lokugaya | Amathumbu Amancane
chapterContent:
Uhlelo lokugaya ukudla lwezilwane ezinomgogodla lwenzelwe ukusiza ukuguqulwa kwezinto zokudla zibe izakhi zezakhamzimba ezisekela izinto eziphilayo.

 Amathumbu Amancane
I-Chyme isuka esiswini iye emathunjini amancane. Amathumbu amancane yisitho lapho kuqedwa khona ukugaya amaprotheni, amafutha, nama-carbohydrate. Amathumbu amancane yisitho eside esifana nethubhu esinobuso obugoqwe kakhulu obuqukethe ama-projection afana neminwe abizwa ngokuthi i-villi. Ubuso obuphezulu be-villus ngayinye bunama-projection amaningi amancane abizwa ngokuthi i-microvilli. Lezi zakhiwo, eziboniswe kuMfanekiso 25.12, zigcwele amaseli e-epithelial ohlangothini lwe-luminal futhi zivumela ukuthi izakhamzimba zimuncwe ekudleni okugayiwe futhi zimuncwe egazini ngakolunye uhlangothi. I-villi ne-microvilli, ngokugoqeka kwazo okuningi, zandisa indawo engaphezulu yamathumbu futhi zandisa ukusebenza kahle kokumuncwa kwezakhamzimba. Izakhamzimba ezimuncwa egazini zithwalwa ziyiswe emthanjeni we-hepatic portal, oholela esibindini. Lapho, isibindi silawula ukusatshalaliswa kwezakhamzimba emzimbeni wonke futhi sisuse izinto ezinobuthi, okuhlanganisa izidakamizwa, utshwala, kanye nezinye izifo ezibangelwa amagciwane.

 Amathumbu amancane omuntu angaphezu kwamamitha ayi-6 ubude futhi ahlukaniswe izingxenye ezintathu: i-duodenum, i-jejunum, kanye ne-ileum. Ingxenye eqinile yamathumbu amancane emise okwe-C ibizwa ngokuthi i-duodenum futhi iboniswe kuMfanekiso 25.11. I-duodenum ihlukaniswe nesisu yi-pyloric sphincter evulekayo ukuvumela i-chyme ukuthi isuke esiswini iye kwi-duodenum. Ku-duodenum, i-chyme ixutshwa namajusi e-pancreatic kusisombululo se-alkaline esicebile nge-bicarbonate esiqeda ubumuncu be-chyme futhi sisebenze njenge-buffer. Amajusi e-pancreatic aqukethe nama-enzyme amaningana okugaya ukudla. Amajusi okugaya ukudla avela ku-pancreas, esibindini, kanye ne-gallbladder, kanye namaseli e-gland odongeni lwamathumbu ngokwawo, angena kwi-duodenum. I-Bile ikhiqizwa esibindini futhi igcinwe futhi igxile kwi-gallbladder. I-Bile iqukethe usawoti we-bile ohlanganisa ama-lipids kuyilapho i-pancreas ikhiqiza ama-enzyme aguqula izitashi, ama-disaccharides, amaprotheni, namafutha. Lawa majusi okugaya ukudla aphula izinhlayiya zokudla ku-chyme zibe yi-glucose, ama-triglycerides, nama-amino acid. Inqwaba yokugaya ukudla ngamakhemikhali kwenzeka kwi-duodenum. Ukumuncwa kwama-fatty acid nakho kwenzeka ku- i-duodenum.

 Ingxenye yesibili yamathumbu amancane ibizwa ngokuthi i-jejunum, eboniswe kuMfanekiso 25.11. Lapha, i-hydrolysis yezakhamzimba iyaqhubeka kuyilapho iningi lama-carbohydrate nama-amino acid limuncwa ngolwelwesi lwamathumbu. Ukugaya okuthile kwamakhemikhali kanye nenqwaba yokumuncwa kwezakhamzimba kwenzeka ku-jejunum.

 I-ileum, nayo eboniswe kuMfanekiso 25.11 yingxenye yokugcina yamathumbu amancane futhi lapha usawoti we-bile namavithamini amuncwa egazini. Ukudla okungagayiwe kuthunyelwa ku-colon kusuka ku-ileum ngokunyakaza kwemisipha. I-ileum iyaphela bese amathumbu amakhulu aqala ku-valve ye-ileocecal. I-appendix ye-vermiform, efana ne-worm,” itholakala ku-valve ye-ileocecal. I-appendix yabantu ayikhiphi ama-enzyme futhi inendima engabalulekile ekuvikeleni amasosha omzimba.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 25. Ukudla Okunomsoco Kwezilwane Nohlelo Lokugaya | 25.1 Izinhlelo Zokugaya | Izingxenye Zohlelo Lokugaya | Amathumbu Amakhulu
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 25. Ukudla Okunomsoco Kwezilwane Nohlelo Lokugaya | 25.1 Izinhlelo Zokugaya | Izingxenye Zohlelo Lokugaya | Amathumbu Amakhulu
chapterContent:
Uhlelo lokugaya ukudla lwezilwane ezinethambo lomgogodla lwenzelwe ukusiza ukuguqulwa kwezinto zokudla zibe izakhi zomzimba ezisekela izinto eziphilayo.

 Amathumbu Amakhulu
Amathumbu amakhulu, aboniswe kuMfanekiso 25.14, amunca amanzi avela ekudleni okungagayiwe futhi acubungule izinto ezilahliwe. Amathumbu amakhulu abantu mancane kakhulu ngobude uma eqhathaniswa namathumbu amancane kodwa makhulu ngobubanzi. Anezingxenye ezintathu: i-cecum, i-colon, kanye ne-rectum. I-cecum ihlanganisa i-ileum ne-colon futhi iyisikhwama sokwamukela izinto ezilahliwe. I-colon iyikhaya lamabhaktheriya amaningi noma izitshalo zamathumbu ezisiza ezinqubweni zokugaya ukudla. I-colon ingahlukaniswa ngezifunda ezine, i-colon ekhuphukayo, i-colon ewelayo, i-colon ehlayo kanye ne-sigmoid colon. Imisebenzi eyinhloko ye-colon ukukhipha amanzi nosawoti wamaminerali ekudleni okungagayiwe, nokugcina izinto ezilahliwe. Izilwane ezidla inyama zine-colon enkulu emfushane uma kuqhathaniswa nezilwane ezidla utshani ngenxa yokudla kwazo.
answer1: Ukumunca amanzi ekudleni okungagayiwe nokucubungula izinto ezilahliwe

answer9: Ngoba ukudla kwabo okusekelwe enyameni kulula ukukugaya futhi kudinga ukubiliswa okuncane

chapterContent:
Uhlelo lokugaya ukudla lwezilwane ezinomgogodla lwenzelwe ukusiza ukuguqulwa kwezinto zokudla zibe izakhi zezakhamzimba ezisekela izinto eziphilayo.

 I-Rectum kanye ne-Anus
I-rectum iwukuphela kokugcina kwamathumbu amakhulu, njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 25.14. Indima eyinhloko ye-rectum ukugcina indle kuze kube yilapho iphuma. Indle iqhutshwa kusetshenziswa ukunyakaza kwe-peristaltic ngesikhathi sokukhipha. I-anus iyindawo evulekile ekugcineni kwendlela yokugaya ukudla futhi iyindawo yokuphuma kwezinto ezilahliwe. Ama-sphincters amabili phakathi kwe-rectum kanye ne-anus alawula ukususwa: i-sphincter yangaphakathi ayizikhetheli kanti i-sphincter yangaphandle iyazikhethela
answer1: Ukugcina indle kuze kube yilapho ikhipha indle

answer3: Imbobo ekugcineni kwendlela yokugaya ukudla lapho imfucuza iphuma khona emzimbeni

chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 25. Ukudla Okunomsoco Kwezilwane Nohlelo Lokugaya | 25.1 Izinhlelo Zokugaya | Izingxenye Zohlelo Lokugaya | Izitho Ezingeziwe
chapterContent:
Uhlelo lokugaya ukudla lwezilwane ezinomgogodla lwenzelwe ukusiza ukuguqulwa kwezinto zokudla zibe izakhi zezakhi ezisekela izinto eziphilayo.

 Izitho Ezisekelayo
Izitho okuxoxwe ngazo ngenhla yizitho zomgudu wokugaya ukudla lapho ukudla kudlula khona. Izitho ezisekelayo yizitho ezengeza uketshezi (ama-enzyme) aguqula ukudla kube izakhi. Izitho ezisekelayo zifaka phakathi izindlala zamathe, isibindi, i-pancreas, kanye ne-gallbladder. Isibindi, i-pancreas, kanye ne-gallbladder kulawulwa ama-hormone ngokuphendula ukudla okudliwayo.

 Isibindi yisitho sangaphakathi esikhulu kunazo zonke kubantu futhi sidlala indima ebaluleke kakhulu ekugayweni kwamafutha nasekususeni ubuthi egazini. Isibindi sikhiqiza i-bile, ujusi wokugaya ukudla odingekayo ekuqhekekeni kwezingxenye ezinamafutha zokudla e-duodenum. Isibindi siphinde sicubungule amavithamini namafutha futhi sihlanganise amaprotheni amaningi e-plasma.

 I-pancreas ingenye i-gland ebalulekile ekhipha ujusi wokugaya ukudla. I-chyme ekhiqizwa esiswini ine-asidi ephezulu ngokwemvelo; Amajusi e-pancreatic aqukethe amazinga aphezulu e-bicarbonate, i-alkali eqeda i-acidic chyme. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amajusi e-pancreatic aqukethe izinhlobo eziningi zama-enzyme adingekayo ekugayweni kwamaprotheni nama-carbohydrate.

 I-gallbladder iyisitho esincane esisiza isibindi ngokugcina i-bile nokugxila kusawoti we-bile. Lapho i-chyme equkethe ama-fatty acid ingena kwi-duodenum, i-bile ikhishwa kwi-gallbladder iye kwi-duodenum.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 25. Ukudla Okunomsoco Kwezilwane kanye Nohlelo Lokugaya | 25.2 Ukudla Okunomsoco Nokukhiqizwa Kwamandla | Ukuxhumana Nezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 25. Ukudla Okunomsoco Kwezilwane kanye Nohlelo Lokugaya | 25.2 Ukudla Okunomsoco Nokukhiqizwa Kwamandla | Ukuxhumana Nezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent:
Okuningi kokuqukethwe okuchazwe kule module akukho ngaphakathi kobubanzi be-AP®. Kodwa-ke, njengoba sifunda esahlukweni sama-macromolecule ezinto eziphilayo, ezilwaneni ama-molecule ezinto eziphilayo adingekayo ekwakheni izinto zamaseli nezicubu avela ekudleni. Ngesikhathi sokugaya, ama-carbohydrate ayinkimbinkimbi ahlukaniswa abe yi-glucose futhi asetshenziselwa ukunikeza amandla ngezindlela ze-metabolic, njengokuphefumula kwamaseli (bheka isahluko sokuphefumula kwamaseli). Ushukela owedlulele emzimbeni ugcinwa njenge-glycogen esibindini nasemisipheni ukuze kusetshenziswe kamuva. Esinye isidingo esibalulekile yi-nitrogen, futhi i-protein catabolism inikeza umthombo we-nitrogen; ama-amino acid avela ekuqhekekeni kwamaprotheni ayizitini zokwakha amaprotheni amasha. I-carbon ne-nitrogen etholakala kuma-amino acid nayo iba izitini zokwakha ama-nucleic acid. I-nitrogen eyeqile ikhishwa ngoba inobuthi. Nakuba umzimba wesilwane ungakhiqiza ama-molecule amaningi adingekayo ekusebenzeni okuvela ezintweni eziphilayo, ezinye izakhamzimba ezibalulekile kumele zidliwe ekudleni. Amavithamini ayisigaba sesinye sama-molecule abalulekile ezinto eziphilayo adingekayo ngobuningi obuncane ukuze ama-enzyme amaningi asebenze. (Cha, awudingi ukukhumbula ithebula lamavithamini nemisebenzi yawo!) Ukuntuleka kwezakhamzimba kungaba nemiphumela emibi empilweni yesilwane. Isibonelo, phakathi kwezinye izinto, i-vitamin D iyadingeka ekumuncweni kwe-calcium ukuze amathambo akhule, kanti i-vitamin C ibalulekile ezindleleni eziningi ze-biochemical, okuhlanganisa nokusebenza komzimba.

 Njengoba sifunda esahlukweni sokuphefumula kwamaseli, izilwane zidinga amandla amahhala, ikakhulukazi ahlinzekwa ama-carbohydrate, ukuze zilondoloze i-homeostasis. I-ATP iyi-energy currency yeseli futhi ikhiqizwa yi-oxidative reactions ku-cytoplasm kanye ne-mitochondria, lapho ama-carbohydrate, amaprotheni, namafutha edlula khona uchungechunge lwe-metabolic reactions ndawonye ebizwa ngokuthi i-cellular respiration. Lapho inani le-ATP elitholakalayo lidlula izidingo zomzimba, isibindi sisebenzisa i-ATP eyengeziwe kanye ne-glucose ukukhiqiza ama-molecule e-glycogen. Amandla okugcina amandla amaningi kuyindlela yokuzivumelanisa nezimo ezishintshashintshayo esiza izilwane ukubhekana nokuhamba kanye nokuntuleka kokudla.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyiswe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo echazwe ku-Big Idea 2 yohlaka lwe-AP® Biology Curriculum. Izinhloso Zokufunda ze-AP® ezibalwe kuhlaka lwe-Curriculum zinikeza isisekelo esicacile senkambo ye-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekuphenyweni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo neyodwa noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa.

 Umqondo Omkhulu 2
Izinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo zisebenzisa amandla amahhala kanye namabhlogo okwakha ama-molecule ukuze zikhule, zizale, futhi zilondoloze i-homeostasis enamandla.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 2.A
Ukukhula, ukuzala kanye nokugcinwa kwezinhlelo eziphilayo kudinga amandla amahhala nezinto.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
2.A.2 Izinto eziphilayo zibamba futhi zigcine amandla amahhala ukuze zisetshenziswe ezinqubweni zezinto eziphilayo.

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
6.2 Umfundi angakha izincazelo zezehlakalo ngokusekelwe ebufakazini obuvezwa ngemikhuba yesayensi.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
2.5 Umfundi uyakwazi ukwakha izincazelo zezindlela kanye nezici zesakhiwo samaseli ezivumela izinto eziphilayo ukuthi zibambe, zigcine noma zisebenzise amandla amahhala.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
2.A.3 Izinto eziphilayo kumele zishintshane ngezinto nendawo ukuze zikhule, zizale futhi zigcine ukuhleleka.

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
4.1 Umfundi angathethelela ukukhethwa kohlobo lwedatha edingekayo ukuphendula umbuzo othile wesayensi.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
2.8 Umfundi uyakwazi ukuthethelela ukukhethwa kwedatha mayelana nezinhlobo zama-molecule isilwane esizowasebenzisa njengezisekelo zokwakha ezidingekayo.

 Njengoba kunikezwe ukuhlukahluka kokuphila kwezilwane emhlabeni wethu, akumangazi ukuthi ukudla kwezilwane nakho kuzohluka kakhulu. Ukudla kwezilwane kungumthombo wezinto ezidingekayo ekwakheni i-DNA kanye namanye ama-molecule ayinkimbinkimbi adingekayo ekukhuleni, ekugcinweni nasekuzaleni; ndawonye lezi zinqubo zibizwa ngokuthi i-biosynthesis. Ukudla nakho kungumthombo wezinto zokukhiqizwa kwe-ATP emaseli. Ukudla kumele kulinganiswe ukuze kuhlinzekwe ngamaminerali namavithamini adingekayo ekusebenzeni kwamaseli
