chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 25. Ukudla Okunomsoco Kwezilwane Nohlelo Lokugaya | 25.2 Ukudla Okunomsoco Nokukhiqizwa Kwamandla | Izidingo Zokudla | Izinto Ezingaphambi Kwemvelo
chapterContent:
Yiziphi izidingo eziyisisekelo zokudla kwezilwane? Ukudla kwezilwane kufanele kube nokulinganisela okuhle futhi kuhlinzeke ngezakhamzimba ezidingekayo ekusebenzeni komzimba kanye namaminerali namavithamini adingekayo ekugcineni isakhiwo kanye nokulawulwa okudingekayo empilweni enhle kanye nekhono lokuzala. Lezi zidingo zomuntu ziboniswe ngemidwebo kuMfanekiso 25.15

 Ama-Organic Precursors
Ama-molecule e-organic adingekayo ekwakheni izinto zamaseli kanye nezicubu kumele avele ekudleni. Ama-carbohydrate noma ushukela angumthombo oyinhloko wama-carbon e-organic emzimbeni wesilwane. Ngesikhathi sokugaya, ama-carbohydrate agayekayo ekugcineni ahlukaniswa abe yi-glucose futhi asetshenziswe ukuhlinzeka ngamandla ngezindlela ze-metabolic. Ama-carbohydrate ayinkimbinkimbi, kufaka phakathi ama-polysaccharides, angahlukaniswa abe yi-glucose ngokuguqulwa kwamakhemikhali; noma kunjalo, abantu abakhiqizi i-enzyme cellulase futhi abanalo ikhono lokuthola i-glucose ku-polysaccharide cellulose. Kubantu, la ma-molecule ahlinzeka nge-fiber edingekayo yokuhambisa imfucuza emathunjini amakhulu kanye ne-colon enempilo. Izitshalo zamathumbu emathunjini omuntu ziyakwazi ukukhipha ukudla okuthile kulezi zindwangu zezitshalo. Ushukela owengeziwe emzimbeni uguqulwa ube yi-glycogen futhi ugcinwe esibindini nasemisipheni ukuze usetshenziswe kamuva. Izitolo ze-Glycogen zisetshenziselwa ukufukula ukuzikhandla isikhathi eside, njengokugijima ibanga elide, kanye nokunikeza amandla ngesikhathi sokuntuleka kokudla. I-glycogen eningi ingaguqulwa ibe ngamafutha, agcinwa engxenyeni engezansi yesikhumba sezilwane ezincelisayo ukuze kugcinwe ukushisa nokugcina amandla. Ama-carbohydrate agayekayo ngokweqile agcinwa yizilwane ezincelisayo ukuze zisinde endlaleni futhi zisize ekuhambeni.

 Esinye isidingo esibalulekile yi-nitrogen. I-protein catabolism inikeza umthombo we-nitrogen ephilayo. Ama-amino acid ayizakhi zokwakha amaprotheni futhi ukuqhekeka kwamaprotheni kunikeza ama-amino acid asetshenziselwa ukusebenza kwamaseli. I-carbon ne-nitrogen etholakala kulezi ziba yisekelo se-nucleotide, ama-nucleic acid, amaprotheni, amaseli, kanye nezicubu. I-nitrogen eningi kumele ikhishwe njengoba inobuthi. Amafutha engeza ukunambitheka ekudleni futhi akhuthaze umuzwa wokwaneliseka noma ukugcwala. Ukudla okunamafutha nakho kuyimithombo ebalulekile yamandla ngoba igremu elilodwa lamafutha liqukethe amakhalori ayisishiyagalolunye. Amafutha ayadingeka ekudleni ukusiza ukumuncwa kwamavithamini ancibilikayo emafutheni kanye nokukhiqizwa kwama-hormone ancibilikayo emafutheni.

chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 25. Ukudla Okunomsoco Kwezilwane kanye Nohlelo Lokugaya | 25.2 Ukudla Okunomsoco Nokukhiqizwa Kwamandla | Izidingo Zokudla | Izakhamzimba Ezibalulekile
chapterContent:
Yiziphi izidingo eziyisisekelo zokudla kwezilwane? Ukudla kwezilwane kufanele kube nokulinganisela okuhle futhi kuhlinzeke ngezakhamzimba ezidingekayo ekusebenzeni komzimba kanye namaminerali namavithamini adingekayo ekugcineni isakhiwo kanye nokulawulwa okudingekayo empilweni enhle kanye nekhono lokuzala. Lezi zidingo zomuntu ziboniswe ngemidwebo kuMfanekiso 25.15

 Izakhamzimba Ezibalulekile
Ngenkathi umzimba wesilwane ungahlanganisa ama-molecule amaningi adingekayo ekusebenzeni okuvela ezintweni eziphilayo, kunezakhamzimba ezithile okudingeka zidliwe ekudleni. Lezi zakhamzimba zibizwa ngokuthi izakhamzimba ezibalulekile, okusho ukuthi kumele zidliwe, futhi umzimba awukwazi ukuzikhiqiza.

 I-omega-3 alpha-linolenic acid kanye ne-omega-6 linoleic acid kungama-fatty acid abalulekile adingekayo ukwenza ama-phospholipid e-membrane. Amavithamini ayisigaba sesinye sama-molecule abalulekile e-organic adingekayo ngobuningi obuncane ukuze ama-enzyme amaningi asebenze futhi, ngenxa yalesi sizathu, abhekwa njengama-co-enzyme. Ukungabikho noma amazinga aphansi amavithamini kungaba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni, njengoba kuchaziwe etafuleni lamaVithamini Abalulekile Ancibilikayo Emanzini kanye nethebula lamaVithamini Abalulekile Ancibilikayo Emafutha ngezansi. Womabili amavithamini ancibilikayo kanye nalawo ancibilikayo emanzini kumele atholakale ekudleni. Amaminerali, abhalwe kuthebula lamaMinerals kanye Nomsebenzi Wawo Emzimbeni Womuntu, ayizakhamzimba ezibalulekile ezingaphili okumele zitholakale ekudleni. Phakathi kwemisebenzi yawo eminingi, amaminerali asiza ekwakheni nasekulawuleni futhi abhekwa njengezinto ezihambisanayo. Amanye ama-amino acid kumele atholakale ekudleni futhi awakwazi ukwenziwa umzimba. Lawa ma-amino acid angama-amino acid abalulekile. Umzimba womuntu ungakhiqiza ama-amino acid angu-11 kuphela kwangu-20 adingekayo; okusele kumele kutholakale ekudleni. Ama-amino acid abalulekile abhalwe kuthebula lama-Amino Acids abalulekile ngezansi.

 Amavithamini Abalulekile Ancibilika Emzimbeni
I-Vitamin
Umsebenzi_____Ukuntuleka Kungaholela_____Imithombo

 I-Vitamin B1 (i-Thiamine)
Edingwa umzimba ukucubungula amafutha, amaprotheni, kanye nama-carbohydrate I-Coenzyme isusa i-CO2 ku-organic com amakhilogremu _____Ubuthakathaka bemisipha, i-Beriberi: ukusebenza kwenhliziyo okunciphile, izinkinga ze-CNS_____Ubisi, inyama, ubhontshisi omisiwe, okusanhlamvu okuphelele

 I-Vitamin B2 (i-Riboflavin)
Ithatha indima esebenzayo ekusetshenzisweni komzimba, isiza ekuguqulweni kokudla kube amandla (i-FAD kanye ne-FMN)_____Ukuqhekeka noma izilonda ebusweni bangaphandle bezindebe (i-cheliosis); ukuvuvukala nokubomvu kolimi; Ukuvuvukala kwesikhumba okumanzi, okunama-scaly (i-seborrheic dermatitis)_____Inyama, amaqanda, okusanhlamvu okucebile, imifino

 I-Vitamin B3 (i-Niacin)
Isetshenziswa ngumzimba ukukhipha amandla kuma-carbohydrate nokucubungula utshwala; okudingekayo ekwakhiweni kwama-hormone ocansi; ingxenye ye-coenzyme NAD+ kanye ne-NADP+_____I-Pellagra, engabangela i-dermatitis, isifo sohudo, i-dementia, kanye nokufa_____Inyama, amaqanda, okusanhlamvu, amantongomane, amazambane

 I-Vitamin B5 (i-Pantothenic acid)
Isiza ekukhiqizeni amandla ekudleni (ama-lipid, ikakhulukazi); ingxenye ye-coenzyme A_____Ukukhathala, ukungasebenzi kahle, ukukhula okubambezelekile, ukuba ndikindiki, ukuqaqamba kwezandla kanye izinyawo _____Inyama, okusanhlamvu okuphelele, ubisi, izithelo, imifino

 I-Vitamin B6 (i-Pyridoxine)
I-Vitamin eyinhloko yokucubungula ama-amino acid nama-lipid; futhi isiza ukuguqula izakhamzimba zibe amandla_____Ukucasuka, ukudideka, izilonda emlonyeni noma izilonda, i-anemia, ukudikiza kwemisipha_____Inyama, imikhiqizo yobisi, okusanhlamvu okuphelele, ujusi wewolintshi

 I-Vitamin B7 (i-Biotin)
Isetshenziswa ekusetshenzisweni kwamandla kanye nama-amino acid, ukwakheka kwamafutha, kanye nokuqhekeka kwamafutha; kusiza umzimba ukusebenzisa ushukela egazini_____Ukulahlekelwa izinwele, i-dermatitis, ukungazweli kanye nokuluma emaphethelweni; izinkinga ze-neuromuscular_____Inyama, amaqanda, ama-legumes kanye neminye imifino

 I-Vitamin B9 (i-Folic acid)
Isiza ekuthuthukisweni okuvamile kwamaseli, ikakhulukazi ngesikhathi sokukhula kwengane; kusiza ekugayweni kwama-nucleic nama-amino acid_____Ukuntuleka ngesikhathi sokukhulelwa kuhlotshaniswa nokukhubazeka kokuzalwa, njengokukhubazeka kwe-neural tube kanye ne-anemia_____Imifino eluhlaza enamaqabunga, ukolweni ophelele, izithelo, amantongomane, ama-legumes

I-Vitamin B12 (i-Cobalamin)
Igcina uhlelo lwezinzwa olunempilo futhi isiza ekwakhekeni kwamaseli egazi; i-coenzyme ekugayweni kwe-nucleic acid_____I-Anemia, izinkinga ze-neurological, ukungazweli, ukulahlekelwa ibhalansi_____Inyama, amaqanda, izilwane imikhiqizo

 I-Vitamin C (i-Ascorbic acid)
Isiza ukugcina izicubu ezixhumene: ithambo, i-cartilage, kanye ne-dentin; iqinisa amasosha omzimba_____I-scurvy, eholela ekuphumeni kwegazi, ekulahlekelweni izinwele namazinyo; ubuhlungu bamalunga nokuvuvukala; ukuphola kwenxeba okulibaziseka_____Izithelo ze-citrus, i-broccoli, utamatisi, upelepele obomvu omnandi

Kubalulekile ekumuncweni kwe-calcium ekukhuleni nasekuqineni kwamathambo; kugcina uhlelo lwezinzwa oluzinzile; kugcina ukushaya kwenhliziyo okujwayelekile nokuqinile; kusiza egazini Ukuminyana_____Ama-Ricket, i-osteomalacia, ukungatheleleki_____Amafutha esibindi se-cod, ubisi, iqanda lobisi

Inciphisa umonakalo we-oxidative wamaseli, futhi ivimbela umonakalo wamaphaphu ovela ekungcoleni; okubalulekile ohlelweni lokuzivikela komzimba_____Ukuntuleka kwe-oxidative akuvamile; i-anemia, ukuwohloka kwesistimu yezinzwa_____Amafutha e-germ kakolweni, amafutha emifino angacolisisiwe, amantongomane, imbewu, okusanhlamvu

Amaminerali

Iyadingeka ekusebenzeni kwemisipha kanye ne-neuron; impilo yenhliziyo; yakha amathambo futhi isekele ukwakheka kanye nokusebenza kwamaseli egazi; umsebenzi wezinzwa_____I-Osteoporosis, ama-rickets, imisipha ukuqaqamba, ukukhula okungasebenzi kahle_____Ubisi, iyogathi, inhlanzi, imifino enamaqabunga aluhlaza, ama-legumes

 Iyadingeka ekukhiqizweni kwe-hydrochloric acid (HCl) esiswini kanye nokusebenza kwezinzwa; ibhalansi ye-osmotic_____Ukuqaqamba kwemisipha, ukuphazamiseka kwemizwa, ukuncipha kwesifiso sokudla_____Usawoti wetafula

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 25. Ukudla Okunomsoco Kwezilwane Nohlelo Lokugaya | 25.2 Ukudla Okunomsoco Nokukhiqizwa Kwamandla | Amandla Okudla Ne-ATP
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 25. Ukudla Okunomsoco Kwezilwane Nohlelo Lokugaya | 25.2 Ukudla Okunomsoco Nokukhiqizwa Kwamandla | Amandla Okudla Ne-ATP
chapterContent:
Izilwane zidinga ukudla ukuze zithole amandla futhi zilondoloze i-homeostasis. I-Homeostasis yikhono lesistimu lokugcina indawo yangaphakathi ezinzile ngisho noma zibhekene nezinguquko zangaphandle endaweni ezungezile. Isibonelo, izinga lokushisa elivamile lomzimba wabantu lingu-37°C (98.6°F). Abantu balondoloza leli zinga lokushisa ngisho noma izinga lokushisa langaphandle lishisa noma libanda. Kudinga amandla ukugcina leli zinga lokushisa lomzimba, futhi izilwane zithola la mandla ekudleni.

 Umthombo oyinhloko wamandla ezilwaneni ama-carbohydrate, ikakhulukazi i-glucose. I-glucose ibizwa ngokuthi uphethiloli womzimba. Ama-carbohydrate agayekayo ekudleni kwesilwane aguqulwa abe ama-molecule e-glucose ngochungechunge lwezimpendulo zamakhemikhali ezishintshashintshayo.

 I-Adenosine triphosphate, noma i-ATP, iyimali yamandla eyinhloko emaseli; I-ATP igcina amandla kuma-phosphate ester bonds. I-ATP ikhipha amandla lapho ama-phosphodiester bonds ephukile futhi i-ATP iguqulwa ibe yi-ADP kanye neqembu le-phosphate. I-ATP ikhiqizwa yi-oxidative reactions ku-cytoplasm kanye ne-mitochondrion yeseli, lapho ama-carbohydrate, amaprotheni, namafutha edlula khona uchungechunge lwe-metabolic reactions ndawonye ebizwa ngokuthi ukuphefumula kwamaseli. Isibonelo, i-glycolysis uchungechunge lwe-reactions lapho i-glucose iguqulwa ibe yi-pyruvic acid kanti amanye amandla ayo amakhemikhali adluliselwa ku-NADH kanye ne-ATP.

 I-ATP iyadingeka kuyo yonke imisebenzi yamaseli. Isetshenziselwa ukwakha ama-molecule e-organic adingekayo kumaseli nezicubu; inikeza amandla okunciphisa imisipha kanye nokudlulisa izimpawu zikagesi ohlelweni lwezinzwa. Lapho inani le-ATP litholakala ngaphezu kwezidingo zomzimba, isibindi sisebenzisa i-ATP eyengeziwe kanye ne-glucose eyengeziwe ukukhiqiza ama-molecule abizwa ngokuthi i-glycogen. I-Glycogen iwuhlobo lwe-polymeric lwe-glucose futhi igcinwa kumaseli esibindi kanye nemisipha yamathambo. Lapho ushukela wegazi wehla, isibindi sikhipha i-glucose ezitolo ze-glycogen. Imisipha yamathambo iguqula i-glycogen ibe yi-glucose ngesikhathi sokuzivocavoca okukhulu. Inqubo yokuguqula i-glucose kanye ne-ATP eyengeziwe ibe yi-glycogen kanye nokugcinwa kwamandla engeziwe kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile ngokwezimo ekusizeni izilwane ukubhekana nokuhamba, ukuntuleka kokudla, kanye nendlala.

chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 25. Ukudla Okunomsoco Kwezilwane Nohlelo Lokugaya | 25.3 Izinqubo Zesistimu Yokugaya | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent:
Ulwazi oluningi olukule module alukho ngaphansi kwe-AP®. Kodwa-ke, lapho sihlola imiqondo mayelana nama-molecule ezinto eziphilayo esahlukweni sama-macromolecule ezinto eziphilayo, sifunda ukuthi ama-macromolecule—ama-carbohydrate, ama-lipid, amaprotheni, nama-nucleic acid—akhiwa kanjani kusuka kuma-monomers. Ngesikhathi sokugaya, lawa ma-polymer ahlukaniswa abe ama-monomers, abese emuncwa futhi athuthelwe kuwo wonke amaseli omzimba. Kumodule ye-Digestive Systems, sichaze isiphetho sezithako zesandwich njengoba zidlula endleleni yokugaya. Ukudla kugwinywa ngomlomo, futhi ukugaya kanye nokumuncwa kwenzeka ngochungechunge lwezinyathelo, ngama-enzyme akhethekile adlala indima ebalulekile ekugayeni ama-carbohydrate, amaprotheni, kanye nama-lipid. (Akudingeki wazi amagama ama-enzyme athile ahilelekile ekugayeni kwamakhemikhali.) Ngenkathi ukumuncwa okuningi kwezakhamzimba kwenzeka emathunjini amancane, amanzi asele, amavithamini athile, nanoma yimaphi ama-salts asele agwinywa emathunjini amakhulu. Ukususwa kuchaza ukususwa kokudla okungagaywanga.

 Ukuthola ukudla okunomsoco namandla ekudleni kuyinqubo enezinyathelo eziningi. Ezilwaneni zangempela, isinyathelo sokuqala ukugaya, isenzo sokudla. Lokhu kulandelwa ukugaya, ukumunca, kanye nokukhipha. Ezigabeni ezilandelayo, ngasinye salezi zinyathelo sizoxoxwa ngokuningiliziwe.

chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 25. Ukudla Okunomsoco Kwezilwane Nohlelo Lokugaya | 25.3 Izinqubo Zesistimu Yokugaya | Ukugaya
chapterContent: Ama-molecule amakhulu atholakala ekudleni okuphelele awakwazi ukudlula emangqamuzaneni eseli. Ukudla kudinga ukuhlukaniswa kube yizinhlayiya ezincane ukuze izilwane zikwazi ukusebenzisa izakhamzimba nama-molecule ezinto eziphilayo. Isinyathelo sokuqala kule nqubo ukugwinya. Ukugwinya inqubo yokumunca ukudla ngomlomo. Ezilwaneni ezinezinhlungu, amazinyo, amathe, nolimi kudlala indima ebalulekile ekuhlafuneni (ukulungiselela ukudla kube yi-bolus). Ngesikhathi ukudla kuphulwa ngomshini, ama-enzyme asematheni nawo aqala ukucubungula ukudla ngamakhemikhali. Isenzo esihlangene salezi zinqubo siguqula ukudla kusuka ezinhlayiya ezinkulu kuya entweni ethambile engagwinywa futhi engahamba ubude bomhubhe.

distractor1a: Ngoba ukudla kumele kuqale kuguqulwe kube yi-ATP

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 25. Ukudla Okunomsoco Kwezilwane Nohlelo Lokugaya | 25.3 Izinqubo Zesistimu Yokugaya | Ukugaya Nokumunca
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 25. Ukudla Okunomsoco Kwezilwane Nohlelo Lokugaya | 25.3 Izinqubo Zesistimu Yokugaya | Ukugaya Nokumunca
chapterContent: Ukugaya ukudla kuwukuhlukaniswa kokudla ngendlela yokwenziwa kanye namakhemikhali kube yizicucu ezincane eziphilayo. Kubalulekile ukuhlukanisa ama-macromolecule abe yizicucu ezincane ezinobukhulu obufanele ukumuncwa kulo lonke i-epithelium yokugaya ukudla. Ama-molecule amakhulu, ayinkimbinkimbi amaprotheni, ama-polysaccharides, nama-lipid kumele ancishiswe abe yizicucu ezilula njengoshukela olula ngaphambi kokuba amuncwe amaseli e-epithelial yokugaya ukudla. Izitho ezahlukene zidlala indima ethile enqubweni yokugaya ukudla. Ukudla kwezilwane kudinga ama-carbohydrate, amaprotheni, namafutha, kanye namavithamini kanye nezingxenye ezingaphili ukuze kulinganiswe ukudla okunempilo. Indlela ngayinye yalezi zingxenye egaywa ngayo ixoxwa ngazo ezigabeni ezilandelayo.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 25. Ukudla Okunomsoco Kwezilwane Nohlelo Lokugaya | 25.3 Izinqubo Zesistimu Yokugaya | Ukugaya Nokumunca | Ama-carbohydrate
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 25. Ukudla Okunomsoco Kwezilwane Nohlelo Lokugaya | 25.3 Izinqubo Zesistimu Yokugaya | Ukugaya Nokumunca | Ama-carbohydrate
chapterContent:
Ukugaya ama-carbohydrate kuqala emlonyeni. I-enzyme yamathe i-amylase iqala ukuqhekeka kwama-starch okudla abe yi-maltose, i-disaccharide. Njengoba i-bolus yokudla ihamba nge-esophagus iye esiswini, akukho ukugaya okuphawulekayo kwama-carbohydrate okwenzekayo. I-esophagus ayikhiqizi ama-enzyme okugaya kodwa ikhiqiza i-mucous ukuze igcobe. Indawo ene-acid esiswini imisa ukusebenza kwe-enzyme ye-amylase.

 Isinyathelo esilandelayo sokugaya ama-carbohydrate senzeka e-duodenum. Khumbula ukuthi i-chyme evela esiswini ingena e-duodenum futhi ixubana nokukhishwa kokugaya okuvela ku-pancreas, isibindi, kanye ne-gallbladder. Amajusi e-pancreatic nawo aqukethe i-amylase, eqhubeka nokuqhekeka kwe-starch kanye ne-glycogen ibe yi-maltose, i-disaccharide. Ama-disaccharide aqhekeka abe yi-monosaccharide ngama-enzyme abizwa ngokuthi ama-maltases, ama-sucrases, nama-lactase, nawo akhona emngceleni webhulashi wodonga lwamathumbu amancane. I-Maltase ihlukanisa i-maltose ibe yi-glucose. Amanye ama-disaccharide, njenge-sucrose kanye ne-lactose aqhekeka yi-sucrase kanye ne-lactase, ngokulandelana. I-Sucrase iphula i-sucrose (noma ushukela etafuleni) ibe yi-glucose ne-fructose, kanti i-lactase iphula i-lactose (noma ushukela wobisi) ibe yi-glucose ne-galactose. Ama-monosaccharides (glucose) akhiqizwa ngaleyo ndlela ayamuncwa bese engasetshenziswa ezindleleni ze-metabolic ukuze kusetshenziswe amandla. Ama-monosaccharides athuthwa ngaphesheya kwe-epithelium yamathumbu aye egazini ukuze athuthwe emaseli ahlukene emzimbeni. Izinyathelo zokugaya ama-carbohydrate zifingqiwe kuMfanekiso 25.17 kanye nethebula elingezansi.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 25. Ukudla Okunomsoco Kwezilwane Nohlelo Lokugaya | 25.3 Izinqubo Zesistimu Yokugaya | Ukugaya Nokumunca | Amaprotheni
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 25. Ukudla Okunomsoco Kwezilwane Nohlelo Lokugaya | 25.3 Izinqubo Zesistimu Yokugaya | Ukugaya Nokumunca | Amaprotheni
chapterContent:
Ingxenye enkulu yokugaya amaprotheni yenzeka esiswini. I-enzyme i-pepsin idlala indima ebalulekile ekugayweni kwamaprotheni ngokuphula iphrotheni engaphelele ibe ama-peptide, angamaketanga amafushane ama-amino acid amane kuya kwayisishiyagalolunye. E-duodenum, amanye ama-enzyme—i-trypsin, i-elastase, ne-chymotrypsin—asebenza kuma-peptide awenza abe ama-peptide amancane. I-Trypsin, i-elastase, i-carboxypeptidase, ne-chymotrypsin akhiqizwa yi-pancreas futhi akhishwa aye e-duodenum lapho asebenza khona ku-chyme. Ukuqhekeka okwengeziwe kwama-peptide abe ama-amino acid angawodwa kusizwa ama-enzyme abizwa ngokuthi ama-peptidases (lawo aphula ama-peptide). Ngokukhethekile, i-carboxypeptidase, i-dipeptidase, ne-aminopeptidase zidlala indima ebalulekile ekunciphiseni ama-peptide abe ama-amino acid akhululekile. Ama-amino acid amuncwa egazini ngamathumbu amancane. Izinyathelo zokugaya amaprotheni zifingqiwe kuMfanekiso 25.18 kanye nethebula elingezansi.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 25. Ukudla Okunomsoco Kwezilwane Nohlelo Lokugaya | 25.3 Izinqubo Zesistimu Yokugaya | Ukugaya Nokumunca | Ama-Lipid
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 25. Ukudla Okunomsoco Kwezilwane Nohlelo Lokugaya | 25.3 Izinqubo Zesistimu Yokugaya | Ukugaya Nokumunca | Ama-Lipid
chapterContent:
Ukugaya kwamafutha kuqala esiswini ngosizo lwe-lingual lipase kanye ne-gastric lipase. Kodwa-ke, ingxenye enkulu yokugaya kwamafutha kwenzeka emathunjini amancane ngenxa ye-pancreatic lipase. Lapho i-chyme ingena kwi-duodenum, izimpendulo zamahomoni ziqala ukukhishwa kwe-bile, ekhiqizwa esibindini futhi igcinwe enyongweni. I-Bile iyasiza ekugayweni kwamafutha, ikakhulukazi ama-triglycerides nge-emulsification. I-Emulsification inqubo lapho ama-lipid globules amakhulu ehlukaniswa khona abe ama-lipid globules amaningana amancane. Lawa ma-globules amancane asatshalaliswa kakhulu ku-chyme kunokuba akhe ama-aggregates amakhulu. Ama-lipids ayizinto ezithinta amanzi: lapho ekhona emanzini, azohlangana ukuze akhe ama-globules ukuze anciphise ukuvezwa emanzini. I-Bile iqukethe usawoti we-bile, okuyi-amphipathic, okusho ukuthi aqukethe izingxenye ezithinta amanzi ne-hydrophilic. Ngakho-ke, uhlangothi oluthinta amanzi ne-bile lungakwazi ukuhlangana namanzi kolunye uhlangothi kanti uhlangothi oluthinta amanzi ne-hydrophobic luhlangana nama-lipid kolunye. Ngokwenza kanjalo, usawoti we-bile uhlanganisa ama-lipid globules amakhulu abe ama-lipid globules amancane.

 Kungani i-emulsification ibalulekile ekugayweni kwama-lipid? Amajusi e-pancreatic aqukethe ama-enzyme abizwa ngokuthi ama-lipase (ama-enzyme aphula ama-lipid). Uma i-lipid ku-chyme ihlangana ibe ama-globule amakhulu, indawo encane kakhulu yama-lipids etholakalayo ukuze ama-lipase asebenze kuyo, okushiya ukugaya kwama-lipid kungaphelele. Ngokwakha i-emulsion, usawoti we-bile wandisa indawo etholakala yama-lipids kaningi. Ama-lipase e-pancreatic angabe esesebenza kuma-lipids ngempumelelo futhi awagaye, njengoba kuchazwe kuMfanekiso 25.19. Ama-lipase aphula ama-lipid abe ama-fatty acid nama-glycerides. Lawa ma-molecule angadlula ku-plasma membrane yeseli futhi angene kumaseli e-epithelial olwelwesini lwamathumbu. Usawoti we-bile uzungeze ama-fatty acid amade kanye nama-monoglycerides akha ama-sphere amancane abizwa ngokuthi ama-micelles. Ama-micelles angena emngceleni webhulashi wamaseli amancane ancela amathumbu lapho ama-fatty acids ama-long-chain kanye nama-monoglycerides esakazeka khona ephuma kuma-micelles aye kumaseli ancela ashiya ama-micelles ngemuva ku-chyme. Ama-fatty acids ama-long-chain kanye nama-monoglycerides ahlangana kabusha kumaseli ancela ukuze akhe ama-triglycerides, ahlangana abe ama-globules futhi ambozwe ngamaprotheni. Lawa ma-sphere amakhulu abizwa ngokuthi ama-chylomicrons. Ama-Chylomicrons aqukethe ama-triglycerides, i-cholesterol, namanye ama-lipid futhi anamaprotheni ebusweni bawo. Ubuso bakhiwe futhi ngamakhanda e-phosphate e-hydrophilic ama-phospholipids. Ndawonye, avumela i-chylomicron ukuthi ihambe endaweni enamanzi ngaphandle kokudalula ama-lipids emanzini. Ama-Chylomicrons ashiya amaseli ancela nge-exocytosis. Ama-Chylomicrons angena emithanjeni ye-lymphatic, bese engena egazini emthanjeni we-subclavian.

chapterContent: Amavithamini angancibilika emanzini noma ancibilike kuma-lipid. Amavithamini ancibilika emafutheni amuncwa ngendlela efanayo nama-lipid. Kubalulekile ukudla inani elithile lama-lipid ekudleni ukuze kusizwe ukumuncwa kwamavithamini ancibilika kuma-lipid. Amavithamini ancibilika emanzini angamuncwa ngqo egazini esuka emathunjini.

chapterContent:
Isinyathelo sokugcina sokugaya ukudla ukususa okuqukethwe kokudla okungagayiwe kanye nemikhiqizo elahliwe. Ukudla okungagayiwe kungena emathunjini, lapho amanzi amaningi ephinde amuncwa khona. Khumbula ukuthi ikholoni liyikhaya le-microflora ebizwa ngokuthi i-intestinal flora” esiza enqubweni yokugaya ukudla. Imfucuza eqinile ihanjiswa ngekholoni ngokuhamba kwemisipha futhi igcinwa e-rectum. Njengoba i-rectum ikhula ngenxa yokugcina indle, ibangela izimpawu ze-neural ezidingekayo ukuze kusungulwe isifiso sokususa. Imfucuza eqinile ikhishwa nge-anus kusetshenziswa ukunyakaza kwe-peristaltic kwe-rectum.

 Izinkinga Ezivamile Zokuqedwa
Isifo sohudo kanye nokuqunjelwa kungenye yezinkinga ezivame kakhulu zempilo ezithinta ukugaya ukudla. Ukuqunjelwa yisimo lapho indle iqina khona ngenxa yokususwa kwamanzi amaningi ekholoni. Ngokuphambene nalokho, uma amanzi anele engasuswa endle, kuholela ekucutshungulweni. Amabhaktheriya amaningi, kufaka phakathi lawo abangela ikholera, athinta amaprotheni ahilelekile ekumuncweni kwamanzi ekholoni futhi abangele uhudo oluningi.

 Ukuqunjelwa
Ukuqunjelwa, noma ukuhlanza, ukukhipha ukudla ngokuxosha ngomlomo. Ngokuvamile kuba ngenxa ye- okucasulayo okuthinta umgudu wokugaya ukudla, okuhlanganisa kodwa kungagcini nje ngamagciwane, amabhaktheriya, imizwa, ukubona, kanye nobuthi bokudla. Lokhu kukhishwa kokudla ngamandla kungenxa yokufinyela okunamandla okubangelwa yimisipha yesisu. Inqubo yokuphuma kwegazi ilawulwa yi-medulla

Imisebenzi yesistimu yokugaya ukudla ilawulwa ngezimpendulo zemizwa nama-hormone. Esahlukweni esixoxa ngesistimu ye-endocrine, sihlola ngokuningiliziwe indima yesistimu ye-endocrine ekugcineni i-homeostasis, okuhlanganisa nokusebenza okuvamile kwesistimu yokugaya ukudla.

 Ubuchopho buyisikhungo sokulawula umuzwa wendlala nokusutha. Imisebenzi yesistimu yokugaya ukudla ilawulwa ngezimpendulo zemizwa nama-hormone.

chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 25. Ukudla Okunomsoco Kwezilwane Nohlelo Lokugaya | 25.4 Ukulawulwa Kwesistimu Yokugaya | Izimpendulo Zezinzwa Ekudleni
chapterContent: Ekuphenduleni iphunga, ukubona, noma ukucabanga ngokudla, njengalokho okuboniswe kuMfanekiso 25.21, impendulo yokuqala iwukuqunjelwa amathe. Izindlala zamathe zikhipha amathe amaningi ngenxa yokukhuthazwa uhlelo lwezinzwa oluzimele olubangelwa ukudla okulungiselela ukugaya. Ngesikhathi esifanayo, isisu siqala ukukhiqiza i-hydrochloric acid ukuze kugaywe ukudla. Khumbula ukuthi ukunyakaza kwe-peristaltic kwe-esophagus nezinye izitho zomgudu wokugaya ukudla kungaphansi kokulawulwa kobuchopho. Ubuchopho bulungiselela le misipha ukuze ihambe futhi. Lapho isisu sigcwele, ingxenye yobuchopho ethola ukusutha ikhombisa ukugcwala. Kunezigaba ezintathu ezihambisanayo zokulawulwa kwesisu—isigaba se-cephalic, isigaba sesisu, kanye nesigaba samathumbu—ngasinye sidinga ama-enzyme amaningi futhi singaphansi kokulawulwa kwemizwa.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 25. Ukudla Okunomsoco Kwezilwane Nohlelo Lokugaya | 25.4 Ukulawulwa Kwesistimu Yokugaya | Izimpendulo Zezinzwa Ekudleni | Izigaba Zokugaya
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 25. Ukudla Okunomsoco Kwezilwane Nohlelo Lokugaya | 25.4 Ukulawulwa Kwesistimu Yokugaya | Izimpendulo Zezinzwa Ekudleni | Izigaba Zokugaya
chapterContent:
Impendulo ekudleni iqala ngisho nangaphambi kokuba ukudla kungene emlonyeni. Isigaba sokuqala sokugwinya, esibizwa ngokuthi isigaba se-cephalic, silawulwa impendulo ye-neural ku-stimulus enikezwa ukudla. Zonke izici—njengokubona, ukucabanga, nokuhogela—zibangela impendulo ye-neural eholela ekukhishweni kwamathe kanye nokukhiqizwa kwamajusi esiswini. Ukukhiqizwa kwesisu kanye namathe esigabeni se-cephalic nakho kungenzeka ngenxa yokucabanga ngokudla. Njengamanje, uma ucabanga ngengxenye kashokoledi noma i-chip yamazambane acwebezelayo, ukwanda kwamathe kuyimpendulo yesigaba se-cephalic ku-cabango. Uhlelo lwezinzwa oluphakathi lulungiselela isisu ukwamukela ukudla.

 Isigaba sesisu siqala uma ukudla kufika esiswini. Sakhela ekukhuthazweni okunikezwa ngesikhathi sesigaba se-cephalic. Ama-asidi esisu kanye nama-enzyme acubungula izinto ezidliwe. Isigaba sesisu sikhuthazwa (1) ukusabalala kwesisu, (2) ukwanda kwe-pH kokuqukethwe kwesisu, kanye (3) nokuba khona kwezinto ezingagaywanga. Lesi sigaba siqukethe izimpendulo zendawo, zamahomoni, kanye neze-neural. Lezi zimpendulo zivuselela ukukhishwa kanye nokufinyela okunamandla.

 Isigaba samathumbu siqala lapho i-chyme ingena emathunjini amancane ibangela ukukhishwa kokugaya ukudla. Lesi sigaba silawula izinga lokukhishwa kwesisu. Ngaphezu kokukhishwa kwesisu, lapho i-chyme ingena emathunjini amancane, ibangela ezinye izehlakalo zamahomoni nezezinzwa ezihlanganisa imisebenzi yomgudu wamathumbu, i-pancreas, isibindi, kanye ne-gallbladder.

answer10: Umgudu wamathumbu, ama-pancreas, isibindi kanye ne-gallbladder

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 25. Ukudla Okunomsoco Kwezilwane Nohlelo Lokugaya | 25.4 Ukulawulwa Kwesistimu Yokugaya | Izimpendulo Zama-hormone Ekudleni
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 25. Ukudla Okunomsoco Kwezilwane Nohlelo Lokugaya | 25.4 Ukulawulwa Kwesistimu Yokugaya | Izimpendulo Zama-hormone Ekudleni
chapterContent:
Uhlelo lwe-endocrine lulawula impendulo yezindlala ezahlukahlukene emzimbeni kanye nokukhishwa kwama-hormone ngezikhathi ezifanele.

 Esinye sezici ezibalulekile ngaphansi kokulawulwa kwama-hormone yindawo ene-asidi esiswini. Ngesikhathi sesigaba sesisu, i-hormone i-gastrin ikhishwa amaseli e-G esiswini ngenxa yokuba khona kwamaprotheni. I-Gastrin ivuselela ukukhishwa kwe-asidi esiswini, noma i-hydrochloric acid (HCl) esiza ekugayweni kwamaprotheni. Kodwa-ke, lapho isisu singenamuntu, indawo ene-asidi akudingeki igcinwe futhi i-hormone ebizwa ngokuthi i-somatostatin ivimba ukukhishwa kwe-hydrochloric acid. Lokhu kulawulwa yindlela yokuphendula engemihle.

 E-duodenum, ukukhishwa kokugaya okuvela esibindini, kuma-pancreas, kanye ne-gallbladder kudlala indima ebalulekile ekugayweni kwe-chyme ngesikhathi sesigaba samathumbu. Ukuze kuncishiswe i-acidic chyme, i-hormone ebizwa ngokuthi i-secretin ivuselela ama-pancreas ukuthi akhiqize isisombululo se-alkaline bicarbonate futhi asiyise e-duodenum. I-Secretin isebenza ngokubambisana nenye i-hormone ebizwa ngokuthi i-cholecystokinin (CCK). I-CCK ayigcini nje ngokukhuthaza ama-pancreas ukuthi akhiqize ujusi we-pancreatic odingekayo, kodwa futhi ikhuthaza i-gallbladder ukuthi ikhiphe i-bile iye e-duodenum.

 Elinye izinga lokulawula ama-hormone lenzeka ngenxa yokwakheka kokudla. Ukudla okunama-lipid amaningi kuthatha isikhathi eside ukugaya. I-hormone ebizwa ngokuthi i-gastric inhibitory peptide ikhishwa yi-small intestine ukuze inciphise ukunyakaza kwe-peristaltic yamathumbu ukuze ivumele ukudla okunamafutha isikhathi esiningi sokugaya nokumuncwa.

 Ukuqonda ukulawula ama-hormone ohlelweni lokugaya ukudla kuyindawo ebalulekile yocwaningo oluqhubekayo. Ososayensi bahlola indima ye-hormone ngayinye enqubweni yokugaya ukudla futhi bathuthukisa izindlela zokuqondisa la ma-hormone.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 25. Ukudla Okunomsoco Kwezilwane Nohlelo Lokugaya | 25.6 Isifinyezo Sesahluko
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 25. Ukudla Okunomsoco Kwezilwane Nohlelo Lokugaya | 25.6 Isifinyezo Sesahluko
chapterContent:
25.1 Izinhlelo Zokugaya
Izilwane ezahlukene ziye zathuthukisa izinhlobo ezahlukene zezinhlelo zokugaya ukudla ezikhethekile ukuze zihlangabezane nezidingo zazo zokudla. Abantu nezinye izilwane eziningi banezinhlelo zokugaya ukudla ezi-single gastric ezinesisu esinegumbi elilodwa. Izinyoni ziye zathuthukisa uhlelo lokugaya ukudla oluhlanganisa i-gizzard lapho ukudla kuchotshozwa khona kube yizicucu ezincane. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukungakwazi kwazo ukuhlafuna. Izilwane ezidla inani elikhulu lezinto zezitshalo zinesisu esinegumbi eliningi esigaya ukudla okungcolile. Izilwane ezi-pseudo-rumenti zinezinqubo zokugaya ukudla ezifanayo njengezilwane ezidla ukudla okungcolile kodwa azinaso isisu esinegumbi elinezicucu ezine. Ukucubungula ukudla kuhilela ukungenisa (ukudla), ukugaya (ukuwohloka komshini kanye ne-enzyme yama-molecule amakhulu), ukumuncwa (ukuthathwa kwezakhamzimba ngamaseli), kanye nokususa (ukususwa kwendle engagaywanga njengendle).

 Izitho eziningi zomzimba zisebenza ndawonye ukugaya ukudla futhi zimunce izakhamzimba. Umlomo uyindawo yokumuncwa kanye nendawo lapho kokubili ukuwohloka kokudla okwenziwa ngomshini kanye namakhemikhali kuqala khona. Amathe aqukethe i-enzyme ebizwa ngokuthi i-amylase ephula ama-carbohydrate. I-bolus yokudla ihamba nge-esophagus ngokuhamba kwe-peristaltic iye esiswini. Isisu sinendawo ene-acid kakhulu. I-enzyme ebizwa ngokuthi i-pepsin igaya amaprotheni esiswini. Ukugaya okwengeziwe kanye nokumuncwa kwenzeka emathunjini amancane. Amathumbu amakhulu aphinde amunce amanzi ekudleni okungagayiwe futhi agcine imfucuza kuze kube yilapho isuswa.

 25.2 Ukudla Okunomsoco Nokukhiqizwa Kwamandla
Ukudla kwezilwane kufanele kube okulinganiselayo futhi kuhlangabezane nezidingo zomzimba. Ama-carbohydrate, amaprotheni, namafutha yizona zinto eziyinhloko zokudla. Ezinye izakhamzimba ezibalulekile ziyadingeka ekusebenzeni kwamaseli kodwa azikwazi ukukhiqizwa umzimba wesilwane. Lokhu kufaka phakathi amavithamini, amaminerali, amanye ama-fatty acid, kanye namanye ama-amino acid. Ukudla okungaphezu kwalokho okudingekayo kugcinwa njenge-glycogen emaseli esibindi kanye nemisipha, kanye nasemaseli amafutha. Ukugcinwa kwamafutha ngokweqile kungaholela ekukhuluphaleni kanye nezinkinga ezinkulu zempilo. I-ATP iyimali yamandla yeseli futhi itholakala ezindleleni ze-metabolic. Ama-carbohydrate amaningi kanye namandla agcinwa njenge-glycogen emzimbeni.

 25.3 Izinqubo Zesistimu Yokugaya
Ukugaya kuqala ngokudla, lapho ukudla kuthathwa khona emlonyeni. Ukugaya nokumunca kwenzeka ngochungechunge lwezinyathelo ngama-enzyme akhethekile adlala indima ebalulekile ekugayeni ama-carbohydrate, amaprotheni, kanye nama-lipid. Ukususwa kuchaza ukususwa kokuqukethwe kokudla okungagayiwe kanye nemikhiqizo engcolile emzimbeni. Ngenkathi ukumunca okuningi kwenzeka emathunjini amancane, ithumbu elikhulu linesibopho sokususwa kokugcina kwamanzi asala ngemva kwenqubo yokumunca yamathumbu amancane. Amaseli azungeze ithumbu elikhulu amunca amavithamini athile kanye nanoma yimaphi usawoti namanzi asele. Ithumbu elikhulu (ikholoni) yilapho kwakheka khona indle.

 25.4 Ukulawulwa Kwesistimu Yokugaya
Ubuchopho kanye nesistimu ye-endocrine zilawula izinqubo zokugaya. Ubuchopho bulawula izimpendulo zendlala nokusutha. Uhlelo lwe-endocrine lulawula ukukhishwa kwama-hormone nama-enzyme adingekayo ekugayeni ukudla endleleni yokugaya ukudla

distractor47b: Ukudla okunomsoco kuvumela amandla amaningi ukuthi agcinwe emzimbeni, ngaleyo ndlela kwandisa izinga lokusabela kwe-metabolic
distractor47c: Ukudla okunomsoco kunikeza izakhamzimba ezidingekayo ukuze kugcinwe ukusebenza kahle komzimba, kanye namavithamini namaminerali ukuze kugcinwe impilo enhle futhi kwandiswe amandla okuzala.
question48: Bheka uMfanekiso 25.23. Le grafu ikhombisa ubudlelwano phakathi kokwenzeka kwe-goiter (isifo) kanye nokugcwala kwe-iodine emanzini okuphuza kubantu. Yisiphi isimangalo esingabhalwa ngokusekelwe kugrafu?
question49:
A. Kungani kubalulekile ukudla izakhamzimba ezibalulekile?
b. Yiziphi izibonelo ezimbili zamavithamini abalulekile ancibilika emafutheni, futhi iyini imisebenzi yawo emzimbeni womuntu?
answer49:
A. Izakhamzimba ezibalulekile azikhiqizwa umzimba kodwa ziyadingeka ekusebenzeni kahle komzimba.
b. Amavithamini A no-K angamavithamini amabili abalulekile ancibilika emafutheni. I-Vitamin A isiza ukugcina amehlo ebona, kanti i-vitamin K ibalulekile ekuqineni kwegazi
distractor49a:
A. Izakhamzimba ezibalulekile azikhiqizwa umzimba futhi azidingeki ukuze umzimba usebenze kahle.
b. Amavithamini B no-C angamavithamini amabili abalulekile ancibilika emafutheni. I-Vitamin B isiza ukugcina amehlo ebona, kanti i-vitamin C ibalulekile ekuqineni kwegazi
distractor49b:
A. Izakhamzimba ezibalulekile azikhiqizwa umzimba kodwa ziyadingeka ekusebenzeni kahle komzimba.
b. Amavithamini A no-K angamavithamini amabili abalulekile ancibilika emafutheni. I-Vitamin A isiza ekugcineni izicubu ezixhumene, kanti i-vitamin K ibalulekile ekuqineni kwegazi
distractor49c:
A. Izakhamzimba ezibalulekile zakhiwa umzimba futhi ziyadingeka ekusebenzeni kahle komzimba.
b. Amavithamini D no-K angamavithamini amabili abalulekile ancibilika emafutheni. I-Vitamin D isiza ekugcineni isimiso sezinzwa esizinzile, kanti i-vitamin K ibalulekile ekuqineni kwegazi
question50: Kwenzekani ku-glycogen lapho ushukela wegazi wehla?
answer50: Ikhishwa esibindini bese iguqulwa ibe ushukela ukuze kwandiswe amazinga kashukela egazini
distractor50a: Ikhuthaza ukukhishwa kwe-insulin, okungalawula amazinga kashukela egazini
distractor50b: Iguqulwa ibe yisitashi, esiphukayo ukuze sakhe i-glucose futhi sandise amazinga kashukela egazini
distractor50c: Ikhishwa esibindini bese iguqulwa ibe yi-pyruvate, engabe isidala i-glucose ukuze kwandiswe amazinga kashukela egazini.
question51: Iyini ukubaluleka kokuziphendukela kwemvelo kokukhiqizwa kwe-glycogen?
answer51: I-ATP kanye ne-glucose eningi kakhulu kukhiqiza i-glycogen, engasetshenziswa kamuva ukukhiqiza amandla uma, isibonelo, ukudla kuyindlala
distractor51a: I-ATP kanye ne-glucose eningi kakhulu kukhiqiza i-glycogen, engasetshenziswa kamuva ukuze isebenze njenge-co-factor uma, isibonelo, umthombo omuhle untuleka.
distractor51b: Amaprotheni amaningi kanye ne-glucose kukhiqiza i-glycogen, engasetshenziswa kamuva ukukhiqiza amandla uma, isibonelo, ukudla kuyindlala
distractor51c: Amaprotheni namafutha amaningi akhiqiza i-glycogen, engasetshenziswa kamuva ukuze isebenze njengomthombo we-nitrogen uma, isibonelo, umthombo omuhle untuleka.
question52: Ukudla isinkwa esiningi kakhulu ne-pasta kungakukhuthaza kanjani ukukhuluphala ngokweqile?
answer52: Ushukela omningi egazini ukhulisa inani le-pyruvate, eliguqulwa libe ama-fatty acid. Ama-fatty acid agcinwa kumaseli amafutha, okwandisa inani lamafutha emzimbeni.
distractor52a: Ushukela wegazi oweqile wandisa inani le-urea, eliguqulwa libe ama-fatty acid. Ama-fatty acid agcinwa kumaseli e-areolar, andisa inani lamafutha emzimbeni.
distractor52b: Isinkwa ne-pasta kucebile ngamafutha. Ukugaya kwazo kukhiqiza ama-fatty acid kanye ne-glycerol. Ama-fatty acid agcinwa kumaseli amafutha, okwandisa inani lamafutha emzimbeni.
distractor52c: Isinkwa ne-pasta kucebile ngamafutha. Ukugaya kwazo kukhiqiza ama-fatty acid kanye ne-glycerol. Ama-fatty acid agcinwa kuma-areolar cells, okwandisa inani lamafutha emzimbeni.
answer53: Ukugaya kuyinqubo yokungenisa ukudla ngomlomo, lapho ukugaya okwenziwa ngomshini nangamakhemikhali kuqala khona ukuhlukanisa ukudla kube ama-molecule amancane angamuncwa futhi asetshenziswe ngumzimba.
distractor53a: Ukugaya ukudla kuwukungenisa ukudla ngomlomo, lapho kuqala khona ukugaya ngomshini. Ukugaya ngamakhemikhali kuqala esiswini, lapho ukudla kuhlukaniswa khona kube ama-molecule amancane angamuncwa futhi asetshenziswe ngumzimba.
distractor53b: Ukugaya ukudla kuwukungenisa ukudla ngomlomo, lapho kuqala khona ukugaya okwenziwe ngomshini nangamakhemikhali. Ukugaya esiswini kuphula amaprotheni namafutha akhona ekudleni abe ama-molecule amancane angamuncwa futhi asetshenziswe ngumzimba.
distractor53c: Ukugaya ukudla kungukudluliselwa kokudla kusuka emlonyeni kuya emqaleni, lapho ukugaya okwenziwa ngomshini nangamakhemikhali kuqala khona ukuhlukanisa ukudla kube ama-molecule amancane angamuncwa futhi asetshenziswe ngumzimba.
question54: Kungani amanye amafutha ekudleni eyingxenye ebalulekile yokudla okulinganiselayo?
answer54: Ama-lipid ekudleni asiza ekumuncweni kwamavithamini ancibilika emafutheni, okuhlanganisa u-A, D, E, no-K, adingekayo emisebenzini eyahlukahlukene yomzimba.
distractor54a: Ama-lipid ekudleni asiza ekumuncweni kwamavithamini ancibilika emanzini, okuhlanganisa u-B no-C, adingekayo emisebenzini eyahlukahlukene yomzimba.
distractor54b: Ama-lipids ekudleni asiza ekumuncweni kwamaminerali athile, okuhlanganisa i-folic acid, i-iron, ne-magnesium, adingekayo emisebenzini eyahlukahlukene yomzimba.
distractor54c: Ama-lipid ekudleni asiza ekumuncweni kwamavithamini, okuhlanganisa u-A, B, C, D, E, no-K, adingekayo emisebenzini eyahlukahlukene yomzimba.
question55: Bheka uMfanekiso 25.24. Le grafu ikhombisa inani lamabhaktheriya ezingxenyeni ezahlukene zesimiso sokugaya ukudla komuntu. Umugqa ngamunye ukhombisa uhlobo oluhlukile lwamabhaktheriya. Yisiphi isitatimende esinembile?
distractor55c: I-Escherichia coli (E. coli) itholakala kakhulu kumathumbu amakhulu kanye ne-rectum
question56:
A. Ayini ama-micelles?
b. Kungani ama-micelles ebalulekile ekumuncweni kwamafutha?
answer56:
A. Ama-Micelles angama-fatty acids nama-monoglycerides azungezwe usawoti we-bile.
b. Ama-Micelles enza kube lula ukumuncwa yi-microvilli, lapho ama-fatty acids nama-monoglycerides esakazeka khona ukuze akhe ama-triglycerides
distractor56a:
A. Ama-Micelles angama-lipoprotein aklanyelwe ukuthutha ama-lipid angena kuma-lacteals.
b. Ama-Micelles enza kube lula ukumuncwa yi-microvilli, lapho ama-fatty acid namaprotheni esakazeka khona ukuze akhe ama-lipoprotein
distractor56b:
A. Ama-Micelles angama-lipoprotein aklanyelwe ukuthutha ama-lipid angena kuma-lacteals.
b. Ama-Micelles enza kube lula ukumuncwa yi-microvilli, lapho ama-fatty acid nama-monoglycerides esakazeka khona ukuze akhe ama-triglycerides.
distractor56c:
A. Ama-Micelles angama-fatty acids nama-phospholipid azungezwe usawoti we-bile.
b. Ama-Micelles enza kube lula ukumuncwa yi-microvilli, lapho ama-fatty acids nama-monoglycerides esakazeka khona ukuze akhe ama-triglycerides.
question57: Ezingeni lamaseli, kungani ukudla kufanele kuhlukaniswe?
answer57: Ama-molecule amakhulu akhona ekudleni okuphelele awakwazi ukudlula emangqamuzaneni eseli. Izakhamzimba kudingeka zidlule epithelium yokugaya ukudla ukuze zisetshenziswe
distractor57a: Ama-molecule amakhulu akhona ekudleni okuphelele adlula epithelium yokugaya ukudla bese engena esitokisini ngolwelwesi, ngaleyo ndlela alimaze ulwelwesi lwenuzi. Ngakho-ke kumele luhlukaniswe.
distractor57b: Amafutha akhona ekudleni okuphelele aqukethe ama-molecule amakhulu kakhulu, angenakudlula emangqamuzaneni eseli. Amafutha kudingeka adlule epithelium yokugaya ukudla ukuze asetshenziswe.
distractor57c: Ama-molecule amakhulu, uma engaqhekekile, akhiqiza izinto ezinobuthi ezidlula epithelium yomgudu wokugaya ukudla futhi zisetshenziswe amaseli. Lokhu kungaba yingozi kuseli
question58: Bheka uMfanekiso 25.25. Ithebula libonisa imiphumela yocwaningo lapho abantu baboniswa khona ukudla okuhlukene futhi kwalinganiswa ukukhiqizwa kwamathe abo. Yisiphi isimangalo esingasibhala kusukela kulolu lwazi?
answer58: Ukubona ukudla kudala ukukhiqizwa kwamathe. Uhlobo lokudla alunawo umehluko omkhulu ekutheni kukhiqizwa amathe amangaki.
distractor58a: Ukubona ukudla kudala ukukhiqizwa kwamathe. Uhlobo lokudla luthinta kakhulu ukuthi kukhiqizwa amathe amangaki.
distractor58b: Abantu bahlala bekhipha amathe. Ukukhiqizwa kwamathe akukhuphuki ngokuphawulekayo uma sibona ukudla
distractor58c: Abantu bahlala bekhipha amathe. Ukukhiqizwa kwamathe kuyanda uma abantu beqala ukudla, hhayi ngaphambi kokuba
answer59: Ama-hormone alawula izici zokugaya ukudla njengokuthi yikuphi ukukhishwa kokugaya ukudla okukhishwayo kanye nokuthi kukhishwa nini
distractor59a: Ama-hormone alawula izici zokugaya ukudla njengokwandisa ukunyakaza kwe-peristaltic ku-esophagus lapho ukudla kuzwakala
distractor59b: Ama-hormone alawula ukugaya ukudla ngokubonisa ukuthi isisu sigcwele noma singenalutho ukuze umuntu adle ukudla noma ayeke ukudla
distractor59c: Ama-hormone afana ne-gastrin, i-secretin, ne-adrenocorticotropic akhishwa ku-pituitary ukuze alawule ukuthi yikuphi ukukhishwa kokugaya ukudla okukhishwayo
question60: Uma udla ukudla, wazi kanjani ukuthi usuthi?
answer60: Ubuchopho butshela ukuthi usuthisile uma isisu sakho sigcwele, okubangela ukuthi ulambe kakhulu.
distractor60a: Indlala ye-pituitary ikhipha ama-hormone uma isisu sigcwele, okwenza kunciphisa indlala
distractor60b: Isisu sibonisa ukuthi sigcwele, okwenza kunciphisa indlala
distractor60c: Amazinga kashukela aphansi egazini avuselela i-neurotransmitter, ethumela isignali ebuchosheni lapho isisu sigcwele futhi ngaleyo ndlela inciphise indlala
question61: Bheka uMfanekiso 25.26. Amaseli e-epithelial e-cuboidal alula agudla imisele yezindlala ezithile ze-exocrine zabantu. Izinto ezahlukahlukene zithuthwa zingene noma ziphume emangqamuzaneni ngokusabalala. Ifomula yendawo engaphezulu kwe-cube ingu-6 × S × S, kanti ifomula yevolumu ye-cube ingu-S × S × S, lapho u-S = ubude bohlangothi lwe-cube. Izakhiwo ezinesilinganiso esiphezulu sendawo kuya ku-volume zingcono ekwenzeni kube lula ukusabalala. Ngokusekelwe kulokhu, yiliphi kula maseli alandelayo anomumo we-cube elingaba ngcono kakhulu ekususeni imfucuza ngokusabalala?
question62: Isifo se-Celiac siyingozi kubantu abathintekile, ngoba ukudla i-gluten kulimaza i-villi yamathumbu amancane. Yisiphi inketho esiyisitatimende esichaza ukuthi kungani isifo se-celiac singaba yingozi empilweni?
answer62: Ama-Villi andisa indawo engaphezulu etholakalayo yokumuncwa kwezakhamzimba. Uma ama-villi onakele, izakhamzimba azikwazi ukungena kahle egazini
distractor62a: I-villi iyasiza ekugayweni kwezicubu zokudla ngomshini. Uma zonakele, izakhamzimba azikwazi ukugaywa kahle emzimbeni.
distractor62b: Ama-Villi andisa indawo engaphezulu yamathumbu amancane, okusiza ekumuncweni kosawoti we-bile. Lesi sakhi asikwazi ukumuncwa uma sonakele.
distractor62c: Ama-Villi anciphisa indawo engaphezulu yamathumbu amancane etholakalayo ukuze amuncwe. Izakhamzimba azikwazi ukungena kahle egazini uma zonakele
question63: Esinye sezici ezibalulekile ze-villi kanye ne-microvilli ohlelweni lokugaya ukudla ukuma kwazo okufana nomunwe. Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okuyisibonelo sendlela ukuma kwe-microvilli okungathuthukisa ngayo ukumuncwa kwezakhamzimba?
answer63: Ama-microvil amakhulu anendawo engaphezulu lapho kudonswa khona izakhamzimba eziningi
distractor63a: Izakhamzimba zingangena egazini ngemithambo yegazi etholakala phakathi kwe-microvilli
distractor63b: Ama-microvilli projection asiza ekugayweni kwezicubu zokudla ngomshini
distractor63c: Izinhlayiya ezifana neminwe zivimbela izinhlayiya ezinkulu zokudla ukuthi zingadluli ohlelweni lokugaya ukudla
question64: Bheka uMfanekiso 25.27. Lesi sithombe sibonisa ingxenye esuka emathunjini amancane. Izakhiwo eziqondile, ezihlanganisiwe ziyi-microvilli, ezimunca izakhamzimba. I-microvilli ngayinye inobude obungu-1 μm nobubanzi obungu-0.1 μm. Ngokusekelwe kulesi sithombe, iyiphi inzuzo enikezwa yi-microvilli entweni ephilayo?
answer64: Ama-Microvilli anesilinganiso esikhulu sendawo ebusweni kuya kumthamo. Lokhu kuwavumela ukuthi ahlangane nezakhamzimba kalula
distractor64a: Ama-Microvilli anesilinganiso esincane sendawo ebusweni kuya kumthamo. Lokhu kuneziningi zazo ezibekwe ngevolumu efanayo
distractor64b: Ama-Microvilli akhipha ama-enzyme abamba izinhlayiya zokudla njengoba zidlula phezu kwazo. Lawa ma-enzyme abangela amazinga aphezulu okumuncwa kokudla.
distractor64c: Ama-microvilli afudumele kunawo wonke umzimba. Lo mehluko wokushisa ubangela ukuthi ama-microvilli amunce izakhamzimba ngokushesha
question65: Izinyoni zinomehluko ohlukile ngokomzimba kwezinye izilwane ezinomgogodla, futhi eziningana ziphathelene nendlela izinyoni ezicubungula ngayo ukudla. Umehluko othile usobala, njengokuba khona komlomo nokungabi namazinyo, kanti omunye umehluko ungabonakala ezicini zazo zangaphakathi. Isibonelo, izinyoni zinesimiso sokugaya esisodwa esiswini njengezinye izilwane ezinomgogodla eziningi, kodwa isakhiwo sesistimu yazo yokugaya ukudla sihlukile kwesezinye izilwane ezinomgogodla esisodwa esiswini. Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okuyiqiniso ngendlela izinyoni ezicubungula ngayo ukudla?
answer65: Inginda yindawo eyinhloko yokugaya ukudla ngomshini
distractor65a: Ukuvela komlomo kuhambisana nokufakwa kwezinambuzane ekudleni kwezinyoni
distractor65b: Izinyoni zikhipha imfucuza ene-nitrogen kanye nendle ngezikhala ezihlukene
distractor65c: Izinyoni zigaya izitshalo kancane kancane kunezithombo zezilwane ezidla inyama
question66: Bheka uMfanekiso 25.28. Njengoba kuboniswe kulesi sithombe, umgodi womlomo unezingxenye eziningana ezifaka isandla ekugwinyeni kanye nezigaba zokuqala zokugaya ukudla. Izingxenye zomgodi womlomo zisebenza kanjani ndawonye ukuze kuqedwe isinyathelo sokuqala sokucubungula ukudla?
answer66: Amazinyo nomhlathi kuhlafuna ukudla ngomshini, kanti amathe avela ezindlaleni zamathe amanzisa ukudla bese eqala ukugaya ngamakhemikhali. Ulimi lube seluhambisa ukudla ngokomzimba luye emphinjeni, lapho i-peristalsis ihambisa khona ukudla esiswini.
distractor66a: Amazinyo nomhlathi kuhlafuna ukudla ngendlela yomshini, kanti amathe avela ezindlaleni zamathe amanzisa ukudla futhi aqale ukugaya ngomshini nangokhemikhali. Ulimi lube seluhambisa ukudla ngokomzimba luye emphinjeni, lapho i-peristalsis ihambisa khona ukudla esiswini.
distractor66b: Amazinyo nomhlathi kuhlafuna ukudla ngomshini, kanti amathe avela ezindlaleni zamathe amanzisa ukudla bese eqala ukugaya ngamakhemikhali. Ulimi lube seluhambisa ukudla ngokomzimba luye elangeni, lapho i-peristalsis ihambisa khona ukudla esiswini.
distractor66c: Amazinyo nomhlathi kuhlafuna ukudla ngendlela yomshini, kanti amathe avela ezindlaleni zamathe amanzisa ukudla futhi aqale ukugaya ngomshini nangokhemikhali. Ulimi lube seluhambisa ukudla ngokomzimba luye emphinjeni, lapho ukuhlukaniswa kwezicubu kuhambisa ukudla esiswini.
question67: Izilwane eziningi ezincelisayo zinesimiso sokugaya ukudla esinomuthi owodwa, okusho ukuthi zinegumbi elilodwa lesisu. Izilwane ezincelisayo kanye nezilwane ezincelisayo zidla inani elikhulu lezinto ezitshalwe ezitshalweni futhi zinezinhlelo zokugaya ukudla eziningi, okusho ukuthi zinegumbi lesisu elingaphezu kwelilodwa. Kungani inani elandayo lamagumbi esisu lizuzisa izilwane ezincelisayo kanye nezilwane ezincelisayo ezingaceliwe?
answer67: Ama-microbes asemakamelweni ayaphula futhi abilise izinto zesitshalo
distractor67a: Ukuchayeka isikhathi eside ku-asidi yesisu kuqeda i-cellulose eningi
distractor67b: Inani elandayo le-peristalsis lichoboza kakhulu imicu yezitshalo
distractor67c: Ukuba namakamelo amaningi esiswini kwandisa ukuchayeka kwezakhamzimba ezizomuncwa
question68: Bheka uMfanekiso 25.29. Lesi sibalo sibonisa iningi lezindlela zokugaya ukudla zezinto eziphilayo ezimbili ezidla imithombo yokudla ehlukene. a. Yimuphi umzila wokugaya ukudla ongowezilwane ezidla uhlaza? b. Ukuthole kanjani lokhu?
answer68: A. Umgudu wokugaya ukudla oboniswe phezulu ungowezilwane ezidla uhlaza. b. Izilwane ezidla uhlaza zinendlela yamathumbu ende, enikeza ithuba elengeziwe lokuthola izakhamzimba nokumuncwa, njengoba kunzima ukuthi izitshalo zibole
distractor68a: A. Umgudu wokugaya ukudla oboniswe ngezansi ungowezilwane ezidla uhlaza. b. Izilwane ezidla uhlaza zinendlela yamathumbu emfushane, evumela ukufinyela kwemisipha okubushelelezi okuqinile okubizwa ngokuthi i-peristalsis endaweni emfushane, okunikeza ithuba elengeziwe lokuthola izakhamzimba nokumuncwa kwazo.
distractor68b: A. Umgudu wokugaya ukudla oboniswe ngezansi ungowezilwane ezidla uhlaza. b. Izilwane ezidla uhlaza zinendlela yamathumbu ende, enikeza ithuba elengeziwe lokuthi izakhamzimba zisabele nama-enzyme amathumbu ukuze zimunceke kangcono, njengoba kunzima ukuthi izitshalo zibole
distractor68c: A. Umgudu wokugaya ukudla oboniswe ngezansi ungowezilwane ezidla uhlaza. b. Izilwane ezidla uhlaza zinendlela yamathumbu emfushane, enikeza ithuba elithe xaxa lokuthola nokudonsa izakhamzimba, njengoba izinto zezitshalo kunzima ukuthi izilwane ziwohloke.
question69: Uhlelo lokugaya ukudla olusebenzisa isilwane esincelisayo luye lwashintshashintsha kakhulu ohlelweni lokugaya ukudla olusebenzisa isilwane esincelisayo esisodwa esiswini ngoba ludla inani elikhulu lezinto ezisetshenziswa ezitshalweni. Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okungeyona ingxenye yohlelo lokugaya ukudla olusebenzisa isilwane esincelisayo oluye lwathuthuka ukuze lugaye imicu yezitshalo ngempumelelo enkulu?
question70: Bheka uMfanekiso 25.30. Lesi sithombe sibonisa izinhlelo zokugaya ukudla zezilwane ezahlukene. Yisiphi isilwane okungenzeka kakhulu ukuba yisilwane esidla inyama?
distractor70c: Ukudla kwezilwane akukwazi ukunqunywa ngezinhlelo zazo zokugaya ukudla
question71: Bheka uMfanekiso 25.31. Lesi sibalo sibonisa ukunyakaza kwemisipha okungazikhetheli engxenyeni yesimiso sokugaya ukudla. Yini evuselela le mpendulo engazikhetheli?
question72: Bheka uMfanekiso 25.32. Lesi sithombe sibonisa uhlelo lokugaya ukudla lwesilwane esetyisayo. Lolu hlelo lokugaya ukudla olune-polygastric luthuthukisa kanjani ukusebenza kahle kokugaya ukudla ezifweni ezetyisayo?
answer72: Amakamelo amaningi esiswini ezilwaneni ezelusayo aqukethe amagciwane ane-cellulase, ephula izinto zezitshalo. Izinto zezitshalo kunzima ukuzigaya ngoba izilwane azinazo i-cellulase yokuphula i-cellulose.
distractor72a: Amakamelo amaningi esiswini ezilwaneni ezelusayo avumela ukufinyela kwemisipha okubushelelezi okuqinile, okuhlukanisa izinto zesitshalo. Izinto zesitshalo kunzima ukuzigaya ngoba izilwane azinayo i-cellulase yokuqhekeza i-cellulose
distractor72b: Amakamelo amaningi esiswini akhona ezilwaneni ezelusayo aqukethe i-cellulase, ephula izinto zezitshalo. Izinto zezitshalo kunzima ukuzigaya ngoba izilwane azinazo i-cellulase yokuphula i-cellulose.
distractor72c: Amakamelo amaningi esiswini ezilwaneni ezelusayo avumela ukudla ukuthi kuhlale esiswini isikhathi eside ukuze ukunyakaza kwe-peristaltic kanye nokusebenza kwama-enzyme ezinhlayiyeni zokudla kwenzeke isikhathi eside.
question73: Bheka Umfanekiso 25.33. Ukuhlolwa kokulinganisa izinga lokuphefumula emagundwini ku-10°C kanye no-25°C kwenziwa kusetshenziswa i-respirometer, ithuluzi elilinganisa izinguquko kuvolumu yegesi. Ukuphefumula kwalinganiswa ku-mL ye-O2 esetshenziswa ngegremu ngayinye yezinto eziphilayo ezivivinyweni eziningana zemizuzu emihlanu, kwathi kwatholakala idatha elandelayo. Yisiphi isimangalo esingenziwa ngokusekelwe kulolu cwaningo?
answer73: Amagundane ku-10°C ayenezinga eliphezulu lokukhiqizwa kwe-ATP kunamagundane ku-25°C.
distractor73a: Amagundane ku-10°C ayenezinga eliphansi lokugaya ukudla kunalawo ku-25°C.
distractor73b: Amagundane lapho eshisa kakhulu angama-25°C ayenesisindo esingaphansi kwamagundane lapho eshisa kakhulu angama-10°C.
distractor73c: Amagundane ku-25°C ayesebenza kakhulu kunamagundane ku-10°C.
question74: Bheka uMfanekiso 25.34. Isithombe sibonisa isakhiwo se-molecule ye-ATP. Uma i-molecule ye-ATP iphulwa ukuze kube namandla, yiziphi izibopho eziphukayo?
question75: Isilwane esidla inyama yonke sihlangana namazambane, ama-avokhado, i-kale, namaqanda futhi sifisa amaqanda kuphela. Yisiphi isakhamzimba okungenzeka ukuthi lesi silwane siswele?
question76: Ama-carbohydrate avame ukuthola idumela elibi ngendima yawo ekukhuthazeni ukukhuluphala uma edliwa ngokweqile. Kodwa-ke, ama-carbohydrate ayadingeka emisebenzini yebhayoloji. Kungani kubalulekile ukudla ama-carbohydrate?
answer76: Ama-carbohydrate ahlukaniswa abe ushukela, ohlinzeka ngamandla njenge-ATP ngokusebenzisa izindlela ze-metabolic. I-ATP iyadingeka ukuze kusebenze kahle amaseli.
distractor76a: Ama-carbohydrate ahlukaniswa abe ushukela, ohlinzeka ngamandla njenge-ATP ngokusebenzisa izindlela ze-metabolic. I-ATP isiza ekugcineni izicubu ezixhumeneyo
distractor76b: Ama-carbohydrate ahlukaniswa abe ushukela, obalulekile ekuqineni kwegazi.
distractor76c: Ama-carbohydrate, kanye namaprotheni, asiza ekugcineni izicubu ezixhumene futhi abalulekile ekuqineni kwegazi
question77: I-ATP eyengeziwe ihlanganiswa ne-glucose eyengeziwe futhi igcinwe njenge-glycogen esibindini nasemisipheni yamathambo. Kungaphansi kwaziphi izimo lapho ukugcinwa kwe-glycogen emisipheni yamathambo kungaba usizo kunogwaja?
answer77: Unogwaja ubona i-coyote bese ebaleka ngenxa yalokho
distractor77a: Unogwaja akakadli muva nje futhi ushukela wakhe egazini uyehla
distractor77b: Kukhona ukudla okuningi kakhulu okutholakala kunogwaja
distractor77c: Unogwaja omncane onomthombo wokudla owanele ukhula ube unogwaja omdala

chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 26. Uhlelo Lwezinzwa | 26.0 Isingeniso
chapterContent:
Uhlelo lucubungula okubonakala ekhasini, uhlelo lwe-motor lulawula ukuphenduka kwamakhasi (noma ukuchofoza igundane), kanti i-prefrontal cortex igcina ukunaka. Ngisho nemisebenzi eyisisekelo, njengokuphefumula nokulawula izinga lokushisa lomzimba, ilawulwa uhlelo lwezinzwa. Uhlelo lwezinzwa luyisikhungo sokulawula sezinto eziphilayo: lucubungula ulwazi lwezinzwa oluvela ngaphandle (nangaphakathi) komzimba futhi lulawula zonke izindlela zokuziphatha—kusukela ekudleni kuya ekulaleni kuya ekutholeni umngane.

 Ososayensi baye bathola nokuthi ama-neurons athile ngamanye (uhlobo lweseli lezinzwa) angenza imisebenzi eminingi. Ososayensi bezinzwa bavame ukusebenzisa i-organism eyisibonelo i-C. elegans (isibungu) ukutadisha ama-neurons. Ngesikhathi befunda lezi zibungu, muva nje kutholakale ukuthi uhlobo olulodwa lwe-neuron olubizwa nge-AIY lulawula kokubili isivinini kanye nesiqondiso sokunyakaza. Ngisho noma abantu benezigidigidi zama-neurons uma kuqhathaniswa nama-302 kuma-C. elegans, kucatshangwa ukuthi amaningi enza imisebenzi eminingi. Bheka Umfanekiso 26.1

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 26. Uhlelo Lwezinzwa | Ama-Neuron angu-26.1 Namaseli E-Glial | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 26. Uhlelo Lwezinzwa | Ama-Neuron angu-26.1 Namaseli E-Glial | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent:
Ulwazi oluningi mayelana nezinhlelo ezahlukene zezitho zezilwane alukho ngaphansi kwe-AP®. Nokho, uhlelo lwezinzwa lukhethelwe ucwaningo olujulile ngoba ikhono lesilwane lokubona, ukudlulisa, nokuphendula ulwazi libalulekile ekusindeni. Uhlelo lwezinzwa lusebenzisana nazo zonke ezinye izinhlelo zezitho ukuze luhlanganise izimpendulo. Ulwazi olukulesi sahluko lusivumela ukuthi sisebenzise imiqondo esiyihlolile ngaphambilini, okuhlanganisa ubudlelwano besakhiwo nomsebenzi, i-homeostasis, ukuhamba kwezinto kuwo wonke ama-membrane esisele, ukusayinwa kwamaseli nokuxhumana, kanye nokusetshenziswa kwe-ATP.

 Izinhlelo zezinzwa ezilwaneni zisukela kumanethi ezinzwa alula ku-jellyfish kuya ebuchosheni obuyinkimbinkimbi, intambo yomgogodla, kanye nemizwa engaphandle kubantu. (Ngenhloso ye-AP®, awudingi ukuba nolwazi oluningiliziwe mayelana nezinhlobo eziningi zezinhlelo zezinzwa kwezinye izilwane. Esikhundleni salokho, gxila nje ohlelweni lwezinzwa oluyinkimbinkimbi lwabantu.) Isakhiwo esiyisisekelo sesimiso sezinzwa esibonisa umsebenzi yi-neuron, okukhona kuzo izinhlobo ezintathu: inzwa, i-motor, kanye ne-interneuron. I-neuron evamile iqukethe ama-dendrite, umzimba weseli, kanye ne-axon ukuthola, ukukhiqiza, ukudlulisa, nokuhlanganisa ulwazi lwesignali. Ama-neurons amaningi azungezwe amaseli e-Schwann (uhlobo lweseli le-glial) akha i-myelin sheath, esebenza njengesivikelo sikagesi, njenge-plastic wrap ezungeze izintambo zethusi entanjeni yemishini yasekhaya. Amaseli e-Schwann ahlukaniswe yizikhala zemicu engafakwanga i-myelin ebizwa ngokuthi ama-node e-Ranvier lapho i-nerve impulse ihamba khona njengoba isignali idlula ku-neuron, okwandisa isivinini sokudlulisela. (Njengoba sizofunda esigabeni se-Nervous System Disorders, ezinye izifo zesimiso sezinzwa zivela ekulahlekelweni yi-myelin.) Amaseli e-Glial—avame ukucatshangwa njengomthombo osekelayo” wesimiso sezinzwa—amaningi kune-neurons futhi adlala indima ekuthuthukisweni kwama-neurons, ama-ion ayingozi kanye namakhemikhali, futhi ahlinzeka ngama-myelin sheath azungeze ama-neurons. Iningi lezimila zobuchopho libangelwa ukuguqulwa kwamaseli e-glial.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyisiwe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo echazwe ku-Big Idea 3 yoHlaka lweKharikhulamu lwe-AP® Biology. Izinhloso Zokufunda ze-AP® ezibalwe kuHlaka lweKharikhulamu zinikeza isisekelo esicacile senkambo ye-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekubuzeni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo nomunye noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa.

 I-Big Idea 3
Izinhlelo eziphilayo zigcina, zibuyise, zidlulise futhi ziphendule ulwazi olubalulekile ezinqubweni zokuphila.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 3.E
Ukudluliselwa kolwazi kuphumela ezinguqukweni ngaphakathi kanye naphakathi kwezinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
3.E.2 Izilwane zinezinhlelo zezinzwa ezithola izimpawu zangaphandle nezangaphakathi, zidlulise futhi zihlanganise ulwazi, futhi zikhiqize izimpendulo.

 Ukuzijwayeza Kwesayensi
1.2 Umfundi angachaza izethulo namamodeli ezethulo nezinhlelo zemvelo noma ezenziwe ngabantu endaweni.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
3.44 Umfundi uyakwazi ukuchaza ukuthi izinhlelo zezinzwa zibona kanjani izimpawu zangaphandle nezangaphakathi.
Ulwazi Olubalulekile
3.E.2 Izilwane zinezinhlelo zezinzwa ezithola izimpawu zangaphandle nezangaphakathi, zidlulise futhi zihlanganise ulwazi, futhi zikhiqize izimpendulo.

 Ukuzijwayeza Kwesayensi
1.1 Umfundi angadala izethulo namamodeli ezethulo nezinhlelo zemvelo noma ezenziwe ngabantu endaweni.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
3.48 Umfundi uyakwazi ukudala izethulo ezibonakalayo ukuchaza ukuthi izinhlelo zemizwa zibona izimpawu zangaphandle nezangaphakathi.

 Izinhlelo zemizwa kulo lonke umbuso wezilwane ziyahlukahluka ngesakhiwo kanye nobunzima, njengoba kuboniswe yizinhlobonhlobo zezilwane eziboniswe kuMfanekiso 26.2. Ezinye izinto eziphilayo, njengeziponji zasolwandle, azinaso isimiso semizwa sangempela. Ezinye, njenge-jellyfish, azinaso ubuchopho bangempela futhi esikhundleni salokho zinesimiso samaseli emizwa ahlukene kodwa axhunyiwe (ama-neurons) abizwa ngokuthi i-nerve net.” Ama-Echinoderms njengezinkanyezi zasolwandle anamaseli emizwa ahlanganiswe abe imicu ebizwa ngokuthi i-nerve. Izibungu eziyisicaba ze-phylum Platyhelminthes zinesimiso sezinzwa esiyinhloko (CNS), esakhiwe ubuchopho obuncane” kanye nezintambo ezimbili zemizwa, kanye nesistimu yezinzwa engaphandle (PNS) equkethe uhlelo lwezinzwa olusabalala kuwo wonke umzimba. Uhlelo lwezinzwa lwezinambuzane luyinkimbinkimbi kakhulu kodwa futhi luhlukaniswe kahle. Luqukethe ubuchopho, intambo yezinzwa engaphakathi, kanye ne-ganglia (amaqoqo ama-neurons axhunyiwe). La ma-ganglia angalawula ukunyakaza nokuziphatha ngaphandle kokufaka okuvela ebuchosheni. I-Octopi ingaba nezinhlelo zezinzwa ezingenamgogodla eziyinkimbinkimbi kakhulu—zinama-neurons ahlelwe ngama-lobes namehlo akhethekile afana nezinhlobo zezilwane ezinomgogodla.

 Uma kuqhathaniswa nezilwane ezingenamgogodla, izinhlelo zezinzwa zezilwane ezinomgogodla ziyinkimbinkimbi kakhulu, ziphakathi, futhi zikhethekile. Ngenkathi kunokwehlukahluka okukhulu phakathi kwezinhlelo zezinzwa zezilwane ezinomgogodla ezahlukene, zonke zabelana ngesakhiwo esiyisisekelo: i-CNS equkethe ubuchopho nentambo yomgogodla kanye ne-PNS eyenziwe ngemithambo yezinzwa engaphandle kanye nemithambo yokunyakaza. Umehluko owodwa othakazelisayo phakathi kwezinhlelo zezinzwa zezilwane ezingenamgogodla kanye nezilwane ezinomgogodla ukuthi izintambo zezinzwa zezilwane eziningi ezingenamgogodla zitholakala ngaphakathi kanti izintambo zomgogodla ezinomgogodla zitholakala ngaphakathi. itholakala emhlane. Kukhona impikiswano phakathi kwezazi zezinto eziphilayo zokuziphendukela kwemvelo mayelana nokuthi lezi zinhlelo ezahlukene zesimiso sezinzwa zavela ngokwehlukana noma ukuthi uhlelo lomzimba we-invertebrate lushintshe ngandlela-thile” ngesikhathi sokuvela kwezilwane ezinomgogodla.

 Uhlelo lwezinzwa lwakhiwe ngama-neurons, amaseli akhethekile angathola futhi adlulise izimpawu zamakhemikhali noma zikagesi, kanye ne-glia, amaseli ahlinzeka ngemisebenzi yokusekela ama-neurons ngokudlala indima yokucubungula ulwazi ehambisana nama-neurons. I-neuron ingafaniswa nentambo kagesi—idlulisa isignali kusuka endaweni eyodwa kuya kwenye. I-Glia ingafaniswa nezisebenzi enkampanini kagesi eziqinisekisa ukuthi izintambo ziya ezindaweni ezifanele, zigcine izintambo, futhi zisuse izintambo eziphukile. Nakuba i-glia ifaniswe nezisebenzi, ubufakazi bamuva busikisela ukuthi lokho kuphinde kuthathe eminye yemisebenzi yokubonisana yama-neurons.

 Kukhona ukuhlukahluka okukhulu ezinhlotsheni zama-neurons kanye ne-glia ezikhona ezingxenyeni ezahlukene zesimiso sezinzwa. Kunezinhlobo ezine ezinkulu zama-neurons, futhi zabelana ngezingxenye eziningana ezibalulekile zamaseli
question1: Yiziphi izinhlobo ezintathu eziyinhloko zama-neurons ezigcizelelwa ku-AP® Biology?
answer1: Ama-neuron ezinzwa, ama-motor neurons, nama-interneurons

answer6: Izilwane ezinethambo lomgogodla zinethambo lomgogodla elisemhlane, kanti izilwane eziningi ezingenamgogodla zinethambo lomgogodla elisemhlane.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 26. Uhlelo Lwezinzwa | 26.1 Ama-Neuron Namaseli E-Glial | Ama-Neuron
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 26. Uhlelo Lwezinzwa | 26.1 Ama-Neuron Namaseli E-Glial | Ama-Neuron
chapterContent:
Uhlelo lwezinzwa lwempukane evamile yelabhorethri, i-Drosophila melanogaster, luqukethe ama-neuron angaba ngu-100,000, inani elifanayo ne-lobster. Leli nani liqhathaniswa nama-neuron ayizigidi ezingu-75 egundaneni kanye nama-300 e-octopus. Ubuchopho bomuntu buqukethe ama-neuron angaba yizigidigidi ezingu-86. Naphezu kwalezi zinombolo ezihlukene kakhulu, izinhlelo zezinzwa zalezi zilwane zilawula ukuziphatha okufanayo—kusukela ekuziphendukeleni okuyisisekelo kuya ekuziphatheni okuyinkimbinkimbi njengokuthola ukudla nokuthandana. Amandla ama-neuron okuxhumana kanye nezinye izinhlobo zamaseli ayisisekelo sazo zonke lezi zindlela zokuziphatha.

 Ama-neurons amaningi abelana ngezingxenye ezifanayo zamaseli. Kodwa ama-neurons nawo akhethekile kakhulu—izinhlobo ezahlukene zama-neurons zinobukhulu obuhlukene kanye nezimo ezihlobene nezindima zawo zokusebenza.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 26. Uhlelo Lwezinzwa | 26.1 Ama-Neuron Namaseli E-Glial | Ama-Neuron | Izingxenye Ze-Neuron
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 26. Uhlelo Lwezinzwa | 26.1 Ama-Neuron Namaseli E-Glial | Ama-Neuron | Izingxenye Ze-Neuron
chapterContent:
Njengamanye amaseli, i-neuron ngayinye inomzimba weseli (noma i-soma) oqukethe i-nucleus, i-reticulum ebushelelezi neyi-rough endoplasmic, i-Golgi apparatus, i-mitochondria, nezinye izingxenye zeseli. Ama-Neuron aqukethe nezakhiwo ezihlukile, eziboniswe ku-Figure 26.3 zokwamukela nokuthumela izimpawu zikagesi ezenza ukuxhumana kwe-neuronal kube nokwenzeka. Ama-Dendrite ayizakhiwo ezifana nezihlahla ezisuka emzimbeni weseli ukuze zithole imiyalezo evela kwamanye ama-neurons ezindaweni ezikhethekile ezibizwa ngokuthi ama-synapses. Nakuba amanye ama-neurons engenawo ama-dendrite, ezinye izinhlobo zama-neurons zinama-dendrite amaningi. Ama-Dendrite angaba nama-protrusion amancane abizwa ngokuthi ama-dendritic spines, akhulisa indawo engaphezulu yokuxhumana okungenzeka kwe-synaptic.

 Uma isignali isitholwe yi-dendrite, bese ihamba kancane iye emzimbeni weseli. Umzimba weseli uqukethe isakhiwo esikhethekile, i-axon hillock ehlanganisa izimpawu ezivela kuma-synapses amaningi futhi isebenza njengendawo yokuhlangana phakathi komzimba weseli ne-axon. I-axon iyisakhiwo esifana nethubhu esisakaza isignali ehlanganisiwe eziphethweni ezikhethekile ezibizwa ngokuthi ama-axon terminals. Lawa ma-terminals aguqula i-synapse kwamanye ama-neurons, imisipha, noma izitho eziqondiwe. Amakhemikhali akhishwa kuma-axon terminals avumela ukuthi amasignali adluliselwe kulawa amanye amaseli. Ama-neurons ngokuvamile ane-axon eyodwa noma ezimbili, kodwa amanye ama-neurons, njengamaseli e-amacrine ku-retina, awaqukethe ama-axon. Amanye ama-axon ambozwe yi-myelin, esebenza njengesivikelo sokunciphisa ukusabalala kwesignali kagesi njengoba ihamba phansi kwe-axon, okwandisa kakhulu isivinini ekuqhutshweni kwayo. Lokhu kufakwa kwe-insulation kubalulekile njengoba i-axon evela ku-neuron ye-motor yomuntu ingaba yimitha ubude—kusukela phansi komgogodla kuya ezinzwaneni. I-myelin sheath ayiyona ingxenye ye-neuron. I-Myelin ikhiqizwa amaseli e-glial. Eceleni kwe-axon kunezikhala ezihlala njalo ku-myelin sheath. Lezi zikhala zibizwa ngokuthi ama-node eRanvier futhi ziyizindawo lapho isignali ivuselelwa khona” njengoba ihamba nge-axon.

 Kubalulekile ukuqaphela ukuthi i-neuron eyodwa ayisebenzi yodwa—ukuxhumana kwe-neuronal kuncike ekuxhumaneni okwenziwa yi-neurons komunye nomunye (kanye namanye amaseli, njengamaseli emisipha). Ama-dendrite avela ku-neuron eyodwa angathola ukuxhumana kwe-synaptic kwamanye ama-neurons amaningi. Isibonelo, ama-dendrite avela kuseli le-Purkinje ku-cerebellum kucatshangwa ukuthi athola ukuxhumana kwamanye ama-neurons angaba ngu-200,000.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 26. Uhlelo Lwezinzwa | 26.1 Ama-Neuron Namaseli E-Glial | Ama-Neuron | Izinhlobo Zama-Neuron
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 26. Uhlelo Lwezinzwa | 26.1 Ama-Neuron Namaseli E-Glial | Ama-Neuron | Izinhlobo Zama-Neuron
chapterContent:
Kunezinhlobo ezahlukene zama-neuron, futhi indima yokusebenza kwe-neuron ethile incike kakhulu esakhiweni sayo. Kukhona ukuhlukahluka okumangalisayo kwezimo nobukhulu be-neuron obutholakala ezingxenyeni ezahlukene zesimiso sezinzwa (nakuzo zonke izinhlobo), njengoba kuboniswe ama-neurons aboniswe kuMfanekiso 26.4.

 Nakuba kunezinhlobo eziningi zamaseli e-neuron ezichaziwe, ama-neurons ahlukaniswe kabanzi ngezinhlobo ezine eziyisisekelo: i-unipolar, i-bipolar, i-multipolar, kanye ne-pseudounipolar. Umfanekiso 26.5 ubonisa lezi zinhlobo ezine eziyisisekelo zama-neuron. Ama-neurons e-unipolar anesakhiwo esisodwa kuphela esisuka kude ne-soma. Lawa ma-neurons awatholakali ezilwaneni ezinomgogodla kodwa atholakala ezinambuzaneni lapho evuselela khona imisipha noma izindlala. I-neuron ye-bipolar ine-axon eyodwa kanye ne-dendrite eyodwa esuka ku-soma. Isibonelo se-bipolar neuron yiseli le-retinal bipolar, elithola izimpawu ezivela kumaseli e-photoreceptor azwela ukukhanya futhi lidlulisela lezi zimpawu kumaseli e-ganglion athwala isignali eya ebuchosheni. Ama-neurons amaningi aluhlobo oluvame kakhulu lwe-neuron. I-neuron ngayinye ye-multipolar iqukethe i-axon eyodwa nama-dendrite amaningi. Ama-neuron amaningi angatholakala ohlelweni lwezinzwa oluphakathi (ubuchopho kanye nentambo yomgogodla). Isibonelo se-neuron eningi yiseli le-Purkinje ku-cerebellum, elinama-dendrite amaningi ahlanganisayo kodwa i-axon eyodwa kuphela. Amaseli e-Pseudounipolar abelana ngezici namaseli e-unipolar kanye ne-bipolar. Iseli le-pseudounipolar linenqubo eyodwa esukela ku-soma, njengeseli le-unipolar, kodwa le nqubo kamuva ihlukana ibe izakhiwo ezimbili ezihlukile, njengeseli le-bipolar. Ama-neurons amaningi enzwa angama-pseudounipolar futhi ane-axon ehlukana ibe izandiso ezimbili: eyodwa exhunywe kuma-dendrite athola ulwazi lwezinzwa kanye nenye edlulisela lolu lwazi emgogodleni.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 26. Uhlelo Lwezinzwa | 26.1 Ama-Neuron Namaseli E-Glial | Ama-Neuron | I-Neurogeneis
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 26. Uhlelo Lwezinzwa | 26.1 Ama-Neuron Namaseli E-Glial | Ama-Neuron | I-Neurogeneis
chapterContent:
Ngesinye isikhathi, ososayensi babekholelwa ukuthi abantu bazalwa benawo wonke ama-neuron ababeyoba nawo. Ucwaningo olwenziwe emashumini ambalwa eminyaka edlule lubonisa ukuthi i-neurogenesis, ukuzalwa kwama-neurons amasha, iyaqhubeka kuze kube yilapho umuntu ekhulile. I-neurogenesis yaqala ukutholwa ezinyonini eziculayo ezikhiqiza ama-neurons amasha ngenkathi zifunda izingoma. Ezilwaneni ezincelisayo, ama-neurons amasha nawo adlala indima ebalulekile ekufundeni: cishe ama-neurons amasha ayi-1000 akhula ku-hippocampus (isakhiwo sobuchopho esihilelekile ekufundeni nasekukhumbuleni) nsuku zonke. Nakuba iningi lama-neurons amasha lizofa, abacwaningi bathole ukuthi ukwanda kwenani lama-neurons amasha asindayo ku-hippocampus kuhlobene nendlela amagundane afunde kahle ngayo umsebenzi omusha. Ngokuthakazelisayo, ukuzivocavoca kukhuthaza ne-neurogenesis ku-hippocampus. Ukucindezeleka kunomphumela ophambene. Ngenkathi i-neurogenesis ilinganiselwe kakhulu uma kuqhathaniswa nokuvuselelwa kwezinye izicubu, ucwaningo kule ndawo lungaholela ekwelashweni okusha kwezifo ezifana ne-Alzheimer's, isifo sohlangothi, kanye nesifo sokuwa.

 Ososayensi bawathola kanjani ama-neurons amasha? Umcwaningi angafaka i-compound ebizwa ngokuthi i-bromodeoxyuridine (BrdU) ebuchosheni besilwane. Nakuba wonke amaseli azovezwa ku-BrdU, i-BrdU izofakwa kuphela ku-DNA yamaseli asanda kukhiqizwa asesigabeni se-S. Indlela ebizwa ngokuthi i-immunohistochemistry ingasetshenziswa ukunamathisela ilebula le-fluorescent ku-BrdU efakiwe, futhi umcwaningi angasebenzisa i-fluorescent microscopy ukubona ngeso lengqondo ukuba khona kwe-BrdU, kanye nama-neurons amasha, ezicutshini zobuchopho. Isithombe 26.6 yi-micrograph ekhombisa ama-neurons abhalwe nge-fluorescent ku-hippocampus yegundane.

chapterContent: Nakuba i-glia ivame ukubhekwa njengesisekelo esisekela uhlelo lwezinzwa, inani lamaseli e-glial ebuchosheni empeleni lidlula inani lama-neurons ngesilinganiso seshumi. Ama-neurons abengeke akwazi ukusebenza ngaphandle kwezindima ezibalulekile ezifezwa yila maseli e-glial. Ama-Glia aqondisa ukuthuthukisa ama-neurons ezindaweni zawo, ama-buffer ions namakhemikhali abengalimaza ama-neurons, futhi ahlinzeke ngama-myelin sheaths azungeze ama-axon. Ososayensi basanda kuthola ukuthi nawo adlala indima ekuphenduleni umsebenzi wezinzwa kanye nokulawula ukuxhumana phakathi kwamaseli ezinzwa.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 26. Uhlelo Lwezinzwa | 26.1 Ama-Neuron Namaseli E-Glial | I-Glia | Izinhlobo ze-Glia
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 26. Uhlelo Lwezinzwa | 26.1 Ama-Neuron Namaseli E-Glial | I-Glia | Izinhlobo ze-Glia
chapterContent: Kunezinhlobo eziningana ezahlukene ze-glia ezinemisebenzi ehlukene, ezimbili zazo eziboniswe kuMfanekiso 26.7. Ama-Astrocyte, aboniswe kuMfanekiso 26.8a axhumana nama-capillary nama-neurons ku-CNS. Ahlinzeka ngezakhamzimba nezinye izinto kuma-neurons, alawula ukugcwala kwama-ion namakhemikhali ku-extracellular fluid, futhi ahlinzeka ngokusekelwa kwesakhiwo sama-synapses. Ama-Astrocyte nawo akha isithiyo segazi nobuchopho—isakhiwo esivimba ukungena kwezinto ezinobuthi ebuchosheni. Ama-Astrocyte, ikakhulukazi, aboniswe ngokuhlolwa kwe-calcium imaging ukuthi asebenza ngokuphendula umsebenzi wezinzwa, adlulise amagagasi e-calcium phakathi kwama-astrocyte, futhi alawule umsebenzi wama-synapses azungezile. I-glia yesathelayithi inikeza izakhamzimba kanye nokusekelwa kwesakhiwo kwama-neurons ku-PNS. I-Microglia isusa futhi yonakalise amangqamuzana afile futhi ivikele ubuchopho kuma-microorganisms ahlaselayo. Ama-Oligodendrocyte, aboniswe kuMfanekiso 26.8b akha ama-myelin sheaths azungeze ama-axon ku-CNS. I-axon eyodwa ingafakwa i-myelin ngama-oligodendrocyte amaningana, kanti i-oligodendrocyte eyodwa ingahlinzeka nge-myelin kuma-neurons amaningi. Lokhu kuhlukile ku-PNS lapho iseli elilodwa le-Schwann linikeza i-myelin ye-axon eyodwa kuphela njengoba lonke iseli le-Schwann lizungeze i-axon. I-radial glia isebenza njengezicabha zokuthuthukisa ama-neurons njengoba ethuthela ezindaweni zawo zokugcina. Amaseli e-Ependymal aqoqa ama-ventricle agcwele uketshezi ebuchosheni kanye nomsele ophakathi womgogodla. Ahilelekile ekukhiqizweni koketshezi lwe-cerebrospinal, olusebenza njengesivikelo sobuchopho, luhambisa uketshezi phakathi komgogodla nobuchopho, futhi luyingxenye ye-choroid plexus.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 26. Uhlelo Lwezinzwa | 26.2 Indlela Ama-Neuron Axhumana Ngayo | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 26. Uhlelo Lwezinzwa | 26.2 Indlela Ama-Neuron Axhumana Ngayo | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent:
I-neuron iyisibonelo esihle sobudlelwano besakhiwo nomsebenzi ezingeni leseli. Ukugeleza kolwazi nge-neuron kuvame ukusuka ku-dendrite kuya ku-axon kanye nokusuka ku-neuron kuya ku-neuron noma kusuka ku-neuron kuya kuseli lesitho esiqondiwe. Njengamanye amangqamuzana e-eukaryotic, ama-neurons aqukethe i-membrane yeseli, i-nucleus, nama-organelle, okuhlanganisa ne-mitochondria. Amandla esenzo asakaza ama-impulses ngama-neurons. Uma i-axon iphumule, i-membrane kuthiwa i-polarized; okungukuthi, kukhona i-gradient ye-electrochemical kuyo yonke, lapho ingaphakathi le-membrane lishaja kabi kunangaphandle. Sihlole ukwakheka kwama-gradient e-electrochemical sisebenzisa i-H+ lapho sifunda nge-photosynthesis kanye nokuphefumula kwamaseli. Nokho, i-neuron isebenzisa i-Na+ ne-K+ ukusungula i-gradient. Kubalulekile futhi ukukhumbula ukuthi ama-ion awakwazi ukusabalala ngaphesheya kwe-lipid bilayer ye-membrane yeseli futhi kumele asebenzise amaprotheni okuthutha; kulokhu, amaprotheni okuthutha angamashaneli e-Na+ ne-K+ avikelwe yi-voltage.

 Ekuphumuleni, ipompo ye-Na+/K+, enikwe amandla yi-ATP, igcina le gradient, eyaziwa ngokuthi i-resting membrane potential. Ukuphendula isikhuthazo, njenge-molecule enuka kamnandi, izinguquko zamandla e-membrane, kanye nekhono lesenzo elikhiqizwa eceleni kwe-membrane njengoba iziteshi ze-Na+ ne-K+ ezivalwe ngogesi zivuleka ngokulandelana, okubangela ukuthi i-membrane i-depolarize. Eku-depolarize, ingaphakathi le-membrane liba ngcono kakhulu kunelangaphandle njengoba i-Na+ igeleza ngaphakathi. Ukuphinda kuvele kwenzeka lapho i-K+ igeleza ngaphesheya kwe-membrane iye ngaphandle. Kuma-neuron ane-myelin, amandla esenzo agxuma phakathi kwezikhala zama-axon angena-myelin (ama-node e-Ranvier), into ebizwa ngokuthi i-saltatory conduction.

 Ukudluliselwa kwe-nerve impulse kusuka ku-neuron eyodwa kuya kwenye noma kolunye uhlobo lweseli njengeseli lemisipha kwenzeka ngaphesheya kwe-junction ebizwa ngokuthi i-synapse. Ama-vesicle e-Synaptic e-axon terminal ye-presynaptic neuron akhipha izithunywa zamakhemikhali ezibizwa ngokuthi ama-neurotransmitters angene e-junction; ama-neurotransmitter abe esebopha kuma-receptor afakwe ku-membrane ye-neuron ye-postsynaptic. Ama-neurotransmitter angaba yi-excitatory (njenge-acetylcholine noma i-epinephrine) noma avimbele (njenge-serotonin noma i-GABA) njengoba ekhulisa noma ehlisa ushintsho lwe-action potential ku-neuron ye-postsynaptic. Imithi eminingi, kufaka phakathi kokubili imithi kanye nezidakamizwa zokusebenzisa kabi, ingadala izinguquko ekudlulisweni kwe-synaptic; isibonelo, i-tetrahydrocannabinol (eyaziwa kakhulu ngokuthi i-THC) ku-marijuana ibopha ku-neurotransmitter eyenzeka ngokwemvelo ebalulekile kwinkumbulo yesikhathi esifushane.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyisiwe esigabeni sokusekela Imiqondo echazwe ku-Big Idea 3 yoHlaka lweKharikhulamu ye-AP® Biology. Izinhloso Zokufunda ze-AP® ezibalwe kuHlaka lweKharikhulamu zinikeza isisekelo esicacile sesifundo se-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekubuzeni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo nomunye noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa.

chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 26. Uhlelo Lwezinzwa | 26.2 Indlela Ama-Neuron Axhumana Ngayo | Ukudluliselwa Kwezinzwa Ezishukunyiswa Ngaphakathi Kwe-Neuron | Ama-Membrane Ashajwe Ngama-Neuronal
chapterContent:
Ukuze uhlelo lwezinzwa lusebenze, ama-neurons kumele akwazi ukuthumela nokwamukela izimpawu. Lezi zimpawu zingenzeka ngoba i-neuron ngayinye ine-membrane yeselula eshajiwe (umehluko we-voltage phakathi kwangaphakathi nangaphandle), futhi ukushaja kwalolu membrane kungashintsha ngokuphendula ama-molecule e-neurotransmitter akhishwe kwamanye ama-neurons kanye nezisusa zemvelo. Ukuze uqonde ukuthi ama-neurons axhumana kanjani, umuntu kumele aqale aqonde isisekelo se-baseline noma 'i-rest' membrane charge.

 Ama-Neuronal Charged Membranes
I-lipid bilayer membrane ezungeze i-neuron ayingeneki kuma-molecule noma ama-ion ashajiwe. Ukuze angene noma aphume ku-neuron, ama-ion kumele adlule kumaphrotheni akhethekile abizwa ngokuthi iziteshi ze-ion ezihlanganisa ulwelwesi. Iziteshi ze-ion zinezilungiselelo ezahlukene: ezivulekile, ezivaliwe, nezingasebenzi, njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 26.9. Ezinye iziteshi ze-ion zidinga ukuvuselelwa ukuze zivuleke futhi zivumele ama-ion ukuthi adlule noma aphume esitokisini. Lezi ziteshi ze-ion zizwela emvelweni futhi zingashintsha isimo sazo ngokufanele. Iziteshi ze-ion ezishintsha isakhiwo sazo ngokuphendula izinguquko ze-voltage zibizwa ngokuthi iziteshi ze-ion ezigadwe yi-voltage. Iziteshi ze-ion ezivalwe nge-voltage zilawula ukujiya okuhlobene kwama-ion ahlukene ngaphakathi nangaphandle kweseli. Umehluko ekushajweni okuphelele phakathi kwangaphakathi nangaphandle kweseli ubizwa ngokuthi amandla e-membrane
