chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 26. Uhlelo Lwezinzwa | 26.2 Indlela Ama-Neuron Axhumana Ngayo | Ukudluliselwa Kwezinzwa Ezishukunyiswa Ngaphakathi Kwe-Neuron | Amandla Okuphumula E-Membrane
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 26. Uhlelo Lwezinzwa | 26.2 Indlela Ama-Neuron Axhumana Ngayo | Ukudluliselwa Kwezinzwa Ezishukunyiswa Ngaphakathi Kwe-Neuron | Amandla Okuphumula E-Membrane
chapterContent:
I-neuron ekuphumuleni ishajwa kabi: ingaphakathi leseli licishe libe ngama-millivolt angu-70 kunelangaphandle (−70 mV, qaphela ukuthi leli nani liyahlukahluka ngohlobo lwe-neuron kanye nohlobo). Le voltage ibizwa ngokuthi i-resting membrane potential; ibangelwa umehluko ekugxilweni kwama-ion ngaphakathi nangaphandle kweseli. Uma i-membrane ingangena ngokulinganayo kuwo wonke ama-ion, uhlobo ngalunye lwe-ion beluzogeleza kulo lonke i-membrane futhi uhlelo beluzofinyelela ukulingana. Ngenxa yokuthi ama-ion awakwazi ukumane awele i-membrane ngokuthanda kwawo, kunezingqimba ezahlukene zama-ion amaningana ngaphakathi nangaphandle kweseli, njengoba kuboniswe kuthebula elingezansi. Umehluko enanini lama-ion e-potassium ashajwe kahle (K+) ngaphakathi nangaphandle kweseli ulawula i-resting membrane potential (Isithombe 26.10). Lapho i-membrane iphumulile, ama-ion e-K+ aqoqana ngaphakathi kweseli ngenxa yomsebenzi wephampu ye-Na/K, eqhuba ama-ion womabili ngokumelene ne-gradient yawo yokuhlushwa. I-negative resting membrane potential idalwa futhi igcinwe ngokwandisa ukuhlushwa kwama-cation ngaphandle kweseli (kuketshezi olungaphandle kweseli) uma kuqhathaniswa nangaphakathi kweseli (ku-cytoplasm). Ishaja engemihle ngaphakathi kweseli idalwa ukuthi ulwelwesi lweseli lungene kalula ekuhambeni kwama-ion e-potassium kunokunyakaza kwama-ion e-sodium. Kuma-neurons, ama-ion e-potassium agcinwa ekugxilweni okuphezulu ngaphakathi kweseli kuyilapho ama-ion e-sodium egcinwa ekugxilweni okuphezulu ngaphandle kweseli. Iseli lineziteshi zokuvuza ze-potassium ne-sodium ezivumela ama-cation amabili ukuthi asabalale phansi kwe-gradient yawo yokuhlushwa. Kodwa-ke, ama-neurons aneziteshi zokuvuza ze-potassium eziningi kakhulu kuneziteshi zokuvuza ze-sodium. Ngakho-ke, i-potassium iyasabalala ngaphandle kweseli ngesivinini esisheshayo kakhulu kunokuvuza kwe-sodium. Ngenxa yokuthi ama-cation amaningi aphuma esitokisini kunalawo angena, lokhu kubangela ukuthi ingaphakathi leseli lishajwe kabi uma kuqhathaniswa nengaphandle leseli. Izenzo zephampu ye-sodium potassium zisiza ukugcina amandla okuphumula, uma sezisunguliwe. Khumbula ukuthi amaphampu e-sodium potassium aletha ama-ion amabili e-K+ esitokisini ngenkathi esusa ama-ion amathathu e-Na+ nge-ATP ngayinye esetshenziswayo. Njengoba ama-cation amaningi ekhishwa esitokisini kunalawo athathwayo, ingaphakathi leseli lihlala lishajwe kabi uma kuqhathaniswa noketshezi olungaphandle kweseli. Kufanele kuqashelwe ukuthi ama-ion e-chloride (Cl–) avame ukuqongelela ngaphandle kweseli ngoba axoshwa amaprotheni ashajwe kabi ngaphakathi kwe-cytoplasm.

chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 26. Uhlelo Lwezinzwa | 26.2 Indlela Ama-Neuron Axhumana Ngayo | Ukudluliselwa Kwezinzwa Ezishukumisayo Ngaphakathi Kwe-Neuron | Amandla Esenzo
chapterContent: Bheka uMfanekiso 26.12. I-neuron ingathola okokufaka okuvela kwamanye ama-neurons futhi, uma lokhu kufakwa kunamandla anele, ithumela isignali kuma-neurons angezansi. Ukudluliselwa kwesignali phakathi kwama-neurons ngokuvamile kuthwalwa yikhemikhali ebizwa ngokuthi i-neurotransmitter. Ukudluliselwa kwesignali ngaphakathi kwe-neuron (kusuka ku-dendrite kuya ku-axon terminal) kuthwalwa ukuguqulwa okufushane kwe-resting membrane potential ebizwa ngokuthi i-action potential. Lapho ama-neurotransmitter molecule ebopha kuma-receptor atholakala kuma-dendrites e-neuron, iziteshi ze-ion ziyavuleka. Ku-excitatory synapses, lokhu kuvulwa kuvumela ama-ion amahle ukuthi angene ku-neuron futhi kuphumela ekususweni kwe-membrane - ukwehla komehluko ku-voltage phakathi kwangaphakathi nangaphandle kwe-neuron. Isikhuthazo esivela kuseli lenzwa noma kwenye i-neuron sisusa i-neuron eqondiwe ku-threshold potential yayo (-55 mV). Iziteshi ze-Na+ ku-axon hillock ziyavuleka, okuvumela ama-ion amahle ukuthi angene kuseli (Umfanekiso 26.10 kanye noMfanekiso 26.11). Uma iziteshi ze-sodium sezivuliwe, i-neuron ihlukana ngokuphelele ibe yi-membrane potential engaba ngu-+40 mV. Ama-Action potentials abhekwa njengomcimbi we-all-or nothing, ngokuthi, uma amandla omkhawulo esefinyelelwe, i-neuron ihlala ihlukana ngokuphelele. Uma i-depolarization isiqediwe, iseli kumele manje libuyisele kabusha i-membrane voltage yalo emuva kwi-resting potential. Ukuze kufezwe lokhu, iziteshi ze-Na+ ziyavalwa futhi azikwazi ukuvulwa. Lokhu kuqala isikhathi sokungaphenduli kwama-neurons, lapho lingakwazi ukukhiqiza elinye amandla okwenza ngoba iziteshi zalo ze-sodium ngeke zivuleke. Ngesikhathi esifanayo, iziteshi ze-K+ ezivalwe ngama-voltage ziyavuleka, okuvumela i-K+ ukuthi ishiye iseli. Njengoba ama-K+ ions eshiya iseli, amandla e-membrane aphinde abe mancane futhi aphinde ahlukane. Ukusabalala kwe-K+ ngaphandle kweseli empeleni kuyaqhubeka isikhathi esifushane esidlule isikhathi sokufezwa kwamandla okuphumula, kanti i-membrane iyanda, ngokuthi amandla e-membrane aba mancane kakhulu kune-resting potential yamaseli evamile. Lokhu kungumphumela wokuvala kancane kweziteshi ze-K+. Kuleli qophelo, iziteshi ze-sodium zizobuyela esimweni sazo sokuphumula, okusho ukuthi sezikulungele ukuvula futhi uma amandla e-membrane ephinde edlula amandla omkhawulo. Ekugcineni zonke iziteshi ze-K+ ziyavalwa, bese iseli libuyela emandleni alo e-membrane yokuphumula.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 26. Uhlelo Lwezinzwa | 26.2 Indlela Ama-Neuron Axhumana Ngayo | Ukudluliselwa Kwezinzwa Ezishukumisayo Ngaphakathi Kwe-Neuron | I-Myelin Nokwanda Kwamandla Esenzo
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 26. Uhlelo Lwezinzwa | 26.2 Indlela Ama-Neuron Axhumana Ngayo | Ukudluliselwa Kwezinzwa Ezishukumisayo Ngaphakathi Kwe-Neuron | I-Myelin Nokwanda Kwamandla Esenzo
chapterContent: Ukuze amandla okwenza isenzo adlulisele ulwazi kwenye i-neuron, kumele ahambe nge-axon futhi afinyelele kuma-terminal e-axon lapho angaqala khona ukukhululwa kwe-neurotransmitter. Ijubane lokuqhuba amandla okwenza isenzo nge-axon lithonywa yibo bobabili ububanzi be-axon kanye nokumelana kwe-axon nokuvuza kwamanje. I-Myelin isebenza njengesivikelo esivimbela amandla kagesi ukuthi angaphumi kwi-axon; lokhu kwandisa ijubane lokuqhuba amandla okwenza isenzo. Ezifweni ezisusa i-myelin. Ezifweni ezisusa i-myelin, ukuqhubela amandla okwenza isenzo kuyehla ngoba ukuvuza kwamanje okuvela ezindaweni ze-axon ezazifakwe ngaphambili. Ama-node e-Ranvier, aboniswe ku-Figure 26.13 ayizikhala emgodleni we-myelin nge-axon. Lezi zikhala ezingafakwanga i-myelin zingaba yi-micrometer eyodwa ubude futhi ziqukethe iziteshi ze-Na+ ne-K+ ezivikelwe nge-voltage. Ukugeleza kwama-ion ngalezi ziteshi, ikakhulukazi iziteshi ze-Na+, kuvuselela amandla okwenza isenzo ngokuphindaphindiwe nge-axon. Lokhu 'kugxuma' kwamandla okwenza isenzo kusuka kwelinye i-node kuya kwelinye kubizwa ngokuthi i-saltatory conduction. Uma ama-node e-Ranvier engekho ku-axon, amandla esenzo abezokhula kancane kakhulu njengoba iziteshi ze-Na+ ne-K+ kuzodingeka zivuselele amandla esenzo njalo kuzo zonke izindawo ku-axon esikhundleni samaphuzu athile. Ama-node e-Ranvier nawo asindisa amandla e-neuron njengoba iziteshi zidinga ukuba khona kuphela kuma-node hhayi ku-axon yonke.

chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 26. Uhlelo Lwezinzwa | 26.2 Indlela Ama-Neuron Axhumana Ngayo | Ukudluliselwa Kwe-Synaptic
chapterContent: I-synapse noma igebe” yindawo lapho ulwazi ludluliselwa khona lusuka kwenye i-neuron luye kwenye. Ama-synapse avame ukwakheka phakathi kwama-terminal e-axon kanye ne-dendritic spines, kodwa lokhu akulona iqiniso elivamile. Kukhona futhi ama-synapse omzimba e-axon-to-axon, i-dendrite-to-dendrite, kanye ne-axon-to-cell. I-neuron edlulisa isignali ibizwa ngokuthi i-presynaptic neuron, kanti i-neuron ethola isignali ibizwa ngokuthi i-postsynaptic neuron. Qaphela ukuthi lezi zimpawu zihlobene ne-synapse ethile—ama-neurons amaningi angama-presynaptic kanye nama-postsynaptic. Kunezinhlobo ezimbili zama-synapse: amakhemikhali kanye nama-electrical
answer1: Igebe lapho ulwazi ludluliselwa khona kusuka kwelinye i-neuron kuya kwelinye

answer5: Umzimba weseli ukusuka kuseli kuya kweseli
question6: Kungani amagama athi presynaptic kanye nelithi postsynaptic ebhekwa njengahlobene?
answer6: Ama-neurons amaningi angasebenza njengama-neuron angaphambi kwe-synaptic kanye nama-neuron angemva kwe-synaptic kuma-synapses ahlukene
distractor6a: Ama-neurons ashintshashintsha njalo phakathi kwemisebenzi yezinzwa kanye nemisebenzi yokunyakaza

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 26. Uhlelo Lwezinzwa | 26.2 Indlela Ama-Neuron Axhumana Ngayo | Ukudluliselwa Kwe-Synaptic | I-Chemical Synapse
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 26. Uhlelo Lwezinzwa | 26.2 Indlela Ama-Neuron Axhumana Ngayo | Ukudluliselwa Kwe-Synaptic | I-Chemical Synapse
chapterContent:
Uma amandla esenzo efika esigungwini se-axon, asusa i-membrane futhi avule iziteshi ze-Na+ ezivalwe nge-voltage. Ama-ion e-Na+ angena esitokisini, asusa i-membrane ye-presynaptic. Lokhu kususa i-voltage kubangela ukuthi iziteshi ze-Ca2+ ezivalwe nge-voltage zivuleke. Ama-ion e-calcium angena esitokisini aqala i-cascade yesignali ebangela ama-vesicle amancane aboshwe nge-membrane, abizwa ngokuthi ama-synaptic vesicles, aqukethe ama-molecule e-neurotransmitter ukuthi ahlangane ne-membrane ye-presynaptic. Ama-vesicle e-Synaptic aboniswe ku-Figure 26.14, okuyisithombe esivela ku-scanning electron microscope.

 Ukuhlanganiswa kwe-vesicle ne-membrane ye-presynaptic kubangela ukuthi i-neurotransmitter ikhishwe ku-synaptic cleft, isikhala esingaphandle kwe-extracellular phakathi kwe-membrane ye-presynaptic ne-postsynaptic, njengoba kuboniswe ku-Figure 26.15. I-neurotransmitter iyasabalala ku-synaptic cleft futhi ibophe amaprotheni e-receptor ku-membrane ye-postsynaptic.

 Ukubopha kwe-neurotransmitter ethile kubangela ukuthi iziteshi ezithile ze-ion, kulokhu iziteshi ezine-ligand-gated, kulwelwesi lwe-postsynaptic zivuleke. Ama-neurotransmitter angaba nemiphumela yokuvuselela noma yokuvimbela kulwelwesi lwe-postsynaptic. Isibonelo, lapho i-acetylcholine ikhishwa ku-synapse phakathi kwenzwa nemisipha (ebizwa ngokuthi i-neuromuscular junction) yi-presynaptic neuron, kubangela ukuthi iziteshi ze-postsynaptic Na+ zivuleke. I-Na+ ingena kuseli le-postsynaptic futhi ibangele ukuthi ulwelwesi lwe-postsynaptic luqede i-polarize. Lokhu kuqeda i-polarization kubizwa ngokuthi i-excitatory postsynaptic potential (EPSP) futhi kwenza i-postsynaptic neuron ibe namathuba amaningi okuvula amandla okwenza isenzo. Ukukhululwa kwe-neurotransmitter kuma-synapses okuvimbela kubangela amandla okuvimbela i-postsynaptic (IPSPs), i-hyperpolarization yelwelwesi lwe-presynaptic. Isibonelo, lapho i-neurotransmitter GABA (gamma-aminobutyric acid) ikhishwa ku-presynaptic neuron, ibopha futhi ivule ama-Cl-channels. Ama-Cl-ion angena kuseli futhi avuselele ilwelwesi, okwenza i-neuron ibe namathuba amancane okuvula amandla okwenza isenzo.

 Uma sekuvele ukudluliselwa kwemizwa, i-neurotransmitter kumele isuswe ku-synaptic cleft ukuze i-membrane ye-postsynaptic ikwazi ukusetha kabusha” futhi ilungele ukuthola esinye isignali. Lokhu kungenziwa ngezindlela ezintathu: i-neurotransmitter ingasakazeka isuke ku-synaptic cleft, ingawohloka ngama-enzyme ku-synaptic cleft, noma ingaphinde isetshenziswe (ngezinye izikhathi ibizwa ngokuthi i-reuptake) yi-presynaptic neuron. Imithi eminingana isebenza kulesi sinyathelo sokudluliselwa kwemizwa. Isibonelo, eminye imithi enikezwa iziguli ze-Alzheimer's isebenza ngokuvimbela i-acetylcholinesterase, i-enzyme ewohloka i-acetylcholine. Lokhu kuvinjelwa kwe-enzyme empeleni kwandisa ukudluliselwa kwemizwa kuma-synapses akhipha i-acetylcholine. Uma ikhishwe, i-acetylcholine ihlala ku-cleft futhi ingahlala ibopha futhi ikhulule kuma-receptor e-postsynaptic.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 26. Uhlelo Lwezinzwa | 26.2 Indlela Ama-Neuron Axhumana Ngayo | Ukudluliselwa Kwe-Synaptic | I-Synapse Kagesi
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 26. Uhlelo Lwezinzwa | 26.2 Indlela Ama-Neuron Axhumana Ngayo | Ukudluliselwa Kwe-Synaptic | I-Synapse Kagesi
chapterContent:
Nakuba ama-synapse kagesi emancane ngenani kune-synapse yamakhemikhali, atholakala kuzo zonke izinhlelo zezinzwa futhi adlala indima ebalulekile neyingqayizivele. Indlela yokudlulisela i-neurotransmission kuma-synapse kagesi ihluke kakhulu kuleyo yama-synapse amakhemikhali. Ku-synapse kagesi, ama-membrane e-presynaptic ne-postsynaptic asondelene kakhulu futhi empeleni axhunywe ngokomzimba ngamaprotheni esiteshi akha ama-gap junction. Ama-gap junction avumela ukuthi ugesi udlule ngqo kusuka kwelinye iseli uye kwelinye. Ngaphezu kwama-ion athwala lo mshini, amanye ama-molecule, njenge-ATP, angasakazeka ngama-pores amakhulu e-gap junction.

 Kukhona umehluko omkhulu phakathi kwama-synapse amakhemikhali nakagesi. Ngenxa yokuthi ama-synapse amakhemikhali ancike ekukhishweni kwama-molecule e-neurotransmitter kusuka kuma-vesicle e-synaptic ukuze adlule esignalini yawo, kukhona ukubambezeleka cishe kwe-millisecond eyodwa phakathi kokuthi amandla e-axon afika nini esigungwini se-presynaptic kanye nalapho i-neurotransmitter iholela ekuvulekeni kweziteshi ze-ion ze-postsynaptic. Ngaphezu kwalokho, lokhu kudlulisela akuqondisi ndawo. Ukudlulisela i-signal kuma-synapse kagesi, ngokuphambene, kwenzeka ngokushesha (okubalulekile kuma-synapse ahilelekile kuma-reflexes abalulekile), kanti amanye ama-synapse kagesi aqondisi ndawo zombili. Ama-synapse kagesi nawo athembeke kakhulu njengoba engase avinjwe kakhulu, futhi abalulekile ekuvumelaneni komsebenzi kagesi weqembu lama-neurons. Isibonelo, ama-synapse kagesi ku-thalamus kucatshangwa ukuthi alawula ukulala okuhamba kancane, futhi ukuphazamiseka kwala ma-synapse kungabangela ukuquleka.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 26. Uhlelo Lwezinzwa | 26.2 Indlela Ama-Neuron Axhumana Ngayo | Ukufingqa Kwesignali
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 26. Uhlelo Lwezinzwa | 26.2 Indlela Ama-Neuron Axhumana Ngayo | Ukufingqa Kwesignali
chapterContent: Ngezinye izikhathi amandla okuvuselela i-postsynaptic (i-EPSP) eyodwa enamandla ngokwanele ukubangela amandla okwenza isenzo ku-neuron ye-postsynaptic, kodwa ngokuvamile okufakwayo okuningi kwe-presynaptic kumele kudale ama-EPSP ngesikhathi esifanayo ukuze i-neuron ye-postsynaptic isuswe ngokwanele ukuze ivuse amandla okwenza isenzo. Le nqubo ibizwa ngokuthi i-summation futhi yenzeka e-axon hillock, njengoba kuboniswe ku-Figure 26.16. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-neuron eyodwa ivame ukuba nokufakwa okuvela kuma-neuron amaningi e-presynaptic—amanye avuselelayo kanti amanye avimbelayo—ngakho ama-IPSP angakhansela ama-EPSP futhi okuphambene nalokho. Ushintsho oluphelele ku-voltage ye-postsynaptic membrane olunquma ukuthi iseli le-postsynaptic selifinyelele yini umkhawulo walo wokuvuselela okudingekayo ukuze kuvuse amandla okwenza isenzo. Ndawonye, ukuhlanganisa kwe-synaptic kanye nomkhawulo wokuvuselela kusebenza njengesihlungi ukuze umsindo ongahleliwe” ohlelweni ungadluliswa njengolwazi olubalulekile.
answer1: Umphumela ohlangene wama-potential amaningi e-postsynaptic onquma ukuthi ngabe amandla esenzo akhiqizwa yini
question2: Kwenzeka kuphi ukufinyela ku-neuron?
question3: Kungani kuvame ukudingeka ama-EPSP amaningi?

distractor3c: Ama-EPSP awakwazi ukuhamba aye egqumeni le-axon

answer6: Zinciphisa ukuwohloka kwesimo futhi zenze amathuba esenzo abe mancane amathuba

question8: Bheka uMfanekiso 26.16. Yisiphi isitatimende mayelana nokuhlanganiswa kwesignali esiyiqiniso?

distractor8a: Ama-EPSP kuphela athonya ukuthi kungenzeka yini ukuthi isenzo sivele
distractor8b: Ukuhlanganiswa kwenzeka ezindaweni zokugcina i-axon lapho kukhishwa khona ama-neurotransmitter

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 26. Uhlelo Lwezinzwa | 26.2 Indlela Ama-Neuron Axhumana Ngayo | Isixhumanisi Sobuchopho Nekhompyutha
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 26. Uhlelo Lwezinzwa | 26.2 Indlela Ama-Neuron Axhumana Ngayo | Isixhumanisi Sobuchopho Nekhompyutha
chapterContent:
I-Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (i-ALS, ebizwa nangokuthi i-Lou Gehrig’s Disease) yisifo sezinzwa esibonakala ngokuwohloka kwama-motor neurons alawula ukunyakaza okuzithandela. Lesi sifo siqala ngobuthakathaka bemisipha kanye nokuntuleka kokuxhumana futhi ekugcineni sibhubhisa ama-neurons alawula ukukhuluma, ukuphefumula, kanye nokugwinya; ekugcineni, lesi sifo singaholela ekukhubazekeni. Ngaleso sikhathi, iziguli zidinga usizo oluvela emishinini ukuze zikwazi ukuphefumula nokuxhumana. Kuye kwasungulwa ubuchwepheshe obuningana obukhethekile ukuze kuvunyelwe iziguli ezivalelwe ngaphakathi ukuthi zixhumane nomhlaba wonke. Ubuchwepheshe obunye, isibonelo, buvumela iziguli ukuthi zibhale imisho ngokunyakazisa isihlathi sazo. Le misho ingafundwa ngokuzwakalayo yikhompyutha.

 Uchungechunge olusha locwaningo lokusiza iziguli ezikhubazekile, okuhlanganisa nalabo abane-ALS, ukuxhumana nokugcina izinga lokuzimela lubizwa ngokuthi ubuchwepheshe be-brain-computer interface (BCI) futhi luboniswe kuMfanekiso 26.17. Lobu buchwepheshe buzwakala njengento engaphandle kwesayensi: buvumela iziguli ezikhubazekile ukulawula ikhompyutha zisebenzisa imicabango yazo kuphela. Kunezinhlobo eziningana ze-BCI. Ezinye izinhlobo zisebenzisa ukuqoshwa kwe-EEG kusuka kuma-electrode anamathiselwe ekhanda. Lokhu kuqoshwa kuqukethe ulwazi oluvela ezixukwini ezinkulu zama-neurons ezingachazwa yikhompyutha. Ezinye izinhlobo ze-BCI zidinga ukufakwa kweqoqo lama-electrode amancane kunesitembu seposi engalweni nasezandleni ze-motor cortex. Lolu hlobo lwe-BCI, yize luhlasela kakhulu, lunamandla kakhulu njengoba i-electrode ngayinye ingaqopha amandla esenzo angempela avela kuma-neurons eyodwa noma ngaphezulu. Lezi zimpawu zithunyelwa kukhompyutha, enayo baqeqeshwe ukunquma isignali bese beyipha ithuluzi—njengesikhombisi esikrinini sekhompyutha. Lokhu kusho ukuthi isiguli esine-ALS singasebenzisa i-imeyili, sifunde i-inthanethi, futhi sixhumane nabanye ngokucabanga ngokuhambisa isandla noma ingalo yaso (yize isiguli esikhubazekile singenakukwazi ukwenza lokho kunyakaza komzimba). Intuthuko yakamuva ivumele isiguli esikhubazekile esivalelwe ngaphakathi esahlushwa isifo sohlangothi eminyakeni eyi-15 eyedlule ukuthi silawule ingalo yerobhothi futhi siziphe ikhofi sisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe be-BCI.

 Naphezu kwentuthuko emangalisayo kubuchwepheshe be-BCI, nayo inemikhawulo. Ubuchwepheshe bungadinga amahora amaningi okuqeqeshwa kanye nezikhathi ezinde zokugxila okukhulu kwesiguli; kungadinga nokuhlinzwa kobuchopho ukuze kufakwe amadivayisi.
answer1: Isifo sezinzwa lapho ama-neuron emisipha alawula ukunyakaza ngokuzithandela ewohloka khona

answer8: Ngokucabanga ngokuhambisa isandla noma ingalo yabo, okuvumela ikhompyutha ukuthi ichaze ukunyakaza okuhlosiwe
distractor8b: Ngokushukumisa amehlo abo ukuze bakhiqize amandla esenzo
question9: Yimuphi umsebenzi oye wafezwa kusetshenziswa ubuchwepheshe obuthuthukisiwe be-BCI?
answer9: Ukulawula ingalo yerobhothi ukuze inike isiguli ikhofi
question10: Yimuphi umkhawulo owodwa wobuchwepheshe bokuxhumana kobuchopho namakhompyutha?
answer10: Kungadinga ukuqeqeshwa okubanzi, futhi kwezinye izimo, ukuhlinzwa kobuchopho

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 26. Uhlelo Lwezinzwa | 26.2 Indlela Ama-Neuron Axhumana Ngayo | I-Synaptic Plasticity | I-Long-term Potentiation (LTP)
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 26. Uhlelo Lwezinzwa | 26.2 Indlela Ama-Neuron Axhumana Ngayo | I-Synaptic Plasticity | I-Long-term Potentiation (LTP)
chapterContent:
Ama-synapses awazona izakhiwo ezimile. Angabuthakathaka noma aqiniswe. Angaphuka, futhi kungenziwa ama-synapses amasha. I-synaptic plasticity ivumela lezi zinguquko, ezidingekayo ohlelweni lwezinzwa olusebenzayo. Eqinisweni, i-synaptic plasticity iyisisekelo sokufunda nokukhumbula. Izinqubo ezimbili ikakhulukazi, i-long-term potentiation (LTP) kanye nokucindezeleka kwesikhathi eside (LTD) yizinhlobo ezibalulekile ze-synaptic plasticity ezenzeka kuma-synapses ku-hippocampus, isifunda sobuchopho esihilelekile ekugcineni izinkumbulo.

 I-Long-term Potentiation (LTP)
I-long-term potentiation (LTP) iwukuqina okuqhubekayo koxhumano lwe-synaptic. I-LTP isekelwe esimisweni sase-Hebrew: amaseli ahlangana ndawonye axhumanisa. Kunezindlela ezahlukahlukene, okungekho okuqondakala ngokugcwele, ngemuva kokuqina kwe-synaptic okubonwa nge-LTP. Enye indlela eyaziwayo ihilela uhlobo lwe-postsynaptic glutamate receptor, olubizwa ngokuthi ama-NMDA (N-Methyl-D-aspartate) receptors, oluboniswe kuMfanekiso 26.18. Lawa ma-receptor avame ukuvinjelwa ama-ion e-magnesium; Nokho, lapho i-neuron ye-postsynaptic isuswa yi-inputs eziningi ze-presynaptic ngokulandelana okusheshayo (kungaba yi-neuron eyodwa noma ama-neurons amaningi), ama-ion e-magnesium ayaphoqeleka ukuphuma okuvumela ama-ion e-Ca2+ ukuthi adlulele esitokisini se-postsynaptic. Okulandelayo, ama-ion e-Ca2+ angena esitokisini aqala i-cascade yokubonisa ebangela uhlobo oluhlukile lwe-receptor ye-glutamate, ebizwa ngokuthi i-AMPA (α-amino-3-hydroxy-5-methyl-4-isoxazolepropionic acid) receptors, ukuthi ifakwe elweleni le-postsynaptic, njengoba ama-receptor e-AMPA asebenzayo evumela ama-ion amahle ukuthi angene esitokisini. Ngakho-ke, ngesikhathi esizayo lapho i-glutamate ikhishwa elweleni le-presynaptic, izoba nomphumela omkhulu wokuvuselela (EPSP) esitokisini se-postsynaptic ngoba ukubopha kwe-glutamate kula ma-receptor e-AMPA kuzovumela ama-ion amahle kakhulu esitokisini. Ukufakwa kwama-receptor e-AMPA engeziwe kuqinisa i-synapse futhi kusho ukuthi i-neuron ye-postsynaptic cishe izovutha ngenxa yokukhululwa kwe-neurotransmitter ye-presynaptic.
answer1: Amandla e-synapses okuqinisa, ukwenza buthaka, ukwakha, noma ukususwa
question2: I-synaptic plasticity iyisisekelo samiphi imisebenzi emibili ebalulekile yobuchopho?
question3: Kukusiphi isifunda sobuchopho lapho i-long-term potentiation (LTP) kanye nokucindezeleka kwesikhathi eside (LTD) kwenzeka khona ngokuyinhloko?
question4: Kuyini amandla okudala isikhathi eside (i-LTP)?
question5: Yisiphi isimiso esiyisisekelo sokuthuthukiswa kwesikhathi eside?
question6: Yiluphi uhlobo lwe-postsynaptic receptor oluvame ukuvinjelwa ama-ion e-magnesium?
question7: Yini ebangela ukuthi ama-ion e-magnesium aphume kuma-receptor e-NMDA?
answer7: Ukususwa kwe-neuron ye-postsynaptic ngokufakwa okuningi kwe-presynaptic
question8: Yiliphi i-ion elingena kuseli le-postsynaptic ngama-receptor e-NMDA ngemva kokususwa kwe-magnesium block?
question9: Ukungena kwe-calcium kuba namuphi umphumela ngesikhathi se-LTP?
answer9: Kubangela ukufakwa kwama-receptor e-AMPA engeziwe kulwelwesi lwe-postsynaptic
question10: Kungani ukwengeza ama-receptor e-AMPA amaningi kuqinisa i-synapse?
answer10: Ama-ion amahle kakhulu angena kuseli le-postsynaptic lapho i-glutamate ibopha, okukhiqiza i-EPSP enkulu
distractor10a: Ama-ion e-chloride engeziwe angena esitokisini, akhiqize i-hyperpolarization

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 26. Uhlelo Lwezinzwa | 26.2 Indlela Ama-Neuron Axhumana Ngayo | Ukuqina Kwe-Synaptic | Ukucindezeleka Kwesikhathi Eside (LTD)
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 26. Uhlelo Lwezinzwa | 26.2 Indlela Ama-Neuron Axhumana Ngayo | Ukuqina Kwe-Synaptic | Ukucindezeleka Kwesikhathi Eside (LTD)
chapterContent:
Ama-synapses awazona izakhiwo ezimile. Angabuthakathaka noma aqiniswe. Angaphuka, futhi kungenziwa ama-synapses amasha. I-synaptic plasticity ivumela lezi zinguquko, ezidingekayo ohlelweni lwezinzwa olusebenzayo. Eqinisweni, i-synaptic plasticity iyisisekelo sokufunda nokukhumbula. Izinqubo ezimbili ikakhulukazi, i-long-term potentiation (LTP) kanye nokucindezeleka kwesikhathi eside (LTD) yizinhlobo ezibalulekile ze-synaptic plasticity ezenzeka kuma-synapses ku-hippocampus, indawo yobuchopho ehilelekile ekugcineni izinkumbulo.

 Ukucindezeleka Kwesikhathi Eside (LTD)
Ukucindezeleka kwesikhathi eside (LTD) empeleni kuphambene ne-LTP: kuwubuthakathaka besikhathi eside bokuxhumana kwe-synaptic. Enye indlela eyaziwa ngokubangela i-LTD ihlanganisa nama-receptor e-AMPA. Kulesi simo, i-calcium engena ngama-receptor e-NMDA iqala i-cascade ehlukile yokubonisa izimpawu, okuholela ekususweni kwama-receptor e-AMPA kusuka ku-membrane ye-postsynaptic, njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 26.18. Ukwehla kwama-receptor e-AMPA ku-membrane kwenza i-neuron ye-postsynaptic ingasabeli kahle ku-glutamate ekhishwe ku-neuron ye-presynaptic. Nakuba kungase kubonakale kungqubuzana, i-LTD ingaba yinto ebalulekile ekufundeni nasekukhumbuleni njenge-LTP. Ubuthakathaka nokunqunywa kwama-synapses angasetshenziswanga kuvumela ukuthi ukuxhumana okungabalulekile kulahleke futhi kwenza ama-synapses adlule ku-LTP abe namandla kangako uma kuqhathaniswa.
answer1: Ubuthakathaka besikhathi eside bokuxhumana kwe-synaptic
question2: Yimaphi ama-receptor asuswa kulwelwesi lwe-postsynaptic ngesikhathi se-LTD?
question3: Yimuphi u-ion oqala i-cascade yesiginali eholela ku-LTD?
question4: Yimaphi ama-receptor lapho i-calcium ingena khona ku-neuron ye-postsynaptic ngesikhathi se-LTD?
question5: Uyini umphumela oqondile wokususa ama-receptor e-AMPA kusuka kulwelwesi lwe-postsynaptic?
answer5: I-neuron ye-postsynaptic ayibe isabeli kahle ku-glutamate
question6: Kungani ukucindezeleka kwesikhathi eside (LTD) kubalulekile?
answer6: Inciphisa futhi inqume ama-synapses angasetshenziswanga, isiza ekuphuculeni izifunda ze-neural ezihilelekile ekufundeni nasekukhumbuleni
question7: I-LTD ihambisana kanjani ne-long-term potentiation (LTP)?
answer7: Ngokususa ama-synapse abuthakathaka noma angasetshenziswanga, okwenza ama-synapse aqinisiwe asebenze kangcono
distractor7b: Ngokufaka iziteshi ze-sodium esikhundleni sama-receptor e-NMDA
question8: Bheka uMfanekiso 26.18. Yisiphi isitatimende esiqhathanisa kahle i-LTP ne-LTD?
answer8: I-LTP ifaka ama-receptor e-AMPA ukuze iqinise ama-synapses, kanti i-LTD isusa ama-receptor e-AMPA ukuze yenze buthaka ama-synapses.
distractor8a: Kokubili i-LTP ne-LTD zisusa ama-receptor e-AMPA
distractor8b: I-LTP isusa ama-receptor e-NMDA, kanti i-LTD ifaka ama-receptor e-NMDA
distractor8c: Kokubili i-LTP kanye ne-LTD kwandisa inani lama-receptor e-AMPA

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 26. Uhlelo Lwezinzwa | 26.3 Uhlelo Lwezinzwa Oluphakathi | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 26. Uhlelo Lwezinzwa | 26.3 Uhlelo Lwezinzwa Oluphakathi | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent:
Uhlelo lwezinzwa oluphakathi (i-CNS) luqukethe ubuchopho kanye nentambo yomgogodla, zombili ezivikelwe yikhanda kanye nekholomu yomgogodla, ngokulandelana. I-CNS ithola ulwazi lwezinzwa, ihlanganisa lolu lwazi, futhi iqalise impendulo yemoto, lapho ubuchopho busebenza njengesikhungo sokulawula sokucubungula ulwazi lwezinzwa nokuqondisa izimpendulo. Izingxenye ezahlukene zobuchopho bezilwane ezinomgogodla (kufaka phakathi ezethu) zinemisebenzi ehlukene, futhi intuthuko yobuchopho ezilwaneni iveza inqubekela phambili eyingqayizivele yokuziphendukela kwemvelo. Akudingeki ukuthi ubambe ngekhanda zonke izingxenye ezahlukene zobuchopho kanye nemisebenzi yazo ye-AP. Kodwa-ke, njengomfundi webhayoloji, kufanele ube nokuqonda okujwayelekile kwezingxenye ezintathu ezinkulu zobuchopho kanye nemisebenzi yazo.

 Ezincelisayo, izingxenye zobuchopho zifaka phakathi i-cerebrum noma i-cortex (engahlukaniswa ibe yizicucu ezine eziyinhloko: i-frontal, i-temporal, i-occipital, kanye ne-parietal), i-basal ganglia, i-thalamus, i-hypothalamus, i-limbic system, i-cerebellum, kanye ne-brainstem. Ulwazi oluhamba ngentambo yomgogodla luye ebuchosheni luqondiswa kwenye yezindawo ezikhethekile ze-cerebrum; isibonelo, izindawo zokuzwa ezihambisanayo zitholakala endaweni ye-temporal lobe. I-cerebellum isiza ukuxhumanisa umsebenzi wemisipha yamathambo, kanti i-medulla oblongata kanye nama-pons ku-brainstem kuyizikhungo zemisebenzi ebalulekile, njengokuphefumula kanye nokushaya kwenhliziyo. Nakuba kwenzeka indawo yemisebenzi, imisebenzi eminingi eyinkimbinkimbi, njengolimi, ihilela ama-neurons ezindaweni eziningi zobuchopho. Ngokuphathelene namandla, njengoba ubuchopho busebenzisa cishe amaphesenti angama-20 ezinsizakalweni zomzimba (i-ATP), ingabe kuyamangaza ukuthi ukhathele ngemva kokuthatha isivivinyo se-AP®? Ulwazi oluvela ebuchosheni luhamba phansi entanjeni yomgogodla, lwenze ukuxhumana nezinzwa zangaphandle; ngakho-ke, intambo yomgogodla idlulisela okokufaka kwemizwa kanye nokunyakaza futhi ilawula ukusabela kwemisipha, njengezimpendulo ezizenzakalelayo lapho izimbotshana zeso lakho zincipha elangeni elikhanyayo noma lapho ususa isandla sakho entweni eshisayo.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyisiwe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo echazwe ku-Big Idea 3 ye-AP® Biology Curriculum Framework. Izinhloso Zokufunda ze-AP® ezibalwe kuHlelo Lwezifundo zinikeza isisekelo esicacile sesifundo se-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekubuzeni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo nomunye noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa.

3.E.2 Izilwane zinezinhlelo zezinzwa ezibona izimpawu zangaphandle nezangaphakathi, zidlulise futhi zihlanganise ulwazi, futhi zikhiqize izimpendulo.
Ukuzijwayeza Kwesayensi
1.1 Umfundi angadala izethulo namamodeli ezethulo nezinhlelo zemvelo noma ezenziwe ngabantu endaweni.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
3.50 Umfundi uyakwazi ukudala umfanekiso obonakalayo ukuchaza indlela ubuchopho besilwane esinomgogodla obuhlanganisa ngayo ulwazi ukuze kukhiqizwe impendulo.

 Njengoba kushiwo ngenhla, uhlelo lwezinzwa oluphakathi (i-CNS) lwakhiwe ubuchopho, ingxenye yalo eboniswe kuMfanekiso 26.19 kanye nentambo yomgogodla futhi lumbozwe ngezingqimba ezintathu zezembozo zokuzivikela ezibizwa ngokuthi ama-meninges (kusukela egameni lesiGreki elisho ulwelwesi). Ingqimba engaphandle yi-dura mater (isiLatini esisho umama oqinile”). Njengoba isiLatini sisikisela, umsebenzi oyinhloko walolu ngqimba olujiyile ukuvikela ubuchopho kanye nentambo yomgogodla. I-dura mater iqukethe nezakhiwo ezifana nemithambo ezithwala igazi lisuka ebuchosheni libuyele enhliziyweni. Ingqimba ephakathi yi-arachnoid mater efana newebhu. Ingqimba yokugcina yi-pia mater (isiLatini esisho umama othambile”), ethinta ngqo futhi imboze ubuchopho kanye nentambo yomgogodla njenge-plastic wrap. Isikhala esiphakathi kwe-arachnoid kanye ne-pia maters sigcwele uketshezi lwe-cerebrospinal (CSF). I-CSF ikhiqizwa yizicubu ezibizwa ngokuthi i-choroid plexus ezindaweni ezigcwele uketshezi ku-CNS ezibizwa ngama-ventricles. Ubuchopho buntanta ku-CSF, esebenza njengomcamelo kanye nomswaki wokushaqeka futhi kwenze ubuchopho bube buthambile. I-CSF iphinde isebenze ukujikeleza izinto zamakhemikhali kulo lonke ubuchopho kanye nasentanjeni yomgogodla.

 Ubuchopho bonke buqukethe cishe izipuni ezingu-8.5 ze-CSF, kodwa i-CSF ikhiqizwa njalo kuma-ventricles. Lokhu kudala inkinga lapho i-ventricle ivinjiwe—i-CSF iyakhula futhi idale ukuvuvukala bese ubuchopho bucindezelwa ekhanda. Lesi simo sokuvuvukala sibizwa ngokuthi i-hydrocephalus (ikhanda lamanzi) futhi singabangela ukuxhuzula, izinkinga zokuqonda, ngisho nokufa uma i-shunt ingafakwanga ukususa uketshezi kanye nengcindezi.

chapterContent: Ubuchopho buyingxenye yesimiso sezinzwa esiyinhloko esitholakala emgodini wekhanda. Kunezindlela ezintathu ezahlukene ubuchopho obungahlukaniswa ngazo ukuze kubonwe izakhiwo zangaphakathi: isigaba se-sagittal sinquma ubuchopho kusukela kwesobunxele kuya kwesokudla, njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 26.21b, isigaba se-coronal sinquma ubuchopho kusukela phambili kuya emuva, njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 26.20a, kanye nesigaba esivundlile sinquma ingxenye yobuchopho kusukela phezulu kuya phansi.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 26. Uhlelo Lwezinzwa | 26.3 Uhlelo Lwezinzwa Oluphakathi | Ubuchopho | I-Cerebral Cortex
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 26. Uhlelo Lwezinzwa | 26.3 Uhlelo Lwezinzwa Oluphakathi | Ubuchopho | I-Cerebral Cortex
chapterContent:
Ingxenye engaphandle yobuchopho iyingcezu ejiyile yezicubu zesimiso sezinzwa ezibizwa ngokuthi i-cerebral cortex, egoqwe yaba amagquma abizwa ngokuthi i-gyri (esinye: i-gyrus) kanye nezigodi ezibizwa ngokuthi i-sulci (esinye: i-sulcus). I-cortex yakhiwe ngama-hemispheres amabili—kwesokudla nakwesobunxele—ahlukaniswe yi-sulcus enkulu. Inqwaba yefayibha ejiyile ebizwa ngokuthi i-corpus callosum (ngesiLatini: umzimba oqinile”) ixhumanisa ama-hemispheres amabili futhi ivumela ulwazi ukuthi ludluliselwe kolunye uhlangothi luye kolunye. Nakuba kuneminye imisebenzi yobuchopho etholakala kakhulu ku-hemisphere eyodwa kunenye, imisebenzi yama-hemispheres amabili ayisebenzi kakhulu. Eqinisweni, ngezinye izikhathi (kancane kakhulu) i-hemisphere yonke isuswa ukuze kwelashwe isifo sokuwa esibi kakhulu. Ngenkathi iziguli zihlushwa ukuntuleka okuthile ngemva kokuhlinzwa, zingaba nezinkinga ezimbalwa ngokumangazayo, ikakhulukazi lapho ukuhlinzwa kwenziwa ezinganeni ezinezinhlelo zezinzwa ezingakavuthwa kahle.

 Kwezinye izinhlinzeko zokwelapha isifo sokuwa esibi kakhulu, i-corpus callosum iyanqunywa esikhundleni sokususa i-hemisphere yonke. Lokhu kubangela isimo esibizwa ngokuthi ubuchopho obuhlukanisiwe, okunikeza ukuqonda ngemisebenzi eyingqayizivele yama-hemispheres amabili. Isibonelo, lapho into yethulwa ensimini yokubona yesobunxele yeziguli, zingase zingakwazi ukusho igama lento ngamazwi (futhi zingase zithi azikaze zibone into nhlobo). Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi okokufaka okubonakalayo okuvela ensimini yokubona yesobunxele kuyadlula futhi kungene ku-hemisphere yesokudla futhi akukwazi ukuthumela isibonakaliso esikhungweni sokukhuluma, esivame ukutholakala ohlangothini lwesobunxele lobuchopho. Ngokuphawulekayo, uma isiguli esinobuchopho obuhlukene sicelwa ukuba sithathe into ethile eqenjini lezinto ngesandla sobunxele, isiguli sizokwazi ukwenza kanjalo kodwa ngeke sikwazi ukuyikhomba ngezwi.

 I-cortical hemisphere ngayinye iqukethe izifunda ezibizwa ngokuthi ama-lobes ahilelekile emisebenzini ehlukene. Ososayensi basebenzisa amasu ahlukahlukene ukuthola ukuthi yiziphi izindawo zobuchopho ezihilelekile emisebenzini ehlukene: bahlola iziguli eziye zaba nokulimala noma izifo ezithinta izindawo ezithile futhi babone ukuthi lezo zindawo zihlobene kanjani nokuntuleka kokusebenza. Baphinde benze izifundo zezilwane lapho bevuselela khona izindawo zobuchopho futhi babone ukuthi kukhona yini izinguquko zokuziphatha. Basebenzisa inqubo ebizwa ngokuthi i-transcranial magnetic stimulation (TMS) ukuze bavale okwesikhashana izingxenye ezithile ze-cortex besebenzisa omaginethi abanamandla ababekwe ngaphandle kwekhanda; futhi basebenzisa i-functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) ukuze babheke izinguquko ekugelezeni kwegazi okunomoya-mpilo ezindaweni ezithile zobuchopho ezihambisana nemisebenzi ethile yokuziphatha. Lawa masu, kanye namanye, anikeze ukuqonda okukhulu ngemisebenzi yezifunda ezahlukene zobuchopho kodwa futhi abonise ukuthi noma iyiphi indawo yobuchopho ingabandakanyeka ekuziphatheni noma enqubweni engaphezu kweyodwa, futhi noma yikuphi ukuziphatha noma inqubo enikeziwe ngokuvamile ihilela ama-neurons ezindaweni eziningi zobuchopho. Lokho kusho ukuthi, ngayinye I-hemisphere ye-cortex yobuchopho yezilwane ezincelisayo ingahlukaniswa ibe ama-lobes amane achazwe ngokusebenza nangokuhlelekile: i-frontal, i-parietal, i-temporal, kanye ne-occipital. Isithombe 26.21 sibonisa la ma-lobes amane e-cortex yobuchopho bomuntu.

 I-frontal lobe itholakala ngaphambili kobuchopho, phezu kwamehlo. Le lobe iqukethe i-bulb ye-olfactory, ecubungula iphunga. I-frontal lobe iqukethe ne-motor cortex, ebalulekile ekuhleleni nasekuqaliseni ukunyakaza. Izindawo ezingaphakathi kwe-motor cortex zihambisana namaqembu emisipha ahlukene, futhi kukhona ukuhlelwa okuthile kule mephu, njengoba kuboniswe ku-Figure 26.22. Isibonelo, ama-neurons alawula ukunyakaza kweminwe aseduze nama-neurons alawula ukunyakaza kwesandla. Ama-neurons ku-frontal lobe nawo alawula imisebenzi yokuqonda njengokugcina ukunaka, inkulumo, kanye nokwenza izinqumo. Izifundo zabantu abalimaze ama-front lobes abo zibonisa ukuthi izingxenye zale ndawo zihilelekile ebuntwini, ekuxhumaneni nabantu, nasekuhloleni ingozi.

 I-parietal lobe itholakala phezulu kobuchopho. Ama-Neurons ku- I-parietal lobe ihilelekile ekukhulumeni nasekufundeni. Imisebenzi emibili eyinhloko ye-parietal lobe ukucubungula imizwa ye-somatosensation—imizwa yokuthinta efana nokucindezela, ubuhlungu, ukushisa, ukubanda—kanye nokucubungula i-proprioception—umuzwa wokuthi izingxenye zomzimba ziqondiswa kanjani esikhaleni. I-parietal lobe iqukethe imephu ye-somatosensory yomzimba efana ne-motor cortex.

 I-occipital lobe itholakala ngemuva kobuchopho. Ihileleke kakhulu embonweni—ekuboneni, ekuqapheleni, nasekuhlonzeni umhlaba obonakalayo.

 I-temporal lobe itholakala phansi kobuchopho ngezindlebe zakho futhi ihileleke kakhulu ekucubunguleni nasekuchazeni imisindo. Iphinde iqukethe i-hippocampus (isiGreki i-seahorse”)—isakhiwo esicubungula ukwakheka kwenkumbulo. I-hippocampus iboniswe kuMfanekiso 26.24. Indima ye-hippocampus enkumbulweni yanqunywa ngokwengxenye ngokutadisha isiguli esidumile esinesifo sokuwa, u-HM, owasuswa izinhlangothi zombili ze-hippocampus yakhe ezama ukwelapha isifo sakhe sokuwa. Ukuwa kwakhe kwaphela, kodwa wayengasakwazi ukwakha izinkumbulo ezintsha (yize ayekwazi ukukhumbula amaqiniso athile ngaphambi kokuhlinzwa kwakhe futhi engafunda imisebenzi emisha yokunyakaza).

 Bheka Isithombe 26.23. Uma kuqhathaniswa nezinye izilwane ezinomgogodla, izilwane ezincelisayo zinobuchopho obukhulu kakhulu ngobukhulu bomzimba wazo. Ubuchopho bengwenya yonke, isibonelo, buzogcwalisa cishe ithisipuni elilodwa nesigamu. Lokhu kwanda kwesilinganiso sobukhulu bobuchopho nomzimba kubonakala kakhulu ezinkawini, imikhomo, namahlengethwa. Ngenkathi lokhu kwanda kobukhulu bobuchopho ngokungenakungatshazwa kudlale indima ekuguqukeni kokuziphatha okuyinkimbinkimbi okuhlukile ezincelisayo, akulandisi yonke indaba. Ososayensi bathole ubudlelwano phakathi kwendawo ephezulu kakhulu ye-cortex kanye nobuhlakani kanye nokuziphatha okuyinkimbinkimbi komphakathi okuboniswa ezinye izilwane ezincelisayo. Le ndawo engaphezulu yobuso ibangelwa, ngokwengxenye, ukugoqeka okwandisiwe kweshidi le-cortical (i-sulci eyengeziwe ne-gyri). Isibonelo, i-cortex yegundane ibushelelezi kakhulu nge-sulci ne-gyri ezimbalwa kakhulu. Ama-cortice ekati nezimvu ane-sulci ne-gyri eyengeziwe. Ama-chimp, abantu, namahlengethwa anokunye okuningi.
answer1: Ingqimba engaphandle yobuchopho eyenziwe ngezicubu zemizwa

distractor12a: I-lobe ngayinye ilawula uhlobo olulodwa kuphela lwemisipha
distractor12b: Ama-motor neurons asatshalaliswa ngokungahleliwe kulo lonke i-cortex

question14: Uma kuqhathaniswa nezinye izilwane eziningi ezinomgogodla, kungani izilwane ezincelisayo zivame ukubonisa ukuziphatha okuyinkimbinkimbi kakhulu?
answer14: Ngokuvamile banobuchopho obukhulu uma kuqhathaniswa nobukhulu bomzimba kanye ne-cerebral cortex egoqeke kakhulu enendawo enkulu ebusweni.
distractor14b: Zinezindawo eziningi kakhulu kunezinye izilwane ezinomgogodla
question15: Yisiphi isici se-cortex yobuchopho yezilwane ezincelisayo esihlotshaniswa nokuhlakanipha okukhulu kanye nokuziphatha okuyinkimbinkimbi komphakathi?
answer15: Ukugoqa okukhulu kwe-cortical okwandisa indawo engaphezulu ngokwakha i-gyri ne-sulci eyengeziwe

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 26. Uhlelo Lwezinzwa | 26.3 Uhlelo Lwezinzwa Oluphakathi | Ubuchopho | I-Basal Ganglia
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 26. Uhlelo Lwezinzwa | 26.3 Uhlelo Lwezinzwa Oluphakathi | Ubuchopho | I-Basal Ganglia
chapterContent: Izindawo zobuchopho ezixhumene ezibizwa ngokuthi i-basal ganglia (noma i-basal nuclei), eziboniswe kuMfanekiso 26.20b, zidlala indima ebalulekile ekulawuleni ukunyakaza kanye nokuma. Ukulimala kwe-basal ganglia, njengasesifo sikaParkinson, kuholela ekuphazamisekeni kwemisipha njengokuhamba kancane lapho uhamba. I-basal ganglia nayo ilawula isisusa. Isibonelo, lapho ukugwazwa yinyosi kuholela ekulimaleni kwe-basal ganglia emaceleni omabili kusomabhizinisi oneminyaka engu-25 ubudala, waqala ukuchitha zonke izinsuku zakhe embhedeni futhi akabonisanga sithakazelo kunoma yini noma kunoma ubani. Kodwa lapho eshukunyiswa ngaphandle—njengalapho othile ecela ukudlala umdlalo wamakhadi naye—wakwazi ukusebenza ngendlela evamile. Ngokuthakazelisayo, yena nezinye iziguli ezifanayo ababiki ukuthi bazizwa benesithukuthezi noma bekhungathekile ngesimo sabo.
answer1: Ukulawula ukunyakaza kanye nesimo somzimba
question2: Ukulimala kwe-basal ganglia, njengasesifo sikaParkinson, kuvame ukubangela luphi uphawu?
question3: Ngaphandle kokunyakaza, yimuphi omunye umsebenzi i-basal ganglia esiza ukuwulawula?
question4: Yikuphi ukuziphatha okungavamile okwabonwa esigulini esinomonakalo we-basal ganglia emaceleni amabili?
answer4: Wayentula isisusa ngaphandle kokuthi kushukunyiswe ngaphandle
question5: Bheka uMfanekiso 26.20. Yisiphi isitatimende mayelana ne-basal ganglia esiyiqiniso?
answer5: Ziyizindawo zobuchopho ezixhumene ezihilelekile ekulawuleni ukunyakaza, ukuma, kanye nokugqugquzela

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 26. Uhlelo Lwezinzwa | 26.3 Uhlelo Lwezinzwa Oluphakathi | Ubuchopho | I-Thalamus
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 26. Uhlelo Lwezinzwa | 26.3 Uhlelo Lwezinzwa Oluphakathi | Ubuchopho | I-Thalamus
chapterContent: I-thalamus (igama lesiGreki elisho ikamelo langaphakathi”), eliboniswe kuMfanekiso 26.24, isebenza njengesango eliya nelibuya ku-cortex. Ithola okufakwayo kwezinzwa kanye nokunyakaza okuvela emzimbeni futhi ithola nempendulo evela ku-cortex. Le ndlela yokuphendula ingashintsha ukuqonda okuqaphelayo kokufakwayo kwezinzwa kanye nokunyakaza kuye ngokuthi isilwane sinake kanjani futhi sivukile yini. I-thalamus isiza ekulawuleni ukuqonda, ukuvuka, kanye nezimo zokulala. Isifo esingavamile sofuzo esibizwa ngokuthi i-fatal familial insomnia sibangela ukuwohloka kwama-neurons e-thalamic kanye ne-glia. Lesi sifo sivimbela iziguli ezithintekile ukuthi zingakwazi ukulala, phakathi kwezinye izimpawu, futhi ekugcineni sibulala.
answer1: Isebenza njengesango eliya futhi libuya ku-cortex yobuchopho
question2: Yiziphi izinhlobo zolwazi olutholwa yi-thalamus emzimbeni?
question3: Impendulo evela ku-cerebral cortex iyithinta kanjani i-thalamus?
answer3: Ilawula ukuqwashisa okuqaphelayo kokufakwa kwezinzwa kanye nezimoto
distractor3a: Kuvimba amandla okwenza isenzo ukuthi angafinyeleli ku-cortex
question4: Yimiphi imisebenzi elawulwa yi-thalamus?
distractor4a: Ukugaya ukudla, ukuphefumula, kanye nokujikeleza kwegazi
distractor4c: Ukukhiqizwa kwama-hormone kanye nokusetshenziswa kwawo emzimbeni
question5: Ukungalali kahle komndeni okubulalayo kubangelwa ukuwohloka kwamangqamuzana aphi?
question6: Bheka uMfanekiso 26.24. Yisiphi isitatimende mayelana ne-thalamus esiyiqiniso?
answer6: Isebenza njengesango eliphakathi komzimba ne-cerebral cortex futhi isiza ekulawuleni ukulala kanye nokuqwashisa

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 26. Uhlelo Lwezinzwa | 26.3 Uhlelo Lwezinzwa Oluphakathi | Ubuchopho | I-Hypothalamus
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 26. Uhlelo Lwezinzwa | 26.3 Uhlelo Lwezinzwa Oluphakathi | Ubuchopho | I-Hypothalamus
chapterContent: Ngaphansi kwe-thalamus kukhona i-hypothalamus, eboniswe kuMfanekiso 26.24. I-hypothalamus ilawula uhlelo lwe-endocrine ngokuthumela izimpawu ku-pituitary gland, i-endocrine gland engange-pea ekhipha ama-hormone amaningana ahlukene athinta ezinye izindlala kanye namanye amaseli. Lobu budlelwano busho ukuthi i-hypothalamus ilawula ukuziphatha okubalulekile okulawulwa yilawa ma-hormone. I-hypothalamus iyi-thermostat yomzimba—iqinisekisa ukuthi imisebenzi ebalulekile njengokudla namanzi, ukusetshenziswa kwamandla, kanye nokushisa komzimba kugcinwa emazingeni afanele. Ama-neuron ngaphakathi kwe-hypothalamus nawo alawula izigqi ze-circadian, ngezinye izikhathi ezibizwa ngokuthi imijikelezo yokulala
answer1: Ngaphansi kwe-thalamus
question2: I-hypothalamus ilawula kanjani uhlelo lwe-endocrine?
question3: Uyini umsebenzi wendlala ye-pituitary?
answer3: Ikhipha ama-hormone athinta ezinye izindlala namaseli
question4: Kungani i-hypothalamus ivame ukubizwa ngokuthi i-bodys thermostat?
answer4: Kuyasiza ukugcina izinga lokushisa lomzimba kanye neminye imisebenzi ebalulekile ye-homeostatic
question5: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okulawulwa yi-hypothalamus?
answer5: Ukudla okudliwayo, amanzi adliwayo, ukusetshenziswa kwamandla, kanye nokushisa komzimba
distractor5b: Ukukhiqizwa kwamaseli egazi kanye nokuzivikela komzimba
question6: Ama-neuron angaphakathi kwe-hypothalamus asiza ekulawuleni yiphi inqubo yezinto eziphilayo?
question7: Bheka uMfanekiso 26.24. Yisiphi isitatimende mayelana ne-hypothalamus esiyiqiniso?
answer7: Ilawula uhlelo lwe-endocrine nge-pituitary gland futhi isiza ukugcina i-homeostasis
distractor7b: Yakha ungqimba olungaphandle kakhulu lwe-cortex yobuchopho

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 26. Uhlelo Lwezinzwa | 26.3 Uhlelo Lwezinzwa Oluphakathi | Ubuchopho | Uhlelo Lwezitho Zomzimba
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 26. Uhlelo Lwezinzwa | 26.3 Uhlelo Lwezinzwa Oluphakathi | Ubuchopho | Uhlelo Lwezitho Zomzimba
chapterContent: Uhlelo lwe-limbic luyisethi exhunyiwe yezakhiwo ezilawula imizwa, kanye nokuziphatha okuhlobene nokwesaba kanye nesisusa. Ludlala indima ekwakhekeni kwenkumbulo futhi luhlanganisa izingxenye ze-thalamus kanye ne-hypothalamus kanye ne-hippocampus. Isakhiwo esisodwa esibalulekile ngaphakathi kohlelo lwe-limbic yisakhiwo se-temporal lobe esibizwa ngokuthi i-amygdala (igama lesiGreki elithi almond)), esiboniswe kuMfanekiso 26.24. Ama-amygdala amabili abalulekile kokubili ekuzweni ukwesaba kanye nokubona ubuso obesabayo. I-cingulate gyrus isiza ukulawula imizwa nobuhlungu.
answer1: Ilawula imizwa, ukwesaba, isisusa, futhi inegalelo ekwakheni inkumbulo
question2: Yiziphi izakhiwo ezifakiwe ohlelweni lwe-limbic?
distractor2b: I-frontal lobe, i-occipital lobe, kanye ne-corpus callosum
question3: Yisiphi isakhiwo ngaphakathi kwesimiso se-limbic esibaluleke kakhulu ekuzizweni kokwesaba?
question4: Ngaphandle kokudala ukwesaba, yini enye i-amygdala esiza ukuyiqaphela?
question5: Iyini indima eyinhloko ye-cingulate gyrus?
question6: Bheka uMfanekiso 26.24. Yisiphi isakhiwo sesimiso se-limbic esihlobene kakhulu nokwesaba nokubona ubuso obesabayo?

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 26. Uhlelo Lwezinzwa | 26.3 Uhlelo Lwezinzwa Oluphakathi | Ubuchopho | I-Cerebellum
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 26. Uhlelo Lwezinzwa | 26.3 Uhlelo Lwezinzwa Oluphakathi | Ubuchopho | I-Cerebellum
chapterContent: I-cerebellum (isiLatini esisho ubuchopho obuncane”), eboniswe kuMfanekiso 26.21, ihlezi phansi kobuchopho phezu kwesiqu sobuchopho. I-cerebellum ilawula ibhalansi futhi isiza ekuhleleni ukunyakaza nokufunda imisebenzi emisha yemisipha.
answer1: Esisekelweni sobuchopho phezu kwesiqu sobuchopho
question2: Uyini umsebenzi oyinhloko we-cerebellum?
question3: Ngaphandle kokulinganisela nokuxhumana, yini enye i-cerebellum esiza ngayo?
question4: Bheka uMfanekiso 26.21. Yisiphi isitatimende mayelana ne-cerebellum esiyiqiniso?
answer4: Itholakala ngaphezu kwesiqu sobuchopho futhi isiza ukuhlanganisa ibhalansi, ukunyakaza, kanye nokufunda kwemisipha

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 26. Uhlelo Lwezinzwa | 26.3 Uhlelo Lwezinzwa Oluphakathi | Ubuchopho | Isimiso Sezinzwa
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 26. Uhlelo Lwezinzwa | 26.3 Uhlelo Lwezinzwa Oluphakathi | Ubuchopho | Isimiso Sezinzwa
chapterContent: I-brainstem, eboniswe ku-Figure 26.21, ixhumanisa lonke ubuchopho nentambo yomgogodla. Yakhiwa ubuchopho obuphakathi, i-medulla oblongata, kanye nama-pons. Ama-neuron e-motor kanye ne-sensory anwebeka nge-brainstem evumela ukudluliselwa kwezimpawu phakathi kobuchopho nentambo yomgogodla. Izindlela ze-neural ezikhuphukayo ziwela kule ngxenye yobuchopho evumela ingxenye yesobunxele yobuchopho ukuthi ilawule uhlangothi lwesokudla lomzimba kanye nohlangothi oluphambene. I-brainstem ixhumanisa izimpawu zokulawula i-motor ezithunyelwa zisuka ebuchosheni ziye emzimbeni. I-brainstem ilawula imisebenzi eminingana ebalulekile yomzimba ehlanganisa ukuqaphela, ukuvuka, ukuphefumula, umfutho wegazi, ukugaya ukudla, ukushaya kwenhliziyo, ukugwinya, ukuhamba, kanye nokuhlanganiswa kolwazi lwe-sensory kanye ne-motor.
answer1: Ixhumanisa ubuchopho nomgogodla futhi idlulise izimpawu phakathi kwazo
question2: Yiziphi izakhiwo ezintathu ezakha i-brainstem?
answer2: Ubuchopho obuphakathi, ama-pons, kanye ne-medulla oblongata
distractor2b: I-frontal lobe, i-parietal lobe, kanye ne-occipital lobe
question3: Kungani ingxenye yesobunxele yobuchopho ilawula uhlangothi lwesokudla lomzimba?
answer3: Izindlela ze-neural ezikhuphukayo ziwela ngaphakathi kwe-brainstem
question4: Hlobo luni lolwazi oludluliselwa nge-brainstem?
question5: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okulawulwa yi-brainstem?
question6: Yimuphi umsebenzi womzimba owengeziwe olawulwa yi-brainstem?
question7: Bheka uMfanekiso 26.21. Yisiphi isitatimende mayelana ne-brainstem esiyiqiniso?
answer7: Ixhumanisa ubuchopho nomgogodla futhi ilawula imisebenzi ebalulekile njengokuphefumula, ukushaya kwenhliziyo, kanye nomfutho wegazi.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 26. Uhlelo Lwezinzwa | 26.3 Uhlelo Lwezinzwa Oluphakathi | Intambo Yomgogodla
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 26. Uhlelo Lwezinzwa | 26.3 Uhlelo Lwezinzwa Oluphakathi | Intambo Yomgogodla
chapterContent:
Intambo yomgogodla ixhuma esiqwini sobuchopho futhi yelula emzimbeni ngekholomu yomgogodla, eboniswe kuMfanekiso 26.21. Intambo yomgogodla iyinqwaba enkulu yezicubu zemizwa ezithwala ulwazi ngomzimba oluya ebuchosheni nasekubuchosheni oluya emzimbeni. Intambo yomgogodla itholakala emathanjeni ekholomu yesilwane esinomgogodla kodwa iyakwazi ukudlulisa izimpawu eziya nezibuya emzimbeni ngokuxhumana kwayo nemizwa yomgogodla (ingxenye yesistimu yezinzwa engaphandle). Ingxenye enqamulayo yentambo yomgogodla ibukeka njenge-oval emhlophe equkethe isimo sevemvane elimpunga, njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 26.25. Ama-axon e-Myelinated akha i-white matter” kanti imizimba yamaseli e-neuron ne-glial yakha i-grey matter.” I-Grey matter nayo yakhiwe ngama-interneurons, axhumanisa ama-neurons amabili ngalinye elitholakala ezingxenyeni ezahlukene zomzimba. Ama-Axon kanye nemizimba yamaseli entanyeni yomgogodla (ebheke ngemuva kwesilwane) idlulisela ulwazi oluningi lwezinzwa oluvela emzimbeni luye ebuchosheni. Ama-Axon kanye nemizimba yamaseli entanyeni yomgogodla (ebheke ngaphambili kwesilwane) ngokuyinhloko idlulisela izimpawu ezilawula ukunyakaza okuvela ebuchosheni kuya emzimbeni.

 Intambo yomgogodla nayo ilawula ukusabela kwemisipha. Lawa ma-reflex ayindlela esheshayo, engazi lutho—njengokususa ngokuzenzakalelayo isandla entweni eshisayo. Ama-Reflex ashesha kakhulu ngoba ahilela ukuxhumana kwe-synaptic yendawo. Isibonelo, i-reflex yedolo udokotela ayihlola ngesikhathi sokuzivocavoca ngokomzimba okuvamile ilawulwa yi-synapse eyodwa phakathi kwe-neuron yezinzwa kanye ne-neuron ye-motor. Ngenkathi i-reflex ingadinga kuphela ukubandakanyeka kwe-synapse eyodwa noma ezimbili, ama-synapse anama-interneurons kukholomu yomgogodla adlulisela ulwazi ebuchosheni ukuze adlulisele okwenzekile (idolo lagxuma, noma isandla sasishisa).

 E-United States, kunezingozi ezingaba ngu-10,000 zomgogodla minyaka yonke. Ngenxa yokuthi intambo yomgogodla iyindlela yolwazi exhumanisa ubuchopho nomzimba, ukulimala kwentambo yomgogodla kungaholela ekukhubazekeni. Izinga lokukhubazeka lincike endaweni yokulimala emgogodleni womgogodla nokuthi intambo yomgogodla inqanyuliwe ngokuphelele. Isibonelo, uma intambo yomgogodla yonakele ezingeni lentamo, ingabangela ukukhubazeka kusukela entanyeni kuye phansi, kanti ukulimala kwekholomu yomgogodla phansi kakhulu kunganciphisa ukukhubazeka emilenzeni. Ukulimala kwentambo yomgogodla kunzima kakhulu ukwelapha ngoba imithambo yomgogodla ayivuseleli, yize ucwaningo oluqhubekayo lusikisela ukuthi ukufakelwa kwamaseli okuqala kungase kusebenze njengebhuloho lokuxhuma kabusha imizwa enqanyuliwe. Abacwaningi babheka nezindlela zokuvimbela ukuvuvukala okwenza umonakalo wemizwa ube mubi kakhulu ngemva kokulimala. Enye indlela yokwelapha enjalo ukupompa umzimba nge-saline ebandayo ukuze kubangele i-hypothermia. Lokhu kupholisa kungavimbela ukuvuvukala nezinye izinqubo okucatshangwa ukuthi zibenza umonakalo wentambo yomgogodla ube mubi kakhulu.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 26. Uhlelo Lwezinzwa | 26.4 Uhlelo Lwezinzwa Oluzungezile | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 26. Uhlelo Lwezinzwa | 26.4 Uhlelo Lwezinzwa Oluzungezile | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent:
Ulwazi mayelana nesistimu yezinzwa engaphandle alukho ngaphansi kwe-AP®. Kodwa-ke, kubalulekile ukuqaphela ukuthi uhlelo lwezinzwa olungaphandle (i-PNS) luwuxhumano phakathi kwesistimu yezinzwa ephakathi kanye nomzimba wonke. I-PNS ingahlukaniswa ibe uhlelo lwezinzwa oluzimele, olulawula imisebenzi yomzimba ngaphandle kokulawula okuqaphelayo, kanye nohlelo lwezinzwa oluhambisana nomzimba, oludlulisela ulwazi lwezinzwa kusuka esikhumbeni, emisipheni, nasezithweni zezinzwa kuya ku-CNS kanye nemiyalo yemoto kusuka ku-CNS kuya emisipheni. Uhlelo lwezinzwa oluzimele lungahlukaniswa kabanzi lube yizindlela ze-parasympathetic kanye ne-sympathetic. Izimpendulo zokuphumula nokugaya "zivuselelwa yi-parasympathetic division, kanti izimpendulo zokulwa noma zokundiza"zivuselelwa yi-sympathetic division. Ngamanye amazwi, lezi zinhlelo ezimbili zivame ukuba nemiphumela ephikisanayo ezithweni eziqondiwe; isibonelo, ukusebenza kwesistimu ye-parasympathetic kunciphisa izinga lokushaya kwenhliziyo, kanti ukusebenza kwesistimu ye-sympathetic kwandisa izinga lokushaya kwenhliziyo. (Uma, njengoba ufunda lolu lwazi, i-Tyrannosaurus rex ingena ngenkani egumbini, yikuphi ukuhlukana okuzosebenza?) Uhlelo lwezinzwa oluhambisana nemizwa luqukethe imizwa ye-cranial kanye ne-spinal ne-neuron yezinzwa kanye neye-motor.

 Uhlelo lwezinzwa oluhambisana ne-peripheral (PNS) luwuxhumano phakathi kohlelo lwezinzwa oluphakathi kanye nomzimba wonke. I-CNS ifana nesitshalo samandla sohlelo lwezinzwa. Idala izimpawu ezilawula imisebenzi yomzimba. I-PNS ifana nezintambo eziya ezindlini ngazinye. Ngaphandle kwalezo zintambo,” izimpawu ezikhiqizwa yi-CNS azikwazanga ukulawula umzimba (futhi i-CNS ngeke ikwazi ukuthola ulwazi lwezinzwa emzimbeni).

 I-PNS ingahlukaniswa ibe uhlelo lwezinzwa oluzimele, olulawula imisebenzi yomzimba ngaphandle kokulawula okuqaphelayo, kanye nohlelo lwezinzwa oluhambisana nemizwa, oludlulisela ulwazi lwezinzwa kusuka esikhumbeni, emisipheni, nasezithweni zezinzwa kuya ku-CNS futhi luthumela imiyalo yezimoto kusuka ku-CNS kuya emisipheni.

chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 26. Uhlelo Lwezinzwa | 26.4 Uhlelo Lwezinzwa Oluzungezile | Uhlelo Lwezinzwa Oluzimele
chapterContent: Uhlelo lwezinzwa oluzimele lusebenza njengokuxhumana phakathi kwe-CNS nezitho zangaphakathi. Lulawula amaphaphu, inhliziyo, imisipha ebushelelezi, kanye nezindlala ze-exocrine kanye ne-endocrine. Uhlelo lwezinzwa oluzimele lulawula lezi zitho kakhulu ngaphandle kokulawulwa okuqaphile; lungaqapha njalo izimo zalezi zinhlelo ezahlukene futhi luqalise izinguquko njengoba kudingeka. Ukunikeza izimpawu ezicutshini eziqondiwe ngokuvamile kuhilela ama-synapses amabili: i-neuron ye-preganglionic (evela ku-CNS) i-synapses ku-neuron e-ganglion, yona-ke, i-synapses esithweni esiqondiwe, njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 26.26. Kunezigaba ezimbili zesistimu yezinzwa ezizimele ezivame ukuba nemiphumela ephikisanayo: uhlelo lwezinzwa oluzwelayo kanye nohlelo lwezinzwa oluyi-parasympathetic

answer1: Idlulisela izimpawu phakathi kwe-CNS nezitho zangaphakathi futhi izilawule ngaphandle kokulawulwa okuqondile
question2: Yiziphi izitho zomzimba ezilawulwa uhlelo lwezinzwa oluzimele?
answer2: Amaphaphu, inhliziyo, imisipha ebushelelezi, kanye nezindlala ze-exocrine kanye ne-endocrine

answer6: Iningi lama-neuron e-preganglionic endleleni yokuxhumana nabantu livela emgogodleni
distractor6a: Indlela yozwela inesibopho sokuphumula umzimba, kanti indlela ye-parasympathetic inesibopho sokulungiselela isimo esiphuthumayo.
distractor6b: Ukunciphisa ukushaya kwenhliziyo kuyindlela yokubonisa uzwela
distractor6c: Ama-neuron e-Parasympathetic anesibopho sokukhulula i-norepinephrine esithweni esiqondiwe, kanti ama-neuron anesibopho sokukhulula i-acetylcholine.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 26. Uhlelo Lwezinzwa | 26.4 Uhlelo Lwezinzwa Oluzungezile | Uhlelo Lwezinzwa Oluzimele | Uhlelo Lwezinzwa Olunozwela
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 26. Uhlelo Lwezinzwa | 26.4 Uhlelo Lwezinzwa Oluzungezile | Uhlelo Lwezinzwa Oluzimele | Uhlelo Lwezinzwa Olunozwela
chapterContent:
Uhlelo lwezinzwa oluzwela lunesibopho sokulwa noma sokundiza” okwenzeka lapho isilwane sibhekene nesimo esiyingozi. Enye indlela yokukhumbula lokhu ukucabanga ngokumangala umuntu akuzwayo lapho ehlangana nenyoka (inyoka” kanye nozwela” zombili ziqala ngo-s). Izibonelo zemisebenzi elawulwa uhlelo lwezinzwa oluzwela zihlanganisa ukushaya kwenhliziyo okusheshayo kanye nokugaya okuvinjelwe. Le misebenzi isiza ukulungiselela umzimba wento ephilayo ukucindezeleka ngokomzimba okudingekayo ukuze ubalekele isimo esingaba yingozi noma ukuzivikela esitha.

 Ama-neuron amaningi e-preganglionic ohlelweni lwezinzwa oluzwela avela emgogodleni, njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 26.27. Ama-axon ala ma-neurons akhipha i-acetylcholine kuma-neurons e-postganglionic ngaphakathi kwe-sympathetic ganglia (i-sympathetic ganglia yakha uchungechunge oludlula eceleni komgogodla). I-acetylcholine isebenzisa ama-neurons e-postganglionic. Ama-neurons e-postganglionic abese ekhipha i-norepinephrine ezithweni eziqondiwe. Njengoba noma ubani owake wazizwa eshesha ngaphambi kokuhlolwa okukhulu, inkulumo, noma umcimbi wezemidlalo angakufakazela, imiphumela yesistimu yezinzwa ezwelala isakazeke kakhulu. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi i-neuron eyodwa ye-preganglionic ihlangana kuma-neuron amaningi e-postganglionic, okwandisa umphumela we-synapse yokuqala, kanye nokuthi i-adrenal gland nayo ikhipha i-norepinephrine (kanye ne-hormone ehlobene eduze i-epinephrine) egazini. Imiphumela yomzimba yalokhu kukhululwa kwe-norepinephrine ihlanganisa ukwandisa i-trachea kanye ne-bronchi (okwenza kube lula ngesilwane ukuphefumula), ukwandisa ukushaya kwenhliziyo, kanye nokuhambisa igazi lisuka esikhumbeni liye enhliziyweni, emisipheni, nasebuchosheni (ukuze isilwane sikwazi ukucabanga nokugijima). Amandla kanye nesivinini sempendulo yozwela kusiza into ephilayo ukugwema ingozi, futhi ososayensi bathole ubufakazi bokuthi kungase kwandise i-LTP—okuvumela isilwane ukuba sikhumbule isimo esiyingozi futhi sisigweme esikhathini esizayo.

chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 26. Uhlelo Lwezinzwa | 26.4 Uhlelo Lwezinzwa Oluzungezile | Uhlelo Lwezinzwa Oluzimele | Uhlelo Lwezinzwa Olune-Parasympathetic
chapterContent:
Nakuba uhlelo lwezinzwa oluhambisana nozwela lusebenza ezimweni ezicindezelayo, uhlelo lwezinzwa oluhambisana nozwela luvumela isilwane ukuthi siphumule futhi sigaye.” Enye indlela yokukhumbula lokhu ukucabanga ukuthi ngesikhathi sesimo sokuphumula njenge-picnic, uhlelo lwezinzwa oluhambisana nozwela lulawula (i-picnic” kanye ne-parasympathetic” zombili ziqala ngo-p). Ama-neuron e-parasympathetic preganglionic anemizimba yamaseli etholakala ebuchosheni kanye nasentanjeni yomgogodla ye-sacral (ngasezantsi), njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 26.27. Ama-axons ama-neurons e-preganglionic akhipha i-acetylcholine kuma-neurons e-postganglionic, ngokuvamile atholakala eduze kakhulu kwezitho eziqondiwe. Ama-neurons amaningi e-postganglionic akhipha i-acetylcholine ezithweni eziqondiwe, yize amanye ekhipha i-nitric oxide.

 Uhlelo lwezinzwa oluhambisana nozwela luqala kabusha ukusebenza kwezitho ngemuva kokuba uhlelo lwezinzwa oluhambisana nozwela selusebenza (i-adrenaline dump evamile oyizwayo ngemva kwesenzakalo ‘sokulwa noma sokundiza’). Imiphumela yokukhululwa kwe-acetylcholine ezithweni eziqondiwe ifaka phakathi ukwehla kwesilinganiso senhliziyo, ukwehla komfutho wegazi, kanye nokukhuthaza ukugaya ukudla.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 26. Uhlelo Lwezinzwa | 26.4 Uhlelo Lwezinzwa Oluseceleni | Uhlelo Lwezinzwa Oluhambisana Nomzimba
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 26. Uhlelo Lwezinzwa | 26.4 Uhlelo Lwezinzwa Oluseceleni | Uhlelo Lwezinzwa Oluhambisana Nomzimba
chapterContent:
Uhlelo lwezinzwa oluhambisana ne-sensory-somatic lwakhiwe yizinzwa ze-cranial kanye nomgogodla futhi luqukethe ama-neuron enzwa kanye nama-motor. Ama-neuron enzwa adlulisela ulwazi lwezinzwa kusuka esikhumbeni, emisipheni yamathambo, kanye nezitho zemizwa kuya ku-CNS. Ama-motor neurons adlulisela imiyalezo mayelana nokunyakaza okufiswayo kusuka ku-CNS kuya emisipheni ukuze azenze zifinyele. Ngaphandle kohlelo lwawo lwezinzwa oluhambisana ne-sensory-somatic, isilwane besingeke sikwazi ukucubungula noma yiluphi ulwazi mayelana nendawo yaso (lokho esikubonayo, esikuzwayo, esikuzwayo, njalo njalo) futhi besingeke sikwazi ukulawula ukunyakaza kwemisipha. Ngokungafani nohlelo lwezinzwa oluzimele, olune-synapses ezimbili phakathi kwe-CNS kanye nesitho esiqondiwe, ama-neuron enzwa kanye nama-motor ane-synapse eyodwa kuphela—isiphetho esisodwa se-neuron sisesitho kanti esinye sixhumana ngqo ne-neuron ye-CNS. I-Acetylcholine iyi-neurotransmitter eyinhloko ekhishwa kulezi zinzwa.

 Abantu banezinzwa ze-cranial ezingu-12, izinzwa eziphuma noma ezingena ekhanda (cranium), ngokungafani nezinzwa zomgogodla, eziphuma kukholamu yomgogodla. Inzwa ngayinye ye-cranial inikezwa igama, elichazwe kuMfanekiso 26.28. Eminye imizwa ye-cranial idlulisela ulwazi lwezinzwa kuphela. Isibonelo, inzwa ye-olfactory idlulisela ulwazi mayelana nephunga elivela ekhaleni liye esiqwini sobuchopho. Eminye imizwa ye-cranial idlulisela cishe ulwazi lwe-motor kuphela. Isibonelo, inzwa ye-oculomotor ilawula ukuvulwa nokuvalwa kwejwabu leso kanye nokunyakaza kwamehlo. Eminye imizwa ye-cranial iqukethe ingxube yemicu yezinzwa neye-motor. Isibonelo, inzwa ye-glossopharyngeal inendima kokubili ekunambithekeni (kwezinzwa) kanye nasekugwinyeni (motor).

 Imizwa yomgogodla idlulisela ulwazi lwezinzwa kanye neye-motor phakathi kwentambo yomgogodla kanye nomzimba wonke. Imizwa ngayinye yomgogodla engu-31 (kubantu) iqukethe kokubili i-sensory kanye ne-motor axons. Imizimba yamaseli e-neuron yezinzwa iqoqwe ngezakhiwo ezibizwa ngokuthi i-dorsal root ganglia futhi iboniswe kuMfanekiso 26.29. I-neuron ngayinye yezinzwa inombono owodwa—one-sensory receptor ephela esikhumbeni, emisipheni, noma ezithweni zezinzwa—kanye nomunye ohlanganisa i-neuron entanjeni yomgogodla yangemuva. Ama-motor neurons anemizimba yamaseli endabeni empunga ye-ventral yentambo yomgogodla ephumela emisipheni ngempande ye-ventral. Lawa ma-neuron avame ukukhuthazwa ama-interneurons ngaphakathi komgogodla kodwa ngezinye izikhathi akhuthazwa ngqo ama-neuron anezinzwa

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 26. Uhlelo Lwezinzwa | 26.5 Izinkinga Zesistimu Yezinzwa | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 26. Uhlelo Lwezinzwa | 26.5 Izinkinga Zesistimu Yezinzwa | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent:
Ulwazi mayelana nokuphazamiseka kwesimiso sezinzwa alukho ezingeni le-AP®. Uhlelo lwezinzwa olusebenza kahle luyimishini eyinkimbinkimbi futhi enamafutha amaningi—ama-synapses avutha ngendlela efanele, ukunyakaza kwemisipha lapho kudingeka, izinkumbulo zakhiwa futhi zigcinwe, futhi imizwa ilawulwa kahle. Manje usungakwazi ukuqonda ukuthi yini edingekayo ukuze ukwazi ukufunda nokuqonda ulwazi olukule ncwadi. Ngeshwa, minyaka yonke izigidi zabantu e-United States zibhekana nohlobo oluthile lokuphazamiseka okubandakanya uhlelo lwezinzwa. Izifo ze-neurodegenerative zibonakala ngokulahlekelwa ukusebenza kwesimiso sezinzwa okuvame ukubangelwa ukufa kwama-neurons; izibonelo zifaka phakathi isifo i-Alzheimer's, isifo i-Parkinson's, kanye ne-amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). Izifo ze-neurodevelopmental zenzeka lapho ukuthuthukiswa kwesimiso sezinzwa kuphazamiseka; izibonelo zifaka phakathi i-autism spectrum disorder (ASD), i-attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD), i-schizophrenia, kanye nokucindezeleka okukhulu. Isifo sokuwa kanye nesifo sohlangothi nazo zinemvelaphi yezinzwa. Nakuba ososayensi bethole izimbangela ezingaba khona zalezi zifo eziningi, kanye nokwelashwa okusebenzayo kwabanye, ucwaningo oluqhubekayo mayelana nokuvimbela nokwelashwa kwalezi zinkinga luyaqhubeka.

 Uhlelo lwezinzwa olusebenza kahle luyimishini eyinkimbinkimbi kakhulu, enamafutha amaningi—i-synapses ivutha ngendlela efanele, imisipha iyanyakaza lapho kudingeka, izinkumbulo zakhiwa futhi zigcinwe, futhi imizwa ilawulwa kahle. Ngeshwa, unyaka ngamunye izigidi zabantu e-United States zibhekana nohlobo oluthile lokuphazamiseka kwesistimu yezinzwa. Nakuba ososayensi bethole izimbangela ezingaba khona zalezi zifo eziningi, kanye nokwelashwa okusebenzayo kwabanye, ucwaningo oluqhubekayo lufuna izindlela zokuvimbela nokwelapha kangcono zonke lezi zinkinga.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 26. Uhlelo Lwezinzwa | 26.5 Izinkinga Zesistimu Yezinzwa | Izinkinga Zokuwohloka Kwezinzwa
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 26. Uhlelo Lwezinzwa | 26.5 Izinkinga Zesistimu Yezinzwa | Izinkinga Zokuwohloka Kwezinzwa
chapterContent: Izifo eziwohloka ngenxa yokuphazamiseka kwemizwa yizifo ezibonakala ngokulahlekelwa ukusebenza kwesimiso sezinzwa okuvame ukubangelwa ukufa kwemizwa. Lezi zifo ngokuvamile ziya ziba zimbi ngokuhamba kwesikhathi njengoba ama-neuron amaningi efa. Izimpawu zesifo esithile esiwohloka ngenxa yokuphazamiseka kwengqondo zihlobene nokuthi kwenzeka kuphi ohlelweni lwezinzwa lapho ukufa kwama-neuron kwenzeka khona. I-spinocerebellar ataxia, isibonelo, iholela ekufeni kwemizwa ku-cerebellum. Ukufa kwala ma-neuron kubangela izinkinga ekulinganiseni nasekuhambeni. Izifo eziwohloka ngenxa yokuphazamiseka kwengqondo zifaka phakathi isifo sikaHuntington, i-amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, isifo sika-Alzheimer kanye nezinye izinhlobo zezifo zokuwohloka kwengqondo, kanye nesifo sikaParkinson. Lapha, kuzoxoxwa ngesifo sika-Alzheimer kanye nesikaParkinson ngokujulile.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 26. Uhlelo Lwezinzwa | 26.5 Izinkinga Zesistimu Yezinzwa | Izinkinga Zokuwohloka Kwemizwa | Isifo Se-Alzheimer
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 26. Uhlelo Lwezinzwa | 26.5 Izinkinga Zesistimu Yezinzwa | Izinkinga Zokuwohloka Kwemizwa | Isifo Se-Alzheimer
chapterContent:
Isifo i-Alzheimer's siyimbangela evame kakhulu ye-dementia kubantu asebekhulile. Ngo-2012, abantu baseMelika ababalelwa ezigidini ezingu-5.4 bahlushwa yisifo i-Alzheimer's, futhi izinkokhelo zokunakekelwa kwabo zilinganiselwa ku-$200 billion. Cishe umuntu oyedwa kwabayisishiyagalombili abaneminyaka engu-65 noma ngaphezulu unalesi sifo. Ngenxa yokuguga kwesizukulwane se-baby-boomer, kulindeleke ukuthi kube neziguli ze-Alzheimer's ezingaba yizigidi ezingu-13 e-United States ngonyaka ka-2050.

 Izimpawu zesifo i-Alzheimer's zifaka phakathi ukulahlekelwa yinkumbulo okuphazamisayo, ukudideka ngesikhathi noma indawo, ubunzima bokuhlela noma ukwenza imisebenzi, ukwahlulela okubi, kanye nokushintsha kobuntu. Izinkinga zokuhogela amaphunga athile nazo zingaba uphawu lwesifo i-Alzheimer's futhi zingase zibe uphawu lwesixwayiso sokuqala. Eziningi zalezi zimpawu zivamile nakubantu abaguga ngokujwayelekile, ngakho-ke ubukhali kanye nobude bezimpawu okunquma ukuthi umuntu unesifo i-Alzheimer's.

 Isifo i-Alzheimer's saqanjwa ngo-Alois Alzheimer, udokotela wezifo zengqondo waseJalimane owashicilela umbiko ngo-1911 ngowesifazane owayenezimpawu ezinkulu ze-dementia. Ekanye nozakwabo, wahlola ubuchopho bowesifazane ngemuva kokushona kwakhe wabika ukuthi kukhona ama-clumps angajwayelekile, manje abizwa ngokuthi ama-amyloid plaques, kanye ne-tangled brain fibers ebizwa ngokuthi ama-neurofibrillary tangles. Ama-Amyloid plaques, ama-neurofibrillary tangles, kanye nokuncipha kwevolumu yobuchopho kuvame ukubonakala ebuchosheni beziguli ze-Alzheimer's. Ukulahlekelwa ama-neurons ku-hippocampus kubi kakhulu ezigulini ze-Alzheimer's ezithuthukile. Isithombe 26.30 siqhathanisa ubuchopho obujwayelekile nobuchopho besiguli se-Alzheimer's. Amaqembu amaningi ocwaningo ahlola izimbangela zalezi zimpawu zesifo.

 Uhlobo olulodwa lwesifo luvame ukubangelwa izinguquko kwenye yezakhi zofuzo ezintathu ezaziwayo. Lolu hlobo olungavamile lwesifo i-Alzheimer's esiqala ekuqaleni luthinta abantu abangaphansi kwamaphesenti amahlanu abanesifo futhi lubangela i-dementia eqala phakathi kweminyaka engama-30 nengama-60. Uhlobo oluvame kakhulu, oluqala ngasekupheleni kwalesi sifo cishe lunezakhi zofuzo. Izakhi zofuzo ezithile, i-apolipoprotein E (APOE) zine-variant (E4) eyandisa amathuba okuba umuntu othwala lesi sifo athole lesi sifo. Kuye kwatholakala ezinye izakhi zofuzo eziningi ezingase zihileleke kule pathology.

 Ngeshwa, ayikho ikhambi lesifo i-Alzheimer's. Izindlela zokwelapha zamanje zigxile ekuphatheni izimpawu zesifo. Ngenxa yokuthi ukwehla komsebenzi wama-neuron e-cholinergic (ama-neurons asebenzisa i-neurotransmitter acetylcholine) kuvamile esifweni i-Alzheimer's, imithi eminingana esetshenziswa ukwelapha lesi sifo isebenza ngokwandisa i-acetylcholine neurotransmission, ngokuvamile ngokuvimbela i-enzyme ephula i-acetylcholine ku-synaptic cleft. Ezinye izindlela zokungenelela emitholampilo zigxila ekwelashweni kokuziphatha njengokwelashwa kwengqondo, ukwelashwa kwezinzwa, kanye nokuzivocavoca kwengqondo. Njengoba isifo i-Alzheimer's sibonakala sithatha inqubo evamile yokuguga, ucwaningo lokuvimbela luvame kakhulu. Ukubhema, ukukhuluphala ngokweqile, nezinkinga zenhliziyo kungaba yizinto ezibangela lesi sifo, ngakho-ke ukwelashwa kwalezo zinto kungasiza nasekuvimbeleni isifo i-Alzheimer's. Ezinye izifundo zibonise ukuthi abantu abahlala bekhuthele ngokwengqondo ngokudlala imidlalo, ukufunda, ukudlala izinsimbi zomculo, kanye nokuba matasa emphakathini kamuva basengozini encishisiwe yokuthola lesi sifo.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 26. Uhlelo Lwezinzwa | 26.5 Izinkinga Zesistimu Yezinzwa | Izinkinga Zokuwohloka Kwemizwa | Isifo SikaParkinson
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 26. Uhlelo Lwezinzwa | 26.5 Izinkinga Zesistimu Yezinzwa | Izinkinga Zokuwohloka Kwemizwa | Isifo SikaParkinson
chapterContent:
Njengesifo i-Alzheimer's, isifo i-Parkinson's siyisifo esiwohloka ngenxa yemizwa. Saqala ukubonakala nguJames Parkinson ngo-1817. Unyaka ngamunye, abantu abangu-50,000-60,000 e-United States batholakala benalesi sifo. Isifo i-Parkinson's sibangela ukulahlekelwa ama-dopamine neurons ku-substantia nigra, isakhiwo sobuchopho obuphakathi esilawula ukunyakaza. Ukulahlekelwa yila ma-neurons kubangela izimpawu eziningi okuhlanganisa ukuthuthumela (ukuqhaqhazela iminwe noma umlenze), ukunyakaza okuhamba kancane, izinguquko zenkulumo, izinkinga zokulinganisela kanye nokuma, kanye nemisipha eqinile. Ukuhlanganiswa kwalezi zimpawu kuvame ukubangela ukuhamba okuhamba kancane okugobile, okuboniswe kuMfanekiso 26.31. Iziguli ezinesifo i-Parkinson's nazo zingabonisa izimpawu zengqondo, njenge-dementia noma izinkinga zomzwelo.

 Nakuba ezinye iziguli zinesimo salesi sifo esaziwa ukuthi sibangelwa ushintsho olulodwa, ezigulini eziningi izimbangela eziqondile zesifo i-Parkinson's azikaziwa: lesi sifo cishe sibangelwa ukuhlanganiswa kwezici zofuzo kanye nezemvelo (ezifana nesifo i-Alzheimer's). Ukuhlaziywa kobuchopho ngemva kokufa okuvela ezigulini zikaParkinson kukhombisa ukuba khona kwemizimba kaLewy—amaqoqo amaprotheni angajwayelekile—kuma-neuron e-dopaminergic. Ukusabalala kwale mizimba kaLewy kuvame ukuhlobana nobunzima besifo.

 Akukho ukwelashwa kwesifo sikaParkinson, futhi ukwelashwa kugxile ekunciphiseni izimpawu. Omunye wemithi evame ukunqunywa yesifo sikaParkinson yi-L-DOPA, okuyikhemikhali eguqulwa ibe yi-dopamine ngama-neurons ebuchosheni. Lokhu kuguqulwa kwandisa izinga eliphelele lokudluliswa kwe-dopamine neurotransmission futhi kungasiza ekubuyiseleni ukulahlekelwa kwama-neuron e-dopaminergic ku-substantia nigra. Eminye imithi isebenza ngokuvimbela i-enzyme ephula i-dopamine

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 26. Uhlelo Lwezinzwa | 26.5 Izinkinga Zesistimu Yezinzwa | Ukuxhumana Nomsebenzi | Udokotela Wezinzwa
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 26. Uhlelo Lwezinzwa | 26.5 Izinkinga Zesistimu Yezinzwa | Ukuxhumana Nomsebenzi | Udokotela Wezinzwa
chapterContent:
Odokotela bezinzwa bangodokotela abangochwepheshe ezinkingeni zesimiso sezinzwa. Baxilonga futhi belaphe izifo ezifana nesifo sokuwa, isifo sohlangothi, i-dementia, ukulimala kwesimiso sezinzwa, isifo sikaParkinson, izinkinga zokulala, kanye ne-multiple sclerosis. Odokotela bezinzwa bangodokotela abafunde ekolishi, esikoleni sezokwelapha, futhi baqede iminyaka emithathu kuya kwemine yokuhlala kwe-neurology.

 Lapho behlola isiguli esisha, udokotela wezinzwa uthatha umlando ogcwele wezokwelapha futhi enze ukuhlolwa komzimba okuphelele. Ukuhlolwa ngokomzimba kuqukethe imisebenzi ethile esetshenziselwa ukunquma ukuthi yiziphi izindawo zobuchopho, umgogodla, noma uhlelo lwezinzwa olungaphandle olungase lonakale. Isibonelo, ukuhlola ukuthi i-hypoglossal nerve isebenza kahle yini, udokotela wezinzwa uzocela isiguli ukuthi sinyakazise ulimi lwaso ngezindlela ezahlukene. Uma isiguli singenalo ukulawula okugcwele ukunyakaza kolimi, khona-ke i-hypoglossal nerve ingase yonakale noma kungase kube nesilonda ebuchosheni lapho kuhlala khona imizimba yamaseli ala ma-neurons (noma kungaba nomonakalo emisipheni yolimi ngokwalo).

 Odokotela bezinzwa banezinye izinto ngaphandle kokuhlolwa ngokomzimba abangazisebenzisela ukuxilonga izinkinga ezithile ohlelweni lwezinzwa. Uma isiguli sike saba nokuquleka, isibonelo, udokotela wezinzwa angasebenzisa i-electroencephalography (EEG), ehilela ukunamathisela ama-electrode ekhanda ukuze aqophe umsebenzi wobuchopho, ukuze azame ukuthola ukuthi yiziphi izindawo zobuchopho ezihilelekile ekuqulekeni. Ezigulini ezisolwa ngokuba nesifo sohlangothi, udokotela wezinzwa angasebenzisa i-computerized tomography (CT) scan, okuwuhlobo lwe-X-ray, ukuze abheke ukopha ebuchosheni noma kwezinye izimo zempilo. Ukuze belaphe iziguli ezinezinkinga zezinzwa, odokotela bezinzwa banganikeza imithi noma badlulisele isiguli kudokotela wezinzwa ukuze ahlinzwe.
answer1: Udokotela ochwepheshe ezinkingeni zesimiso sezinzwa

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 26. Uhlelo Lwezinzwa | 26.5 Izinkinga Zesistimu Yezinzwa | Izinkinga Zokuthuthukiswa Kwezinzwa | I-Autism
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 26. Uhlelo Lwezinzwa | 26.5 Izinkinga Zesistimu Yezinzwa | Izinkinga Zokuthuthukiswa Kwezinzwa | I-Autism
chapterContent:
Isifo se-Autism spectrum disorder (ASD) siyisifo esibangelwa yizinzwa. Ubunzima baso buyahlukahluka kuye ngomuntu nomuntu. Izilinganiso zokusabalala kwalesi sifo zishintshe ngokushesha eminyakeni embalwa edlule. Izilinganiso zamanje zisikisela ukuthi ingane eyodwa kwezingu-88 izoqala lesi sifo. I-ASD ivame ngokuphindwe kane kwabesilisa kunabesifazane.

 Uphawu oluphawulekayo lwe-ASD ukungakwazi ukuxhumana nabantu kahle. Izingane ezine-autism zingase zibe nobunzima bokwenza nokugcina ukuxhumana kwamehlo nokufunda izimpawu zomphakathi. Zingase zibe nezinkinga zokuzwelana nabanye. Ezinye izimpawu ze-ASD zifaka phakathi ukuziphatha okuphindaphindayo kwemisipha (njengokuzulazula emuva naphambili), ukukhathazeka ngezihloko ezithile, ukunamathela ngokuqinile emasikweni athile, kanye nokusetshenziswa kolimi okungavamile. Iziguli ezingafika ku-30% ezine-ASD ziba nesifo sokuwa, kanti iziguli ezinezinhlobo ezithile zalesi sifo (njenge-Fragile X) nazo zinokukhubazeka kwengqondo. Ngenxa yokuthi kuyisifo se-spectrum, ezinye iziguli ze-ASD zisebenza kahle kakhulu futhi zinamakhono olimi amahle kakhulu. Iningi lalezi ziguli alizizwa sengathi lihlushwa yisifo futhi kunalokho licabanga ukuthi ubuchopho bazo bucubungula ulwazi ngendlela ehlukile.

 Ngaphandle kwezinye izinhlobo ze-autism ezibonakala kahle, ezicacile ngokwezakhi zofuzo (njenge-Fragile X kanye ne-Rett's Syndrome), izimbangela ze-ASD azaziwa kakhulu. Izinhlobo zezakhi zofuzo eziningana zihlobene nokuba khona kwe-ASD, kodwa kunoma yisiphi isiguli, kungadingeka izinguquko eziningi ezahlukene kuzakhi zofuzo ezahlukene ukuze lesi sifo sikhule. Ezingeni elijwayelekile, i-ASD kucatshangwa ukuthi iyisifo sokuxhuma okungalungile. Ngakho-ke, ubuchopho bezinye iziguli ze-ASD abunalo izinga elifanayo lokusika i-synaptic elivela kubantu abangathintekile. Ngawo-1990, iphepha locwaningo laxhumanisa i-autism nomuthi wokugomela ovamile onikezwa izingane. Leli phepha lahoxiswa lapho kutholakala ukuthi umbhali waqamba amanga ngemininingwane, futhi izifundo zokulandelela azibonisanga ukuxhumana phakathi kwemijovo kanye ne-autism.

 Ukwelashwa kwe-autism kuvame ukuhlanganisa izindlela zokwelapha zokuziphatha kanye nokungenelela, kanye nemithi yokwelapha ezinye izifo ezivamile kubantu abane-autism (ukucindezeleka, ukukhathazeka, ukuphazamiseka kokucindezeleka okucindezelayo). Nakuba ukungenelela kwasekuqaleni kungasiza ekunciphiseni imiphumela yalesi sifo, okwamanje akukho ukwelashwa kwe-ASD
