chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 26. Uhlelo Lwezinzwa | 26.5 Izinkinga Zesistimu Yezinzwa | Izinkinga Zokuthuthukiswa Kwezinzwa | Isifo Sokuntuleka Kokunaka Okungapheli (ADHD)
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 26. Uhlelo Lwezinzwa | 26.5 Izinkinga Zesistimu Yezinzwa | Izinkinga Zokuthuthukiswa Kwezinzwa | Isifo Sokuntuleka Kokunaka Okungapheli (ADHD)
chapterContent:
Cishe amaphesenti amathathu kuya kwayisihlanu ezingane nabantu abadala athinteka yisifo sokungakwazi ukunaka/ukungasebenzi kahle kwengqondo (ADHD). Njenge-ASD, i-ADHD ivame kakhulu kwabesilisa kunabesifazane. Izimpawu zalesi sifo zifaka phakathi ukunganaki (ukuntuleka kokugxila), ubunzima bokusebenza kahle, ukungaziphathi kahle, kanye nokusebenza ngokweqile okungaphezu kwalokho okubonakala esigabeni esijwayelekile sokukhula. Ezinye iziguli azinaso isici esisebenza kakhulu sezimpawu futhi zitholakala zine-subtype ye-ADHD: i-attention deficit disorder (ADD). Abantu abaningi abane-ADHD nabo babonisa ukukhubazeka, ngoba bahlakulela izifo zesibili ngaphezu kwe-ADHD. Izibonelo zifaka phakathi ukucindezeleka noma i-obsessive compulsive disorder (OCD). Umfanekiso 26.33 unikeza izibalo ezithile mayelana nokuhambisana ne-ADHD.

 Imbangela ye-ADHD ayaziwa, yize ucwaningo lukhomba ukubambezeleka kanye nokungasebenzi kahle ekuthuthukisweni kwe-prefrontal cortex kanye nokuphazamiseka kokudluliselwa kwemizwa. Ngokusho kocwaningo lwamawele, lesi sifo sinesici esiqinile sezakhi zofuzo. Kunezakhi zofuzo eziningana ezingaba negalelo kulesi sifo, kodwa azikho izixhumanisi eziqondile ezitholakele. Izici zemvelo, okuhlanganisa ukuchayeka ezibulala-zinambuzane ezithile, nazo zingaba negalelo ekuthuthukisweni kwe-ADHD kwezinye iziguli. Ukwelashwa kwe-ADHD kuvame ukuhilela izindlela zokwelapha zokuziphatha kanye nokunikezwa imithi evuselelayo, okubangela ukuzola kulezi ziguli.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 26. Uhlelo Lwezinzwa | 26.5 Izinkinga Zesistimu Yezinzwa | Izinkinga Zokuthuthukiswa Kwezinzwa | Izifo Zengqondo
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 26. Uhlelo Lwezinzwa | 26.5 Izinkinga Zesistimu Yezinzwa | Izinkinga Zokuthuthukiswa Kwezinzwa | Izifo Zengqondo
chapterContent: Izifo zengqondo ziyizinkinga zesimiso sezinzwa ezibangela izinkinga ngokucabanga, imizwa, noma ubudlelwano nabanye abantu. Lezi zinkinga zinzima ngokwanele ukuthi zithinte ikhwalithi yokuphila komuntu futhi zivame ukwenza kube nzima ngabantu ukwenza imisebenzi evamile yokuphila kwansuku zonke. Izinkinga zengqondo eziwohlozayo zihlasela cishe abantu baseMelika abayizigidi ezingu-12.5 (cishe umuntu oyedwa kwabayi-17) ngezindleko zonyaka ezingaphezu kwamaRandi ayizigidi eziyizinkulungwane ezingu-300. Kunezinhlobo eziningana zezinkinga zengqondo ezihlanganisa i-schizophrenia, ukucindezeleka okukhulu, ukuphazamiseka kwengqondo okuguquguqukayo, ukuphazamiseka kokukhathazeka kanye nama-phobias, ukuphazamiseka kokucindezeleka ngemva kokushaqeka, kanye nesifo sengqondo esicindezelayo (OCD), phakathi kwezinye. I-American Psychiatric Association ishicilela i-Diagnostic and Statistical Manual of Mental Disorders (noma i-DSM), echaza izimpawu ezidingekayo ukuze isiguli sitholakale sinesifo sengqondo esithile. Inguqulo ngayinye esanda kukhishwa ye-DSM iqukethe izimpawu ezahlukene kanye nokuhlukaniswa njengoba ososayensi befunda kabanzi ngalezi zinkinga, izimbangela zazo, nokuthi zihlobene kanjani. Ingxoxo eningiliziwe yezifo ezimbili zengqondo—i-schizophrenia kanye nokucindezeleka okukhulu—inikezwe ngezansi.

chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 26. Uhlelo Lwezinzwa | 26.5 Izinkinga Zesistimu Yezinzwa | Izinkinga Zokuthuthukiswa Kwezinzwa | I-Schizophrenia
chapterContent: I-Schizophrenia isifo sengqondo esibi futhi esivame ukuba buthakathaka esithinta iphesenti elilodwa labantu e-United States. Izimpawu zalesi sifo zifaka phakathi ukungakwazi ukuhlukanisa phakathi kweqiniso kanye nomcabango, izimpendulo zemizwa ezingafanele nezingalawulwa, ubunzima bokucabanga, kanye nezinkinga ngezimo zomphakathi. Abantu abane-schizophrenia bangahlushwa ukungaboni kahle futhi bezwe amazwi; bangase futhi bahlushwe ukukhohliswa. Iziguli nazo zinezimpawu okuthiwa "ezimbi"njengesimo somzwelo esiphansi, ukulahlekelwa injabulo, kanye nokulahlekelwa yizinto eziyisisekelo. Iziguli eziningi ezine-schizophrenia zitholakala zisebusheni bazo noma ekuqaleni kweminyaka yama-20. Ukuthuthukiswa kwe-schizophrenia kucatshangwa ukuthi kuhilela ama-neuron e-dopaminergic angasebenzi kahle futhi kungase kuhilele nezinkinga ngokusayina kwe-glutamate. Ukwelashwa kwalesi sifo kuvame ukudinga imithi yokulwa nesifo sengqondo esebenza ngokuvimbela ama-receptor e-dopamine kanye nokunciphisa ukudluliswa kwe-dopamine ebuchosheni. Lokhu kwehla kwe-dopamine kungabangela izimpawu ezifana nesifo sikaParkinson kwezinye iziguli. Ngenkathi ezinye izinhlobo zama-antipsychotic zingaba nempumelelo enkulu ekwelapheni lesi sifo, azilona ikhambi, futhi iziguli eziningi kumele zihlale zinemithi impilo yazo yonke.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 26. Uhlelo Lwezinzwa | 26.5 Izinkinga Zesistimu Yezinzwa | Izinkinga Zokuthuthukiswa Kwezinzwa | Ukucindezeleka
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 26. Uhlelo Lwezinzwa | 26.5 Izinkinga Zesistimu Yezinzwa | Izinkinga Zokuthuthukiswa Kwezinzwa | Ukucindezeleka
chapterContent: Ukucindezeleka okukhulu kuthinta cishe amaphesenti angu-6.7 abantu abadala e-United States minyaka yonke futhi kungenye yezinkinga zengqondo ezivame kakhulu. Ukuze umuntu atholakale enesifo sokucindezeleka okukhulu, kumelwe ukuthi ube nesimo sengqondo sokucindezeleka okukhulu esihlala isikhathi esingaphezu kwamasonto amabili kanye nezinye izimpawu ezihlanganisa ukulahlekelwa injabulo emisebenzini eyayijatshulelwa ngaphambilini, izinguquko ekufiseni ukudla kanye nezikhathi zokulala, ubunzima bokugxilisa ingqondo, imizwa yokungafaneleki, kanye nemicabango yokuzibulala. Izimbangela eziqondile zokucindezeleka okukhulu azaziwa futhi cishe zihlanganisa izici eziyingozi zofuzo kanye nezemvelo. Olunye ucwaningo lusekela i-classic monoamine hypothesis,” ephakamisa ukuthi ukucindezeleka kubangelwa ukwehla kwe-norepinephrine kanye ne-serotonin neurotransmission. Impikiswano eyodwa ephikisana nale mbono ukuthi eminye imithi yokucindezeleka ibangela ukwanda kokukhishwa kwe-norepinephrine kanye ne-serotonin emahoreni ambalwa okuqala ukwelashwa—kodwa imiphumela yezokwelapha yale mithi ayibonakali kuze kube amasonto kamuva. Lokhu kuholele ezicatshangweni ezihlukile: isibonelo, i-dopamine ingase yehle nasezigulini ezicindezelekile, noma empeleni kungaba ukwanda kwe-norepinephrine kanye ne-serotonin okubangela lesi sifo, futhi imithi yokucindezeleka iphoqa i-feedback loop enciphisa lokhu kukhululwa. Ukwelashwa kokucindezeleka kufaka phakathi i-psychotherapy, ukwelashwa nge-electroconvulsive, ukukhuthazwa kobuchopho obujulile, kanye nemithi kadokotela. Kunezinhlobo eziningana zemithi yokucindezeleka esebenza ngezindlela ezahlukene. Isibonelo, i-monoamine oxidase inhibitors (MAO inhibitors) ivimba i-enzyme elimaza ama-neurotransmitter amaningi (kufaka phakathi i-dopamine, i-serotonin, i-norepinephrine), okuholela ekwandeni kwe-neurotransmitter ku-synaptic cleft. Ama-selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors (SSRIs) avimba ukuphinda kuthathwe kwe-serotonin ku-presynaptic neuron. Lokhu kuvinjelwa kuphumela ekwandeni kwe-serotonin ku-synaptic cleft. Ezinye izinhlobo zemithi efana ne Ama-inhibitors e-norepinephrine-dopamine reuptake kanye nama-inhibitors e-norepinephrine-serotonin reuptake nawo asetshenziswa ekwelapheni ukucindezeleka.

chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 26. Uhlelo Lwezinzwa | 26.5 Izinkinga Zesistimu Yezinzwa | Ezinye Izinkinga Zezinzwa | Isifo Sokuxhuzula
chapterContent:
Kunezinye izifo eziningana zezinzwa ezingeke zibekwe kalula ezigabeni ezingenhla. Lezi zihlanganisa izimo zobuhlungu obungapheli, umdlavuza wesimiso sezinzwa, izinkinga zesifo sokuwa, kanye nesifo sohlangothi.

 Isifo sokuwa
Izilinganiso zisikisela ukuthi abantu abangafika kumaphesenti amathathu e-United States bazotholakala benesifo sokuwa empilweni yabo. Nakuba kunezinhlobo eziningana ezahlukene zesifo sokuwa, zonke zibonakala ngokuwa okuphindaphindiwe. Isifo sokuwa ngokwaso singaba uphawu lokulimala kobuchopho, isifo, noma olunye ukugula. Isibonelo, abantu abakhubazekile ngokwengqondo noma i-ASD bangaba nokuwa, mhlawumbe ngoba ukungasebenzi kahle kwezintambo zokukhula okubangele izifo zabo kubabeka engozini yokuba nesifo sokuwa. Nokho, ezigulini eziningi, imbangela yesifo sokuwa kwabo ayikaze itholakale futhi kungenzeka ukuthi iyinhlanganisela yezici zofuzo kanye nezemvelo. Ngokuvamile, ukuwa kungalawulwa ngemithi yokubulala ukuwa. Kodwa-ke, ezimweni ezimbi kakhulu, iziguli zingase zihlinzwe ubuchopho ukuze kususwe indawo yobuchopho lapho kuvela khona ukuwa.

distractor4b: Ama-neurons awo aphinde avuseleleke ngokushesha okukhulu

question6: Ukuwa kuvame ukuphathwa kanjani kubantu abanesifo sokuwa?

answer7: Ukuhlinzwa kobuchopho ukususa indawo lapho kuvela khona ukuxhuzula

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 26. Uhlelo Lwezinzwa | 26.5 Izinkinga Zesistimu Yezinzwa | Ezinye Izinkinga Zezinzwa | Isifo Sohlangothi
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 26. Uhlelo Lwezinzwa | 26.5 Izinkinga Zesistimu Yezinzwa | Ezinye Izinkinga Zezinzwa | Isifo Sohlangothi
chapterContent:
Kunezinye izifo eziningana zezinzwa ezingeke zibekwe kalula ezigabeni ezingenhla. Lokhu kufaka phakathi izimo zobuhlungu obungapheli, umdlavuza wesimiso sezinzwa, izinkinga zesifo sokuwa, kanye nesifo sohlangothi.

 Isifo sohlangothi
Isifo sohlangothi sivela lapho igazi lihluleka ukufinyelela ingxenye yobuchopho isikhathi eside ngokwanele ukubangela umonakalo. Ngaphandle komoya-mpilo ohlinzekwa ukugeleza kwegazi, ama-neurons kulesi sifunda sobuchopho ayafa. Lokhu kufa kwezinzwa kungabangela izimpawu eziningi ezahlukene—kuye ngokuthi indawo yobuchopho ithintekile—kufaka phakathi ikhanda elibuhlungu, ubuthakathaka bemisipha noma ukukhubazeka, ukuphazamiseka kwenkulumo, izinkinga zezinzwa, ukulahlekelwa inkumbulo, kanye nokudideka. Isifo sohlangothi sivame ukubangelwa amahlule egazi futhi singabangelwa nokuqhuma komthambo wegazi obuthakathaka. Isifo sohlangothi sivame kakhulu futhi siyimbangela yesithathu evame kakhulu yokufa e-United States. Ngokwesilinganiso umuntu oyedwa ubhekana nesifo sohlangothi njalo ngemizuzwana engama-40 e-United States. Cishe amaphesenti angama-75 esifo sohlangothi senzeka kubantu abaneminyaka engaphezu kwengu-65. Izici eziyingozi zesifo sohlangothi zifaka phakathi umfutho wegazi ophakeme, isifo sikashukela, i-cholesterol ephezulu, kanye nomlando womndeni wesifo sohlangothi. Ngenxa yokuthi isifo sohlangothi siyisimo esiphuthumayo sezokwelapha, iziguli ezinezimpawu zohlangothi kufanele ziye ngokushesha egumbini lezimo eziphuthumayo, lapho zingathola khona imithi ezoncibilikisa noma yiliphi ihlule elingase libe khona. Le mithi ngeke isebenze uma isifo sohlangothi sibangelwe ukuqhuma komthambo wegazi noma uma isifo sohlangothi senzeke amahora angaphezu kwamathathu ngaphambi kokufika esibhedlela. Ukwelashwa ngemva kwesifo sohlangothi kungafaka imithi yokucindezela kwegazi (ukuvimbela isifo sohlangothi esikhathini esizayo) kanye nokwelashwa ngokomzimba (ngezinye izikhathi okunamandla).
answer1: Igazi lihluleka ukufinyelela engxenyeni yobuchopho isikhathi eside ngokwanele ukubangela umonakalo
question2: Kungani ama-neurons efa ngesikhathi sokuhlaselwa yisifo sohlangothi?
question3: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okungaba uphawu lwesifo sohlangothi?
question4: Iyini imbangela evame kakhulu yesifo sohlangothi?

question6: Cishe kangaki umuntu ebhekana nesifo sohlangothi e-United States?
question7: Cishe yimaphi amaphesenti okushaywa yisifo sohlangothi okwenzeka kubantu abaneminyaka engaphezu kwengu-65?
question8: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okuyingozi yokushaywa unhlangothi?
question9: Kungani isifo sohlangothi sibhekwa njengesimo esiphuthumayo sezokwelapha?
answer9: Ukwelashwa okusheshayo kungaqeda amahlule egazi uma kunikezwa zingakapheli amahora amathathu
distractor9a: Ama-neuron aphinde avuseleleke zingakapheli amahora amathathu
question10: Yikuphi ukwelashwa okunganconywa ngemva kokuhlaselwa yisifo sohlangothi ukuze kusize ukululama?

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 26. Uhlelo Lwezinzwa | 26.7 Isifinyezo Sesahluko
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 26. Uhlelo Lwezinzwa | 26.7 Isifinyezo Sesahluko
chapterContent:
26.1 Ama-Neuron nama-Glial Cells
Uhlelo lwezinzwa lwakhiwe ngama-neurons nama-glia. Ama-Neuron angamaseli akhethekile akwazi ukuthumela izimpawu zikagesi kanye nezamakhemikhali. Ama-neurons amaningi aqukethe ama-dendrites, athola lezi zimpawu, kanye nama-axon athumela izimpawu kwamanye ama-neurons noma izicubu. Kunezinhlobo ezine eziyinhloko zama-neurons: ama-unipolar, ama-bipolar, ama-multipolar, kanye nama-pseudounipolar neurons. Ama-Glia amaseli angewona ama-neuronal ohlelweni lwezinzwa asekela ukuthuthukiswa kwe-neuronal kanye nokubonisa izimpawu. Kunezinhlobo eziningana ze-glia ezikhonza imisebenzi ehlukene.

 26.2 Indlela Ama-Neuron Axhumana Ngayo
Ama-Neuron ane-membrane eshaja ngoba kunezingqimba ezahlukene zama-ion ngaphakathi nangaphandle kweseli. Iziteshi ze-ion ezigadwe yi-voltage zilawula ukuhamba kwama-ion angena futhi aphume kwi-neuron. Lapho i-membrane ye-neuronal isuswa i-polarized okungenani kuze kube sezingeni lokuvuselela, amandla okwenza izinto ayakhishwa. Amandla okwenza izinto abe esesakazwa nge-axon ene-myelinated eya kuma-terminals e-axon. Ku-synapse yamakhemikhali, amandla okwenza izinto abangela ukukhululwa kwama-molecule e-neurotransmitter ku-synaptic cleft. Ngokubopha kuma-receptor e-postsynaptic, i-neurotransmitter ingabangela amandla okuvuselela noma okuvimbelayo e-postsynaptic ngokususa i-polarizing noma i-hyperpolarizing, ngokulandelana, i-postsynaptic membrane. Ku-synapses kagesi, amandla okwenza izinto adluliselwa ngqo kuseli le-postsynaptic ngokusebenzisa ama-gap junctions—amaprotheni amakhulu esiteshi axhumanisa ama-membrane angaphambi nangemuva kwe-synaptic. Ama-synapses awazona izakhiwo ezimile futhi angaqiniswa futhi ancishiswe. Izindlela ezimbili ze-synaptic plasticity amandla esikhathi eside kanye nokucindezeleka kwesikhathi eside.

 26.3 Uhlelo Lwezinzwa Oluphakathi
Uhlelo lwezinzwa oluphakathi olunethambo lomgogodla luqukethe ubuchopho kanye nentambo yomgogodla, ezimbozwe futhi zivikelwe ama-meninge amathathu. Ubuchopho buqukethe izifunda ezichazwe ngokwesakhiwo nangokusebenza. Ezincelisayo, lokhu kufaka phakathi i-cortex (engahlukaniswa ibe yizicucu ezine eziyinhloko ezisebenzayo: i-frontal, i-temporal, i-occipital, kanye ne-parietal), i-basal ganglia, i-thalamus, i-hypothalamus, i-limbic system, i-cerebellum, kanye ne-brainstem—yize izakhiwo kwezinye zalezi zimpawu zihlangana. Ngenkathi imisebenzi ingase ibekwe endaweni eyodwa ebuchosheni, imisebenzi eminingi eyinkimbinkimbi, njengolimi nokulala, ihilela ama-neurons ezindaweni eziningi zobuchopho. Intambo yomgogodla iyindlela yolwazi exhumanisa ubuchopho nomzimba wonke ngokuxhumana kwayo nemizwa yangaphandle. Idlulisela okokufaka kwemizwa kanye nokunyakaza futhi ilawula nokuguquguquka kwemizwa.

 26.4 Uhlelo Lwezinzwa Oluzungezile
Uhlelo lwezinzwa oluzungezile luqukethe zombili izinhlelo zezinzwa ezizimele kanye nezinzwa-zomzimba. Uhlelo lwezinzwa oluzimele lunikeza ukulawula okungaqondakali emisebenzini ye-visceral futhi lunezigaba ezimbili: izinhlelo zezinzwa ezihambisanayo kanye nezihambisanayo. Uhlelo lwezinzwa oluzwela lusebenza ezimweni ezicindezelayo ukuze lulungiselele isilwane impendulo yokulwa noma yokubaleka. Uhlelo lwezinzwa olune-parasympathetic lusebenza ngezikhathi zokuphumula. Uhlelo lwezinzwa olune-sensomatic lwenziwe ngemithambo ye-cranial kanye ne-spinal edlulisa ulwazi lwezinzwa kusuka esikhumbeni nasemisipheni kuya ku-CNS kanye nemiyalo ye-motor kusuka ku-CNS kuya emisipheni.

 26.5 Ukuphazamiseka Kwesistimu Yezinzwa
Ezinye izingqikithi ezijwayelekile zivela ekuthathweni kwesampula yezinkinga zesistimu yezinzwa ezivezwe ngenhla. Izimbangela zezinkinga eziningi aziqondakali ngokugcwele—okungenani hhayi kubo bonke iziguli—futhi cishe zihilela inhlanganisela yemvelo (ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo okuba yizinto eziyingozi) kanye nokunakekelwa (ukuhlukumezeka ngokomzwelo, ukucindezeleka, ukuvezwa kwamakhemikhali okuyingozi). Ngenxa yokuthi izimbangela azikakanqunywa ngokugcwele, izinketho zokwelapha zivame ukuntuleka futhi zibhekana nezimpawu kuphela.

question14: Bheka uMfanekiso 26.34. Yisiphi isiphetho esingafinyelelwa mayelana ne-APOE gene kanye nengozi yesifo se-Alzheimer?

question19: Bheka uMfanekiso 26.37. Isignali idluliselwa kanjani isuka kwenye i-neuron iye kwenye?
answer19: Isignali ikhishwa ku-axon bese idlula ku-axon terminal, ehlanganisa ama-dendrite. Ama-dendrite athola isignali njengoba idlula ku-soma. Isignali eziningi ezivela kuma-synapses amaningi zihlanganiswa ku-axon hillock, bese idlulisela isignali ku-axon, lapho isignali idluliselwa khona kwenye iseli.
distractor19a: Isignali ikhishwa ku-axon, idlule ku-axon terminal, kanye nama-synapse anama-dendrite. Ama-dendrite athola isignali, edlula ku-soma. Isignali eziningi ezivela ku-synapse eyodwa zihlanganiswa ku-axon hillock, bese idlulisela isignali ku-axon, lapho isignali idluliselwa kwenye iseli.
distractor19b: Isignali ikhishwa kusukela esigungwini se-axon, idlule ku-axon, bese kuba nama-synapse anama-dendrite. Ama-dendrite athola isignali, edlula ku-soma. Isignali eziningi ezivela kuma-synapse amaningi zihlanganiswa ku-axon hillock, bese idlulisela isignali ku-axon, lapho isignali idluliselwa khona kwenye iseli.
distractor19c: Isignali ikhishwa kusukela esigungwini se-axon, idlule ku-axon, bese kuba nama-synapse anama-dendrite. Ama-dendrite athola isignali njengoba idlula ku-soma. Isignali eziningi ezivela ku-synapse eyodwa zihlanganiswa ku-axon hillock, bese idlulisela isignali ku-axon, lapho isignali idluliselwa kwenye iseli.
distractor20a: Wonke ama-neurons anama-dendrite amaningana okwamukela isignali
distractor20b: Imisipha ye-dendritic inciphisa ukuxhumana okungenzeka kwe-synaptic
distractor20c: Ukukhishwa kwamakhemikhali kuma-dendrites kuvumela ukuxhumana kwesignali kwamanye amaseli
question21: Bheka uMfanekiso 26.38. Yimaphi ama-ion ahambisana nomugqa ngamunye wedatha eshadini elingase libe khona le-membrane ephumuzayo?

question22: Kungani kungenakwenzeka ukuqala amandla esenzo ngaphandle kweziteshi ze-ion ezivikelwe yi-voltage?
answer22: Iseli ngeke libhekane nokungavuthwa, ukuphinda kuvolwe, kanye nokwanda kwe-hyperpolarization, okudingekayo ukuze kuqhutshwe amandla okwenza okuthile bese kubuyiselwa iseli esimweni sokuphumula.
distractor22a: Iseli ngeke lidlule ekususweni kwe-polarization, okudingekayo ukuze kuqhunyiswe amandla okwenza isenzo bese kubuyiselwa iseli esimweni sokuphumula.
distractor22b: Iseli ngeke liphinde libhekane nokushintshashintsha kwesimo, okudingekayo ukuze kuqhunyiswe amandla okwenza okuthile bese kubuyiselwa iseli esimweni sokuphumula.
distractor22c: Iseli ngeke lidlule ekususweni kobunye kanye nokwanda kobunye, okudingekayo ukuze kuqhutshwe amandla okwenza okuthile bese kubuyiselwa iseli esimweni sokuphumula.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 27. Izinhlelo Zezinzwa | 27.0 Isingeniso
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 27. Izinhlelo Zezinzwa | 27.0 Isingeniso
chapterContent: Zonke izilwane ezilinganayo zombili zinesimiso sezinzwa, okuthuthuka kwaso okuqhutshwa ukukhethwa kwemvelo. Ngakho-ke, izinhlelo zezinzwa ziyahlukahluka phakathi kwezinhlobo ngokwezidingo zendawo ezikuyo. Izinzwa zezilwane zihlala zisebenza, zizenza ziqaphele izinto ezishukumisayo, njengokukhanya, noma umsindo, noma ukuba khona kwento yamakhemikhali endaweni engaphandle. Ziphinde ziqaphe ulwazi mayelana nendawo engaphakathi yesidalwa. Ushaka oboniswe ngenhla unekhono lokubona izinto ezishukumisayo zikagesi zemvelo ezikhiqizwa ezinye izilwane endaweni ezungezile, umuzwa obizwa ngokuthi i-electroreception. Leli khono elithuthukisiwe lokuzwa inyamazane linikeza ushaka ithuba lokuziphendukela kwemvelo kunezinye izinhlanzi. Nakuba liwusizo kulesi sitha esingaphansi kwamanzi, i-electroreception umuzwa ongatholakali ezilwaneni eziningi zomhlaba. Bheka Umfanekiso 27.1

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 27. Izinhlelo Zezinzwa | 27.1 Izinqubo Zezinzwa | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 27. Izinhlelo Zezinzwa | 27.1 Izinqubo Zezinzwa | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent: Okuqukethwe kulesi sahluko akukho ngaphakathi kwe-AP® ngaphandle kokuqaphela ukuxhumana phakathi kwezitho zokuzwa kanye nesistimu yezinzwa. Ikhono lokubona nokuphendula ulwazi libalulekile ekusindeni nasekuqineni komzimba. Uma isikhathi sivuma, ungase uhlole ukuvela kohlobo olulodwa lwe-sensory receptor (ama-photoreceptor, ama-chemoreceptor, ama-thermoreceptor, noma ama-proprioreceptor) ezinhlotsheni eziningana zezilwane ezahlukene, ngokucabangela okukhethekile izici ezivumela ukuthi iguqule isikhuthazo sibe yi-nerve impulse. (Lo msebenzi uwukusetshenziswa kolwazi ku-Big Idea 1 yoHlaka lweKharikhulamu lwe-AP®—ukuthi ukuvela kwesakhiwo esinjenge-sensory receptor kusekela umqondo wokuthi ukuvela kuyaqhubeka nokwenzeka.)

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 27. Izinhlelo Zezinzwa | 27.1 Izinqubo Zezinzwa
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 27. Izinhlelo Zezinzwa | 27.1 Izinqubo Zezinzwa
chapterContent:
Izinzwa zinikeza ulwazi mayelana nomzimba kanye nendawo okuyo. Abantu banezinzwa ezinhlanu ezikhethekile: ukuhogela (iphunga), ukugwinya (ukunambitha), ukulingana (ibhalansi kanye nesimo somzimba), umbono, kanye nokuzwa. Ngaphezu kwalokho, sinezinzwa ezijwayelekile, ezibizwa nangokuthi i-somatosensation, ezisabela ezishukumisweni ezifana nokushisa, ubuhlungu, ingcindezi, kanye nokudlidliza. Umuzwa we-Vestibular, okuwumuzwa womzimba wokuqondiswa kwendawo kanye nokulinganisela, ukutholakala (indawo yamathambo, amalunga, kanye nemisipha), kanye nomuzwa wesikhundla semilenze osetshenziselwa ukulandelela i-kinesthesia (ukunyakaza kwemilenze) kuyingxenye ye-somatosensation. Nakuba izinhlelo zezinzwa ezihlobene nalezi zinzwa zihlukile kakhulu, zonke zihlanganyela umsebenzi ofanayo: ukuguqula isikhuthazo (njengokukhanya, noma umsindo, noma isikhundla somzimba) sibe isignali kagesi ohlelweni lwezinzwa. Le nqubo ibizwa ngokuthi i-sensory transduction.

 Kunezinhlobo ezimbili ezibanzi zezinhlelo zamaseli ezenza i-sensory transduction. Kokunye, i-neuron isebenza ne-sensory receptor, iseli, noma inqubo yeseli ekhethekile ukuzibandakanya nokubona isikhuthazo esithile. Ukukhuthazwa kwe-sensory receptor kushukumisa i-neuron ehlobene ne-afferent, ethwala ulwazi mayelana ne-stimulus eya ohlelweni lwezinzwa oluphakathi. Ohlotsheni lwesibili lokudluliselwa kwemizwa, isiphetho semizwa sisabela ku-stimulus emvelweni wangaphakathi noma wangaphandle: le neuron yakha i-sensory receptor. Iziphetho zemizwa zamahhala zingavuselelwa yizisusa eziningana ezahlukene, ngaleyo ndlela zibonise ukucaciswa okuncane kwe-receptor. Isibonelo, ama-sensor obuhlungu ezinsinini nasemazinyweni akho angase avuselelwe yizinguquko zokushisa, ukuvuselelwa kwamakhemikhali, noma ingcindezi.
answer1: Ukuhogela, ukugwinya, ukulingana, ukubona, nokuzwa
distractor1a: Umbono, ukuzwa, ukuthinta, ubuhlungu, kanye nokushisa
distractor1b: Iphunga, ukunambitha, ukuthinta, ibhalansi, kanye nokucindezela
distractor1c: Umbono, iphunga, ukuqonda okuyimfihlo, ubuhlungu, kanye nokudlidliza

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 27. Izinhlelo Zezinzwa | 27.1 Izinqubo Zezinzwa | Ukwamukela
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 27. Izinhlelo Zezinzwa | 27.1 Izinqubo Zezinzwa | Ukwamukela
chapterContent: Isinyathelo sokuqala sokuzwa ukwamukela, okuwukusebenza kwama-sensor receptors ngezisusa ezifana nezisusa zomshini (ukugoba noma ukucindezelwa, isibonelo), amakhemikhali, noma izinga lokushisa. I-receptor ingabe isisabela ezisusa. Indawo esesikhaleni lapho i-sensor receptor ethile ingasabela khona esisusa, kungaba kude noma ithintane nomzimba, yinsimu yokwamukela ye-receptor. Cabanga okwesikhashana ngomehluko emasimini okwamukela izinzwa ezahlukene. Ukuze uthole umuzwa wokuthinta, isisusa kumele sithintane nomzimba. Ukuze uthole umuzwa wokuzwa, isisusa singaba kude kakhulu (eminye imisindo ye-baleen whale ingasakazeka amakhilogremu amaningi amamitha ). Ukuze uthole umbono, isisusa singaba kude kakhulu; isibonelo, uhlelo lokubona lubona ukukhanya okuvela ezinkanyezini emabangeni amakhulu.
answer1: Indawo yokwamukela izivakashi
question2: Yini evuselela ama-sensor receptors ngesikhathi sokwamukelwa?
answer2: Izisusa ezifana namandla emishini, amakhemikhali, noma izinga lokushisa
question3: Iyini insimu yokwamukela?
answer3: Indawo esesikhaleni lapho i-sensor receptor ingasabela khona ku-stimulus
question4: Yiluphi uhlobo lwesikhuthazo oluyisibonelo sesikhuthazo somshini?
question5: Yimuphi umqondo okufanele isikhuthazo sithintane ngqo nomzimba?
question6: Isisindo somsindo singatholakala kude kangakanani ngomuzwa wokuzwa?
answer6: Ibanga eliphakathi nendawo, kanye nemisindo ethile yemikhomo ehamba amakhilogremu amaningi amamitha
question7: Izinto ezibonakalayo zingaqala kude kangakanani?
answer7: Kude kakhulu, kufaka phakathi ukukhanya okuvela ezinkanyezini ezikude

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 27. Izinhlelo Zezinzwa | 27.1 Izinqubo Zezinzwa | Ukuguqulwa
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 27. Izinhlelo Zezinzwa | 27.1 Izinqubo Zezinzwa | Ukuguqulwa
chapterContent:
Umsebenzi oyisisekelo kakhulu wesistimu yezinzwa ukuhumusha isignali yezinzwa ibe isignali kagesi ohlelweni lwezinzwa. Lokhu kwenzeka ku-receptor yezinzwa, futhi ushintsho emandleni kagesi akhiqizwayo lubizwa ngokuthi amandla e-receptor. Ukufakwa kwezinzwa, njengokucindezela esikhumbeni, kushintshwa kanjani kube amandla e-receptor? Kulesi sibonelo, uhlobo lwe-receptor olubizwa ngokuthi i-mechanoreceptor (njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 27.2) lunezinhlayiya ezikhethekile ezisabela ekucindezelweni. Ukuphazamiseka kwala ma-dendrite ngokuwacindezela noma ukuwagoba kuvula iziteshi ze-ion ezivalekile ku-membrane ye-plasma ye-neuron yezinzwa, kushintsha amandla ayo kagesi. Khumbula ukuthi ohlelweni lwezinzwa, ushintsho oluhle lwamandla kagesi e-neuron (olubizwa nangokuthi amandla e-membrane), lususa i-neuron. Amandla e-Receptor angama-potential ahlelwe ngokwezinga: ubukhulu bala mandla ahlelwe ngokwezinga (ama-receptor) buyahlukahluka ngamandla esikhuthazo. Uma ubukhulu be-depolarization banele (okungukuthi, uma amandla e-membrane efika emkhawulweni), i-neuron izokhipha amandla esenzo. Ezimweni eziningi, isikhuthazo esifanele esithinta i-sensor receptor sizoqhuba amandla e-membrane ngendlela enhle, yize kwamanye ama-receptor, njengalawo asesimweni sokubona, lokhu akuhlali kunjalo.

 Ama-sensory receptors ezinzwa ezahlukene ahluke kakhulu komunye nomunye, futhi akhethekile ngokohlobo lwesikhuthazo asizwelayo: anokucaciswa kwe-receptor. Isibonelo, ama-touch receptors, ama-light receptors, kanye nama-sound receptors ngalinye livuselelwa yizikhuthazo ezahlukene. Ama-touch receptors awazweli ekukhanyeni noma emsindweni; azwela kuphela ekuthinteni noma ekucindezelweni. Kodwa-ke, izikhuthazo zingahlanganiswa emazingeni aphezulu ebuchosheni, njengoba kwenzeka nge-olfaction, okufaka isandla emsindweni wethu wokunambitha.
answer1: Ukuguqula isikhuthazo sezinzwa sibe isignali kagesi ohlelweni lwezinzwa

question7: Kwenzekani uma amandla e-receptor efinyelela umkhawulo?
question8: Kusho ukuthini ukucaciswa kwe-receptor?
answer8: Ama-receptor ezinzwa akhethekile ukuphendula ezinhlotsheni ezithile zezisusa
distractor8a: I-receptor ngayinye isabela ngokulinganayo kuzo zonke izinto ezibangela ukucindezeleka.
distractor8b: Zonke izitho zokwamukela zibona kuphela izinto ezishukumisayo zemishini

distractor9b: Ama-receptors e-Olfactory athola ukunambitheka okumnandi, okumuncu, okunosawoti, nokubabayo
distractor9c: Lezi zinhlelo ezimbili zisebenza ngokuzimela ngokuphelele

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 27. Izinhlelo Zezinzwa | 27.1 Izinqubo Zezinzwa | Ukudluliselwa | Ukufakwa Kwekhodi Nokudluliselwa Kolwazi Lwezinzwa
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 27. Izinhlelo Zezinzwa | 27.1 Izinqubo Zezinzwa | Ukudluliselwa | Ukufakwa Kwekhodi Nokudluliselwa Kolwazi Lwezinzwa
chapterContent:
Izici ezine zolwazi lwezinzwa zifakwa ikhodi yizinhlelo zezinzwa: uhlobo lwesikhuthazo, indawo yesikhuthazo ensimini yokwamukela, ubude besikhuthazo, kanye namandla ahlobene nesikhuthazo. Ngakho-ke, amandla esenzo adluliselwa phezu kwama-axon ahlobene ne-receptor yezinzwa afaka ikhodi yohlobo olulodwa lwesikhuthazo, futhi lokhu kuhlukaniswa kwezinzwa kugcinwa kwezinye izifunda zezinzwa. Isibonelo, ama-receptor okuzwa adlulisela izimpawu ohlelweni lwawo oluzinikele, futhi umsebenzi kagesi kuma-axon ama-receptor okuzwa uzohunyushwa ubuchopho njengesikhuthazo sokuzwa—umsindo.

 Amandla esikhuthazo avame ukufakwa ikhodi ngesilinganiso samandla esenzo akhiqizwa yi-receptor yezinzwa. Ngakho-ke, isikhuthazo esinamandla sizokhiqiza isitimela esisheshayo samandla esenzo, futhi ukunciphisa isikhuthazo nakho kuzonciphisa izinga lokukhiqizwa kwamandla esenzo. Indlela yesibili lapho amandla afakwa ikhodi khona ngenani lama-receptor asebenzayo. Isikhuthazo esinamandla singase siqalise amandla esenzo enanini elikhulu lama-receptor aseduze, kuyilapho isikhuthazo esincane singase sivuselele ama-receptor ambalwa. Ukuhlanganiswa kolwazi lwezinzwa kuqala ngokushesha nje lapho ulwazi selutholakele ku-CNS, futhi ubuchopho buzoqhubeka nokucubungula izimpawu ezingenayo.
question1: Yiziphi izici ezine zolwazi lwezinzwa ezibhalwe phansi yizinhlelo zezinzwa?
answer1: Uhlobo, indawo, ubude, kanye nobukhulu besikhuthazo
distractor1a: Usayizi, umbala, ukuma, kanye nokushisa kwesikhuthazo
distractor1b: Ubudala, isisindo, indawo, kanye nobukhulu besikhuthazo
distractor1c: Umthombo, imvamisa, isivinini, kanye nesiqondiso sesikhuthazo
question2: Hlobo luni lwama-neurons athwala ulwazi lwezinzwa oluvela kuma-receptors luye ohlelweni lwezinzwa oluphakathi?
question3: Ubuchopho buwuchaza kanjani umsebenzi kagesi ohamba nge-axons ye-auditory receptor?
question4: Ukuqina kwesikhuthazo kuvame kanjani ukufakwa ikhodi yi-receptor yezinzwa?

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 27. Izinhlelo Zezinzwa | 27.1 Izinqubo Zezinzwa | Ukuqonda
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 27. Izinhlelo Zezinzwa | 27.1 Izinqubo Zezinzwa | Ukuqonda
chapterContent:
Ukuqonda kuyindlela yomuntu yokuchaza umuzwa. Nakuba ukuqonda kuncike ekusebenzeni kwama-sensory receptors, ukuqonda akwenzeki ezingeni le-sensory receptor, kodwa emazingeni aphezulu ohlelweni lwezinzwa, ebuchosheni. Ubuchopho buhlukanisa izinto ezishukumisayo ngokusebenzisa indlela yezinzwa: amandla esenzo avela kuma-sensory receptors ahamba ngama-neurons azinikele ekushukumiseni okuthile. Lawa ma-neurons azinikele kulokho kukhuthaza okuthile kanye ne-synapse nama-neurons athile ebuchosheni noma emgogodleni.

 Zonke izimpawu zezinzwa, ngaphandle kwalezo ezivela ohlelweni lwe-olfactory, zidluliselwa ohlelweni lwezinzwa oluphakathi futhi zihanjiswa ziye kwi-thalamus kanye nendawo efanele ye-cortex. Khumbula ukuthi i-thalamus iyisakhiwo ebuchosheni obungaphambili esisebenza njenge-clearinghouse kanye nesiteshi sokudlulisela izimpawu zezinzwa (kanye ne-motor). Lapho isignali yezinzwa iphuma kwi-thalamus, iqhutshwa endaweni ethile ye-cortex (Isithombe 27.3) esizinikele ekucubunguleni lowo muzwa othile.

 Zichazwa kanjani izimpawu zezinzwa? Ukuchazwa kwezimpawu zokuzwa phakathi kwabantu bohlobo olufanayo kufana kakhulu, ngenxa yokufana okuzuzwe njengefa kwezinhlelo zabo zezinzwa; noma kunjalo, kunezinye izinhlobo ezahlukene. Isibonelo esihle salokhu ukubekezelela komuntu ngamunye isikhuthazo esibuhlungu, njengobuhlungu bamazinyo, obuhlukile impela.
answer1: Ukuchazwa komuntu ngamunye kwemizwa
question2: Ukuqonda kwenzeka ngaliphi izinga?
question3: Ubuchopho buhlukanisa kanjani izinto ezishukumisa izinzwa ezahlukene?
answer3: Ngezindlela ezizinikele zezinzwa eziphethe izinhlobo ezithile zolwazi
distractor3a: Ngokuthumela zonke izinto ezishukumisayo ngama-neurons afanayo
distractor3c: Ngokuguqula zonke izinto ezishukumisayo zibe izimpawu zemoto
question4: Yisiphi isimiso sezinzwa esingahambisi izimpawu zaso nge-thalamus ngaphambi kokufika ku-cortex?
question5: Iyini indima eyinhloko ye-thalamus ekucubungulweni kwezinzwa?
answer5: Isebenza njengendawo yokudlulisela kanye nendawo yokuhlanza izimpawu zokuzwa kanye nezimoto
distractor5a: Ikhiqiza amandla okwenza izinto kuma-receptor ezinzwa
question6: Ngemva kokuphuma ku-thalamus, isignali yezinzwa iqhutshwa kuphi?
answer6: Endaweni ethile ye-cortex yobuchopho ecubungula lowo muzwa
question7: Kungani ukuhumusha kwezinzwa ngokuvamile kufana phakathi kwabantu bohlobo olufanayo?
answer7: Ngoba bazuza njengefa izinhlelo zezinzwa ezifanayo
distractor7a: Ngoba wonke umuntu uhlangabezana nezimo ezifanayo
distractor7b: Ngoba ama-sensor receptors afana kuzo zonke izilwane
distractor7c: Ngoba wonke amandla esenzo anokuphindaphinda okufanayo
question8: Yisiphi isibonelo somehluko womuntu ngamunye ekuqondeni okukhulunywe ngawo embhalweni?

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 27. Izinhlelo Zezinzwa | 27.2 Ukuzwa Kwe-Somato
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 27. Izinhlelo Zezinzwa | 27.2 Ukuzwa Kwe-Somato
chapterContent:
I-Somatosensation iyisigaba sezinzwa ezixubile futhi ihlanganisa yonke imizwa etholakala esikhumbeni kanye nasezingxeni zamafinyila, kanye nasezithweni nasemalungeni. I-Somatosensation yaziwa nangokuthi umuzwa wokuthinta, noma ngokujwayelekile, njengomuzwa wokuthinta. I-Somatosensation yenzeka kuyo yonke indawo yangaphandle yomzimba nakwezinye izindawo zangaphakathi. Izinhlobo ezahlukene ze-receptor—ezifakwe esikhumbeni, izingxeni zamafinyila, imisipha, amalunga, izitho zangaphakathi, kanye nesistimu yenhliziyo—zidlala indima.

 Khumbula ukuthi i-epidermis iwungqimba lwangaphandle lwesikhumba ezincelisayo. Incane kakhulu, yakhiwe ngamaseli agcwele i-keratin, futhi ayinalo igazi. I-epidermis isebenza njengesithiyo emanzini nasekuhlaselweni yizifo ezibangelwa amagciwane. Ngaphansi kwalokhu, i-dermis ejiyile kakhulu iqukethe imithambo yegazi, izindlala zokujuluka, ama-follicle ezinwele, imithambo ye-lymph, kanye nezindlala ze-sebaceous ezikhipha amafutha (Isithombe 27.4). Ngaphansi kwe-epidermis kanye ne-dermis kukhona izicubu ezingaphansi komhlaba, noma i-hypodermis, ungqimba olunamafutha oluqukethe imithambo yegazi, izicubu ezixhumeneyo, kanye nama-axon ama-neurons ezinzwa. I-hypodermis, ephethe cishe amaphesenti angu-50 amafutha omzimba, inamathisela i-dermis emathanjeni nasemisipheni, futhi inikeze imizwa nemithambo yegazi ku-dermis.
answer1: Isigaba sezinzwa ezixubile esihlanganisa imizwa evela esikhumbeni, emaqakaleni, emalungeni, nasemalungeni
question2: Iliphi elinye igama le-somatosensation?
question3: Kwenzeka kuphi ukuzwela kwe-somato?
answer3: Ngaphezulu kwangaphandle komzimba nakwezinye izindawo zangaphakathi
question4: Yiziphi izakhiwo eziqukethe ama-receptor ahilelekile ekuzweleni kwe-somato?
answer4: Isikhumba, ulwelwesi lwamafinyila, imisipha, amalunga, izitho zangaphakathi, kanye nesistimu yenhliziyo nemithambo yegazi
question5: Iyini ungqimba olungaphandle kakhulu lwesikhumba sezilwane ezincelisayo?
question6: Yisiphi isici esichaza i-epidermis?
answer6: Yakhiwe ngamaseli agcwele i-keratin futhi ayinalo igazi eliningi
distractor6a: Iqukethe izindlala zokujuluka kanye nezimbotshana zezinwele
question7: Yiziphi izakhiwo ezitholakala ku-dermis?
answer7: Imithambo yegazi, izindlala zokujuluka, ama-follicle ezinwele, imithambo ye-lymph, kanye nezindlala ze-sebaceous
question8: Liyini elinye igama lezicubu ezingaphansi kwesikhumba?
question9: Uyini umsebenzi oyinhloko we-hypodermis?
answer9: Inamathisela i-dermis emathanjeni nasemisipheni futhi ihlinzeka ngemizwa nemithambo yegazi ku-dermis.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 27. Izinhlelo Zezinzwa | 27.2 Ukuzwa Kwe-Somato | Ama-Receptors E-Somatosensory
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 27. Izinhlelo Zezinzwa | 27.2 Ukuzwa Kwe-Somato | Ama-Receptors E-Somatosensory
chapterContent:
Ama-receptor e-Somatosensory ahlukaniswe ngezigaba ezine: ama-mechanoreceptors, ama-thermoreceptors, ama-pain receptors (ama-nociceptors), kanye nama-chemoreceptors. Lezi zigaba zisekelwe kuhlobo lwezikhuthazo ezidluliselwa yikilasi ngalinye lama-receptor. Lokho okuvame ukubizwa ngokuthi ukuthinta” kuhilela izinhlobo ezingaphezu kweyodwa zesikhuthazo kanye nezinhlobo ezingaphezu kweyodwa ze-receptor. Ama-Mechanoreceptors esikhumbeni achazwa ngokuthi ahlanganiswe (okungukuthi, azungezwe i-capsule) noma angahlanganisiwe (iqembu elihlanganisa ukuphela kwemizwa yamahhala). Isiphetho semizwa yamahhala, njengoba igama laso lisho, yi-dendrite engahlanganisiwe ye-neuron yezinzwa. Iziphetho zemizwa yamahhala yizona ezivame kakhulu ukuphela kwemizwa esikhumbeni, futhi zidlulela phakathi kwe-epidermis. Iziphetho zemizwa yamahhala zizwela kakhulu ezishukumisweni ezibuhlungu, ekushiseni nasekubanda, kanye nasekuthinteni okuncane. Ziyaphuza ukuzivumelanisa nesishukumi ngakho-ke azizweli kangako ezinguqukweni ezisheshayo ekushukumisweni.

 Kunezinhlobo ezintathu zama-mechanoreceptors: ama-tactile, ama-proprioreceptors, nama-baroreceptors. Ama-Mechanoreceptors azwa izishukumi ngenxa yokuguquka komzimba kwama-membrane awo e-plasma. Aqukethe iziteshi ze-ion ezivalwe ngomshini amasango awo avuleka noma avaleka ngenxa yokucindezela, ukuthinta, ukwelula, nomsindo. Kunezinhlobo ezine eziyinhloko zama-tactile mechanoreceptors esikhumbeni somuntu: Amadiski kaMerkel, ama-corpuscle kaMeissner, iziphetho zikaRuffini, kanye ne-corpuscle kaPacinian; amabili atholakala ebusweni besikhumba kanti amabili atholakala ngokujulile. Uhlobo lwesihlanu lwe-mechanoreceptor, ama-Krause end bulbs, atholakala kuphela ezindaweni ezikhethekile. Amadiski kaMerkel (aboniswe kuMfanekiso 27.5) atholakala ezingqimbeni eziphezulu zesikhumba eduze kwesisekelo se-epidermis, kokubili esikhumbeni esinezinwele nasesikhumbeni esicwebezelayo, okungukuthi, isikhumba esingenaboya esitholakala ezintendeni zezandla neminwe, ezithendeni zezinyawo izinyawo, kanye nasezindebeni zabantu nezinye izilwane. Amadiski kaMerkel asatshalaliswe kakhulu ezinyaweni zeminwe nasezindebeni. Ayiziphetho zemizwa ezivumelana kancane, ezingavaliwe, futhi asabela ekuthinteni okulula. Ukuthinta okulula, okwaziwa nangokuthi ukuthinta okuhlukile, ukucindezela okulula okuvumela indawo yesikhuthazo ukuthi ikhonjwe. Amasimu okwamukela amadiski kaMerkel mancane anemingcele echazwe kahle. Lokho kuwenza abe nomuzwa omuhle emaphethelweni futhi asetshenziswa emisebenzini efana nokuthayipha ikhibhodi.

 Ama-corpuscle kaMeissner, (aboniswe kuMfanekiso 27.6) aziwa nangokuthi ama-corpuscle athintayo, atholakala ku-dermis engenhla, kodwa aphumela ku-epidermis. Nawo, atholakala ikakhulukazi esikhumbeni esithambile ezinyaweni nasezinkopheni. Asabela ekuthinteni okuncane nasekucindezelweni, kodwa futhi asabela ekudlidlizeni noma ekushayweni okuphansi. Azivumelanisa ngokushesha, agcwele uketshezi, afakwe ema-neurons anemingcele emincane, echazwe kahle futhi asabela emininingwaneni emincane. Njengama-disk kaMerkel, ama-corpuscle kaMeissner awaningi ezintendeni zezandla njengoba enjalo ezinyaweni.

 Ejulile ku-epidermis, eduze kwesisekelo, kukhona ukuphela kwe-Ruffini, okwaziwa nangokuthi ama-corpuscle ama-bulbous. Atholakala kokubili esikhumbeni esithambile nesinoboya. Lawa ama-mechanoreceptor ashintsha kancane, afakwe ema-capsule athola ukwelula kwesikhumba kanye nokuguquguquka ngaphakathi kwamalunga, ngakho-ke anikeza impendulo ebalulekile yokubamba izinto nokulawula. isikhundla nokunyakaza kweminwe. Ngakho-ke, ziphinde zibe negalelo ekuqondeni komuntu kanye ne-kinesthesia. Iziphetho ze-Ruffini nazo zibona ukufudumala. Qaphela ukuthi lezi zivikeli zokufudumala zitholakala ngokujulile esikhumbeni kunezivikeli zokushisa. Akumangazi-ke ukuthi abantu bathola izikhuthazo ezibandayo ngaphambi kokuba bathole izikhuthazo ezifudumele.

 Ama-corpuscle asePacinian (abonakala ku-Figure 27.7) atholakala ekujuleni kwesikhumba sesikhumba esicwebezelayo nesinoboya futhi afana ngokwesakhiwo nama-corpuscle kaMeissner; atholakala ku-periosteum yamathambo, ama-capsule ahlangene, ama-pancreas kanye nezinye izitho zangasese, amabele, kanye nezitho zangasese. Ashintsha ngokushesha ama-mechanoreceptor azwa ingcindezi ejulile yesikhashana (kodwa hhayi ende) kanye nokudlidliza okuphezulu. Ama-receptor asePacinian abona ingcindezi nokudlidliza ngokucindezelwa, avuselele ama-dendrite awo angaphakathi. Kuneziphetho ezimbalwa ze-Pacinian kanye neziphetho ze-Ruffini esikhumbeni kunezidiski zikaMerkel kanye nama-corpuscle kaMeissner.

 Ku Izimpawu zokutholwa, zokutholwa kanye neze-kinesthetic zihamba ngama-neuron afferent afferent agijima esuka emgogodleni iye e-medulla. Ama-neurons awaxhunyiwe ngokomzimba, kodwa axhumana ngama-neurotransmitters akhishwe kuma-synapses noma izikhala” phakathi kwama-neurons axhumanayo. Uma ese-medulla, ama-neurons aqhubeka nokuthwala izimpawu aye e-thalamus.

 Ama-spindle emisipha angama-stretch receptors athola inani lokwelula, noma ukwandiswa kwemisipha. Okuhlobene nalokhu yizitho ze-tendon ze-Golgi, okuyi-tension receptors ezithola amandla okuqina kwemisipha. Izimpawu zokutholwa kanye neze-kinesthetic zivela emilenzeni. Izimpawu zokutholwa ezingazi lutho zigijima kusukela emgogodleni ziye e-cerebellum, isifunda sobuchopho esihlanganisa ukugoba kwemisipha, kunokuba ziye e-thalamus, njengolunye ulwazi oluningi lwezinzwa.

 Ama-baroreceptors athola izinguquko zokucindezela esithweni. Atholakala ezindongeni zomthambo we-carotid kanye ne-aorta lapho eqapha khona umfutho wegazi, nasemaphashini lapho ethola khona izinga lokukhula kwamaphaphu. Ama-stretch receptors atholakala ezindaweni ezahlukene ohlelweni lokugaya ukudla kanye nomchamo.

 Ngaphezu kwalezi zinhlobo ezimbili zama-deeper receptors, kukhona nama-hair receptors ashintsha ngokushesha, atholakala eziphethweni zemizwa ezizungeza isisekelo sezinwele. Kunezinhlobo ezimbalwa zama-hair receptors ezithola ukunyakaza kwezinwele okuhamba kancane nokusheshayo, futhi ziyahlukahluka ngokuzwela kwazo ukunyakaza. Amanye ama-hair receptors athola nokuphambuka kwesikhumba, kanti amanye ama-hair receptors ashintsha ngokushesha avumela ukutholakala kwezinto ezingakathinti isikhumba.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 27. Izinhlelo Zezinzwa | 27.2 Ukuzwa Kwemizwa | Ama-Receptors E-Somatosensory | Ukuhlanganiswa Kwezimpawu Ezivela Kuma-Mechanoreceptors
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 27. Izinhlelo Zezinzwa | 27.2 Ukuzwa Kwemizwa | Ama-Receptors E-Somatosensory | Ukuhlanganiswa Kwezimpawu Ezivela Kuma-Mechanoreceptors
chapterContent: Ukwakheka kwezinhlobo ezahlukene zama-receptor asebenza ngokubambisana esikhumbeni somuntu kuphumela ekuzweni kokuthinta okucwengekile kakhulu. Ama-receptor e-nociceptive—lawo abona ubuhlungu—atholakala eduze kobuso. Ama-mechanoreceptor amancane, alinganiswe kahle—ama-disk kaMerkel nama-corpuscle kaMeissner—atholakala ezingqimbeni eziphezulu futhi angakwazi ukuthola indawo ngisho nokuthinta okumnene. Ama-mechanoreceptor amakhulu—ama-corpuscle kaPacinian kanye neziphetho zikaRuffini—atholakala ezingqimbeni ezingezansi futhi asabela ekuthinteni okujulile. (Cabanga ukuthi ingcindezi ejulile efinyelela kulawo ma-receptor ajulile ngeke kudingeke itholakale kahle.) Zombili izingqimba eziphezulu nezingezansi zesikhumba zibamba ngokushesha futhi zivumelanisa ama-receptor kancane kancane. Zombili izingqimba eziyinhloko ze-somatosensory cortex kanye nezindawo ze-cortical zesibili zinomthwalo wokucubungula isithombe esiyinkimbinkimbi sezinto ezidluliselwa ekuhlanganyeleni kwama-mechanoreceptors.

answer1: Ngoba izinhlobo eziningi zama-mechanoreceptors zisebenza ndawonye ukuthola izinhlobo ezahlukene zezikhuthazo

distractor6b: Ngoba ama-receptor obuhlungu kuphela asabela ekucindezelekeni okujulile
distractor6c: Ngoba ingcindezi ejulile icutshungulwa kuphela emgogodleni
question7: Yiziphi izinhlobo zama-adapting receptors ezitholakala kokubili ezingxenyeni eziphezulu nezingezansi zesikhumba?
answer7: Ukuvumelanisa ngokushesha futhi kancane kancane ama-receptor

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 27. Izinhlelo Zezinzwa | 27.2 Ukuzwa Kwe-Somato | Ama-Receptors E-Somatosensory | Ubuningi Bama-Mechanoreceptors
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 27. Izinhlelo Zezinzwa | 27.2 Ukuzwa Kwe-Somato | Ama-Receptors E-Somatosensory | Ubuningi Bama-Mechanoreceptors
chapterContent:
Ukusatshalaliswa kwama-touch receptors esikhumbeni somuntu akuhlali njalo emzimbeni. Kubantu, ama-touch receptors aminyene kakhulu esikhumbeni esimbozwe yinoma yiluphi uhlobo lwezinwele, njengezingalo, imilenze, umzimba, nobuso. Ama-touch receptors aminyene kakhulu esikhumbeni esicwebezelayo (uhlobo olutholakala ezinzwaneni zomuntu nasezindebeni, isibonelo), oluvame ukuzwela kakhulu futhi lujiyile kunesikhumba esinoboya (4 kuya ku-5 mm uma kuqhathaniswa no-2 kuya ku-3 mm).

 Kulinganiselwa kanjani ubuningi bama-receptor kumuntu? Ubuningi obuhlobene bama-pressure receptors ezindaweni ezahlukene emzimbeni bungaboniswa ngokuhlola kusetshenziswa isivivinyo sokuhlukaniswa kwamaphuzu amabili. Kulo mboniso, amaphuzu amabili abukhali, njenge-thumbtacks ezimbili, ahlanganiswa nesikhumba somuntu (nakuba kungenzima ngokwanele ukubangela ubuhlungu noma ukuphula isikhumba). Umuntu ubika uma ezwa iphuzu elilodwa noma amabili. Uma amaphuzu amabili ezwakala njengephuzu elilodwa, kungacatshangwa ukuthi amaphuzu amabili womabili asensimini yokwamukela ye-sensory eyodwa. Uma amaphuzu amabili ezwakala njengephuzu elilodwa, ngalinye lisensimini yokwamukela yama-sensory amabili ahlukene. Amaphuzu angabe esehanjiswa eduze futhi ahlolwe kabusha kuze kube yilapho umuntu ebika ukuthi uzizwa enephuzu elilodwa kuphela, futhi ubukhulu bensimu yokwamukela ye-receptor eyodwa bungalinganiswa kusukela kulelo banga.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 27. Izinhlelo Zezinzwa | 27.2 Ukuzwa Kwe-Somato | Ukwamukela Ukushisa Kwegazi
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 27. Izinhlelo Zezinzwa | 27.2 Ukuzwa Kwe-Somato | Ukwamukela Ukushisa Kwegazi
chapterContent: Ngaphezu kwama-Krause end bulbs athola ukubanda kanye nokuphela kwe-Ruffini okubona ukufudumala, kunezinhlobo ezahlukene zama-cold receptors kwezinye iziphetho ze-nerve ezikhululekile: ama-thermoreceptors, atholakala ku-dermis, imisipha yamathambo, isibindi, kanye ne-hypothalamus, asebenza ngokushisa okuhlukene. Izindlela zawo eziya ebuchosheni ziqala kusukela emgogodleni nge-thalamus kuya ku-cortex eyinhloko ye-somatosensory. Ulwazi lokufudumala nokubanda oluvela ebusweni luhamba ngesinye sezinzwa ze-cranial luye ebuchosheni. Uyazi ngokuhlangenwe nakho kwakho ukuthi isikhuthazo esibandayo noma esishisayo esingabekezeleleka singathuthuka ngokushesha siye esikhuthazweni esinamandla kakhulu esingasabekezeleleki. Noma yisiphi isikhuthazo esinamandla kakhulu singabhekwa njengobuhlungu ngoba imizwa yokushisa yenziwa ngezindlela ezifanayo ezithwala imizwa yobuhlungu.

answer5: Intambo yomgogodla, i-thalamus, kanye ne-cortex eyinhloko ye-somatosensory

distractor7c: Ngoba amazinga okushisa aphakeme adlula isimiso sezinzwa

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 27. Izinhlelo Zezinzwa | 27.3 Ukunambitha Nokuphunga
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 27. Izinhlelo Zezinzwa | 27.3 Ukunambitha Nokuphunga
chapterContent: Ukunambitha, okubizwa nangokuthi i-gustation, kanye nephunga, elibizwa nangokuthi i-olfaction, yizinzwa ezixhumene kakhulu ngoba zombili zihilela ama-molecule esikhuthazo angena emzimbeni futhi ahlangane nama-receptor. Ukunuka kuvumela isilwane ukuzwa ukuba khona kokudla noma ezinye izilwane—kungaba abangane abangaba khona, izilwane ezidla ezinye, noma izisulu—noma amanye amakhemikhali endaweni ezungezile angathinta ukusinda kwazo. Ngokufanayo, umuzwa wokunambitha uvumela izilwane ukuthi zihlukanise phakathi kwezinhlobo zokudla. Ngenkathi inani lomuzwa wokunuka lisobala, liyini inani lomuzwa wokunambitha? Ukudla okuhlukahlukene kokunambitha kunezimfanelo ezahlukene, eziwusizo neziyingozi. Isibonelo, izinto ezinambitha ubumnandi zivame ukuba nama-caloric amaningi, okungadingeka ukuze usinde ngezikhathi zokungabi namandla. Ukufutheka kuhlotshaniswa nobuthi, kanti ubumuncu buhlotshaniswa nokudla okonakele. Ukudla okunosawoti kubalulekile ekugcineni i-homeostasis ngokusiza umzimba ukuthi ugcine amanzi nangokuhlinzeka ngama-ion adingekayo ukuze amaseli asebenze.
question1: Yiziphi izinzwa ezimbili zamakhemikhali okuxoxwe ngazo kulesi sigaba?
answer1: Ukunambitha (ukudla) nokunuka (ukunuka)

answer4: Kuyasiza ukuhlukanisa phakathi kwezinhlobo ezahlukene zokudla

answer8: Zisiza ekugcineni i-homeostasis ngokugcina amanzi nokunikeza ama-ion abalulekile

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 27. Izinhlelo Zezinzwa | 27.3 Ukunambitha Nokuphunga | Ukunambitha Nokuphunga
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 27. Izinhlelo Zezinzwa | 27.3 Ukunambitha Nokuphunga | Ukunambitha Nokuphunga
chapterContent:
Kokubili ukunambitheka kanye nephunga kuyizinto ezitholakala endaweni ezungezile. Ukunambitheka okuyinhloko okutholwa ngabantu kumnandi, kumuncu, kubabayo, kusawoti kanye ne-umami. Ukunambitheka kokuqala okune akudingi ncazelo eningi. Ukuhlonza i-umami njengokunambitheka okuyisisekelo kwenzeke muva nje—kwatholakala ngo-1908 ngusosayensi waseJapan uKikunae Ikeda ngenkathi esebenza ngomhluzi wolwandle, kodwa kwakungamukelwa kabanzi njengokunambitheka okungahlukaniswa ngokomzimba kwaze kwaba yiminyaka eminingi kamuva. Ukunambitheka kwe-umami, okwaziwa nangokuthi ukunambitheka, kubangelwa ukunambitheka kwe-amino acid L-glutamate. Eqinisweni, i-monosodium glutamate, noma i-MSG, ivame ukusetshenziswa ekuphekeni ukuthuthukisa ukunambitheka okumnandi kokudla okuthile. Iyini inani eliguquguqukayo lokukwazi ukuhlukanisa i-umami? Izinto ezinongiwe zivame ukuba namaprotheni amaningi.

 Wonke amaphunga esiwabonayo angama-molecule emoyeni esiwuphefumulayo. Uma into ingakhiphi ama-molecule emoyeni esuka ebusweni bayo, ayinaphunga. Futhi uma umuntu noma esinye isilwane singenayo i-receptor eqaphela i-molecule ethile, khona-ke leyo molecule ayinaphunga. Abantu banezinhlobo ze-receptor ezicishe zibe ngu-350 ezisebenza ngokuhlanganiswa okuhlukahlukene ukuze sikwazi ukuzwa amaphunga ahlukene angaba ngu-10,000. Qhathanisa lokho namagundane, isibonelo, anezinhlobo ze-receptor ezicishe zibe ngu-1,300, ngakho-ke mhlawumbe ezwa amaphunga amaningi. Kokubili amaphunga nokunambitha kuhilela ama-molecule avuselela ama-chemoreceptor athile. Nakuba abantu bevame ukuhlukanisa ukunambitheka njengomuzwa owodwa nokunuka njengomunye, basebenzisana ukudala umbono wokunambitheka. Umbono womuntu ngokunambitheka uyancipha uma enemihubhe emincane yekhala.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 27. Izinhlelo Zezinzwa | 27.3 Ukunambitha Nokuphunga | Ukwamukela Nokudluliswa Kwezinzwa
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 27. Izinhlelo Zezinzwa | 27.3 Ukunambitha Nokuphunga | Ukwamukela Nokudluliswa Kwezinzwa
chapterContent:
Amaphunga (ama-molecule ephunga) angena ekhaleni bese encibilika ku-epithelium yephunga, i-mucosa ngemuva komgodi wekhala (njengoba kuboniswe ku-Figure 27.8). I-epithelium yephunga iyiqoqo lama-receptor akhethekile ephunga ngemuva komgodi wekhala ohlanganisa indawo engaba ngu-5 cm 2 kubantu. Khumbula ukuthi amangqamuzana emizwa angama-neurons. I-receptor yephunga, okuyi-dendrite ye-neuron ekhethekile, iyaphendula lapho ibopha ama-molecule athile aphefumulwe endaweni ezungezile ngokuthumela imizwa ngqo ku-bulb yephunga yobuchopho. Abantu bane-receptor yephunga engaba yizigidi ezingu-12, esakazeke phakathi kwamakhulu ezinhlobo ezahlukene zama-receptor ezisabela emaphunga ahlukene. Izigidi eziyishumi nambili zibonakala njengenani elikhulu lama-receptor, kodwa qhathanisa lokho nezinye izilwane: onogwaja banezigidi ezingaba yi-100, iningi lezinja linezigidi ezingaba yi-1, kanti ama-bloodhound—izinja ezikhuliswe ngokukhetha ngenxa yemizwa yazo yokuhogela—anezigidi ezingaba yi-4. Ubukhulu be-epithelium ye-olfactory buhlukile phakathi kwezinhlobo, njengoba eye-bloodhound, isibonelo, inkulu ngokuphindwe kaningi kunoyabantu.

 Ama-neuron e-olfactory angama-neuron e-bipolar (ama-neurons anezinqubo ezimbili ezisukela emzimbeni weseli). I-neuron ngayinye ine-dendrite eyodwa efihliwe ku-epithelium ye-olfactory, futhi esukela kule-dendrite kune-cilia engu-5 kuya ku-20 ethwele ama-receptor, efana nezinwele ebamba ama-molecule e-olrant. Ama-receptor e-sensory ku-cilia angamaprotheni, futhi ukuhlukahluka kwamaketanga awo e-amino acid okwenza ama-receptor azwele kuma-odorant ahlukene. I-neuron ngayinye ye-olfactory sensory inohlobo olulodwa kuphela lwe-receptor ku-cilia yayo, futhi ama-receptor akhethekile ukuthola ama-odorant athile, ngakho-ke ama-neurons e-bipolar ngokwawo akhethekile. Lapho i-odorant ibopha ne-receptor eyiqaphelayo, i-neuron ye-sensory ehlobene ne-receptor iyakhuthazwa. Ukukhuthazwa kwe-olfactory kuwukuphela kolwazi lwe-sensory olufinyelela ngqo ku-cortex yobuchopho, kanti eminye imizwa idluliselwa nge-thalamus.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 27. Izinhlelo Zezinzwa | 27.3 Ukunambitha Nokuphunga | Ukwamukela Nokudluliswa Kwazo | Ama-Pheromone
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 27. Izinhlelo Zezinzwa | 27.3 Ukunambitha Nokuphunga | Ukwamukela Nokudluliswa Kwazo | Ama-Pheromone
chapterContent:
I-pheromone iyikhemikhali ekhishwa yisilwane ethinta ukuziphatha noma i-physiology yezilwane zohlobo olufanayo. Izimpawu ze-pheromonal zingaba nemiphumela ejulile ezilwaneni eziziphefumulayo, kodwa ama-pheromone ngokusobala awabonakali ngamabomu ngendlela efanayo namanye amaphunga. Kunezinhlobo eziningana ezahlukene zama-pheromone, ezikhishwa emchameni noma njengezinto ezikhipha ama-glandular. Ama-pheromone athile ayakhanga kubalingani abangaba khona, amanye ayaxosha abancintisani abangaba khona bobulili obufanayo, kanti amanye adlala indima ekunamatheleni kukamama nosana. Amanye ama-pheromone angathonya nesikhathi sokuthomba, ashintshe imijikelezo yokuzala, futhi avimbele nokufakelwa kombungu. Ngenkathi izindima zama-pheromone ezinhlotsheni eziningi ezingezona ezomuntu zibalulekile, ama-pheromone awabalulekanga kangako ekuziphatheni kwabantu ngesikhathi sokuziphendukela kwemvelo uma kuqhathaniswa nokubaluleka kwawo ezintweni eziphilayo ezinezindlela zokuziphatha ezilinganiselwe.

 Isitho se-vomeronasal (i-VNO, noma isitho sikaJacobson) sisitho esishubhu, esigcwele uketshezi, esinukayo esikhona ezilwaneni eziningi ezinomgogodla ezihlala eduze komgodi wekhala. Izwela kakhulu kuma-pheromone futhi ixhunywe emgodini wempumulo ngepayipi. Lapho ama-molecule encibilika ku-mucosa yesikhala sempumulo, abese engena ku-VNO lapho ama-molecule e-pheromone phakathi kwawo ebopha khona ama-receptor akhethekile e-pheromone. Lapho echayeka kuma-pheromone avela ezinhlotsheni zawo noma kwezinye, izilwane eziningi, kufaka phakathi amakati, zingabonisa impendulo ye-flehmen (eboniswe kuMfanekiso 27.9), ukugoba komlomo ongaphezulu okusiza ama-molecule e-pheromone ukuthi angene ku-VNO.

 Izimpawu ze-pheromonal zithunyelwa, hhayi kubhamuza oyinhloko we-olfactory, kodwa esakhiweni esihlukile se-neural esivelela ngqo ku-amygdala (khumbula ukuthi i-amygdala iyisikhungo sobuchopho esibalulekile ekuphenduleni ngokomzwelo, njengokwesaba). Isibonakaliso se-pheromonal sibe sesiqhubeka siye ezindaweni ze-hypothalamus eziyisihluthulelo se-physiology yokuzala nokuziphatha. Nakuba abanye ososayensi begomela ngokuthi i-VNO ibonakala ingasebenzi kahle kubantu, yize kukhona isakhiwo esifanayo esiseduze nemigodi yamakhala abantu, abanye bayayicwaninga njengohlelo olusebenzayo olungaba khona, isibonelo, olungasiza ekuvumelaneni kwemijikelezo yokuya esikhathini kwabesifazane abahlala eduze.
answer1: Ikhemikhali ekhishwa yisilwane ethinta ukuziphatha noma i-physiology yezilwane zohlobo olufanayo

answer8: Akubalulekile kangako ekuziphatheni kwabantu ngesikhathi sokuziphendukela kwemvelo

distractor9a: Ama-pheromone akhishwa yi-exlind yesifazane bese engena esithweni se-vomeronasal. Ama-molecule ancibilikile abopha kuma-receptor, athumela isignali ku-hypothalamus, yona ethumela isignali ku-amygdala.
distractor9b: Ama-pheromone akhishwa yi-extrusion yesifazane bese engena ku-amygdala. Ama-molecule ancibilikile abopha kuma-receptor, athumela isignali esithweni se-vomeronasal, esithumela isignali ku-hypothalamus.
distractor9c: Ama-pheromone akhishwa yi-exlind yesifazane bese engena ku-amygdala. Ama-molecule ancibilikile anamathela kuma-receptor, athumela isignali ku-hypothalamus, yona ethumela isignali esithweni se-vomeronasal.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 27. Izinhlelo Zezinzwa | 27.3 Ukunambitha Nokuphunga | Ukwamukela Nokudluliswa Kwezinzwa | Ukunambitha
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 27. Izinhlelo Zezinzwa | 27.3 Ukunambitha Nokuphunga | Ukwamukela Nokudluliswa Kwezinzwa | Ukunambitha
chapterContent:
Ukuthola ukunambitheka (ukunambitheka) kufana kakhulu nokuthola iphunga (ukunuka), njengoba kokubili ukunambitheka nephunga kuncike kuma-receptor amakhemikhali avuselelwa ama-molecule athile. Isitho esiyinhloko sokunambitha yi-tastebud. I-tastebud iyiqoqo lama-receptors okunambitha (amaseli okunambitha) atholakala ngaphakathi kwamaqhubu olimini abizwa ngokuthi i-papillae (inye: i-papilla) (okuboniswe ku-Figure 27.10). Kunezinhlobo eziningana zama-papillae ahlukene ngokwesakhiwo. Ama-Filiform papillae, atholakala ngaphesheya kolimi, ayathinteka, ahlinzeka ngokungqubuzana okusiza ulimi ukuhambisa izinto, futhi awaqukethe amaseli okunambitha. Ngokuphambene nalokho, ama-papillae e-fungiform, atholakala ikakhulukazi ezingxenyeni ezimbili kuya kwezintathu zolimi, ngalinye liqukethe amaqhubu okunambitha okukodwa kuya kweziyisishiyagalombili futhi linama-receptor okucindezela nokushisa.

 Ngaphezu kwalezo zinhlobo ezimbili zama-papillae azwela ngamakhemikhali nangokwemishini kukhona ama-papillae afana namaqabunga atholakala emafolweni afanayo emaphethelweni nangemuva kolimi, njengoba kuboniswe ku-Mifanekiso 27.10 micrograph. Ama-papillae angama-foliate aqukethe ama-nambitheka angaba ngu-1,300 ngaphakathi kwamafoldi awo. Ekugcineni, kukhona ama-papillae azungezayo, angama-papillae afana nodonga ngesimo se-V” eguquliwe ngemuva kolimi. I-papillae ngayinye izungezwe umsele futhi iqukethe ama-tastebud angaba ngu-250.

 Amaseli okunambitha e-tastebud ngayinye ayashintshwa njalo ezinsukwini eziyi-10 kuya kweziyi-14. Lawa amaseli amade anezinqubo ezifana nezinwele ezibizwa ngokuthi ama-microvilli eziqongweni ezinwebeka embotsheni ye-tastebud (bonisa ku-Figure 27.11). Ama-molecule okudla (ama-tastant) ayancibilika ematheni, futhi abopha futhi avuselele ama-receptor ku-microvilli. Ama-receptor ama-tastant atholakala engxenyeni engaphandle nangaphambili kolimi, ngaphandle kwendawo ephakathi lapho ama-papillae e-filiform evelele khona kakhulu.

 Kubantu, kunezinhlobo ezinhlanu eziyinhloko zokunambitha, futhi ukunambitheka ngakunye kunohlobo olulodwa oluhambisanayo lwe-receptor. Ngakho-ke, njenge-olfaction, i-receptor ngayinye iqondene nesikhuthazo sayo (i-tastant). Ukudluliselwa kwezinhlobo ezinhlanu zokunambitha kwenzeka ngezindlela ezahlukene ezibonisa ukwakheka kwama-molecule e-tastant. I-tastant enosawoti (equkethe i-NaCl) inikeza ama-ion e-sodium (Na+) angena kuma-neurons okunambitha futhi awavuselele ngqo. Ama-tastant anosawoti angama-acid futhi angomndeni wamaprotheni e-thermoreceptor. Ukubopha kwe-acid noma enye i-molecule enambitha umuncu kubangela ushintsho esiteshini se-ion futhi lokhu kwandisa ukugcwala kwe-hydrogen ion (H+) kuma-neurons okunambitha, ngaleyo ndlela kuwaqede amandla. Ama-tastant anomnandi, ababayo, kanye ne-umami adinga i-receptor ehlanganisiwe ye-G-protein. Lawa ma-tastant abopha kuma-receptor awo, ngaleyo ndlela avuse ama-neurons akhethekile ahlobene nawo.

 Kokubili amakhono okunambitha kanye nomuzwa wokuhogela kuyashintsha ngokuguga. Kubantu, izinzwa ziyawohloka kakhulu lapho umuntu eneminyaka engu-50 futhi ziyaqhubeka nokuncipha. Ingane ingathola ukudla okubabayo kakhulu, kanti umuntu osekhulile angathola ukudla okufanayo kungamnandi futhi kungamnandi.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 27. Izinhlelo Zezinzwa | 27.3 Ukunambitha Nokunuka | Ukunuka Nokunuka Ebuchosheni
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 27. Izinhlelo Zezinzwa | 27.3 Ukunambitha Nokunuka | Ukunuka Nokunuka Ebuchosheni
chapterContent:
Ama-neurons e-olfactory avela ku-epithelium ye-olfactory aye ku-bulb ye-olfactory njengama-axon amancane, angafakwanga i-myelin. I-bulb ye-olfactory yakhiwe ngamaqoqo e-neural abizwa ngokuthi ama-glomeruli, futhi i-glomerulus ngayinye ithola izimpawu ezivela kolunye uhlobo lwe-receptor ye-olfactory, ngakho-ke i-glomerulus ngayinye ikhethekile ku-one phunga. Kusukela ku-glomeruli, izimpawu ze-olfactory zihamba ngqo ku-cortex ye-olfactory bese ziya ku-cortex yangaphambili kanye ne-thalamus. Khumbula ukuthi lena yindlela ehlukile kolunye ulwazi oluningi lwezinzwa, oluthunyelwa ngqo ku-thalamus ngaphambi kokuphela ku-cortex. Izimpawu ze-olfactory nazo zihamba ngqo ku-amygdala, ngemva kwalokho zifinyelele ku-hypothalamus, i-thalamus, kanye ne-cortex yangaphambili. Isakhiwo sokugcina izimpawu ze-olfactory ezihamba ngqo kuso yisikhungo se-cortical esakhiweni se-lobe yesikhashana esibalulekile ezinkumbulo zendawo, ze-autobiographical, ze-declarative, kanye neze-episodic. I-olfaction ekugcineni icutshungulwa yizindawo zobuchopho ezibhekene nenkumbulo, imizwa, ukuzala, kanye nomcabango.

 Ama-neurons okunambitha avela kumaseli okunambitha olimini, emhubheni, naselungwini kuya ku-medulla, esiqwini sobuchopho. Kusukela ku-medulla, izimpawu zokunambitha ziya ku-thalamus bese ziya ku-cortex eyinhloko yokunambitha. Ulwazi oluvela ezifundeni ezahlukene zolimi luhlukaniswe ku-medulla, i-thalamus, kanye ne-cortex.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 27. Izinhlelo Zezinzwa | 27.4 Ukuzwa Nokuzwa Kwe-Vestibular
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 27. Izinhlelo Zezinzwa | 27.4 Ukuzwa Nokuzwa Kwe-Vestibular
chapterContent: Ukuzwa, noma ukuzwa, kubalulekile kubantu nakwezinye izilwane ekusebenzelaneni okuningi okuhlukene. Kwenza isidalwa sikwazi ukubona nokwamukela ulwazi mayelana nengozi, njengesilo esisondelayo, nokuhlanganyela ekushintshaneni komphakathi okufana nalokho okuphathelene nezindawo noma ukuhlangana. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, nakuba kuxhunywe ngokomzimba ohlelweni lokuzwa, uhlelo lwe-vestibular aluhilelekile ekuzweni. Esikhundleni salokho, uhlelo lwe-vestibular lwesilwane luthola ukunyakaza kwaso, kokubili ukusheshisa okuqondile kanye nokujika kanye nokwehla kwejubane, kanye nokulinganisela.
answer1: Umuzwa wokuzwa

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 27. Izinhlelo Zezinzwa | 27.4 Ukuzwa Nokuzwa Kwe-Vestibular | Umsindo
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 27. Izinhlelo Zezinzwa | 27.4 Ukuzwa Nokuzwa Kwe-Vestibular | Umsindo
chapterContent:
Izinto ezishukumisayo zokuzwa amaza omsindo, angamagagasi okucindezela omshini ahamba ngendlela, njengomoya noma amanzi. Awekho amagagasi omsindo endaweni engenalutho njengoba kungekho ma-molecule omoya ahamba ngamaza. Ijubane lamagagasi omsindo liyahluka, ngokusekelwe ekuphakameni, izinga lokushisa, kanye neliphakathi, kodwa ezingeni lolwandle kanye nezinga lokushisa elingu-20o C (68o F), amagagasi omsindo ahamba emoyeni cishe ngama-343 amamitha ngomzuzwana.

 Njengoba kunjalo kuwo wonke amagagasi, kunezici ezine eziyinhloko zamagagasi omsindo: imvamisa, ubude besikhathi, isikhathi, kanye ne-amplitude. Imvamisa yinani lamagagasi ngeyunithi yesikhathi, futhi emsindweni uzwakala njenge-pitch. Imisindo yemvamisa ephezulu (≥15,000Hz) iphakeme kakhulu (ubude besikhathi obufushane) kunemisindo yemvamisa ephansi (ubude besikhathi eside; ≤100Hz). Ngemvamisa yomsindo, iyunithi esetshenziswa kakhulu yi-hertz (Hz), noma imijikelezo ngomzuzwana. Iningi labantu lingabona imisindo enemvamisa ephakathi kuka-30 no-20,000 Hz. Abesifazane bavame ukuba ngcono ekuzweni amaza aphezulu, kodwa ikhono lawo wonke umuntu lokuzwa amaza aphezulu liyancipha ngokweminyaka. Izinja zibona kufika ku-40,000 Hz; amakati, angu-60,000 Hz; amalulwane, angu-100,000 Hz; namahlengethwa angu-150,000 Hz, kanye ne-American shad (Alosa sapidissima), inhlanzi, ingezwa u-180,000 Hz. Lawo maza angaphezu kwebanga lomuntu abizwa ngokuthi i-ultrasound.

 Ukuphakama, noma ubukhulu begagasi kusukela endaweni yokuphumula (ukulingana) kuya esicongweni, emsindweni uzwakala njengevolumu futhi uboniswe kuMfanekiso 27.12. Amaza omsindo emisindo ephakeme anokuphakama okukhulu kunalawo emisindo ethambile. Ngomsindo, ivolumu ilinganiswa ngama-decibel (dB). Umsindo othambile kakhulu umuntu angawuzwa yiphuzu elingu-zero. Abantu bakhuluma ngokujwayelekile kuma-decibel angu-60

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 27. Izinhlelo Zezinzwa | 27.4 Ukuzwa Nokuzwa Nge-Vestibular | Ukwamukela Umsindo
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 27. Izinhlelo Zezinzwa | 27.4 Ukuzwa Nokuzwa Nge-Vestibular | Ukwamukela Umsindo
chapterContent: Ezincelisayo, amaza omsindo aqoqwa yingxenye yangaphandle yendlebe ebizwa ngokuthi i-auricle, bese ehamba ngomsele wokuzwa bese ebangela ukudlidliza kwe-diaphragm encane ebizwa ngokuthi i-tympanum noma i-ear drum, ingxenye engaphakathi yendlebe yangaphandle (eboniswe ku-Figure 27.13). Ingaphakathi le-tympanum yindlebe ephakathi. Indlebe ephakathi iphethe amathambo amathathu amancane abizwa ngokuthi ama-ossicles, adlulisela amandla kusuka ku-tympanum ehambayo aye endlebeni engaphakathi. Ama-ossicles amathathu yi-malleus (eyaziwa nangokuthi i-hammer), i-incus (i-anvil), kanye ne-stapes (i-stirrup). Ama-stapes aqanjwe ngokufanele abukeka njenge-stirrup. Ama-ossicles amathathu ahlukile ezincelisayo, futhi ngalinye lidlala indima ekuzweni. I-malleus inamathela ezindaweni ezintathu ebusweni bangaphakathi be-tympanic membrane. I-incus inamathela i-malleus kuma-stapes. Kubantu, ama-stapes awade ngokwanele ukufinyelela i-tympanum. Ukube besingenayo i-malleus kanye ne-incus, khona-ke ukudlidliza kwe-tympanum bekungeke kufinyelele endlebeni yangaphakathi. Lawa mathambo asebenza futhi ukuqoqa amandla nokukhulisa imisindo. Ama-ossicles endlebe afana namathambo emlonyeni wenhlanzi: amathambo asekela ama-gill enhlanzini kucatshangwa ukuthi alungele ukusetshenziswa endlebeni yezilwane ezinomgogodla ngesikhathi sokuziphendukela kwemvelo. Izilwane eziningi (amaxoxo, izilwane ezihuquzelayo, nezinyoni, isibonelo) zisebenzisa ama-stapes endlebeni ephakathi ukudlulisa ukudlidliza endlebeni yangaphakathi.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 27. Izinhlelo Zezinzwa | 27.4 Ukuzwa Nokuzwa Nge-Vestibular | Ukudluliselwa Komsindo
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 27. Izinhlelo Zezinzwa | 27.4 Ukuzwa Nokuzwa Nge-Vestibular | Ukudluliselwa Komsindo
chapterContent:
Izinto ezidlidlizayo, njengezintambo zezwi, zidala amaza omsindo noma amaza okucindezela emoyeni. Lapho la maza okucindezela efika endlebeni, indlebe idlulisela lesi sikhuthazo somshini (igagasi lokucindezela) sibe yi-nerve impulse (isignali kagesi) ubuchopho obuyibona njengomsindo. Amaza okucindezela ashaya i-tympanum, okwenza idlidlize. Amandla omshini avela ku-tympanum ehambayo adlulisela ukudlidliza emathanjeni amathathu endlebe ephakathi. Ama-stapes adlulisela ukudlidliza ku-diaphragm encane ebizwa ngokuthi i-oval window, okuyisakhiwo sangaphandle sendlebe yangaphakathi. Izakhiwo zendlebe yangaphakathi zitholakala ku-labyrinth, isakhiwo esinamathambo, esingenalutho esiyingxenye engaphakathi kakhulu yendlebe. Lapha, amandla avela kugagasi lomsindo adluliselwa kusuka ku-stapes ngefasitela eligobile eliguquguqukayo kanye noketshezi lwe-cochlea. Ukudlidliza kwefasitela eligobile kudala amaza okucindezela kuketshezi (perilymph) ngaphakathi kwe-cochlea. I-cochlea iyisakhiwo esifana ne-whorled, njengegobolondo le-snake, futhi iqukethe ama-receptor okudlulisela igagasi lomshini libe yisignali kagesi (njengoba kuboniswe ku-Figure 27.14). Ngaphakathi kwe-cochlea, i-basilar membrane iyi-mechanical analyzer eqhuba ubude be-cochlea, igobe iye enkabeni ye-cochlea.

 Izakhiwo ze-mechanical ze-basilar membrane ziyashintsha ngobude bayo, kangangokuthi ijiyile, ithambile, futhi incane ngaphandle kwe-whorl (lapho i-cochlea inkulu khona), futhi incane, i-floppier, futhi ibanzi iye eqophelweni, noma enkabeni, ye-whorl (lapho i-cochlea incane kakhulu). Izifunda ezahlukene ze-basilar membrane ziyavevezela ngokwemvamisa yegagasi lomsindo eliqhutshwa ngoketshezi ku-cochlea. Ngenxa yalezi zizathu, i-cochlea egcwele uketshezi ithola amaza ahlukene wamagagasi (ama-pitches) ezindaweni ezahlukene ze-membrane. Lapho amaza omsindo ku-cochlear fluid ethinta i-basilar membrane, iyaguquguquka iye emuva naphambili ngendlela efana negagasi. Ngaphezulu kwe-basilar membrane kukhona i-tectorial membrane.

 Indawo yokudluliselwa kwe-transduction isesitho se-Corti (isitho esijikelezayo). Sakhiwe ngamaseli ezinwele abanjwe endaweni yawo ngaphezu kwe-basilar membrane njengezimbali ezivela enhlabathini, kanye ne-stereocilia yazo emfushane, efana nezinwele ebonakala ithinta noma inamathele ku-tectorial membrane engaphezulu kwawo. Amaseli ezinwele zangaphakathi ayizitho zokwamukela eziyinhloko futhi akhona emgqeni owodwa, angaba ngu-3,500. Ama-stereocilia avela kumaseli ezinwele zangaphakathi anwebeka abe yizimbotshana ezincane ebusweni obungezansi be-tectorial membrane. Amaseli ezinwele zangaphandle ahlelwe ngemigqa emithathu noma emine. Angaba ngu-12,000, futhi asebenza ukulungisa kahle amaza omsindo angenayo. Ama-stereocilia amade avela kumaseli ezinwele zangaphandle empeleni anamathela ku-tectorial membrane. Wonke ama-stereocilia angama-mechanoreceptors, futhi uma egobile ngokudlidliza aphendula ngokuvula isiteshi se-ion esivalwe ngesango (bheka kuMfanekiso 27.2). Ngenxa yalokho, ulwelwesi lweseli lezinwele luyasuswa, bese kudluliselwa isignali emthanjeni we-chochlear. Ubukhulu bomsindo bunqunywa ukuthi mangaki amangqamuzana ezinwele endaweni ethile ashukunyiswayo.

 Amangqamuzana ezinwele ahlelwe kulwelwesi lwe-basilar ngendlela ehlelekile. Ulwelwesi lwe-basilar luyavevezela ezindaweni ezahlukene, ngokuya ngemvamisa yamaza omsindo ayithintayo. Ngokufanayo, amangqamuzana ezinwele abekwe ngaphezu kwalo azwela kakhulu kumvamisa ethile yamaza omsindo. Amangqamuzana ezinwele angaphendula kububanzi obuncane bemvamisa efanayo, kodwa adinga ukukhuthazwa okukhulu ukuze aqhume kumaza angaphandle kobubanzi bawo obuhle. Umehluko kumvamisa yokuphendula phakathi kwamangqamuzana ezinwele angaphakathi aseduze cishe ungamaphesenti angu-0.2. Qhathanisa lokho nezintambo zepiyano eziseduze, ezihlukile cishe ngamaphesenti ayisithupha. Ithiyori yendawo, okuyimodeli yokuthi izazi zezinto eziphilayo zicabanga ukuthi ukutholwa kwephimbo kusebenza kanjani endlebeni yomuntu, ithi imisindo yemvamisa ephezulu ivevezela ngokukhetha ulwelwesi lwe-basilar lwendlebe yangaphakathi eduze kwesango lokungena (ifasitela eliyindilinga). Amaza aphansi ahamba phambili kulwelwesi ngaphambi kokubangela ukucasuka okukhulu kwelwelwesi. Indlela eyisisekelo yokunquma iphimbo isekelwe endaweni eseduze nolwelwesi lapho amangqamuzana ezinwele evuselelwa khona. Ithiyori yendawo iyisinyathelo sokuqala sokuqonda ukuqonda iphimbo. Uma kucatshangelwa ukuzwela okukhulu kwephimbo lendlebe yomuntu, kucatshangwa ukuthi kumele kube nendlela ethile yokulola indlebe ukuze kuthuthukiswe isinqumo sephimbo.

 Lapho amaza omsindo ekhiqiza amaza oketshezi ngaphakathi kwe-cochlea, i-basilar membrane iyaguquguquka, igobe i-stereocilia enamathela ku-tectorial membrane. Ukugoba kwawo kuphumela emandleni esenzo emaseli ezinwele, futhi ulwazi lokuzwa luhamba ngeziphetho ze-neural zama-bipolar neurons amaseli ezinwele (ngokubambisana, i-auditory nerve) ebuchosheni. Lapho izinwele zigoba, zikhipha i-neurotransmitter evusa inkanuko ku-synapse ene-sensory neuron, eqhuba amandla esenzo ohlelweni lwezinzwa oluphakathi. Igatsha le-cochlear le-vestibulocochlear cranial nerve lithumela ulwazi ngokuzwa. Uhlelo lokuzwa lucwengekile kakhulu, futhi kukhona ukuguqulwa noma ukulola okwakhelwe ngaphakathi. Ubuchopho bungathumela izimpawu emuva ku-cochlea, okuholela ekushintsheni kobude emaseli ezinwele angaphandle, kucijise noma kunciphise impendulo yamaseli ezinwele kumaza athile.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 27. Izinhlelo Zezinzwa | 27.4 Ukuzwa Nokuzwa Nge-Vestibular | Ukudluliselwa Komsindo | Ukucubungula Okuphezulu (Ukudluliselwa Komsindo)
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 27.4 Ukuzwa Nokuzwa Kwe-Vestibular | Ukuguqulwa Komsindo | Ukucubungula Okuphezulu (Ukuguqulwa Komsindo)
chapterContent: Amaseli ezinwele zangaphakathi abaluleke kakhulu ekudluliseleni ulwazi lokuzwa ebuchosheni. Cishe amaphesenti angama-90 ama-neuron ahlobene athwala ulwazi oluvela kumaseli ezinwele zangaphakathi, kanti iseli ngalinye lezinwele lihlangana nama-neurons angaba yi-10. Amaseli ezinwele zangaphandle axhuma kumaphesenti ayi-10 kuphela ama-neurons ahlobene, futhi i-neuron ngayinye ehlobene ivikela amaseli amaningi ezinwele. Ama-neurons ahlobene, aguquguqukayo, adlulisela ulwazi lokuzwa ahamba esuka ku-cochlea aye ku-medulla, ngokusebenzisa ama-pons kanye nobuchopho obuphakathi esikhumbeni sobuchopho, ekugcineni afinyelela ku-cortex eyinhloko yokuzwa ku-lobe yesikhashana.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 27. Izinhlelo Zezinzwa | 27.4 Ukuzwa Nokuzwa Kwe-Vestibular | Ulwazi Lwe-Vestibular
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 27.4 Ukuzwa Nokuzwa Kwe-Vestibular | Ulwazi Lwe-Vestibular
chapterContent:
Izinto ezihambisana nohlelo lwe-vestibular ukusheshisa okuqondile (amandla adonsela phansi) kanye nokusheshisa kwe-angular kanye nokwehla kwejubane. Amandla adonsela phansi, ukusheshisa, kanye nokwehla kwejubane kutholwa ngokuhlola i-inertia kumaseli amukelayo ohlelweni lwe-vestibular. Amandla adonsela phansi atholakala ngokuma kwekhanda. Ukusheshisa kwe-angular kanye nokwehla kwejubane kuvezwa ngokujika noma ukutshekisa ikhanda.

 Uhlelo lwe-vestibular lunokufana okuthile nohlelo lokuzwa. Lusebenzisa amaseli ezinwele njengohlelo lokuzwa, kodwa luwavusa ngezindlela ezahlukene. Kunezitho ezinhlanu ze-vestibular receptor endlebeni yangaphakathi: i-utricle, i-saccule, kanye nemisele emithathu ye-semicircular. Ndawonye, zakha lokho okwaziwa ngokuthi i-vestibular labyrinth eboniswe kuMfanekiso 27.15. I-utricle kanye ne-saccule zisabela ekusheshiseni ngendlela eqondile, njengokudonsa phansi. Amaseli ezinwele angaba ngu-30,000 ku-utricle kanye namaseli ezinwele angu-16,000 ku-saccule angaphansi kwengqimba ye-gelatinous, kanti i-stereocilia yawo ivelela ku-gelatin. Kuleli gelatin kukhona amakristalu e-calcium carbonate—njengamatshe amancane. Uma ikhanda litshekile, amakristalu ayaqhubeka nokudonswa phansi ngqo ngamandla adonsela phansi, kodwa i-engeli entsha yekhanda ibangela ukuthi i-gelatin ishintshe, ngaleyo ndlela igobe i-stereocilia. Ukugoba kwe-stereocilia kuvuselela ama-neurons, futhi atshela ubuchopho ukuthi ikhanda litshekile, okuvumela ukugcinwa kwebhalansi. Yigatsha le-vestibular le-vestibulocochlear cranial nerve elibhekene nebhalansi.

 Ama-semicircular canals agcwele uketshezi ayizihibe ezi-tubular ezibekwe kuma-engeli a-oblique. Ahlelwe ngezindawo ezintathu. Isisekelo somsele ngamunye sinokuvuvukala okuqukethe iqoqo lamaseli ezinwele. Izinwele ziphuma zibe yi-gelatinous cap ebizwa ngokuthi i-cupula futhi ziqaphe ukusheshisa kwe-angular kanye nokwehla kwejubane kusukela ekujikelezeni. Zingakhuthazwa ngokushayela imoto yakho ekhoneni, ukujika ikhanda lakho, noma ukuwa phambili. Umsele owodwa ulele ngokuvundlile, kanti eminye emibili ilale cishe ngama-degree angu-45 kuya ku-axis evundlile, njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 27.15. Lapho ubuchopho bucubungula okungenayo okuvela kuzo zonke imisele emithathu ndawonye, bungathola ukusheshisa noma ukwehla kwejubane ngezilinganiso ezintathu. Lapho ikhanda liphenduka, uketshezi olusemiseleni luyashintsha, ngaleyo ndlela lugobe i-stereocilia futhi luthumele izimpawu ebuchosheni. Lapho kuphela ukusheshisa noma ukwehla kwejubane—noma ukuhamba nje—ukunyakaza koketshezi olungaphakathi kwemisele kuyehla noma kuyeke. Isibonelo, cabanga ubambe ingilazi yamanzi. Lapho uhamba phambili, amanzi angase ashaye emuva esandleni, futhi lapho ukunyakaza sekumile, amanzi angase ashaye phambili eminweni. Ngesikhathi ukunyakaza, amanzi ahlala engilazini futhi awashayi. Qaphela ukuthi imisele ayizweli ijubane ngokwalo, kodwa ibhekene noshintsho lwejubane, ngakho-ke ukuya phambili ngesivinini esingu-60mph ngamehlo akho avaliwe ngeke kukunikeze umuzwa wokunyakaza, kodwa ukusheshisa noma ukubhuleka kungashukumisa ama-receptor ngokuzumayo.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 27. Izinhlelo Zezinzwa | 27.4 Ukuzwa Nokuzwa Kwe-Vestibular | Ulwazi Lwe-Vestibular | Ukucubungula Okuphezulu (Ulwazi Lwe-Vestibular)
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 27.4 Ukuzwa Nokuzwa Kwe-Vestibular | Ulwazi Lwe-Vestibular | Ukucubungula Okuphezulu (Ulwazi Lwe-Vestibular)
chapterContent: Amaseli ezinwele avela emiseleni ye-utricle, i-saccule, kanye ne-semicircular nawo axhumana ngama-neuron e-bipolar aye kwi-nucleus ye-cochlear e-medulla. Ama-neurons e-cochlear athumela ama-projection ehlayo aye emgogodleni kanye nama-projection enyukayo aye kuma-pons, thalamus, kanye ne-cerebellum. Ukuxhumana ne-cerebellum kubalulekile ekunyakazeni okuhlelekile. Kukhona futhi ama-projection aya kwi-temporal cortex, abangela imizwa yokuba nesiyezi; ama-projection aya ezindaweni zesistimu yezinzwa ezizimele ebuchosheni, abangela ukugula kokunyakaza; kanye nama-projection aya kwi-primary somatosensory cortex, eqaphela izilinganiso ezizimele zomhlaba wangaphandle kanye nokuzinyakazisa. Abantu abanezilonda endaweni ye-vestibular ye-somatosensory cortex babona izinto eziqondile emhlabeni njengezithambekile. Okokugcina, izimpawu ze-vestibular ziya emisipheni ethile ye-optic ukuze zihlanganise ukunyakaza kwamehlo nekhanda.
