chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 27. Izinhlelo Zezinzwa | 27.5 Ukubona
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 27.5 Umbono
chapterContent: Ukubona yikhono lokubona amaphethini okukhanya avela endaweni engaphandle bese uwahumusha abe yizithombe. Izilwane zigcwele ulwazi lwezinzwa, futhi inani elikhulu lolwazi olubonakalayo lingaba yinkinga. Ngenhlanhla, izinhlelo ezibonwayo zezinhlobo zezilwane ziye zashintsha ukuze zinakekele izinto ezibaluleke kakhulu. Ukubaluleka kokubona kubantu kuqinisekiswa kakhulu yiqiniso lokuthi cishe ingxenye eyodwa kwezintathu ye-cortex yobuchopho bomuntu izinikele ekuhlaziyeni nasekuboneni ulwazi olubonwayo.
answer1: Ikhono lokubona amaphethini okukhanya avela endaweni ezungezile bese uwahumusha abe izithombe
distractor1a: Ikhono lokubona amaza omsindo nokuwahumusha abe yinkulumo
distractor1c: Ikhono lokubona ingcindezi bese uyichaza njengokuthinta
question2: Kungani ulwazi olubonakalayo lungaba yinselele ukuthi izilwane zilucubungule?
answer2: Ngoba izilwane zihlala zihlaselwa ngolwazi oluningi olubonakalayo
distractor2b: Ngoba iso libona umbala owodwa ngesikhathi
distractor2c: Ngoba ama-visual receptors awakwazi ukuzivumelanisa nezimo ezishintshayo

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 27. Izinhlelo Zezinzwa | 27.5 Umbono | Ukukhanya
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 27.5 Umbono | Ukukhanya
chapterContent:
Njengasezintweni ezishukumisayo, ukukhanya kuhamba ngamagagasi. Amagagasi okucindezela aqamba umsindo kumele ahambe endaweni ephakathi nendawo—igesi, uketshezi, noma into eqinile. Ngokuphambene nalokho, ukukhanya kwakhiwe ngamagagasi kagesi futhi akudingi ndawo ephakathi nendawo; ukukhanya kungahamba endaweni engenalutho (Isithombe 27.16). Ukuziphatha kokukhanya kungaxoxwa ngokuphathelene nokuziphatha kwamagagasi kanye nangokuphathelene nokuziphatha kweyunithi eyisisekelo yokukhanya—iphakethe lemisebe kagesi ebizwa ngokuthi i-photon. Ukubheka i-spectrum ye-electromagnetic kubonisa ukuthi ukukhanya okubonakalayo kubantu kumane kuyingcezu encane ye-spectrum yonke, okuhlanganisa imisebe esingenakuyibona njengokukhanya ngoba ingaphansi kwemvamisa yokukhanya okubomvu okubonakalayo futhi ingaphezu kwemvamisa yokukhanya okuluhlaza okotshani okubonakalayo.

 Izinguquko ezithile zibalulekile lapho kuxoxwa ngokubona ukukhanya. Ubude be-wavelength (obuhlukahluka ngokuphambene nemvamisa) buzibonakalisa njengombala. Ukukhanya ekugcineni okubomvu kwe-spectrum ebonakalayo kune-wavelengths ende (futhi imvamisa ephansi), kuyilapho ukukhanya ekugcineni kwe-violet kune-wavelengths emfushane (futhi imvamisa ephezulu). Ubude be-wavelength bokukhanya buvezwa ku-nano amamitha (nm); I-nanometer eyodwa iyingxenye eyodwa kweziyizigidigidi zemitha. Abantu babona ukukhanya okuphakathi kuka-380 nm no-740 nm. Nokho, ezinye izilwane zingabona ubude bamaza ngaphandle kwebanga labantu. Isibonelo, izinyosi zibona ukukhanya okuseduze kwe-ultraviolet ukuze zithole iziqondiso ze-nectar ezimbalini, kanti ezinye izilwane ezihuquzelayo ezingezona izinyoni zizwa ukukhanya kwe-infrared (ukushisa okukhishwa yizinyamazane).

 Ukuphakama kwamagagasi kubhekwa njengokukhanya okukhulu, noma ukukhanya. Iyunithi ejwayelekile yokukhanya okukhulu yi-candela, okucishe kube ukuqina okukhanyayo kwekhandlela elilodwa elivamile.

 Amagagasi okukhanya ahamba amakhilomitha angu-299,792 ngomzuzwana endaweni engenalutho, (futhi kancane kancane ezindaweni ezahlukahlukene njengomoya namanzi), futhi lawo magagasi afika esweni njengamagagasi amade (abomvu), aphakathi (aluhlaza), kanye namafushane (aluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka). Lokho okubizwa ngokuthi ukukhanya okumhlophe” ukukhanya okubonwa njengokumhlophe yiso lomuntu. Lo mphumela ukhiqizwa ukukhanya okuvuselela ngokulinganayo ama-receptor ombala esweni lomuntu. Umbala obonakalayo wento umbala (noma imibala) obonakaliswa yinto. Ngakho-ke into ebomvu ibonakalisa ubude besikhathi obubomvu ekukhanyeni okuxubile (okumhlophe) futhi imunca wonke amanye ubude besikhathi bokukhanya.

answer1: Ukukhanya kungahamba nge-vacuum, kanti umsindo udinga i-medium
distractor1a: Umsindo ungahamba nge-vacuum, kanti ukukhanya kudinga i-medium
distractor1b: Kokubili ukukhanya nomsindo kudinga indawo ewuketshezi
distractor1c: Ukukhanya noma umsindo akukwazi ukuhamba nge-vacuum

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 27. Izinhlelo Zezinzwa | 27.5 Umbono | Ukwakheka Kweso
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 27.5 Umbono | Ukwakheka Kweso
chapterContent:
Amaseli e-photoreceptive eliso, lapho kwenzeka khona ukudluliselwa kokukhanya kuya ezinzwa, atholakala ku-retina (okuboniswe ku-Figure 27.17) ebusweni bangaphakathi bengemuva leso. Kodwa ukukhanya akuthinteli i-retina ingashintshiwe. Kudlula kwezinye izendlalelo eziyisebenzisa ukuze ikwazi ukuhunyushwa yi-retina (Figure 27.17b). I-cornea, ungqimba olungaphambili olubonakalayo lweso, kanye ne-crystalline lens, isakhiwo esibonakalayo esihlanganisiwe ngemuva kwe-cornea, kokubili kushintsha ukukhanya ukuze kugxile isithombe ku-retina. I-iris, ebonakala njengengxenye enemibala yeso, iyindandatho yemisipha eyindilinga elele phakathi kwelensi ne-cornea elawula inani lokukhanya okungena esweni. Ezimweni zokukhanya okuphezulu, i-iris iyafinyela, inciphise usayizi womfundi ophakathi nendawo. Ezimweni zokukhanya okuphansi, i-iris iyakhululeka futhi umfundi uyakhula.

 Umsebenzi oyinhloko welensi ukugxila ukukhanya ku-retina kanye ne-fovea centralis. Ilensi iyashintshashintsha, igxila futhi igxila kabusha ekukhanyeni njengoba iso lihlala ezintweni eziseduze nezikude ensimini yokubona. Ilensi isebenza ngemisipha eyinwebayo noma eyivumela ukuba ijiye, ishintsha ubude bokukhanya obungena kuyo ukuze igxile kakhulu ku-retina. Ngokukhula kulandela ukulahlekelwa ukuguquguquka kwelensi, futhi kuvela uhlobo lokubona kude olubizwa ngokuthi i-presbyopia. I-Presbyopia yenzeka ngoba isithombe sigxila ngemuva kwe-retina. I-Presbyopia iyisici esifana nohlobo oluhlukile lokubona kude olubizwa ngokuthi i-hyperopia olubangelwa yi-eyeball emfushane kakhulu. Kuzo zombili iziphambeko, izithombe ezikude zicacile kodwa izithombe eziseduze azicacile. I-Myopia (ukubona eduze) yenzeka lapho i-eyeball inwetshwa futhi ukugxila kwesithombe kuwela phambi kwe-retina. Kulokhu, izithombe ezikude azicacile kodwa izithombe eziseduze zicacile.

 Kunezinhlobo ezimbili zama-photoreceptors ku-retina: izinduku nama-cone, aqanjwe ngokubukeka kwawo okuvamile njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 27.18. Izinduku zizwela kakhulu ezithombeni futhi zitholakala emaphethelweni angaphandle e-retina. Zibona ukukhanya okufiphele futhi zisetshenziselwa ikakhulukazi ukubona okuseceleni nasebusuku. Ama-cone azwela kancane ezithombeni futhi atholakala eduze nesikhungo se-retina. Asabela ekukhanyeni okukhanyayo, futhi indima yawo eyinhloko iwukubona imibala emini.

 I-fovea yisifunda esisemuva kweso esibangela umbono obukhali. I-fovea inama-cone amaningi. Uma uletha amehlo akho entweni ukuze uyihlole ngokucophelela ekukhanyeni okukhanyayo, amehlo aqondisa ukuze isithombe sento siwele ku-fovea. Kodwa-ke, uma ubheka inkanyezi esibhakabhakeni sasebusuku noma enye into ekukhanyeni okufiphele, into ingabukwa kangcono ngombono ongaphandle ngoba yizinduku ezisemaphethelweni e-retina, kunokuba yizinduku ezisemaphakathini, ezisebenza kangcono ekukhanyeni okuphansi. Kubantu, ama-cone maningi kakhulu kunezinduku eziku-fovea

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 27. Izinhlelo Zezinzwa | 27.5 Umbono | Ukudluliselwa Kokukhanya
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 27.5 Umbono | Ukudluliselwa Kokukhanya
chapterContent: Izinduku nama-cone kuyindawo lapho ukukhanya kudluliselwa khona esignalini ye-neural. Zombili izinduku nama-cone ziqukethe ama-photopigment. Ezilwaneni ezinomgogodla, i-photopigment eyinhloko, i-rhodopsin, inezingxenye ezimbili eziyinhloko Umfanekiso 27.19: i-opsin, okuyiprotheni ye-membrane (esimweni seqoqo lama-α-helices ahlanganisa i-membrane), kanye ne-retinal—i-molecule emunca ukukhanya. Lapho ukukhanya kushaya i-photoreceptor, kubangela ushintsho lwesimo ku-retinal, kushintsha isakhiwo sayo kusuka esimweni esigobile (cis) se-molecule kuya ku-isomer yayo eqondile (trans). Lokhu kuhlanganiswa kwe-retinal kusebenze i-rhodopsin, kuqala uchungechunge lwezehlakalo oluphela ngokuvalwa kweziteshi ze-Na+ ku-membrane ye-photoreceptor. Ngakho-ke, ngokungafani nezinye izinzwa eziningi (eziba yi-depolarized ngokuvezwa ku-stimulus) ama-visual receptors aba yi-hyperpolarized futhi ngaleyo ndlela aqhutshwe kude nomkhawulo (Umfanekiso 27.20)

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 27. Izinhlelo Zezinzwa | 27.5 Umbono | Ukudluliselwa Kokukhanya | Ukubhala Ikhodi Kwe-Trichromatic
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 27.5 Umbono | Ukuguqulwa Kokukhanya | Ukubhala Amakhodi E-Trichromatic
chapterContent:
Kunezinhlobo ezintathu zama-cone (ane-photopsin ehlukene), futhi ahlukile kubude be-wavelength asabela kakhulu kubo, njengoba kuboniswe ku-Figure 27.21. Amanye ama-cone asabela kakhulu kumaza okukhanya amafushane angu-420 nm, ngakho abizwa ngokuthi ama-S cone (S” okusho ukufingqa”); amanye asabela kakhulu kumaza angu-530 nm (ama-M cone, okusho okuphakathi”); iqembu lesithathu liphendula kakhulu ekukhanyeni kwamaza amade, ku-560 nm (L, noma ama-long” cone). Ngohlobo olulodwa lwe-cone, umbono wombala ngeke ukwazike, futhi uhlelo lwe-two-cone (dichromatic) lunemikhawulo. Ama-Primate asebenzisa uhlelo lwe-three-cone (trichromatic), okuholela ekuboneni kombala ogcwele.

 Umbala esiwubonayo uwumphumela wesilinganiso somsebenzi wezinhlobo zethu ezintathu zama-cone. Imibala ye-spectrum ebonakalayo, eqala ekukhanyeni okude kuya kokufushane, ibomvu (700 nm), i-orenji (600 nm), iphuzi (565 nm), iluhlaza (497 nm), iluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka (470 nm), i-indigo (450 nm), kanye ne-violet (425 nm). Abantu banombono obucayi kakhulu wombala futhi bangahlukanisa amazinga okukhanya angaba ngu-500, imibala ehlukene engu-200, kanye nezinyathelo ezingu-20 zokugcwala, noma cishe imibala ehlukene eyizigidi ezimbili.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 27. Izinhlelo Zezinzwa | 27.5 Umbono | Ukudluliselwa Kokukhanya | Ukucubungula I-Retinal
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 27.5 Umbono | Ukudluliselwa Kokukhanya | Ukucubungula I-Retina
chapterContent:
Izimpawu ezibonakalayo zishiya ama-cone nama-rod, zihambe ziye kuma-bipolar cell, bese ziya kuma-ganglion cell. Izinga elikhulu lokucutshungulwa kolwazi olubonakalayo lwenzeka ku-retina uqobo, ngaphambi kokuba ulwazi olubonakalayo luthunyelwe ebuchosheni.

 Ama-photoreceptors ku-retina aqhubeka nokusebenza kwe-tonic. Okusho ukuthi, ahlala esebenza kancane ngisho noma engashukunyiswa ukukhanya. Kuma-neurons abonisa umsebenzi we-tonic, ukungabikho kwezisusa kugcina izinga lokudubula ekuqaleni; kuyilapho ezinye izisusa zandisa izinga lokudubula kusukela ekuqaleni, kanti ezinye izisusa zehlisa izinga lokudubula. Uma kungekho ukukhanya, ama-bipolar neurons axhumanisa izinduku nama-cone kumaseli e-ganglion avinjelwa njalo futhi ngenkuthalo yizinduku nama-cone. Ukuvezwa kwe-retina ekukhanyeni kwandisa i-rod nama-cone futhi kususe ukuvinjelwa kwawo kwamaseli e-bipolar. Amaseli e-bipolar asebenzayo manje avuselela amaseli e-ganglion, athumela amandla okwenza okuthile kuma-axon awo (ashiya iso njenge-optic nerve). Ngakho-ke, uhlelo lokubona luthembele ekushintsheni komsebenzi we-retina, kunokuba kungabikho noma ukuba khona komsebenzi, ukuze kufakwe izimpawu ezibonakalayo zobuchopho. Ngezinye izikhathi amaseli avundlile athwala izimpawu ezivela endukwini eyodwa noma ekhonini kuya kwamanye ama-photoreceptor kanye namaseli amaningana e-bipolar. Lapho induku noma i-cone ivuselela iseli elivundlile, iseli elivundlile livimbela ama-photoreceptor akude kakhulu namaseli e-bipolar, okudala ukuvimbela okusemaceleni. Lokhu kuvimbela kulola imiphetho futhi kuthuthukise ukungafani ezithombeni ngokwenza izindawo ezithola ukukhanya zibonakale zikhanya futhi indawo ezungezile emnyama ibonakale imnyama. Amaseli e-Amacrine angasabalalisa ulwazi oluvela kuseli elilodwa le-bipolar kuya kumaseli amaningi e-ganglion.

 Ungakubonisa lokhu usebenzisa indlela elula yokukhohlisa "i-retina yakho kanye nobuchopho bakho ngemibala oyibonayo ensimini yakho yokubona. Bheka ngokugxilile ku-Figure 27.22 cishe imizuzwana engama-45. Bese ushintshela amehlo akho ngokushesha ephepheni elimhlophe elingenalutho noma odongeni olumhlophe. Kufanele ubone isithombe esilandelayo sefulegi laseNorway ngemibala yalo efanele. Kuleli qophelo, vala amehlo akho isikhashana, bese uwavula kabusha, ubheke futhi ephepheni elimhlophe noma odongeni; isithombe esilandelayo sefulegi kufanele siqhubeke nokuvela njengobomvu, omhlophe, noluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka. Yini ebangela lokhu? Ngokusho kwencazelo ebizwa ngokuthi i-optiner process theory, njengoba ubheke ngokugxilile ifulegi eliluhlaza, elimnyama, neliphuzi, amangqamuzana akho e-retinal ganglion asabela kahle kokuluhlaza, okumnyama, nokuphuzi andise ukudubula kwawo kakhulu. Lapho ushintshela amehlo akho emhlabathini omhlophe ongathathi hlangothi, lawa maseli e-ganglion anciphisa umsebenzi wawo ngokuzumayo futhi ubuchopho bahumusha lokhu kwehla okungazelelwe njengokungathi amangqamuzana e-ganglion asabela manje emibalani yabaphikisi bawo: obomvu, omhlophe, noluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, ngokulandelana, ensimini yokubona. Uma amangqamuzana e-ganglion ebuyela esimweni sawo somsebenzi oyisisekelo, umbono ongeyiwo wombala uzonyamalala

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 27. Izinhlelo Zezinzwa | 27.5 Umbono | Ukucubungula Okuphezulu (Umbono)
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 27.5 Umbono | Ukucubungula Okuphezulu (Umbono)
chapterContent:
Ama-axon e-myelinated amangqamuzana e-ganglion akha imizwa ye-optic. Ngaphakathi kwemizwa, ama-axon ahlukene aphethe izimfanelo ezahlukene zesignali ebonakalayo. Amanye ama-axon akha indlela ye-magnocellular (iseli elikhulu), ephethe ulwazi mayelana nefomu, ukunyakaza, ukujula, kanye nomehluko ekukhanyeni. Amanye ama-axon akha indlela ye-parvocellular (iseli elincane), ephethe ulwazi ngombala kanye nemininingwane emincane. Olunye ulwazi olubonakalayo lubuyela ngqo ebuchosheni, kanti olunye ulwazi luwela kolunye uhlangothi lobuchopho. Lokhu kuwela kwezindlela zokubona kukhiqiza i-optic chiasma ehlukile (ngesiGreki, okusho ukuwela”) etholakala phansi kobuchopho futhi isenza sikwazi ukuhlanganisa ulwazi oluvela emehlweni womabili.

 Uma selusebuchosheni, ulwazi olubonakalayo luyacutshungulwa ezindaweni eziningana, futhi imizila yalo ibonisa ubunzima nokubaluleka kolwazi olubonakalayo kubantu nakwezinye izilwane. Enye indlela ithatha izimpawu iye ku-thalamus, esebenza njengesiteshi sokuqondisa zonke izinzwa ezingenayo ngaphandle kwephunga. Ku-thalamus, umehluko we-magnocellular kanye ne-parvocellular uhlala unjalo, futhi kunezingqimba ezahlukene ze-thalamus ezinikezelwe kuzo zonke. Lapho izimpawu ezibonwayo ziphuma ku-thalamus, ziyahamba ziye ku-cortex eyinhloko ebonakalayo ngemuva kobuchopho. Ukusuka ku-cortex ebonakalayo, izimpawu ezibonwayo zihamba ngezindlela ezimbili. Umfudlana owodwa ohambela ku-lobe ye-parietal, ohlangothini lobuchopho, uphatha ulwazi lwe-magnocellular (lapho”). Umfudlana wesibili uhambela ku-lobe yesikhashana futhi uphatha ulwazi lwe-magnocellular (lapho”) kanye ne-parvocellular (lapho”).

 Enye indlela ebalulekile yokubona yindlela esuka ku-retina iye ku-colliculus ephakeme ebuchosheni obuphakathi, lapho ukunyakaza kwamehlo kuhlanganiswa khona futhi kuhlanganiswe nolwazi lokuzwa. Okokugcina, kukhona indlela esuka ku-retina iye ku-suprachiasmatic nucleus (SCN) ye-hypothalamus. I-SCN iyiqoqo lamaseli abhekwa njengewashi langaphakathi lomzimba, elilawula umjikelezo wethu we-circadian (usuku lonke). I-SCN ithumela ulwazi ku-pineal gland, ebalulekile emaphethini okulala/ukuvuka kanye nemijikelezo yonyaka.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 27. Izinhlelo Zezinzwa | 27.7 Isifinyezo Sesahluko
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | Isifinyezo Sesahluko 27.7
chapterContent:
27.1 Izinqubo Zezinzwa
Ukusebenza kwezinzwa kwenzeka lapho isikhuthazo somzimba noma samakhemikhali sicutshungulwa sibe isignali yemizwa (ukudluliselwa kwezinzwa) yi-receptor yezinzwa. Ukuqonda kuyindlela yomuntu ngamunye yokuzwa futhi kuwumsebenzi wobuchopho. Abantu banezinzwa ezikhethekile: ukuhogela, ukugwinya, ukulingana, kanye nokuzwa, kanye nezinzwa ezijwayelekile zokuzwa kwemizwa.

 Ama-receptor ezinzwa angamaseli akhethekile ahlotshaniswa nama-neurons ezinzwa noma iziphetho ezikhethekile zama-neurons ezinzwa ayingxenye yesistimu yezinzwa engaphandle, futhi asetshenziselwa ukuthola ulwazi mayelana nendawo (yangaphakathi noma yangaphandle). I-receptor ngayinye yezinzwa iguqulwa ngohlobo lwesikhuthazo esiyitholayo. Isibonelo, ama-receptor okugwinya noma ama-receptor okuzwa awazweli ekukhanyeni. I-receptor ngayinye yezinzwa iyasabela ezishukumisweni ngaphakathi kwesifunda esithile esikhaleni, esaziwa ngokuthi insimu yokwamukela ye-receptor. Umsebenzi oyisisekelo kakhulu wesistimu yezinzwa ukuhunyushwa kwesignali yezinzwa ibe isignali kagesi ohlelweni lwezinzwa.

 Zonke izimpawu zokuzwa, ngaphandle kwalezo ezivela ohlelweni lokunuka, zingena ohlelweni lwezinzwa oluphakathi bese zidluliselwa ku-thalamus. Lapho isignali yokuzwa iphuma ku-thalamus, iqhutshwa endaweni ethile ye-cortex ezinikele ekucubunguleni lowo muzwa othile.

 27.2 Ukuzwa kwe-Somatosensation
Ukuzwa kwe-Somatosensation kufaka phakathi yonke imizwa etholakala esikhumbeni nakuma-mucous membranes, kanye nasemilenzeni nasemalungeni. Ukuzwa kwe-Somatosensation kwenzeka kuyo yonke indawo yangaphandle yomzimba nakwezinye izindawo zangaphakathi, futhi izinhlobo ezahlukene ze-receptor, ezifakwe esikhumbeni nakuma-mucous membranes, zidlala indima.

 Kunezinhlobo eziningana ze-sensor receptors ezikhethekile. Ukushintsha ngokushesha iziphetho ze-nerve zamahhala kuthola i-nociception, ukushisa nokubanda, kanye nokuthinta okulula. Ama-disc kaMerkel avumelana kancane kancane, atholakala ezinzwaneni zeminwe nasezindebeni, futhi asabela ekuthinteni okulula. Ama-corpuscle kaMeissner, atholakala esikhumbeni esicwebezelayo, ayakwazi ukuzivumelanisa ngokushesha, afakwe ama-capsule athola ukuthinta, ukudlidliza okuphansi, kanye nokuphaphazela. Iziphetho ze-Ruffini ziyazivumelanisa kancane, ama-receptor afakwe ama-capsule athola ukwelula kwesikhumba, umsebenzi wamalunga, kanye nokufudumala. Ama-receptor ezinwele ayazivumelanisa ngokushesha iziphetho zemizwa ezizungeze isisekelo sezinwele ezibona ukunyakaza kwezinwele kanye nokuphambuka kwesikhumba. Okokugcina, ama-corpuscle asePacinian afakwe ama-capsule, ashintsha ngokushesha ama-receptor athola ukucindezeleka kwesikhashana kanye nokudlidliza okuphakeme.

 27.3 Ukunambitha Nokunuka
Kunezinhlobo ezinhlanu eziyinhloko kubantu: okumnandi, okumuncu, okubabayo, okunosawoti, kanye ne-umami. Ukunambitha ngakunye kunohlobo lwakho lwe-receptor oluphendula kuphela kulokho kunambitheka. Ama-tastant angena emzimbeni futhi ancibilike ematheni. Amaseli okunambitha atholakala ngaphakathi kwama-taste bud, atholakala ezinhlotsheni ezintathu kwezine ze-papillae emlonyeni.

 Ngokuphathelene nokunuka, kunezinkulungwane eziningi zeziphunga, kodwa abantu bathola cishe ezingu-10,000 kuphela. Njengezithombisi zokunambitha, izithombisi zokunuka zisabela kuphunga elilodwa kuphela. Iziphunga ziyancibilika ekhaleni lamakhala, lapho zivusa khona amaseli azo ezinzwa ezinukayo. Lapho la maseli ethola iphunga, athumela izimpawu zawo kubhamuza oyinhloko wephunga bese eya kwezinye izindawo ebuchosheni, kufaka phakathi i-cortex yephunga.

 27.4 Ukuzwa Nokuzwa Nge-Vestibular
Ukuhlola kubalulekile ekuvikeleni indawo, ekuzingeleni, ekuvikeleni izilwane ezidla ezinye, kanye nokushintshana komphakathi. Uhlelo lwe-vestibular, olungeyona i-auditory, luthola ukusheshisa okuqondile kanye nokusheshisa kwe-angular kanye nokwehla kwejubane. Kokubili uhlelo lokuzwa kanye nohlelo lwe-vestibular zisebenzisa amaseli ezinwele njenge-receptors zazo.

 Izinto ezishukumisayo zokuzwa ngamagagasi omsindo. Amandla wamagagasi omsindo afinyelela endlebeni yangaphandle (i-auricle, i-canal, i-tympanum), kanye nokudlidliza kwe-tympanum kuthumela amandla endlebeni ephakathi. Amathambo endlebe ephakathi ayashintshashintsha kanti ama-stapes adlulisela amandla omshini efasiteleni eliyindilinga le-cochlea yangaphakathi egcwele uketshezi. Uma ese-cochlea, amandla abangela ukuthi i-basilar membrane igobe, ngaleyo ndlela igobe i-stereocilia kumaseli ezinwele ze-receptor. Lokhu kusebenze ama-receptor, athumela izimpawu zawo ze-neural zokuzwa ebuchosheni.

 Uhlelo lwe-vestibular lunezingxenye ezinhlanu ezisebenza ndawonye ukunikeza umuzwa wesiqondiso, ngaleyo ndlela kusiza ukugcina ibhalansi. I-utricle ne-saccule zilinganisa ukuqondiswa kwekhanda: amakristalu azo e-calcium carbonate ayashintsha lapho ikhanda lithambekile, ngaleyo ndlela kusebenze amaseli ezinwele. Imisele ye-semicircular isebenza ngendlela efanayo, kangangokuthi lapho ikhanda liphendulwa, uketshezi olusemiseleni lugoba i-stereocilia kumaseli ezinwele. Amaseli ezinwele ze-vestibular nawo athumela izimpawu ku-thalamus naku-cortex ye-somatosensory, kodwa naku-cerebellum, isakhiwo esingaphezu kwe-brainstem edlala indima enkulu esikhathini nasekuhlanganiseni ukunyakaza.

 27.5 Umbono
Umbono uwukuphela komuzwa ophendulayo esithombeni. Ukukhanya okubonakalayo kuhamba ngamagagasi futhi kuyingxenye encane kakhulu ye-spectrum yemisebe ye-electromagnetic. Amagagasi okukhanya ahluka ngokusekelwe emvamisa yawo (ubude be-wavelength = umbala) kanye nobukhulu (ukuqina = ukukhanya).

 Ku-retina yezilwane ezinomgogodla, kunezinhlobo ezimbili zama-receptor okukhanya (ama-photoreceptor): ama-cone nama-rod. Ama-cone, angumthombo wombono wombala, akhona ngezindlela ezintathu—L, M, kanye no-S—futhi azwela ngokuhlukile kuma-wavelength ahlukene. Ama-cone atholakala ku-retina, kanye nama-receptor a-dim-light, a-achromatic (ama-rod). Ama-cone atholakala ku-fovea, isifunda esiphakathi se-retina, kanti ama-rod atholakala ezindaweni ezingaphandle kwe-retina.

 Izimpawu ezibonakalayo zihamba zisuka esweni zidlula kuma-axon amaseli e-retinal ganglion, akha imizwa ye-optic. Amaseli e-ganglion eza ngezinguqulo eziningana. Amanye ama-axon eseli le-ganglion aphethe ulwazi ngesimo, ukunyakaza, ukujula, nokukhanya, kanti amanye ama-axon aphethe ulwazi ngombala kanye nemininingwane emincane. Ulwazi olubonakalayo luthunyelwa ku-colliculi ephakeme ebuchosheni obuphakathi, lapho ukuhlanganiswa kokunyakaza kwamehlo nokuhlanganiswa kolwazi lokuzwa kwenzeka khona. Ulwazi olubonakalayo luthunyelwa naku-suprachiasmatic nucleus (SCN) ye-hypothalamus, edlala indima emjikelezweni we-circadian.

question31: Kule mibala elandelayo, khomba umbala ohlotshaniswa nobude besikhathi obufushane kakhulu
question32: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okuyiqiniso ngokutholwa kokukhanya?

question33: I-fovea inesibopho se-_______ ngoba inamakhoni amaningi
question34: Bheka uMfanekiso 27.25. Isithombe sibonisa iso elivamile, kanye neso lapho isithombe siwela phambi kwe-retina, okubangela isici sokubona. Sibizwa ngokuthini lesi sici?
question35: Kwenzeka kuphi ukucubungula okuthile okubonakalayo ngaphambi kokuba ulwazi lufinyelele ebuchosheni?
question36: Umuntu obamba ibhola kumele aqondise ikhanda lakhe namehlo akhe. Thola ingxenye yobuchopho esiza ukwenza lokhu
question37: Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza ukuthi lezi zinhlobo ezimbili zokudluliselwa kwezinzwa zihluke kanjani?
answer37: Ama-receptors angamaseli akhethekile athola isikhuthazo esithile, kanti ukuphela kwezinzwa okukhululekile kungasabela ezikhuthazweni eziningi
distractor37a: Ama-receptor angasabela ezintweni eziningi ezishukumisayo, kanti iziphetho zemizwa yamahhala zingamaseli akhethekile athola isikhuthazo esithile
distractor37b: Ama-receptor afana ngezisusa ezahlukene, kanti iziphetho zemizwa yamahhala zihlukile ngezisusa ezahlukene
distractor37c: Ama-receptors angamaseli akhethekile athola isikhuthazo esithile, kanti ukuphela kwezinzwa okukhululekile kungasabela ekucindezelweni
question38: Chaza ukuthi izinyathelo zokuqonda izinzwa zingathinteka kanjani uma umuntu elimele ama-axon aholela kusuka kuma-receptor ezinzwa kuya ohlelweni lwezinzwa oluphakathi.
answer38: Ukwamukelwa kanye nokudluliswa kwesignali ngeke kuthinteke. Kodwa-ke, ukuqonda ngeke kuphelele
distractor38a: Ukwamukelwa ngeke kuthinteke. Kodwa-ke, ukudluliselwa kwesignali kanye nokubona ngeke kuphelele
distractor38b: Ukubona ngeke kuthinteke. Kodwa-ke, ukudluliselwa kwesignali kanye nokwamukelwa kwayo ngeke kuphelele
distractor38c: Ukudluliselwa kwesignali ngeke kuthinteke. Kodwa-ke, ukwamukelwa kanye nokubonwa ngeke kuphelele
question39: Bheka uMfanekiso 27.26. Le grafu ikhombisa umehluko obonakalayo uma kuqhathaniswa nomsindo womsindo. Amanani e-CPS abonisa imvamisa yomsindo. Yisiphi isimangalo esingashiwo ngokusekelwe kule grafu?
answer39: Abantu bezwa umehluko omncane kakhulu emisindweni ephakeme
distractor39a: Abantu abakwazi ukuzwa umehluko omncane kakhulu wemisindo ephezulu
distractor39b: Imvamisa yomsindo ayinawo umthelela ekwehlukeni kwemizuzu yokuzwa
distractor39c: Abantu bangezwa umehluko wemisindo eminingi nge-CPS ephezulu (imvamisa)
question40: Abantu banemizwa ekhethekile kanye nemizwa evamile. Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza lokho okufana ngazo zombili izinhlobo zezinzwa?
answer40: Zonke izinhlobo zezinzwa zidluliselwa ezinzwa ngokuguqula isikhuthazo sibe isignali kagesi ngohlelo lwezinzwa
distractor40a: Zonke izinhlobo zezinzwa zidluliselwa ezinzwa ngokuguqula isikhuthazo sibe isignali yamakhemikhali ngesistimu yezinzwa ephakathi
distractor40b: Zonke izinhlobo zezinzwa zithola ukudluliswa kwezinzwa ngokuguqula isikhuthazo sibe isignali kagesi ngesistimu yezinzwa engaphandle
distractor40c: Zonke izinhlobo zezinzwa zidluliselwa ezinzwa ngokuguqula isikhuthazo sibe isignali yamakhemikhali ngohlelo lwezinzwa
question41: Chaza ukuthi kungani kunezinhlayiya eziningi ze-Merkel kanye ne-Meissner's corpuscles ezandleni zakho kunasezintendeni zezandla zakho
answer41: Lezi zinhlobo ezimbili zama-mechanoreceptors zisetshenziselwa ukuthola imininingwane emincane edingekayo ezindimeni eziningi zeminwe kodwa hhayi izintende njengokuthayipha
distractor41a: Lezi zinhlobo ezimbili zama-thermoreceptors zisetshenziselwa ukuthola ukufudumala nokubanda okudingekayo ukuze kulondolozwe izinga lokushisa lomzimba.
distractor41b: Lezi zinhlobo ezimbili zama-proprioreceptors zisetshenziselwa ukuthola imininingwane emincane edingekayo ezindimeni eziningi zeminwe kodwa hhayi ezintendeni zezandla, njengokuthayipha
distractor41c: Lezi zinhlobo ezimbili zama-mechanoreceptors zisetshenziselwa ukuthola imininingwane emincane, edingekayo emisebenzini eminingi yeminwe kanye nezandla.
question42: Bheka uMfanekiso 27.27. Ithebula libonisa imiphumela yokuhlolwa kokuhlukaniswa kwamaphuzu amabili kwabantu. Ekuhlolweni, amaphuzu amabili abukhali, njengezintambo ezimbili, ahlanganiswa nesikhumba somuntu. Umuntu ubika uma ezwa iphuzu elilodwa noma amabili. Ukuhlolwa kungasetshenziswa ukuthola ubuningi bama-receptor esikhumbeni. Yisiphi isiphetho esingatholakala ngokusekelwe kulolu lwazi?
answer42: Iminwe emide nemincane inezinga eliphezulu kakhulu lama-receptor
distractor42a: Iqoqo eliphezulu kakhulu lama-mechanoreceptors lisengxenyeni engezansi
distractor42b: Ingalo engenhla inobuningi obukhulu bama-receptor kunengalo engezansi
distractor42c: Azikho izitho zokwamukela iminwe ngaphandle kwesithupha, umunwe omude kanye nomunwe omncane.
question43: Chaza ukuthi kungani abanye abantu becabanga ukuthi upelepele uyabuhlungu noma uyashisa, kanti abanye abantu abawutholi upelepele ubuhlungu noma ushisa
answer43: Upelepele uqukethe i-capsaicin, evula imigudu efanayo ye-calcium nama-receptor afudumele. Ukuvuselela ngokweqile kunikeza umbono wobuhlungu. Ngakho-ke abantu abakwazi ukubekezelela ukushisa okukhulu bathola ukuthi upelepele awubuhlungu kakhulu.
distractor43a: Upelepele uqukethe i-capsaicin, evula iziteshi ze-sodium ezifanayo nama-receptor afudumele. Ukukhuthazwa ngokweqile kunikeza umbono wobuhlungu. Ngakho-ke abantu abakwazi ukubekezelela ukushisa okukhulu bathola ukuthi upelepele awubuhlungu kakhulu.
distractor43b: Upelepele uqukethe i-quinine, evula imigudu efanayo ye-calcium nama-receptor afudumele. Ukuvuselela ngokweqile kunikeza umbono wobuhlungu. Ngakho-ke abantu abakwazi ukubekezelela ukushisa okukhulu bathola ukuthi upelepele awubuhlungu kakhulu.
distractor43c: Upelepele uqukethe i-quinine, evula iziteshi ze-sodium ezifanayo nama-receptor afudumele. Ukuvuselela ngokweqile kunikeza umbono wobuhlungu. Ngakho-ke abantu abakwazi ukubekezelela ukushisa okukhulu bathola ukuthi upelepele awubuhlungu kakhulu.
question44: Xoxa ngokuthi indawo yama-mechanoreceptors ithinta kanjani ikhono lawo lokuzwa izinto ezishukumisayo ezahlukene
answer44: Amadiski kaMerkel kanye nama-corpuscle kaMeissner atholakala ezingxenyeni ezingaphezulu zesikhumba futhi athola ukuthinta okuncane. Ama-corpuscle asePacinian kanye neziphetho zikaRuffini ziyakwazi ukuzwa ukuthinta okujulile, njengokucindezela okujulile.
distractor44a: Amadiski kaMerkel kanye nama-corpuscle kaMeissner atholakala ezindaweni ezikhethekile futhi athola inani lokwelula. Ama-corpuscle asePacinian kanye neziphetho zikaRuffini ziyakwazi ukuzwa ukuthinta okujulile, njengokucindezela okujulile.
distractor44b: Amadiski kaMerkel kanye nama-corpuscle kaMeissner atholakala ejulile esikhumbeni futhi ayakwazi ukuzwa ukuthinta okujulile, njengokucindezela okujulile. Ama-corpuscle asePacinian kanye neziphetho zikaRuffini ziyakwazi ukubona kangcono ukuthinta okuncane.
distractor44c: Amadiski kaMerkel kanye nama-corpuscle kaMeissner atholakala ejulile esikhumbeni futhi athola ukuthinta okuncane. Ama-corpuscle asePacinian kanye neziphetho zikaRuffini ziyakwazi ukuzwa ukuthinta okujulile, njengokucindezela okujulile.
question45: Bheka uMfanekiso 27.28. Le grafu ikhombisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwe-body-mass index (BMI) kanye nokuzwela ukunambitheka. Yisiphi inketho esiyisiphetho ongasithola kule grafu?
answer45: Abantu abane-BMI ephezulu bavame ukuba nomuzwa obuthakathaka wokunambitha ngokwesilinganiso
distractor45b: Abantu abane-BMI ephezulu bavame ukuba nomuzwa onamandla wokunambitha ngokwesilinganiso
distractor45c: Abantu abane-BMI ephansi bavame ukuba nomuzwa obuthakathaka kakhulu wokunambitha
question46: Bika umphumela ongaba khona esilwaneni ngenxa yokungakwazi ukubona ukunambitheka
answer46: Isilwane singase singakwazi ukuhlukanisa ukudla okuyingozi, okubabayo, okonakele, okumuncu noma okumnandi
distractor46b: Isilwane singase singakwazi ukudla ukudla okumnandi nokungonakali
distractor46c: Isilwane singase singakwazi ukuhlukanisa ukudla okubabayo nokumuncu
question47: Uma ingane encane ilahleka, bikezela ukuthi kungani kuzosetshenziswa inja yegazi hhayi inja encane ukuthola ingane.
answer47: Ama-bloodhound akhuliswa ukuze abe nomuzwa ongcono wokuhogela, ngaleyo ndlela abe nama-receptor amaningi okuhogela kanye ne-epithelia enkulu yokuhogela.
distractor47a: Ama-bloodhound akhuliswa ukuze abe nomuzwa ongcono wokuhogela, futhi ngaleyo ndlela abe nama-receptor ambalwa okuhogela kanye ne-epithelia enkulu yokuhogela.
distractor47b: Ama-bloodhound akhuliswa ukuze abe nomuzwa ongcono wokuhogela, ngaleyo ndlela abe nama-receptor amaningi okuhogela kanye ne-epithelia encane yokuhogela.
distractor47c: Ama-bloodhound akhuliswa ukuze abe nomuzwa ongcono wokuhogela, ngaleyo ndlela abe nama-bulb amaningi okuhogela kanye nama-receptor amakhulu okuhogela.
question48: Chaza ukuthi ama-pheromone ahluke kanjani kwamanye amaphunga, ngokombono womamukeli wesignali
answer48: Ama-pheromone athunyelwa ku-amygdala esikhundleni se-bulb eyinhloko yokuhogela futhi awabonwa ngamabomu.
distractor48a: Ama-pheromone athunyelwa ku-bulb eyinhloko yokuhogela esikhundleni se-amygdala futhi awabonwa ngamabomu.
distractor48b: Ama-pheromone athunyelwa ku-amygdala esikhundleni se-bulb eyinhloko yokuhogela futhi aqondwa ngamabomu.
distractor48c: Ama-pheromone athunyelwa ku-bulb eyinhloko yokuhogela esikhundleni se-amygdala futhi aqondwa ngamabomu
question49: Bheka uMfanekiso 27.29. Ithebula libonisa ububanzi bokuzwa kwezinye izilwane. Yisiphi isiphetho esingasithola kulolu lwazi?
answer49: Amahlengethwa nemikhomo ingezwa imisindo ephezulu kakhulu uma iqhathaniswa nabantu
distractor49a: Izindlovu zizwa imisindo ephakeme kakhulu kunabantu
distractor49b: I-gerbil ngeke ikwazi ukuzwa umsindo ku-40 kHz
distractor49c: Imvu ayikwazi ukuzwa umsindo ongaphezu kwe-1 kHz
question50: Unempikiswano nothile emtatsheni wezincwadi. Umgcini wezincwadi ukucela ukuthi ukhulume kamnandi.” Yisiphi isici somsindo umgcini wezincwadi afuna usishintshe futhi ungasishintsha kanjani?
distractor50a: Ubude be-wavelength, ngokunciphisa ubukhulu be-amplitude okhuluma ngayo
question51: Bheka uMfanekiso 27.13. Isithombe sibonisa isakhiwo sendlebe enempilo. Uma umuntu wazalwa engenalo i-malleus kuzo zombili izindlebe, chaza ukuthi kungani engase abe nezinkinga zokuzwa.
answer51: Ngaphandle kwe-malleus ne-incus, ukudlidliza kwe-tympanum bekungeke kukwazi ukufinyelela kuma-stapes bese kuthunyelwa ku-cochlea.
distractor51a: Ngaphandle kwe-malleus ne-incus, ukudlidliza kwe-pinna bekungeke kukwazi ukufinyelela kuma-stapes bese kuthunyelwa ku-cochlea.
distractor51b: Ngaphandle kwe-malleus ne-incus, amaza omsindo abengeke aqoqwe yi-tympanum
distractor51c: Ngaphandle kwe-malleus ne-incus, amaza omsindo abengeke aqoqwe yi-pinna
question52: Inyanga inamandla adonsela phansi amancane kunoMhlaba. Lokhu kungawuthinta kanjani umuzwa we-vestibular womkhathi eNyangeni?
answer52: Ukuzwa kwe-Vestibular kuncike emiphumeleni yamandla adonsela phansi ukuze kusebenze kahle. Kumandla adonsela phansi ahlukile, ukuqonda ukunyakaza kuzohluka
distractor52a: Umuzwa we-Vestibular awuncikile emiphumeleni yamandla adonsela phansi, kodwa udinga ingcindezi. Ngaphakathi kwesudi ecindezelwe, umgibeli wezindiza ngeke azizwe ehlukile.
distractor52b: Imizwa ye-Vestibular ayikwazi ukusebenza ngaphandle kwamandla adonsela phansi oMhlaba. ENyangeni, osomkhathi kuzodingeka basebenze ngokuphelele ngaphandle kwayo
distractor52c: Umsebenzi wemizwa ye-Vestibular kanye nokusebenza kahle kangcono ekudonseleni phansi kwamandla adonsela phansi. Enyangeni, imizwa yezinkanyezi izothuthukiswa
question53: Bheka uMfanekiso 27.30. Isithombe sithathwe yikhamera ekhethekile ekwazi ukubona amalulwane ngobusuku obumnyama. Kungani amehlo abantu engakwazi ukubona amalulwane kanje?
answer53: Izinto ezifudumele zikhipha imisebe ye-infrared. Imvamisa yemisebe ye-infrared iphansi kakhulu ukuba amehlo ethu angayiboni
distractor53a: Izinto ezifudumele zikhipha imisebe ye-ultraviolet. Imvamisa yemisebe ye-infrared iphansi kakhulu ukuba amehlo ethu angayiboni
distractor53b: Ikhamera ikhipha ukukhanya kwe-infrared kumalulwane, bese iyakubona. Amehlo ethu awakwazi ukukhipha ukukhanya njengoba kwenza ikhamera
distractor53c: Ikhamera ikhipha ukukhanya kwe-ultraviolet kumalulwane, bese iyakubona. Amehlo ethu awakwazi ukukhipha ukukhanya njengoba kwenza ikhamera
question54: Bheka uMfanekiso 27.21. Le grafu ikhombisa ubude bamaza okukhanya okungabonwa yizinduku nama-cone eliso. Yimaphi ama-receptor asebenzayo uma ubona isakhiwo esimhlophe ngosuku olukhanyayo?
answer54: Zonke izikhonkwane ezintathu emehlweni akho ziyashukunyiswa uma ubona umbala omhlophe. Izinduku azidlali indima ekuboneni umbala
distractor54a: Ama-L kanye nama-M cones ayavuselelwa emehlweni akho uma ubona umbala omhlophe. Ama-rod awadlali indima ekuboneni umbala
distractor54b: Ama-S cone kanye nezinduku kuyavuselelwa emehlweni akho uma ubona umbala omhlophe
distractor54c: Ama-L cone kanye nezinduku kuyavuselelwa emehlweni akho uma ubona umbala omhlophe
question55: Xoxani ngokuthi ubudlelwano phakathi kwama-photoreceptors namaseli e-bipolar buhluke kanjani kwamanye ama-sensor receptors namaseli aseduze.
answer55: Ama-photoreceptors namaseli e-bipolar agcwele i-hyperpolarized, kanti amanye ama-sensor receptors avame ukuba yi-depolarized
distractor55a: Ama-photoreceptors namaseli e-bipolar aphelelwe amandla, kanti amanye ama-sensor receptors avame ukuhlala ephazamisekile.
distractor55b: Ama-photoreceptors namaseli e-bipolar agcwele i-hyperpolarized, kanti amanye ama-sensor receptors avame ukuhlala evulekile
distractor55c: Ama-photoreceptors namaseli e-bipolar aphelelwa amandla, kanti amanye ama-sensor receptors avame ukuba yi-hyperpolarized
question56: Chaza ukuthi kwenzekani uma izimpawu ezibonakalayo zifika ku-cortex ebonakalayo
answer56: Ezinye izimpawu ziya ku-lobe ye-parietal, ethola ulwazi lokuthi "kuphi", kanti ezinye izimpawu ziya ku-lobe yesikhashana, ethola izimpawu zokuthi "kuphi"nokuthi "yini".
distractor56a: Ezinye izimpawu ziya ku-lobe yesikhashana, ethola ulwazi lokuthi "kuphi", kanti ezinye izimpawu ziya ku-lobe ye-parietal, ethola izimpawu zokuthi "kuphi"nokuthi "yini".
distractor56b: Ezinye izimpawu ziya ku-lobe ye-parietal, ethola ulwazi lapho "lukhona", kanti ezinye izimpawu ziya ku-lobe yesikhashana, ethola ukuthi "yini"izimpawu
distractor56c: Ezinye izimpawu ziya ku-lobe ye-parietal, ethola ulwazi lokuthi "kuphi nokuthi"kuphi kanti ezinye izimpawu ziya ku-lobe yesikhashana, ethola futhi izimpawu zokuthi "kuphi nokuthi"kuphi.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 28. Uhlelo Lwe-Endocrine | 28.0 Isingeniso
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 28. Uhlelo Lwe-Endocrine | 28.0 Isingeniso
chapterContent:
Uhlelo lwe-endocrine lwesilwane lulawula izinqubo zomzimba ngokukhiqizwa, ukukhishwa, kanye nokulawulwa kwama-hormone, asebenza njengezithunywa zamakhemikhali"ezisebenza emisebenzini yamaseli nezitho zomzimba, futhi ekugcineni, alondoloze i-homeostasis yomzimba. Uhlelo lwe-endocrine ludlala indima ekukhuleni, ekusetshenzisweni kwe-metabolism, kanye nasekuthuthukisweni kocansi. Kubantu, izifo ezivamile zesistimu ye-endocrine zifaka phakathi isifo se-thyroid nesifo sikashukela. Ezintweni eziphilayo ezidlula ekuguqukeni kwesimo, inqubo ilawulwa uhlelo lwe-endocrine. Ukuguqulwa kusuka ku-tadpole kuya ku-frog, isibonelo, kuyinkimbinkimbi futhi kunezici ukuze kuvumelane nezimo ezithile kanye nezimo zemvelo.

 Ucwaningo lwesistimu ye-endocrine luholele ekuthuthukisweni okuningi kwezokwelapha. Manje ososayensi bathole i-hormone elingisa imiphumela yokuzivocavoca ngokulawula ukusetshenziswa kwe-metabolism kanye nokulwa nokumelana ne-insulin. Bheka Umfanekiso 28.1

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 28. Uhlelo Lwe-Endocrine | 28.1 Izinhlobo Zama-Hormones | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 28. Uhlelo Lwe-Endocrine | 28.1 Izinhlobo Zama-Hormones | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent:
Ulwazi oluningi mayelana nezinhlelo ezahlukene zezitho zezilwane alukho ngaphakathi kwe-AP®. Nokho, uhlelo lwe-endocrine lukhethelwe ucwaningo olujulile ngoba ikhono lesilwane lokubona, ukudlulisa nokuphendula ulwazi libalulekile ekusindeni. Izinhlelo ze-endocrine kanye nezinzwa zisebenza ndawonye ukugcina i-homeostasis nokulungisa umsebenzi womzimba lapho izimo zemvelo zangaphandle noma zangaphakathi zishintsha. Uhlelo lwezinzwa lusebenza ngokukhiqiza amandla esenzo kuma-neurons; uhlelo lwe-endocrine lusebenzisa izithunywa zamakhemikhali ezibizwa ngokuthi ama-hormone akhishwa kuma-gland, ahambela kumaseli aqondiwe, futhi akhiphe impendulo yiseli eliqondiwe. Ku-AP® akulindelekile ukuthi ubambe ngekhanda uhlu lwezindlala ezahlukene ze-endocrine, ama-hormone azo, kanye nemiphumela ye-hormone ngayinye. Nokho, kufanele ukwazi ukuhumusha umdwebo okhombisa umsebenzi wesignali yama-hormone. Sizochaza kafushane ezimbalwa zalezi zibonelo ku-How Hormone Work.

 Kunezinhlobo ezintathu zama-hormone ezihlukaniswe ngokusekelwe esakhiweni sama-molecule kanye nezakhiwo zawo. (Sihlole ubudlelwano besakhiwo/umsebenzi ezingeni lama-molecule esahlukweni sama-Biological Macromolecules.) Ama-hormone atholakala kuma-lipid ancibilika kuma-lipid futhi angasabalala kuwo wonke ama-membrane eseli ngoba awawona ama-polar. Ama-hormone amaningi e-lipid atholakala ku-cholesterol; izibonelo zifaka phakathi ama-steroids njenge-estrogen ne-testosterone. Ngenxa yokuthi ama-hormone e-lipid angasabalala kuwo wonke ama-membrane eseli, ama-receptor awo atholakala ku-cytoplasm yamaseli aqondiwe. Ama-hormone atholakala kuma-amino acid angama-molecule amancane atholakala kuma-amino acid i-tyrosine ne-tryptophan; izibonelo zifaka phakathi i-epinephrine, i-norepinephrine, i-thyroxin, ne-melatonin. Ama-hormone e-peptide afana ne-oxytocin kanye ne-growth hormone aqukethe amaketanga e-polypeptide ama-amino acid. Ngenxa yokuthi la ma-hormone ayancibilika emanzini futhi awancibiliki kuma-lipid, awakwazi ukudlula ku-plasma membrane yamaseli; ama-receptor awo atholakala ebusweni bamaseli aqondiwe.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo ezigqanyisiwe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo echazwe ku-Big Idea 3 kanye ne-Big Idea 4 yohlaka lwe-AP® Biology Curriculum. Izinhloso Zokufunda ze-AP® ezibalwe kuhlaka lwe-Curriculum zinikeza isisekelo esicacile senkambo ye-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekuphenyweni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo neyodwa noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa.

 Umqondo Omkhulu 3
Izinhlelo eziphilayo zigcina, zibuyise, zidlulise futhi ziphendule ulwazi olubalulekile ezinqubweni zokuphila.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 3.D
Amaseli ayaxhumana ngokukhiqiza, ukudlulisa nokwamukela izimpawu zamakhemikhali.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
3.D.1 Izinqubo zokuxhumana kwamaseli zabelana ngezici ezifanayo ezibonisa umlando wokuziphendukela kwemvelo okwabiwe.

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
6.2 Umfundi angakha izincazelo zezehlakalo ngokusekelwe ebufakazini obuvezwa ngemikhuba yesayensi.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
3.33 Umfundi uyakwazi ukusebenzisa izethulo namamodeli ukuchaza izici zendlela yokubonisana kwamaseli.

 Umqondo Omkhulu 4
Izinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo ziyasebenzisana, futhi lezi zinhlelo kanye nokusebenzisana kwazo zinezakhiwo eziyinkimbinkimbi.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 4.A
Ukusebenzisana ngaphakathi kwezinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo kuholela ezimpahleni eziyinkimbinkimbi.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
4.A.1 Izingxenye ezincane zama-molecule ezinto eziphilayo kanye nokulandelana kwazo kunquma izakhiwo zaleyo molecule.

 Ukuzijwayeza Kwesayensi
7.1 Umfundi angaxhumanisa izimo namamodeli kuzo zonke izikali zendawo nezesikhathi.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
4.1 Umfundi uyakwazi ukuchaza ukuxhumana phakathi kokulandelana kanye nezingxenye ezincane ze-polymer yezinto eziphilayo kanye nezakhiwo zayo.

 Ukugcina i-homeostasis emzimbeni kudinga ukuhlanganiswa kwezinhlelo eziningi ezahlukene kanye nezitho zomzimba. Ukuxhumana phakathi kwamaseli angomakhelwane, kanye naphakathi kwamaseli nezicubu ezingxenyeni ezikude zomzimba, kwenzeka ngokukhululwa kwamakhemikhali abizwa ngokuthi ama-hormone. Ama-hormone akhishwa oketshezini lomzimba (ngokuvamile egazini) oluthwala la makhemikhali luye kumaseli awo aqondiwe. Kumaseli aqondiwe, angamaseli ane-receptor yesignali noma i-ligand evela kuseli yesignali, ama-hormone akhipha impendulo. Amaseli, izicubu, kanye nezitho ezikhipha ama-hormone zakha uhlelo lwe-endocrine. Izibonelo zezindlala zesistimu ye-endocrine zifaka phakathi izindlala ze-adrenal, ezikhiqiza ama-hormone afana ne-epinephrine ne-norepinephrine alawula izimpendulo zokucindezeleka, kanye nendlala ye-thyroid, ekhiqiza ama-hormone e-thyroid alawula amazinga okusebenza komzimba.

 Nakuba kunezinhlobo eziningi zama-hormone emzimbeni womuntu, angahlukaniswa ngezigaba ezintathu ngokusekelwe esakhiweni sawo samakhemikhali: ama-hormone atholakala ku-lipid, atholakala ku-amino acid, kanye nama-hormone e-peptide (i-peptide namaprotheni). Esinye sezici ezibalulekile ezihlukanisa ama-hormone atholakala ku-lipid ukuthi angasabalala kuwo wonke ama-membrane e-plasma kanti ama-hormone atholakala ku-amino acid kanye nama-peptide awakwazi.

answer6: Ngoba ama-hormone e-peptide ayancibilika emanzini futhi awakwazi ukuwela ulwelwesi lwe-plasma

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 28. Uhlelo Lwe-Endocrine | 28.1 Izinhlobo Zama-Hormone | Ama-Hormone Avela Ku-Lipid (noma Ama-Hormone Ancibilikayo Ku-Lipid)
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 28. Uhlelo Lwe-Endocrine | 28.1 Izinhlobo Zama-Hormone | Ama-Hormone Avela Ku-Lipid (noma Ama-Hormone Ancibilikayo Ku-Lipid)
chapterContent: Ama-hormone amaningi e-lipid atholakala ku-cholesterol futhi ngaleyo ndlela afana nayo ngokwesakhiwo, njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 28.2. Isigaba esiyinhloko sama-hormone e-lipid kubantu ama-hormone e-steroid. Ngokwekhemikhali, la ma-hormone ngokuvamile ama-ketone noma ama-alcohols; amagama awo amakhemikhali azophela ngo--ol” kuma-alcohols noma--one” kuma-ketone. Izibonelo zama-hormone e-steroid zifaka i-estradiol, okuyi-estrogen, noma i-hormone yocansi yabesifazane, kanye ne-testosterone, eyi-androgen, noma i-hormone yocansi yabesilisa. Lawa ma-hormone amabili akhishwa yizitho zokuzala zabesifazane nabesilisa, ngokulandelana. Amanye ama-hormone e-steroid afaka i-aldosterone ne-cortisol, ekhishwa yizindlala ze-adrenal kanye nezinye izinhlobo zama-androgens. Ama-hormone e-steroid awancibiliki emanzini, futhi athuthwa ngamaprotheni okuthutha egazini. Ngenxa yalokho, ahlala isikhathi eside ekujikelezeni kwegazi kunama-hormone e-peptide. Isibonelo, i-cortisol inokuphila kwesigamu semizuzu engama-60 kuya kwengama-90, kuyilapho i-epinephrine, i-hormone etholakala ku-amino acid, inokuphila kwesigamu cishe komzuzu owodwa.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 28. Uhlelo Lwe-Endocrine | 28.1 Izinhlobo Zama-Hormone | Ama-Hormone e-Peptide
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 28. Uhlelo Lwe-Endocrine | 28.1 Izinhlobo Zama-Hormone | Ama-Hormone e-Peptide
chapterContent:
Isakhiwo sama-hormone e-peptide singesochungechunge lwe-polypeptide (uchungechunge lwama-amino acid). Ama-hormone e-peptide afaka ama-molecule angamaketanga amafushane e-polypeptide, njenge-hormone ye-antidiuretic kanye ne-oxytocin ekhiqizwa ebuchosheni bese ikhishwa egazini endlaleni ye-posterior pituitary. Leli klasi lifaka namaprotheni amancane, njengama-hormone okukhula akhiqizwa yi-pituitary, kanye nama-glycoprotein amakhulu njenge-follicle-stimulating hormone ekhiqizwa yi-pituitary. Isithombe 28.4 sibonisa la ma-hormone e-peptide.

 Ama-peptide akhishwe njenge-insulin agcinwa ngaphakathi kwama-vesicles emaseli awahlanganisayo. Bese ekhishwa ngenxa yezizathu ezifana namazinga aphezulu kashukela egazini uma kwenzeka i-insulin. Ama-hormone atholakala ku-amino acid kanye ne-polypeptide ancibilika emanzini futhi awancibiliki kuma-lipid. Lawa ma-hormone awakwazi ukudlula kuma-membrane e-plasma amaseli; ngakho-ke, ama-receptor awo atholakala ebusweni bamaseli aqondiwe

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 28. Uhlelo Lwe-Endocrine | 28.1 Izinhlobo Zama-Hormones | Ukuxhumana Komsebenzi | Isazi Se-Endocrinologist
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 28. Uhlelo Lwe-Endocrine | 28.1 Izinhlobo Zama-Hormones | Ukuxhumana Komsebenzi | Isazi Se-Endocrinologist
chapterContent:
I-endocrinologist ingudokotela wezokwelapha ogxile ekwelapheni izifo ze-endocrine, izinhlelo zama-hormone, kanye nezindlela ze-glucose kanye ne-lipid metabolism. Udokotela ohlinzayo we-endocrine ugxile ekwelapheni izifo ze-endocrine kanye nezindlala ngokuhlinzwa. Ezinye zezifo ezilawulwa odokotela be-endocrinologist: izifo ze-pancreas (isifo sikashukela), izifo ze-pituitary (i-gigantism, i-acromegaly, kanye ne-pituitary dwarfism), izifo ze-thyroid gland (i-goiter nesifo se-Graves), kanye nezinkinga ze-adrenal glands (isifo sikaCushing nesifo sika-Addison).

 Odokotela be-endocrinologist bayadingeka ukuthi bahlole iziguli futhi baxilonge izifo ze-endocrine ngokusebenzisa kakhulu izivivinyo zelebhu. Izifo eziningi ze-endocrine zixilongwa kusetshenziswa izivivinyo ezivuselela noma ezicindezela ukusebenza kwezitho ze-endocrine. Amasampula egazi abe esedonswa ukuze kutholakale umphumela wokuvuselela noma ukucindezela isitho se-endocrine ekukhiqizweni kwama-hormone. Isibonelo, ukuze kuxilongwe isifo sikashukela, iziguli kudingeka zizile ukudla amahora ayi-12 kuya kwangu-24. Bese zinikezwa isiphuzo esinoshukela, esivuselela i-pancreas ukuthi ikhiqize i-insulin ukuze yehlise amazinga e-glucose egazini. Isampula yegazi ithathwa ihora elilodwa kuya kwamabili ngemva kokuphuza isiphuzo sikashukela. Uma i-pancreas isebenza kahle, izinga likashukela egazini lizoba ngaphakathi kwebanga elijwayelekile. Esinye isibonelo ukuhlolwa kwe-A1C, okungenziwa ngesikhathi sokuhlolwa kwegazi. Ukuhlolwa kwe-A1C kulinganisa amazinga ajwayelekile kashukela egazini ezinyangeni ezimbili kuya kwezintathu ezedlule ngokuhlola ukuthi ushukela wegazi uphathwa kahle kangakanani isikhathi eside.

 Uma isifo sesitholakele, odokotela be-endocrinologists bangakunikeza izinguquko zendlela yokuphila kanye/noma imithi yokwelapha lesi sifo. Amanye amacala esifo sikashukela angaphathwa ngokuzivocavoca umzimba, ukwehlisa isisindo, kanye nokudla okunempilo; kwezinye izimo, kungadingeka imithi yokuthuthukisa ukukhishwa kwe-insulin. Uma lesi sifo singenakulawulwa ngalezi zindlela, udokotela we-endocrinologist angakunikeza imijovo ye-insulin.

 Ngaphezu komkhuba wezokwelapha, odokotela be-endocrinologists bangase bahileleke emisebenzini yocwaningo oluyisisekelo kanye nentuthuko. Isibonelo, ucwaningo oluqhubekayo lokufakelwa kwe-islet luphenya ukuthi amaseli e-islet e-pancreas anempilo angafakwa kanjani ezigulini ezinesifo sikashukela. Ukufakelwa kwe-islet okuphumelelayo kungavumela iziguli ukuthi ziyeke ukuthatha imijovo ye-insulin

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 28. Uhlelo Lwe-Endocrine | 28.2 Indlela Ama-hormone Asebenza Ngayo | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 28. Uhlelo Lwe-Endocrine | 28.2 Indlela Ama-hormone Asebenza Ngayo | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent:
Ulwazi oluningi kulesi sigaba luwukusetshenziswa kwezinto esizihlolile esahlukweni Sokuxhumana Kwamaseli mayelana nokuxhumana kwamaseli kanye nezindlela zokubonisa izimpawu. Ama-hormone ayizimpawu zamakhemikhali (ama-ligand) ezilawula izinguquko kumaseli aqondiwe ngokubopha kuma-receptor athile. Ngisho noma ama-hormone akhishwa yizindlala ze-endocrine engahamba amabanga amade egazini futhi ahlangane nezinhlobo eziningi zamaseli ezahlukene, athinta kuphela amaseli anama-receptor adingekayo. Kuye ngokuthi i-receptor ikuphi kuseli eliqondiwe kanye nesakhiwo samakhemikhali se-hormone, isibonelo, ukuthi incibilika kuma-lipid noma cha, ama-hormone angakwazi ukulawula izinguquko ngqo ngokubopha kuma-receptor ama-hormone angaphakathi kweseli kanye nokuguqula ukubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo (ukubhalwa nokuhumusha), noma ngokungaqondile ngokubopha kuma-receptor angaphezulu kweseli kanye nokulingisa izindlela zokubonisa izimpawu.

 I-hormone ibopha ku-receptor yayo njengesihluthulelo esifanelana nokukhiya. Ngenxa yokuthi i-hormone etholakala kuma-lipid njenge-hormone ye-steroid ingasabalala kulo lonke ulwelwesi lweseli eliqondiwe, ibopha kuma-receptor angaphakathi kweseli ahlala ku-cytoplasm noma ku-nucleus. Izindlela zokubonisa izimpawu zamaseli ezibangelwa ama-hormone e-steroid zilawula izakhi zofuzo ezithile ngokusebenza njengabaqondisi bokubhala. Lokhu kuthinta inani lamaprotheni akhiqizwayo. Ama-hormone atholakala ku-lipid angewona ama-steroid, isibonelo, i-vitamin D kanye ne-thyroxin, abopha kuma-receptor atholakala ku-nucleus yeseli eliqondiwe.

 Ngenxa yokuthi ama-hormone atholakala ku-amino acid (ngaphandle kwe-thyroxine) kanye nama-hormone e-polypeptide awancibiliki ku-lipid, abopha kuma-hormone receptors e-plasma membrane atholakala ebusweni bangaphandle be-membrane. Ngokungafani nama-hormone e-steroid, awakwazi ukusebenza ngqo ku-DNA kodwa asebenze ngendlela yokubonisa; lokhu kubangela umsebenzi wangaphakathi kweseli futhi kwenza imiphumela ethile ehlobene ne-hormone. I-hormone eyaqala indlela yokubonisa ibizwa ngokuthi isithunywa sokuqala. Endabeni yendlela yokubonisa i-epinephrine, ukubopha i-hormone etholakala ku-amino acid i-epinephrine ku-receptor yayo kusebenzisa i-G-protein, yona evuselela i-cAMP, isithunywa sesibili, ekugcineni okuholela empendulweni yeselula njengokuguqulwa kwe-glycogen ibe yi-glucose.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyiswe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo echazwe ku-Big Idea 3 ye-AP® Biology Curriculum Framework. Izinhloso Zokufunda ze-AP® ezibalwe kuHlelo Lwezifundo zinikeza isisekelo esicacile sesifundo se-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekubuzeni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo nomunye noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa.

 Umqondo Omkhulu 3
Izinhlelo zokuphila zigcina, zibuyise, zidlulise futhi ziphendule ulwazi olubalulekile ezinqubweni zokuphila.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 3.D
Amaseli ayaxhumana ngokukhiqiza, ukudlulisa nokwamukela izimpawu zamakhemikhali.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
3.D.3 Izindlela zokudlulisela izimpawu zixhumanisa ukwamukelwa kwezimpawu nempendulo yeselula.

 Ukuzijwayeza Kwesayensi
1.5 Umfundi angaphinda aveze izakhi ezibalulekile zezehlakalo zemvelo kuzo zonke izethulo eziningi kulesi sizinda.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
3.36 Umfundi uyakwazi ukuchaza imodeli eveza izakhi ezibalulekile zezindlela zokudlulisa isignali lapho isignali iguqulwa khona ibe yimpendulo yeselula.

 Ama-hormone alawula izinguquko kumaseli aqondiwe ngokubopha kuma-receptor athile ama-hormone. Ngale ndlela, noma ama-hormone ejikeleza kuwo wonke umzimba futhi ahlangana nezinhlobo eziningi zamaseli ezahlukene, athinta kuphela amaseli anama-receptor adingekayo. Ama-receptor e-hormone ethile angatholakala kumaseli amaningi ahlukene noma angakhawulelwa enanini elincane lamaseli akhethekile. Isibonelo, ama-hormone e-thyroid asebenza ezinhlotsheni eziningi ezahlukene zezicubu, evuselela umsebenzi we-metabolic kuwo wonke umzimba. Amaseli angaba nama-receptor amaningi e-hormone efanayo kodwa avame ukuba nama-receptor ezinhlobo ezahlukene zama-hormone. Inani lama-receptor aphendula ku-hormone linquma ukuzwela kweseli kuleyo hormone, kanye nempendulo yeselula ephumelayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, inani lama-receptor aphendula ku-hormone lingashintsha ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, okuholela ekuzweleni kweseli okwandisiwe noma okunciphile. Ekukhuleni komthetho, inani lama-receptor liyakhula ngokuphendula amazinga ama-hormone aphansi isikhathi eside, okwenza iseli lizwele kakhulu ku-hormone futhi livumele umsebenzi weselula owengeziwe. Uma inani lama-receptor lehla ngenxa yokwenyuka kwamazinga ama-hormone, okubizwa ngokuthi ukwehla komthetho, umsebenzi wamaseli uyancishiswa.

 Ukubopha kwama-receptor kushintsha umsebenzi wamaseli futhi kuholele ekwandeni noma ekwehleni kwezinqubo ezijwayelekile zomzimba. Kuye ngokuthi i-protein receptor ikuphi kuseli eliqondiwe kanye nesakhiwo samakhemikhali se-hormone, ama-hormone angakwazi ukuxazulula izinguquko ngqo ngokubopha kuma-receptor ama-hormone angaphakathi kweseli kanye nokuguqula ukubhalwa kwezakhi zofuzo, noma ngokungaqondile ngokubopha kuma-receptor angaphezulu kweseli kanye nokuvuselela izindlela zokubonisa izimpawu.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 28. Uhlelo Lwe-Endocrine | 28.2 Indlela Ama-Hormone Asebenza Ngayo | Ama-Hormone Angaphakathi Kweseli
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 28. Uhlelo Lwe-Endocrine | 28.2 Indlela Ama-Hormone Asebenza Ngayo | Ama-Hormone Angaphakathi Kweseli
chapterContent:
Ama-hormone asuselwa ku-lipid (ancibilikayo) afana nama-hormone e-steroid asakazeka kuwo wonke ama-membrane eseli le-endocrine. Uma esengaphandle kweseli, abopha ukuze ahambise amaprotheni awagcina encibilika egazini. Eselini eliqondiwe, ama-hormone akhishwa ku-carrier protein bese esakazeka kuwo wonke ungqimba lwe-lipid lwe-plasma membrane yamaseli. Ama-hormone e-steroid adlula ku-plasma membrane yeseli eliqondiwe futhi anamathele kuma-receptor angaphakathi kweseli ahlala ku-cytoplasm noma ku-nucleus. Izindlela zokubonisana kwamaseli ezibangelwa ama-hormone e-steroid zilawula izakhi zofuzo ezithile kumaseli e-DNA. Ama-hormone kanye ne-receptor complex asebenza njengabalawuli bokuqopha ngokwandisa noma ukunciphisa ukwakheka kwama-molecule e-mRNA ezakhi zofuzo ezithile. Lokhu, nakho, kunquma inani leprotheyini ehambisanayo ekhiqizwa ngokushintsha ukubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo. Le phrotheyini ingasetshenziswa ukushintsha isakhiwo seseli noma ukukhiqiza ama-enzyme avuselela ukusabela kwamakhemikhali. Ngale ndlela, i-hormone ye-steroid ilawula izinqubo ezithile zamaseli njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 28.5.

 Amanye ama-hormone ancibilikayo ku-lipid angewona ama-hormone e-steroid, njenge-vitamin D kanye ne-thyroxine, anama-receptor atholakala ku-nucleus. Nakuba i-thyroxine ivame ukungangenisi amanzi, ukudlula kwayo olwelwesini kuncike kuphrotheni yokuthutha. I-Vitamin D iyasabalala olwelwesini lwe-plasma kanye ne-nuclear envelope. Uma isisesiseleni, womabili ama-hormone abopha kuma-receptors ku-nucleus. I-hormone-receptor complex ivuselela ukuqoshwa kwezakhi zofuzo ezithile.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 28. Uhlelo Lwe-Endocrine | 28.2 Indlela Ama-Hormone Asebenza Ngayo | Ama-Hormone Receptors e-Plasma Membrane
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 28. Uhlelo Lwe-Endocrine | 28.2 Indlela Ama-Hormone Asebenza Ngayo | Ama-Hormone Receptors e-Plasma Membrane
chapterContent:
Ama-hormone atholakala kuma-amino acid kanye nama-hormone e-polypeptide awatholakali kuma-lipid (ancibilika kuma-lipid) ngakho-ke awakwazi ukusabalala nge-plasma membrane yamaseli. Ama-hormone angancibiliki kuma-lipid abopha kuma-receptor angaphandle kwe-plasma membrane, ngama-receptor ama-hormone e-plasma membrane. Ngokungafani nama-hormone e-steroid, ama-hormone angancibiliki kuma-lipid awathinti ngqo iseli eliqondiwe ngoba awakwazi ukungena esitokisini futhi asebenze ngqo kwi-DNA. Ukubopha la ma-hormone kwi-receptor yobuso beseli kuphumela ekusebenzeni kwendlela yokubonisa izimpawu; lokhu kubangela umsebenzi wangaphakathi kweseli futhi kufeza imiphumela ethile ehlotshaniswa ne-hormone. Ngale ndlela, akukho lutho oludlula kwi-membrane yeseli; i-hormone ebopha ebusweni ihlala ebusweni beseli kuyilapho umkhiqizo wangaphakathi kweseli uhlala ngaphakathi kweseli. I-hormone eqala indlela yokubonisa izimpawu ibizwa ngokuthi i-first messenger, evuselela i-messenger yesibili kwi-cytoplasm, njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 28.6.

 I-second messenger ebaluleke kakhulu yi-cyclic AMP (cAMP). Lapho i-hormone ibopha kwi-membrane receptor yayo, i-G-protein ehlotshaniswa ne-receptor iyavuselelwa; Ama-protein e-G amaprotheni ahlukene nama-receptor atholakala kulwelwesi lweseli. Uma i-hormone ingaboshelwe ku-receptor, i-G-protein ayisebenzi futhi iboshelwe ku-guanosine diphosphate, noma i-GDP. Uma i-hormone iboshelwe ku-receptor, i-G-protein iyasebenza ngokubopha i-guanosine triphosphate, noma i-GTP, esikhundleni se-GDP. Ngemva kokubopha, i-GTP ifakwa i-hydrolyzed yi-G-protein ibe yi-GDP futhi ayisebenzi.

 I-G-protein esebenzayo nayo isebenzisa i-enzyme eboshelwe kulwelwesi ebizwa ngokuthi i-adenylyl cyclase. I-Adenylyl cyclase ikhuthaza ukuguqulwa kwe-ATP ibe yi-cAMP. I-cAMP, nayo, isebenzisa iqembu lama-protein abizwa ngokuthi ama-protein kinases, adlulisela iqembu le-phosphate kusuka ku-ATP liye kulwelwesi lwe-substrate enqubweni ebizwa ngokuthi i-phosphorylation. I-phosphorylation ye-substrate molecule ishintsha ukuma kwayo kwesakhiwo, ngaleyo ndlela iyisebenze. Lawa ma-molecule asebenzayo angabe eselawula izinguquko ezinqubweni zamaseli.

 Umphumela we-hormone uyandiswa njengoba indlela yokubonisa iqhubeka. Ukubopha kwe-hormone ku-receptor eyodwa kubangela ukusebenza kwama-protein amaningi e-G, okuvuselela i-adenylyl cyclase. I-molecule ngayinye ye-adenylyl cyclase ibe isibangela ukwakheka kwama-molecule amaningi e-cAMP. Ukwanda okuqhubekayo kwenzeka njengoba ama-protein kinase, uma esesebenze yi-cAMP, engavuselela ukusabela okuningi. Ngale ndlela, inani elincane le-hormone lingabangela ukwakheka kwenani elikhulu lomkhiqizo weseli. Ukuze kumiswe umsebenzi we-hormone, i-cAMP iyavalwa yi-enzyme ye-cytoplasmic i-phosphodiesterase, noma i-PDE. I-PDE ihlala ikhona esitokisini futhi iphula i-cAMP ukulawula umsebenzi we-hormone, ivimbele ukukhiqizwa ngokweqile kwemikhiqizo yeseli.

 Impendulo ethile yeseli ku-hormone engancibiliki incike ohlotsheni lwama-receptor akhona ku-membrane yeseli kanye nama-molecule e-substrate akhona ku-cytoplasm yeseli. Izimpendulo zeseli ekubopheni kwama-hormone kwe-receptor zifaka phakathi ukushintsha ukuvuleka kwe-membrane kanye nezindlela ze-metabolic, ukukhuthaza ukwakheka kwamaprotheni nama-enzyme, kanye nokwenza kusebenze ukukhululwa kwama-hormone

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 28. Uhlelo Lwe-Endocrine | 28.3 Ukulawulwa Kwezinqubo Zomzimba | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 28. Uhlelo Lwe-Endocrine | 28.3 Ukulawulwa Kwezinqubo Zomzimba | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent:
Iningi lolwazi kulesi sigaba liyisibonelo se-AP®. Awudingi ukukhumbula uhlu lwama-hormone nemiphumela yawo ezinqubweni ezahlukene zomzimba. Kodwa-ke, uma unikezwe umdwebo obonisa umsebenzi we-hormone ethile, kufanele ukwazi ukuhumusha umdwebo. Lesi sigaba sichaza ngqo ukuthi ama-hormone ahlukene athinta kanjani uhlelo lokukhipha indle, uhlelo lokuzala, i-metabolism, ukugcwala kwe-calcium egazini, ukukhula, kanye nokusabela kokucindezeleka. Izinkinga ezifana nesifo sikashukela zingavela kokubili ekukhiqizweni okunganele kanye nokukhiqizwa ngokweqile kwama-hormone. Kuyasiza ukubheka ezimbalwa zalezi zibonelo zomsebenzi wama-hormone.

 Amazinga kashukela egazini (ushukela) ayahlukahluka kakhulu phakathi nosuku njengoba izikhathi zokudla zishintshana ngezikhathi zokuzila ukudla. I-insulini ne-glucagon ama-hormone amabili ayinhloko anesibopho sokugcina i-homeostasis yamazinga kashukela egazini. Lapho izinga likashukela egazini liphezulu, amaseli e-beta e-pancreas akhipha i-insulin, okwandisa izinga lokumuncwa kwe-glucose egazini kanye nokusetshenziswa ngamaseli aqondiwe, njengokusetshenziswa kwe-glucose ekukhiqizweni kwe-ATP. Uma izinga likashukela egazini liphansi, amaseli e-alpha e-pancreas akhipha i-glucagon, ekhuthaza ukuwohloka kwe-glycogen ibe yi-glucose.

 Isibonelo sesibili ukulawulwa kwamahomoni kwezinhlelo zokuzala zabesilisa nabesifazane (bheka isahluko Sokuzala Nokuthuthukiswa Kwezilwane). Ukulawulwa kudinga isenzo samahomoni amaningana akhiqizwa yi-pituitary gland, i-adrenal cortex, kanye ne-gonads. Ngesikhathi sokuthomba kwabesilisa nabesifazane, i-hypothalamus ikhiqiza i-gonadotropins hormone (GnRH), ekhuthaza ukukhiqizwa nokukhululwa kwe-follicle-stimulating hormone (FSH) kanye ne-luteinizing hormone (LH) kusuka ku-anterior pituitary gland. Lawa mahomoni alawula ama-testes kwabesilisa nakuma-ovari kwabesifazane. Kwabesilisa, i-FSH ivuselela ukuvuthwa kwamaseli esidoda; i-LH ivuselela ukukhiqizwa kwamahomoni ocansi noma ama-androgens njenge-testosterone. (Ama-steroid e-Anabolic, uhlobo lwe-testosterone, ahlotshaniswa nokuthuthukiswa kokusebenza kwabadlali abangochwepheshe.) Kwabesifazane, i-FSH ivuselela ukuthuthukiswa kwamaseli amaqanda (ama-ova); I-LH idlala indima ekuthuthukisweni kwe-ovary, ekuqalisweni kwe-ovulation, nasekukhuthazweni kwe-estradiol, uhlobo olunamandla kakhulu noluvame kakhulu lwe-estrogen, kanye nokukhiqizwa kwe-progesterone ngama-ovary. I-Estradiol ne-progesterone ama-hormone e-steroid alawula umjikelezo wokuya esikhathini, phakathi kweminye imisebenzi. (Amaphilisi okulawula ukuzalwa aklanyelwe ukuvimbela i-ovulation aqukethe amazinga ashintshashintshayo ala ma-hormone.)

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyiswe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo echazwe ku-Big Idea 3 yoHlaka Lwezifundo lwe-AP® Biology. Izinhloso Zokufunda ze-AP® ezibalwe kuHlaka Lwezifundo zinikeza isisekelo esicacile senkambo ye-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekubuzeni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 28. Uhlelo Lwe-Endocrine | 28.3 Ukulawulwa Kwezinqubo Zomzimba | Ukulawulwa Kwamahomoni Ohlelo Lokukhipha Indle
chapterContent:
Ukugcina ibhalansi efanele yamanzi emzimbeni kubalulekile ukuze kugwenywe ukuphelelwa amanzi emzimbeni noma ukumuncwa ngokweqile (i-hyponatremia). Ukuminyana kwamanzi emzimbeni kubhekwa ama-osmoreceptors ku-hypothalamus, athola ukuminyana kwama-electrolyte kuketshezi olungaphandle kwe-extracellular. Ukuminyana kwama-electrolyte egazini kuyanda lapho kunokulahleka kwamanzi okubangelwa ukujuluka ngokweqile, ukungena kwamanzi ngokwanele, noma umthamo wegazi ophansi ngenxa yokulahlekelwa igazi. Ukwanda kwamazinga e-electrolyte egazini kuholela ekuthunyelweni kwesignali ye-neuronal kusuka kuma-osmoreceptors kuma-nuclei e-hypothalamic. I-pituitary gland inezingxenye ezimbili: i-anterior kanye ne-posterior. I-anterior pituitary yakhiwe ngamaseli e-glandular akhipha ama-hormone e-protein. I-posterior pituitary iyisandiso se-hypothalamus. Yakhiwe kakhulu ngama-neurons aqhubeka ne-hypothalamus.

 I-hypothalamus ikhiqiza i-polypeptide hormone eyaziwa ngokuthi i-antidiuretic hormone (ADH), ethuthwa iye futhi ikhishwe ku-posterior pituitary gland. Isenzo esiyinhloko se-ADH ukulawula inani lamanzi akhishwa yizinso. Njengoba i-ADH (eyaziwa nangokuthi i-vasopressin) ibangela ukumuncwa kwamanzi ngqo kusuka kuma-renal tubules, usawoti kanye nokungcola kugxile kulokho okuzokhishwa ekugcineni njengomchamo. I-hypothalamus ilawula izindlela zokukhishwa kwe-ADH, kungaba ngokulawula umthamo wegazi noma ukugcwala kwamanzi egazini. Ukuphelelwa amanzi emzimbeni noma ukucindezeleka ngokomzimba kungabangela ukwanda kwe-osmolarity ngaphezu kwama-300 mOsm/L, okubangela ukwanda kokukhishwa kwe-ADH futhi amanzi azogcinwa, okubangela ukwanda komfutho wegazi. I-ADH ihamba egazini iye ezinso. Uma isisezinso, i-ADH ishintsha izinso ukuze zingene emanzini ngokukhuthaza ukufakwa kwesikhashana kweziteshi zamanzi, ama-aquaporin, kuma-renal tubules. Amanzi aphuma kuma-renal tubules ngama-aquaporin, anciphisa umthamo womchamo. Amanzi aphinde amuncwe kuma-capillary, ehlisa i-osmolarity yegazi ibuyele esimweni esijwayelekile. Njengoba i-osmolarity yegazi incipha, indlela yokuphendula engemihle inciphisa umsebenzi we-osmoreceptor ku-hypothalamus, futhi ukukhishwa kwe-ADH kuncishisiwe. Ukukhishwa kwe-ADH kungancishiswa yizinto ezithile, okuhlanganisa utshwala, okungabangela ukwanda kokukhiqizwa komchamo kanye nokuphelelwa ngamanzi emzimbeni.

 Ukungakhiqizwa kahle kwe-ADH okungapheli noma ukuguquka kwe-ADH receptor kuholela ku-insipidus yesifo sikashukela. Uma i-posterior pituitary ingakhiphi i-ADH eyanele, amanzi awakwazi ukugcinwa yizinso futhi alahleke njengomchamo. Lokhu kubangela ukoma okwandisiwe, kodwa amanzi athathwayo ayalahleka futhi futhi kumele asetshenziswe njalo. Uma isimo singesibi kakhulu, ukuphelelwa ngamanzi emzimbeni kungase kungenzeki, kodwa amacala amakhulu angaholela ekungalinganini kwe-electrolyte ngenxa yokuphelelwa ngamanzi emzimbeni.

 Elinye i-hormone elinomthwalo wokugcina amazinga e-electrolyte oketshezini olungaphandle kwe-extracellular yi-aldosterone, i-hormone ye-steroid ekhiqizwa yi-adrenal cortex. Ngokungafani ne-ADH, ekhuthaza ukumuncwa kabusha kwamanzi ukuze kugcinwe ibhalansi efanele yamanzi, i-aldosterone igcina ibhalansi efanele yamanzi ngokuthuthukisa ukumuncwa kabusha kwe-Na+ kanye nokukhiqizwa kwe-K+ kusuka kuketshezi olungaphandle kwe-extracellular lwamaseli kuma-reso tubules. Ngenxa yokuthi ikhiqizwa ku-cortex ye-adrenal gland futhi ithinta ukugcwala kwamaminerali i-Na+ ne-K+, i-aldosterone ibizwa ngokuthi i-mineralocorticoid, i-corticosteroid ethinta ibhalansi ye-ion namanzi. Ukukhishwa kwe-Aldosterone kukhuthazwa ukwehla kwamazinga e-sodium egazini, umthamo wegazi, noma umfutho wegazi, noma ukwanda kwamazinga e-potassium egazini. Kuvimbela nokulahlekelwa yi-Na+ ekujulukeni, ematheni, kanye nojusi wesisu. Ukuphinda kufakwe i-Na+ kuholela ekufakweni kabusha kwamanzi yi-osmotic, okushintsha umthamo wegazi kanye nomfutho wegazi.

 Ukukhiqizwa kwe-Aldosterone kungakhuthazwa umfutho wegazi ophansi, obangela ukulandelana kokukhishwa kwamakhemikhali, njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 28.7. Lapho umfutho wegazi wehla, uhlelo lwe-renin-angiotensin-aldosterone (RAAS) luyavuselelwa. Amaseli ase-juxtaglomerular apparatus, alawula imisebenzi yama-nephron ezinso, ayakubona lokhu futhi akhulule i-renin. I-Renin, i-enzyme, ijikeleza egazini futhi isabela neprotheni ye-plasma ekhiqizwa yisibindi ebizwa ngokuthi i-angiotensinogen. Lapho i-angiotensinogen ihlukaniswa yi-renin, ikhiqiza i-angiotensin I, eguqulwa ibe yi-angiotensin II emaphashini. I-Angiotensin II isebenza njenge-hormone bese ibangela ukukhishwa kwe-hormone i-aldosterone yi-adrenal cortex, okuholela ekwandeni kokumuncwa kwe-Na+, ukugcinwa kwamanzi, kanye nokwanda komfutho wegazi. I-Angiotensin II ngaphezu kokuba yi-vasoconstrictor enamandla ibangela nokwanda kwe-ADH kanye nokoma okwandisiwe, kokubili okusiza ukuphakamisa umfutho wegazi.

chapterContent: Ukulawulwa kohlelo lokuzala kuyinqubo edinga ukusebenza kwama-hormone avela ku-pituitary gland, i-adrenal cortex, kanye nama-gonad. Ngesikhathi sokuthomba kwabesilisa nabesifazane, i-hypothalamus ikhiqiza i-gonadotropin-releasing hormone (GnRH), ekhuthaza ukukhiqizwa nokukhululwa kwe-follicle-stimulating hormone (FSH) kanye ne-luteinizing hormone (LH) evela ku-anterior pituitary gland. Lawa ma-hormone alawula ama-gonad (ama-testes kwabesilisa kanye nama-ovari kwabesifazane) ngakho-ke abizwa ngokuthi ama-gonadotropin. Kwabesilisa nabesifazane, i-FSH ivuselela ukukhiqizwa kwe-gamete kanti i-LH ivuselela ukukhiqizwa kwama-hormone ngama-gonad. Ukwanda kwamazinga e-gonad hormone kuvimbela ukukhiqizwa kwe-GnRH nge-negative feedback loop.

chapterContent:
Kwabesilisa, i-FSH ivuselela ukuvuthwa kwamaseli esidoda. Ukukhiqizwa kwe-FSH kuvinjelwa yi-hormone i-inhibin, ekhishwa ama-testes. I-LH ivuselela ukukhiqizwa kwama-hormone ocansi (ama-androgens) ngamaseli angaphakathi kwama-testes ngakho-ke ibizwa nangokuthi i-hormone evuselela amaseli angaphakathi.

 I-androgen eyaziwa kakhulu kwabesilisa yi-testosterone. I-Testosterone ikhuthaza ukukhiqizwa kwesidoda kanye nezici zesilisa. I-adrenal cortex nayo ikhiqiza inani elincane le-testosterone precursor, yize indima yalokhu kukhiqizwa kwama-hormone engeziwe ingaqondwa ngokugcwele.

chapterContent:
Abanye abasubathi bazama ukukhulisa ukusebenza kwabo ngokusebenzisa ama-hormone okwenziwa athuthukisa ukusebenza kwemisipha. Ama-steroid e-Anabolic, uhlobo lwe-hormone yobulili yabesilisa i-testosterone, angenye yezidakamizwa ezaziwayo kakhulu ezithuthukisa ukusebenza. Ama-steroids asetshenziselwa ukusiza ekwakheni isisindo semisipha. Amanye ama-hormone asetshenziselwa ukuthuthukisa ukusebenza kwezemidlalo afaka i-erythropoietin, ebangela ukukhiqizwa kwamangqamuzana abomvu egazi, kanye ne-hormone yokukhula komuntu, engasiza ekwakheni isisindo semisipha. Imithi eminingi ethuthukisa ukusebenza ayisemthethweni ngezinjongo ezingezona ezokwelapha. Ivinjelwe futhi yizinhlangano eziningi ezibusayo zezwe nezamazwe ngamazwe, kufaka phakathi izinhlangano eziningi zezemidlalo zama-amateur neze-major league.

 Imiphumela emibi yama-hormone okwenziwa ivame ukuba nkulu futhi ayiguquki, futhi kwezinye izimo, iyabulala. Ama-Androgens akhiqiza izinkinga eziningana ezifana nokungasebenzi kahle kwesibindi, ukukhulisa indlala ye-prostate, ubunzima bokuchama, ukuvalwa ngaphambi kwesikhathi kwe-epiphyseal cartilages, ukuqina kwama-testicular, ukungazali, kanye nokucindezeleka kwesistimu yomzimba. Ukucindezeleka komzimba okubangelwa yilezi zinto kuvame ukuba kukhulu kunalokho umzimba ongakusingatha, okuholela emiphumeleni engalindelekile neyingozi futhi kuhlobanisa ukusetshenziswa kwazo nokuhlaselwa yinhliziyo, ukushaywa yisifo sohlangothi, kanye nokusebenza kwenhliziyo okuphazamisekile.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 28. Uhlelo Lwe-Endocrine | 28.3 Ukulawulwa Kwezinqubo Zomzimba | Ukulawulwa Kwama-hormone Ohlelo Lokuzala | Ukulawulwa Kwesistimu Yokuzala Yabesifazane
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 28. Uhlelo Lwe-Endocrine | 28.3 Ukulawulwa Kwezinqubo Zomzimba | Ukulawulwa Kwama-hormone Ohlelo Lokuzala | Ukulawulwa Kwesistimu Yokuzala Yabesifazane
chapterContent:
Kwabesifazane, i-FSH ivuselela ukukhula kwamaseli amaqanda, abizwa ngokuthi ama-ova, akhula ezakhiweni ezibizwa ngokuthi ama-follicle. Amaseli e-follicle akhiqiza i-hormone i-inhibin, evimbela ukukhiqizwa kwe-FSH. I-LH idlala indima ekuthuthukisweni kwe-ova, ekuqalisweni kwe-ovulation, nasekukhuthazeni ukukhiqizwa kwe-estradiol ne-progesterone ngama-ovari, njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 28.9. I-Estradiol ne-progesterone ama-hormone e-steroid alungiselela umzimba ukukhulelwa. I-Estradiol ikhiqiza izici zobulili zesibili kwabesifazane, kuyilapho i-estradiol ne-progesterone zombili zilawula umjikelezo wokuya esikhathini.

 Ngaphezu kokukhiqiza i-FSH ne-LH, ingxenye engaphambili ye-pituitary gland ikhiqiza ne-hormone i-prolactin (PRL) kwabesifazane. I-Prolactin ivuselela ukukhiqizwa kobisi ngama-gland ebele ngemva kokubeletha. Amazinga e-prolactin alawulwa ama-hormone e-hypothalamic i-prolactin-releasing hormone (PRH) kanye ne-prolactin-inhibiting hormone (PIH), eyaziwa manje ngokuthi i-dopamine. I-PRH ivuselela ukukhishwa kwe-prolactin futhi i-PIH iyayivimbela.

 I-posterior pituitary ikhipha i-hormone i-oxytocin, evuselela ukufinyela kwesibeletho ngesikhathi sokubeletha. Imisipha ebushelelezi yesibeletho ayizweli kakhulu ku-oxytocin kuze kube sekupheleni kokukhulelwa lapho inani lama-receptor e-oxytocin esibelethweni likhuphuka khona. Ukwelula izicubu esibelethweni nasesibelethweni kukhuthaza ukukhishwa kwe-oxytocin ngesikhathi sokubeletha. Ukufinyela kuyanda ngamandla njengoba amazinga egazi e-oxytocin ekhuphuka ngendlela enhle yokuphendula kuze kube yilapho ukubeletha sekuqediwe. I-Oxytocin iphinde ivuselele ukufinyela kwamaseli e-myoepithelial azungeze izindlala zebele ezikhiqiza ubisi. Njengoba la maseli efinyela, ubisi luphoqeleka kusuka ku-secretory alveoli luye emiseleni yobisi futhi lukhishwa emabeleni ngokukhipha ubisi (ukwehlisa ijubane) reflex. Ukukhishwa kwe-oxytocin kukhuthazwa ukuncela kosana, okubangela ukwenziwa kwe-oxytocin ku-hypothalamus nokukhululwa kwayo ekujikelezeni kwegazi ku-posterior pituitary.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 28. Uhlelo Lwe-Endocrine | 28.3 Ukulawulwa Kwezinqubo Zomzimba | Ukulawulwa Kwama-Hormonal Kwe-Metabolism | Ukulawulwa Kwamazinga E-Glucose Egazini Nge-Insulin Ne-Glucagon
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 28. Uhlelo Lwe-Endocrine | 28.3 Ukulawulwa Kwezinqubo Zomzimba | Ukulawulwa Kwama-Hormonal Kwe-Metabolism | Ukulawulwa Kwamazinga E-Glucose Egazini Nge-Insulin Ne-Glucagon
chapterContent:
Amaseli omzimba adinga izakhamzimba ukuze asebenze, futhi lezi zakhamzimba zitholakala ngokudla. Ukuze kulawulwe ukudla okunezakhamzimba, kugcinwe ukudla okuningi futhi kusetshenziswe izindawo ezigciniwe uma kudingeka, umzimba usebenzisa ama-hormone ukuze ulinganisele izitolo zamandla. I-insulin ikhiqizwa amaseli e-beta e-pancreas, akhuthazwa ukukhulula i-insulin njengoba amazinga kashukela egazini ekhuphuka (isibonelo, ngemva kokudla). I-insulin yehlisa amazinga kashukela egazini ngokuthuthukisa izinga lokuthathwa nokusetshenziswa kwe-glucose ngamaseli aqondiwe, asebenzisa i-glucose ekukhiqizweni kwe-ATP. Iphinde ivuselele isibindi ukuthi siguqule i-glucose ibe yi-glycogen, egcinwa amaseli ukuze isetshenziswe kamuva. I-insulin iphinde ikhulise ukuthuthwa kwe-glucose emaseli athile, njengamaseli emisipha nesibindi. Lokhu kubangelwa ukwanda kwenani lamaprotheni okuthutha i-glucose emangqamuzaneni eseli, asusa i-glucose ekujikelezeni kwegazi ngokusabalala okulula. Njengoba i-insulin ibopha iseli layo eliqondiwe ngama-receptor e-insulin kanye nokudluliselwa kwesignali, ibangela iseli ukuthi lifake amaprotheni okuthutha i-glucose engqamuzaneni yalo. Lokhu kuvumela i-glucose ukuthi ingene esitokisini, lapho ingasetshenziswa khona njengomthombo wamandla. Kodwa-ke, lokhu akwenzeki kuwo wonke amaseli: amanye amaseli, okuhlanganisa nalawo asezinso nasebuchosheni, angafinyelela i-glucose ngaphandle kokusebenzisa i-insulin. I-insulin iphinde ivuselele ukuguqulwa kwe-glucose ibe amafutha kuma-adipocytes kanye nokwakheka kwamaprotheni. Lezi zenzo eziqhutshwa yi-insulin zibangela ukwehla kwamazinga kashukela egazini, okubizwa ngokuthi umphumela we-hypoglycemic low sugar”, okuvimbela ukukhishwa okwengeziwe kwe-insulin kumaseli e-beta ngokusebenzisa i-negative feedback loop.

 Ukungasebenzi kahle kwe-insulin kungaholela esimweni esibizwa ngokuthi isifo sikashukela, izimpawu zaso eziyinhloko ziboniswe kuMfanekiso 28.10. Lokhu kungabangelwa amazinga aphansi okukhiqizwa kwe-insulin ngamaseli e-beta e-pancreas, noma ukuncipha kokuzwela kwamaseli ezicubu ku-insulin. Lokhu kuvimbela i-glucose ekumuncweni ngamaseli, okubangela amazinga aphezulu kashukela egazini, noma i-hyperglycemia (ushukela ophezulu). Amazinga aphezulu kashukela egazini enza kube nzima ngezinso ukubuyisa yonke i-glucose emchameni osafufusa, okuholela ekulahlekeni kwe-glucose emchameni. Amazinga aphezulu kashukela egazini aphinde abangele ukuthi izinso ziphinde zimuncwe ngamanzi amancane, okubangela ukuthi kukhiqizwe inani elikhulu lomchamo; lokhu kungabangela ukuphelelwa amanzi emzimbeni. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, amazinga aphezulu kashukela egazini angabangela ukulimala kwemizwa emehlweni nasezicutshini zomzimba, kanye nomonakalo ezinso nasesimisweni senhliziyo nemithambo yegazi. Ukukhishwa ngokweqile kwe-insulin kungabangela i-hypoglycemia, amazinga aphansi kashukela egazini. Lokhu kubangela ukutholakala okunganele kwe-glucose kumaseli, okuvame ukuholela ebuthakathakeni bemisipha, futhi ngezinye izikhathi kungabangela ukungazi lutho noma ukufa uma kungelashwa.

 Lapho amazinga kashukela egazini ehla ngaphansi kwamazinga ajwayelekile, isibonelo phakathi kokudla noma lapho i-glucose isetshenziswa ngokushesha ngesikhathi sokuzivocavoca, i-hormone i-glucagon ikhishwa kumaseli e-alpha e-pancreas. I-Glucagon iphakamisa amazinga kashukela egazini, ibangele lokho okubizwa ngokuthi umphumela we-hyperglycemic, ngokukhuthaza ukuwohloka kwe-glycogen ibe yi-glucose kumaseli emisipha yamathambo namaseli esibindi enqubo ebizwa ngokuthi i-glycogenolysis. I-glucose ingasetshenziswa njengamandla ngamaseli emisipha futhi ikhishwe ekujikelezeni kwegazi ngamaseli esibindi. I-Glucagon ivuselela futhi ukumuncwa kwama-amino acid egazini yisibindi, bese iwaguqula abe yi-glucose. Le nqubo yokwenziwa kwe-glucose ibizwa ngokuthi i-gluconeogenesis. I-Glucagon ivuselela futhi amaseli amafutha ukuze akhiphe ama-fatty acid egazini. Lezi zenzo eziqhutshwa yi-glucagon ziholela ekwandeni kwamazinga kashukela egazini abe amazinga ajwayelekile e-homeostatic. Ukwanda kwamazinga kashukela egazini kuvimbela ukukhishwa kwe-glucagon okwengeziwe yi-pancreas ngendlela yokuphendula engemihle. Ngale ndlela, i-insulin ne-glucagon zisebenza ndawonye ukugcina amazinga kashukela e-homeostatic, njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 28.11
