chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 28. Uhlelo Lwe-Endocrine | 28.3 Ukulawulwa Kwezinqubo Zomzimba | Ukulawulwa Kwama-Hormonal Kwe-Metabolism | Ukulawulwa Kwamazinga E-Metabolic Ngama-hormone E-thyroid
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 28. Uhlelo Lwe-Endocrine | 28.3 Ukulawulwa Kwezinqubo Zomzimba | Ukulawulwa Kwama-Hormonal Kwe-Metabolism | Ukulawulwa Kwamazinga E-Metabolic Ngama-hormone E-thyroid
chapterContent:
Izinga eliyisisekelo lokuguqulwa kwe-metabolic, okuyinani lamakhalori adingwa umzimba lapho uphumule, linqunywa ama-hormone amabili akhiqizwa yi-thyroid gland: i-thyroxine, eyaziwa nangokuthi i-tetraiodothyronine noma i-T4, kanye ne-triiodothyronine, eyaziwa nangokuthi i-T3. La ma-hormone athinta cishe wonke amaseli emzimbeni ngaphandle kobuchopho bomuntu omdala, isibeletho, ama-testes, amaseli egazi, kanye ne-spleen. Athuthwa adlule ku-plasma membrane yamaseli aqondiwe futhi abopha kuma-receptors ku-mitochondria okuholela ekukhiqizweni kwe-ATP okwandisiwe. Ku-nucleus, i-T3 ne-T4 zivuselela izakhi zofuzo ezihilelekile ekukhiqizweni kwamandla kanye nokushiswa kwe-glucose. Lokhu kuphumela emazingeni akhuphukile okuguqulwa kwe-metabolic kanye nokukhiqizwa kokushisa komzimba, okwaziwa ngokuthi umphumela we-calorigenic we-hormone.

 Ukukhululwa kwe-T3 ne-T4 kusuka ku-thyroid gland kukhuthazwa yi-thyroid-stimulating hormone (TSH), ekhiqizwa yi-anterior pituitary. Ukubopha kwe-TSH kuma-receptors e-follicle ye-thyroid kubangela ukukhiqizwa kwe-T3 ne-T4 kusuka ku-glycoprotein ebizwa ngokuthi i-thyroglobulin. I-Thyroglobulin ikhona kuma-follicle e-thyroid, futhi iguqulwa ibe ama-hormone e-thyroid ngokufakwa kwe-iodine. I-Iodine yakhiwa ngama-ion e-iodide athuthwa ngenkuthalo aye ku-follicle ye-thyroid esuka egazini. I-enzyme ye-peroxidase ibe isinamathisela i-iodine ku-amino acid ye-tyrosine etholakala ku-thyroglobulin. I-T3 inama-ion amathathu e-iodine anamathiselwe, kuyilapho i-T4 inama-ion amane e-iodine anamathiselwe. I-T3 ne-T4 bese zikhishwa ziye egazini, kanti i-T4 ikhishwa ngamanani amakhulu kakhulu kune-T3. Njengoba i-T3 isebenza kakhulu kune-T4 futhi inesibopho semiphumela eminingi yama-hormone e-thyroid, izicubu zomzimba ziguqula i-T4 ibe yi-T3 ngokususwa kwe-ion ye-iodine. Iningi le-T3 ne-T4 ekhishwe linamathela ekuthuthweni kwamaprotheni egazini futhi alikwazi ukuwela ulwelwesi lwe-plasma lwamaseli. Lawa ma-molecule aboshwe ngamaprotheni akhishwa kuphela lapho amazinga egazi e-hormone engaxhunywanga eqala ukwehla. Ngale ndlela, i-hormone yokugcina yesonto lonke igcinwa egazini. Ukwanda kwamazinga e-T3 kanye ne-T4 egazini kuvimbela ukukhishwa kwe-TSH, okuholela ekukhishweni okuphansi kwe-T3 kanye ne-T4 ku-thyroid.

 Amaseli e-follicular e-thyroid adinga ama-iodide (ama-anion e-iodine) ukuze akhiqize i-T3 kanye ne-T4. Ama-iodide atholakala ekudleni athuthwa ngenkuthalo kumaseli e-follicle okuholela ekugxilweni okuphindwe cishe izikhathi ezingu-30 kunegazi. Ukudla okuvamile eNyakatho Melika kunikeza i-iodine eningi kunalokho okudingekayo ngenxa yokwengezwa kwe-iodide kusawoti wetafula. Ukungena ngokwanele kwe-iodine, okwenzeka emazweni amaningi asathuthuka, kuholela ekungakwazini ukukhiqiza ama-hormone e-T3 kanye ne-T4. I-thyroid gland iyanda esimweni esibizwa ngokuthi i-goiter, esibangelwa ukukhiqizwa ngokweqile kwe-TSH ngaphandle kokwakheka kwe-hormone ye-thyroid. I-Thyroglobulin iqukethwe kuketshezi olubizwa ngokuthi i-colloid, futhi ukukhuthazwa kwe-TSH kuphumela emazingeni aphezulu okuqongelela kwe-colloid ku-thyroid. Uma ingekho i-iodine, lokhu akuguquki kube yi-hormone ye-thyroid, futhi i-colloid iqala ukuqongelela kakhulu ku-thyroid gland, okuholela ku-goiter.

 Izinkinga zingavela kokubili ekukhiqizweni okunganele kanye nasekukhiqizweni ngokweqile kwama-hormone e-thyroid. I-Hypothyroidism, ukukhiqizwa okunganele kwama-hormone e-thyroid, kungabangela izinga eliphansi lokuguqulwa kwe-metabolic okuholela ekukhuleni kwesisindo, ukuzwela emakhazeni, kanye nokuncipha komsebenzi wengqondo, phakathi kwezinye izimpawu. Ezinganeni, i-hypothyroidism ingabangela i-cretinism, engaholela ekubambezelekeni kwengqondo kanye nokukhubazeka kokukhula. I-Hyperthyroidism, ukukhiqizwa ngokweqile kwama-hormone e-thyroid, kungaholela ekwandeni kwesilinganiso sokuguqulwa kwe-metabolic kanye nemiphumela yaso: ukwehla kwesisindo, ukukhiqizwa kokushisa ngokweqile, ukujuluka, kanye nokwanda kwesilinganiso senhliziyo. Isifo se-Graves siyisibonelo esisodwa sesimo se-hyperthyroid

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 28. Uhlelo Lwe-Endocrine | 28.3 Ukulawulwa Kwezinqubo Zomzimba | Ukulawulwa Kwama-Hormonal Kwamazinga E-Calcium Egazini
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 28. Uhlelo Lwe-Endocrine | 28.3 Ukulawulwa Kwezinqubo Zomzimba | Ukulawulwa Kwama-Hormonal Kwamazinga E-Calcium Egazini
chapterContent:
Ukulawulwa kokugcwala kwe-calcium egazini kubalulekile ekudalweni kokufinyela kwemisipha kanye nemizwa, okuvuselelwa ngogesi. Uma amazinga e-calcium eba phezulu kakhulu, ukungena kwe-membrane ku-sodium kuyancipha futhi ulwelwesi luba luncane ukuphendula. Uma amazinga e-calcium eba phansi kakhulu, ukungena kwe-membrane ku-sodium kuyanda futhi kungabangela ukuxhuzula noma ukuqaqamba kwemisipha.

 Amazinga e-calcium egazini alawulwa yi-parathyroid hormone (PTH), ekhiqizwa yizindlala ze-parathyroid, njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 28.12. I-PTH ikhishwa ngenxa yamazinga aphansi e-Ca2+ egazini. I-PTH ikhulisa amazinga e-Ca2+ ngokubhekisisa ulwelwesi, izinso, kanye namathumbu. Elulwelweni, i-PTH ivuselela ama-osteoclast, abangela ukuthi amathambo aphinde amuncwe, akhulule i-Ca2+ emathanjeni aye egazini. I-PTH ivimbela nama-osteoblast, inciphise ukufakwa kwe-Ca2+ emathanjeni. Emathunjini, i-PTH ikhulisa ukumuncwa kwe-Ca2+ ekudleni, kanti ezinso, i-PTH ivuselela ukumuncwa kwe-CA2+. Nakuba i-PTH isebenza ngqo ezinso ukuze yandise ukumuncwa kwe-Ca2+, imiphumela yayo emathunjini ayiqondile. I-PTH ibangela ukwakheka kwe-calcitriol, uhlobo olusebenzayo lwe-vitamin D, olusebenza emathunjini ukuze lwandise ukumuncwa kwe-calcium ekudleni. Ukukhishwa kwe-PTH kuvinjelwa ukwanda kwamazinga e-calcium egazini.

 I-Hyperparathyroidism ibangelwa ukukhiqizwa ngokweqile kwe-hormone ye-parathyroid. Lokhu kuholela ekususweni kwe-calcium eningi emathanjeni futhi kufakwe ekujikelezeni kwegazi, okukhiqiza ubuthakathaka besakhiwo samathambo, okungaholela ekuguqukeni nasekuqhekekeni, kanye nokukhubazeka kwesistimu yezinzwa ngenxa yamazinga aphezulu e-calcium egazini. I-Hypoparathyroidism, ukukhiqizwa okunganele kwe-PTH, kuholela emazingeni aphansi kakhulu e-calcium egazini, okubangela ukusebenza kwemisipha okungasebenzi kahle futhi kungabangela i-tetany (ukuminyana kwemisipha okuqhubekayo).

 I-hormone i-calcitonin, ekhiqizwa amaseli e-parafollicular noma e-C e-thyroid, inomphumela ophambene emazingeni e-calcium egazini njengoba kwenza i-PTH. I-Calcitonin yehlisa amazinga e-calcium egazini ngokuvimbela ama-osteoclast, ivuselele ama-osteoblast, futhi ivuselele ukukhishwa kwe-calcium yizinso. Lokhu kuphumela ekufakweni kwe-calcium emathanjeni ukuze kukhuthazwe ukuqina kwesakhiwo. I-Calcitonin ibaluleke kakhulu ezinganeni (uma ivuselela ukukhula kwamathambo), ngesikhathi sokukhulelwa (lapho inciphisa ukulahlekelwa kwamathambo kamama), kanye nangesikhathi sokulamba isikhathi eside (ngoba inciphisa ukulahlekelwa kwamathambo). Kubantu abadala abanempilo abangakhulelwe nabangenaso indlala, indima ye-calcitonin ayicaci.
question1: Kungani kubalulekile ukulawula amazinga e-calcium egazini?
answer1: Ngoba i-calcium ibalulekile ekuqiniseni imisipha kanye nokukhiqiza imizwa yezinzwa
distractor1a: Ngoba i-calcium iwumthombo oyinhloko wamandla eseli
distractor1b: Ngoba i-calcium ilawula amazinga kashukela egazini

distractor2a: Ukumuncwa kwe-membrane ku-sodium kunciphisa, kuvimbela imizwa yezinzwa

answer6: Ukumuncwa kwamathambo ngokweqile okuholela emathanjeni abuthakathaka kanye namazinga aphezulu e-calcium egazini
distractor6a: Ukwakheka kwamathambo ngokweqile kanye namazinga e-calcium egazini anciphile
distractor6b: Ushukela wegazi ophansi kanye nokukhiqizwa kwe-insulin okwandisiwe

answer7: Ukukhiqizwa okunganele kwe-PTH okuholela emazingeni aphansi e-calcium egazini kanye nokusebenza kwemisipha okuphazamisekile

distractor7c: Ukukhiqizwa okunganele kwe-insulin okubangela isifo sikashukela

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 28. Uhlelo Lwe-Endocrine | 28.3 Ukulawulwa Kwezinqubo Zomzimba | Ukulawulwa Kokukhula Kwama-hormone
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 28. Uhlelo Lwe-Endocrine | 28.3 Ukulawulwa Kwezinqubo Zomzimba | Ukulawulwa Kokukhula Kwama-hormone
chapterContent:
Kudingeka ukulawulwa kwama-hormone ukuze kukhule futhi kuphindaphindwe amaseli amaningi emzimbeni. I-Growth hormone (GH), ekhiqizwa yingxenye engaphambili ye-pituitary gland, isheshisa izinga lokwenziwa kwamaprotheni, ikakhulukazi emisipheni nasemathanjeni. I-Growth hormone inezindlela zokusebenza eziqondile nezingaqondile. Isenzo sokuqala esiqondile se-GH ukukhuthazwa kokuqhekeka kwe-triglyceride (i-lipolysis) nokukhululwa egazini ngama-adipocytes. Lokhu kuholela ekushintsheni kwezicubu eziningi ekusebenziseni i-glucose njengomthombo wamandla kuya ekusebenziseni ama-fatty acid. Le nqubo ibizwa ngokuthi umphumela wokonga i-glucose. Kwenye indlela eqondile, i-GH ivuselela ukuqhekeka kwe-glycogen esibindini; i-glycogen bese ikhishwa egazini njenge-glucose. Amazinga e-glucose egazini ayanda njengoba izicubu eziningi zisebenzisa ama-fatty acid esikhundleni se-glucose ukuze zifeze izidingo zazo zamandla. Ukwanda kwe-GH emazingeni e-glucose egazini kubizwa ngokuthi umphumela we-diabetogenic ngoba kufana namazinga aphezulu e-glucose egazini abonakala ku-diabetes mellitus.

 Indlela engaqondile yokusebenza kwe-GH iqondiswa yizinto zokukhula ezifana ne-insulin (ama-IGF) noma ama-somatomedins, angumndeni wamaprotheni akhuthaza ukukhula akhiqizwa yisibindi, akhuthaza ukukhula kwezicubu. Ama-IGF avuselela ukumuncwa kwama-amino acid egazini, okuvumela ukwakheka kwamaprotheni amasha, ikakhulukazi kumaseli emisipha yamathambo, amaseli e-cartilage, nakwamanye amaseli aqondiwe, njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 28.13. Lokhu kubaluleke kakhulu ngemva kokudla, lapho amazinga okuhlushwa kwe-glucose nama-amino acid ephezulu egazini. Amazinga e-GH alawulwa ama-hormone amabili akhiqizwa yi-hypothalamus. Ukukhululwa kwe-GH kukhuthazwa yi-hormone yokukhula ekhulula i-hormone (i-GHRH) futhi kuvinjelwa yi-hormone yokukhula evimbela i-hormone (i-GHIH), ebizwa nangokuthi i-somatostatin.

 Ukukhiqizwa okulinganiselayo kwe-hormone yokukhula kubalulekile ekuthuthukisweni okufanele. Ukukhiqizwa okunganele kwe-GH kubantu abadala akubonakali kubangela noma yikuphi ukukhubazeka, kodwa ezinganeni kungabangela ukufiphala kwe-pituitary, okuholela ekukhuleni okufushane ngokungavamile ngokulingana komzimba okuvamile. Ukuphakama kwabantu abanjalo kuvame ukuba ngaphansi kuka-4 izinyawo (122 cm) ukuphakama. Ukukhishwa ngokweqile kwe-hormone yokukhula kungaholela ekukhuleni okukhulu ezinganeni, okubangela ukukhula ngokweqile. Kwezinye izimo ezibhaliwe, abantu bangafinyelela ukuphakama okungaphezu kuka-8 izinyawo. Kubantu abadala, i-GH ngokweqile kungaholela ku-acromegaly, isimo lapho kukhona ukwanda kwamathambo ebusweni, ezandleni, kanye izinyawo asakwazi ukukhula.
answer1: I-anterior pituitary gland
question2: Iyini imiphumela eqondile ye-hormone yokukhula kwezicubu zamafutha?
answer2: Kuvuselela ukuwohloka kwe-triglyceride (i-lipolysis) kanye nokukhululwa kwama-fatty acid egazini
question3: Iyini imiphumela yokulondoloza ushukela we-hormone yokukhula?
answer3: Izicubu eziningi ziyashintsha kusukela ekusebenziseni i-glucose ziye ekusebenziseni ama-fatty acid njengomthombo wazo wamandla oyinhloko
distractor3a: Izicubu eziningi ziguqula ama-fatty acid abe yi-glucose
distractor3b: I-glucose igcinwa njenge-glycogen kuzo zonke izicubu
distractor3c: Amaseli ayayeka ukusebenzisa kokubili i-glucose kanye nama-fatty acid
question4: Kungani i-hormone yokukhula inomphumela wesifo sikashukela?
answer4: Ngoba kwandisa amazinga kashukela egazini ngokukhuthaza ukuwohloka kwe-glycogen kuyilapho izicubu zisebenzisa ama-fatty acid ukuze zithole amandla
question5: Yimaphi amaprotheni alawula imiphumela engaqondile ye-hormone yokukhula?
answer5: Izinto zokukhula ezifana ne-insulin (IGFs), ezibizwa nangokuthi i-somatomedins
question6: Zikhiqizwa kuphi izinto zokukhula ezifana ne-insulin (ama-IGF) ngokuyinhloko?
question7: Ama-IGF akhuthaza kanjani ukukhula kwezicubu?
answer7: Ngokukhuthaza ukumuncwa kwama-amino acid kanye nokwakheka kwamaprotheni ezicutshini eziqondiwe
question8: Yimaphi ama-hormone e-hypothalamic alawula ukukhiqizwa kwe-hormone yokukhula?
answer8: I-hormone yokukhulisa ekhulula i-hormone yokukhula (i-GHRH) ivuselela ukukhishwa kwe-GH, kuyilapho i-hormone yokukhulisa evimbela i-hormone yokukhula (i-GHIH noma i-somatostatin) iyivimbela
distractor8a: I-GnRH ivuselela ukukhishwa kwe-GH, kuyilapho i-LH iyivimbela
distractor8b: I-TSH ivuselela ukukhishwa kwe-GH, kuyilapho i-ACTH iyivimbela
distractor8c: I-insulin ivuselela ukukhishwa kwe-GH, kuyilapho i-glucagon iyivimbela

chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 28. Uhlelo Lwe-Endocrine | 28.3 Ukulawulwa Kwezinqubo Zomzimba | Ukulawulwa Kwama-Hormonal Kokucindezeleka
chapterContent:
Uma kutholakala usongo noma ingozi, umzimba usabela ngokukhulula ama-hormone azowulungiselela impendulo yokulwa noma yokubaleka. Imiphumela yale mpendulo ijwayelekile kunoma ubani oke waba sesimweni esicindezelayo: ukushaya kwenhliziyo okwandayo, umlomo owomile, kanye nezinwele ezimile.

 Uhlelo lwezinzwa oluzwelayo lulawula impendulo yokucindezeleka nge-hypothalamus. Izinto ezibangela ukucindezeleka zibangela i-hypothalamus ukuthi ibonise i-adrenal medulla (eqondisa izimpendulo zokucindezeleka zesikhathi esifushane) ngemizwa yezinzwa, kanye ne-adrenal cortex, eqondisa izimpendulo zokucindezeleka zesikhathi eside, nge-hormone i-adrenocorticotropic hormone (ACTH), ekhiqizwa yi-anterior pituitary.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 28. Uhlelo Lwe-Endocrine | 28.3 Ukulawulwa Kwezinqubo Zomzimba | Ukulawulwa Kwama-hormone Okucindezeleka | Impendulo Yokulwa Noma Yokundiza
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 28. Uhlelo Lwe-Endocrine | 28.3 Ukulawulwa Kwezinqubo Zomzimba | Ukulawulwa Kwama-hormone Okucindezeleka | Impendulo Yokulwa Noma Yokundiza
chapterContent:
Ukusebenzisana kwama-hormone e-endocrine kuye kwavela ukuqinisekisa ukuthi indawo yangaphakathi yomzimba ihlala izinzile. Izingcindezi ziyizinto eziphazamisa i-homeostasis. Ukuhlukaniswa kwe-sympathetic kwesistimu yezinzwa ezizimele zomgogodla kuthuthukise impendulo yokulwa noma yokubaleka ukuze kulwiwe nokuphazamiseka kwe-homeostasis okubangelwa ukucindezeleka. Esigabeni sokuqala sokuxwayisa, uhlelo lwezinzwa oluzwelayo luvuselela ukwanda kwamazinga amandla ngokusebenzisa amazinga aphezulu kashukela egazini. Lokhu kulungiselela umzimba umsebenzi womzimba ongadingeka ukuze uphendule ekucindezelekeni: ukulwela ukusinda noma ukubalekela ingozi.

 Kodwa-ke, ezinye izingcindezi, njengokugula noma ukulimala, zingahlala isikhathi eside. Izigcini ze-Glycogen, ezinikeza amandla ekuphenduleni kwesikhashana ekucindezelekeni, ziyaphela ngemva kwamahora amaningana futhi azikwazi ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zamandla zesikhathi eside. Uma izigcini ze-glycogen zaziwukuphela komthombo wamandla otholakalayo, ukusebenza kwezinzwa bekungeke kugcinwe uma izigcini seziphelile ngenxa yesidingo esiphezulu sesistimu yezinzwa se-glucose. Kulesi simo, umzimba uthuthukise impendulo yokulwa nokucindezeleka kwesikhathi eside ngezenzo ze-glucocorticoids, eziqinisekisa ukuthi izidingo zamandla zesikhathi eside zingahlangatshezwa. Ama-glucocorticoids ahlanganisa amafutha namaprotheni agciniwe, avuselele i-gluconeogenesis, alondoloze i-glucose ukuze isetshenziswe yizicubu ze-neural, futhi akhuthaze ukulondolozwa kosawoti namanzi. Izindlela zokugcina i-homeostasis ezichazwe lapha yilezo ezibonakala emzimbeni womuntu. Kodwa-ke, impendulo yokulwa noma ukubaleka ikhona ngandlela thile kuzo zonke izilwane ezinomgogodla.
answer1: Izisusa eziphazamisa i-homeostasis
question2: Yikuphi ukuhlukaniswa kwesistimu yezinzwa ezizimele okuqalisa impendulo yokulwa noma ukubaleka?

distractor3c: Ukunciphisa izinga lokushaya kwenhliziyo kanye nomfutho wegazi

answer4: Ngoba izinqolobane ze-glycogen ziyaphela ngemva kwamahora amaningana

distractor4c: Ngoba i-glycogen igcinwa kuphela ezicutshini zamafutha

distractor5c: Ngoba izicubu zamafutha zidinga i-glucose kuphela

question7: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okuwumphumela we-glucocorticoids ngesikhathi sokucindezeleka kwesikhathi eside?
answer7: Zivuselela i-gluconeogenesis futhi zikhuthaza ukugcinwa kwamafutha namaprotheni
question8: Ama-glucocorticoids asiza kanjani ukugcina i-homeostasis ngesikhathi sokucindezeleka isikhathi eside?
answer8: Zigcina i-glucose yezicubu zezinzwa futhi zikhuthaza ukulondolozwa kosawoti namanzi
distractor8a: Zandisa ukukhishwa kwe-calcium futhi zinciphise umthamo wegazi
question9: Chaza ukuthi kungani impendulo yokulwa noma ukubaleka inenzuzo esikhathini esifushane kodwa hhayi esikhathini eside

distractor9b: Ukulwa noma ukundiza kunciphisa ukufinyelela ezinqolobaneni ze-glycogen futhi lokhu kuncipha ngokushesha okukhulu

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 28. Uhlelo Lwe-Endocrine | 28.3 Ukulawulwa Kwezinqubo Zomzimba | Ukulawulwa Kwamahomoni Okucindezeleka | Impendulo Yesikhashana Yokucindezeleka
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 28. Uhlelo Lwe-Endocrine | 28.3 Ukulawulwa Kwezinqubo Zomzimba | Ukulawulwa Kwamahomoni Okucindezeleka | Impendulo Yesikhashana Yokucindezeleka
chapterContent: Uma ubhekene nesimo esicindezelayo, umzimba uphendula ngokubiza ukukhishwa kwama-hormone anikeza amandla amaningi. Ama-hormone i-epinephrine (aziwa nangokuthi i-adrenaline) kanye ne-norepinephrine (aziwa nangokuthi i-noradrenaline) akhishwa yi-adrenal medulla. La ma-hormone anikeza kanjani amandla amaningi? I-Epinephrine kanye ne-norepinephrine kwandisa amazinga kashukela egazini ngokuvuselela isibindi nemisipha yamathambo ukuze kuqhekeke i-glycogen kanye nokuvuselela ukukhishwa kwe-glucose ngamaseli esibindi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, la ma-hormone andisa ukutholakala komoya-mpilo kumaseli ngokwandisa izinga lokushaya kwenhliziyo nokwandisa ama-bronchioles. La ma-hormone aphinde abeke phambili ukusebenza komzimba ngokwandisa ukuhlinzekwa kwegazi ezithweni ezibalulekile njengenhliziyo, ubuchopho, kanye nemisipha yamathambo, kuyilapho ekhawulela ukugeleza kwegazi ezithweni ezingadingeki ngokushesha, njengesikhumba, uhlelo lokugaya ukudla, kanye nezinso. I-Epinephrine kanye ne-norepinephrine zibizwa ngokuthi ama-catecholamines.

answer1: I-Epinephrine ne-norepinephrine
question2: Kukuyiphi ingxenye yendlala ye-adrenal lapho kukhishwa khona i-epinephrine ne-norepinephrine?
question3: I-epinephrine ne-norepinephrine ziwandisa kanjani amazinga kashukela egazini?
answer3: Ngokukhuthaza ukuwohloka kwe-glycogen esibindini nasemisipheni yamathambo nokukhuthaza ukukhishwa kwe-glucose esibindini
question4: I-epinephrine ne-norepinephrine zikhulisa kanjani ukutholakala komoya-mpilo emaseli?
answer4: Ngokwandisa izinga lokushaya kwenhliziyo nokwandisa ama-bronchioles
distractor4a: Ngokunciphisa izinga lokushaya kwenhliziyo nokunciphisa ama-bronchioles
question5: Yiziphi izitho zomzimba ezithola ukugeleza kwegazi okwandisiwe ngesikhathi sokusabela kokucindezeleka kwesikhashana?
distractor5a: Isikhumba, uhlelo lokugaya ukudla, kanye nezinso
question6: Yiziphi izitho zomzimba ezithola ukugeleza kwegazi okunciphile ngesikhathi sokusabela kokucindezeleka kwesikhashana?
answer6: Isikhumba, uhlelo lokugaya ukudla, kanye nezinso

answer7: Ukubeka phambili umoya-mpilo kanye nokulethwa kwezakhamzimba ezithweni zomzimba ezidingekayo ukuze ziphile ngokushesha
distractor7a: Ukwandisa ukugaya ukudla ngesikhathi sezimo ezicindezelayo

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 28. Uhlelo Lwe-Endocrine | 28.3 Ukulawulwa Kwezinqubo Zomzimba | Ukulawulwa Kwama-hormone Okucindezeleka | Impendulo Yokucindezeleka Yesikhathi Eside
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 28. Uhlelo Lwe-Endocrine | 28.3 Ukulawulwa Kwezinqubo Zomzimba | Ukulawulwa Kwama-hormone Okucindezeleka | Impendulo Yokucindezeleka Yesikhathi Eside
chapterContent:
Impendulo yokucindezeleka yesikhathi eside ihlukile empendulweni yokucindezeleka yesikhathi esifushane. Umzimba awukwazi ukusekela ukuqhuma kwamandla okwenziwa yi-epinephrine ne-norepinephrine isikhathi eside. Kunalokho, amanye ama-hormone ayadlala indima. Empendulweni yokucindezeleka yesikhathi eside, i-hypothalamus ibangela ukukhishwa kwe-ACTH kusuka ku-anterior pituitary gland. I-adrenal cortex ikhuthazwa yi-ACTH ukuze ikhiphe ama-hormone e-steroid abizwa ngokuthi ama-corticosteroids. Ama-Corticosteroids avula ukuqoshwa kwezakhi zofuzo ezithile kuma-nuclei amaseli aqondiwe. Ashintsha ukuhlushwa kwama-enzyme ku-cytoplasm futhi athinta imetabolism yamaseli. Kunezinhlobo ezimbili eziyinhloko zama-corticosteroids: ama-glucocorticoids njenge-cortisol, kanye nama-mineralocorticoids njenge-aldosterone. Lawa ma-hormone ahlose ukuqhekeka kwamafutha abe ama-fatty acid ezicutshini zamafutha. Ama-fatty acid akhishwa egazini ukuze ezinye izicubu ziwasebenzisele ukukhiqizwa kwe-ATP. Ama-glucocorticoids athinta kakhulu imetabolism ye-glucose ngokuvuselela ukwakheka kwe-glucose. Ama-Glucocorticoids nawo anezakhiwo zokulwa nokuvuvukala ngokuvimbela isimiso somzimba sokuzivikela. Isibonelo, i-cortisone isetshenziswa njengomuthi wokulwa nokuvuvukala; noma kunjalo, ayikwazi ukusetshenziswa isikhathi eside njengoba yandisa ukuthambekela ezifweni ngenxa yemiphumela yayo yokucindezela amasosha omzimba.

 Ama-Mineralocorticoids asebenza ukulawula ibhalansi ye-ion namanzi emzimbeni. I-hormone i-aldosterone ivuselela ukumuncwa kabusha kwamanzi nama-ion e-sodium ezinso, okuholela ekukhuphukeni komfutho wegazi kanye nomthamo.

 Ukukhiqizwa ngokweqile kwama-glucocorticoids kungabangela isimo esaziwa ngokuthi isifo sikaCushing, esibonakala ngokushintshashintsha kwezindawo zokugcina amafutha emzimbeni. Lokhu kungabangela ukuqongelela kwezicubu zamafutha ebusweni nasentanyeni, kanye ne-glucose eningi egazini. Ukukhiqizwa ngokweqile kwama-corticosteroids kungabangela isifo sika-Addison, okungaholela ekuqhekekeni kwesikhumba, i-hypoglycemia, kanye namazinga aphansi e-electrolyte egazini.
question1: Yiliphi i-hormone ekhishwa yi-anterior pituitary eqala impendulo yokucindezeleka yesikhathi eside?
answer1: I-hormone ye-Adrenocorticotropic (ACTH)

answer4: Zilawula ukubhalwa kwezakhi zofuzo, zishintsha amazinga e-enzyme kanye ne-metabolism yamaseli
distractor4a: Zikhulisa ngqo ukukhiqizwa kwe-ATP ngaphandle kokuthinta ukubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo
question5: Yiziphi izinhlobo ezimbili ezinkulu zama-corticosteroids ezikhishwa ngesikhathi sokucindezeleka kwesikhathi eside?

answer6: Zikhuthaza ukwakheka kwe-glucose futhi zikhuthaze ukugcinwa kwamafutha

answer7: Ngoba kucindezela amasosha omzimba futhi kwandisa ukuthambekela kwezifo
distractor7a: Ngoba kuphakamisa unomphela amazinga e-calcium egazini
question8: Uyini umsebenzi oyinhloko we-aldosterone ye-mineralocorticoid?
answer8: Kwandisa ukumuncwa kabusha kwe-sodium namanzi yizinso, kuphakamisa umfutho wegazi kanye nomthamo wegazi
question9: Yisiphi isimo esibangelwa ukukhiqizwa ngokweqile kwama-glucocorticoids?
question10: Yiziphi izimpawu ezibonisa isifo i-Addisons?
answer10: Ukuncipha kwesikhumba, i-hypoglycemia, kanye namazinga aphansi e-electrolyte egazini
distractor10a: Ukukhuluphala, ushukela wegazi ophakeme, kanye nokuqongelela kwamafutha ebusweni nasentanyeni

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 28. Uhlelo Lwe-Endocrine | 28.4 Ukulawulwa Kokukhiqizwa Kwama-hormone | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 28. Uhlelo Lwe-Endocrine | 28.4 Ukulawulwa Kokukhiqizwa Kwama-hormone | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent:
Ukukhiqizwa nokukhululwa kwama-hormone kuvame ukulawulwa impendulo engemihle noma impendulo enhle, yize ukulawulwa impendulo engemihle kuvame kakhulu. Empendulweni engemihle, isikhuthazo sivusa ukukhululwa kwe-hormone ekhiqiza impendulo, futhi uma impendulo ifinyelela ezingeni elithile, ithumela isignali evimba ukukhululwa okwengeziwe kwe-hormone. Ngale ndlela, ukuhlushwa kwama-hormone egazini kugcinwa ngaphakathi kobubanzi obuncane. Isibonelo, i-anterior pituitary ivuselela i-thyroid gland ukuthi ikhiphe ama-hormone e-thyroid T3 kanye ne-T4. Amazinga akhuphukile ala ma-hormone abangela impendulo ku-hypothalamus kanye ne-anterior pituitary ukuze kuvinjelwe ukudluliselwa okwengeziwe kwe-thyroid gland.

 Amanye ama-hormone alawulwa impendulo enhle lapho impendulo ikhuliswa khona; isibonelo sokulawulwa kwama-hormone ngempendulo enhle ukukhiqizwa kwe-oxytocin ngesikhathi sokubeletha kanye nokubeletha njengoba ukufinyela kwesibeletho kubangela ukukhiqizwa nokukhululwa kwe-oxytocin eningi. Ukuphazamiseka ezindleleni zokuphendula kuvame ukuba nemiphumela emibi, njengesifo sikashukela esibangela ukwehla kokukhiqizwa kwe-insulin.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyiswe esigabeni imiqondo yokusekela echazwe ku-Big Idea 2 ye-AP® Biology Curriculum Framework. Izinhloso Zokufunda ze-AP® ezibalwe kuHlaka Lwezifundo zinikeza isisekelo esicacile sesifundo se-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekubuzeni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo neyodwa noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa.

 Umqondo Omkhulu 2
Izinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo zisebenzisa amandla amahhala kanye namabhlogo okwakha ama-molecule ukuze zikhule, zizale, futhi zilondoloze i-homeostasis eguquguqukayo.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 2.C
Izinto eziphilayo zisebenzisa izindlela zokuphendula ukulawula ukukhula nokuzala, kanye nokugcina i-homeostasis eguquguqukayo.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
2.C.1 Izinto eziphilayo zisebenzisa izindlela zokuphendula ukuze zilondoloze izindawo zazo zangaphakathi futhi ziphendule ezinguqukweni zemvelo zangaphandle.

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
6.1 Umfundi angathethelela izimangalo ngobufakazi.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
2.15 Umfundi angathethelela isimangalo esenziwe mayelana nomthelela (imiphumela) ohlelweni lwezinto eziphilayo ezingeni lama-molecule, lezinto eziphilayo noma lezinto eziphilayo uma enikezwe isimo lapho ingxenye eyodwa noma ngaphezulu ngaphakathi kohlelo lokulawula olubi ishintshwa khona.

 Ukukhiqizwa nokukhululwa kwama-hormone kulawulwa kakhulu yimpendulo engemihle. Ezinhlelweni zempendulo engemihle, isikhuthazo sibangela ukukhululwa kwento ethile; uma into ifinyelela ezingeni elithile, ithumela isignali evimba ukukhululwa okwengeziwe kwento ethile. Ngale ndlela, ukuhlushwa kwama-hormone egazini kugcinwa ngaphakathi kobubanzi obuncane. Isibonelo, i-anterior pituitary inika i-thyroid isibonakaliso ukuthi ikhiphe ama-hormone e-thyroid. Amazinga akhulayo ala ma-hormone egazini abe esenikeza impendulo ku-hypothalamus kanye ne-anterior pituitary ukuze kuvinjelwe ukudluliselwa okwengeziwe kwe-thyroid gland, njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 28.14. Kunezindlela ezintathu lapho ama-endocrine glands akhuthazwa khona ukukhiqiza nokukhulula ama-hormone: izikhuthazo ezihlekisayo, izikhuthazo zama-hormone, kanye nezikhuthazo ze-neural

chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 28. Uhlelo Lwe-Endocrine | 28.4 Ukulawulwa Kokukhiqizwa Kwama-Hormone | Ukushukumisa Okuhlekisayo
chapterContent: Igama elithi "humoral"lisuselwa egameni elithi "humor,"elibhekisela oketshezini lomzimba njengegazi. Isikhuthazo se-humoral sibhekisela ekulawulweni kokukhishwa kwama-hormone ngenxa yezinguquko oketshezini olungaphandle kwegazi njengegazi noma ukuhlushwa kwama-ion egazini. Isibonelo, ukwenyuka kwamazinga kashukela egazini kubangela ukukhishwa kwe-insulin yi-pancreatic. I-insulin ibangela amazinga kashukela egazini ukuthi ehle, okubonisa ukuthi i-pancreas iyeke ukukhiqiza i-insulin ngendlela engemihle.
answer1: Uketshezi lomzimba olufana negazi
question2: Kuyini isikhuthazo se-humoral?
answer2: Ukulawulwa kokukhishwa kwama-hormone ngenxa yezinguquko eziketshezini ezingaphandle kwegazi njengegazi
distractor2a: Ukulawulwa kokukhishwa kwama-hormone ngemizwa yezinzwa kuphela
distractor2c: Ukukhiqizwa kwama-hormone ngenxa yokuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo
question3: Yiluphi ushintsho egazini olukhuthaza ukukhishwa kwe-insulin kusuka kuma-pancreas?

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 28. Uhlelo Lwe-Endocrine | 28.4 Ukulawulwa Kokukhiqizwa Kwama-Hormonal | Ukuvuselelwa Kwama-Hormonal
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 28. Uhlelo Lwe-Endocrine | 28.4 Ukulawulwa Kokukhiqizwa Kwama-Hormonal | Ukuvuselelwa Kwama-Hormonal
chapterContent: Izisusa zamahomoni zibhekisela ekukhishweni kwehomoni ngenxa yelinye ihomoni. Izindlala eziningana ze-endocrine zikhipha amahomoni lapho zivuselelwa amahomoni akhishwa ezinye izindlala ze-endocrine. Isibonelo, i-hypothalamus ikhiqiza amahomoni avuselela ingxenye engaphambili ye-pituitary gland. I-anterior pituitary yona ikhipha amahomoni alawula ukukhiqizwa kwamahomoni ngezinye izindlala ze-endocrine. I-anterior pituitary ikhipha ihomoni evuselela i-thyroid, bese ivuselela i-thyroid gland ukuthi ikhiqize amahomoni i-T3 ne-T4. Njengoba amazinga egazi e-T3 ne-T4 enyuka, avimbela i-pituitary kanye ne-hypothalamus ku-negative feedback loop.
answer1: Ukukhululwa kwe-hormone ngenxa yesinye i-hormone
distractor1a: Ukukhishwa kwe-hormone ngenxa yezinguquko kushukela egazini
distractor1c: Ukukhishwa kwehomoni ngenxa yezinguquko ekushiseni komzimba

question3: Iyini indima ye-anterior pituitary gland ezicini ze-hormone?
answer3: Ikhipha ama-hormone alawula ukukhiqizwa kwama-hormone ngamanye ama-endocrine glands

distractor6c: Zivimbela ngqo indlala yegilo ngaphandle kokuthinta i-hypothalamus noma i-pituitary

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 28. Uhlelo Lwe-Endocrine | 28.4 Ukulawulwa Kokukhiqizwa Kwama-Hormone | I-Neural Stimuli
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 28. Uhlelo Lwe-Endocrine | 28.4 Ukulawulwa Kokukhiqizwa Kwama-Hormone | I-Neural Stimuli
chapterContent: Kwezinye izimo, uhlelo lwezinzwa luvuselela ngqo izindlala ze-endocrine ukuze zikhiphe ama-hormone, okubizwa ngokuthi izisusa ze-neural. Khumbula ukuthi empendulweni yokucindezeleka yesikhashana, ama-hormone i-epinephrine ne-norepinephrine abalulekile ekuhlinzekeni ukuqhuma kwamandla adingekayo ukuze umzimba uphendule. Lapha, ukuhanjiswa kwe-neuronal okuvela ohlelweni lwezinzwa oluzwelayo kuvuselela ngqo i-adrenal medulla ukuze kukhishwe ama-hormone i-epinephrine ne-norepinephrine ekuphenduleni ukucindezeleka.
answer1: Ukukhuthazwa okuqondile kwendlala ye-endocrine yisimiso sezinzwa ukuze kukhishwe ama-hormone
distractor1a: Ukukhishwa kwama-hormone ngenxa yezinguquko kumakhemikhali egazi
question2: Yimaphi ama-hormone akhishwa ngenxa yokuvuselelwa kwemizwa ngesikhathi sokucindezeleka kwesikhashana?
question3: Yikuphi ukuhlukaniswa kwesimiso sezinzwa okuvuselela ngqo i-adrenal medulla ngesikhathi sokuphendula kokucindezeleka kwesikhashana?
question4: Yimuphi umgudu we-endocrine ovuselelwa ngqo uhlelo lwezinzwa oluzwelanayo ngesikhathi sokuvuselelwa kwezinzwa?
question5: Iyini injongo eyinhloko yokukhipha i-epinephrine ne-norepinephrine ngesikhathi sokucindezeleka?
answer5: Ukunikeza amandla asheshayo alungiselela umzimba impendulo yokulwa noma yokubaleka

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 28. Uhlelo Lwe-Endocrine | 28.5 Izindlala Ze-Endocrine | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 28. Uhlelo Lwe-Endocrine | 28.5 Izindlala Ze-Endocrine | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent:
Ulwazi oluthile kulesi sigaba lungaphandle kwemingcele ye-AP®. Akudingeki ukuthi ubambe ngekhanda uhlu lwezindlala ze-endocrine, izindawo zazo emzimbeni, kanye nama-hormone azikhiqizayo. Kodwa-ke, ungase ufune ukugxila esibonelweni esisodwa noma ezimbili bese ucabanga ngendlela izindlala ze-endocrine kanye nemikhiqizo yazo yama-hormone ezisebenzisana ngayo kanye nesistimu yezinzwa ukuxhumana nokulawula i-physiology yomzimba ukuze kugcinwe i-homeostasis. Isibonelo, i-hypothalamus ezinhlotsheni zezilwane ezinomgogodla ihlanganisa i-endocrine kanye nezinhlelo zezinzwa. I-hypothalamus itholakala ebuchosheni futhi ithola uvo oluvela emzimbeni nakwezinye izindawo zobuchopho futhi iqala izimpendulo ze-endocrine ezinguqukweni zemvelo. I-pituitary gland inamathele kwi-hypothalamus futhi ithola imikhiqizo evela kwi-hypothalamus, okubangela, futhi, ukukhishwa kwama-hormone e-pituitary angaphambili nangemuva njenge-growth hormone (GH), i-follicle-stimulating hormone (FSH), i-luteinizing hormone (LH), kanye ne-oxytocin. I-thyroid gland, etholakala entanyeni ngaphansi nje kwe-larynx, ikhipha i-T3 kanye ne-T4 ngenxa ye-thyroid stimulating hormone (TSH) ekhiqizwa yi-anterior pituitary. Esinye isibonelo ukuthi ukukhula kwexoxo kuphazamiseka kanjani yi-estrogen emanzini angcolile, ongafunda kabanzi ngakho kuwebhusayithi yeSayensi News.

 Zombili izinhlelo ze-endocrine kanye nezezinzwa zisebenzisa izimpawu zamakhemikhali ukuxhumana nokulawula i-physiology yomzimba. Uhlelo lwe-endocrine lukhipha ama-hormone asebenza kumaseli aqondiwe ukulawula intuthuko, ukukhula, amandla okusebenza kwe-metabolism, ukuzala, kanye nokuziphatha okuningi. Uhlelo lwezinzwa lukhipha ama-neurotransmitter noma ama-neurohormone alawula ama-neurons, amaseli emisipha, kanye namaseli e-endocrine. Ngenxa yokuthi ama-neurons angalawula ukukhishwa kwama-hormone, izinhlelo ze-nervous kanye ne-endocrine zisebenza ngendlela ehlelekile ukulawula i-physiology yomzimba.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 28. Uhlelo Lwe-Endocrine | 28.5 Izindlala Ze-Endocrine | I-Hypothalamic-Pituitary Axis
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 28. Uhlelo Lwe-Endocrine | 28.5 Izindlala Ze-Endocrine | I-Hypothalamic-Pituitary Axis
chapterContent:
I-hypothalamus ezinhlotsheni ezinomgogodla ihlanganisa i-endocrine kanye nezinhlelo zezinzwa. I-hypothalamus iyisitho se-endocrine esitholakala ku-diencephalon yobuchopho. Ithola impendulo evela emzimbeni nakwezinye izindawo zobuchopho futhi iqala izimpendulo ze-endocrine ezinguqukweni zemvelo. I-hypothalamus isebenza njengesitho se-endocrine, ihlanganisa ama-hormone futhi iwathuthe ngama-axons iye endlaleni ye-posterior pituitary. Ihlanganisa futhi ikhiphe ama-hormone alawulayo alawula amaseli e-endocrine endlaleni ye-anterior pituitary. I-hypothalamus iqukethe izikhungo ezizimele ezilawula amaseli e-endocrine e-adrenal medulla ngokulawula kwe-neuronal.

 I-pituitary gland, ngezinye izikhathi ebizwa ngokuthi i-hypophysis noma i-master gland” itholakala phansi kobuchopho ku-sella turcica, umsele wethambo le-sphenoid lekhanda, okuboniswe ku-Figure 28.15. Inamathele kwi-hypothalamus ngesiqu esibizwa ngokuthi isiqu se-pituitary (noma i-infundibulum). Ingxenye engaphambili ye-pituitary gland ilawulwa ngokukhulula noma ukukhulula ama-hormone akhiqizwa yi-hypothalamus, kanti i-posterior pituitary ithola izimpawu ngamaseli e-neurosecretory ukuze ikhulule ama-hormone akhiqizwa yi-hypothalamus. I-pituitary inezindawo ezimbili ezihlukene—i-anterior pituitary kanye ne-posterior pituitary—ezikhipha phakathi kwazo ama-peptide noma ama-protein hormone ayisishiyagalolunye ahlukene. I-posterior lobe ye-pituitary gland iqukethe ama-axons ama-neuron e-hypothalamic.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 28. Uhlelo Lwe-Endocrine | 28.5 Izindlala Ze-Endocrine | I-Hypothalamic-Pituitary Axis | I-Anterior Pituitary
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 28. Uhlelo Lwe-Endocrine | 28.5 Izindlala Ze-Endocrine | I-Hypothalamic-Pituitary Axis | I-Anterior Pituitary
chapterContent:
I-anterior pituitary gland, noma i-adenohypophysis, izungezwe inethiwekhi ye-capillary esukela ku-hypothalamus, yehle nge-infundibulum, kanye ne-anterior pituitary. Le nethiwekhi ye-capillary iyingxenye yesistimu ye-hypophyseal portal ethwala izinto ezivela ku-hypothalamus ziye ku-anterior pituitary kanye nama-hormone avela ku-anterior pituitary aye ohlelweni lokujikeleza kwegazi. Uhlelo lwe-portal luthwala igazi kusuka kunethiwekhi eyodwa ye-capillary ukuya kwenye; ngakho-ke, uhlelo lwe-hypophyseal portal luvumela ama-hormone akhiqizwa yi-hypothalamus ukuthi athwalwe ngqo ku-anterior pituitary ngaphandle kokungena kuqala ohlelweni lokujikeleza kwegazi.

 I-anterior pituitary ikhiqiza ama-hormone ayisikhombisa: i-growth hormone (GH), i-prolactin (PRL), i-thyroid-stimulating hormone (TSH), i-melanin-stimulating hormone (MSH), i-adrenocorticotropic hormone (ACTH), i-follicle-stimulating hormone (FSH), kanye ne-luteinizing hormone (LH). Ama-anterior pituitary ngezinye izikhathi abizwa ngokuthi ama-tropic hormone, ngoba alawula ukusebenza kwezinye izitho. Nakuba la ma-hormone ekhiqizwa yi-anterior pituitary, ukukhiqizwa kwawo kulawulwa ama-hormone alawulayo akhiqizwa yi-hypothalamus. La ma-hormone alawulayo angaba ukukhulula ama-hormone noma ukuvimbela ama-hormone, okubangela ukuthi kukhishwe ama-hormone amaningi noma amancane e-anterior pituitary. Lawa ahamba esuka ku-hypothalamus ngesistimu ye-hypophyseal portal aye ku-anterior pituitary lapho enza khona umphumela wawo. Impendulo engemihle ibe isilawula ukuthi kukhishwa mangakanani lawa ma-hormone alawulayo nokuthi kukhishwe i-hormone engakanani ye-anterior pituitary.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 28. Uhlelo Lwe-Endocrine | 28.5 Izindlala Ze-Endocrine | I-Hypothalamic-Pituitary Axis | I-Posterior Pituitary
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 28. Uhlelo Lwe-Endocrine | 28.5 Izindlala Ze-Endocrine | I-Hypothalamic-Pituitary Axis | I-Posterior Pituitary
chapterContent:
I-posterior pituitary ihluke kakhulu ngesakhiwo sayo kune-anterior pituitary. Iyingxenye yobuchopho, esukela phansi kwi-hypothalamus, futhi iqukethe kakhulu imicu yezinzwa namaseli e-neuroglial, asekela ama-axon asukela kwi-hypothalamus aye kwi-posterior pituitary. I-posterior pituitary kanye ne-infundibulum ndawonye kubizwa ngokuthi i-neurohypophysis.

 Ama-hormone i-antidiuretic hormone (ADH), eyaziwa nangokuthi i-vasopressin, kanye ne-oxytocin akhiqizwa ama-neurons ku-hypothalamus futhi athuthwa ngaphakathi kwala ma-axons nge-infundibulum aye kwi-posterior pituitary. Akhishwa ohlelweni lokujikeleza kwegazi nge-neural signaling evela kwi-hypothalamus. Lawa ma-hormone abhekwa njengama-posterior pituitary hormone, yize ekhiqizwa yi-hypothalamus, ngoba yilapho akhishwa khona ohlelweni lokujikeleza kwegazi. I-posterior pituitary ngokwayo ayikhiqizi ama-hormone, kodwa kunalokho igcina ama-hormone akhiqizwa yi-hypothalamus futhi iwakhiphe egazini.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 28. Uhlelo Lwe-Endocrine | 28.5 Izindlala Ze-Endocrine | Indlala Ye-Thyroid
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 28. Uhlelo Lwe-Endocrine | 28.5 Izindlala Ze-Endocrine | Indlala Ye-Thyroid
chapterContent:
Indlala yegilo itholakala entanyeni, ngaphansi nje kwelarynx naphambi kwe-trachea, njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 28.16. Iyindlala efana novemvane enama-lobe amabili axhunywe yi-isthmus. Inombala obomvu omnyama ngenxa yesistimu yayo ebanzi yemithambo yegazi. Lapho indlala yegilo ivuvukala ngenxa yokungasebenzi kahle, ingazwakala ngaphansi kwesikhumba sentamo.

 Indlala yegilo yakhiwe ngama-follicle amaningi e-thyroid ayindilinga, agcwele i-epithelium elula ye-cuboidal. La ma-follicle aqukethe uketshezi oluqinile, olubizwa ngokuthi i-colloid, olugcina i-glycoprotein thyroglobulin, eyandulela ama-hormone egilo. Ama-follicle akhiqiza ama-hormone angagcinwa ku-colloid noma akhishwe kunethiwekhi ye-capillary ezungezile ukuze athuthwe aye kuwo wonke umzimba ngohlelo lokujikeleza kwegazi.

 Amaseli e-thyroid follicle akhiqiza i-hormone i-thyroxine, eyaziwa nangokuthi i-T4 ngoba iqukethe ama-athomu amane e-iodine, kanye ne-triiodothyronine, eyaziwa nangokuthi i-T3 ngoba iqukethe ama-athomu amathathu e-iodine. Amaseli e-follicle akhuthazwa ukukhipha i-T3 ne-T4 egciniwe yi-hormone evuselela i-thyroid (TSH), ekhiqizwa yi-anterior pituitary. Lawa ma-hormone e-thyroid andisa amazinga okukhiqizwa kwe-mitochondrial ATP.

 I-hormone yesithathu, i-calcitonin, ikhiqizwa amaseli e-parafollicular e-thyroid. Ukukhishwa kwe-Calcitonin akulawulwa yi-TSH, kodwa kunalokho kukhishwa lapho amazinga e-calcium ion egazini ekhuphuka. I-Calcitonin isebenza ukusiza ukulawula amazinga e-calcium oketshezini lomzimba. Isebenza emathanjeni ukuvimbela umsebenzi we-osteoclast kanye nasezinso ukukhuthaza ukukhishwa kwe-calcium. Ukuhlanganiswa kwalezi zenzakalo ezimbili kunciphisa amazinga e-calcium oketshezi lomzimba.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 28. Uhlelo Lwe-Endocrine | 28.5 Izindlala Ze-Endocrine | Izindlala Ze-Parathyroid
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 28. Uhlelo Lwe-Endocrine | 28.5 Izindlala Ze-Endocrine | Izindlala Ze-Parathyroid
chapterContent:
Iningi labantu linezindlala ezine ze-parathyroid; nokho, inani lingahluka kusuka kwezimbili kuya kweziyisithupha. Lezi zindlala zitholakala ebusweni obungemuva bendlala ye-thyroid, njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 28.17. Ngokuvamile, kukhona indlala ephakeme kanye nendlala engaphansi ehlotshaniswa ne-lobes ezimbili ze-thyroid ngayinye. Indlala ngayinye ye-parathyroid imbozwe izicubu ezixhumene futhi iqukethe amaseli amaningi akhipha uketshezi ahlotshaniswa nenethiwekhi ye-capillary.

 Izindlala ze-parathyroid zikhiqiza i-parathyroid hormone (PTH). I-PTH inyusa amazinga e-calcium egazini lapho amazinga e-calcium ion ehla ngaphansi kokujwayelekile. I-PTH (1) ithuthukisa ukumuncwa kabusha kwe-Ca2+ yizinso, (2) ivuselela umsebenzi we-osteoclast futhi ivimbela umsebenzi we-osteoblast, kanye (3) ivuselela ukwenziwa nokukhiqizwa kwe-calcitriol yizinso, okuthuthukisa ukumuncwa kwe-Ca2+ uhlelo lokugaya ukudla. I-PTH ikhiqizwa amaseli amakhulu e-parathyroid. I-PTH kanye ne-calcitonin zisebenza ngokuphambene ukuze zigcine amazinga e-Ca2+ asekhaya oketshezini lomzimba. Olunye uhlobo lwamaseli, amaseli e-oxyphil, akhona ku-parathyroid kodwa umsebenzi wawo awaziwa. Lawa ma-hormone akhuthaza ukukhula kwamathambo, imisipha, kanye nokwakheka kwamaseli egazi ezinganeni nakwabesifazane.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 28. Uhlelo Lwe-Endocrine | 28.5 Izindlala Ze-Endocrine | Izindlala Ze-Adrenal | I-Adrenal Cortex
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 28. Uhlelo Lwe-Endocrine | 28.5 Izindlala Ze-Endocrine | Izindlala Ze-Adrenal | I-Adrenal Cortex
chapterContent:
I-adrenal cortex yakhiwe ngezingqimba zamaseli e-epithelial kanye namanethiwekhi e-capillary ahlobene. Lezi zingqimba zakha izifunda ezintathu ezihlukene: i-zona glomerulosa yangaphandle ekhiqiza i-mineralocorticoids, i-zona fasciculata ephakathi ekhiqiza i-glucocorticoids, kanye ne-zona reticularis yangaphakathi ekhiqiza ama-androgens.

 I-mineralocorticoid eyinhloko yi-aldosterone, elawula ukuhlushwa kwama-ion e-Na+ kumchamo, ekujulukeni, kuma-pancreas, nasematheni. Ukukhululwa kwe-aldosterone kusuka ku-adrenal cortex kukhuthazwa ukwehla kokuhlushwa kwegazi kwama-ion e-sodium, umthamo wegazi, noma umfutho wegazi, noma ngokwanda kwamazinga e-potassium egazini.

 Ama-glucocorticoids amathathu amakhulu yi-cortisol, i-corticosterone, kanye ne-cortisone. Ama-glucocorticoids akhuthaza ukwenziwa kwe-glucose kanye ne-gluconeogenesis (ukuguqula okungeyona i-carbohydrate ibe yi-glucose) ngamaseli esibindi futhi akhuthaza ukukhishwa kwama-fatty acids kusuka ezicutshini zamafutha. Lawa ma-hormone andisa amazinga kashukela egazini ukuze agcine amazinga ngaphakathi kwebanga elijwayelekile phakathi kokudla. Lawa ma-hormone akhishwa ngenxa ye-ACTH futhi amazinga alawulwa yimpendulo engemihle.

 Ama-Androgens ama-hormone ocansi akhuthaza ubudoda. Akhiqizwa ngamanani amancane yi-adrenal cortex kokubili kwabesilisa nabesifazane. Awathinti izici zobulili futhi anganezela ama-hormone ocansi akhishwa kuma-gonads

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 28. Uhlelo Lwe-Endocrine | 28.5 Izindlala Ze-Endocrine | Izindlala Ze-Adrenal | I-Adrenal Medulla
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 28. Uhlelo Lwe-Endocrine | 28.5 Izindlala Ze-Endocrine | Izindlala Ze-Adrenal | I-Adrenal Medulla
chapterContent:
I-adrenal medulla iqukethe amaseli amakhulu, angamile ngendlela engavamile ahlotshaniswa eduze nemithambo yegazi. Lawa maseli agcinwa yi-preganglionic autonomic nerve fibers evela ohlelweni lwezinzwa oluphakathi.

 I-adrenal medulla iqukethe izinhlobo ezimbili zamaseli akhipha i-secretory: eyodwa ekhiqiza i-epinephrine (i-adrenaline) kanye nenye ekhiqiza i-norepinephrine (i-noradrenaline). I-Epinephrine iyi-hormone eyinhloko ye-adrenal medulla ebangela amaphesenti angama-75 kuya kwangu-80 okuphuma kwayo. I-Epinephrine ne-norepinephrine zandisa ukushaya kwenhliziyo, ukuphefumula, ukufinyela kwemisipha yenhliziyo, umfutho wegazi, kanye namazinga kashukela egazini. Ziphinde zisheshise ukuwohloka kwe-glucose emisipheni yamathambo namafutha agcinwe ezicutshini zamafutha.

 Ukukhishwa kwe-epinephrine ne-norepinephrine kukhuthazwa yizinzwa ezivela ohlelweni lwezinzwa oluhambisana ne-sympathetic. Ukukhishwa kwala ma-hormone kukhuthazwa ukukhululwa kwe-acetylcholine kusuka ku-preganglionic sympathetic fibers egcina i-adrenal medulla. Lawa ma-neural impulses avela ku-hypothalamus ekuphenduleni ukucindezeleka ukuze kulungiselelwe umzimba impendulo yokulwa noma yokubaleka.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 28. Uhlelo Lwe-Endocrine | 28.5 Izindlala Ze-Endocrine | I-Pancreas
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 28. Uhlelo Lwe-Endocrine | 28.5 Izindlala Ze-Endocrine | I-Pancreas
chapterContent:
I-pancreas, eboniswe kuMfanekiso 28.19, iyisitho eside esitholakala phakathi kwesisu nengxenye eseduze yamathumbu amancane. Iqukethe womabili amangqamuzana e-exocrine akhipha ama-enzyme okugaya ukudla kanye namaseli e-endocrine akhipha ama-hormone. Ngezinye izikhathi ibizwa ngokuthi i-heterocrine gland ngoba inemisebenzi ye-endocrine kanye ne-exocrine.

 Amangqamuzana e-endocrine e-pancreas akha amaqoqo abizwa ngokuthi ama-pancreas islets noma ama-islets aseLangerhans, njengoba kubonakala ku-micrograph eboniswe kuMfanekiso 28.20. Ama-islets e-pancreatic aqukethe izinhlobo ezimbili eziyinhloko zamaseli: amangqamuzana e-alpha, akhiqiza i-hormone glucagon, kanye namaseli e-beta, akhiqiza i-hormone insulin. Lawa ma-hormone alawula amazinga e-glucose egazini. Njengoba amazinga e-glucose egazini ehla, amangqamuzana e-alpha akhipha i-glucagon ukuze aphakamise amazinga e-glucose egazini ngokwandisa amazinga okuqhekeka kwe-glycogen kanye nokukhishwa kwe-glucose yisibindi. Lapho amazinga e-glucose egazini ekhuphuka, njengangemva kokudla, amangqamuzana e-beta akhipha i-insulin ukuze ehlise amazinga e-glucose egazini ngokwandisa izinga lokuthathwa kwe-glucose emaseli amaningi omzimba, nangokwandisa ukwakheka kwe-glycogen emisipheni yamathambo nesibindi. Ngokubambisana, i-glucagon ne-insulin kulawula amazinga kashukela egazini

distractor1b: Ngoba igcina ama-hormone enziwa ezinye izindlala
distractor1c: Ngoba isebenza kuphela ngesikhathi sokugaya ukudla

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 28. Uhlelo Lwe-Endocrine | 28.5 Izindlala Ze-Endocrine | I-Pineal Gland
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 28. Uhlelo Lwe-Endocrine | 28.5 Izindlala Ze-Endocrine | I-Pineal Gland
chapterContent: I-pineal gland ikhiqiza i-melatonin. Izinga lokukhiqizwa kwe-melatonin lithintwa yi-photoperiod. Ama-collateral avela ezindleleni ezibonakalayo agcina i-pineal gland. Ngesikhathi se-photoperiod yasemini, kukhiqizwa i-melatonin encane; noma kunjalo, ukukhiqizwa kwe-melatonin kuyanda ngesikhathi se-photoperiod emnyama (ebusuku). Kwezinye izilwane ezincelisayo, i-melatonin inomphumela wokuvimbela emisebenzini yokuzala ngokunciphisa ukukhiqizwa nokuvuthwa kwesidoda, ama-oocyte, nezitho zokuzala. I-Melatonin iyi-antioxidant esebenzayo, evikela i-CNS kuma-free radicals njenge-nitric oxide ne-hydrogen peroxide. Okokugcina, i-melatonin ihilelekile ezilinganisweni zezinto eziphilayo, ikakhulukazi ezilinganisweni ze-circadian njengomjikelezo wokulala nokuvuka kanye nemikhuba yokudla.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 28. Uhlelo Lwe-Endocrine | 28.5 Izindlala Ze-Endocrine | Izitho Ezinemisebenzi Yesibili Ye-Endocrine
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 28. Uhlelo Lwe-Endocrine | 28.5 Izindlala Ze-Endocrine | Izitho Ezinemisebenzi Yesibili Ye-Endocrine
chapterContent:
Kunezitho eziningana zomzimba ezinemisebenzi yazo eyinhloko engeyona eye-endocrine kodwa futhi ezinemisebenzi ye-endocrine. Lokhu kufaka phakathi inhliziyo, izinso, amathumbu, i-thymus, i-gonads, kanye nezicubu zamafutha.

 Inhliziyo inamaseli e-endocrine ezindongeni ze-atria angamaseli emisipha yenhliziyo akhethekile. Lawa maseli akhipha i-hormone i-atrial natriuretic peptide (ANP) ngenxa yokwanda komthamo wegazi. Umthamo wegazi ophezulu ubangela ukuthi amaseli elulwe, okuholela ekukhishweni kwama-hormone. I-ANP isebenza ezinso ukunciphisa ukumuncwa kabusha kwe-Na+, okubangela ukuthi i-Na+ namanzi kukhishwe emchameni. I-ANP iphinde yehlise inani le-renin elikhishwa yizinso kanye ne-aldosterone ekhishwa yi-adrenal cortex, okuvimbela kakhulu ukugcinwa kwamanzi. Ngale ndlela, i-ANP ibangela ukwehla komthamo wegazi kanye nomfutho wegazi, futhi yehlisa ukuhlushwa kwe-Na+ egazini.

 Umgudu wokugaya ukudla ukhiqiza ama-hormone amaningana asiza ekugayweni kokudla. Amaseli e-endocrine atholakala ku-mucosa yendlela ye-GI esiswini namathumbu amancane. Amanye ama-hormone akhiqizwayo afaka phakathi i-gastrin, i-secretin, ne-cholecystokinin, akhishwa lapho kukhona ukudla, kanti amanye awo asebenza kwezinye izitho ezifana ne-pancreas, i-gallbladder, nesibindi. Aqala ukukhishwa kwamajusi esiswini, okusiza ukuphula nokugaya ukudla emgudwini we-GI.

 Ngenkathi izindlala ze-adrenal ezihlotshaniswa nezinso ziyizindlala ezinkulu ze-endocrine, izinso ngokwazo zinomsebenzi we-endocrine. I-Renin ikhishwa ngenxa yokwehla kwevolumu yegazi noma ingcindezi futhi iyingxenye yesistimu ye-renin-angiotensin-aldosterone eholela ekukhishweni kwe-aldosterone. I-Aldosterone ibe isibangela ukugcinwa kwe-Na+ namanzi, ikhuphule ivolumu yegazi. Izinso zikhipha ne-calcitriol, esiza ekumuncweni kwama-ion e-Ca2+ nama-phosphate. I-Erythropoietin (EPO) iyi-hormone yephrotheni ebangela ukwakheka kwamaseli abomvu egazi emnkantsheni wethambo. I-EPO ikhishwa ngenxa yamazinga aphansi e-oxygen. Ngenxa yokuthi amaseli abomvu egazi angabathwali be-oxygen, ukukhiqizwa okwandisiwe kuphumela ekulethweni okukhulu kwe-oxygen kuwo wonke umzimba. I-EPO isetshenziswe abadlali ukuthuthukisa ukusebenza, njengoba ukulethwa okukhulu komoya-mpilo emaseli emisipha kuvumela ukukhuthazela okukhulu. Ngenxa yokuthi amangqamuzana abomvu egazi andisa ukujiya kwegazi, amazinga aphezulu e-EPO angabangela izingozi ezinkulu zempilo.

 I-thymus itholakala ngemuva kwe-sternum; ivame kakhulu ezinganeni, iba ncane ngobukhulu kuze kube yilapho umuntu esekhulile. I-thymus ikhiqiza ama-hormone abizwa ngokuthi ama-thymosins, afaka isandla ekuthuthukisweni kwempendulo yomzimba.

 Izicubu zamafutha ziyizicubu ezixhumanisayo ezitholakala kuwo wonke umzimba. Ikhiqiza i-hormone i-leptin ngokuphendula ukudla. I-Leptin yandisa umsebenzi wama-neuron anorexigenic futhi yehlisa lowo wama-neuron orexigenic, ikhiqiza umuzwa wokusutha ngemva kokudla, ngaleyo ndlela ithinta isifiso sokudla futhi inciphise isifiso sokudla okwengeziwe. I-Leptin ihlotshaniswa nokuzala. Kumele ibe khona ukuze ukwakheka kwe-GnRH ne-gonadotropin kwenzeke. Abesifazane abancane kakhulu bangangena ebusheni sekwephuzile; noma kunjalo, uma amazinga e-adipose enyuka, kuzokhiqizwa i-leptin eningi, kuthuthukiswe ukuzala.

chapterContent:
28.1 Izinhlobo Zama-hormone
Kunezinhlobo ezintathu eziyisisekelo zama-hormone: atholakala ku-lipid, atholakala ku-amino acid, kanye ne-peptide. Ama-hormone atholakala ku-lipid afana ne-cholesterol ngokwesakhiwo futhi afaka ama-hormone e-steroid njenge-estradiol kanye ne-testosterone. Ama-hormone atholakala ku-amino acid angama-molecule amancane futhi afaka ama-hormone e-adrenal i-epinephrine kanye ne-norepinephrine. Ama-hormone e-Peptide angamaketanga noma amaprotheni e-polypeptide futhi afaka ama-hormone e-pituitary, i-hormone ye-antidiuretic (i-vasopressin), kanye ne-oxytocin.

 28.2 Indlela Ama-hormone Asebenza Ngayo
Ama-hormone abangela izinguquko zamaseli ngokubopha kuma-receptor kumaseli aqondiwe. Inani lama-receptor kuseli eliqondiwe linganda noma lehle ekuphenduleni umsebenzi wama-hormone. Ama-hormone angathinta amaseli ngqo ngama-receptor ama-hormone angaphakathi kweseli noma ngokungaqondile ngama-receptor ama-hormone e-plasma membrane.

 Ama-hormone atholakala ku-lipid (ancibilikayo) angangena esitokisini ngokusabalala kulo lonke ulwelwesi lwe-plasma futhi abophane ne-DNA ukulawula ukubhalwa kwezakhi zofuzo nokushintsha imisebenzi yeseli ngokubangela ukukhiqizwa kwamaprotheni athinta, ngokuvamile, isakhiwo kanye nomsebenzi wesikhathi eside weseli. Ama-hormone angancibiliki ku-lipid abopha kuma-receptor ebusweni belwelwesi lwe-plasma futhi aqalise indlela yokubonisa ukushintsha imisebenzi yeseli ngokubangela ukukhiqizwa kwemikhiqizo ehlukahlukene yeseli ethinta iseli esikhathini esifushane. I-hormone ibizwa ngokuthi isithunywa sokuqala kanti ingxenye yeseli ibizwa ngokuthi isithunywa sesibili. Ama-G-protein avuselela isithunywa sesibili (i-cyclic AMP), okubangela impendulo yeseli. Impendulo ekubopheni kwama-hormone iyandiswa njengoba indlela yokubonisa iqhubeka. Izimpendulo zeseli kuma-hormone zifaka phakathi ukukhiqizwa kwamaprotheni nama-enzyme kanye nokuguqulwa kokungena kwelwelwesi.

 28.3 Ukulawulwa Kwezinqubo Zomzimba
Amazinga amanzi emzimbeni alawulwa yi-antidiuretic hormone (ADH), ekhiqizwa ku-hypothalamus futhi ibangele ukumuncwa kabusha kwamanzi yizinso. Ukukhiqizwa okunganele kwe-ADH kungabangela isifo sikashukela i-insipidus. I-Aldosterone, i-hormone ekhiqizwa yi-adrenal cortex yezinso, ithuthukisa ukumuncwa kwe-Na+ kusuka kuketshezi olungaphandle kweseli kanye nokumuncwa kwamanzi okulandelayo ngokusabalala. Uhlelo lwe-renin-angiotensin-aldosterone luyindlela eyodwa yokulawulwa kokukhishwa kwe-aldosterone.

 Uhlelo lokuzala lulawulwa yi-gonadotropins follicle-stimulating hormone (FSH) kanye ne-luteinizing hormone (LH), ezikhiqizwa yi-pituitary gland. Ukukhishwa kwe-gonadotropin kulawulwa yi-hypothalamic hormone i-gonadotropin-releasing hormone (GnRH). I-FSH ivuselela ukuvuthwa kwamaseli esidoda kwabesilisa futhi ivinjelwa yi-hormone i-inhibin, kuyilapho i-LH ivuselela ukukhiqizwa kwe-androgen testosterone. I-FSH ivuselela ukuvuthwa kwamaqanda kwabesifazane, kuyilapho i-LH ivuselela ukukhiqizwa kwama-estrogens kanye ne-progesterone. Ama-estrogens ayiqembu lama-hormone e-steroid akhiqizwa ama-ovary aqala ukuthuthukiswa kwezici zobulili zesibili kwabesifazane kanye nokulawula ukuvuthwa kwe-ovary. Kwabesifazane, i-pituitary ikhiqiza ne-prolactin, ekhuthaza ukukhiqizwa kobisi ngemva kokubeletha, kanye ne-oxytocin, ekhuthaza ukufinyela kwesibeletho ngesikhathi sokubeletha kanye nokwehlisa ubisi ngesikhathi sokuncelisa.

 I-insulin ikhiqizwa yi-pancreas ngenxa yokwenyuka kwamazinga kashukela egazini futhi ivumela amaseli ukuthi asebenzise ushukela wegazi futhi agcine ushukela omningi ukuze asetshenziswe kamuva. Isifo sikashukela sibangelwa umsebenzi ophansi we-insulin futhi sibangela amazinga aphezulu kashukela egazini, noma i-hyperglycemia. I-Glucagon ikhishwa yi-pancreas ngenxa yokwehla kwamazinga kashukela egazini futhi ikhuthaza ukuqhekeka kwe-glycogen ibe ushukela, ongasetshenziswa ngumzimba. Izinga lomzimba eliyisisekelo le-metabolic lilawulwa yi-hormone ye-thyroid i-thyroxine (T4) kanye ne-triiodothyronine (T3). I-anterior pituitary ikhiqiza i-hormone evuselela i-thyroid (TSH), elawula ukukhishwa kwe-T3 kanye ne-T4 kusuka ku-thyroid gland. I-iodine iyadingeka ekukhiqizweni kwe-hormone ye-thyroid, futhi ukuntuleka kwe-iodine kungaholela esimweni esibizwa ngokuthi i-goiter.

 I-Parathyroid hormone (PTH) ikhiqizwa yi-parathyroid glands ngenxa yokwehla kwamazinga e-Ca2+ egazini. Amaseli e-parafollicular e-thyroid akhiqiza i-calcitonin, ehlisa amazinga e-Ca2+ egazini. I-Growth hormone (GH) ikhiqizwa yi-anterior pituitary futhi ilawula izinga lokukhula kwemisipha namathambo. Isenzo se-GH siqondiswa ngokungaqondile yi-insulin-like growth factors (IGFs). Ukucindezeleka kwesikhathi esifushane kubangela ukuthi i-hypothalamus ivuse i-adrenal medulla ukuze ikhiphe i-epinephrine ne-norepinephrine, okubangela ukulwa noma impendulo yokundiza. Ukucindezeleka kwesikhathi eside kubangela ukuthi i-hypothalamus ivuse i-anterior pituitary ukuze ikhiphe i-adrenocorticotropic hormone (ACTH), okubangela ukukhishwa kwama-corticosteroids, ama-glucocorticoids, kanye nama-mineralocorticoids, kusuka ku-adrenal cortex.

 28.4 Ukulawulwa Kokukhiqizwa Kwama-Hormone
Amazinga ama-hormone alawulwa ngokuyinhloko ngempendulo engemihle, lapho amazinga akhuphukayo e-hormone evimbela ukukhishwa kwayo okuqhubekayo. Izindlela ezintathu zokukhululwa kwama-hormone yi-humoral stimuli, i-hormonal stimuli, kanye ne-neural stimuli. I-humoral stimuli ibhekisela ekulawulweni kokukhululwa kwama-hormone ekuphenduleni izinguquko emazingeni oketshezi olungaphandle kwe-extracellular noma amazinga e-ion. Izisusa zamahomoni zibhekisela ekukhishweni kwamahomoni ekuphenduleni amahomoni akhishwa ezinye izindlala ze-endocrine. Izisusa zemizwa zibhekisela ekukhishweni kwamahomoni ekuphenduleni izisusa zemizwa.

 28.5 Izindlala ze-Endocrine
Indlala ye-pituitary itholakala phansi kobuchopho futhi inamathele kwi-hypothalamus yi-infundibulum. I-anterior pituitary ithola imikhiqizo evela kwi-hypothalamus ngesistimu ye-hypophyseal portal futhi ikhiqiza amahomoni ayisithupha. I-posterior pituitary iyisandiso sobuchopho futhi ikhipha amahomoni (i-antidiuretic hormone kanye ne-oxytocin) akhiqizwa yi-hypothalamus.

 Indlala ye-thyroid itholakala entanyeni futhi yakhiwe ngama-lobes amabili axhunywe yi-isthmus. I-thyroid yakhiwe ngamaseli e-follicle akhiqiza amahomoni i-thyroxine kanye ne-triiodothyronine. Amaseli e-parafollicular e-thyroid akhiqiza i-calcitonin. Izindlala ze-parathyroid zilele ebusweni obungemuva bendlala ye-thyroid futhi zikhiqiza i-parathyroid hormone.

 Izindlala ze-adrenal zitholakala phezu kwezinso futhi zakhiwe yi-renal cortex kanye ne-renal medulla. I-adrenal cortex yingxenye engaphandle ye-adrenal gland futhi ikhiqiza ama-corticosteroids, ama-glucocorticoids, kanye nama-mineralocorticoids. I-adrenal medulla yingxenye engaphakathi ye-adrenal gland futhi ikhiqiza ama-catecholamines i-epinephrine kanye ne-norepinephrine.

 I-pancreas itholakala esiswini phakathi kwesisu namathumbu amancane. Amaqoqo amangqamuzana e-endocrine ku-pancreas akha iziqhingi ze-Langerhans, ezakhiwa amangqamuzana e-alpha akhipha amaseli e-glucagon kanye ne-beta akhipha i-insulin.

 Ezinye izitho zinomsebenzi we-endocrine njengomsebenzi wesibili kodwa zinomsebenzi oyinhloko. Inhliziyo ikhiqiza i-hormone i-atrial natriuretic peptide, esebenza ukunciphisa ivolumu yegazi, ingcindezi, kanye nokuhlushwa kwe-Na+. Indlela yokugaya ukudla ikhiqiza ama-hormone ahlukahlukene asiza ekugayweni kokudla. Izinso zikhiqiza i-renin, i-calcitriol, kanye ne-erythropoietin. Izicubu zamafutha zikhiqiza i-leptin, ekhuthaza izimpawu zokugcwala ebuchosheni

question53: Chaza ukuthi i-insulin igcinwa kuphi nokuthi ikhishwa ngaphansi kwaziphi izimo
answer53: Igcinwa kuma-pancreas futhi ikhishwa njengoba i-glucose ikhuphuka egazini ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinga lokumuncwa kwe-glucose.
distractor53a: Igcinwa esibindini futhi ikhishwa njengoba i-glucose ikhuphuka egazini ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinga lokumuncwa kwe-glucose.
distractor53b: Igcinwa kuma-pancreas futhi ikhishwa njengoba amazinga kashukela egazini ehla ukuze kwehliswe izinga lokuthathwa kweglucose.
distractor53c: Igcinwa esibindini futhi ikhishwa njengoba amazinga kashukela egazini ehla ukuze kwehliswe izinga lokuthathwa kweglucose.
question54: URalph uhlala enxanelwe futhi muva nje ufunde ukuthi ukhiqiza i-hormone ye-antidiuretic eguquliwe (i-ADH). Sebenzisa ukuqonda kwakho indima ye-ADH ukuchaza ukuthi kungani uRalph engaba sengozini enkulu yokuthola isifo sikashukela insipidus.
answer54: I-ADH isiza ukugcina amanzi. Ukukhiqizwa okunganele kwe-ADH kungabangela ukusebenza kabi kwezinso
distractor54a: I-ADH iyasiza ekulahlekelweni kwamanzi. Ukukhiqizwa ngokweqile kwe-ADH kungabangela ukusebenza kabi kwezinso
distractor54b: Ukukhiqizwa okunganele kwe-ADH kuvimbela ukukhishwa kwe-aldosterone okungabangela ukusebenza kabi kwezinso
distractor54c: I-ADH iyasiza ekugcineni ama-electrolyte. Ukukhiqizwa okunganele kwe-ADH kungabangela ukusebenza kabi kwezinso
question55: Chaza ukuthi ukucindezeleka kukhuthaza kanjani ukugcinwa kwamanzi, okungaholela ekukhuluphaleni
answer55: Ukucindezeleka kwandisa i-osmolality, okwandisa ukukhiqizwa kwe-hormone yokulwa nokukhipha uketshezi emzimbeni. I-hormone yokulwa nokukhipha uketshezi emzimbeni isiza ukugcina amanzi emzimbeni
distractor55a: Ukucindezeleka kunciphisa i-osmolality, okwandisa ukukhishwa kwe-hormone yokulwa nokukhipha uketshezi emzimbeni. I-hormone yokulwa nokukhipha uketshezi emzimbeni isiza ukugcina amanzi emzimbeni.
distractor55b: Ukucindezeleka kwandisa i-osmolality, okunciphisa ukukhiqizwa kwe-hormone ye-antidiuretic. I-hormone ye-antidiuretic iyasiza ekulahlekelweni kwamanzi.
distractor55c: Ukucindezeleka kunciphisa i-osmolality, okunciphisa ukukhiqizwa kwe-hormone yokulwa nokukhipha uketshezi emzimbeni. I-hormone yokulwa nokukhipha uketshezi emzimbeni iyasiza ekulahlekelweni kwamanzi emzimbeni.
question56: Thola ukuthi yiluphi uhlobo lwendlela yokuphendula olulawula ngokuyinhloko ukukhiqizwa nokukhululwa kwama-hormone bese uchaza ukuthi kungani lokhu kwenzeka
answer56: I-loop yempendulo engalungile ukusiza ukugcina imisebenzi efanele yomzimba ngaphakathi kobubanzi obuthile
distractor56a: I-loop yempendulo enhle ukusiza ukugcina ukugcwala kwamanzi emzimbeni
distractor56b: I-Negative feedback loop ukusiza ukugcina ukugcwala kwamanzi emzimbeni
distractor56c: I-loop yempendulo enhle ukusiza ukugcina imisebenzi efanele yomzimba ngaphakathi kobubanzi obuthile
question57: Qhathanisa futhi uqhathanise izinto ezibangela ukuthukuthela kanye nama-hormone
answer57: Kokubili izisusa ezihlekisayo nezihlekisayo zikhipha ama-hormone. Izisusa ezihlekisayo ziyizisusa ezihlobene noketshezi olungaphandle kwe-extracellular, kanti izisusa zama-hormone ziyizisusa ezivuselela amanye ama-hormone.
distractor57a: Kokubili izisusa ezihlekisayo nezihlekisayo zikhipha amaprotheni. Izisusa ezihlekisayo zingama-hormone avuselela amanye ama-hormone, kanti izisusa zama-hormone ziyizisusa ezihlobene noketshezi olungaphandle kwe-extracellular.
distractor57b: Kokubili izisusa ezihlekisayo nezihlekisayo zikhipha amaprotheni. Izisusa ezihlekisayo ziyizisusa ezihlobene noketshezi olungaphandle kwesikhumba, kanti izisusa ezihlekisayo ziyizisusa ezivuselela amanye ama-hormone.
distractor57c: Kokubili izisusa ezihlekisayo nezihlekisayo zikhipha ama-hormone. Izisusa ezihlekisayo zingama-hormone avuselela amanye ama-hormone, kanti izisusa zama-hormone ziyizisusa ezihlobene noketshezi olungaphandle kwe-extracellular.
question58: Chaza ukuthi kungani kungaba yinkinga ukube ama-hormone amaningi abelawulwa yi-positive feedback loop
answer58: Ukukhiqizwa ngokweqile kwezenzo kungakhuthazwa ama-hormone afana nokukhula kanye namazinga kashukela egazini
distractor58a: Ukukhiqizwa kwezenzo kungancishiswa ama-hormone afana nokukhula kanye namazinga kashukela egazini
distractor58b: Ukuvinjelwa kokukhiqizwa kwe-GnRH ngokwanda kwamazinga e-gonad hormone
distractor58c: Ukuvinjelwa kokukhishwa kwe-insulin ngokunciphisa amazinga kashukela egazini
question59: Qhathanisa izincazelo ezingezansi ukuze ukhethe leyo echaza kahle ukuthi i-aldosterone ilawula ini, nokuthi ivuselelwa kanjani
answer59: I-Aldosterone ilawula amazinga e-sodium emchameni, ekujulukeni, kuma-pancreas nasematheni. Ivuselelwa ukwehla kwamazinga e-sodium ion egazini, umthamo wegazi, noma umfutho wegazi, noma ukwanda kwamanani e-potassium egazini.
distractor59a: I-Aldosterone ilawula inani lamanzi akhishwa yizinso futhi ibangela ukumuncwa kwamanzi ngqo kusuka kuma-reso tubules. Ivuselelwa ukwehla kokuhlushwa kwamanzi egazini, noma ukwanda kwenani le-potassium egazini.
distractor59b: I-Aldosterone ilawula amazinga e-calcium emchameni, ematheni, kanye nakuma-pancreas. Ivuselelwa ukwehla kwamazinga e-calcium ion egazini, umfutho wegazi, umthamo wegazi, noma ukwanda kwamanani e-potassium egazini.
distractor59c: I-Aldosterone ilawula amazinga kashukela egazini ngokukhuthaza ukuwohloka kwe-glycogen ibe ushukela. Ivuselelwa ukwehla kwamazinga kashukela egazini, umthamo wegazi, noma umfutho wegazi.
question60: Bheka uMfanekiso 28.28. Isithombe sibonisa i-hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal (HPA) axis, enye yezingxenye eziyinhloko zesistimu ye-endocrine, ngesikhathi sokuvuvukala. Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza indima ye-cortisol kulesi simiso?
answer60: Kubangela imiphumela ye-metabolic ngokumelene nokuvuvukala kanye nokunciphisa ukukhiqizwa kwe-CRH kanye ne-ACTH
distractor60a: Ukuqala imiphumela ye-metabolic ngokumelene nokuvuvukala nokwandisa ukukhiqizwa kwe-CRH ne-ACTH
distractor60b: Ukwandisa ukukhiqizwa kwe-CRH kanye nokunciphisa ukukhiqizwa kwe-ACTH
distractor60c: Ukwandisa ukukhiqizwa kwe-ACTH nokunciphisa ukukhiqizwa kwe-CRH
question61: I-adrenal medulla ikhipha izinhlobo ezimbili zama-hormone. Thola ukuthi yini ekhishwayo bese uchaza imisebenzi yawo
answer61: Zikhipha i-epinephrine kanye ne-norepinephrine, okwandisa ukushaya kwenhliziyo, ukuphefumula, ukufinyela kwemisipha, umfutho wegazi, kanye noshukela wegazi njengempendulo yesikhashana yokucindezeleka.
distractor61a: Zikhipha i-cortisol kanye ne-aldosterone, okwandisa ukushaya kwenhliziyo, ukuphefumula, ukufinyela kwemisipha, umfutho wegazi, kanye noshukela wegazi njengempendulo yokucindezeleka yesikhashana.
distractor61b: Zikhipha i-epinephrine kanye ne-norepinephrine, okwandisa ukushaya kwenhliziyo, ukuphefumula, ukufinyela kwemisipha, umfutho wegazi, kanye noshukela egazini njengempendulo yokucindezeleka kwesikhathi eside.
distractor61c: Zikhipha i-cortisol kanye ne-aldosterone, okwandisa ukushaya kwenhliziyo, ukuphefumula, ukufinyela kwemisipha, umfutho wegazi, kanye noshukela wegazi njengempendulo yokucindezeleka kwesikhathi eside.
question62: Bheka uMfanekiso 28.29. Igrafu ikhombisa ukugcwala kwama-hormone amabili, i-epinephrine kanye ne-noepinephrine, egazini ngesikhathi nangemva kokuzivocavoca. Imigqa ehlukene imelela abantu abahlukene. Qaphela ukuthi ama-y-axis amagrafu amabili anezilinganiso ezihlukene. Yenza isimangalo ngokusekelwe kula magrafu
answer62: Kukhona i-noephinephrine eningi egazini kune-efinephrine ngesikhathi sokuzivocavoca
distractor62a: Ukugxila kwama-hormone womabili kufinyelela phezulu ngesikhathi esisodwa ngesikhathi sokuzivocavoca
distractor62b: Ukugxila kwama-hormone womabili kwehla kancane kancane
distractor62c: Kukhona cishe inani elilinganayo le-efinephrine ne-noephinephrine egazini ngesikhathi sokuzivocavoca
question63: Bheka uMfanekiso 28.30. Ama-platelet ayizingcezu ezincane zamaseli ezikhona egazini ezidlala indima ekujiyeni kwegazi. Igrafu ikhombisa ucwaningo ngomphumela we-hormone i-epinephrine ekubalweni kwama-platelet egazini. Ingxenye ye-epinephrine IV yegrafu ikhombisa lapho i-epinephrine yafakwa khona kusampula yegazi. Cabanga ngomugqa we-ACD bese ungazinaki umugqa we-EDTA kugrafu. Yikuphi ukukhetha okuchaza umphumela we-epinephrine ekubalweni kwama-platelet?
answer63: I-Epinephrine ibangela ukwanda kokuqala kwenani lama-platelet. Ngemva kokwanda, inani lama-platelet liyehla ngisho nalapho umjovo we-epinephrine uqhubeka.
distractor63a: I-Epinephrine yandisa inani lama-platelet ku-curve enomumo we-J
distractor63b: I-Epinephrine ikhulisa inani lamaplatelet ku-curve enomumo we-S
distractor63c: I-Epinephrine ibangela i-spike yokuqala ye-platelet. Ngemva kwe-spike, i-platelet iyaqhubeka injalo uma nje umjovo we-epinephrine uqhubeka.
question64: Ama-hormone e-steroid ayaziwa ukuthi ajikeleza egazini isikhathi eside kunama-hormone e-peptide. Chaza ukuthi kungani lokhu kwenzeka
distractor64a: Ama-hormone e-peptide awakwazi ukudlula emangqamuzaneni eseli
distractor64c: Ama-hormone e-steroid awakwazi ukudlula emangqamuzaneni eseli
question65: Chaza ukuthi kungani ama-hormone atholakala ku-lipid, njengama-hormone e-steroid, kanye nama-hormone atholakala ku-peptide kanye nama-amino acid esebenzisa izinhlobo ezahlukene zama-receptor. Khomba uhlobo lwe-receptor olusetshenziswa yiqembu ngalinye lama-hormone
answer65: Ama-hormone atholakala ku-lipid angangena ngaphakathi kwe-plasma membrane futhi ngaleyo ndlela asebenzise ama-receptor angaphakathi kweseli. Ama-hormone atholakala ku-peptide kanye nama-amino acid awancibiliki ku-lipid ngakho-ke adinga ama-receptor angaphezulu kweseli.
distractor65a: Ama-hormone atholakala ku-lipid anama-receptor atholakala ku-nucleus, ngakho-ke asebenzisa ama-receptor angaphakathi kweseli, kuyilapho ama-hormone atholakala ku-peptide kanye nama-hormone atholakala ku-amino acid enama-receptor kuphela ebusweni beseli futhi ngaleyo ndlela asebenzisa ama-receptor angaphezulu kweseli.
distractor65b: Ama-hormone atholakala ku-lipid angangena ngaphakathi kwe-plasma membranes njengoba kudingeka ahlale ejikeleza isikhathi eside, ngaleyo ndlela asebenzise ama-receptor angaphakathi kweseli. Ama-hormone atholakala ku-peptide kanye nama-amino acid awancibiliki ku-lipid futhi adinga ama-surface receptors.
distractor65c: Ama-hormone atholakala ku-lipid angangena ngaphakathi kwe-plasma membranes futhi ngaleyo ndlela asebenzise ama-receptor angaphezulu kweseli. Amanye ama-hormone atholakala ku-peptide kanye nama-amino acid angawela i-membrane kodwa amaningi awancibiliki ku-lipids ngakho-ke adinga ama-receptor angaphakathi kweseli.
question66: Bheka uMfanekiso 28.31. Igrafu ikhombisa amazinga e-hormone i-epinephrine egazini ngesikhathi nangemva kokuzivocavoca. Imigqa ehlukene imelela abantu abahlukene. Yenza isimangalo ngokusekelwe kule grafu.,/p>
answer66: Ukuhlushwa kwe-epinephrine kuyanda kancane kancane ngesikhathi sokuzivocavoca futhi kwehla ngokuzumayo ngemva kokuzivocavoca
distractor66a: Ukuhlushwa kwe-Epinephrine kuyanda kancane kancane ngesikhathi sokuzivocavoca futhi kwehla kancane kancane ngemva kokuzivocavoca
distractor66b: Ukuhlushwa kwe-epinephrine kukhuphuka kakhulu ekuqaleni kokuzivocavoca futhi kuhlala kusezingeni eliphezulu. Ngemva kokuzivocavoca kwehla ngokuzumayo
distractor66c: Ukuhlushwa kwe-epinephrine kukhuphuka kakhulu ekuqaleni kokuzivocavoca futhi kuhlala kusezingeni eliphezulu. Ngemva kokuzivocavoca kwehla kancane kancane
question67: Bheka uMfanekiso 28.32. Isithombe sibonisa ukuthi i-hormone ye-insulin ibangela kanjani ukudluliselwa kwamaprotheni e-GLUT4 kusuka ngaphakathi kweseli kuya kulwelwesi lweseli. Lokhu kwandisa ukungena kwe-glucose yiseli. Ucwaningo luthole ukuthi ama-fatty acid amaningi kakhulu ku-metabolism, angabangelwa ukukhuluphala ngokweqile, aphazamisa ukusebenza kwe-enzyme ye-PI3K. Yenza isimangalo ngokusekelwe kulolu lwazi.<,/p>
answer67: Amaprotheni e-GLUT4 awadluliselwa olwelwesini lweseli. Iseli alikhulisi izinga lokungenisa ushukela egazini futhi alimelani ne-insulin.
distractor67a: Amaprotheni e-GLUT4 aselungeni leseli, kodwa awakwazi ukusebenza. Iseli alikhulisi izinga lokungenisa ushukela egazini futhi alimelani ne-insulin.
distractor67b: Amaprotheni e-GLUT4 ahlala evulekile, esikhundleni sokulawula ukungenisa ushukela. Iseli lithatha inani eliningi le-glucose futhi alikwazi ukuyicubungula yonke
distractor67c: Amaprotheni e-GLUT4 engeziwe ayakhiqizwa futhi athunyelwe olwelwesini lweseli. Iseli lithatha inani eliningi le-glucose futhi alikwazi ukuyicubungula yonke
question68: Bheka uMfanekiso 28.33. Hlola umfanekiso onikeziwe. Nquma ukuthi hlobo luni lwe-hormone olubophayo kulesi sithombe bese uchaza ubufakazi obusesithombeni obusekela impendulo yakho.
answer68: I-hormone etholakala kuma-lipid iyabopha; lokhu kusobala ngoba iyancibilika emafutheni ngakho-ke iyakwazi ukudlula olwelwesini lweseli ukuze ifinyelele kuma-receptor angaphakathi kweseli.
distractor68a: I-hormone etholakala ku-lipid iyabopha; lokhu kusobala ngoba ayincibiliki emafutheni ngakho-ke iyakwazi ukubopha kuma-receptors ebusweni bangaphandle be-plasma membrane.
distractor68b: I-hormone ethathwe ku-polypeptide iyabopha; lokhu kusobala ngoba iyancibilika emafutheni ngakho-ke iyakwazi ukudlula elwengeni leseli ukuze ifinyelele kuma-receptor angaphakathi kweseli.
distractor68c: I-hormone ethathwe ku-polypeptide iyabopha; lokhu kusobala ngoba ayincibiliki kumafutha ngakho-ke ibopha kuma-receptors ebusweni bangaphandle be-plasma membrane.
question69: Bheka uMfanekiso 28.34. Isithombe sibonisa ukuthi i-gonadotrophin-releasing hormone (GnRH) isebenza kanjani esitokisini. I-GnRH yakhiwe ngama-amino acid amaningi. Yiluphi uhlobo lwe-hormone i-GnRH?
question70: Umfutho wegazi kanye nomthamo wegazi kukhushulwa ukukhiqizwa kwamahomoni i-antidiuretic hormone (ADH) kanye ne-aldosterone. Chaza ukuthi i-renin ikhuthaza kanjani ukukhishwa kwe-ADH kanye ne-aldosterone
distractor70a: I-Renin ilingisa ngqo ukukhiqizwa kwe-ADH ne-aldosterone
distractor70c: I-Angiotensin I iguqulwa ibe yi-angiotensin II
question71: Bheka uMfanekiso 28.35. Igrafu ikhombisa amazinga kashukela egazini, i-insulini kanye ne-glucagon yomuntu ophilile kanye nomuntu onesifo sikashukela. Qaphela ngokukhethekile isikali se-y-axis se-glucose kanye ne-insulini. Qaphela idatha ngaphambi kokufakwa kwe-insulini (imibuthano engagcwalisiwe). Yenza isimangalo ngokusekelwe kula magrafu.
answer71: Umuntu onesifo sikashukela angakhipha inani elifanayo le-insulin kumuntu ophilile, kodwa i-insulin ayikwazi ukunciphisa ushukela egazini
distractor71a: Umuntu onesifo sikashukela akakwazi ukukhiqiza amazinga aphezulu e-insulin
distractor71b: Amazinga kashukela kumuntu onesifo sikashukela kanye nomuntu onempilo ayafana ngemva kokudla.
distractor71c: Umuntu onesifo sikashukela ukhipha inani elikhulu le-insulin ngokushesha nje ngemva kokudla.
question72: Bheka uMfanekiso 28.36. Igrafu ikhombisa amazinga kashukela egazini, i-insulini kanye ne-glucagon yomuntu ophilile ngemuva kokudla okune-carbohydrate eningi (i-CHO). Yenza isimangalo ngokusekelwe kule grafu.
answer72: I-insulin kanye ne-glucagon kunemiphumela ephambene ku-glucose
distractor72c: I-insulin ne-glucagon zombili zinciphisa ushukela egazini
question73: Bheka uMfanekiso 28.37. Igrafu ikhombisa amazinga amahomoni amahomoni amane ayinhloko emjikelezweni wokuya esikhathini ofanele. Kule grafu, iyini i-dependent variable?
question74: Bheka Umfanekiso 28.37. Igrafu ikhombisa amazinga ama-hormone ama-hormone amane ayinhloko emjikelezweni wokuya esikhathini ofanele. Umuntu unamazinga akhuphuka kakhulu e-lutenizing hormone (LH) kanye namazinga e-estradiol akhuphuka kancane kancane. Lo muntu cishe uzoba kuluphi usuku lomjikelezo?
question75: Bheka Umfanekiso 28.38. I-hormone yokulwa nokukhipha isisu (i-ADH) ilawula inani lamanzi akhishwa yizinso. Igrafu ikhombisa izinga le-ADH egazini uma liqhathaniswa ne-osmolarity yegazi (i-osmomolality) kwabesifazane abakhulelwe nabangebona abakhulelwe. Qaphela ukuthi i-osmomolarity ephezulu isho ukuthi igazi linosawoti omningi namanzi amancane. Yenza isimangalo ngokusekelwe kule grafu.
answer75: Ezingeni elifanayo le-ADH egazini, igazi labesifazane abakhulelwe linamanzi amaningi uma liqhathaniswa negazi labesifazane abangakhulelwe.
distractor75a: Ngesikhathi esifanayo se-osmomolarity, abesifazane abangakhulelwe bakhipha i-ADH eyengeziwe
distractor75b: Ngesikhathi esifanayo se-osmomolarity, abesifazane abakhulelwe nabangebona abakhulelwe bakhipha inani elifanayo le-ADH
distractor75c: Ezingeni elifanayo le-ADH egazini, igazi labesifazane abakhulelwe nabangebona abakhulelwe linamazinga alinganayo kasawoti.
question76: Ama-positive feedback loops awavamile ohlelweni lwe-endocrine kodwa amanye akhona. Qhathanisa izimo zembangela nemiphumela ezichazwe ngezansi ukuze ubone ukuthi yisiphi isibonelo se-positive feedback loop
distractor76b: Amazinga e-calcium egazini akhuphuka amisa ukukhiqizwa kwe-PTH
distractor76c: Amanani akhuphukile e-T3 kanye ne-T4 avimbela ukukhiqizwa okuqhubekayo
question77: Nakuba ama-positive feedback loops engavamile ohlelweni lwe-endocrine, akhona ekuzalweni komntwana. Sekela lesi sitatimende ngokuchaza kahle izinyathelo ze-positive feedback loop elawula ukubeletha.
answer77: Uma ingane icindezela umlomo wesibeletho, kuthunyelwa isignali yokukhuthaza ukukhishwa kwe-oxytocin, okukhuthaza ukuncipha okwengeziwe. Lokhu kukhuthaza ukukhishwa kwe-oxytocin okwengeziwe okuvumela ingane ukuthi icindezelwe ngemisele yokuzalwa
distractor77a: Uma ingane icindezela umlomo wesibeletho, kuthunyelwa isignali yokukhuthaza ukukhishwa kwe-oxytocin, okukhuthaza ukuncipha kwesisu. Lokhu kukhuthaza ukukhishwa kwe-progesterone evumela ingane ukuthi icindezelwe ngemisele yokuzalwa
distractor77b: Uma ingane isunduza umlomo wesibeletho, kuthunyelwa isignali yokukhuthaza ukukhishwa kwe-prolactin, okukhuthaza ukuncipha okwengeziwe. Lokhu kukhuthaza ukukhishwa kwe-prolactin eyengeziwe evumela ingane ukuthi isunduze idlule emgudwini wokuzalwa.
distractor77c: Uma ingane icindezela umlomo wesibeletho, kuthunyelwa isignali yokukhuthaza ukukhishwa kwe-progesterone, okukhuthaza ukuncipha kwesisu. Lokhu kukhuthaza ukukhishwa kwe-oxytocin evumela ingane ukuthi icindezelwe ngemisele yokuzalwa.
question78: Ama-osmoreceptor abalulekile ekuqapheni ukugcwala kwamanzi emzimbeni. Chaza ukuthi ama-osmoreceptor awufeza kanjani lo msebenzi
answer78: Ama-Osmoreceptors athola lapho amazinga e-electrolyte egazini eshintsha
distractor78b: Izimpawu zokwanda kokumuncwa kabusha kwe-sodium yi-Osmoreceptors
question79: ULaura unesifo sikashukela sohlobo 1, ngakho umzimba wakhe awukwazi ukukhiqiza i-insulin ngendlela efanele ngenxa yamazinga aphezulu kashukela egazini. Khetha ezinkethweni ezinikeziwe ukuthi yiluphi uhlobo lwesikhuthazo se-endocrine uLaura angakwazi ukusabela kuso
question80: Bheka uMfanekiso 28.14. UTerry usanda kukhula isisindo futhi ubekhathele kakhulu kunokujwayelekile. Udokotela kaTerry uphakamise ukuthi kungenzeka angakhiqizi i-hormone evuselela i-thyroid (TSH) eyanele. Hlola umdwebo ukuze uthethelele okushiwo odokotela ngokuchaza ukuthi kungani ukuntuleka kwe-TSH kungabangela ukukhuluphala nokukhathala kukaTerry.
answer80: Ngaphandle kwe-TSH, i-T3 ne-T4 azikwazi ukukhiqizwa kahle, okuholela esilinganisweni esiphansi se-metabolic esingabangela ukukhuluphala nokukhathala
distractor80a: Ngaphandle kwe-TSH, bekuyoba nokukhiqizwa ngokweqile kwe-T3 ne-T4, okuholela esilinganisweni esiphakeme se-metabolic esingabangela ukukhuluphala nokukhathala.
distractor80b: Ngaphandle kwe-TSH, bekuyoba nokukhiqizwa ngokweqile kwe-T3 ne-T4, okuholela esilinganisweni esiphansi se-metabolic esingabangela ukukhuluphala nokukhathala.
distractor80c: Ngaphandle kwe-TSH, i-T3 ne-T4 azikwazi ukukhiqizwa kahle, okuholela esilinganisweni esiphakeme se-metabolic esingabangela ukukhuluphala nokukhathala
question81: UMarcus ubhekane nokulimala kwesimiso sezinzwa engozini yemoto. Faka isimangalo sokuthi yimuphi umsebenzi womzimba ohlobene ne-endocrine olandelayo ozoba nokuphazamiseka okukhulu ngenxa yalokho.
