chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 29. Uhlelo Lwemisipha | 29.0 Isingeniso
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 29. Uhlelo Lwemisipha | 29.0 Isingeniso
chapterContent:
Izinhlelo zemisipha namathambo zinikeza ukwesekwa emzimbeni futhi zivumela ukunyakaza okubanzi. Amathambo ohlelo lwamathambo avikela izitho zangaphakathi zomzimba futhi asekele isisindo somzimba. Imisipha yohlelo lwemisipha iyafinyela futhi idonse amathambo, okuvumela ukunyakaza okuhlukahlukene njengokuma, ukuhamba, ukugijima, nokubamba izinto.

 Ukulimala noma isifo esithinta uhlelo lwemisipha kungaba nzima kakhulu. Kubantu, izifo ezivame kakhulu zemisipha emhlabeni wonke zibangelwa ukungondleki kahle. Izifo ezithinta amalunga nazo zisakazeke kabanzi, njenge-arthritis, engenza ukunyakaza kube nzima futhi—ezimweni ezithuthukile—ziphazamisa ngokuphelele ukunyakaza. Ezimweni ezimbi lapho ilunga lonakele kakhulu, kungase kudingeke ukuhlinzwa kokufaka esikhundleni samalunga.

 Intuthuko kwesayensi yokuklama i-prosthesis iholele ekuthuthukisweni kwamalunga okwenziwa, lapho ukuhlinzwa kokufaka esikhundleni samalunga ezinqeni nasemadolweni kuyinto evame kakhulu. Amalunga okufaka esikhundleni samahlombe, izindololwane, neminwe nawo ayatholakala. Ngisho nangale ntuthuko, kusenendawo yokuthuthukiswa ekwakhiweni kwe-prostheses. Ama-prostheses asezingeni eliphezulu aqinile futhi ngenxa yalokho aguga ngokushesha, ikakhulukazi kubantu abasebasha noma abakhuthele.

 Insimu yama-prosthesis e-robotic igxile kuma-prosthetics anamathele ngqo emathanjeni futhi angalawulwa yingqondo ngokusebenzisa izixhumi ze-neuromuscular ezifakiwe. Bheka Umfanekiso 29.1
answer1: Ukusekela umzimba, ukuvikela izitho zangaphakathi, kanye nokwenza kube lula ukunyakaza
distractor1b: Ukukhiqiza ama-enzyme okugaya ukudla nokumunca izakhamzimba

question3: Yimuphi umsebenzi obalulekile wesistimu yamathambo?
question4: Yiziphi izifo zemisipha nemisipha ezivame kakhulu emhlabeni jikelele?
question5: Yisiphi isimo esivame ukuthinta amalunga futhi esingalimaza kakhulu ukunyakaza?
question6: Yikuphi ukwelashwa kokuhlinzwa okungadingeka uma ilunga lilimele kakhulu?
question7: Yimaphi amalunga avame ukushintshwa ngama-prostheses okwenziwa?
question8: Yimuphi umkhawulo owodwa wamalunga okufakelwa asezingeni eliphezulu amanje?
answer8: Zihlala isikhathi eside futhi ziguga ngokushesha
question9: Iyini isici esiyinhloko se-prostheses yamarobhothi?
answer9: Zingaxhunywa ngqo emathanjeni futhi zilawulwe ngokusebenzisa izixhumanisi zemisipha ezifakiwe

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 29. Uhlelo Lwemisipha | 29.1 Izinhlobo Zezinhlelo Zamathambo | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 29. Uhlelo Lwemisipha | 29.1 Izinhlobo Zezinhlelo Zamathambo | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent:
Ulwazi oluningi kulesi sigaba alukho emkhakheni we-AP®. Kodwa-ke, njengomfundi webhayoloji kufanele ube nokuqonda okuyisisekelo kokuthi izinhlelo zemisipha namathambo zisebenza kanjani ndawonye ukuze zinikeze ukwesekwa nokuvikelwa ngenkathi zivumela ukunyakaza okuhlukahlukene. Amathambo ahlinzeka ngendawo yokugcina usawoti we-calcium ne-phosphorus futhi futhi ayindawo yokwakheka kwamaseli egazi. Esigabeni esilandelayo, ulwazi lwesimiso sezinzwa luzosetshenziswa ukuqonda uhlelo lwemisipha ngoba ukufinyela kwemisipha kuncike ekufakweni kwemizwa. Imicimbi eyenzeka endaweni yokuhlangana kwemizwa ifana nemicimbi eyenzeka kuma-synapses phakathi kwama-neurons njengoba kuxoxwe ngakho esahlukweni sesimiso sezinzwa. Abantu, kanye nezilwane eziningi bathembele ekunyakazeni kwemisebenzi yansuku zonke. Ngokombono wokuziphendukela kwemvelo, ukushintshela kwezilwane ezweni kwakudinga izinguquko ekwakhiweni komzimba njengoba ukuhamba komhlaba kwaletha izinselele ezintsha eziningana ezilwaneni ezazijwayele ukunyakaza emanzini, njengomphumela wamandla adonsela phansi kanye nokuntuleka kokuntanta. Isinyathelo ngesinyathelo, lezi zimo zanqwabelana. Ukuhlola ukuvela kwesistimu yemisipha ezilwaneni kuzohlinzeka ngolwazi ngalo mlando.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyisiwe kulesi sigaba azikho ngaphakathi kwe-AP® futhi azihambisani noHlaka Lwezifundo
question1: Uyini umsebenzi oyinhloko wesimiso samathambo ezilwaneni?
answer1: Ukunikeza ukwesekwa, ukuvikelwa, kanye nohlaka lokunyakaza
question2: Yiluphi uhlobo lwamathambo olutholakala ngaphandle komzimba?
question3: Yiluphi uhlobo lwamathambo oluthembele ezingxeni ezigcwele uketshezi kanye nokufinyela kwemisipha ukuze lusekele futhi lunyakaze?
question4: Iyini inzuzo enkulu ye-endoskeleton?
answer4: Ikhula kanye nemvelo futhi isekela usayizi womzimba omkhulu
question5: Yiliphi iqembu lezilwane elivame ukuba ne-exoskeleton eyenziwe ngokuyinhloko nge-chitin?
question6: Kungani izilwane eziningi ezinama-exoskeletons kumele zibole?
answer6: Ngoba i-exoskeleton eqinile ayikwazi ukukhula njengoba isilwane sikhula
question7: Yisiphi isimiso samathambo esivame kakhulu phakathi kwezilwane ezinethambo lomgogodla?

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 29. Uhlelo Lwemisipha | 29.1 Izinhlobo Zezinhlelo Zamathambo | I-Hydrostatic Skeleton
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 29. Uhlelo Lwemisipha | 29.1 Izinhlobo Zezinhlelo Zamathambo | I-Hydrostatic Skeleton
chapterContent:
I-hydrostatic skeleton iyi-skeleton eyakhiwe yi-compartment egcwele uketshezi emzimbeni, ebizwa ngokuthi i-coelom. Izitho ze-coelom zisekelwa yi-aqueous fluid, ephinde imelane nokucindezelwa kwangaphandle. Le compartment ingaphansi kwengcindezi ye-hydrostatic ngenxa yoketshezi futhi isekela ezinye izitho zomzimba. Lolu hlobo lwesistimu yamathambo lutholakala ezilwaneni ezinomzimba othambile njenge-sea anemones, izibungu zomhlaba, i-Cnidaria, nezinye izilwane ezingenamgogodla (Isithombe 29.2).

 Ukunyakaza kwe-hydrostatic skeleton kunikezwa yimisipha ezungeze i-coelom. Imisipha e-hydrostatic skeleton iyafinyela ukushintsha isimo se-coelom; ukucindezela koketshezi ku-coelom kukhiqiza ukunyakaza. Isibonelo, izibungu zomhlaba zihamba ngamagagasi okufinyeza kwemisipha yemisipha yamathambo odonga lomzimba we-hydrostatic skeleton, ebizwa ngokuthi i-peristalsis, efinyeza futhi inwebe umzimba ngokushintshana. Ukwelula umzimba kwandisa ingxenye engaphambili yomzimba. Izinto eziphilayo eziningi zinendlela yokuzilungisa ku-substrate. Ukwelula imisipha bese kudonsela ingxenye engemuva yomzimba phambili. Nakuba uhlaka lwamathambo olusebenzisa amanzi lufaneleka kahle ezintweni eziphilayo ezingenamgogodla njengezikelemu zomhlaba kanye nezinye izinto eziphilayo zasemanzini, alulona uhlaka olusebenza kahle ezilwaneni zasemhlabeni.
answer1: Uhlaka lwamathambo olwakhiwe yingxenye yomzimba egcwele uketshezi ebizwa ngokuthi i-coelom
question2: Yini esekela izitho ezisesikhwameni se-hydrostatic?
answer2: Ukucindezela kwe-hydrostatic okudalwe uketshezi olungaphakathi kwe-coelom
question3: Yisiphi kulezi zilwane ezilandelayo esinohlaka lwe-hydrostatic?
question4: Ukunyakaza kukhiqizwa kanjani ku-skeleton ye-hydrostatic?
answer4: Imisipha ezungeze i-coelom iyafinyela, ishintshe isimo sayo futhi isebenzise ukucindezela koketshezi ukudala ukunyakaza
question5: Kuyini i-peristalsis embungwini womhlaba?
answer5: Amagagasi okufinyeza kwemisipha okufinyeza futhi kwandise umzimba ukuze ushukume
question6: Ngesikhathi sokuhamba kwezimpethu, kwenzekani uma umzimba ukhula?
question7: Kungani uhlaka lwe-hydrostatic lungasebenzi kahle ezilwaneni eziningi zasemhlabeni?
answer7: Ayinikezi ukwesekwa okwanele ngokumelene namandla adonsela phansi okuphila emhlabeni

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 29. Uhlelo Lwemisipha | 29.1 Izinhlobo Zezinhlelo Zamathambo | I-Exoskeleton
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 29. Uhlelo Lwemisipha | 29.1 Izinhlobo Zezinhlelo Zamathambo | I-Exoskeleton
chapterContent: I-exoskeleton iyisikeletho sangaphandle esakhiwe yisivikelo esiqinile ebusweni bento ephilayo. Isibonelo, amagobolondo ezinkalankala nezinambuzane angama-exoskeleton (Isithombe 29.3). Lolu hlobo lwesikeletho luhlinzeka ngokuzivikela ezitheni, lusekela umzimba, futhi luvumela ukunyakaza ngokufinyela kwemisipha enamathele. Njengasezilwaneni ezinomgogodla, imisipha kumele inqamule ilunga ngaphakathi kwe-exoskeleton. Ukufinyezwa kwemisipha kushintsha ubudlelwano bezingxenye ezimbili ze-exoskeleton. Ama-arthropod afana nezinkalankala nama-lobster ane-exoskeletons aqukethe i-chitin engu-30-50%, i-polysaccharide derivative ye-glucose eyinto eqinile kodwa eguquguqukayo. I-Chitin ikhishwa ngamaseli e-epidermal. I-exoskeleton iqiniswa ngokwengeziwe ngokungezwa kwe-calcium carbonate ezintweni eziphilayo ezifana ne-lobster. Ngenxa yokuthi i-exoskeleton iyi-acellular, ama-arthropod kumele alahle ama-exoskeleton awo ngezikhathi ezithile ngoba i-exoskeleton ayikhuli njengoba into ephilayo ikhula.
answer1: Uhlaka lwangaphandle olunesembozo esiqinile ebusweni bento ephilayo
distractor1b: Umgodi womzimba ogcwele uketshezi osekela ukunyakaza
question2: Yisiphi kulezi zilwane ezilandelayo esine-exoskeleton?
question3: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okuwumsebenzi we-exoskeleton?
answer3: Ihlinzeka ngokuvikela, ukusekela umzimba, futhi ivumela ukunyakaza ngemisipha enamathele
question4: Imisipha ikhiqiza kanjani ukunyakaza ezilwaneni ezinama-exoskeleton?
answer4: Imisipha iyafinyela emalungeni, ishintshe izindawo zezingxenye ze-exoskeleton
distractor4b: Imisipha iyancibilika futhi yakha kabusha i-exoskeleton
distractor4c: Imisipha isunduza ngqo emhlabathini ngaphandle kwamalunga
question5: Kuyini i-chitin?
answer5: I-polysaccharide enamandla kodwa eguquguqukayo etholakala ku-glucose
distractor5c: I-lipid esetshenziselwa ukugcina amandla isikhathi eside
question6: Yimaphi amangqamuzana akhipha i-chitin ukuze akhe i-exoskeleton?
question7: Kungani i-calcium carbonate ingezwa eqoqweni lezinto eziphilayo ezifana nama-lobster?
question8: Kungani ama-arthropod kumele ancibilike ngezikhathi ezithile?
answer8: Ngoba i-exoskeleton ye-acellular ayikwazi ukukhula njengoba umzimba ukhula
distractor8b: Ngoba i-exoskeleton ikhiqiza i-calcium eningi kakhulu
distractor8c: Ngoba ukubola kuyadingeka ukuze kukhiqizwe kabusha

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 29. Uhlelo Lwemisipha | 29.1 Izinhlobo Zezinhlelo Zamathambo | I-Endoskeleton
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 29. Uhlelo Lwemisipha | 29.1 Izinhlobo Zezinhlelo Zamathambo | I-Endoskeleton
chapterContent:
I-endoskeleton iyithambo lomzimba eliqukethe izakhiwo eziqinile, ezinamaminerali ezitholakala ngaphakathi kwezicubu ezithambile zezinto eziphilayo. Isibonelo sesakhiwo se-endoskeletal esidala yizinhlayiya zeziponji. Amathambo ezilwane ezinomgogodla akhiwe yizicubu, kanti iziponji azinazo izicubu zangempela (Isithombe 29.4). Ama-endoskeleton ahlinzeka ngokusekela umzimba, avikele izitho zangaphakathi, futhi avumela ukunyakaza ngokufinyela kwemisipha enamathele kuthambo lomzimba.

 Ithambo lomuntu liyithambo lomzimba eliqukethe amathambo angu-206 kumuntu omdala. Linemisebenzi emihlanu eyinhloko: ukuhlinzeka ngokusekela umzimba, ukugcina amaminerali nama-lipid, ukukhiqiza amangqamuzana egazi, ukuvikela izitho zangaphakathi, nokuvumela ukunyakaza. Uhlelo lwamathambo ezilwaneni ezinomgogodla luhlukaniswe ngethambo lomzimba (eliqukethe ugebhezi, ikholomu yomgogodla, kanye nekheji lembambo), kanye nethambo lomzimba (eliqukethe amahlombe, amathambo emilenze, ibhande lesifuba, kanye nebhande le-pelvic)
answer1: Uhlaka lwamathambo olwenziwe ngezakhiwo eziqinile, ezinamaminerali atholakala ngaphakathi kwezicubu ezithambile zento ephilayo
distractor1a: Uhlaka olugcwele uketshezi oluthembele ekucindezelweni kwe-hydrostatic
distractor1b: Isimbozo sangaphandle esiqinile esenziwe ngokuyinhloko nge-chitin
question2: Iyini isibonelo sesakhiwo samathambo esidala?
question3: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okuwumsebenzi we-endoskeleton?
answer3: Isekela umzimba, ivikela izitho zangaphakathi, futhi ivumela ukunyakaza ngemisipha enamathele
question4: Mangaki amathambo akhona emathanjeni omuntu omdala?
question5: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okungeyona into eyinhloko ohlelweni lwamathambo omuntu?
question6: Yiziphi izakhiwo ezakha uhlaka lwe-axial?
answer6: Ugebhezi, ikholomu yomgogodla, kanye nekheji lezimbambo
question7: Yiziphi izakhiwo eziyingxenye yohlaka lwe-appendicular?
answer7: Amahlombe, amathambo ezitho, ibhande lesifuba, kanye nebhande le-pelvic
question8: Ama-endoskeleton avumela kanjani ukunyakaza?
answer8: Ngokunikeza izindawo zokunamathela zemisipha okufinyela kwayo okushukumisa uhlaka lwamathambo

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 29. Uhlelo Lwemisipha | 29.1 Izinhlobo Zezinhlelo Zamathambo | I-Human Axial Skeleton
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 29. Uhlelo Lwemisipha | 29.1 Izinhlobo Zezinhlelo Zamathambo | I-Human Axial Skeleton
chapterContent: Uhlaka lwe-axial lwakha i-axis ephakathi yomzimba futhi luhlanganisa amathambo ekhanda, ama-ossicle endlebe ephakathi, ithambo le-hyoid lomphimbo, ikholomu yomgogodla, kanye nekheji lesifuba (i-ribcage) (Isithombe 29.5). Umsebenzi wohlaka lwe-axial ukuhlinzeka ukwesekwa nokuvikelwa kobuchopho, intambo yomgogodla, kanye nezitho ezisemgodini womzimba we-ventral. Luhlinzeka ngendawo yokunamathela kwemisipha eshukumisa ikhanda, intamo, kanye nomzimba, yenza ukunyakaza kokuphefumula, futhi izinzise izingxenye zohlaka lwe-appendicular.
question1: Yiziphi izakhiwo ezakha uhlaka lwe-axial lomuntu?
answer1: Ugebhezi, ama-ossicle endlebe ephakathi, ithambo le-hyoid, ikholomu yomgogodla, kanye nekheji lesifuba
question2: Uyini umsebenzi oyinhloko wohlaka lwe-axial?
answer2: Ukunikeza ukwesekwa nokuvikela ubuchopho, umgogodla, kanye nezitho zomzimba ezingaphakathi kwesisu
question3: Yiliphi ithambo lesikelemu se-axial elitholakala emphinjeni?
question4: Yini evikelwa yikholomu yomgogodla?
question5: Liyini elinye igama lekheji lesifuba?
question6: Ngaphandle kokuvikela, yimuphi omunye umsebenzi owenziwa yi-axial skeleton?
answer6: Ihlinzeka ngezindawo zokunamathela zemisipha enyakazisa ikhanda, intamo, kanye nomzimba futhi isize ekuphefumuleni
question7: Uhlaka lwe-axial lusiza kanjani kuhlaka lwe-appendicular?

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 29. Uhlelo Lwemisipha | 29.1 Izinhlobo Zezinhlelo Zamathambo | Uhlaka Lwezinzwa Zomuntu | Ukhakhayi
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 29. Uhlelo Lwemisipha | 29.1 Izinhlobo Zezinhlelo Zamathambo | Uhlaka Lwezinzwa Zomuntu | Ukhakhayi
chapterContent:
Amathambo ekhanda asekela izakhiwo zobuso futhi avikele ubuchopho. Ikhanda lakhiwe ngamathambo angu-22, ahlukaniswe ngezigaba ezimbili: amathambo ekhanda namathambo obuso. Amathambo ekhanda angamathambo ayisishiyagalombili akha umgodi wekhanda, ohlanganisa ubuchopho futhi osebenza njengendawo yokunamathisela imisipha yekhanda nentamo. Amathambo ayisishiyagalombili ekhanda yithambo langaphambili, amathambo amabili e-parietal, amathambo amabili esikhashana, ithambo le-occipital, ithambo le-sphenoid, kanye nethambo le-ethmoid. Nakuba amathambo akhula ngokwehlukana ku-embryo kanye ne-fetus, kumuntu omdala, ahlanganiswe ngokuqinile nezicubu ezixhumene futhi amathambo ahambisanayo awashukumi (Isithombe 29.6).

 Ama-ossicle okuzwa endlebeni ephakathi adlulisa imisindo evela emoyeni njengokudlidliza kuya ku-cochlea egcwele uketshezi. Ama-ossicle okuzwa aqukethe amathambo amathathu ngalinye: i-malleus, i-incus, kanye ne-stapes. Lawa amathambo amancane kakhulu emzimbeni futhi ahlukile ezincelisayo.

 Amathambo obuso ayishumi nane akha ubuso, ahlinzeka ngemigodi yezitho zokuxhumana (amehlo, umlomo, nekhala), avikela iminyango yokugaya ukudla kanye neyokuphefumula, futhi asebenza njengezindawo zokunamathisela imisipha yobuso. Amathambo obuso ayi-14 amathambo ekhala, amathambo e-maxillary, amathambo e-zygomatic, i-palatine, i-hlanza, amathambo e-lacrimal, i-inferior nasal conchae, kanye ne-mandible. Wonke la mathambo atholakala ngamabili ngaphandle kwe-mandible kanye ne-hlanza (Isithombe 29.7).

 Nakuba ingatholakali ekhanda, ithambo le-hyoid libhekwa njengengxenye ye-axial skeleton. Ithambo le-hyoid lingaphansi kwe-mandible ngaphambili kwentamo. Lisebenza njengesisekelo esinyakazayo solimi futhi lixhunywe emisipheni yomhlathi, i-larynx, kanye nolimi. I-mandible ihambisana nesisekelo sekhanda. I-mandible ilawula ukuvuleka komoya kanye namathumbu. Ezilwaneni ezinamazinyo, i-mandible ihlanganisa ubuso bamazinyo namazinyo e-maxillary.
answer1: Ukusekela izakhiwo zobuso nokuvikela ubuchopho
question2: Mangaki amathambo akha ugebhezi lomuntu?
question3: Mangaki amathambo ekhanda akha umgodi wekhanda?
question4: Uyini umsebenzi oyinhloko wamathambo ekhanda?
answer4: Ukubopha nokuvikela ubuchopho nokuhlinzeka ngezindawo zokunamathela zemisipha yekhanda nentamo
question5: Yimaphi amathambo amathathu akha ama-ossicle okuzwa endlebeni ephakathi?
question6: Uyini umsebenzi wama-ossicle okuzwa?
answer6: Ukudlulisa ukudlidliza komsindo kusuka emoyeni kuya ku-cochlea egcwele uketshezi
question7: Mangaki amathambo obuso akha ubuso?
question8: Yimaphi amathambo amabili obuso angabonakali ngamabili?
question9: Uyini umsebenzi oyinhloko wethambo le-hyoid?
answer9: Isebenza njengesisekelo esinyakazayo solimi futhi ihlinzeka ngokunamathela kwemisipha yomhlathi, i-larynx, nolimi.
question10: Uyini umsebenzi we-mandible?
answer10: Ihlangana nogebhezi, ilawula ukuvuleka komoya kanye namathumbu, futhi iletha amazinyo angaphansi ukuthi ahlangane namazinyo angaphezulu.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 29. Uhlelo Lwemisipha | 29.1 Izinhlobo Zezinhlelo Zamathambo | Uhlaka Lwezinzwa Zomuntu | Ikholomu Yomgogodla
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 29. Uhlelo Lwemisipha | 29.1 Izinhlobo Zezinhlelo Zamathambo | Uhlaka Lwezinzwa Zomuntu | Ikholomu Yomgogodla
chapterContent:
Ikholomu yomgogodla, noma ikholomu yomgogodla, izungeza futhi ivikele intambo yomgogodla, isekele ikhanda, futhi isebenza njengendawo yokunamathisela izimbambo nemisipha yomhlane nentamo. Ikholomu yomgogodla omdala inamathambo angu-26: ama-vertebrae angu-24, i-sacrum, namathambo e-coccyx. Kumuntu omdala, i-sacrum ivame ukwakhiwa ama-vertebrae amahlanu ahlangana abe yinye. I-coccyx ivame ukuba ama-vertebrae angu-3-4 ahlangana abe yinye. Cishe eminyakeni engu-70, i-sacrum ne-coccyx zingahlangana ndawonye. Siqala ukuphila ngama-vertebrae angaba ngu-33, kodwa njengoba sikhula, ama-vertebrae amaningana ahlangana ndawonye. Ama-vertebrae amadala ahlukaniswa ngokwengeziwe abe ama-vertebrae angu-7 omlomo wesibeletho, ama-vertebrae angu-12 e-thoracic, nama-vertebrae angu-5 e-lumbar (Isithombe 29.8).

 Umzimba ngamunye womgogodla unembobo enkulu phakathi nendawo lapho imizwa yomgogodla idlula khona. Kukhona futhi i-notch ohlangothini ngalunye lapho imizwa yomgogodla, ekhonza umzimba kulelo zinga, ingaphuma khona emgogodleni womgogodla. Ikholomu yomgogodla icishe ibe ngu-71 cm (28 amayintshi) kubantu besilisa abadala futhi igobile, okungabonakala ngokubuka eceleni. Amagama ama-spinal curves ahambisana nendawo yomgogodla lapho eyenzeka khona. Ama-thoracic curves nama-sacral curves agobile (agobile ngaphakathi maqondana nengaphambili lomzimba) kanti ama-cervical curves nama-lumbar curves aguquguquka (agobile ngaphandle maqondana nengaphambili lomzimba). Ukugoba okugobile kwekholomu yomgogodla kwandisa amandla ayo nokuguquguquka, okuvumela ukuthi imunce ama-shock anjengentwasahlobo (Isithombe 29.8).

 Ama-intervertebral disc akhiwe yi-fibrous cartilage aphakathi kwemizimba yomgogodla eseduze kusukela ku-vertebra yesibili yomlomo wesibeletho kuya ku-sacrum. I-disc ngayinye iyingxenye yelungu elivumela ukunyakaza komgogodla futhi lisebenza njengomcamelo wokumunca ama-shock asuka ekunyakazeni okufana nokuhamba nokugijima. Ama-intervertebral discs nawo asebenza njengemisipha yokubopha ama-vertebrae ndawonye. Ingxenye yangaphakathi yama-disc, i-nucleus pulposus, iyaqina njengoba abantu bekhula futhi iba yi-elastic kancane. Lokhu kulahlekelwa ukunwebeka kunciphisa ikhono layo lokumunca ukushaqeka
answer1: Ukuze uvikele umgogodla, usekele ikhanda, futhi unikeze izindawo zokunamathela izimbambo nemisipha
question2: Mangaki amathambo akha ikholomu yomgogodla yomuntu omdala?
question3: Mangaki amathambo omgogodla womlomo wesibeletho, wesifuba, nowe-lumbar akhona kumuntu omdala?
answer3: Amathambo omgogodla angu-7 omlomo wesibeletho, angu-12 esifuba, kanye namathambo omgogodla angu-5 omlenze ophansi
distractor3a: Amathambo omgogodla angu-8 omlomo wesibeletho, angu-10 esifuba, kanye namathambo omgogodla angu-6
distractor3b: Amathambo omgogodla angu-7 omlomo wesibeletho, angu-10 esifuba, kanye nangu-7 e-lumbar vertebrae
distractor3c: Amathambo omgogodla angu-5 omlomo wesibeletho, angu-12 esifuba, kanye nangu-7 e-lumbar
question4: Kungani abantu beqala ukuphila benamathambo angama-vertebrae angaba ngu-33 kodwa abantu abadala benamathambo angama-26 kuphela ekholomu yomgogodla?
answer4: Ama-vertebrae amaningana ayahlangana ukuze akhe i-sacrum kanye ne-coccyx
question5: Yini edlula emgodini omkhulu ophakathi kuwo wonke amathambo omgogodla?
question6: Uyini umsebenzi wezinotshi ezinhlangothini zomgogodla ngamunye?
answer6: Zivumela imizwa yomgogodla ukuthi iphume emgogodleni womgogodla
distractor6a: Zivumela igazi ukuthi lingene emathanjeni omgogodla
question7: Yimaphi amagophe omgogodla agobile uma kuqhathaniswa nengaphambili lomzimba?
question8: Iyini inzuzo yesimo esigobile samakholomu e-vertebral?
answer8: Kwandisa amandla nokuguquguquka ngenkathi kusiza ukumunca ukushaqeka
question9: Yimiphi imisebenzi eyinhloko yama-disc e-intervertebral?
answer9: Zivumela ukunyakaza okulinganiselwe, zimunce ukushaqeka, futhi zibopha amathambo aseduze ndawonye
question10: Kwenzekani ku-nucleus pulposus njengoba abantu bekhula?
answer10: Iyaqina, iba buthaka kancane, futhi ayimunci kahle ukushaqeka
distractor10a: Kuba mnene futhi kube nezimo eziguquguqukayo

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 29. Uhlelo Lwemisipha | 29.1 Izinhlobo Zezinhlelo Zamathambo | Uhlaka Lwezinzwa Zomuntu | Ikheji Lesifuba
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 29. Uhlelo Lwemisipha | 29.1 Izinhlobo Zezinhlelo Zamathambo | Uhlaka Lwezinzwa Zomuntu | Ikheji Lesifuba
chapterContent:
Ikheji lesifuba, elaziwa nangokuthi i-ribcage, liwuhlaka lwesifuba, futhi lakhiwe izimbambo, i-sternum, i-vertebrae yesifuba, kanye ne-cartilage ye-costal (Isithombe 29.9). Ikheji lesifuba lihlanganisa futhi livikele izitho zomgodi wesifuba, okuhlanganisa inhliziyo namaphaphu. Liphinde lisekele amabhande ehlombe kanye nemilenze engenhla, futhi lisebenza njengendawo yokunamathisela i-diaphragm, imisipha yomhlane, isifuba, intamo, kanye namahlombe. Izinguquko kuvolumu yesifuba zivumela ukuphefumula.

 I-sternum, noma ithambo lesifuba, yithambo elide, eliyisicaba elitholakala ngaphambili kwesifuba. Lakhiwa ngamathambo amathathu ahlangana nomuntu omdala. Izimbambo zingama-pair angu-12 amathambo amade, agobile anamathela ku-vertebrae yesifuba futhi agobe phambili komzimba, akha i-ribcage. Ama-cartilage e-Costal axhumanisa iziphetho zangaphambili zezimbambo ne-sternum, ngaphandle kwezimbambo 11 no-12, eziyizimbambo ezintantayo ngokukhululeka.
answer1: Izimbambo, i-sternum, i-thoracic vertebrae, kanye ne-costal cartilages
distractor1c: I-sternum, i-clavicle, kanye ne-vertebrae yomlomo wesibeletho
question2: Uyini umsebenzi oyinhloko wekheji lesifuba?
answer2: Ukuvikela izitho zomgodi wesifuba, okuhlanganisa inhliziyo namaphaphu
question3: Ngaphandle kokuvikela izitho zomzimba, iyiphi enye indima eyenziwa yikheji lesifuba?
answer3: Isekela amabhande ehlombe kanye nemilenze engenhla futhi inikeza izindawo zokunamathela kwemisipha
question4: Ikheji lesifuba lisiza kanjani ekuphefumuleni?
question5: Liyini elinye igama le-sternum?
question6: Yakhiwa kanjani i-sternum yabantu abadala?
distractor6b: Ikhula njengethambo elilodwa futhi ayilokothi ihlangane
question7: Zingaki izimbambo ezitholakala kubantu?
question8: Yini exhumanisa iziphetho zangaphambili zezimbambo eziningi ne-sternum?
question9: Yiziphi izimbambo ezintantayo futhi ezinganamatheli entanyeni?

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 29. Uhlelo Lwemisipha | 29.1 Izinhlobo Zezinhlelo Zamathambo | I-Skeleton Yomuntu Ehambisana Naso
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 29. Uhlelo Lwemisipha | 29.1 Izinhlobo Zezinhlelo Zamathambo | I-Skeleton Yomuntu Ehambisana Naso
chapterContent: Uhlaka lwamathambo oluhambisanayo lwakhiwe ngamathambo ezitho zangaphezulu (asebenza ukubamba nokuphatha izinto) kanye nezitho zangaphansi (ezivumela ukuhamba). Luhlanganisa nebhande lesifuba, noma ibhande lamahlombe, elinamathisela izitho zangaphezulu emzimbeni, kanye nebhande lesifuba elinamathisela izitho zangaphansi emzimbeni (Isithombe 29.10)
question1: Uyini umsebenzi oyinhloko wemilenze engenhla kuhlaka lwe-appendicular?
answer1: Ukuqonda nokuphatha izinto
question2: Uyini umsebenzi oyinhloko wemilenze engezansi kuhlaka lwe-appendicular?
question3: Yiziphi izakhiwo ezifakiwe kuhlaka lwe-appendicular?
answer3: Izingalo ezingaphezulu, izingalo ezingezansi, ibhande lesifuba, kanye nebhande le-pelvic
question4: Liyini elinye igama lebhande lesifuba?
question5: Uyini umsebenzi webhande lesifuba?
question6: Uyini umsebenzi webhande le-pelvic?
question7: Iyiphi ingxenye yamathambo ebangela ukuhamba kanye nokuphathwa kwezinto?

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 29. Uhlelo Lwemisipha | 29.1 Izinhlobo Zezinhlelo Zamathambo | Uhlaka Lwezitho Zomuntu | Uhlaka Lwesifuba
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 29. Uhlelo Lwemisipha | 29.1 Izinhlobo Zezinhlelo Zamathambo | Uhlaka Lwezitho Zomuntu | Uhlaka Lwesifuba
chapterContent:
Amathambo ebhande lesifuba ahlinzeka ngamaphuzu okunamathela kwezingalo ezingaphezulu kuhlaka lwethambo oluyindilinga. Ibhande lesifuba somuntu lakhiwe yi-clavicle (noma ithambo le-collarbone) ngaphambili, kanye ne-scapula (noma amahlombe) ngemuva (Isithombe 29.11).

 Ama-clavicle amathambo anomumo we-S abeka izingalo emzimbeni. Ama-clavicle alele ngokuvundlile ngaphambili kwesifuba (isifuba) ngaphezu nje kombambo wokuqala. Lawa mathambo abuthakathaka futhi asengozini yokuqhekeka. Isibonelo, ukuwa lapho izingalo zeluliwe kubangela ukuthi amandla adluliselwe kuma-clavicle, angaphuka uma amandla eqile. I-clavicle ihlangana ne-sternum kanye ne-scapula.

 Ama-scapulae amathambo asicaba, angunxantathu atholakala ngemuva kwebhande lesifuba. Asekela imisipha ewela ijoyinti lehlombe. Umgogodla, obizwa ngokuthi umgogodla, ugijima ngemuva kwe-scapula futhi ungazwakala kalula esikhumbeni (Isithombe 29.11). Umgogodla we-scapula uyisibonelo esihle sokuphuma kwamathambo okwenza kube lula indawo ebanzi yokunamathela kwemisipha emathanjeni.
answer1: Ukuxhumanisa izitho ezingaphezulu nohlaka lwe-axial
question2: Yimaphi amathambo akha ibhande lesifuba somuntu?
question3: Liyini elinye igama le-clavicle?
question4: Iyini ukuma kwe-clavicle?
question5: Kungani ama-clavicle esengozini enkulu yokuqhekeka?
answer5: Zidlulisela amandla ngokuwa ezingalweni ezeluliwe futhi zingaphuka ngaphansi kwamandla amakhulu
question6: Yimaphi amathambo i-clavicle ehlangana nawo?
question7: Liyini elinye igama le-scapula?
question8: Iyini umsebenzi oyinhloko we-scapula?
question9: Uyini umgogodla we-scapula?
answer9: Umugqa wamathambo ohlinzeka ngendawo ebanzi yokunamathela kwemisipha

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 29. Uhlelo Lwemisipha | 29.1 Izinhlobo Zezinhlelo Zamathambo | Uhlaka Lwezitho Zomuntu | Isitho Esingaphezulu
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 29. Uhlelo Lwemisipha | 29.1 Izinhlobo Zezinhlelo Zamathambo | Uhlaka Lwezitho Zomuntu | Isitho Esingaphezulu
chapterContent:
Isitho esingaphezulu siqukethe amathambo angu-30 ezindaweni ezintathu: ingalo (ehlombe kuya endololwaneni), ingalo (i-ulna kanye ne-radius), kanye nesihlakala kanye nesandla (Isithombe 29.12).

 Ukuhlangana noma yikuphi lapho kuhlanganiswa khona amathambo amabili. I-humerus iyithambo elikhulu nelide kunawo wonke lesitho esingaphezulu kanye nethambo elilodwa kuphela lengalo. Ihlangana ne-scapula ehlombe kanye nengalo engalweni. Ingalo ingalo isuka endololwaneni iye esihlakaleni futhi inamathambo amabili: i-ulna kanye ne-radius. I-radius itholakala ohlangothini lwengalo olungakwesobunxele (isithupha) futhi ihlangana ne-humerus endololwaneni. I-ulna itholakala ohlangothini oluphakathi (uhlangothi olupinki-nomunwe) lwengalo engalweni. Yinde kune-radius. I-ulna ihlangana ne-humerus endololwaneni. I-radius kanye ne-ulna nazo zihlangana namathambo e-carpal kanye nomunye nomunye, okwenza kube lula ukujikeleza kwe-carpus maqondana ne-axis ende yesitho. Isandla sihlanganisa amathambo ayisishiyagalombili e-carpus (isihlakala), amathambo amahlanu e-metacarpus (isundu), kanye namathambo ayi-14 e-phalanges (izinombolo). Inombolo ngayinye iqukethe ama-phalanges amathathu, ngaphandle kwesithupha, uma sikhona, esinamabili kuphela.
answer1: Amathambo angu-30
question2: Yiziphi izifunda ezintathu zengxenye engenhla yomzimba?
answer2: Ingalo, ingalo, kanye nesandla kanye nesandla
question3: Kuyini ukuhlanganiswa?
answer3: Indawo lapho amathambo amabili ehlanganiswa khona
distractor3a: Iphuzu lapho umsipha unamathela khona ethanjeni
question4: Yiliphi ithambo elikhulu nelide kunawo wonke esitho sangaphezulu?
question5: Yiliphi ithambo lengalo eliseceleni kwesithupha?
question6: Yiliphi ithambo lengalo elisehlangothini olufana nomunwe opinki futhi elide kune-radius?
question7: Yikuphi ukunyakaza okuvunyelwa ukuhlangana phakathi kwe-radius ne-ulna?
answer7: Ukujikeleza kwesihlakala nesandla maqondana nengalo engalweni
question8: Mangaki amathambo e-carpal akha isihlakala?
question9: Mangaki amathambo e-metacarpal akha intende yesandla?
question10: Zingaki izinhlayiya ezitholakala emunweni ngamunye nasesithupheni?
answer10: Umunwe ngamunye unama-phalanges amathathu, kanti isithupha sinama-phalanges amabili
distractor10a: Umunwe ngamunye unezimbobo ezimbili, kanti isithupha sinezintathu

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 29. Uhlelo Lwemisipha | 29.1 Izinhlobo Zezinhlelo Zamathambo | Uhlaka Lwezitho Zomuntu | Ibhande Lesifuba
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 29. Uhlelo Lwemisipha | 29.1 Izinhlobo Zezinhlelo Zamathambo | Uhlaka Lwezitho Zomuntu | Ibhande Lesifuba
chapterContent:
Amathambo ebhande le-pelvic ahlinzeka ngamaphuzu okunamathela kwemilenze engezansi ku-axial skeleton. Ngenxa yokuthi inesibopho sokuthwala isisindo somzimba kanye nokuhamba, ibhande le-pelvic linamathele ngokuqinile ku-axial skeleton ngemisipha eqinile. Liphinde libe nezimbobo ezijulile ezinemisipha eqinile yokunamathisela i-femur emzimbeni ngokuphephile. Ibhande le-pelvic liqiniswa ngokwengeziwe ngamathambo amabili amakhulu e-hip. Kwabantu abadala, amathambo e-hip, noma amathambo e-coxal, akhiwa ukuhlangana kwamathambo amathathu: i-ilium, i-ischium, ne-pubis. I-pelvis ihlangana ndawonye ngaphambili komzimba endaweni ebizwa ngokuthi i-pubic symphysis kanye namathambo e-sacrum ngemuva komzimba.

 I-pelvis yesifazane ihlukile kancane ku-pelvis yesilisa. Ezizukulwaneni eziningi zokuvela, abesifazane abane-angle ebanzi ye-pubic kanye nomsele omkhulu we-pelvic bazala ngempumelelo kakhulu. Ngakho-ke, inzalo yabo nayo yayine-anatomy ye-pelvic eyavumela ukubeletha okuphumelelayo (Isithombe 29.13)
answer1: Ukuxhumanisa izitho ezingezansi nohlaka lwe-axial nokusekela isisindo somzimba ngesikhathi sokuhamba
question2: Kungani ibhande le-pelvic linamathele kahle ohlakeni lwe-axial?
answer2: Ngoba ithwala isisindo somzimba futhi ibalulekile ekuhambeni
distractor2a: Ngoba ikhiqiza iningi lamaseli egazi emzimbeni
question3: Yisiphi isakhiwo esixhunywe kahle ebhandeni le-pelvic ngama-socket ajulile kanye nemisipha eqinile?
question4: Abizwa nangokuthi amathambo enqulu?
question5: Ithambo lesinqe elidala lakhiwa ukuhlangana kwamathambo amathathu?
question6: Amathambo amabili esinqe ahlangana kuliphi ilungu ngaphambili komzimba?
question7: Yiliphi ithambo elixhunywa yibhande le-pelvic ngemuva komzimba?
question8: I-pelvis yowesifazane ihluke kanjani kwi-pelvis yowesilisa?
answer8: Ine-angle ebanzi ye-pubic kanye nomsele omkhulu we-pelvic ukuze kube lula ukubeletha
distractor8a: Ine-angle encane ye-pubic kanye nomsele omncane we-pelvic
distractor8c: Ine-sacrum enkulu kodwa umsele omncane we-pelvic

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 29. Uhlelo Lwemisipha | 29.1 Izinhlobo Zezinhlelo Zamathambo | Uhlaka Lwezitho Zomuntu | Isitho Esingezansi
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 29. Uhlelo Lwemisipha | 29.1 Izinhlobo Zezinhlelo Zamathambo | Uhlaka Lwezitho Zomuntu | Isitho Esingezansi
chapterContent:
Isitho esingezansi sakhiwe yithanga, umlenze, kanye nonyawo. Amathambo esitho esingezansi yi-femur (ithambo lethanga), i-patella (i-kneecap), i-tibia kanye ne-fibula (amathambo omlenze), ama-tarsal (amathambo eqakala), kanye nama-metatarsal kanye nama-phalanges (amathambo onyawo) (Isithombe 29.14). Amathambo ezitho ezingezansi ajiyile futhi anamandla kunamathambo ezitho ezingenhla ngenxa yesidingo sokusekela sonke isisindo somzimba kanye namandla avela ekuhambeni. Ngaphezu kokuqina komzimba, amathambo omuntu ngamunye azosabela emandleni asetshenziswa kuwo.

 I-femur, noma ithambo lethanga, yithambo elide kunawo wonke, elisindayo, nelinamandla kunawo wonke emzimbeni. I-femur kanye ne-pelvis kwakha i-hip joint ekugcineni kwe-proximal. Ekugcineni kwe-distal, i-femur, i-tibia, kanye ne-patella kwakha i-kneecap. I-patella, noma i-kneecap, yithambo elingunxantathu elilele ngaphambili kwe-knee joint. I-patella ifakwa emsipha we-femoral extensors (quadriceps). Ithuthukisa ukwelulwa kwedolo ngokunciphisa ukungqubuzana. I-tibia, noma ithambo lomzimba, iyithambo elikhulu lomlenze elitholakala ngqo ngaphansi kwedolo. I-tibia ihlangana ne-femur ekugcineni kwayo okuseduze, kanye ne-fibula kanye namathambo e-tarsal ekugcineni kwayo okukude. Iyithambo lesibili ngobukhulu emzimbeni womuntu futhi inesibopho sokudlulisa isisindo somzimba kusuka ku-femur kuya onyaweni. I-fibula, noma ithambo lethole, lihambisana futhi lihlangana ne-tibia. Alihlanganisi ne-femur futhi alithwali isisindo. I-fibula isebenza njengendawo yokunamathela kwemisipha futhi yakha ingxenye eseceleni yejoyinti leqakala.

 Ama-tarsal angamathambo ayisikhombisa eqakala. Iqakala lidlulisela isisindo somzimba kusuka ku-tibia kanye ne-fibula kuya onyaweni. Ama-metatarsal angamathambo amahlanu onyawo. Ama-phalange angamathambo ayi-14 ezinzwane. Uzwane ngalunye luqukethe ama-phalange amathathu, ngaphandle kozwane olukhulu olunezimbili kuphela (Isithombe 29.15). Kunezinhlobo ezahlukene kwezinye izinhlobo; isibonelo, ama-metacarpals nama-metatarsal ehhashi aqondiswe phezulu futhi awaxhumani ne-substrate.
answer1: I-femur, i-patella, i-tibia, i-fibula, i-tarsal, i-metatarsal, kanye ne-phalanges
distractor1a: I-femur, i-humerus, i-radius, i-ulna, kanye ne-carpals
question2: Kungani amathambo ezitho ezingezansi ekhuluphele futhi eqine kunalawo ezitho ezingenhla?
answer2: Ngoba zisekela isisindo somzimba futhi zimelana namandla akhiqizwa ngesikhathi sokuhamba
question3: Yiliphi ithambo elide kunawo wonke, elinzima kunawo wonke, nelinamandla kunawo wonke emzimbeni womuntu?
question4: Yimaphi amathambo akha ijoyinti ledolo?
question5: Uyini umsebenzi oyinhloko we-patella?
question6: Uyini umsebenzi oyinhloko we-tibia?
answer6: Ukudlulisa isisindo somzimba sisuka entanyeni siye onyaweni
question7: Yisiphi isitatimende mayelana ne-fibula esinembile?
answer7: Ayithwali isisindo kodwa isebenza njengendawo yokunamathela kwemisipha futhi yakha ingxenye yelunga leqakala.
question8: Mangaki amathambo e-tarsal atholakala eqakaleni?
question9: Mangaki amathambo e-metatarsal atholakala onyaweni?
question10: Zingaki izinhlayiya ezitholakala ozwaneni ngalunye kanye nakubhozo olukhulu?

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 29. Uhlelo Lwemisipha | 29.1 Izinhlobo Zezinhlelo Zamathambo | Ukuvela Komklamo Womzimba Wokuhamba Emhlabeni
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 29. Uhlelo Lwemisipha | 29.1 Izinhlobo Zezinhlelo Zamathambo | Ukuvela Komklamo Womzimba Wokuhamba Emhlabeni
chapterContent:
Ukushintshela kwezilwane ezinomgogodla ziye ezweni kudinge izinguquko eziningana ekwakhiweni komzimba, njengoba ukunyakaza ezweni kuletha izinselele eziningana ezilwaneni ezijwayele ukunyakaza emanzini. Ukuntanta kwamanzi kunikeza inani elithile lokuphakamisa, futhi uhlobo oluvamile lokunyakaza yizinhlanzi ukuntanta okusemaceleni komzimba wonke. Lokhu kuhamba emuva naphambili kusunduza umzimba emanzini, kudala ukunyakaza phambili. Eziningi zezinhlanzi, imisipha yamaphiko abhangqiwe inamathela ezintanjeni zomzimba, okuvumela ukulawula ukuhamba. Njengoba izinhlanzi ezithile ziqala ukuhamba ziye ezweni, zagcina uhlobo lwazo lokuntanta olusemaceleni lokuntanta (i-anguilliform). Kodwa-ke, esikhundleni sokusunduza emanzini, amaphiko azo noma amaphini aba amaphuzu okuxhumana nomhlabathi, lapho zazizungeza khona imizimba yazo.

 Umphumela wamandla adonsela phansi kanye nokuntuleka kokuntanta emhlabathini kwasho ukuthi isisindo somzimba sasilenga emilenzeni, okwaholela ekuqineni okukhulu nasekuqineni kwamalungu. Umphumela wamandla adonsela phansi nawo wawudinga izinguquko emathanjeni e-axial. Ukuntanta okusemaceleni kwamakholomu omgogodla wezilwane zomhlaba kubangela ukucindezeleka kokugoba. Ikholomu yomgogodla eqinile nene-ossized yaba yinto evamile kuma-tetrapod omhlaba ngoba inciphisa ukucindezeleka ngenkathi inikeza amandla adingekayo ukusekela isisindo somzimba. Kuma-tetrapod kamuva, ama-vertebrae aqala ukuvumela ukunyakaza okuqondile kunokujika ohlangothini. Olunye ushintsho ku-axial skeleton kwaba ukulahlekelwa ukunamathela okuqondile phakathi kwe-pectoral girdle nekhanda. Lokhu kunciphisa ukugoba ekhanda okubangelwa ukushaya kwamalungu emhlabathini. Ama-vertebrae entanyeni nawo aguqukela ukuvumela ukunyakaza kwekhanda ngokuzimela komzimba.

 Uhlaka lwe-appendicular lwezilwane zasemhlabeni nalo luhlukile kwezilwane zasemanzini. Amahlombe anamathela ku-pectoral girdle ngemisipha nezicubu ezixhumanisayo, ngaleyo ndlela kunciphisa ukugoba kwekhanda. Ngenxa yekholomu yomgogodla egoba ohlangothini, kuma-tetrapod okuqala, amalungu ayephakanyiswe eceleni futhi ukunyakaza kwenzeka ngokwenza ama-push-up.” Amathambo alezi zilwane kwakudingeka ahambe eceleni ngendlela efanayo nezinhlanzi nezilwane ezihuquzelayo. Lolu hlobo lokunyakaza ludinga imisipha emikhulu ukuhambisa amalungu aye emgqeni ophakathi; kwakufana nokuhamba ngenkathi wenza ama-push-up, futhi akuyona indlela ephumelelayo yokusebenzisa amandla. Ama-tetrapod kamuva abeka amalungu awo ngaphansi kwemizimba yawo, ukuze isinyathelo ngasinye sidinge amandla amancane ukuze siqhubekele phambili. Lokhu kwaholela ekunciphiseni usayizi wemisipha ye-adductor kanye nobubanzi obuningi bokunyakaza kwe-scapulae. Lokhu futhi kuvimbela ukunyakaza ngokuyinhloko endaweni eyodwa, okudala ukunyakaza phambili kunokuhambisa amalungu phezulu kanye naphambili. I-femur kanye ne-humerus nazo zazijikeleziswa, ukuze iziphetho zemilenze nezinombolo zikhombe phambili, ngasendleleni yokunyakaza, kunokuba ziphume eceleni. Ngokubeka ngaphansi komzimba, amalungu angajika phambili njenge-pendulum ukuze akhiqize isinyathelo esisebenza kahle kakhulu sokuhamba phezu komhlaba.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 29. Uhlelo Lwemisipha | 29.2 Ithambo | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 29. Uhlelo Lwemisipha | 29.2 Ithambo | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent:
Ulwazi olukulesi sigaba alukho ngaphakathi kwe-AP® futhi aluhambisani nohlaka lwezifundo. Kodwa-ke, njengomfundi webhayoloji kubalulekile ukuqonda izinhlobo zamathambo nezicubu zamathambo kanye nemisebenzi yazo ngoba le ngxenye eyisisekelo ye-anatomy iyisibonelo esihle kakhulu sesimo esilandela umsebenzi. Isibonelo, izicubu zethambo ezithambile zitholakala engxenyeni yangaphakathi yamathambo futhi ziqukethe imithambo yegazi yokuletha izakhamzimba nokususa imfucuza emaseli ethambo.

 Ithambo, noma izicubu ezithambile, iyizicubu ezixhumanisayo ezakha i-endoskeleton. Iqukethe amangqamuzana akhethekile kanye ne-matrix kasawoti wamaminerali kanye nezintambo ze-collagen.

 Usawoti wamaminerali ikakhulukazi uhlanganisa i-hydroxyapatite, iminerali eyakhiwe nge-calcium phosphate. I-Calcification inqubo yokufakwa kukasawoti wamaminerali ku-matrix ye-collagen fiber eqinisa futhi iqinise izicubu. Inqubo ye-calcification yenzeka kuphela lapho kukhona izintambo ze-collagen.

 Amathambo ohlaka lomuntu ahlukaniswa ngesimo sawo: amathambo amade, amathambo amafushane, amathambo asicaba, amathambo e-sutural, amathambo e-sesamoid, namathambo angajwayelekile (Isithombe 29.16).

 Amathambo amade amade kunalawo abanzi futhi anomphetho kanye neziphetho ezimbili. I-diaphysis, noma umphetho ophakathi, uqukethe umphunga wamathambo emgodini we-medullary (marrow). Iziphetho eziyindilinga, ama-epiphyses, zimbozwe yi-articular cartilage futhi zigcwele umphunga wamathambo obomvu, okhiqiza amangqamuzana egazi (Isithombe 29.17). Iningi lamathambo emilenze ngamathambo amade—isibonelo, i-femur, i-tibia, i-ulna, kanye ne-radius. Okuhlukile kulokhu kufaka phakathi i-patella namathambo esihlakala kanye neqakala.

 Amathambo amafushane, noma amathambo e-cuboidal, amathambo anobubanzi nobude obufanayo, okwenza abe nesimo esifana ne-cube. Isibonelo, amathambo esihlakala (carpals) kanye neqakala (tarsals) amathambo amafushane (Isithombe 29.16).

 Amathambo ayisicaba ngamathambo amancane nabanzi atholakala lapho kudingeka khona ukuvikelwa okukhulu kwezitho zomzimba noma lapho kudingeka khona izindawo ezibanzi zokunamathela kwemisipha. Izibonelo zamathambo ayisicaba yi-sternum (ithambo lesifuba), izimbambo, i-scapulae (amahlombe), kanye nophahla lwekhanda (Isithombe 29.16).

 Amathambo angajwayelekile amathambo anezimo eziyinkimbinkimbi. Lawa mathambo angase abe nezindawo ezimfushane, eziyisicaba, ezineziqephu, noma ezinamaqhubu. Izibonelo zamathambo angajwayelekile amathambo amathambo, amathambo ezinqe, kanye namathambo amaningana ekhanda.

 Amathambo e-sesamoid amancane, ayisicaba futhi akhiwe ngendlela efanayo nembewu yesesame. Ama-patellae amathambo e-sesamoid (Isithombe 29.18). Amathambo e-sesamoid akhula ngaphakathi kwemisipha futhi angatholakala eduze kwamalunga emadolweni, ezandleni, kanye izinyawo.

 Amathambo e-sutural amathambo amancane, ayisicaba, angakheki ngendlela engavamile. Angatholakala phakathi kwamathambo ayisicaba ekhanda. Ziyahlukahluka ngenani, ukuma, usayizi, kanye nendawo

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 29. Uhlelo Lwemisipha | 29.2 Ithambo | Izicubu Zethambo
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 29. Uhlelo Lwemisipha | 29.2 Ithambo | Izicubu Zethambo
chapterContent: Amathambo abhekwa njengezitho zomzimba ngoba aqukethe izinhlobo ezahlukene zezicubu, njengegazi, izicubu ezixhumanisayo, imizwa, kanye nezicubu zamathambo. Ama-osteocyte, amaseli aphilayo ezicubu zamathambo, akha i-mineral matrix yamathambo. Kunezinhlobo ezimbili zezicubu zamathambo: eziqinile nezithambile

distractor1b: Ngoba ziqukethe izicubu zamathambo eziqinile kuphela
question2: Yisiphi izicubu ezilandelayo esitholakala emathanjeni?
question3: Ayini ama-osteocyte?
answer3: Amaseli aphilayo ezicubu zamathambo akha i-mineral matrix yamathambo
question4: Yiziphi izinhlobo ezimbili eziyinhloko zezicubu zamathambo?
question5: Yiluphi uhlobo lwezicubu zethambo olwakha ungqimba lwangaphandle oluqinile lwamathambo?
question6: Yiluphi uhlobo lwezicubu zethambo olunezikhala eziningi ezivulekile futhi oluvame ukutholakala ngaphakathi kwamathambo?

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 29. Uhlelo Lwemisipha | 29.2 Ithambo | Izicubu Zamathambo | Izicubu Zamathambo Ezincane
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 29. Uhlelo Lwemisipha | 29.2 Ithambo | Izicubu Zamathambo | Izicubu Zamathambo Ezincane
chapterContent: Ithambo elihlangene (noma ithambo le-cortical) lakha ungqimba lwangaphandle oluqinile lwawo wonke amathambo futhi lizungeze umgodi we-medullary, noma umongo wamathambo. Lihlinzeka ngokuvikelwa namandla emathanjeni. Izicubu zethambo ezihlangene zakhiwe ngamayunithi abizwa ngokuthi ama-osteon noma izinhlelo ze-Haversian. Ama-osteon ayizakhiwo ezisilinda eziqukethe i-mineral matrix kanye nama-osteocyte aphilayo axhunywe yi-canaliculi, athwala igazi. Ahlelwe ngokuhambisana ne-axis ende yethambo. I-osteon ngayinye iqukethe ama-lamellae, okuyizingqimba ze-compact matrix ezizungeze umsele ophakathi obizwa ngokuthi umsele we-Haversian. Umsele we-Haversian (umsele we-osteonic) uqukethe imithambo yegazi yethambo kanye nemicu yezinzwa (Isithombe 29.19). Ama-osteon ezicutshini zethambo ezihlangene ahlelwe ngendlela efanayo emigqeni yokucindezeleka futhi asiza ithambo ukuthi limelane nokugoba noma ukuqhekeka. Ngakho-ke, izicubu zethambo ezihlangene zivelele ezindaweni zethambo lapho ukucindezeleka kusetshenziswa khona ngezindlela ezimbalwa kuphela.
answer1: Ukunikeza isivikelo namandla emathanjeni
question2: Ithambo elincane litholakala kuphi?
answer2: Yakha ungqimba lwangaphandle oluqinile lwamathambo futhi izungeze umgodi ophakathi nendawo
question3: Zibizwa ngokuthini izingxenye zesakhiwo sethambo elihlangene?
question4: Ayini ama-osteon?
answer4: Izakhiwo ze-cylindrical ezakhiwe yi-matrix yamaminerali kanye nama-osteocyte aphilayo
question5: Ziyini i-canaliculi?
answer5: Iziteshi ezincane ezixhumanisa ama-osteocyte futhi zithutha igazi
question6: Ayini ama-lamellae?
answer6: Izendlalelo ze-compact bone matrix ezizungeze umsele waseHaversian
question7: Yiziphi izakhiwo ezitholakala ngaphakathi komsele we-Haversian (osteonic)?
question8: Kungani ama-osteon ehambisana ne-axis ende yethambo?
answer8: Ukusiza ithambo ukuthi limelane nokugoba nokuqhekeka emigqeni yokucindezeleka
distractor8c: Ukukhiqiza amaseli egazi ngendlela ephumelela kakhudlwana

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 29. Uhlelo Lwemisipha | 29.2 Ithambo | Izicubu Zamathambo | Izicubu Zamathambo Ezine-Spongy
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 29. Uhlelo Lwemisipha | 29.2 Ithambo | Izicubu Zamathambo | Izicubu Zamathambo Ezine-Spongy
chapterContent:
Nakuba izicubu zamathambo ezihlangene zakha ungqimba lwangaphandle lwawo wonke amathambo, ithambo eliyi-spongy noma ithambo eliyi-cancellous lakha ungqimba lwangaphakathi lwawo wonke amathambo. Izicubu zamathambo eziyi-spongy azinawo ama-osteon akha izicubu zamathambo ezihlangene. Esikhundleni salokho, zakhiwa ama-trabeculae, angama-lamellae ahlelwe njengezinduku noma amapuleti. Umnkantsha obomvu utholakala phakathi kwe-trabeculae. Imithambo yegazi ngaphakathi kwalesi zicubu iletha izakhamzimba kuma-osteocyte futhi isuse imfucuza. Umnkantsha obomvu we-femur kanye nengaphakathi lamanye amathambo amakhulu, njenge-ilium, kwakha amangqamuzana egazi.

 Ithambo eliyi-spongy linciphisa ubuningi bamathambo futhi livumela iziphetho zamathambo amade ukuthi zicindezeleke ngenxa yokucindezeleka okusetshenziswa ethanjeni. Ithambo eliyi-spongy livelele ezindaweni zamathambo ezingacindezelekile kakhulu noma lapho ukucindezeleka kuvela khona ngezindlela eziningi. Ama-epiphyses amathambo, njengentamo ye-femur, angaphansi kokucindezeleka okuvela ngezindlela eziningi. Cabanga ubeka isithombe esinohlaka olunzima phansi. Ungaphakamisa uhlangothi olulodwa lwesithombe nge-toothpick uma i-toothpick iqonde phansi kanye nesithombe. Manje bhoboza umgodi bese unamathisela i-toothpick odongeni ukuze ulengise isithombe. Kulesi simo, umsebenzi we-toothpick ukudlulisa ingcindezi ephansi yesithombe odongeni. Amandla esithombeni aqonde phansi, kodwa amandla ku-toothpick kokubili ucingo lwesithombe oludonsa phansi kanye nephansi lembobo odongeni oluphusha phezulu. I-toothpick izophuka ngqo odongeni.

 Intamo ye-femur ivundlile njenge-toothpick odongeni. Isisindo somzimba siyisunduzela phansi eduze kwejoyinti, kodwa i-diaphysis eqondile ye-femur iyisunduzela phezulu ngakolunye uhlangothi. Intamo ye-femur kumele ibe namandla ngokwanele ukudlulisa amandla ehla esisindo somzimba ngokuvundlile ku-shaft eqondile ye-femur (Isithombe 29.20)
answer1: Yakha ungqimba lwangaphakathi lwawo wonke amathambo
distractor1a: Yakha ungqimba lwangaphandle lwamathambo amade kuphela
question2: Yisiphi isici sokwakheka esihlukanisa ithambo elithambile nethambo elincane?
answer2: Ithambo elithambile liqukethe i-trabeculae esikhundleni sama-osteon
distractor2a: Ithambo le-spongy liqukethe imisele yaseHaversian kuphela

question6: Ithambo elithambile lisiza kanjani ekusebenzeni kwethambo?
answer6: Kunciphisa ukuqina kwamathambo futhi kuvumela ukuthi iziphetho zamathambo amade zicindezeleke ngaphansi kokucindezeleka
distractor6c: Ithatha indawo yethambo eliqinile ngesikhathi sobudala
question7: Ithambo elinjengesiponji litholakala kuphi kakhulu?
answer7: Ezindaweni lapho ukucindezeleka kuvela khona ngezindlela eziningi, njenge-epiphyses

answer8: Ngoba kumele imelane futhi isabalalise amandla avela ezindleleni eziningi

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 29. Uhlelo Lwemisipha | 29.2 Ithambo | Izinhlobo Zamaseli Emathanjeni
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 29. Uhlelo Lwemisipha | 29.2 Ithambo | Izinhlobo Zamaseli Emathanjeni
chapterContent: Ithambo lakhiwe izinhlobo ezine zamaseli: ama-osteoblast, ama-osteoclast, ama-osteocyte, namaseli e-osteoprogenitor. Ama-osteoblast angamaseli ethambo anesibopho sokwakheka kwamathambo. Ama-osteoblast akhiqiza futhi akhiphe ingxenye ephilayo kanye nengxenye engaphili ye-extracellular matrix yezicubu zamathambo, kanye nemicu ye-collagen. Ama-osteoblast abhajwa kulezi zinhlayiya futhi ahlukane abe ama-osteocyte angasebenzi kahle. Ama-osteoclast angamaseli amakhulu ethambo anama-nuclei afinyelela ku-50. Asusa isakhiwo samathambo ngokukhulula ama-enzyme e-lysosomal nama-acid ancibilikisa i-bony matrix. Lawa maminerali, akhishwa emathanjeni aye egazini, asiza ukulawula ukugcwala kwe-calcium emanzini omzimba. Ithambo lingaphinde lifakwe ukuze lilungiswe kabusha, uma ukucindezeleka okusetshenzisiwe kushintshile. Ama-osteocyte angamaseli ethambo avuthiwe futhi angamaseli ayinhloko ezicutshini ezixhumene namathambo; lawa maseli awakwazi ukuhlukana. Ama-osteocyte agcina isakhiwo esijwayelekile samathambo ngokuphinda asebenzise usawoti wamaminerali ku-bony matrix. Amaseli e-osteoprogenitor angamaseli e-squamous stem ahlukana ukuze akhiqize amaseli endodakazi ahluka abe ama-osteoblast. Amaseli e-osteoprogenitor abalulekile ekulungiseni ukuqhekeka
question1: Yiziphi izinhlobo ezine eziyinhloko zamaseli amathambo?
answer1: Ama-osteoblast, ama-osteoclast, ama-osteocytes, namaseli e-osteoprogenitor
question2: Uyini umsebenzi oyinhloko wama-osteoblast?
answer2: Ukwakha ithambo elisha ngokuhlanganisa nokukhipha i-matrix yethambo
question3: Kwenzekani kuma-osteoblast ngemva kokuba evaleleke ku-bone matrix ayikhiphayo?
question4: Uyini umsebenzi oyinhloko wama-osteoclast?
question5: Ama-osteoclast ancibilikisa kanjani i-bone matrix?
question6: Uyini umsebenzi oyinhloko wama-osteocyte?
answer6: Ukugcina izicubu zamathambo ngokuvuselela usawoti wamaminerali ku-matrix yamathambo
question7: Yimaphi amangqamuzana ethambo angakwazi ukwahlukana?
question8: Hlobo luni lwamaseli angamaseli e-osteoprogenitor?
answer8: Amaseli esiqu ahlukana ukuze akhiqize ama-osteoblast
distractor8a: Amaseli amathambo avuthiwe agcina izicubu zamathambo
question9: Kungani amangqamuzana e-osteoprogenitor ebalulekile?
answer9: Zidlala indima ebalulekile ekulungiseni ukuphuka kwamathambo

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 29. Uhlelo Lwemisipha | 29.2 Ithambo | Ukuthuthukiswa Kwamathambo
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 29. Uhlelo Lwemisipha | 29.2 Ithambo | Ukuthuthukiswa Kwamathambo
chapterContent: Ukwakheka kwethambo, noma i-osteogenesis, inqubo yokwakheka kwamathambo yi-osteoblasts. Ukwakheka kwethambo kuhlukile enkambisweni yokwakheka kwethambo; kanti ukwakheka kwethambo kwenzeka ngesikhathi sokwakheka kwethambo, kungenzeka nakwezinye izicubu. Ukwakheka kwethambo kuqala cishe emavikini ayisithupha ngemva kokukhulelwa kumbungu. Ngaphambi kwalesi sikhathi, uhlaka lwethambo lombungu luqukethe ngokuphelele ulwelwesi olunezintambo kanye ne-hyaline cartilage. Ukuthuthukiswa kwamathambo kusuka kulwelwesi olunezintambo kubizwa ngokuthi i-intramembranous ossification; ukuthuthukiswa kusuka ku-hyaline cartilage kubizwa ngokuthi i-endochondral ossification. Ukukhula kwamathambo kuyaqhubeka kuze kube cishe eminyakeni engu-25. Amathambo angakhula ngokuqina kuyo yonke impilo, kodwa ngemva kweminyaka engu-25, ukwakheka kwethambo kusebenza ngokuyinhloko ekulungisweni nasekulungisweni kwamathambo.
answer1: Inqubo yokwakheka kwamathambo yi-osteoblasts
question2: I-ossification ihluke kanjani ku-calcification?
answer2: Ukwakheka kwe-Ossification ukwakheka kwamathambo, kanti ukwakheka kwe-calcium kuwukufakwa kwamaminerali okungenzeka emathanjeni nakwezinye izicubu
distractor2a: Ukwakheka kwe-calcification kwakha ithambo, kuyilapho ukwakheka kwe-ossification kwenzeka kuphela ku-cartilage
distractor2c: Ukwakheka kwe-oss kwenzeka kuphela ngemva kokuzalwa, kuyilapho ukwakheka kwe-calcium kwenzeka ngaphambi kokuzalwa.
question3: Cishe nini ukuqala kwe-ossification ku-embryo esakhula?
question4: Yiziphi izicubu ezakha uhlaka lwe-embryonic ngaphambi kokuba kuqale ukubola?
question5: Kuyini ukubola kwezicubu ngaphakathi kwesikhumba?
question6: Kuyini i-endochondral ossification?
question7: Amathambo aqhubeka nokukhula ngobude aze abe neminyaka emingaki?
question8: Iyini indima eyinhloko yokwakheka kwe-ossification ngemva kweminyaka engaba ngu-25?

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 29. Uhlelo Lwemisipha | 29.2 Ithambo | Ukwakheka Kwamathambo Ngaphakathi Kwesikhumba
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 29. Uhlelo Lwemisipha | 29.2 Ithambo | Ukwakheka Kwamathambo Ngaphakathi Kwesikhumba
chapterContent: Ukwakheka kwe-ossification ngaphakathi kwe-membrane inqubo yokukhula kwethambo kusuka kuma-membrane ane-fibrous. Ihilelekile ekwakhekeni kwamathambo ayisicaba ekhanda, emadodeni, kanye nama-clavicle. Ukwakheka kwe-ossification kuqala njengoba amangqamuzana e-mesenchymal akha ithempulethi yethambo lesikhathi esizayo. Abe esehlukana abe ama-osteoblast esikhungweni se-ossification. Ama-Osteoblast akhipha i-matrix yangaphandle futhi abeke i-calcium, eqinisa i-matrix. Ingxenye yethambo noma i-osteoid engaxutshwe namaminerali iyaqhubeka nokwakheka izungeze imithambo yegazi, yakha ithambo eliyi-spongy. Izicubu ezixhumene ku-matrix ziyahlukahluka zibe umongo wethambo obomvu embungwini. Ithambo eliyi-spongy livuselelwa libe ungqimba oluncane lwethambo elihlangene ebusweni bethambo eliyi-spongy
answer1: Inqubo yokukhula kwamathambo kusuka kulwelwesi olunemicu
distractor1a: Inqubo yokuthuthukiswa kwamathambo kusuka ku-hyaline cartilage
question2: Yimaphi amathambo akhiwa ngokuyinhloko yi-ossification yangaphakathi kwe-membrane?
answer2: Amathambo ayisicaba ekhanda, i-mandible, kanye ne-clavicle
question3: Yimaphi amaseli akha kuqala ithempulethi yethambo lesikhathi esizayo ngesikhathi sokuqina kwezicubu ngaphakathi kwe-membrane?
question4: Amaseli e-mesenchymal ahlukaniswa abe uhlobo luni lwamaseli esikhungweni se-ossification?
question5: Yini ekhishwa ama-osteoblast ngesikhathi sokwakheka kwezicubu ngaphakathi kwesikhumba?
answer5: I-matrix yangaphandle kanye ne-calcium okuqinisa i-matrix
question6: Kuyini i-osteoid?
question7: Uhlobo luni lwethambo oluqala ukwakheka eduze kwemithambo yegazi ngesikhathi sokwakheka kwezicubu ngaphakathi kwesikhumba?
question8: Yini eba yizicubu ezixhumanisayo ngaphakathi kwethambo elikhulayo emntwaneni?
question9: Kwenzekani ethanjeni eliyi-spongy njengoba ukwakheka kwezicubu ngaphakathi kwe-membrane kuqhubeka?
answer9: Iphinde yakhiwe kabusha ibe ungqimba oluncane lwangaphandle lwethambo elincane elizungeze ithambo elinjengesiponji

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 29. Uhlelo Lwemisipha | 29.2 Ithambo | Ukwakheka Kwamathambo Ngaphakathi Kwe-membrane | Ukwakheka Kwamathambo E-Endochondral
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 29. Uhlelo Lwemisipha | 29.2 Ithambo | Ukwakheka Kwamathambo Ngaphakathi Kwe-membrane | Ukwakheka Kwamathambo E-Endochondral
chapterContent:
Ukwakheka kwe-endochondral kuyinqubo yokukhula kwethambo kusuka ku-hyaline cartilage. Wonke amathambo omzimba, ngaphandle kwamathambo ayisicaba ekhanda, i-mandible, kanye ne-clavicles, akhiwa nge-endochondral ossification.

 Emathanjeni amade, ama-chondrocyte akha ithempulethi ye-hyaline cartilage diaphysis. Esabela ezimpawini zokukhula eziyinkimbinkimbi, i-matrix iqala ukubala. Lokhu kubala kuvimbela ukusabalala kwezakhamzimba ku-matrix, okuholela ekutheni ama-chondrocyte afe kanye nokuvuleka kwemigodi ku-cartilage ye-diaphysis. Imithambo yegazi ingena ezimbotsheni, kanti ama-osteoblast nama-osteoclast aguqula i-calcid cartilage matrix ibe yithambo eliyi-spongy. Ama-Osteoclast abe esephula elinye lamathambo e-spongy ukuze akhe umgodi we-medullary, noma umongo, phakathi nendawo ye-diaphysis. Izicubu ezixhumeneyo eziminyene nezingavamile zakha i-sheath (periosteum) ezungeze amathambo. I-periosteum isiza ekunamathiseleni ithambo ezicutshini ezizungezile, imisipha, kanye nemisipha. Ithambo liyaqhubeka likhula futhi likhula njengoba amangqamuzana e-cartilage kuma-epiphyses ehlukana.

 Esigabeni sokugcina sokuthuthukiswa kwamathambo ngaphambi kokubeletha, izikhungo zama-epiphyses ziqala ukuba calcify. Izikhungo zesibili ze-ossification zakha kuma-epiphyses njengoba imithambo yegazi nama-osteoblast kungena kulezi zindawo futhi kuguqula i-hyaline cartilage ibe yithambo eliyi-spongy. Kuze kube yilapho umuntu esemusha, i-hyaline cartilage iyaqhubeka epuletini le-epiphyseal (ipuleti lokukhula), okuyisifunda esiphakathi kwe-diaphysis ne-epiphysis esibangela ukukhula kwamathambo amade ngobude (Isithombe 29.21)
answer1: Inqubo yokuthuthukiswa kwamathambo kusuka ku-hyaline cartilage
distractor1a: Inqubo yokukhula kwamathambo kusuka kulwelwesi olunemicu
question2: Yimaphi amathambo ANGAKWENZEKI ngokuqina kwe-endochondral?
answer2: Amathambo ayisicaba ekhanda, i-mandible, kanye ne-clavicles
question3: Hlobo luni lwamaseli akha ithempulethi yokuqala ye-hyaline cartilage emathanjeni amade?
question4: Kungani ama-chondrocyte efa ngesikhathi sokuqina kwe-endochondral?
answer4: Ukwakheka kwe-calcification ye-cartilage matrix kuvimbela izakhamzimba ukuthi zingasabalali kuzo
question5: Iyini indima yama-osteoblast ngemva kokuba imithambo yegazi ingena ku-cartilage ene-calcified?
answer5: Ziguqula i-calcite cartilage matrix ibe yithambo elinjengesiponji
question6: Uyini umsebenzi wama-osteoclast ngesikhathi sokwakheka kwe-endochondral ossification?
answer6: Basusa ithambo elithambile ukuze bakhe umgodi ogobile
question7: Iyini i-periosteum?
answer7: Isikhumba esiqinile esixhumanisa ithambo futhi sisize ukusinamathisela ezicutshini ezizungezile, imisipha, kanye nemisipha
question8: Zitholakalaphi izikhungo zesibili zokwakheka kwezicubu?
question9: Uyini umsebenzi wepuleti le-epiphyseal (ukukhula)?

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 29. Uhlelo Lwemisipha | 29.2 Ithambo | Ukukhula Kwamathambo (Ukwandiswa Kwamathambo Amade, Ukuqina Kwamathambo Amade)
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 29. Uhlelo Lwemisipha | 29.2 Ithambo | Ukukhula Kwamathambo (Ukwandiswa Kwamathambo Amade, Ukuqina Kwamathambo Amade)
chapterContent:
Amathambo amade ayaqhubeka nokukhula, mhlawumbe kuze kube yilapho esemusha, ngokufakwa kwezicubu zamathambo epuletini le-epiphyseal. Ayanda futhi ngobubanzi ngokukhula kwe-appositional.

 Ukwandiswa Kwamathambo Amade
Ama-Chondrocyte ohlangothini lwe-epiphyseal lwepuleti le-epiphyseal ayahlukana; iseli elilodwa lihlala lingahlukani eduze kwe-epiphysis, kanti iseli elilodwa liya e-diaphysis. Amaseli, asunduzwa e-epiphysis, ayavuthwa futhi abhujiswa yi-calcification. Le nqubo ithatha indawo ye-cartilage ngethambo ohlangothini lwe-diaphyseal lwepuleti, okuholela ekwandeni kwethambo.

 Amathambo amade ayayeka ukukhula cishe eneminyaka engu-18 kwabesifazane kanye neminyaka engu-21 kwabesilisa enkambisweni ebizwa ngokuthi i-epiphyseal plate closure. Phakathi nale nqubo, amaseli e-cartilage ayayeka ukuhlukana futhi yonke i-cartilage ithathelwa indawo yithambo. Ipuleti le-epiphyseal liyaphela, lishiya isakhiwo esibizwa ngokuthi umugqa we-epiphyseal noma i-epiphyseal residue, kanye ne-epiphysis kanye ne-diaphysis fuse.

 Ukujiya Kwamathambo Amade
Ukukhula kwe-Appositional ukwanda kobubanzi bamathambo ngokufaka izicubu ezinamathambo ebusweni bamathambo. Ama-Osteoblast ebusweni bamathambo akhipha i-bone matrix, kanti ama-osteoclast ebusweni bangaphakathi aphula ithambo. Ama-osteoblast ahluka abe ama-osteocyte. Ibhalansi phakathi kwalezi zinqubo ezimbili ivumela ithambo ukuba lijiye ngaphandle kokuba lisinde kakhulu.
answer1: Epuletini le-epiphyseal (ukukhula)
question2: Amathambo amade akhula kanjani ububanzi?
question3: Ngesikhathi sokwandiswa kwethambo elide, kwenzekani kuma-chondrocyte ohlangothini lwe-epiphyseal lwepuleti lokukhula?
answer3: Ziyahlukana, iseli elilodwa lisala eduze kwe-epiphysis kanti elinye liya ngase-diaphysis
question4: Ipuleti le-epiphyseal lisiza kanjani ekwandiseni amathambo?
answer4: I-cartilage ithathelwa indawo yithambo ohlangothini lwe-diaphyseal lwe-growth plate
distractor4a: Ithambo lithathelwa indawo yi-cartilage ohlangothini lwe-epiphyseal
distractor4b: Ithambo eliqinile likhula ngokulinganayo kusukela emaphethelweni womabili
question5: Kuyini ukuvalwa kwepuleti le-epiphyseal?
answer5: Inqubo lapho i-cartilage ithathelwa indawo ngokuphelele yithambo futhi ukukhula kwesikhathi eside kuyayeka
distractor5c: Ukuguqulwa kwethambo eliyisiponji libe yithambo eliqinile
question6: Cishe ngamuphi ubudala lapho amathambo amade eyeka ukukhula ngobude?
answer6: Cishe uneminyaka engu-18 kwabesifazane kanye no-21 kwabesilisa
distractor6a: Cishe iminyaka eyi-12 kwabesifazane kanye nengu-15 kwabesilisa
distractor6b: Cishe uneminyaka engu-25 kubo bobabili ubulili
distractor6c: Cishe iminyaka engama-30 kwabesifazane kanye neminyaka engama-35 kwabesilisa
question7: Yisiphi isakhiwo esisele ngemva kokuvalwa kwepuleti le-epiphyseal?
question8: Kuyini ukukhula kwe-appositional?
answer8: Ukwanda kobubanzi bethambo ngokufaka izicubu zethambo ebusweni
question9: Ama-osteoblast nama-osteoclast asebenza kanjani ndawonye ngesikhathi sokukhula kwe-appositional?
answer9: Ama-osteoblast anezela ithambo ebusweni obungaphandle kuyilapho ama-osteoclast esusa ithambo ebusweni obungaphakathi
distractor9a: Zombili izinhlobo zamaseli zengeza ithambo ebusweni obungaphandle
distractor9b: Zombili izinhlobo zamaseli zisusa ithambo ebusweni obungaphakathi
distractor9c: Ama-osteoblast asusa ithambo kuyilapho ama-osteoclast akha ithambo elisha

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 29. Uhlelo Lwemisipha | 29.2 Ithambo | Ukulungiswa Nokulungiswa Kwamathambo
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 29. Uhlelo Lwemisipha | 29.2 Ithambo | Ukulungiswa Nokulungiswa Kwamathambo
chapterContent:
Ukuvuselelwa kwamathambo kuyaqhubeka ngemva kokuzalwa kuze kube yilapho umuntu emdala. Ukuvuselelwa kwamathambo kungukushintshwa kwezicubu ezindala zamathambo ngezicubu ezintsha zamathambo. Kuhilela izinqubo zokufakwa kwamathambo yi-osteoblast kanye nokumuncwa kwamathambo yi-osteoclasts. Ukukhula kwamathambo okuvamile kudinga amavithamini D, C, no-A, kanye namaminerali afana ne-calcium, i-phosphorus, ne-magnesium. Ama-hormone afana ne-parathyroid hormone, i-growth hormone, ne-calcitonin nawo ayadingeka ukuze amathambo akhule kahle futhi agcinwe kahle.

 Amanani okuguquka kwamathambo aphezulu kakhulu, kanti amaphesenti amahlanu kuya kwayisikhombisa esisindo samathambo aphinde asetshenziswe njalo ngeviki. Umehluko ezingeni lokuguquka ukhona ezindaweni ezahlukene zamathambo nasezindaweni ezahlukene zethambo. Isibonelo, ithambo elisekhanda le-femur lingashintshwa ngokuphelele njalo ezinyangeni eziyisithupha, kanti ithambo eliseceleni komgodi lishintshwa kancane kakhulu.

 Ukuvuselelwa kwamathambo kuvumela amathambo ukuthi azivumelanise nokucindezeleka ngokuba makhulu futhi aqine lapho ecindezelwa. Amathambo angenakho ukucindezeleka okuvamile, isibonelo lapho isitho sisesigxotsheni, azoqala ukulahlekelwa isisindo. Ithambo eliphukile noma eliphukile lilungiswa ngezigaba ezine:

 Imithambo yegazi ethanjeni eliphukile iyadabuka futhi iphume igazi, okuholela ekwakhekeni kwegazi eliqhekekile, noma i-hematoma, endaweni yokuqhekeka. Imithambo yegazi eqhekekile emaphethelweni ethambo aphukile ivalwa yinqubo yokuqhekeka, futhi amangqamuzana amathambo aswele izakhamzimba aqala ukufa.
Ezinsukwini ezimbalwa ngemva kokuqhekeka, ama-capillary akhula abe yi-hematoma, futhi amangqamuzana e-phagocytic aqala ukususa amangqamuzana afile. Nakuba izingcezu ze-clot yegazi zingase zihlale, ama-fibroblast nama-osteoblast angena endaweni futhi aqale ukuguqula amathambo. Ama-Fibroblast akhiqiza imicu ye-collagen exhumanisa amaphethelo ethambo aphukile, futhi ama-osteoblast aqala ukwakha ithambo eliyi-spongy. Izicubu zokulungisa phakathi kwamaphethelo ethambo aphukile zibizwa ngokuthi i-fibrocartilaginous callus, njengoba yakhiwe yi-hyaline kanye ne-fibrocartilage (Isithombe 29.22). Amanye ama-spicule ethambo nawo angavela kuleli qophelo.
I-fibrocartilaginous callus iguqulwa ibe yi-bone callus yethambo eliyi-spongy. Kuthatha cishe izinyanga ezimbili ukuthi iziphetho zethambo eliphukile zihlanganiswe ngokuqinile ngemva kokuphuka. Lokhu kufana nokwakheka kwethambo le-endochondral, njengoba i-cartilage iba yi-ossified; ama-osteoblast, ama-osteoclast, kanye ne-bone matrix zikhona.
I-bony callus ibe isilungiswa kabusha ngama-osteoclast nama-osteoblast, bese kususwa izinto ezengeziwe ngaphandle kwethambo nangaphakathi kwe-medullary cavity. Ithambo elihlanganisiwe liyangezwa ukuze kudalwe izicubu zethambo ezifana nethambo lokuqala, elingaphukile. Lokhu kulungiswa kabusha kungathatha izinyanga eziningi, futhi ithambo lingahlala lingalingani iminyaka eminingi.
answer1: Ukufakwa esikhundleni kwezicubu ezindala zamathambo yizicubu ezintsha zamathambo
distractor1b: Ukuguqulwa kwethambo elihlangene libe yithambo elithambile
question2: Yiziphi izinhlobo ezimbili zamaseli ezibangela kakhulu ukuvuselelwa kwamathambo?
question3: Yimaphi amavithamini abalulekile ekukhuleni nasekugcinweni kwamathambo okuvamile?
question4: Amathambo asabela kanjani ekucindezelekeni okukhulu kwemishini?
question5: Kwenzekani emathanjeni angacindezeleki kahle, njengomlenze ofakwe ukhonkolo?
question6: Yini eyakha ngokushesha ngemva kokuphuka kwethambo?
question7: Yimaphi amangqamuzana akhiqiza imicu ye-collagen exhumanisa iziphetho eziphukile zethambo eliphukile?
question8: Iyini i-fibrocartilaginous callus eyenziwe ngayo?
question9: Yisiphi isakhiwo esithatha indawo ye-fibrocartilaginous callus ngesikhathi sokulungiswa kokuphuka?
question10: Kwenzekani esigabeni sokugcina sokulungiswa kwamathambo?
answer10: I-callus yamathambo iguqulwa ibe yithambo elifana nethambo lokuqala yi-osteoblasts kanye ne-osteoclasts.
distractor10a: I-hematoma iyanda futhi ithathe indawo yethambo

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 29. Uhlelo Lwemisipha | 29.3 Amalunga Nokunyakaza Kwamathambo | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 29. Uhlelo Lwemisipha | 29.3 Amalunga Nokunyakaza Kwamathambo | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent:
Ulwazi olukulesi sigaba alukho ngaphakathi kwe-AP® futhi aluhambisani nohlaka lwezifundo. Kodwa-ke, ulwazi olukulesi sigaba lubalulekile ekuqondeni ukuthi amalunga ahlinzeka kanjani ngokuqina ohlelweni lwamathambo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuqonda izinhlobo ezahlukene zamalunga kuzosiza umuntu aqonde ukuthi imisipha ikwazi kanjani ukuhambisa amathambo ngezindlela ezithile.

 Indawo lapho amathambo amabili noma ngaphezulu ahlangana khona ibizwa ngokuthi ilunga, noma ukuhlangana. Amalunga anesibopho sokunyakaza, njengokunyakaza kwamalungu, kanye nokuqina, njengokuqina okutholakala emathanjeni ekhanda.
answer1: Indawo lapho amathambo amabili noma ngaphezulu ahlangana khona
distractor1a: Iphuzu lapho umsipha unamathela khona ku-tendon
question2: Yiliphi elinye igama elisho i-joint?
question3: Yikuphi kokulandelayo okuwumsebenzi oyinhloko wamalunga?
question4: Yiziphi izakhiwo zomzimba ezibangela ukunyakaza okufana nokugoba izitho?
question5: Amalunga ekhanda asebenza kanjani ngokuyinhloko?
question6: Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza kahle indima yamalunga ohlelweni lwamathambo?
answer6: Zixhumanisa amathambo ngenkathi zivumela amazinga ahlukahlukene okunyakaza noma ukuzinza
question7: Yini enquma ukuthi ilunga lihlinzeka ngokunyakaza noma ukuqina?
answer7: Isakhiwo sayo kanye nendlela amathambo axhumene ngayo

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 29. Uhlelo Lwemisipha | 29.3 Amalunga Nokunyakaza Kwamathambo | Ukuhlukaniswa Kwamalunga Ngokwesisekelo Sesakhiwo | Amalunga Ane-Fibrous | Amalunga E-Cartilaginous | Amalunga E-Synovial
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 29. Uhlelo Lwemisipha | 29.3 Amalunga Nokunyakaza Kwamathambo | Ukuhlukaniswa Kwamalunga Ngokwesisekelo Sesakhiwo | Amalunga Ane-Fibrous | Amalunga E-Cartilaginous | Amalunga E-Synovial
chapterContent:
Kunezindlela ezimbili zokuhlukanisa amalunga: ngokusekelwe esakhiweni sawo noma ngokusekelwe emsebenzini wawo. Ukuhlukaniswa kwesakhiwo kuhlukanisa amalunga abe amalunga amathambo, aqinile, aqinile, kanye namalungu e-synovial kuye ngokuthi yini eyakha ilunga kanye nokuba khona noma ukungabikho kwesikhala esihlanganyelweni.

 Amalunga Aqinile
Amathambo amalunga aqinile abanjwe ndawonye yizicubu ezixhumene ne-fibrous. Akukho sikhala, noma isikhala, esikhona phakathi kwamathambo ngakho-ke amalunga amaningi aqinile awashukumi nhlobo, noma akwazi ukunyakaza okuncane kuphela. Kunezinhlobo ezintathu zamalunga aqinile: ama-suture, ama-syndesmoses, nama-gomphoses. Ama-suture atholakala kuphela ekhanda futhi anemicu emifushane yezicubu ezixhumene ezibamba amathambo ekhanda ngokuqinile endaweni yawo (Isithombe 29.23).

 Ama-Syndesmoses amalunga lapho amathambo axhunywe khona yibhande lezicubu ezixhumene, okuvumela ukunyakaza okwengeziwe kunasesithuthweni. Isibonelo se-syndesmosis yilunga le-tibia kanye ne-fibula eqakaleni. Inani lokunyakaza kulezi zinhlobo zamalunga linqunywa ubude bemicu yezicubu ezixhumene. Ama-gomphoses ayenzeka phakathi kwamazinyo nezisekelo zawo; leli gama libhekisela endleleni izinyo elingena ngayo esokhethini njengesikhonkwane (Isithombe 29.24). Izinyo lixhunywe esokhethini ngezicubu ezixhumene ezibizwa ngokuthi i-periodontal ligament.

 Ama-Cartilaginous Joints
Ama-Cartilaginous Joints angamajoyini lapho amathambo exhunywe khona yi-cartilage. Kunezinhlobo ezimbili zama-cartilaginous joints: ama-synchondroses nama-symphyses. Ku-synchondrosis, amathambo ahlanganiswa yi-hyaline cartilage. Ama-Synchondroses atholakala kuma-epiphyseal plates amathambo akhulayo ezinganeni. Ku-symphyses, i-hyaline cartilage imboza ukuphela kwethambo kodwa ukuxhumana phakathi kwamathambo kwenzeka nge-fibrocartilage. Ama-Symphyses atholakala emajoyini phakathi kwama-vertebrae. Noma yiluphi uhlobo lwejoyinti elinongwengwezi luvumela ukunyakaza okuncane kakhulu.

 Amajoyinti e-Synovial
Amajoyinti e-Synovial yiwona kuphela amajoyinti anesikhala phakathi kwamathambo aseduze (Isithombe 29.25). Lesi sikhala sibizwa ngokuthi umgodi we-synovial (noma ijoyinti) futhi sigcwele uketshezi lwe-synovial. Uketshezi lwe-Synovial luthambisa ijoyinti, lunciphisa ukungqubuzana phakathi kwamathambo futhi luvumela ukunyakaza okukhulu. Iziphetho zamathambo zimbozwe i-articular cartilage, i-hyaline cartilage, futhi lonke ijoyinti lizungezwe i-articular capsule eyakhiwe izicubu ezixhumanisayo ezivumela ukunyakaza kwejoyinti ngenkathi imelana nokuhlukana. Ama-capsule e-articular angase abe nemisipha ebamba amathambo ndawonye. Amajoyinti e-Synovial ayakwazi ukunyakaza okukhulu kakhulu kwezinhlobo ezintathu zejoyinti ezihlelekile; nokho, uma ijoyinti lihamba kakhulu, ijoyinti liba buthaka. Amadolo, izindololwane, namahlombe kuyizibonelo zamajoyinti e-synovial

chapterContent: Ukuhlukaniswa okusebenzayo kuhlukanisa amalunga ngezigaba ezintathu: i-synarthroses, i-amphiarthroses, kanye ne-diarthroses. I-synarthrosis ilunga elingashukumi. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ama-sutures, ama-gomphoses, kanye nama-synchondroses. Ama-Amphiarthroses amalunga avumela ukunyakaza okuncane, kufaka phakathi ama-syndesmoses kanye nama-symphyses. Ama-Diarthroses amalunga avumela ukunyakaza okukhululekile kwelunga, njengasemalungeni e-synovial.

chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nomsebenzi Wazo | 29. Uhlelo Lwemisipha | 29.3 Amalunga Nokunyakaza Kwamathambo | Ukunyakaza Kwamalunga E-Synovial | Ukunyakaza Okushelelayo | Ukunyakaza Okuyindilinga | Ukunyakaza Okujikelezayo | Ukunyakaza Okukhethekile
chapterContent:
Ububanzi bokunyakaza okuvunyelwe amalunga e-synovial bukhiqiza izinhlobo ezahlukene zokunyakaza. Ukunyakaza kwamalunga e-synovial kungahlukaniswa njengolunye lwezinhlobo ezine ezahlukene: ukushelela, i-angular, i-rotational, noma ukunyakaza okukhethekile.

 Ukunyakaza Okushelelayo
Ukunyakaza Okushelelayo kwenzeka njengoba izindawo zamathambo ezisicaba zihamba zidlulana. Ukunyakaza Okushelelayo kudala ukujikeleza okuncane kakhulu noma ukunyakaza kwe-angular kwamathambo. Amalunga amathambo e-carpal kanye ne-tarsal ayizibonelo zamalunga akhiqiza ukunyakaza okushelelayo.

 Ukunyakaza Oku-angular
Ukunyakaza Oku-angular kukhiqizwa lapho i-angle phakathi kwamathambo elunga ishintsha. Kunezinhlobo eziningana ezahlukene zokunyakaza kwe-angular, okuhlanganisa ukujiya, ukunwetshwa, i-hyperextension, i-abduction, kanye ne-circumduction. Ukujiya, noma ukugoba, kwenzeka lapho i-angle phakathi kwamathambo incipha. Ukuhambisa ingalo phezulu endololwaneni noma ukuhambisa isihlakala ukuhambisa isandla siye engalweni kuyizibonelo zokujiya. Ukwandiswa kuphambene nokujiya ngokuthi i-angle phakathi kwamathambo elunga iyanda. Ukuqondisa isitho ngemva kokujiya kuyisibonelo sokwelula. Ukwelula ngaphezu kwesimo esijwayelekile somzimba kubizwa ngokuthi i-hyperextension. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhambisa intamo emuva ukuze ibheke phezulu, noma ukugoba isihlakala ukuze isandla sisuke engalweni.

 Ukususwa kwenzeka lapho ithambo lisuka emgqeni ophakathi womzimba. Izibonelo zokuthunjwa ukuhambisa izingalo noma imilenze eceleni ukuze ziphakanyiswe ziqonde eceleni. Ukususwa ukuhamba kwethambo kuya emgqeni ophakathi womzimba. Ukunyakaza kwamalungu ngaphakathi ngemva kokuthunjwa kuyisibonelo sokwelula. Ukujikeleza ukuhamba kwesitho ngokunyakaza okujikelezayo, njengasekushukumiseni ingalo ngokunyakaza okujikelezayo.

 Ukunyakaza Okujikelezayo
Ukunyakaza Okujikelezayo ukuhamba kwethambo njengoba lijikeleza ku-axis yalo ende. Ukujikeleza kungaba ngasemgqeni ophakathi womzimba, okubizwa ngokuthi ukujikeleza okuphakathi, noma kude nomugqa ophakathi womzimba, okubizwa ngokuthi ukujikeleza okuseceleni. Ukunyakaza kwekhanda kusuka ohlangothini kuya kolunye kuyisibonelo sokujikeleza.

 Ukunyakaza Okukhethekile
Eminye intshukumo engenakuhlukaniswa njengokushelela, ukugoba, noma ukujikeleza ibizwa ngokuthi ukunyakaza okukhethekile. Ukuguquka kuhilela amathe izinyawo ahamba ngaphakathi, eya phakathi komzimba. Ukuguquka kuphambene nokuguquka, ukunyakaza kwephansi lonyawo ngaphandle, kude nomugqa ophakathi womzimba. Ukunyakaza ukunyakaza kwangaphambi kwethambo endaweni evundlile. Ukuhlehla kwenzeka njengoba ilunga libuyela esimweni ngemva kokuhlehla. Ukuhlehla nokubuyela emuva kungabonakala ekuhambeni kwe-mandible njengoba umhlathi uphonswa ngaphandle bese ubuyela ngaphakathi. Ukuphakama ukunyakaza kwethambo phezulu, njengalapho amahlombe ehlikihla, ephakamisa i-scapulae. Ukucindezeleka kuphambene nokuphakama—ukunyakaza phansi kwethambo, njengalapho amahlombe ehlikihla futhi i-scapulae ibuyela esimweni sayo esijwayelekile isuka endaweni ephakeme. I-Dorsiflexion ukugoba eqakaleni kangangokuthi izinzwane ziphakanyiswa ziye edolweni. Ukujiya kwe-Plantar kuwukugoba eqakaleni lapho isithende siphakanyiswa, njengalapho ume ngezinzwane. Ukugoba ukunyakaza kwamathambo e-radius kanye ne-ulna engalweni ukuze intende ibheke phambili. Ukujiya ukunyakaza okuphambene, lapho intende ibheke emuva. Ukuphikisana ukunyakaza kwesithupha kuya eminweni yesandla esifanayo, okwenza kube nokwenzeka ukubamba nokubamba izinto
