chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 29. Uhlelo Lwemisipha | 29.3 Amalunga Nokunyakaza Kwamathambo | Izinhlobo Zamalunga E-Synovial (Amalunga Ahleliwe, Amalunga E-Hinge, Amalunga E-Pivot, Amalunga E-Condyloid, Amalunga E-Saddle, Amalunga Ebhola Nesokhethi)
chapterContent:
Amalunga e-Synovial ahlukaniswa ngezigaba eziyisithupha ezahlukene ngokusekelwe ekubunjweni kanye nesakhiwo selunga. Ukuma kwelunga kuthinta uhlobo lokunyakaza oluvunyelwe yilunga (Isithombe 29.26). Lawa malunga angachazwa ngokuthi amalunga a-planar, hinge, pivot, condyloid, saddle, noma amalunga e-ball-and-socket.

 Amalunga A-Planar
Amalunga a-Planar anamathambo anezindawo ezihambisanayo ezinobuso obuyisicaba noma obugobile kancane. Lawa malunga avumela ukunyakaza kokushelela, ngakho-ke amalunga ngezinye izikhathi abizwa ngokuthi amalunga okushelela. Ububanzi bokunyakaza bunqunyelwe kula malunga futhi abubandakanyi ukujikeleza. Amalunga a-Planar atholakala emathanjeni e-carpal esandleni kanye namathambo e-tarsal onyawo, kanye naphakathi kwamathambo omgogodla (Isithombe 29.27).

 Amalunga e-Hinge
Emalungeni e-hinge, ukuphela okuyisiyingi kancane kwethambo elilodwa kungena ekugcineni okungenalutho kwelinye ithambo. Ngale ndlela, ithambo elilodwa liyahamba kanti elinye lihlala limile, njenge-hinge yomnyango. Ingqiniba iyisibonelo se-hinge joint. Idolo ngezinye izikhathi lihlukaniswa njenge-hinge joint eguquliwe (Isithombe 29.28).

 Ama-Pivot Joints
Ama-Pivot Joints aqukethe ukuphela okuyisiyingi kwethambo elilodwa okungena endandatho eyakhiwe elinye ithambo. Lesi sakhiwo sivumela ukunyakaza okujikelezayo, njengoba ithambo eliyindilinga lihamba lizungeze i-axis yalo. Isibonelo se-pivot joint yi-joint ye-vertebrae yokuqala neyesibili yentamo evumela ikhanda ukuthi lihambe liye emuva naphambili (Isithombe 29.29). I-joint yesihlakala evumela intende yesandla ukuthi iphendukele phezulu naphansi nayo iyi-pivot joint.

 Ama-Condyloid Joints
Ama-Condyloid Joints aqukethe ukuphela okuyisiyingi kwethambo elilodwa okungena embotsheni efanayo yethambo eliyisiyingi (Isithombe 29.30). Lokhu ngezinye izikhathi kubizwa ngokuthi i-ellipsoidal joint. Lolu hlobo lwelunga luvumela ukunyakaza kwe-angular ngemigqa emibili, njengoba kubonakala emalungeni esihlakala neminwe, okungahamba kokubili ohlangothini kuya kolunye kanye naphezulu naphansi.

 Amajoyinti Esihlalo
Amajoyinti Esihlalo abizwa kanjalo ngoba iziphetho zethambo ngalinye zifana nesihlalo, esinezingxenye ezigobile nezigobile ezihlangana ndawonye. Amajoyinti Esihlalo avumela ukunyakaza kwe-angular okufana namajoyinti e-condyloid kodwa anobubanzi obukhulu bokunyakaza. Isibonelo selunga lesihlalo yilunga lesithupha, elingahamba liye phambili naphambili naphezulu naphansi, kodwa ngokukhululeka kakhulu kunengalo noma iminwe (Isithombe 29.31).

 Amajoyinti Ebhola Nesokhethi
Amajoyinti Ebhola Nesokhethi anokuphela okuyindilinga, okufana nebhola kwethambo elilodwa okungena kusokhethi efana nendebe yelinye ithambo. Le nhlangano ivumela ububanzi obukhulu bokunyakaza, njengoba zonke izinhlobo zokunyakaza zingenzeka kuzo zonke izinkomba. Izibonelo zamajoyinti ebhola nesokhethi yilunga lamahlombe nesokhethi (Isithombe 29.32)

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 29. Uhlelo Lwemisipha | 29.3 Amalunga Nokunyakaza Kwamathambo | Ukuxhumana Kwabasebenzi | Isazi Sezifo Zamathambo
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 29. Uhlelo Lwemisipha | 29.3 Amalunga Nokunyakaza Kwamathambo | Ukuxhumana Kwabasebenzi | Isazi Sezifo Zamathambo
chapterContent:
Odokotela be-rheumatology bangodokotela abangochwepheshe ekuxilongeni nasekuphatheni izifo zamalunga, imisipha, namathambo. Baxilonga futhi belapha izifo ezifana ne-arthritis, izifo ze-musculoskeletal, i-osteoporosis, kanye nezifo ezizimele ezifana ne-ankylosing spondylitis kanye ne-rheumatoid arthritis.

 I-rheumatoid arthritis (RA) isifo sokuvuvukala esithinta kakhulu amalunga e-synovial ezandla, izinyawo, kanye nomgogodla wesibeletho. Amalunga athintekile ayavuvukala, aqine, futhi abe buhlungu. Nakuba kwaziwa ukuthi i-RA yisifo esizimele lapho amasosha omzimba omzimba ehlasela khona izicubu ezinempilo ngephutha, imbangela ye-RA ayaziwa. Amangqamuzana omzimba avela egazini angena emalungeni kanye ne-synovium okubangela ukuqhekeka kwe-cartilage, ukuvuvukala, kanye nokuvuvukala kolwelwesi lwamalunga. Ukuqhekeka kwe-cartilage kubangela amathambo ukuthi akhuhlane abangele ubuhlungu. I-RA ivame kakhulu kwabesifazane kunabesilisa futhi iminyaka yokuqala ivame ukuba yiminyaka engama-40-50 ubudala.

 Odokotela be-rheumatology bangaxilonga i-RA ngokusekelwe ezimpawini ezifana nokuvuvukala nobuhlungu bamalunga, i-X-ray kanye ne-MRI imaging, kanye nokuhlolwa kwegazi. I-Arthrography uhlobo lokuthwebula izithombe zezokwelapha zamalunga olusebenzisa i-ejenti yokuqhathanisa, njengedayi, engacaci kuma-X-ray. Lokhu kuvumela ukuthi izakhiwo zezicubu ezithambile zamalunga—njenge-cartilage, imisipha, kanye ne-ligaments—zibonwe. I-arthrogram ihlukile kwi-X-ray evamile ngokubonisa ubuso bezicubu ezithambile ezimboze ilunga ngaphezu kwamathambo amalunga. I-arthrogram ivumela izinguquko zokuqala eziwohlokayo ku-cartilage yamalunga ukuthi zitholakale ngaphambi kokuba amathambo athinteke.

 Okwamanje akukho ukwelashwa kwe-RA; noma kunjalo, odokotela bamathambo banezinketho eziningi zokwelapha ezitholakalayo. Izigaba zokuqala zingelashwa ngamanye amalunga athintekile ngokusebenzisa induku noma ngokusebenzisa izinti zamalunga ezinciphisa ukuvuvukala. Lapho ukuvuvukala sekunciphile, ukuzivocavoca kungasetshenziswa ukuqinisa imisipha ezungeze ilunga nokugcina ukuguquguquka kwamalunga. Uma umonakalo wamalunga ubanzi kakhulu, imithi ingasetshenziswa ukunciphisa ubuhlungu nokunciphisa ukuvuvukala. Imithi yokulwa nokuvuvukala njenge-aspirin, izinsiza zokunciphisa ubuhlungu, kanye nemijovo ye-corticosteroid ingasetshenziswa. Kungadingeka ukuhlinzwa ezimweni lapho umonakalo wamalunga unzima khona
answer1: Udokotela ochwepheshe ekuxilongeni nasekwelapheni izinkinga zamalunga, imisipha, namathambo

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 29. Uhlelo Lwemisipha | 29.4 Ukufinyela Kwemisipha Nokuhamba Kokuhamba | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 29. Uhlelo Lwemisipha | 29.4 Ukufinyela Kwemisipha Nokuhamba Kokuhamba | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterContent:
Imisipha inyakazisa amathambo, kanti futhi, ukufinyela kwemisipha kuncike ekufakweni kwezinhlelo zezinzwa. Imisebenzi ekuhlanganeni kwe-neuromuscular ifana nemisebenzi eyenzeka kuma-synapses phakathi kwama-neurons.

 Kunemisipha yamathambo engaba ngu-650 emzimbeni womuntu, ngayinye yayo yakhiwe ngemicu yemisipha. (Umzimba uqukethe nezicubu zemisipha ezibushelelezi nezikhethekile zenhliziyo.) Ngaphezu kokuqoqwa kwama-organelles ajwayelekile kumaseli e-eukaryotic, i-fiber ngayinye yemisipha iqukethe ama-myofibrils, nawo aqukethe ukuhlelwa kwe-filaments yamaprotheni ebizwa ngokuthi i-actin ne-myosin. Kumodeli ye-filament eshelelayo yokufinyela kwemisipha, imicu ye-myosin ejiyile inamabhuloho ahlanganisa futhi ahlukane ne-filaments ye-actin emincane. Ukubopha kwe-myosin ne-actin kubangela ukuthi imicu ye-actin ishelele, kufinyeze i-fiber yemisipha. I-ATP ekhiqizwa ekuphefumuleni kwamaseli inikeza amandla adingekayo ukuze kufinyele. Kodwa-ke, ukufinyela kudinga isignali evela ohlelweni lwezinzwa (ukuhlanganiswa kokukhushulwa nokwehliswa).

 Imizwa ehamba ngama-neuron e-motor ibangela ukukhishwa kwe-acetylcholine kusuka kuma-vesicles ku-axon terminus iye ku-synapse phakathi kwe-neuron kanye ne-muscle fiber. I-Acetylcholine ibopha kuma-receptors ku-plasma membrane (sarcolemma) ye-muscle fiber, okuvumela amandla esenzo ukuthi ahambe aye ku-endoplasmic reticulum lapho kugcinwa khona ama-ion e-calcium. Lapho i-Ca2+ ikhishwa ngenxa yokushintsha kwe-voltage, ibopha ku-actin, okubangela ukuthi ama-filament e-actin ashintshe isikhundla futhi aveze izindawo zokubopha ze-myosin zamabhuloho awelayo. Imisipha iyafinyela kuze kube yilapho i-nerve impulse iyeka futhi i-Ca2+ ibuyela ezindaweni zayo zokugcina. I-enzyme i-acetylcholinesterase isusa i-acetylcholine ehlala isikhathi eside ku-synaptic cleft.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyiswe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo echazwe ku-Big Idea 4 ye-AP® Biology Curriculum Framework. Izinhloso Zokufunda ze-AP® ezibhalwe ku-Curriculum Framework zinikeza isisekelo esicacile senkambo ye-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekuphenyweni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo neyodwa noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa.

 Amaseli emisipha akhethekile ukuze anciphe. Imisipha ivumela ukunyakaza njengokuhamba, futhi futhi yenza kube lula izinqubo zomzimba njengokuphefumula nokugaya ukudla. Umzimba uqukethe izinhlobo ezintathu zezicubu zemisipha: imisipha yamathambo, imisipha yenhliziyo, kanye nemisipha ebushelelezi (Isithombe 29.33).

 Izicubu zemisipha yamathambo zakha imisipha yamathambo, enamathela emathanjeni noma esikhumbeni futhi ilawule ukuhamba kanye nanoma yikuphi ukunyakaza okungalawulwa ngamabomu. Ngenxa yokuthi ingalawulwa ngemicabango, imisipha yamathambo ibizwa nangokuthi imisipha yokuzithandela. Imisipha yamathambo imide futhi ibukeka iyisilinda; uma ibukwa ngaphansi kwe-microscope, izicubu zemisipha yamathambo zinokubukeka okunemigqa noma okunemigqa. Ukuhlukana kubangelwa ukuhlelwa okuvamile kwamaprotheni ahlanganisiwe (i-actin ne-myosin). I-Actin iyiprotheni ehlanganisiwe ehlanganisa i-myosin ukuze kunciphe imisipha. Imisipha yamathambo iphinde ibe nama-nuclei amaningi akhona esitokisini esisodwa.

 Izicubu zemisipha ezibushelelezi zenzeka ezindongeni zezitho ezingenalutho njengamathumbu, isisu, kanye nesinye somchamo, kanye nezindawo ezizungezile ezifana nomgudu wokuphefumula kanye nemithambo yegazi. Imisipha ebushelelezi ayinazo izingqimba, ayilawulwa ngokuzithandela, ine-nucleus eyodwa kuphela ngeseli, incipha kuzo zombili izinhlangothi, futhi ibizwa ngokuthi imisipha engakhethi.

 Izicubu zemisipha yenhliziyo zitholakala kuphela enhliziyweni, futhi ukufinyela kwenhliziyo kupompa igazi emzimbeni wonke futhi kugcine umfutho wegazi. Njengemisipha yamathambo, imisipha yenhliziyo i-striated, kodwa ngokungafani nemisipha yamathambo, imisipha yenhliziyo ayikwazi ukulawulwa ngamabomu futhi ibizwa ngokuthi imisipha engakhethi. Ine-nucleus eyodwa ngeseli, inamagatsha, futhi ihlukaniswa ngokuba khona kwama-disk ahlanganisiwe.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 29. Uhlelo Lwemisipha | 29.4 Ukufinyela Kwemisipha Nokuhamba Kokuhamba | Isakhiwo Semisipha Yemisipha
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 29. Uhlelo Lwemisipha | 29.4 Ukufinyela Kwemisipha Nokuhamba Kokuhamba | Isakhiwo Semisipha Yemisipha
chapterContent:
I-fiber ngayinye yemisipha yamathambo iyiseli lemisipha yamathambo. Lawa maseli makhulu kakhulu, ane-dia amamitha efinyelela ku-100 μm kanye nobude obufika ku-30 cm. I-plasma membrane ye-fiber yemisipha yamathambo ibizwa ngokuthi i-sarcolemma. I-sarcolemma yindawo lapho isenzo siqhutshwa khona, okubangela ukufinyela kwemisipha. Ngaphakathi kwe-fiber ngayinye yemisipha kukhona ama-myofibrils—izakhiwo ezinde ezisilinda ezihambisana ne-fiber yemisipha. Ama-myofibrils asebenzisa ubude bonke be-fiber yemisipha, futhi ngoba angama-1.2 μm kuphela ububanzi, amakhulu kuya ezinkulungwaneni angatholakala ngaphakathi kwe-fiber eyodwa yemisipha. Anamathela ku-sarcolemma emaphethelweni awo, ukuze njengoba ama-myofibrils efinyela, lonke iseli lemisipha liyafinyela (Isithombe 29.34).

 Ukubukeka okunemigqa kwezicubu zemisipha yamathambo kuwumphumela wamabhande aphindaphindayo amaprotheni i-actin ne-myosin akhona ngobude be-myofibrils. Amabhande A Amnyama kanye namabhande e-I akhanyayo ayaphindana kuma-myofibrils, kanti ukuhambisana kwama-myofibrils esitokisini kubangela ukuthi lonke iseli libonakale liboshwe noma liboshwe.

 Ibhande ngalinye le-I linomugqa ominyene ohamba ngokuqondile phakathi nendawo obizwa ngokuthi i-Z disc noma umugqa we-Z. Amadiski e-Z aphawula umngcele wamayunithi abizwa ngokuthi ama-sarcomeres, okuyiyunithi esebenzayo yemisipha yamathambo. I-sarcomere eyodwa yisikhala esiphakathi kwamadiski amabili e-Z alandelanayo futhi iqukethe ibhande elilodwa eliphelele le-A kanye nezingxenye ezimbili zebhande le-I, elilodwa ohlangothini ngalunye lwebhande le-A. I-myofibril yakhiwa ama-sarcomere amaningi ahamba ngobude bayo, futhi njengoba ama-sarcomere encipha ngokwawo, amaseli e-myofibrils kanye nemisipha afinyela (Isithombe 29.35).

 Ama-myofibrils akhiwa izakhiwo ezincane ezibizwa ngokuthi ama-myofilaments. Kunezinhlobo ezimbili eziyinhloko zama-filaments: ama-filaments aminyene kanye nama-filaments amancane; ngalinye linezakhiwo nezindawo ezahlukene. Ama-filaments aminyene avela kuphela kubhande le-A le-myofibril. Izintambo ezincane zinamathela kuphrotheni ku-Z disc ebizwa ngokuthi i-alpha-actinin futhi zenzeka kulo lonke ubude be-I band bese zingena kancane ku-A band. Indawo lapho izintambo ezinkulu nezincane zihlangana khona inokubukeka okuxinene, njengoba kunendawo encane phakathi kwezintambo. Izintambo ezincane azinwebeki zingene kuma-A band, zishiya indawo ephakathi ye-A band equkethe izintambo ezinkulu kuphela. Lesi sifunda esiphakathi se-A band sibukeka silula kancane kunezinye ze-A band futhi sibizwa ngokuthi i-H zone. Isikhungo se-H zone sinomugqa oqondile obizwa ngokuthi i-M line, lapho amaprotheni asekelayo ebamba khona izintambo ezinkulu. Kokubili i-Z disc kanye ne-M line bamba ama-myofilaments endaweni ukuze kugcinwe ukuhlelwa kwesakhiwo kanye nokubekwa kwe-myofibril. Ama-Myofibrils axhumene ngezintambo eziphakathi, noma ze-desmin, ezinamathela ku-Z disc.

 Izintambo ezinkulu nezincane ngokwazo zakhiwe ngamaprotheni. Izintambo ezinkulu zakhiwe yi-protein myosin. Umsila we-molecule ye-myosin uxhumana namanye ama-molecule e-myosin ukuze akhe indawo ephakathi ye-filament ejiyile eduze komugqa we-M, kuyilapho amakhanda eqondana kuzo zombili izinhlangothi ze-filament ejiyile lapho i-filament encane ihlangana khona. Ingxenye eyinhloko ye-filament encane yi-actin protein. Ezinye izingxenye ezimbili ze-filament encane yi-tropomyosin ne-troponin. I-Actin inezindawo zokubopha ukuze kunamathiselwe i-myosin. Izintambo ze-tropomyosin zivimba izindawo zokubopha futhi zivimbele ukusebenzisana kwe-actin-myosin lapho imisipha iphumule. I-Troponin yakhiwe ama-subunit amathathu e-globular. I-subunit eyodwa ibopha ku-tropomyosin, i-subunit eyodwa ibopha ku-actin, kanti i-subunit eyodwa ibopha ama-ion e-Ca2+

chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 29. Uhlelo Lwemisipha | 29.4 Ukufinyela Kwemisipha Nokuhamba Kokuhamba | Imodeli Yentambo Eshelelayo Yokufinyela
chapterContent:
Ukuze iseli lemisipha lifinyele, i-sarcomere kumele ifinyele. Kodwa-ke, imicu emincane nemincane—izingxenye ze-sarcomere—ayifinyele. Esikhundleni salokho, iyashelelana, okwenza i-sarcomere ifinyele kuyilapho imicu ihlala inobude obufanayo. Ithiyori yemicu eshelelayo yokufinyela kwemisipha yathuthukiswa ukuze ivumelane nomehluko obonwe kumabhande aqanjwe ku-sarcomere ngamazinga ahlukene okufinyela kwemisipha nokuphumula. Indlela yokufinyela ukubopha kwe-myosin ku-actin, kwakha amabhuloho ahlanganisa ukunyakaza kwemicu (Isithombe 29.36).

 Lapho i-sarcomere ifinyele, ezinye izindawo zifinyele kanti ezinye zihlala nobude obufanayo. I-sarcomere ichazwa njengebanga eliphakathi kwama-disc amabili e-Z alandelanayo noma imigqa ye-Z; lapho imisipha ifinyele, ibanga eliphakathi kwama-disc e-Z liyancishiswa. Indawo ye-H—isifunda esiphakathi sendawo ye-A—iqukethe imicu emincane kuphela futhi ifinyeleliswa ngesikhathi sokufinyela. Ibhendi ye-I iqukethe imicu emincane kuphela futhi iyafinyela. Ibhande lika-A alifinyezi—lihlala linobude obufanayo—kodwa amabhande ka-A ama-sarcomere ahlukene asondelana ngesikhathi sokufinyela, ekugcineni ayanyamalala. Amabhande amancane adonswa yizintambo ezijiyile aye enkabeni ye-sarcomere kuze kube yilapho ama-Z disc esondela kumabhande amakhulu. Indawo yokuhlangana, lapho amabhande amancane namabhande amakhulu ahlala endaweni efanayo, iyanda njengoba amabhande amancane eqhubekela phambili.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 29. Uhlelo Lwemisipha | 29.4 Ukufinyela Kwemisipha Nokuhamba Kokuhamba | I-ATP Nokufinyela Kwemisipha
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 29. Uhlelo Lwemisipha | 29.4 Ukufinyela Kwemisipha Nokuhamba Kokuhamba | I-ATP Nokufinyela Kwemisipha
chapterContent:
Ukunyakaza kokufinyeza kwemisipha kwenzeka njengoba amakhanda e-myosin ebopha ku-actin futhi edonsa i-actin ngaphakathi. Lesi senzo sidinga amandla, anikezwa yi-ATP. I-Myosin ibopha ku-actin endaweni yokubopha ku-globular actin protein. I-Myosin inenye indawo yokubopha ye-ATP lapho umsebenzi we-enzyme ufaka khona i-ATP ku-ADP, ikhulule i-molecule ye-phosphate engaphili kanye namandla.

 Ukubopha kwe-ATP kubangela i-myosin ukuthi ikhulule i-actin, okuvumela i-actin ne-myosin ukuthi zihlukane. Ngemva kwalokhu, i-ATP esanda kubopha iguqulwa ibe yi-ADP kanye ne-phosphate engaphili, i-Pi. I-enzyme endaweni yokubopha ku-myosin ibizwa ngokuthi i-ATPase. Amandla akhishwa ngesikhathi se-hydrolysis ye-ATP ashintsha i-engeli yekhanda le-myosin ibe yisimo esigoqekile. Ikhanda le-myosin libe sesimweni sokuqhubeka nokunyakaza, linamandla angaba khona, kodwa i-ADP ne-Pi zisanamathele. Uma izindawo zokubopha i-actin zimboziwe futhi zingatholakali, i-myosin izohlala ekucushweni kwamandla aphezulu nge-ATP hydrolyzed, kodwa isanamathele.

 Uma izindawo zokubopha i-actin zingabonakali, kuzokwakhiwa ibhuloho eliwela; okungukuthi, ikhanda le-myosin lidlula ibanga eliphakathi kwama-molecule e-actin ne-myosin. I-Pi ibe isikhishwa, okuvumela i-myosin ukuthi isebenzise amandla agciniwe njengoshintsho oluguquguqukayo. Ikhanda le-myosin liyahamba liye emgqeni we-M, lidonsa i-actin kanye nayo. Njengoba i-actin idonswa, ama-filaments ahamba cishe ngama-10 nm aya emgqeni we-M. Lokhu kuhamba kubizwa ngokuthi i-power stroke, njengoba kuyisinyathelo lapho kukhiqizwa khona amandla. Njengoba i-actin idonswa iye emgqeni we-M, i-sarcomere iyafinyela futhi imisipha iyafinyela.

 Lapho Ikhanda le-myosin ligobile,” liqukethe amandla futhi lisesimweni samandla aphezulu. Lawa mandla asetshenziswa njengoba ikhanda le-myosin lihamba nge-power stroke; ekupheleni kwe-power stroke, ikhanda le-myosin lisesimweni samandla aphansi. Ngemva kwe-power stroke, i-ADP iyakhishwa; noma kunjalo, ibhuloho eliwelayo elakhiwe lisesekhona, futhi i-actin ne-myosin zihlanganiswa ndawonye. I-ATP ingabe isinamathela ku-myosin, okuvumela umjikelezo webhuloho eliwelayo ukuthi uqale futhi futhi ukufinyela kwemisipha okwengeziwe kungenzeka (Isithombe 29.37)

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 29. Uhlelo Lwemisipha | 29.4 Ukufinyela Kwemisipha Nokuhamba Kwezinyawo | Amaprotheni Alawulayo
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 29. Uhlelo Lwemisipha | 29.4 Ukufinyela Kwemisipha Nokuhamba Kwezinyawo | Amaprotheni Alawulayo
chapterContent:
Uma umsipha usesimeni sokuphumula, i-actin ne-myosin ziyahlukaniswa. Ukuze kuvinjwe i-actin ukuthi ingabophi endaweni esebenzayo ku-myosin, amaprotheni alawulayo avimba izindawo zokubopha ama-molecule. I-Tropomyosin ivimba izindawo zokubopha i-myosin kuma-molecule e-actin, ivimbela ukwakheka kwebhuloho eliwelayo futhi ivimbele ukugoba emisipheni ngaphandle kokufakwa kwemizwa. I-Troponin ibopha ku-tropomyosin futhi isiza ukuyibeka ku-molecule ye-actin; ibopha futhi ama-ion e-calcium.

 Ukuze kuvunyelwe ukugoba kwemisipha, i-tropomyosin kumele ishintshe ukwakheka, iveze indawo yokubopha i-myosin ku-molecule ye-actin futhi ivumele ukwakheka kwebhuloho eliwelayo. Lokhu kungenzeka kuphela lapho kukhona i-calcium, egcinwa ngamanani aphansi kakhulu ku-sarcoplasm. Uma ikhona, ama-ion e-calcium abopha ku-troponin, okubangela izinguquko zokwakheka ku-troponin ezivumela i-tropomyosin ukuthi isuke ezindaweni zokubopha i-myosin ku-actin. Uma i-tropomyosin isisusiwe, ibhuloho eliwelayo lingakheka phakathi kwe-actin ne-myosin, okubangela ukugoba. Ukujikeleza ngebhuloho eliwela ibhuloho kuyaqhubeka kuze kube yilapho ama-ion e-Ca2+ noma i-ATP engasatholakali futhi i-tropomyosin iphinde imboze izindawo zokubopha ku-actin
answer1: Ivimba izindawo zokubopha i-myosin ku-actin, ivimbele ukwakheka kwebhuloho eliwelayo
distractor1a: Ibopha ngqo ku-myosin ukuze iqalise ukufinyela
question2: Uyini umsebenzi oyinhloko we-troponin?
answer2: Ibopha kuma-tropomyosin nama-calcium ions ukulawula ukufinyela kwemisipha
question3: Yini okumele yenzeke ngaphambi kokuba i-myosin ikwazi ukubopha ku-actin?
answer3: I-Tropomyosin kumele isuke ezindaweni ezibopha i-myosin ku-actin
question4: Yini ebangela ukuthi i-tropomyosin isuke ezindaweni ezibopha i-myosin?

answer5: Ukuvimbela ukufinyela kwemisipha okungafuneki lapho imisipha iphumule
question6: Iyini ibhuloho eliwelayo?
answer6: Ukuxhumana kwakheka lapho ikhanda le-myosin libopha ku-actin
question7: Ukugibela ibhayisikili ngebhuloho eliwelayo kuyaqhubeka kuze kube yilapho kwenzeka yikuphi okulandelayo?
question8: Kwenzekani uma ama-ion e-calcium esuswa ku-sarcoplasm?
answer8: I-Tropomyosin iphinde imboze izindawo ezibopha i-myosin ku-actin, iqeda ukufinyela

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 29. Uhlelo Lwemisipha | 29.4 Ukufinyela Kwemisipha Nokuhamba Kokuhamba | Ukuxhumanisa Okujabulisayo Nokufinyela
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 29. Uhlelo Lwemisipha | 29.4 Ukufinyela Kwemisipha Nokuhamba Kokuhamba | Ukuxhumanisa Okujabulisayo Nokufinyela
chapterContent:
Ukuxhumanisa kwe-Excitation-contraction kuyisixhumanisi (transduction) phakathi kwamandla esenzo akhiqizwa ku-sarcolemma kanye nokuqala kokufinyela kwemisipha. Isisusa sokukhishwa kwe-calcium kusuka ku-sarcoplasmic reticulum kuya ku-sarcoplasm yisignali ye-neural. I-fiber ngayinye yemisipha yamathambo ilawulwa yi-motor neuron, eqhuba izimpawu ezivela ebuchosheni noma emgogodleni kuya emisipheni. Indawo ye-sarcolemma ku-muscle fiber exhumana ne-neuron ibizwa ngokuthi i-motor end plate. Ukuphela kwe-axon ye-neuron kubizwa ngokuthi i-synaptic terminal, futhi empeleni ayithinti i-motor end plate. Isikhala esincane esibizwa ngokuthi i-synaptic cleft sihlukanisa i-synaptic terminal ne-motor end plate. Izimpawu zikagesi zihamba nge-axon ye-neuron, exhuma ngemisipha futhi ixhumeke ku-muscle fibers ngayinye endaweni yokuhlangana kwe-neuromuscular.

 Amandla amaseli okuxhumana ngogesi adinga ukuthi amaseli asebenzise amandla ukudala i-gradient kagesi kuwo wonke ama-membrane amaseli awo. Lokhu kufinyela kwe-charge kuthwalwa ama-ion, asakazwa ngokuhlukile kuwo wonke ulwelwesi. I-ion ngayinye inethonya likagesi kanye nomthelela wokuhlushwa. Njengoba nje ubisi luzogcina luxubene nekhofi ngaphandle kwesidingo sokuxubha, ama-ion nawo asakazeka ngokulinganayo, uma evunyelwe ukwenza kanjalo. Kulesi simo, awavunyelwe ukubuyela esimweni esixubene ngokulinganayo.

 I-Sodium-potassium ATPase isebenzisa amandla eselula ukuhambisa ama-ion e-K+ ngaphakathi kweseli kanye nama-ion e-Na+ ngaphandle. Lokhu kukodwa kuqoqa ishaja encane kagesi, kodwa i-gradient enkulu yokuhlushwa. Kukhona i-K+ eningi esiseleni kanye ne-Na+ eningi ngaphandle kweseli. I-Potassium iyakwazi ukushiya iseli ngeziteshi ze-K+ ezivulekile isikhathi esingu-90%, futhi iyasebenza. Kodwa-ke, iziteshi ze-Na+ azivamile ukuvulwa, ngakho-ke i-Na+ ihlala ngaphandle kweseli. Lapho i-K+ ishiya iseli, ilalela i-gradient yayo yokuhlushwa, lokho kushiya ishaja engemihle ngemuva. Ngakho-ke ekuphumuleni, kukhona i-gradient enkulu yokuhlushwa ukuze i-Na+ ingene esiseleni, futhi kukhona ukuqongelela kwezindleko ezingemihle ezisele esiseleni. Lokhu kuyikhono lokuphumula le-membrane. I-potential kulo mongo isho ukuhlukaniswa kweshaja kagesi ekwaziyo ukwenza umsebenzi. Ilinganiswa ngama-volts, njengebhethri. Kodwa-ke, i-transmembrane potential incane kakhulu (0.07 V); ngakho-ke, inani elincane livezwa njenge-millivolts (mV) noma i-70 mV. Ngenxa yokuthi ingaphakathi leseli liyi-negative uma liqhathaniswa nengaphandle, uphawu lokususa lubonisa ukweqisa kwe-negative charges ngaphakathi kweseli, −70 mV.

 Uma isenzakalo sishintsha ukuvuleka kwe-membrane ibe yi-Na+ ion, zizongena esiseleni. Lokho kuzoshintsha i-voltage. Lesi yisenzakalo sikagesi, esibizwa ngokuthi i-action potential, esingasetshenziswa njengesignali yeselula. Ukuxhumana kwenzeka phakathi kwezinzwa nemisipha ngama-neurotransmitters. I-neuron action potentials ibangela ukukhishwa kwama-neurotransmitters avela esigungwini se-synaptic aye e-synaptic cleft, lapho angasakazeka khona ngaphesheya kwe-synaptic cleft bese ebopha i-receptor molecule epuletini lokugcina le-motor. Ipuleti lokugcina lemoto linemigoqo ehlangene—imigoqo e-sarcolemma edala indawo enkulu ukuze i-neurotransmitter ibophe kuma-receptor. Ama-receptor empeleni ayiziteshi ze-sodium ezivulekayo ukuvumela ukudlula kwe-Na+ kuseli lapho ethola isignali ye-neurotransmitter.

 I-Acetylcholine (ACh) iyi-neurotransmitter ekhishwa ama-neuron emoto ebopha kuma-receptor kupuleti lokugcina lemoto. Ukukhululwa kwe-neurotransmitter kwenzeka lapho amandla esenzo ehamba phansi kwe-axon ye-neuron yemoto, okuholela ekushintsheni kokungena kwe-membrane ye-synaptic terminal kanye nokungena kwe-calcium. Ama-ion e-Ca2+ avumela ama-vesicle e-synaptic ukuthi ahambe futhi abophane ne-membrane ye-presynaptic (ku-neuron), futhi akhulule i-neurotransmitter kuma-vesicles aye ku-synaptic cleft. Uma ikhishwe yi-terminal ye-synaptic, i-ACh iyasabalala ngaphesheya kwe-synaptic cleft iye kupuleti lokugcina lemoto, lapho ibopha khona ngama-receptor e-ACh. Njengoba i-neurotransmitter ibopha, lawa ma-ion channel ayavuleka, futhi ama-Na+ ions awela i-membrane aye kuseli lemisipha. Lokhu kunciphisa umehluko we-voltage phakathi kwangaphakathi nangaphandle kweseli, okubizwa ngokuthi i-depolarization. Njengoba i-ACh ibopha epuletini lokugcina le-motor, lokhu ku-depolarization kubizwa ngokuthi i-end-plate potential. I-depolarization bese isakazeka eduze kwe-sarcolemma, idale i-action potential njengoba iziteshi ze-sodium eziseduze nendawo yokuqala ye-depolarization zizwa ushintsho ku-voltage futhi zivuleka. I-action potential ihamba kulo lonke iseli, idale igagasi le-depolarization.

 I-ACh ihlukaniswa yi-enzyme i-acetylcholinesterase (AChE) ibe yi-acetyl ne-choline. I-AChE ihlala ku-synaptic cleft, iphula i-ACh ukuze ingahlali iboshiwe kuma-receptor e-ACh, okungabangela ukufinyela kwemisipha okungafuneki (Isithombe 29.38).

 Ngemva kwe-depolarization, i-membrane ibuyela esimweni sayo sokuphumula. Lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi i-repolarization, lapho iziteshi ze-sodium ezivalwe nge-voltage. Iziteshi ze-potassium ziqhubeka no-90% conductance. Ngenxa yokuthi i-plasma membrane i-sodium-potassium ATPase ihlala ithutha ama-ion, isimo sokuphumula (esishajelwe ngaphakathi uma kuqhathaniswa nengaphandle) siyabuyiselwa. Isikhathi esilandela ngokushesha ukudluliselwa kwe-impulse emsipheni noma emisipheni, lapho i-neuron noma iseli lemisipha lithola khona ikhono lalo lokudlulisa omunye umsiphe, sibizwa ngokuthi isikhathi sokungaphenduli. Ngesikhathi sokungaphenduli, i-membrane ayikwazi ukukhiqiza elinye ikhono lesenzo. . Isikhathi sokungaphenduli sivumela iziteshi ze-ion ezizwela i-voltage ukuthi zibuyele ekubunjweni kwazo kokuphumula. I-sodium potassium ATPase iqhubeka nokuhambisa i-Na+ emuva esitokisini kanye ne-K+ emuva esitokisini, kanti i-K+ iyavuza ishiya i-negative charge ngemuva. Ngokushesha kakhulu, i-membrane iyaphinda i-polarized, ukuze iphinde isuswe i-polarized.

chapterName: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 29. Uhlelo Lwemisipha | 29.4 Ukufinyela Kwemisipha Nokuhamba Kokuhamba | Ukulawula Ukucindezeleka Kwemisipha
chapterNameEnglish: 7. Isakhiwo Sezilwane Nokusebenza Kwazo | 29. Uhlelo Lwemisipha | 29.4 Ukufinyela Kwemisipha Nokuhamba Kokuhamba | Ukulawula Ukucindezeleka Kwemisipha
chapterContent:
Ukulawulwa kwemizwa kuqala ukwakheka kwamabhuloho okuwela imisipha e-actin-myosin, okuholela ekufinyeleni kwe-sarcomere okubandakanyeka ekufinyeleni kwemisipha. Lokhu kufinyela kusuka ku-fiber yemisipha ngezicubu ezixhumanisayo ukuze kudonse amathambo, okubangela ukunyakaza kwamathambo. Ukudonsa okwenziwa yimisipha kubizwa ngokuthi ukucindezelwa, futhi inani lamandla adalwe yilokhu kucindezelwa lingahluka. Lokhu kwenza imisipha efanayo ikwazi ukuhambisa izinto ezilula kakhulu nezinto ezisindayo kakhulu. Emicubeni yemisipha ngayinye, inani lokucindezelwa okukhiqizwayo lincike endaweni enqamulayo ye-fiber yemisipha kanye nokuvama kokukhuthazwa kwemizwa.

 Inani lamabhuloho okuwela akhiwa phakathi kwe-actin ne-myosin linquma inani lokucindezelwa okungakhiqizwa yi-fiber yemisipha. Amabhuloho okuwela angakheka kuphela lapho imicu emikhulu nemincane ihlangana khona, okuvumela i-myosin ukuthi ibophe ku-actin. Uma kwakheka imicu eminingi yokuwela, i-myosin eyengeziwe izodonsa i-actin, futhi kuzokhiqizwa ukucindezelwa okwengeziwe.

 Ubude obuhle be-sarcomere ngesikhathi sokukhiqizwa kokucindezelwa okukhulu kwenzeka lapho imicu emikhulu nemincane ihlangana ngezinga elikhulu kakhulu. Uma i-sarcomere ephumule yeluliwe idlule ubude obufanele bokuphumula, imicu emikhulu nemincane ayihlangani ngezinga elikhulu, futhi kungakhiwa imicu embalwa yokuwela. Lokhu kuphumela emakhanda amancane e-myosin adonsa i-actin, futhi kukhiqizwa ukucindezeleka okuncane. Njengoba i-sarcomere ifinyezwa, indawo yokuwela iyancishiswa njengoba imicu emincane ifika endaweni ye-H, eyakhiwe yimisila ye-myosin. Ngenxa yokuthi amakhanda e-myosin akha imicu yokuwela, i-actin ngeke ibophezele ku-myosin kule ndawo, inciphise ukucindezeleka okukhiqizwa yile myofiber. Uma i-sarcomere ifinyezwa kakhulu, imicu emincane iqala ukuwelana—kunciphisa ukwakheka kwebhuloho lokuwela ngisho nakakhulu, futhi kukhiqize ukucindezeleka okuncane nakakhulu. Ngokuphambene nalokho, uma i-sarcomere yeluliwe kuze kube yilapho imicu emikhulu nemincane ingahlangani nhlobo, akukho micu yokuwela eyakhiwayo futhi akukho ukucindezeleka okukhiqizwayo. Leli nani lokuwela alivamile ukwenzeka ngoba amaprotheni asekelayo, izinzwa zangaphakathi zemizwa, kanye nezicubu ezixhumeneyo ziphikisana nokwelula okukhulu.

 Ukuguquguquka okuyinhloko okunquma ukukhiqizwa kwamandla yinani lama-myofiber ngaphakathi kwemisipha ethola amandla okwenza isenzo kusuka ku-neuron elawula leyo fiber. Uma usebenzisa ama-biceps ukuze ubambe ipensela, i-motor cortex yobuchopho ikhombisa ama-neurons ambalwa kuphela e-biceps, futhi ambalwa kuphela ama-myofiber aphendulayo. Ezilwaneni ezinomgogodla, i-myofiber ngayinye iphendula ngokugcwele uma ishukunyiswa. Lapho ithatha upiyano, i-motor cortex ikhombisa wonke ama-neurons kuma-biceps futhi yonke i-myofiber iyahlanganyela. Lokhu kuseduze namandla aphezulu imisipha engawakhiqiza. Njengoba kushiwo ngenhla, ukwandisa imvamisa yamandla okwenza isenzo (inani lezibonakaliso ngomzuzwana) kungandisa amandla kancane, ngoba i-tropomyosin igcwele i-calcium
answer1: Amandla okudonsa asetshenziswa umsipha ofinyelayo
question2: Ku-fiber yemisipha ngayinye, yiziphi izici ezimbili ezinquma inani lokucindezeleka okukhiqizwayo?
answer2: Indawo ye-muscle fibers cross-sectional kanye nemvamisa yokuvuselelwa kwemizwa

distractor2b: Inani lamathambo anamathele ekugxilweni kwemisipha kanye ne-ATP
distractor2c: Ubudala be-fiber yemisipha kanye nenani lezicubu ezixhumeneyo

answer3: Inani lamabhuloho awela phakathi kwe-actin ne-myosin

answer4: Uma imicu emikhulu nemincane ihlangana ngezinga elikhulu kakhulu

answer5: Ngoba kukhona ukufana okuncane phakathi kwezintambo ezijiyile nezincane, okuholela ekuncipheni kokuxhumana
question6: Kungani ukufinyeza ngokweqile kwe-sarcomere kunciphisa ukucindezeleka?
answer6: Ngoba imicu emincane iyagoqana futhi ukwakheka kwebhuloho eliwelayo kuyancipha
question7: Iyini isici esiyinhloko esinquma amandla aphelele akhiqizwa yimisipha yonke?
answer7: Inani lemicu yemisipha ethola amandla okwenza okuthile
question8: Isimiso sezinzwa siwandisa kanjani amandla okufinyela kwemisipha lapho siphakamisa into esindayo?
answer8: Ngokusebenzisa ama-neuron amaningi ukuze imicu eminingi yemisipha ifinyele
question9: Ukwandisa imvamisa yamandla esenzo kungawandisa kanjani amandla emisipha kancane?
answer9: Ngokulondoloza amazinga aphezulu e-calcium azungeze i-troponin, okuvumela ukwakheka okuqhubekayo kwebhuloho eliwelayo

chapterContent:
29.1 Izinhlobo Zezinhlelo Zamathambo
Izinhlobo ezintathu zemiklamo yamathambo yizinhlayiya ze-hydrostatic, ama-exoskeleton, nama-endoskeleton. Uhlaka lwe-hydrostatic lwakhiwa ngendawo egcwele uketshezi ebanjwe ngaphansi kwengcindezi ye-hydrostatic; ukunyakaza kudalwe yimisipha ekhiqiza ingcindezi kuketshezi. I-exoskeleton uhlaka lwangaphandle oluqinile oluvikela ubuso bangaphandle bento ephilayo futhi luvumela ukunyakaza ngemisipha enamathele ngaphakathi. I-endoskeleton uhlaka lwangaphakathi olwakhiwe yizicubu eziqinile, ezinamaminerali ezivumela ukunyakaza ngokunamathela emisipheni. Uhlaka lwe-skeleton lomuntu luhlaka lwe-endoskeleton olwakhiwe uhlaka lwe-axial kanye ne-appendicular. Uhlaka lwe-axial lwakhiwe ngamathambo ekhanda, ama-ossicles endlebe, ithambo le-hyoid, ikholomu ye-vertebral, kanye ne-ribcage. Uhlaka lwekhanda luqukethe amathambo ayisishiyagalombili e-cranial namathambo obuso ayi-14. Amathambo ayisithupha akha ama-ossicles endlebeni ephakathi, kanti ithambo le-hyoid litholakala entanyeni ngaphansi kwe-mandible. Ikholomu ye-vertebral iqukethe amathambo angu-26, futhi lizungeza futhi livikele intambo yomgogodla. Ikheji lesifuba lakhiwe yi-sternum, izimbambo, amathambo esifuba, kanye ne-cartilage ebizayo. Uhlaka lwe-appendicular lwakhiwe yizitho zemilenze engenhla nengezansi. Ibhande lesifuba lakhiwe yi-clavicles kanye ne-scapulae. Uhlaka olungaphezulu luqukethe amathambo angu-30 engalweni, engalweni, nasesandleni. Uhlaka lwe-pelvic lunamathisela izitho ezingezansi kuhlaka lwe-axial. Uhlaka olungezansi luhlanganisa amathambo ethanga, umlenze, kanye nonyawo.

 29.2 Ithambo
Ithambo, noma izicubu ezinamathambo, yizicubu ezixhumanisayo ezihlanganisa amangqamuzana akhethekile, usawoti wamaminerali, kanye nemicu ye-collagen. Uhlaka lwethambo lomuntu lungahlukaniswa lube amathambo amade, amathambo amafushane, amathambo asicaba, namathambo angajwayelekile. Izicubu zethambo ezihlangene zakhiwe yi-osteon futhi zakha ungqimba lwangaphandle lwawo wonke amathambo. Izicubu zethambo ezine-spongy zakhiwe yi-trabeculae futhi zakha ingxenye yangaphakathi yawo wonke amathambo. Izinhlobo ezine zamaseli zakha izicubu ezinamathambo: ama-osteocytes, ama-osteoclasts, amaseli e-osteoprogenitor, kanye nama-osteoblasts. Ukwakheka kwethambo yinqubo yokwakheka kwamathambo yi-osteoblasts. Ukwakheka kwethambo ngaphakathi kwe-membrane yinqubo yokukhula kwamathambo kusuka kuma-membrane ane-fibrous. Ukwakheka kwe-endochondral yinqubo yokukhula kwamathambo kusuka ku-hyaline cartilage. Amathambo amade ayanda njengoba ama-chondrocyte ehlukana futhi ekhipha i-hyaline cartilage. Ama-Osteoblast athatha indawo ye-cartilage ngethambo. Ukukhula kwe-apppositional ukwanda kobubanzi bamathambo ngokufaka izicubu zamathambo ebusweni bamathambo. Ukulungiswa kwamathambo kuhilela izinqubo zokubekwa kwamathambo yi-osteoblasts kanye nokumuncwa kwamathambo yi-osteoclasts. Ukulungiswa kwamathambo kwenzeka ngezigaba ezine futhi kungathatha izinyanga eziningana.

 29.3 Amalunga kanye Nokunyakaza Kwamathambo
Ukuhlukaniswa kwesakhiwo kwamalunga kuwahlukanisa abe amalunga amathambo, ane-fibrous, ane-cartilaginous, kanye ne-synovial. Amathambo amalunga ane-fibrous abanjwe ndawonye yizicubu ezixhumene ne-fibrous; izinhlobo ezintathu zamalunga ane-fibrous yi-sutures, syndesomes, kanye ne-gomphoses. Amalunga e-cartilaginous amalunga lapho amathambo axhunyaniswa khona yi-cartilage; izinhlobo ezimbili zamalunga e-cartilaginous yi-synchondroses kanye ne-symphyses. Amalunga e-synovial amalunga anesikhala phakathi kwamathambo aseduze. Ukuhlukaniswa okusebenzayo kuhlukanisa amalunga ngezigaba ezintathu: i-synarthroses, i-amphiarthroses, kanye ne-diarthroses. Ukunyakaza kwamalunga e-synovial kungahlukaniswa njengolunye lwezinhlobo ezine ezahlukene: ukushelela, i-angular, i-rotational, noma ukunyakaza okukhethekile. Ukunyakaza okushelelayo kwenzeka njengoba izindawo zamathambo ezisicaba zihamba zidlulana. Ukunyakaza kwe-angular kukhiqizwa lapho i-angle phakathi kwamathambo elungu ishintsha. Ukunyakaza okujikelezayo ukunyakaza kwethambo njengoba lijikeleza ku-axis yalo ende. Ukunyakaza okukhethekile kufaka phakathi ukuguqulwa, ukuphenduka, ukuqhubekela phambili, ukuhoxa, ukuphakama, ukucindezeleka, i-dorsiflexion, i-plantar flexion, i-supination, i-pronation, kanye nokuphikiswa. Amalunga e-synovial nawo ahlukaniswe ngezigaba eziyisithupha ezahlukene ngokusekelwe esimweni nesakhiwo selungu: i-planar, i-hinge, i-pivot, i-condyloid, i-saddle, kanye ne-ball-and-socket.

 29.4 Ukugoba Kwemisipha Nokuhamba
Umzimba uqukethe izinhlobo ezintathu zezicubu zemisipha: imisipha yamathambo, imisipha yenhliziyo, kanye nemisipha ebushelelezi. Izicubu zemisipha yamathambo zakhiwe ngama-sarcomeres, amayunithi asebenzayo ezicubu zemisipha. Ukugoba kwemisipha kwenzeka lapho ama-sarcomeres efinyeza, njengoba imicu emincane nemincane ishelelana, okubizwa ngokuthi imodeli ye-sliding filament yogoba kwemisipha. I-ATP inikeza amandla okwakheka kwe-cross-bridge kanye nokugoba kwe-filament. Amaprotheni alawulayo, njenge-troponin ne-tropomyosin, alawula ukwakheka kwe-cross-bridge. Ukuhlanganiswa kwe-excitation-contraction kudlulisa isignali kagesi ye-neuron, nge-acetylcholine, kusignali kagesi ku-membrane yemisipha, eqala ukukhiqizwa kwamandla. Inani lemicu yemisipha egobayo linquma ukuthi imisipha yonke ikhiqiza amandla angakanani.
